Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.Schwab India DescriptionOur Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the regionWhat you haveRole DescriptionWe are looking for a Scrum Master who is passionate about agile delivery in the age of AI to join our Move Money transformation development team. This is an opportunity to work on an innovative money movement platform while building reliable, scalable, and advanced solutions to help our clients take ownership of their financial futures. The Scrum Master will provide effective collaboration, coordination, facilitation, leadership, and coaching skills supporting the agile development process and delivery of our applications. As an agile expert, the Scrum Master will be responsible for enforcing the agile tenants as interpreted by our team, removing impediments, and promoting empowerment. The Scrum Master position is highly responsible and accountable and will challenge the teams and strive to improve agile best practices. This position requires technical understanding of software development and technology and experience with complex project coordination.Key ResponsibilitiesAct as a Scrum Master for 1-2 Agile teams simultaneously.Provide leadership, direction and coaching to the team by encouraging them to adopt and mature good Scrum processes according to the Scrum Guide.Create an environment whereby the team is motivated, self-organizing and self-sufficient.Organize and facilitate effective Scrum meetings: backlog grooming, Sprint planning, daily Scrum, Sprint review, and Sprint retrospective.Encourage your teams to routinely inspect and adapt.Assist the team in establishing a consistent and predictable team level cadence (predictable velocity)Identify and facilitate the removal of team impediments and escalate as appropriate.Work with and coach Product Owners to develop, manage, and continuously groom the team’s product backlog.In partnership with the Product Owner, track and communicate to Stakeholders information such as team velocity, Sprint/release progress, impediments, team successes, etc.In coordination with Project Managers, facilitate cross-team coordination and collaboration when projects require it.Assist Product Owners and Project Managers with planning and grooming activities.Be a servant leader where you receive as much satisfaction from facilitating others’ success as your own.Foster an environment where creativity and empowerment can flourish.Improve the team’s engineering practices and tools as needed to help them succeed.Required Qualification-Servant Leadership – Able to garner respect from your teams, lead and demonstrate value-add principles, and willing and able to get your hands dirty to get the job done.Communicative and social skills – Able to communicate well with your Teams.Working experience with Schwab systems and processesEnthusiasm and high-energy.Continual improvement - Constantly learning new tools and techniques to grow your craft, yourself, and your Teams.Attitude of transparency – Desire and ability to bring disclosure and transparency to the business about development and grow trust between the business and development.Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or related field, or related experience.Fully educated and conversant on the Scrum process according to the Scrum Guide.A thorough understanding and appreciation for Agile values and principles.Thorough Understanding OfBacklog grooming and relative estimating.Release planning.Sprint planningScrum metrics such as Sprint burndown, release burnup, & velocity, to name a fewSprint review best practices and techniquesA variety of retrospective techniquesPrior experience as a Scrum Master.5+ years of experience in a software development environment preferably involving cross-team dependencies.5+ years of experience owning and managing customer expectations, project schedules, status and reporting and change management.Have led teams in a large, complex enterprise environment where successful projects potentially involve more than 1 Scrum team.Ability to apply a wide variety of patterns and techniques to enable the team to achieve success.Knowledge of project management fundamentals.Conflict resolution: Able to facilitate discussion of issues and different approaches and alternatives and effectively resolve issues in a timely manner. Facilitate: Able to lead and demonstrate value-add principles to a team.Assertive: Able to ensure Agile and Scrum concepts and principles are adhered to, be a voice of reason and authority, and make the tough calls.Situationally aware: Be the first to notice differences and issues as they arise and elevate them as appropriate.Attitude of empowerment: Able to lead a team to self-organization.Strong grasp of software development and technology.Preferred QualificationScrum Master certification.Experience with SAFe Agile frameworks.DevOps experience: continuous integration, continuous build, continuous delivery tools and techniques.ATDD, BDD, TDD, and pair programming, and other eXtreme Programming (XP) practices.Prior experience using Jira.Experience working in a highly regulated environment.Experience working in a financial services organization.Previous Schwab experience.What’s in it for youAt Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
  
  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
  
  
**Job Function**
R&D Product Development
  
  
**Job Sub Function**
R&D Software/Systems Engineering
  
  
**Job Category**
Scientific/Technology
  
  
**All Job Posting Locations:**

**Job Description**
**At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything.**
Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow and profoundly impact health for humanity.
  
  
**Sub Function**
Forward Deployed Engineering, Full Stack Product Engineering, Digital Solutions & Cloud Applications
  
  
**Location**
Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)
  
  
**Reports To**
Director, Product Engineering / ICC
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
Johnson & Johnson is seeking a highly capable Forward Deployed Engineer, Full Stack, Lead Engineer to work directly with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering partners to design, build, deploy, and operationalize modern digital solutions in real-world enterprise environments.
  
  
This role will serve as a hands-on technical lead embedded close to users and product teams, translating ambiguous business problems into secure, scalable, and production-ready full stack solutions. The successful candidate will bridge product strategy, solution architecture, engineering execution, deployment, adoption, and operational support across Clinical Development, R&D, Medical Affairs, and enterprise technology capabilities.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep full stack engineering expertise, strong systems thinking, customer-facing problem solving, cloud-native delivery experience, DevSecOps discipline, and the ability to rapidly prototype, harden, and scale solutions within regulated enterprise technology environments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Forward Deployed Engineering Leadership
  
  

* Act as the technical lead for customer-embedded delivery efforts, owning solution discovery, design, build, deployment, and adoption from concept to production.
* Lead by influence across product managers, architects, engineers, data teams, AI teams, cybersecurity, quality, and business stakeholders.
* Translate complex and evolving business needs into actionable technical designs, prototypes, integration patterns, and delivery plans.
* Mentor engineers on solution design, secure coding, debugging, technical decision-making, and production-readiness practices.

Full Stack Product Engineering
  
  

* Design and build modern web applications, APIs, services, workflow tools, dashboards, portals, automation components, and integration layers.
* Rapidly prototype solutions with users, validate value, iterate based on feedback, and convert prototypes into maintainable production-grade applications.
* Own implementation across front-end, back-end, API, database, identity, integration, observability, and deployment layers.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, accessible, performant, compliant, and aligned with enterprise architecture and platform standards.

Deployment, Integration & Enterprise Platforms
  
  

* Deploy and integrate solutions within complex enterprise environments, including legacy systems, cloud platforms, identity services, data platforms, and third-party applications.
* Apply cloud-native patterns, microservices, API-first design, event-driven integration, containerization, and managed services where appropriate.
* Troubleshoot production issues, resolve integration blockers, optimize performance, and address edge cases in live business workflows.
* Capture deployment learnings and convert them into reusable engineering patterns, product improvements, accelerators, and reference architectures.

DevSecOps & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, quality gates, security scans, infrastructure automation, and release management practices.
* Establish operational KPIs covering reliability, performance, deployment frequency, incident trends, and service health.
* Partner with cybersecurity, privacy, and quality teams to ensure secure software development lifecycle practices.
* Drive root cause analysis, technical debt reduction, application rationalization, and continuous platform improvement.

Stakeholder & Product Delivery
  
  

* Run discovery workshops, technical deep dives, and solution design sessions with business users, product owners, architects, and delivery teams.
* Communicate trade-offs, risks, technical options, and delivery progress clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Partner with product teams to convert field insights into backlog items, platform enhancements, roadmap inputs, and adoption strategies.
* Balance rapid delivery, business value, user adoption, security, compliance, quality, and long-term maintainability.

Compliance, Security & Quality
  
  

* Ensure applications comply with applicable enterprise security, privacy, quality, accessibility, and regulatory requirements.
* Support delivery practices aligned with GxP, Computer System Validation (CSV), GDPR, HIPAA, and internal J&J technology standards where applicable.
* Maintain audit-ready engineering documentation, traceability, and release evidence for regulated applications.
* Promote responsible use of data and AI-enabled capabilities within application experiences.

**Required Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Master's Degree preferred.

**Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in software engineering, full stack development, enterprise application delivery, solution engineering, or digital product engineering.
* 3+ years of experience as a technical lead, lead engineer, solution architect, forward deployed engineer, or senior hands-on engineering owner.
* Proven experience building and deploying production-grade full stack applications using modern front-end, back-end, API, database, and cloud technologies.
* Experience working directly with business users or customers to discover needs, design solutions, implement integrations, troubleshoot issues, and drive adoption.
* Experience with Agile delivery, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, release management, and production support practices.
* Experience in Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, Life Sciences, or other regulated industries preferred.

Technical Skills
  
  
**Front-End Engineering**
**Back-End & APIs**
**Cloud & DevSecOps**
**Engineering Practices**

* React / Angular / modern JavaScript frameworks
* TypeScript / JavaScript
* HTML5 / CSS3
* Responsive design
* Accessibility and UX collaboration
* Java / .NET / Node.js / Python
* REST APIs and microservices
* API security and authentication
* Relational and NoSQL databases
* Event-driven integrations
* Azure preferred / AWS
* Containers and Kubernetes
* CI/CD pipelines
* Infrastructure as Code
* Monitoring, logging, observability
* Secure SDLC
* Automated testing
* Code quality and reviews
* Agile delivery
* Architecture and design patterns
* Production support excellence

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering solutions for Clinical Development, R&D, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, enterprise data platforms, or internal business productivity use cases.
* Experience integrating applications with analytics platforms, AI services, workflow tools, enterprise identity, API gateways, and data products.
* Experience operating in ambiguous environments where requirements evolve and rapid experimentation is required to validate business value.
* Relevant certifications in Azure, AWS, software architecture, Agile, DevOps, cybersecurity, or application engineering.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to simplify complex technology topics, influence without authority, and build trust with stakeholders.

title: Salesforce Technical Lead
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late-stage pipeline. The company’s patient-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.
  
  
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Manager / Technical Lead to lead a high-performing Marketing Cloud and Experience Cloud team while serving as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders. This role requires strong people management, clear communication, and the ability to guide teams through complex architecture, development, delivery oversight, and strategic partnership. The ideal candidate is a strong technical leader and effective people manager who can mentor development teams, communicate complex ideas with clarity, drive innovation, and partner with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable, impactful solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Experience Cloud developers, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Oversee project delivery to ensure solutions are delivered on time, within budget, and at the highest quality standards.
* Manage project priorities, resource allocation, timelines, and client expectations across multiple engagements.
* Conduct code reviews and enforce development standards, best practices, and governance policies.
* Monitor team performance, utilization, and project metrics to drive operational excellence.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Aura, and Visualforce.
* Architect enterprise-grade solutions that effectively balance custom development with Salesforce platform capabilities and low-code/no-code approaches.
* Ensure adherence to Salesforce security, performance, data integrity, and platform architecture best practices.
* Lead integrations with third-party applications and services using APIs, Apex, and JavaScript frameworks.
* Partner closely with business teams on an ongoing basis to assess business challenges and recommend strategic Salesforce solutions that deliver measurable value.
* Present completed solutions and articulate technical concepts clearly to business stakeholders and technical audiences.
* Identify opportunities to expand client engagements and contribute to strategic revenue growth initiatives.
* Stay current with Salesforce platform releases, emerging technologies, and industry best practices.
* Evaluate and implement new tools, frameworks, and Salesforce capabilities to improve delivery efficiency and solution quality.
* Coach, mentor, and support professional development for junior and mid-level associates.
* Encourage certification attainment and continuous technical learning across the team.

Required Skills and Experience
  
  

* 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, including required experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud and Marketing Cloud.
* Proven experience leading and developing technical teams.
* Expert knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Salesforce Data Model, and Salesforce Security Model.
* Experience with Salesforce DX, Git version control, CI/CD deployment methodologies, and REST/SOAP APIs.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce platform architecture, governor limits, and scalable design principles.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining quality and client satisfaction.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Salesforce Platform Developer I and/or II certifications.
* Experience implementing enterprise integration and design patterns within Salesforce.
* Familiarity with UX/UI principles and the Lightning Design System.
* Experience working within Agile and EOS-based delivery environments.
* Experience supporting healthcare and pharmaceuticals.

By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

title: Software Project Manager Intern
description:
Software Project Manager Intern

**Company:**
Purple Business

**Website:**
https://purplebusiness.in

**Role:**
Software Project Manager Intern

**Department:**
Product & Engineering

**Location:**
Remote / Flexible

**Reporting To:**
Founder & Technical Leads

About Purple Business

Purple Business is an emerging AI startup building an AI-powered business growth platform to help small businesses grow through intelligent marketing, advertising, customer insights, and automation.

We're looking for a highly organized, proactive, and execution-focused
**Software Project Manager Intern**
to coordinate our technical teams, manage development workflows, track project progress, and ensure that engineering priorities are delivered efficiently.

You'll work closely with the founders, technical leads, Flutter developers, backend engineers, AI engineers, QA testers, and product designers to help build and launch the Purple Business platform.

Key Roles & Responsibilities1. Kanban & Trello Board Management

1. Create, organize, and maintain
   **Trello boards and Kanban workflows**
   for different engineering teams.
2. Break down large projects, features, and development requirements into smaller, actionable tasks.
3. Assign tasks to the appropriate team members in coordination with technical leads.
4. Maintain clear task statuses, including Backlog, To Do, In Progress, Review, Testing, Blocked, and Completed.
5. Ensure each task has a clear description, priority, owner, deadline, and expected deliverable.
6. Regularly update boards to reflect actual development progress.
7. Identify overdue tasks, blocked work, and incomplete deliverables.

2. Task Prioritization & Sprint Planning

1. Work with the founders and engineering leads to understand product priorities and upcoming development milestones.
2. Translate product requirements into actionable development plans and task lists.
3. Help plan weekly sprints, development cycles, and release milestones.
4. Prioritize tasks based on urgency, business impact, dependencies, and technical requirements.
5. Ensure critical product features and high-priority bugs receive appropriate attention.
6. Monitor sprint progress and coordinate adjustments when priorities change.

3. Workload & Resource Management

1. Monitor task allocation and workload distribution across developers and technical teams.
2. Identify overloaded team members and underutilized development capacity.
3. Help distribute responsibilities based on individual skills, availability, and project priorities.
4. Coordinate with technical leads to estimate task complexity and required development effort.
5. Identify dependencies between Flutter, backend, AI, and QA teams.
6. Recommend workload adjustments to improve efficiency and avoid unnecessary delays.

4. Progress Tracking & Team Communication

1. **Conduct frequent progress check-ins**
   with developers, AI engineers, and QA team members.
2. Organize regular standups, sprint reviews, and project coordination meetings.
3. Collect updates on completed tasks, ongoing development, blockers, and upcoming priorities.
4. Follow up on pending tasks and ensure team members communicate delays proactively.
5. Maintain visibility into the progress of individual features and overall product development.
6. Act as a communication bridge between the founders, engineering leads, and development teams.
7. Share regular progress reports and highlight issues requiring founder attention.

5. Deadlines & Project Delivery

1. Establish realistic deadlines and development milestones in collaboration with technical leads.
2. Track whether assigned tasks are progressing according to agreed timelines.
3. Identify potential delays early and coordinate appropriate corrective actions.
4. Ensure development work moves through implementation, code review, testing, and completion.
5. Coordinate with QA teams to track bugs, verify fixes, and support release readiness.
6. Help maintain release checklists and monitor progress toward product launch milestones.

6. Technical Project Documentation

1. Maintain organized project documentation, task descriptions, requirements, and meeting notes.
2. Document technical dependencies, blockers, decisions, and changes in project scope.
3. Ensure developers have sufficient information and acceptance criteria before starting tasks.
4. Maintain a clear overview of completed features, ongoing work, and upcoming development priorities.
5. Help create repeatable workflows and project management standards across technical teams.

7. Agile Process Improvement & Productivity

1. Apply
   **Agile, Scrum, and Kanban principles**
   to improve development coordination.
2. Identify inefficiencies in task management, communication, and engineering workflows.
3. Monitor delivery metrics such as task completion rates, cycle time, blocked tasks, and sprint predictability.
4. Research and implement project management best practices suitable for an early-stage technology startup.
5. Explore AI-powered tools and automation to improve task tracking, reporting, meeting summaries, and project coordination.
6. Work with the founders to continuously improve the productivity and execution efficiency of the engineering organization.

Requirements

* Strong organizational, communication, and coordination skills.
* Good understanding of
  **software development lifecycles (SDLC)**

description:

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
**Senior Project Manager - Project Controls**
Milestone is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Project Controls Business Analyst / Project Manager to support the financial, operational, and governance activities across a portfolio of Information Systems (IS) projects and programs. This role serves as a critical liaison between Project Managers, Portfolio Managers, Technology Leadership, Finance, Procurement, and external vendors to ensure accurate financial forecasting, project reporting, budget management, and portfolio governance.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong project controls expertise with business analysis, financial management, and PMO support capabilities. The role requires hands-on ownership of project financials, purchase order management, forecasting, vendor tracking, status reporting, and project governance activities while helping ensure alignment between project execution and broader organizational financial objectives.
  
  
This is a tactical execution-focused position that works directly with project and program teams to maintain financial discipline, reporting accuracy, and operational excellence across a diverse technology portfolio.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Financial Management & Controls**

* Develop and maintain project budgets, forecasts, and cost estimates for IS initiatives.
* Build and manage quarterly and ad hoc project financial forecasts.
* Monitor project expenditures and ensure spend aligns with approved budgets and forecasts.
* Track and manage Capital Expenditures (CapEx) and Operational Expenditures (OpEx).
* Maintain project balance sheets and assist with financial reconciliation activities.
* Support monthly and quarterly financial close processes.
* Create and maintain cost tracking models and financial dashboards.
* Analyze project financial performance and identify budget variances, risks, and cost-saving opportunities.
* Prepare and present financial reports for project teams, leadership, and portfolio stakeholders.
* Support Long-Range Estimates (LEs) and financial planning activities.
* Prepare and maintain Total Cost Management (TCM) reports and related financial controls documentation.
* Understand and communicate how project financials impact departmental budgets and overall P&L performance.

**Procurement, Vendor & Invoice Management**

* Create, submit, and track Purchase Orders (POs) throughout the procurement lifecycle.
* Partner with Procurement, Accounts Payable, and vendors to ensure timely PO processing and invoice payments.
* Review Statements of Work (SOWs), change orders, contract amendments, and vendor funding requests.
* Monitor vendor invoices for accuracy and alignment to contractual agreements.
* Investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies and payment issues.
* Conduct monthly vendor spend reviews and validate vendor cost reporting across multiple suppliers.
* Track committed costs versus actual expenditures and identify financial risks.
* Support vendor onboarding and purchasing processes using established company policies and procedures.

**Project Controls & Portfolio Governance**

* Establish and maintain project financial controls and governance processes.
* Monitor project performance metrics, budget adherence, resource allocations, and financial health indicators.
* Ensure project data, documentation, and reporting artifacts remain current and audit-ready.
* Maintain project repositories, PMO documentation, governance records, and portfolio data.
* Support project intake, funding approvals, and investment lifecycle management (ILM) activities.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise project management standards, processes, and controls.

**PMO & Program Support**

* Facilitate weekly and bi-weekly meetings with Project Managers, Program Managers, Portfolio Managers, and IS Leadership.
* Support program governance activities, reviews, and steering committee preparation.
* Coordinate status collection, reporting cycles, action items, decisions, and risk tracking.
* Review, maintain, and enhance project dashboards and portfolio reporting.
* Assist in the preparation and delivery of executive-level presentations and status communications.
* Manage project documentation repositories, PMO vaults, and project records.
* Support resource planning, project prioritization, and portfolio visibility initiatives.

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Prepare monthly project and portfolio dashboards highlighting budget, forecast, risks, milestones, and overall health.
* Create executive reporting packages and management presentations.
* Develop financial analyses that support strategic decision-making.
* Produce recurring and ad hoc reports related to project performance, vendor performance, financial trends, and portfolio metrics.
* Analyze complex data sets and present findings in a clear, business-focused format.
* Recommend process improvements to increase reporting accuracy and operational efficiency.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner closely with IS Leaders, Finance teams, Project Managers, Portfolio Managers, Procurement, and vendor partners.
* Build strong relationships with business and technical stakeholders.
* Facilitate discussions regarding budgets, forecasts, funding requests, prioritization, and project performance.
* Communicate project financial risks, assumptions, and recommendations to leadership.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Project Management, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 12+ years of experience supporting IT/IS projects in a Financial Analyst, Project Controls Analyst, Project Coordinator, Project Manager, PMO Analyst, or Business Analyst capacity.
* Experience managing project budgets, forecasting, financial reporting, and procurement processes.
* Working knowledge of project management methodologies, including Agile and Waterfall.
* Strong understanding of project financial controls, budgeting, CapEx, OpEx, and cost management practices.
* Experience with vendor management, purchase orders, invoices, contracts, and SOW administration.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, financial modeling, and reporting automation.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP, CAPM, PMI-PBA, Agile, Scrum, or related certifications.
* Experience supporting enterprise technology portfolios or PMO organizations.
* Experience with financial planning, portfolio management, and investment governance processes.
* Knowledge of IT financial management and technology investment practices.
* Experience working within large-scale infrastructure, digital transformation, ERP, cloud, or application development programs.

* Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook)
* Microsoft 365 / O365
* SAP

* Smartsheet

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.
  
  
At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate, serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.
  
  
**Team's Impact**
The Analytics API & MCP Platform team is responsible for delivering FactSet's analytics capabilities through scalable APIs, developer platforms, and AI-enabled solutions. The team enables clients, partners, and internal applications to access portfolio analytics, performance attribution, risk, and investment insights through modern integration channels including APIs, Power BI, Snowflake, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) applications.
  
  
Our mission is to create seamless, secure, and scalable experiences that help clients integrate FactSet analytics into their workflows, applications, and AI-powered solutions.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Associate Product Manager partners with clients, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve customer problems, and deliver impactful product outcomes. This role supports the full product lifecycle, including discovery, requirements definition, execution, launch, adoption, and ongoing product optimization.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical skills with a product mindset and is passionate about APIs, developer experiences, data integration platforms, and AI-enabled workflows.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Customer & Product Discovery**

* Gather and analyse feedback from clients, prospects, and internal stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, and product opportunities.
* Participate in product discovery activities, market research, and validation of new product concepts.
* Help define success metrics and measure product outcomes.

**Product Development & Execution**

* Define and document business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering, UX, and stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle.
* Support prioritization of enhancements, client requests, defects, and technical improvements.
* Participate in testing, release validation, and post-release monitoring to ensure product quality.

**Analytics API & MCP Platform Ownership**

* Develop deep expertise in Analytics APIs, MCP solutions, developer workflows, and platform capabilities.
* Support client onboarding, implementation, and adoption of Analytics API and MCP solutions.
* Troubleshoot product, integration, entitlement, authentication, and configuration issues.
* Act as a subject matter expert for internal stakeholders and client-facing teams.

**Adoption, Monitoring & Enablement**

* Monitor usage, client adoption, and key product health metrics.
* Help improve product instrumentation, analytics, and reporting capabilities.
* Create and maintain product documentation, knowledge base content, release communications, and onboarding materials.
* Support internal training and client enablement initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Product, Engineering, Consulting, Sales, Support, and Client Success teams to deliver successful outcomes.
* Contribute ideas that improve processes, product quality, scalability, and client experience.
* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and a continuous learning mindset.

**Required Qualifications**
**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
* 2-5 years of experience in Product Development, Product Management, Business Analysis, Financial Technology, or a related role.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working in Agile software development environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA and working knowledge on Python preffered
* Understanding of REST APIs, API lifecycle management, authentication, and developer workflows.
* Experience with API testing and troubleshooting tools (e.g., Postman).
* Familiarity with JSON, OpenAPI specifications, and technical documentation.
* Experience supporting integrations with Power BI, Snowflake, or similar analytics and data platforms.
* Exposure to AI, LLMs, MCP, copilots, or agent-based applications.
* Knowledge of portfolio analytics, performance attribution, risk analytics, or investment workflows.

**Key Competencies**
**Insights**

* Uses data, client feedback, and market research to identify product opportunities and drive decisions.

**Strategy**

* Understands how Analytics APIs, Snowflake, Power BI, and MCP capabilities support FactSet's broader platform strategy.

**Execution**

* Delivers high-quality product outcomes through strong requirements, prioritization, testing, and stakeholder collaboration.

**Technical Expertise**

* Develops expertise in APIs, data integration platforms, developer tooling, and AI-enabled workflows.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Influences through communication, data, and relationship building while effectively collaborating across cross-functional teams.

**Career Progression**
**Product Specialist → Senior Product Specialist → Associate Product Manager → Product Manager → Senior Product Manager**
**What's In It For You**
At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:
  
  

* The opportunity to join an S&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start-up.
* Support for your total well-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.
* Learn more about our benefits here.

Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, and certifications.
  
  
**Company Overview**
FactSet (NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn.
  
  
At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

title: Senior Manager, Product Manager (WT- Product Leader)
description:
Leads a team responsible for the strategic vision and roadmap for a digital product or products with cross-divisional impact, demonstrating a deep understanding of the digital product(s) and associated business areas. Digital products often have enterprise-wide implications.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
This role leads a team responsible for the strategic vision and roadmap for a digital product or products with cross-divisional impact, demonstrating a deep understanding of the digital product(s) and associated business areas. Digital products often have enterprise-wide implications. This role also incorporates market research and consumer trends to influence innovation, product direction, and cross-functional execution across the entire product life cycle.
  
  
**Responsibilites**

* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Oversees digital product management activities for multiple digital products, or one strategic product, with cross-divisional impact.
* Influences and collaborates with cross-functional teams to create best practices that drive significant change to the client experience.
* Provides guidance and coaches digital product teams towards best practices and learnings. Oversees digital product teams' support of the messaging, communication, and customer outreach as necessary.
* Facilitates strong business support through working with team members to promote a consistent approach to decisions/impacts and client propositions. Drives connection across all appropriate internal and external stakeholders.
* Leads the planning, development and implementation of new products with cross-divisional impact. Defines and analyzes markets, developing detailed product features and requirements, and developing implementation plans.
* Influences and employs a variety of qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience.
* Participates in and influences ongoing business planning and departmental prioritization activities.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Manages the entire product life cycle from strategy and planning through execution, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and customer needs.
* Conducts market research and analyzes consumer trends to identify opportunities for product innovation and enhancement.
* Defines key product features and functionality, and oversees execution by collaborating with cross-functional teams.
* Prepares product documentation and provides technical support to internal teams including sales and marketing.
* Leverages market and user feedback to evaluate existing product functionality and guide future roadmap decisions.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 10 years of experience in product management, with at least 3 years in innovation strategy and execution. Supervisory experience preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; Graduate degree preferred.
* Good to have skills in product lifecycle management, stakeholder engagement, market research, innovation strategy, and customer experience improvement. Strong understanding of digital product ecosystems and ability to work with engineering, marketing, and operations teams.
* Excellent communication, analytical thinking, problem-solving, team leadership, and time management skills.
* Preferred certifications include Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, or Product Management certifications from Pragmatic Institute or AIPMM.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

title: Sr. Product Manager, Operations Evaluation, Worldwide Returns and Recommerce
description:
**Description**
In the Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce (WW R&R) group at Amazon, we are dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ – zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects – to benefit our customers, company, and environment. We are an agile and inclusive organization that constantly innovates to create long-term value by investing in our people and our planet, not simply focusing on the bottom line.
  
  
WW R&R includes business, product, operations, data, and software engineering teams, who together manage the lifecycle of returned and damaged products. In WW R&R, you will partner across these teams to help customers get the most value out of Amazon’s products; improve the customer returns experience; and reduce defects, waste, and cost in reverse logistics processes. You will be a leader, a builder, and an owner, collaborating cross-functionally with technical, operations, and business teams to design scalable and automated solutions to customer problems.
  
  
Evaluation Automation charter is dedicated to grading every returned item with machine-learned precision instead of static rules, by building the science based scalable solutions that replace heuristic rules for sellability and recovery disposition thereby maximizing sellable yield, reducing associate subjectivity, and protecting the customer experience across Amazon's reverse logistics network.
  
  
We're looking for someone who has a passion for working in cross functional environment, strong communication skills (verbal & written) in addition to proven product management experience. Join us if you want the opportunity to make a big impact in a quickly growing team that can make a big difference in the customers' journey with Amazon.
  
  
Amazon is Earth’s most customer-centric company and in WW R&R, the Earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**
Create vision, product strategy, roadmap, and execution across a suite of return products to improve customer trust
  
  
Develop worldwide features with huge customer-facing and financial impact
  
  
Work with technology, customer service, returns operations, retail etc. to develop a comprehensive solution to fulfil the returns CX.

* 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
* Master's degree or equivalent

title: Sr. Product Manager-Tech, DSP-DA Lifecycle Solutions
description: DescriptionThe Sr. Product Manager-Tech on the DSP-DA LifeCycle Management (DALCM) team owns the end-to-end product strategy and execution for the critical milestones in the Delivery Service Partner (DSP) Delivery Associate (DA) lifecycle, including onboarding, off-boarding, qualifications management, and status management across Amazon's global transportation network. The DSP program is the backbone of Amazon's last-mile delivery network, operating in 22 countries with over 4,400 DSPs and 390,000+ Delivery Associates.This role is responsible for customer experiences with considerable complexity, managing a unified data platform that serves as the single source of truth for associate information. This includes ownership of multiple concurrent product workstreams — DSP DA onboarding/off-boarding workflow, DSP onboarding/off-boarding experience, employment classification models, qualifications management, and DA data/metadata services — each requiring distinct technical approaches and stakeholder alignment. The Sr. Product Manager-Tech is responsible for driving strategic goals that span multi-million dollar cost savings, DSP satisfaction (CSAT), and DA sentiment — influencing the DA experience from the very first interaction with Amazon's systems. You will own the financial entitlement for your product area and be accountable for measurable improvements in onboarding speed, compliance automation, and operational efficiency for DSPs worldwide.We are in the early stages of a multi-year initiative to overhaul much of the DA lifecycle experience from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to invent and simplify at scale — redesigning foundational systems and workflows that touch hundreds of thousands of drivers globally. The role comes with significant investment backing and outsized influence in shaping what the next-generation experience looks like.This is a global role requiring cross-regional coordination across all regions where the DSP program is established or will be established, each with distinct compliance requirements, legal frameworks, hiring models, and payment structures. The role requires distinguishing between one-way and two-way door decisions to drive rapid experimentation where possible while ensuring appropriate rigor for irreversible choices. The Sr. Product Manager-Tech serves as Voice of the Customer by generalizing requirements from diverse DSP DA personas across regions and use cases — working backward from their needs to reduce friction and time spent in onboarding and offboarding phases. Through direct engagement with DSPs, analysis of support tickets, and monitoring of operational health post-launch, the Sr. Product Manager-Tech gains insight that distinguishes between surface-level requests and underlying problems that truly matter. The Sr. Product Manager-Tech regularly drives product discussions with senior managers and Directors, producing clear documentation and contributing to OP1/OP2 planning cycles.We are seeking a PM with expertise and high judgment to determine the right goals, design long-term solutions, and take the lead on initiatives independently while seeking direction when needed. This role operates in a space where problems, opportunities, and strategy are not always clearly defined, and the right candidate will thrive in that ambiguity.Key job responsibilities Leading the build-out of new external facing applications, products, features and tools. Owning the translation of business intent, customer needs, and/or technical direction into clear, concise, well-documented business requirements or product backlog for one or more complex applications (or a product family) spanning one or more technical domains. Developing longer-term (12 months or more) product roadmap, ensuring product development plans align with and support stakeholder business and application objectives. Communicate and collaborate cross-functionally across multiple teams in operations, technology and planning to define strategic roadmaps while keeping the impact of the solution to all stakeholders in mind Creating and implementing data driven improvements to Amazon's transportation network Monitoring KPI’s to analyze their drivers and determine the level of investment neededAbout The TeamThe team consists of engineers, product managers, and program managers. These functions roll up into a shared VP with a shared goal of delivering the most efficient experience for our transportation partners.Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product 5+ years of end to end product delivery experience Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planningPreferred Qualifications Experience bridging technical and business teams to collect and refine requirements, prioritize incoming work requests, and ensure all committed work is delivered on time Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSightOur inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: User Assistance Developer 2
description:
**Job Description**
Oracle NetSuite is looking for an exceptional user assistance developer to create documentation for business software development tools. The ideal candidate has excellent writing and verbal communication skills, experience documenting business software, and a demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced development environment. You will join a team with significant opportunities for career growth and development. You will work in an AI-assisted authoring environment and use sound editorial judgment to ensure that documentation is accurate, clear, complete, and aligned with product information and documentation standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree and three or more years of experience as a user assistance developer, or equivalent transferable writing experience.
* Knowledge of technical communication techniques and standards.
* Excellent English-language, proofreading, editing, writing, and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail.
* Strong time-management and prioritization skills, including experience meeting tight deadlines and adapting to changing priorities.
* Experience working with report authoring tools.
* Experience with industry-standard financial and operational reports.
* Strong critical-thinking and editorial-review skills, including the ability to evaluate AI-assisted output for accuracy, completeness, bias, unsupported claims, and consistency with product information and documentation standards.
* Ability to validate information using authoritative sources and exercise sound judgment about when AI-assisted content requires additional research or subject-matter-expert review.
* Familiarity with prompt design, content-review workflows, and repeatable quality-assurance practices for AI-assisted documentation.
* Ability to learn and adapt to evolving authoring tools, content platforms, and documentation processes.
* Experience with, or strong interest in, writing developer documentation, including API documentation.
* Knowledge of XML authoring tools.

**Responsibilities:**

* Work closely with Product Management, Development, QA, and Technical Writing to successfully deliver assigned documentation projects.
* Proactively research product changes to determine the scope of edits for assigned documentation areas.
* Write new documentation based on use cases, user stories, feature requirements, specifications, information from developers and product managers, and hands-on use of the product.
* Use AI-assisted writing and development tools, such as ChatGPT, Codex, and Visual Studio Code, to support research, drafting, editing, analysis, and content maintenance.
* Validate AI-assisted output against authoritative product sources, including product behavior, requirements, specifications, and subject-matter-expert input.
* Apply strong editorial judgment to identify and correct hallucinations, unsupported claims, inconsistencies, ambiguity, outdated information, and deviations from documentation standards.
* Develop and refine effective prompts, reusable workflows, and quality checks that improve documentation quality and team efficiency.
* Maintain ownership of final content quality; AI-generated output is a starting point and does not replace writer review, product verification, or subject-matter-expert collaboration.
* Attend and actively contribute to writing and scrum team meetings.
* Partner with teams such as Support, Training, and Professional Services to understand and respond to customer documentation needs.
* Collaborate with other writers and cross-functional partners to establish responsible, scalable AI-assisted authoring practices.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: HR Partner, AWS
description:
**Description**
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a dynamic, growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided companies of all sizes with an infrastructure platform in the cloud. Using AWS, companies can requisition compute power, storage, and other services – gaining access to a global computing infrastructure that is the backbone of Amazon.com’s multi-billion-dollar retail business. Today, AWS provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers millions of active monthly customers from start-ups to multi-national corporations to governments.
  
  
At Amazon, we are committed to being Earth’s Best Employer and the most customer-centric company. To get there, we need exceptionally talented and empathetic leaders passionate about making every day better for all employees (Builders) – and you would play a key role in that journey! Our HR Partners care deeply about the employee experience and support builders and managers to focus on people through engagement, technology, and innovation.
  
  
The HR Partner role in our Builder Experience Team (BeXT) focuses on the Builder experience. You will be working with business teams and other cross-functional HR teams in driving and deploying strategies. Great opportunity for a highly motivated, self-directed individual to gain valuable HR experience in a fast-paced, dynamic, globally scaling organization - and have fun doing it as an Amazonian!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Consult, coach, develop, and support leadership through decision making with empathy and sound judgement; collaborating and actioning on talent management processes, people development and performance management, compensation, and Employee Relations issues.
* Foster and role model an environment of inclusion for all Builders.
* Advocate for Builders’ needs through end-to-end experiences that help Builders feel fully engaged in the work they do and valued for who they are.
* Equitably exercise high-judgement, manage through ambiguity and serve as first point of escalation for Builder concerns.
* Support Builder queries and situations with discretion and expertise navigating Amazon Policies and applying high judgement as necessary.
* Actively promote adoption of technology and self-service.
* Collaborate and influence multiple levels of the organization ranging from Builders to senior leaders.
* Conduct difficult workplace investigations in collaboration with Builder Relations.
* Coach HR new hires, mentor HR professionals, engaged in global projects and contribute to regional programs.

A day in the life
  
  

* Application of HR fundamentals.
* Problem solving and influencing in diverse populations.
* Working in a rapid and complex changing environment driven by continuous innovation.
* Influence change and foster an environment of inclusion for our Builders.
* Partnering with leaders at multiple levels of the organization to develop forward looking strategies and goals focused on the Builder experience.

**About The Team**
BeXT delivers personalized people-support to AWS Builders to amplify the voice of the Builder. In this role, you will collaborate with AWS business leaders and line HR teams to innovate, implement, and deploy HR strategies from customer service, talent and performance management, compensation, employee relations and other HR functions. In addition, you will provide support to our Builders and their leaders aligned to AWS flywheel(s) or region(s) calling on HR expertise and empathy.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or above in Human Resources, Human Resources Management, Labor Relations, Business/Management, Psychology, or a related field
* 7+ years of HR Generalist or HR Business Partner experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience consulting with senior leadership and executives in a fast-paced environment
* Experience in employee relations, labor relations, or labor/employment law
* Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
* Experience working with and protecting confidential and sensitive HR information
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Experience working with teams across APAC region
* Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and ability to translate data into actionable insights
* Intellectual curiosity; brings insight and fresh thinking to the team and business
* Demonstrated empathy in navigating complex people situations

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Software Development Manager
description:

Since 1998, Oracle NetSuite has been on a mission to deliver an agile, unified application suite that gives leaders a complete view into their business. Our team is growing, and we’re looking for people like you to help us make a global impact.

As the leading cloud business system, NetSuite includes financials, inventory management, HR, professional services automation, commerce, and more. Tens of thousands of customers all over the world trust NetSuite to give their businesses the visibility, agility, and control needed to make data-informed decisions quickly. **Our company culture:**

* We help each other and foster collaboration across roles and teams.
* We lift each other up. We know how to celebrate our successes and learn from our failures.
* Ideas are fragile and we consider them no matter how simple or outlandish.
* We always try to do the right thing – for ourselves, for the product and ultimately for our customers.

You'll work with awesome people that care about their craft and what they deliver. Your efforts will contribute to making things better for thousands of our customers.

You will collaborate strongly with our partners in Product Management, Security and Compliance – we’re all pulling in the same direction to deliver the secure, reliable software our customers want and need.

  

* People first.
* Manage a team of 7+ Engineers.
* Being open-minded for discussions and promoting team collaboration.
* Taking initiative, responsibility, and ownership of the projects.
* Driving continuous improvement of the team's productivity, product, and processes.
* Provide career growth and development opportunities for the team and build effective backup/succession plan to handle unanticipated attrition.

* Experience working with Quality Leads.
* Responsible for hiring of software engineers for agile development teams.
* Mentor, train and motivate software engineers to increase overall technical skillsets and stay current with technology trends.
* Drive the annual performance reviews and appraisal process for the team.
* Participate in the campus / Industry hiring drives.
* Work with team to resolve customer issues as per defined service level agreements.
* Able to successfully deliver committed features on time and meeting project objectives/deadlines.
* Participate in various scrum ceremonies such as Daily scrum calls , Sprint Planning, Sprint Retrospection

* Bachelor/Master degree in computer engineering or equivalent.

title: Senior UI-UX Designer
description:
**Job Description**

1. Design intuitive, easy-to-use user experiences and interfaces across a range of projects and applications, from concept through final execution
2. Partner with product managers to translate business requirements and user needs into practical, scalable product designs
3. Communicate design rationale and collaborate closely with engineers to ensure designs are technically feasible and adhere to established standards
4. Develop and maintain wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and detailed design specifications
5. Design visual assets — logos, icons, and other UI elements — for both in-product use and marketing purposes
6. Stay current with industry trends, emerging tools, and competitor products; communicate design concepts and prototypes clearly to developers and stakeholders
7. Conduct comparative UX audits of existing applications (internal and competitor) and design improved alternatives based on findings
8. Champion and help evolve the organization's design system, ensuring consistency across products
9. Mentor junior/mid-level designers and contribute to design process improvements
10. Conduct or coordinate usability testing and synthesize user research into actionable design decisions

**Skills & Requirements**

**Core Experience**

1. 8+ years of professional UI/UX design experience, with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design process
2. Deep proficiency in Figma (or equivalent tools like Sketch/Adobe XD), including auto-layout, components, variants, and prototyping
3. Proven experience designing for software products (SaaS, web apps, or enterprise platforms)
4. Hands-on experience building, contributing to, or scaling a design system (component libraries, tokens, style guides)
5. Strong understanding of interaction design, information architecture, and visual design fundamentals (typography, color, spacing, accessibility/WCAG standards)

**Tool Sets & Technical Familiarity**

1. Design & prototyping: Figma (Dev Mode, variables, plugins), FigJam, Framer, Principle, or ProtoPie for high-fidelity interactive prototypes
2. Design systems tooling: Storybook, Zeroheight, or similar for documenting and syncing design-to-code
3. Handoff & collaboration: Zeplin, Figma Dev Mode, Jira, Confluence, Linear
4. User research: Maze, UserTesting, Hotjar, FullStory, or similar for usability testing and behavioral analytics
5. Basic front-end literacy: working knowledge of HTML/CSS and enough JS/React vocabulary to have productive conversations with engineer about feasibility and constraints

**AI-Driven Design & Development Familiarity**

(increasingly essential at senior level)

1. Practical experience using AI tools within the design workflow — e.g., Figma AI, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney/DALL·E for concept exploration and asset generation
2. Familiarity with AI-assisted prototyping/code-gen tools (e.g., v0, Claude, Cursor, Lovable, Galileo AI) to rapidly translate designs into functional prototypes or accelerate handoff
3. Understanding of how generative AI is reshaping design workflows — using it for ideation, variant generation, copywriting, and user research synthesis — while knowing where human judgment must stay central (accessibility, ethical UX, brand nuance)
4. Experience designing AI-powered product features themselves (e.g., conversational UI, recommendation surfaces, human-in-the-loop patterns) is a strong plus
5. Comfort prompting and evaluating AI outputs critically, rather than treating them as a black box

**Additional Strengths That Matter at Senior Level**

1. Strategic thinking — able to push back on requirements and advocate for the user, not just execute specs
2. Strong storytelling and presentation skills for communicating design decisions to leadership and non-design stakeholders
3. Experience working in agile/cross-functional teams with tight iteration cycles
4. Data literacy — comfortable using analytics/experiment results (A/B tests, funnel data) to inform design choices

title: Application Delivery Lead
description:
The Application Development Lead (ADL) is responsible for overseeing delivery of high-profile software development initiatives under the defined jurisdiction. Responsibilities may include managing large projects or small project portfolios, leading architecture and design initiatives, and leading quality management processes aimed at ensuring incidents and other customer-impacting issues are handled efficiently and thoroughly.
  
  
When assigned to a large program, the ADL works directly with the program’s PMO team to deliver on program-specific goals while keeping development teams on track per Agile guidelines (including traditional Agile Scrum Master duties). The ADL also ensures technical continuity between the program and other areas of the business unit. This includes Salesforce teams, corporate technology support teams, and vendor resources that contribute to business-critical projects and significant technical initiatives.
  
  
Examples of the types of initiatives that might be led by the ADL include major technology migration or transformation, application and infrastructure security initiatives, and application performance governance including system availability and the management of incidents and problems. Given the diverse set of technical disciplines that the ADL may manage, the ideal candidate must have an equally diverse background including robust experience with application development as well as some exposure to other topics such as operations, infrastructure and DevOps.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead development resources across multiple disciplines
* Run all relevant Agile ceremonies
* Lead team of 8+ people
* Develop and maintain relationships with support and customer organizations
* Ensure in-scope incidents are tracked and resolved within SLA guidelines
* Establish and enforce sound development practices

* Familiar with application architecture concepts
* Continuous Integration & Delivery and DevOps philosophy
* Technical strategy and planning

* 10+ years in information technology
* Experience working in Agile environments; ideally using SAFe practices
* Scrum Master experience(4 yrs)
* Experience leading remote/offshore teams
* Experience establishing and managing vendor relationships
* Experience in complex, high-visibility programs
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Experience with Salesforce-integrated applications
* Ability to travel up to 30%
* People management Experience (minimum 3 years).
* Experience in creating Delivery plans.
* Good understanding of release management and risk management

* DSDM: Practitioner, Advanced Practitioner, trainer/Coach, Consultant

title: CX Analyst & Product Insights  (B2C, Tier-1) (GB04)
description: Roles & Responsibilities We’re building a central Design Thinking function at Bajaj Finance - a team that will play a defining role as the organisation pivots into a direct-to-consumer company. This role sits at the intersection of data and human understanding, and thrives in that grey zone. You’ll be the person who can stare at a funnel and see a human story. Who can sit with a field research readout and spot what’s missing. Who treats data not as an answer, but as a better question - and turns both into something the team can act on. What Your Work Looks Like- You’ll operate across the Design Thinking lifecycle — from signal to solution: Insight & Evidence: Journey analytics, Mining session replays, heatmaps, and behavioural data to surface where customers struggle and why. You bring statistical rigour — you know the difference between a pattern and noise, between correlation and causation, and you know when to trust the data and when to trust instinct. Challenge & Synthesis: You consume field research from dedicated research teams and stress-test it. You triangulate digital signals against qualitative findings, competitive benchmarks, and business metrics to build problem statements that hold up under scrutiny. You craft How Might We statements from clustered signals — framing the right questions that give the team a clear direction to solve against. Prototyping & Testing: You participate in solutioning — helping the team move from problem to prototype, designing tests, and closing the loop between what was hypothesised and what customers actually do. What Makes Someone Right for This- 4–8 years in consumer insights, CX analytics, product analytics, UX research, or a similar role in B2C or consumer-facing companies, where you’ve worked across quantitative and qualitative inputs Comfortable in analytics platforms — session replay, web/app analytics, funnel analysis, segmented and cohort analysis. Can layer behavioural data over system-of-record data to move beyond surface-level insights. Specific tools matter less than your ability to get depth from any tool quickly Understands statistical thinking — hypothesis testing, significance, when to apply rigour and when to move on intuition Can read, challenge, and build on qualitative research even if you’re not the one conducting it — you know what good methodology looks like and can spot when a finding is thin Structures findings into clear, concise arguments. You’ve presented to senior stakeholders and know the difference between showing data and making a case Thinks in systems — you connect a drop-off at step 3 to an upstream design choice, a policy constraint, and a downstream business metric without being told to SQL-literate — you can pull what you need or speak to data teams in their language Brings critical reasoning that stress-tests assumptions rather than confirming them RequirementsIdeal Candidate Strong Consumer Insights / CX Analytics / Product Insights profile (behavioral/user/product/UX analytics) Mandatory (Experience 1) - Must have 4+ years of experience in Customer Experience (CX) Analytics, Consumer Insights, Product Analytics, Behavioral Analytics, or UX Analytics, working on B2C digital products (Web/App) with a focus on understanding customer behavior, customer journeys, and experience improvement. Mandatory (Experience 2) - Must have hands-on experience analyzing customer journeys, behavioral funnels, digital interactions, session-level behavior, clickstream data, and experience metrics to identify pain points, drop-offs, and optimization opportunities. Mandatory (Experience 3) - Must have experience using CX and Digital Experience Analytics platforms such as Medallia, ContentSquare, Google Analytics (GA4) or similar tools for customer behavior analysis, journey mapping, and insight generation. Mandatory (Experience 4) - Must have experience working closely with Product, Design, CX, Business, Marketing, and Research teams to generate insights, validate hypotheses, and drive customer experience improvements. Mandatory (Experience 5 ) - Strong working knowledge of SQL and Python for data extraction, querying, analysis, exploratory data analysis, automation, and behavioral data interpretation. Ability to independently analyze large datasets, identify patterns, and generate actionable business insights. Mandatory (Experience 6): Understanding of hypothesis-driven thinking and basic experimentation/A/B testing concepts, including interpreting results and distinguishing between correlation and causation. Mandatory (Age)—The candidate's age should be below 28 years Preferred ( Experience 1) - Candidates from product-based companies (B2C preferred) OR Data Analytics Service companies like Mu Sigma etc Experience: 3–6 years · Work from office · 5 days a week + alternate Saturdays · Notice period up to 30 days BenefitsOur people define our passion and our audacious, incredibly rewarding achievements. Bajaj Finance Limited is one of India’s most diversified Non-banking financial companies, and among Asia’s top 10 Large workplaces. If you have the drive to get ahead, we can help find you an opportunity at any of the 500+ locations we’re present in India.
