title: Engineering Manager - Consumer Intelligence & Engagement
description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION:**
**About the Organisation & Role:**
You will be part of the Consumer Intelligence & Engagement organisation responsible for delivering the intelligence and engagement capabilities that enable more relevant and personalised consumer experiences across digital channels. The organisation plays a key role in how consumers discover products, engage with content, and elevate experiences through membership & loyalty. Through capabilities such as personalisation, recommendations, consumer intelligence, experimentation, and AI-driven decisioning, the organisation helps deliver more contextual, data-driven interactions across the consumer journey.
  
  
The Engineering Manager is accountable for engineering delivery, roadmap execution, operational excellence, and engineering team development. Partnering with Product Owners, Data Engineering & Analytics, Tech Leads, and peer engineering teams, you will enable predictable delivery, grow engineering talent, and build a high-performing culture focused on ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Lead and develop a team of software engineers building product discovery experiences, including search, browse, merchandising, recommendations and consumer engagement capabilities.
* Enable the delivery of scalable, reliable and reusable services that power product discovery, content discovery and consumer engagement experiences across digital channels.
* Drive continuous improvement of search, browse, recommendation and merchandising experiences through experimentation, analytics, and consumer behavioral insights in collaboration with Product & Merchandising team.
* Partner with Product, Merchandising, Data Engineering, and Consumer Experience teams to improve product findability, discovery effectiveness, consumer engagement, and conversion outcomes.
* Drive planning and execution against team objectives and key results (OKRs), ensuring alignment, accountability and transparent reporting.
* Own sprint execution, delivery planning, capacity management, dependency management, and risk management.
* Drive engineering excellence through strong development practices, quality standards, operational discipline and continuous improvement.
* Coach engineers through regular feedback, mentoring, performance management, and career development.
* Build a high-performing engineering culture focused on ownership, accountability, collaboration, and learning.
* Establish effective engineering metrics and use data to improve team productivity, quality, and delivery predictability.
* Drive adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices and automation to improve productivity, quality, and delivery efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI across software development, testing, documentation, knowledge management and onboarding.
* Collaborate with engineering leadership on hiring, staffing, onboarding, talent development, and succession planning.
* Manage delivery partners and vendors where applicable and ensure alignment with team objectives.

**YOUR TALENT:**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, with experience leading engineering teams in an agile delivery environment.
* 3+ years of people leadership experience.
* Strong experience leading roadmap execution, delivery planning, dependency management, and stakeholder engagement.
* Strong people leadership skills with experience in hiring, mentoring, developing, and retaining high-performing engineering teams.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices including software architecture & engineering principles, code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, and AI-assisted development.
* Strong communication, collaboration, decision-making, and organisational leadership skills.
* Experience driving engineering quality, operational excellence, reliability, security, and continuous improvement.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments using tools such as Jira & Confluence or equivalent.
* A data-driven mindset with the ability to use engineering, delivery, and operational metrics to improve team effectiveness and predictability.
* Experience working with search, browse, recommendations, merchandising and product discovery capabilities.
* Experience working with consumer behavioural data, experimentation platforms, product catalogues, search technologies, recommendation engines, or personalization platforms will be a plus.
* Experience leveraging coding agents, LLMs, and AI-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery and team productivity will be a strong advantage.
* Experience in global DTC, retail, omnichannel commerce or high-volume consumer digital environment preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field.

title: SAP CML Test Engineer
description:
**Position Overview**
**Job Title: SAP CML Test Engineer**
**Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President**
**Location: Pune, India**
**Role Description**

* As an SAP CML Test Engineer, you will be a crucial member of our cross-functional team, ensuring the quality, stability, and performance of our core Lending applications. You will leverage your expertise in both mortgages business processes and SAP CML to design, execute, and document comprehensive testing strategies. You will collaborate closely with Requirements Engineers, Developers and Application Managers in both Pune and Frankfurt to verify and secure the technology solutions that support Deutsche Bank's lending operations.
* The Lending Platforms team is a global unit responsible for the development, enhancement, and maintenance of Deutsche Bank's core lending systems. As a critical function within our Private Bank Technology division, we manage the lifecycle of loan products on the SAP CML (Consumer and Mortgage Loans) platform. Our team is strategically located in Frankfurt and Pune, fostering a collaborative, multinational environment to deliver robust and innovative solutions for our business partners.

**What We’ll Offer You**
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,
  
  

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Test Strategy and Planning: Deliver a strong contribution with the test team, which will develop, document, and maintain functional and non-functional test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on business requirements and technical specifications.
* Test Execution: Execute manual and automated tests for SAP CML and integrated systems, covering all phases of testing including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Regression Testing.
* Defect Management: Identify, log, and track defects with precision. Collaborate with development teams to analyze root causes and ensure timely resolution and re-testing.
* Domain Expertise: Apply your in-depth knowledge of the mortgages business lifecycle (origination, servicing, closure) to create/manage realistic and effective test scenarios.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work in close partnership with a multi-national team of Requirements Engineers, Developers and Application Managers across Pune and Frankfurt to ensure a shared understanding of requirements and quality standards.
* Reporting and Documentation: Contribute to providing clear, concise, and timely reporting on test progress, defect status, and overall quality to project stakeholders. Maintain comprehensive test documentation.
* Process Improvement: Contribute to the continuous improvement of our testing processes, methodologies, and tools.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* SAP CML Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience in testing SAP Consumer and Mortgage Loans (CML) module. Strong understanding of CML configuration, processes, and integration points.
* Testing Proficiency: Minimum of 2+ years in a dedicated software testing role with a strong grasp of QA methodologies, tools, and processes (STLC, SDLC).
* Mortgages Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of the end-to-end mortgage lending business process, from application and underwriting to servicing and securitization.
* Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed, multi-national team environment across different time zones.
* Analytical Mindset: Analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.

**Advantageous / Nice to Have**

* Test Management Tools: Familiarity with test management tools, particularly Tricentis Test, for planning and tracking test execution.
* Test Automation Tools: Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks, especially Tricentis Tosca, for creating and maintaining automated test suites.
* Certifications: ISTQB/ISEB or other relevant software testing certifications.
* Agile Experience: Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment.
* Broader SAP Knowledge: Experience with other SAP Banking Services modules (e.g., SAP BP, BCA) or FI/CO is a plus.
* German language skills: would be regarded as a plus point.

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**
**How We’ll Support You**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career.
* Coaching and support from experts in your team.
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

**About Us And Our Teams**
Please visit our company website for further information:
  
  
**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**
We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
  
  
Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

title: Software Engineer - Team Leader
description:
**Who We Are**
Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
  
  
Long Description
  
  
**Who Are We Looking For**
We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:
  
  

* Technical Proficiency: A lead developer should have a deep understanding of the technologies used in the project. They should be able to write clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
* Leadership: They should be able to guide and mentor other developers in the team. They should be able to delegate tasks effectively and ensure that the team is working towards the project goals.
* Communication: A lead developer should have excellent communication skills. They should be able to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Problem Solving: They should be able to identify and solve problems quickly and efficiently. They should also be able to anticipate potential issues and take proactive measures to prevent them.
* Collaboration: A lead developer should be able to work well with others. They should be able to collaborate effectively with other teams and stakeholders.
* Continuous Learning: Technology is always evolving, and a lead developer should be committed to continuous learning and improvement. They should be open to new ideas and technologies.
* Quality Assurance: They should be responsible for ensuring the quality of the code produced by the team. They should enforce coding standards and best practices, and should also be involved in code reviews.
* Project Management: A lead developer should have a good understanding of project management principles. They should be able to manage resources effectively, meet deadlines, and deliver projects on time and within budget.
* Ethics: They should adhere to the ethical standards of the software development profession. They should respect intellectual property rights, maintain confidentiality, and avoid conflicts of interest.
* Innovation: A lead developer should be innovative and creative. They should be able to come up with new ideas to improve the product or the development process.

**Must have**

* Sense of ownership and technical responsibility on the team's software
* Technical expertise in .NET Core and practices surrounding it as well as the faculty to spread them in the team.
* Experience with SCRUM methodology and participation to the backlog construction, refinement and sprint planning, in order to help estimate and plan work items.
* Contribution to the development of organizational policies, standards, and guidelines for software development.
* Experience in software design in complex, high throughput, real time and 0 downtime context aligned with architectural guidelines and documented precisely.
* Ensures team software respect functionally but also non functionally (Security, Performance, Resilience, etc...) the requirements Experience with DevOps tooling and practices (CI/CD pipelines, Git, 4 eyes principle or canary releases) Experience troubleshooting complex systems in case of bug, incident or test result failures.
* Experience with SOA and API contract definitions and preferably in a micro services architecture context.
* Experience with testing techniques and automation such as BDD, TDD, etc... allowing the lead developer to design test cases covering complex or non functional test cases.
* Continuous improvement mindset.

**Shape the evolution**
We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
  
  
Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com
  
  
We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

description:

We are seeking an experienced and passionate Scrum Master to be the agile leader and performance coach for our engineering development teams. In this role, you will champion a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and predictable delivery. You will be the hands-on partner to your teams, empowering them to deliver high-quality, valuable software while fostering an environment where they can do their best work. If you are passionate about building teams that are both happy 
*and*
high-performing, and you thrive on guiding people to achieve tangible results, this is the role for you.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Empower the team to run their own team ceremonies by providing the necessary support, tools, and guidance. Acting as a supportive figure to ensure meetings become team-led, productive, and value-driven.
* ensuring they are engaging, productive, and focused on delivering value.
* Act as a subject matter expert on lean and agile principles, ensuring the team to develop, own, and refine an effective process that consistently delivers value based on the chosen frameworks principles and practices.
* Promote transparency by maintaining clear reporting and visible Agile dashboards (e.g., burn-down charts, flow metrics), making the team's progress and challenges understood by all.
* Coach the team towards greater self-organization, cross-functional collaboration, and a strong sense of ownership for their outcomes.
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement, guiding the team to use metrics to identify and solve bottlenecks or delays in their workflow
* Partner closely with the Product Owner to ensure the product backlog is healthy, well-groomed, and prioritized to deliver maximum business value.
* Proactively identify, track, and relentlessly remove impediments and risks that are impacting the team's progress, protecting their flow and productivity.
* Act as a key collaborative partner to the Agile Delivery Manager (ADM), providing on-the-ground visibility into team-level risks and working together to resolve systemic, domain-level blockers.
* Facilitate productive communication and collaboration between the team and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment and clear expectations.

**Your Qualifications**

* Proven Experience: 3+ years of dedicated experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach in a software development environment, with a track record of improving team performance and health.
* Deep Agile Knowledge: Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent certification is required. You have a deep understanding of the principles behind Scrum, Kanban, and other agile methodologies, and you know when and how to apply them to get results.
* A Coach's Mindset: You don't just facilitate; you coach. You have demonstrable experience mentoring teams and individuals to foster self-organization and a growth mindset. You are an empathetic listener and a powerful question-asker.
* Data-Driven Facilitator: You are comfortable using agile metrics not as a report card, but as a tool to help teams have insightful conversations and drive their own improvement.
* Exceptional Communicator: You have excellent moderation, facilitation, and conflict-resolution skills. You can communicate complex topics clearly and effectively to a variety of audiences, from engineering teams to stakeholders.
* Technical Fluency: You are proficient with agile project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence).

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

title: Software Development Project Lead
description:
**Be a Part of the Technology Revolution**
There has never been a more exciting time to be part of an automotive technology company like Visteon. No industry offers more fast-paced change and opportunity than today’s automotive industry. We are in the midst of a mobility revolution that will completely change the way we interact with our vehicles, reduce the number of car accidents and fatalities, and make the world a cleaner place. Visteon is at the epicenter of this mobility revolution. Two major trends in the automotive industry – the shift to electric vehicles and vehicles with autonomous safety technologies – have created unique opportunities for Visteon. We are the only automotive provider solely focused exclusively on cockpit electronics – the fastest-growing segment in the industry.
  
  
**Key objectives of this Role:**

* Experience leading large design & architecture of automotive embedded products is preferred.
* Knowledgeable in different products (Cluster, Display, ADAS).
* Knowledgeable in large project management and delivery.
* Work independently and collaboratively with multiple teams.
* Communication with rationale and build consensus with stakeholders.
* Prioritize and manage work to critical project timelines in a fast-paced environment.
* Develop new approaches to complex design problems.
* High level of domain expertise.
* Lead overall project delivery and coordination across projects / multiple internal teams.
* Leverage project management skills and understanding of multiple domains/technology to balance projects with varying schedules and priorities.
* Sustain and lead efforts in High Level Design (HLD) through complete ownership and commitment to quality standards. Act as the single point of contact for all aspects relating to HLD.
* Understand and review business requirements with the software delivery team, leveraging their knowledge of multiple domains.
* Work on assigning the requirements between different tech teams internally, identifying the interfaces and dependencies. Work to ensure there is a clear channel of communication between teams to meet deliveries.
* Work with the architects to define project-specific architectures. Understand and contribute to the technical solution from design through to code level. Analyze technical issues and guide the teams to find solutions.
* Lead project-focused technical discussions between the domains and internal teams. Work with the integration and testing teams on triaging of defects with accurate assignment of defects and analysis of complex defects that would overlap multiple domains.
* Work with external vendors/suppliers on tools and other software. Support supplier quality and assessments with other internal teams.

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* On-Time Delivery: Achieve 85% or higher on-time delivery of customer milestones. Tracked on a sprint level.
* Code Coverage Metric: Percentage of Code Covered by Testing, Maintain code coverage at 85% or higher. Regularly monitored during each development cycle.
* Static Analysis KPI assessed at the end of each development iteration.
* Global Team Collaboration: Frequency and Effectiveness of Collaboration with Global Teams

**Qualifications, Experience, and Skills:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent in Computer engineering, Electronics Communication Engineering or mechatronics or equivalent.
* 10+ years of software experience.

**Desired Competencies:**

* Detail Oriented: Capable of carrying out a given task with all details necessary to get the task done well.
* Dedicated: Devoted to a task or purpose with loyalty or integrity.
* Organized: Eye for detail and can put across ideas in a tangible form.
* Goal Completion: Inspired to perform well by the completion of tasks.
* Ability to Make an Impact: Inspired to perform well by the ability to contribute to the success of a project or the organization.

title: Graphic Designer Global Learning Talent Services Contract Role
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Position: Graphics Designer – Senior Associate**
**Education:**
Any Graduate
  
  
**Experience:**
5 – 8 years of relevant experience
  
  
**The Opportunity**
This position will support the design and development of engaging visual content for eLearning modules and other digital learning materials. The Graphics Designer will work to agreed design quality standards and processes, using approved templates and tools, and will collaborate with other designers and learning professionals to enhance the quality and effectiveness of visual learning solutions. Additionally, the designer will develop and maintain strong relationships with content owners, Subject Matter Reviewers (SMRs), and other stakeholders.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Proficiently create and customize eLearning modules using development tools, implementing interactive elements and assessments.
* Independently produce high-quality graphic designs and layouts, mentoring junior designers in the process.
* Manage LMS content areas, troubleshooting issues and providing user support while mentoring others in LMS usage.
* Design and implement interactive elements for eLearning modules, creating complex interactive experiences.
* Produce animations and videos, including storyboarding, editing, and post-production, contributing to creative brainstorming sessions.
* Create a wide range of visual assets, including complex graphics and illustrations, guiding junior designers in asset production.
* Design sophisticated typographic and layout solutions, setting benchmarks for quality and brand compliance.
* Ensure all designs meet accessibility standards, advocating for inclusive design practices and mentoring others in best practices.
* Design and implement gamification strategies within eLearning modules to enhance engagement and learning retention.
* Craft compelling visual narratives that align with project messages and goals, developing storyboards and providing creative direction.
* Apply design principles to enhance project outcomes, mentoring junior designers in effective design practices.
* Communicate design ideas clearly, gathering feedback effectively and engaging in collaborative discussions.
* Translate complex storyboards into detailed visual designs that enhance learning, providing guidance to junior designers.
* Conduct thorough quality assurance reviews, ensuring visual consistency and functionality of eLearning materials.
* Audit design work for brand compliance, mentoring junior designers on adherence to brand standards.
* Facilitate effective teamwork by coordinating tasks and supporting team members, taking a proactive role in projects.
* Adapt designs in response to feedback and evolving project requirements, proactively seeking solutions to design challenges.
* Build strong relationships with SMRs and project teams, effectively gathering requirements and incorporating feedback.
* Provide mentorship to junior designers, leading by example in design projects and supporting their professional development.
* Foresee and proactively deal with challenges in projects

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with content owners, SMRs, and other stakeholders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate design concepts and engage in collaborative feedback.
* Ability to adapt to a constantly changing and growing business environment.
* Good problem-solving skills and a customer service-focused mindset.
* Proactive in mentoring junior team members and facilitating effective teamwork.

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* 5 to 8 years of experience in graphic design and eLearning development.
* Advanced proficiency with graphic design software and eLearning development tools which must include:

+ Articulate Rise & Storyline 360
+ MS Word, PowerPoint, and whiteboarding applications (ie Miro/Mural/MS Whiteboard)
+ Videos
+ Adobe (iPDFs/Flipbooks)

* A foundational understanding of LMS platforms and content management.
* Experience building and maintaining strong relationships with business customers/clients.
* Ability to work in fast-paced, stressful environments to deliver required results.

**What We Look For**

* An experienced graphics designer who can support multiple projects concurrently.
* A professional who can quickly problem-solve and offer perspective on solutions.
* A professional who demonstrates resilience and is energized by working in a global environment, proactively seeking different opinions and valuing diverse perspectives.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Product Designer
description:
We're looking for a
**highly independent, product-minded designer**
who can take complete ownership of design at Pinegap, spanning Product Design, UI/UX, interaction design, and rapid prototyping.

This is not a role where you'll simply receive requirements and turn them into Figma screens. We want someone who can understand complex problems, challenge assumptions, think from first principles, and independently translate ideas into exceptional product experiences. You'll work closely with the founders, product, and engineering teams, with significant ownership over how our products look, feel, and function.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **End-to-End Design Ownership:**
  Independently own product design across our web platform, AI agents, research dashboards, and internal tools, from ideation to final implementation.
* **UI/UX & Product Thinking:**
  Translate complex financial research workflows into intuitive, elegant, and scalable user experiences.
* **AI-Native Product Design:**
  Design interfaces for AI-powered products, including conversational experiences, agentic workflows, and human-AI interactions.
* **Rapid Prototyping:**
  Use AI-powered tools to rapidly convert ideas into interactive, functional prototypes and validate concepts before engineering implementation.
* **Design Systems:**
  Build and maintain consistent design systems, reusable components, and interaction patterns.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Work directly with founders, engineers, and product stakeholders to shape product direction and execute design initiatives.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Proactively identify UX gaps, recommend improvements, and drive initiatives without waiting for detailed instructions.

**What We're Looking For**

**Product Design Experience**

* Proven experience designing and shipping complex web-based products, preferably in AI, B2B SaaS, fintech, or enterprise software.
* Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, interaction design, information architecture, and design systems.
* Experience working on AI-native products, particularly LLM-powered applications, AI agents, or conversational interfaces.
* Ability to simplify complex workflows and large amounts of information into clean, intuitive interfaces.

**Tools & Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Figma, including advanced prototyping, components, and design systems.
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted design and prototyping tools such as Claude, Figma Make, Cursor, v0, Lovable, or similar platforms.
* Ability to build interactive or functional prototypes using AI-assisted coding tools.
* Basic understanding of frontend technologies such as HTML, CSS, React, or Tailwind is a strong advantage.
* Comfortable collaborating with engineering teams and understanding technical constraints.

**Mindset & Ownership**

* **High Accountability:**
  Takes full responsibility for deliverables, timelines, and design quality.
* **Independent Execution:**
  Comfortable operating with minimal supervision and ambiguous requirements.
* **Critical Thinking:**
  Challenges assumptions, asks the right questions, and focuses on solving underlying user problems.
* **Bias for Action:**
  Moves quickly from problem identification to prototypes, testing, and implementation.
* **Product-First Approach:**
  Thinks beyond aesthetics and understands how design impacts usability, adoption, and business outcomes.
* **Proactive Communication:**
  Can independently collaborate with distributed teams and communicate design decisions effectively.

**Preferred Background**

* Experience working in early-stage startups or high-ownership product teams.
* Prior experience building AI-powered or data-intensive B2B SaaS products.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership, problem-solving, and shipped products.
* Experience working directly with founders and engineering teams.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to accelerate design and prototype development.

**Why Join Pinegap?**

* **Own the Design Function:**
  Take significant ownership of product design and influence the direction of our platform.
* **Build at the AI Frontier:**
  Work on real-world applications of LLMs and AI agents for institutional investment research.
* **Work with Global Customers:**
  Design products used by sophisticated investment professionals and funds worldwide.
* **High-Impact Role:**
  Work directly with founders and engineering teams, with minimal bureaucracy and fast decision-making.
* **Build, Experiment, Ship:**
  Join an environment where ideas can quickly become working products.

**Important Requirements**

* This is a
  **full-time, work-from-office role in Bengaluru**
  .
* Candidates must be comfortable with working hours that provide meaningful overlap with US Eastern Time.
* We are specifically looking for someone who can work independently with limited guidance and take end-to-end responsibility for design.
* A portfolio showcasing product design, problem-solving, and preferably AI-powered prototypes is required.

**How to Apply**

**If you're a product designer who loves solving complex problems, experimenting with AI tools, and building products from scratch, we'd love to hear from you.**

**Please share your CV, portfolio, and examples of AI-powered prototypes or products you've worked on**
at hiring@pinegap.us

Our client is an established U.S.-based FinTech and payments technology company providing merchant payment processing, Point-of-Sale (POS) systems, e-commerce payment gateways, and business technology solutions to small and midsize businesses (SMBs) across the United States.
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on
**Digital Marketing Manager**
based in
**Bengaluru**
to spearhead B2B demand generation targeting U.S. business owners, build and manage a high-performing local marketing team, and drive measurable customer acquisition.
  
  
**About The Role**
This is a player-coach role combining
**U.S. B2B marketing strategy, hands-on campaign execution, and team leadership**
. You will oversee paid performance marketing, organic social media, content, SEO/GEO, email marketing, and lead-generation funnels while collaborating closely with the U.S. sales and leadership teams.
  
  
As the Bengaluru team scales, you will manage graphic designers, video editors/creators, SEO specialists, and other marketing contributors. Your primary objective is to generate a consistent pipeline of qualified U.S. merchant leads and optimize conversion through to activated customers.
  
  
Key Responsibilities1. U.S. B2B Marketing Strategy
  
  

* Develop and execute full-funnel digital marketing strategies targeting U.S. business owners and decision-makers across retail, hospitality, e-commerce, and service sectors.
* Craft segment-specific campaigns, offers, and high-converting landing pages for payment processing, POS hardware/software, and e-commerce solutions.
* Own monthly marketing plans, budget allocation, content calendars, and pipeline targets.
* Paid Advertising & Performance Lead Generation
* Hands-on launch, management, and optimization of paid acquisition campaigns across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook & Instagram), and LinkedIn.
* Test and scale additional video and retargeting channels including YouTube and TikTok.
* Evaluate, test, and manage emerging AI search & ad placements (including ChatGPT search/ad opportunities and AI discovery platforms) focused on qualified merchant acquisition and ROAS.
* Own keyword research, audience segmentation, ad copywriting, creative A/B testing, bidding strategies, and landing page conversion rate optimization (CRO).
* Optimize campaigns strictly around Cost Per Qualified Lead (CPQL), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
* Social Media, Content & Video Direction
* Lead an engaging organic social strategy across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and TikTok tailored to U.S. SMB owners.
* Direct the creation of performance graphics, short-form reels/videos, product demos, merchant testimonials, and educational content.
* Write clear creative briefs and review output from designers and video editors to ensure U.S.-market polish, accuracy, and brand consistency.
* SEO, Website & AI Search Optimization (AEO/GEO)
* Oversee technical and on-page SEO strategy, keyword research, and authoritative content creation that drives organic discovery across both traditional search engines (Google) and AI-powered search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini).
* Continuously improve website messaging, UX flow, forms, and landing-page conversion rates.
* Email Marketing, CRM & U.S. Sales Alignment
* Build automated email nurturing sequences, drip campaigns, and prospect re-engagement flows.
* Connect marketing attribution directly to CRM outcomes—tracking booked appointments, merchant applications, and activated accounts.
* Partner closely with the U.S. sales team (with agreed overlap hours) to tighten lead quality definitions, handoff speed, and offer messaging.
* Team Leadership & Analytics
* Recruit, onboard, coach, and manage a growing in-house team of designers, video editors, and SEO specialists (plus external freelancers/agencies as needed).
* Maintain end-to-end tracking using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), ad pixels, UTM frameworks, and CRM dashboards.
* Deliver clear weekly/monthly reporting on spend, CPQL, CAC, conversion rates, and revenue attribution.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* U.S. B2B Marketing Experience: Proven track record of running digital marketing and lead generation specifically targeting U.S. B2B or U.S. SMB customers.
* Paid Media Mastery: Hands-on execution expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads, plus working proficiency across LinkedIn, YouTube, and TikTok.
* AI & Emerging Search Awareness: Strong understanding of AI-driven search discovery (AEO/GEO) and emerging ad placements on platforms like ChatGPT.
* Full-Stack Funnel Skills: Practical command of SEO, WordPress/landing page CRO, email automation, GA4, GTM, and CRM attribution.
* Team Management: Experience leading or reviewing the work of graphic designers, video editors, and SEO/content specialists.
* Communication & Schedule: Exceptional written and spoken English tailored for American business audiences, with comfort working in-person in Bengaluru and maintaining agreed overlap hours with the U.S. team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in FinTech, Merchant Services, Payment Processing, POS Systems, E-commerce Tech, or B2B SaaS.
* Experience scaling an in-house marketing pods/team from the ground up.

description: About the job :Complyance is a global tax technology partner enabling businesses to meet their indirect tax compliance requirements through a single API and a unified global e-invoicing platform. Our platform is currently live across 10+ jurisdictions and is purpose-built for enterprises with multi-jurisdictional operations and high-volume, complex business environments.Beyond e-invoicing, we support businesses across their entire compliance journey, from readiness assessment and solution implementation to seamless ERP integration, testing, regulatory compliance and ongoing support. With a strong and growing MENA footprint and a strong base in India, we are now expanding into Europe and the US.Our subject is complex and technical. Design is how we make it clear, credible and easy to act on for the people who buy and use our product.Life at Complyance :We are a lean, high-ownership team that cares about doing the basics exceptionally well. Our work is visible, our decisions matter, and we are looking for people who bring ideas without being asked.The mission :As our Marketing Designer, you will design across our brand, social media, website, email, events and sales materials. You will turn marketing and sales briefs into clear, on-brand designs, bring fresh ideas to every project, and use AI tools to explore concepts and solve design problems quickly.This is a marketing and brand design role. It is not a UI/UX or product design role.Where you’ll leave your mark :• Own the brand foundation: Maintain and develop guidelines, the colour and type system, icon set, illustration style and master templates.• Create social content that stands out: Design posts, carousels, short videos and motion graphics.• Design pages that convert: Build landing pages with a clear understanding of the visitor, the message and the action the page should drive, plus website visuals such as hero images, web banners, blog thumbnails and in-article diagrams.• Make email work harder: Design newsletter templates, campaign headers, nurture sequence layouts and signatures.• Show up well at events: Design booths, backdrops, signage, print collateral, merchandise and promotional assets.• Equip our sales team: Design pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies and battlecards.• Explore more than one direction: Understand the problem behind each brief, present more than one creative direction, and keep exploring new styles and formats so our designs stay fresh and never repeat.• Practise vibe design with AI: Describe the mood, message and audience to AI tools, generate visual directions quickly, and refine the strongest into finished, on-brand campaign assets, checking all output for quality and brand fit.• Test everything before it ships: Watch every video and animation in full, click through every landing page and deck, send test emails, and check designs on real devices and print proofs.• Deliver and improve: Work with the marketing, sales and product teams, and with printers and vendors, to deliver on time, then review how designs perform and improve them.The kind of designer we’re looking for You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:• Have 3–4+ years of experience in marketing or brand design, in-house or at an agency.• Have a strong portfolio covering several of these areas: brand, social media, web, email, events and sales materials, including at least one landing page.• Have strong skills in layout, typography, colour and visual hierarchy.• Are proficient in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign), with working knowledge of PowerPoint or Google Slides.• Have hands-on experience using AI tools in design work (for example Higgsfield, Figma AI, ChatGPT or Claude Design), and have applied vibe design to campaign visuals, social content, landing pages and decks.• Understand landing page structure, responsive layout and conversion basics.• Know print production: bleed, CMYK and large-format files.• Are a creative thinker and problem solver who brings new ideas without being asked.• Are curious: you ask why before you design, explore new tools, trends and formats, and keep learning on your own.• Communicate well and manage your time across companies.• Experience with Webflow, Framer or WordPress.• Experience with email platforms such as Brevo or Mailchimp.Why Complyance? • Competitive base salary. title: Design System/UX Engineer
description: At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.TTEC Digital seeks a Design System/UX Engineer to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!The work:We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982.This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don’t just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.Who we hire — the DNA:Self-starters and do-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals. Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama. Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread. AI-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity. Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands. Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them. You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we. No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fastWhat You Will Do:The role:Own the design system in code and the UX of the wedge — the Agent UI shell, slide-out / pill, Control UI, and the per-module panelsUX here ships as code, not Figma hand-offs. This is not a look-pretty job: the UI renders live voice, desktop, and AI event streams in real time, and you have to understand the technology underneath — events, WebSocket state, latency, plugin loading — so what you design flows and works, not just looks goodStartup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast, move forward. What you'll own:The design system as a real component library — templates and patterns developers implement without frictionAgent UI / Control UI interaction patternsActive Listening and Agent Handover UXThe graphics language of the product (iconography, motion, data visualization)Accessibility (Lighthouse a11y > 90) and keyboard-first agent flowsYour committed timelines. Who you are:A self-starter with taste and grit — a designer who shipsShow-me mentality: you demo working UI on Fridays like every other engineerYou think from the developer's seat: every component you design, you've already thought through how the squads will implement, extend, and theme it — your design system makes them faster, never slowerYou love new technology, adapt fast when the product shifts weekly, use AI tools daily to multiply velocity, consider yourself exceptional, and like winning. What You Will Bring:7+ years of product design with real front-end engineering — you ship React + TypeScript, not just specs. Strong graphics experience — ++++ on visual craft: iconography, motion design, canvas/SVG data visualization, rendering dense live data beautifully and legibly. Has owned a design system as a living component library in a fast-shipping product — versioned, documented, themed, adopted. Strong templating discipline — reusable patterns and layout systems built for developer implementation; you understand component APIs, composition, and what makes a pattern cheap or expensive to build. Understands the tech underneath — WebSocket-driven state, event ordering, render performance, module federation/plugin loading — well enough that your designs never fight the architecture. Strong on dense, real-time, professional-tool UX (think trading terminals, not marketing sites) — an agent lives in this UI 8 hours a day. Accessibility and keyboard-first design as defaults, not afterthoughts. Perceived-performance craft — skeletons, optimistic updates, motion that masks latency; the UI must feel instant even when the network isn't. Design tokens as the theming backbone — enterprise customers will want branding; tokens make that config, not a rewrite. Overlay/extension constraints fluency — designing UI injected over a host page (pill, slide-out) with its size, z-index, and isolation realities. Usability evidence at startup speed — lightweight session recordings and agent feedback loops instead of month-long studies. A debugger in the browser — you profile the render, find the jank, and fix your own component. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.   **scale, proportion, circulation and overall design language**
  .
* Understand architectural drawings, floor plans, mood boards and interior-design presentations shared by clients or architects.
* Prepare furniture selections and preliminary proposals for complete rooms or residences.
* Coordinate with the internal design and technical teams for
  **customisation, dimensions, materials, finishes and feasibility**
  .
* Prepare and explain quotations clearly to clients.
* Follow up professionally with clients after showroom visits and quotations.
* Build long-term relationships rather than focusing only on immediate transactions.
* Coordinate with architects and interior designers who visit or refer clients to the showroom.
* Maintain complete and accurate client information, requirements, follow-ups and quotation status in the CRM.
* Participate in periodic reviews of open enquiries and quotations.
* Assist clients through the complete pre-sales journey until order confirmation and handover to the execution/back-office team.
* Keep yourself updated about Alankaram products, construction methods, solid woods, upholstery, finishes, hardware and customisation possibilities.
* Maintain a high standard of product presentation and client experience within the showroom.
* Support showroom events, architect interactions, product launches and design presentations whenever required.

What We Are Looking For

**Education**

Bachelor's / Diploma in:

* Interior Design
* Architecture
* Furniture Design
* Spatial Design
* or a related design discipline.

**Experience**

Ideally
**3–7 years of experience**
in one or more of the following:

* Interior design
* Premium furniture
* Luxury home interiors
* Modular/interior solutions
* Kitchens or wardrobes
* Home décor
* Architectural products
* Premium building materials

Previous sales experience is useful but
**not mandatory if the candidate has excellent client-facing ability and commercial orientation**
.

Essential Skills

The candidate should have:

* Strong understanding of
  **interior design and furniture**
* Good aesthetic sense
* Ability to understand floor plans and dimensions
* Strong verbal communication
* Confidence while interacting with premium clients
* Good listening skills
* Ability to understand an unstated client requirement
* Commercial awareness
* Strong follow-up discipline
* Attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple clients simultaneously
* Comfort with numbers, quotations and pricing
* Ability to explain design recommendations logically rather than merely expressing personal preferences

Particularly Important for This Role

We are looking for someone who can move naturally from:

**“What kind of home are you creating?”**

to

**“These are the furniture pieces, dimensions, finishes and combinations that will work best for your space.”**

and eventually to:

**“Let me prepare the complete proposal and help you take this forward.”**

The candidate therefore needs to be
**a designer first, but commercially minded**
.

Performance Indicators

* Qualified clients handled
* Showroom walk-in to quotation %
* Quotation value generated
* Quotation-to-order conversion %
* Follow-up compliance
* Average response time
* Sales value
* Gross margin / discount discipline
* Average order value
* Architect/interior-designer relationships developed
* CRM discipline
* Client feedback
* Repeat/referral business

Career Growth

A strong candidate should be able to progress through:

→
**Senior Pre-Sales Designer**

→
**Assistant Sales Manager**

→
**Sales Manager / Showroom Manager**

→
**Zonal Sales Manager**

→
**Regional Sales Manager**

* Degree/Diploma in Interior Design or Architecture
* 3+ years relevant experience
* Strong design and aesthetic understanding
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Confidence dealing with premium clients
* Ability to understand drawings and space plans
* Strong ownership and follow-up skills
* A commercial mindset and willingness to work towards sales goals

**Why join Alankaram?**

Build expertise in premium furniture and client advisory while developing a career beyond conventional interior-design roles.

Strong performers can grow into
**Senior Pre-Sales, Sales Manager, Showroom Manager, Zonal Sales Manager and Regional Sales Manager roles**
.

Hyderabad

**Role:**
Full-time, showroom-based

title: UX Researcher (Behavioural, Anthropology, Ethanography) (GB03/04)
description:
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

The User Researcher is responsible for generating deep, psychology-backed insights into user behavior, motivations, and decision-making within fintech and digital financial products. The role focuses on applying behavioral science, cognitive psychology, and quantitative/qualitative research methods to uncover latent user needs and translate them into actionable inputs for design, product, and business strategy. The role ensures user-centric, evidence-based decision-making across the organization.

**A - Minimum required Accountabilities for this role-**

* Conduct in-depth moderated and unmoderated user interviews using psychological frameworks (e.g., Prospect Theory, Cognitive Dissonance, System 1 & 2) to uncover latent motivations, emotional drivers, and behavioral barriers.
* Design, deploy, and analyze quantitative research studies (surveys, questionnaires, experiments) grounded in validated psychological models such as Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB), Big Five Personality Traits, and Self-Determination Theory.
* Synthesize qualitative and quantitative data into actionable insights by identifying underlying cognitive and behavioral patterns (e.g., loss aversion, anchoring bias, trust erosion).
* Translate research findings into structured outputs such as personas, mental models, journey maps, and behavioral frameworks that predict user behavior.
* Test UI/UX prototypes through usability and concept validation studies using tools like Figma, Maze, and UserTesting, leveraging models such as Fogg’s Behavior Model.
* Own end-to-end research execution including study design, participant recruitment, psychometric segmentation, data analysis, and insight storytelling.

**B - Additional Accountabilities pertaining to the role-**

* Partner closely with design, product, and business teams to convert behavioral insights into bias-aware recommendations, nudges, and experience improvements.
* Monitor fintech and behavioral science trends (e.g., hyperbolic discounting, decision fatigue) through diary studies, ethnographic research, and secondary analysis.
* Support business KPIs such as conversion, engagement, retention, and trust through evidence-backed research inputs.
* Contribute to the development of internal research standards, methodologies, and best practices.

Requirements
  
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  

* Strong Behavioral Research / Behavioral Insights / Consumer Behavior Research Profiles
* Mandatory (Experience 1): Must have 2+ years of experience in Behavioral Research, Consumer Behavior Analysis, Behavioral Science, or Market Research, focusing on understanding user motivations, decision patterns, and digital behavior
* Mandatory (Experience 2): Must have hands-on experience conducting primary and secondary research, including qualitative and quantitative research methods such as interviews, ethnographic studies, surveys, behavioral experiments, and observational research
* Mandatory (Experience 3) : Experience analyzing user behavior patterns, engagement trends, and digital interaction journeys to generate insights that influence product design, feature development, or platform experience improvements
* Mandatory (Experience 4): Must have exposure to data analysis or data mining of user behavior datasets, combining research insights with behavioral data to identify patterns, anomalies, or opportunities for product innovation
* Mandatory (Skills 1): Strong understanding of Behavioral Science principles such as Cognitive Bias, Cognitive Dissonance, System 1 & System 2 Thinking, Decision Science, or Consumer Psychology
* Mandatory (Skills 2): Experience in testing concepts, prototypes, or product ideas through usability testing, concept validation, or behavioral experimentation to evaluate user response and product effectiveness
* Mandatory (Skills 3): Ability to synthesize research findings into actionable insights, hypotheses, and recommendations for Product, Design, or Business teams
* Mandatory (Skills 4): Basic understanding of UI/UX and digital product journeys, including how users interact with mobile apps or web platforms, though this is not a design role
* Candidates from institutes with strong behavioral research exposure are preferred
* Mandatory (Company): Candidates from B2C consumer product organizations where user behavior is closely tracked and analyzed, such as consumer tech, fintech, e-commerce, or digital platforms
* Mandatory (Note):This is not a pure UX Researcher or Data Analyst role. The client is looking for Design Thinking–oriented Behavioral Researchers who combine behavioral science, research methodologies, and behavioral data analysis to generate insights
* Preferred (Skills): Exposure to behavioral experimentation, usability testing, journey analysis, or consumer psychology frameworks used to improve digital product experience
* Preferred (Education): Background in Behavioral Science, Psychology, Sociology, Anthropology, Ethnography, Cognitive Science, or related fields (BA/MA/MSc/BSc)
* Mandatory (Age)—The candidate's age should be below 28 years

Experience: 2–7 years · Work from office · 5 days a week + alternate Saturdays · Notice period up to 30 days

title: CX Analyst & Product Insights  (B2C, Tier-1) (GB04)
description: Roles & Responsibilities We’re building a central Design Thinking function at Bajaj Finance - a team that will play a defining role as the organisation pivots into a direct-to-consumer company. This role sits at the intersection of data and human understanding, and thrives in that grey zone. You’ll be the person who can stare at a funnel and see a human story. Who can sit with a field research readout and spot what’s missing. Who treats data not as an answer, but as a better question - and turns both into something the team can act on. What Your Work Looks Like- You’ll operate across the Design Thinking lifecycle — from signal to solution: Insight & Evidence: Journey analytics, Mining session replays, heatmaps, and behavioural data to surface where customers struggle and why. You bring statistical rigour — you know the difference between a pattern and noise, between correlation and causation, and you know when to trust the data and when to trust instinct. Challenge & Synthesis: You consume field research from dedicated research teams and stress-test it. You triangulate digital signals against qualitative findings, competitive benchmarks, and business metrics to build problem statements that hold up under scrutiny. You craft How Might We statements from clustered signals — framing the right questions that give the team a clear direction to solve against. Prototyping & Testing: You participate in solutioning — helping the team move from problem to prototype, designing tests, and closing the loop between what was hypothesised and what customers actually do. What Makes Someone Right for This- 4–8 years in consumer insights, CX analytics, product analytics, UX research, or a similar role in B2C or consumer-facing companies, where you’ve worked across quantitative and qualitative inputs Comfortable in analytics platforms — session replay, web/app analytics, funnel analysis, segmented and cohort analysis. Can layer behavioural data over system-of-record data to move beyond surface-level insights. Specific tools matter less than your ability to get depth from any tool quickly Understands statistical thinking — hypothesis testing, significance, when to apply rigour and when to move on intuition Can read, challenge, and build on qualitative research even if you’re not the one conducting it — you know what good methodology looks like and can spot when a finding is thin Structures findings into clear, concise arguments. You’ve presented to senior stakeholders and know the difference between showing data and making a case Thinks in systems — you connect a drop-off at step 3 to an upstream design choice, a policy constraint, and a downstream business metric without being told to SQL-literate — you can pull what you need or speak to data teams in their language Brings critical reasoning that stress-tests assumptions rather than confirming them RequirementsIdeal Candidate Strong Consumer Insights / CX Analytics / Product Insights profile (behavioral/user/product/UX analytics) Mandatory (Experience 1) - Must have 4+ years of experience in Customer Experience (CX) Analytics, Consumer Insights, Product Analytics, Behavioral Analytics, or UX Analytics, working on B2C digital products (Web/App) with a focus on understanding customer behavior, customer journeys, and experience improvement. Mandatory (Experience 2) - Must have hands-on experience analyzing customer journeys, behavioral funnels, digital interactions, session-level behavior, clickstream data, and experience metrics to identify pain points, drop-offs, and optimization opportunities. Mandatory (Experience 3) - Must have experience using CX and Digital Experience Analytics platforms such as Medallia, ContentSquare, Google Analytics (GA4) or similar tools for customer behavior analysis, journey mapping, and insight generation. Mandatory (Experience 4) - Must have experience working closely with Product, Design, CX, Business, Marketing, and Research teams to generate insights, validate hypotheses, and drive customer experience improvements. Mandatory (Experience 5 ) - Strong working knowledge of SQL and Python for data extraction, querying, analysis, exploratory data analysis, automation, and behavioral data interpretation. Ability to independently analyze large datasets, identify patterns, and generate actionable business insights. Mandatory (Experience 6): Understanding of hypothesis-driven thinking and basic experimentation/A/B testing concepts, including interpreting results and distinguishing between correlation and causation. Mandatory (Age)—The candidate's age should be below 28 years Preferred ( Experience 1) - Candidates from product-based companies (B2C preferred) OR Data Analytics Service companies like Mu Sigma etc Experience: 3–6 years · Work from office · 5 days a week + alternate Saturdays · Notice period up to 30 days BenefitsOur people define our passion and our audacious, incredibly rewarding achievements. title: Senior Instructional Designer- Partner Enablement
description:
**Build your best future with Johnson Controls**
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to apply your instructional design expertise to projects that support a global, digitally driven organization? Do you enjoy creating learning experiences that help customers and partners build the skills they need to succeed? If so, Johnson Controls has an opportunity for you.
  
  
As a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places, and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Make an impact, grow your expertise, and work with innovative products and people who are shaping the future of our industry.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
The Senior Instructional Designer will support the Partner Enablement organization by designing and developing instructor-led training, virtual instructor-led training, eLearning, videos, and performance support resources for customers and channel partners. Working closely with Partner Enablement leaders, instructors, and subject matter experts, this role will translate complex technical concepts into effective learning experiences that drive product knowledge, technical proficiency, and business results.
  
  
**How You Will Do It**

* Design and develop engaging learning solutions, including instructor-led training, virtual instructor-led training, eLearning, video-based learning, learning guides, and job aids.
* Partner with business stakeholders and subject matter experts to analyze learning needs and develop effective training programs.
* Create storyboards, facilitator guides, participant materials, assessments, videos, and performance support resources.
* Apply instructional design methodologies and adult learning principles to create engaging and effective learning experiences.
* Collaborate with Partner Enablement leaders, instructors, and business stakeholders throughout the development process.
* Manage multiple learning projects simultaneously while meeting quality, timeline, and stakeholder expectations.
* Leverage learning technologies, authoring tools, multimedia solutions, and AI-enabled capabilities to enhance learning experiences.
* Support curriculum maintenance and content updates to align with product releases, business priorities, and learner feedback.
* Ensure learning content is accurate, consistent, scalable, and aligned with global standards.
* Measure learning effectiveness and recommend continuous improvements based on learner feedback, business needs, and performance outcomes.
* Stay current on instructional design best practices, learning technologies, and emerging trends within the learning and development industry.
* Contribute to a collaborative global learning team environment focused on delivering high-quality customer and partner education:

**What We Look For**

* 5-10 years of experience designing and developing learning solutions.
* 5+ years of instructional design experience, including curriculum development and storyboarding.
* Experience developing instructor-led training (ILT), virtual instructor-led training (vILT), eLearning, and multimedia learning solutions.
* Experience partnering with subject matter experts and business stakeholders to develop technical training programs.
* Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience supporting corporate learning and development programs in a global organization preferred.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Education, Communications, Business, or a related field.
* Knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies, including ADDIE and Agile.
* Familiarity with learning evaluation models such as Kirkpatrick and Phillips ROI preferred

**Technical Skills**


* Experience with learning authoring and multimedia development tools such as Articulate Storyline, Rise, Camtasia, Vyond, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar applications.
* Experience working with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and learning technologies.
* Ability to analyze learning effectiveness and recommend improvements.
* Ability to quickly learn Johnson Controls products, solutions, and industry concepts.

Professional Skills
  
  

* Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* Ability to build effective relationships across global teams and stakeholder groups.
* Demonstrated accountability, professionalism, attention to detail, and customer focus.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, collaborative environment

title: Instructional Designer/Learning Experience Designer (Commercial, Products, and Service Solutions - Sales Focus)
description:
**What You Will Do**
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to apply your Instructional Design expertise to projects that support a global, digitally-driven organization? Do you have experience leading projects supporting commercial or sales organizations? Do you want to turn all those great ideas you have into tangible results that make a difference? Do you have experience designing multi-media learning solutions to drive business outcomes? Are you adept at project management? If that’s the case, Johnson Controls Inc (JCI) has an amazing opportunity for you!
  
  
The future is being built today, and Johnson Controls is making that future more productive, secure, sustainable, and far safer. We are harnessing the power of the cloud, the Internet of Things, and user-design thinking to deliver intelligent buildings and smart cities that connect communities in ways that make people’s lives – and the world – better. Are you excited about enabling an organization transforming the buildings industry?
  
  
Your challenge, if you wish to accept it, will be to create innovative and effective enablement materials that support Johnson Controls’ sellers to understand customer needs throughout a building’s lifecycle , communicate value, and position our broader building systems and services portfolio with confidence. You will do this by working collaboratively with colleagues and business leaders, immersing yourself in the fascinating business, bringing creativity and hard work to every project you do, and being open to learning new skills and technologies every single day. Requirements include a strong learner-focused mindset, business acumen, a willingness to act amid ambiguity, strong project management skills, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Does this sound like you? If so, keep reading!
  
  
**How You Will Do It**

* Design intuitive and creative learning or performance support tools and sales programs
* Develop training with an emphasis on innovative learning and performance support that could be used globally
* Apply what you know about adult learning and share what you learn along the way with the rest of the team
* Use strong project management skills in developing outcomes that positively impact the business
* Work very closely with team members who will develop your designs
* Partner and collaborate with Commercial (Sales) focused learning experience designers (peers) located across the globe
* Driven curation strategies that pull content from multiple sources across our learning ecosystem
* Drive in depth discovery and needs analysis with stakeholder and learner interviews
* Act as an internal consultant and combine multiple perspectives into holistic solutions that maximize the impact on the business
* Create and support a strong global team environment
* Engage commercial partners and stakeholders to develop capability building programs
* Participate in organizational development exercises including group facilitation, team building, and systems analysis
* Maintain current knowledge of trends and issues in instructional design and training
* Understand technology to effectively design your learning and performance support tools
* Leverage innovative learning technologies and platforms to deploy learning, including the Johnson Controls Workday Learning platform.
* Establish measurement and evaluation plans that include key business metrics and return on investment strategies

**What impact would you have?**
Everyone Wants To Feel Like They’re Having An Impact. In This Position, You Absolutely Will. You Will Have The Opportunity To
  
  

* Support successful launches of new products/solutions by ensuring that our sales organization has the training they need for success.
* Enable sellers to succeed in their roles through role based training and skill development training.
* Impact sellers, sales managers, and sales leaders from around the world as a part of a global team creating stimulating ways to help our sales organizations build new skills and improve their performance.
* Investigate new opportunities and develop effective training that is impactful and inventive
* Directly impact key performance indicators such as quota attainment, secured volume, and revenue generation
* Align your ingenuity and innovative ideas with the global strategic plan of the business
* Learn on a day-to-day basis about how our equipment and strategies work to conserve energy and protect our environment

Focus on Johnson Controls’ expanding portfolio of technology-based anproducts impacting our customers’ daily life
  
  
**What We Look For**

* Experience:

+ 5-10 years of designing and developing learning solutions preferred (exposure to Commercial / Sales, Industrial Tech B2B solutions preferred)
+ 5+ years of experience in Instructional Design and storyboarding, working for the Training & eLearning industry
+ At least 1-2 years of experience in stakeholder communication

* Education:

+ Holds a bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, and Education or Graduate or PG from a recognized university
+ Demonstrates certain levels of proficiency in evaluations, Kirkpatrick model, Philips ROI model, ADDIE, Agile, cultural, and regional adjustments, change management, and adult learning theory

* Technical: JCI’s product and services portfolio is complex, so we need someone who is quick to grasp how building environments are created and business lines organized. Don’t worry, we’ll help you with that!
* Quality: Produces content and materials with the highest polish when required, but knows when to create fast and informal
* Professional: Has personal ethics, does quality work, and has a positive attitude
* Articulate: Has strong writing and communication skills

**Specialized Skills**

* Empathetic – Ability to connect with learners while enabling change. Understanding of human-centered needs to allow individual growth through learning and personal development
* Creative – Can look at a project and find alternatives
* Flexible – Can change course if needed
* Cutting edge – Isn’t limited by what’s out there today and is constantly looking for what is next
* Detailed – Realizes the importance of details in leading to impactful outcomes
* Collaborative – Collaborates with other designers, vendors, program managers, and more people in the business than we can count
* Ambitious – Willing to assume authority, take risks, and set clear goals for career development
* Proactive approach – Continually questions existing work standards and processes and delivery to find better, faster, less expensive, or more effective ways to do things

Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou.

Build More Than a CV. Build Real-World Capability.

The objective isn't to replace thinking with technology. It's to become better at using
