title: Delivery AI Product Analyst
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
We are seeking exceptional candidates with experience and passion to fill Senior Solution Analyst Position in BCG’s new business unit, BCG X. This global business unit brings together cutting-edge AI, visionary business ventures, and unique software and products in the most strategic industry applications to deliver superior value and sustained impact. All of BCG’s core product capabilities are housed within the business unit including product management, design, development, support, and data analytics experts who work in deep collaboration with BCG practice areas, consulting teams, and clients. This team, of highly motivated and insightful colleagues, will provide an opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial environment supported by a global management consulting firm, which is the world’s leading advisor on business strategy.
  
  
A BCG Senior Solution Analyst is someone who will work with product manager and senior leadership in various business groups to help drive capabilities and support increased commercialization of BCG proprietary data and software assets. This person will work together with technical and commercial teams from the initial business case to roadmap delivery, launch, and ongoing support operations. We want someone with an entrepreneurial drive and demonstrated experience leading enterprise or large-scale product efforts across product strategy, marketing, finance, engineering, support, and executive stakeholders.
  
  
Additionally, you will work in a growing global team, providing industry & topic expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, methodologies, software solutions, analysis and expert advisory. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues This is an exciting opportunity to jump into a unique position at a world class firm.
  
  
**YOU'RE GOOD AT**
**Product Management**

* Co-own the product roadmap with the Product Manager and keep it tied to business goals and user needs
* Conduct user research and usability tests, and use the results alongside market analysis and client feedback to improve the product
* Gather and prioritize requirements in stakeholder workshops, then write them up as user stories with acceptance criteria
* Build user personas and use AI design tools to prototype and iterate with the UI/UX team
* Run Scrum ceremonies with the engineering team and clear blockers to keep features shipping on time
* Join technical discussions and translate between engineering and business stakeholders so product decisions stay feasible
* Keep feature lists, user guides and release notes current, and update stakeholders on progress and milestones

**Product Delivery**

* As a thought partner to case teams and clients, define the business problem early and shape a solution around it
* Apply BCG Transformation and Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) methodology on cases and configure the product for each client’s program
* Manage MVP-based implementation plans as the client’s day-to-day point of contact, and set realistic expectations about what the product covers today
* Lead demos and training sessions that get case teams and client users working in the product
* Triage client issues and work them through to resolution with Engineering and Support
* Convert case learnings into proprietary assets and input for the roadmap

**AI-Native ways of working**

* Set up and maintain the team’s AI harness, including a product knowledge base that captures context, personas, business rules and past decisions, plus connectors to Azure DevOps, Confluence and SharePoint
* Create a library of reusable skills, such as a story writer, BRD generator and release notes generator, and update/maintain them as the product changes

Who You'll Work With

title: Product Localisation Lead - India
description:
**Job Description**
**Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**
Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte, namaste!
  
  
Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
  
  
**Where And How You Can Work**
Our headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role, we’re focusing on Bangalore so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.
  
  
**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**

* Own Canva’s product and localisation strategy for India, with a strong focus on user growth and experience across languages.
* Contribute to the product roadmap for India, including features, payment methods, authentication flows, and other market-specific initiatives.
* Analyse the active user and subscription funnels to identify opportunities for improving activation, engagement, and conversion.
* Evaluate and adapt global messaging, campaigns, and product experiences to resonate with Indian users across different regions and languages.
* Provide cultural and linguistic insights to global teams to inform product, content, and marketing decisions.
* Project management to drive cross-functional collaboration on localisation: Marketing, Content, SEO and Product
* Manage relationships with external localisation partners and collaborate with external linguists, translators and the in-house Language Manager, to ensure clarity, cultural nuance, and consistency across all Indian-language experiences. Together, develop and evolve style guides, tone of voice principles, and best practices for the region.
* Help prioritise localisation investments across languages and regions based on impact, scale, and user needs.

**Qualifications**
What we're looking for
  
  

* 5+ years of experience working in product, growth, or localisation roles within a high-growth SaaS or product-led company.
* Strong product and growth mindset, with an understanding of how India’s language ecosystem (including regional languages and English usage patterns) influences user behaviour and product adoption.
* Strong understanding of content and UX copy, including the ability to write and adapt English-language messaging for Indian users across product and growth surfaces.
* Experience working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders across product, marketing, content, and regional teams.
* Fluency in English, with strong proficiency in at least one major Indian language. Familiarity with multiple Indian languages is a strong plus.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and scaling solutions in complex, multi-market environments.
* A strategic thinker who is equally happy rolling up their sleeves and executing.
* Genuine passion for Canva’s mission to empower the world to design.

**Additional Information**
**About the Group/Team**
Canva’s International Supergroup is responsible for driving growth and deepening adoption across our key regions worldwide. We are an entrepreneurial, cross-functional team that turns bold strategy into culturally resonant execution.
  
  
In India, our mission is to empower people across the country to design and express themselves, regardless of language, geography, or background. India represents one of Canva’s most important growth opportunities, with a deeply diverse language ecosystem, a rapidly expanding creator economy, and millions of users coming online for the first time. Our goal is to make Canva feel intuitive, accessible, and truly local for users across India.
  
  
**About The Role/Specialty**
As the India Localisation Lead, you will own Canva’s product and localisation experience in India, ensuring users across different regions and languages have the best possible Canva experience. You will be the voice of Indian users and a champion for culturally and linguistically relevant product experiences.
  
  
This role goes beyond translation. It requires a strong understanding of India’s language landscape, how users switch between languages, and how localisation decisions impact trust, usability, and growth at scale.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**Marketing Manager (Performance Marketing)**

**Company:**
Precize

**Location:**
Mumbai (On-Site)

**Experience:**
2 to 5 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Team:**
Leads a lean marketing pod of 3

**About Precize**

Precize is a fast-growing fintech startup that simplifies access to private companies like Zepto, NSE, Oyo Rooms, and 150+ other companies.

We envision a future where accessing private assets is as seamless as navigating the public markets: an open environment that transcends traditional investing in India.

**About the Role**

We’re hiring a Marketing Manager to own Precize’s growth engine, with paid media at its core. You’ll run Google Ads and Meta Ads hands-on, own the budget and the numbers, lead a small team, and see your work directly move acquisition, activation, retention, and referral.

This is a high-ownership role with a direct line to the founders and a clear runway into a Head of Marketing role as we scale.

**What You’ll Own**

*Paid Acquisition*

* Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns on Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, YouTube, App campaigns) and Meta Ads (app install, lead, and conversion campaigns).
* Own the monthly paid budget and its outcomes: CAC, CPA, ROAS, and cost per signup or first investment.
* Run a steady cadence of creative, audience, and landing page tests. Scale what works, and cut what doesn’t, fast.
* Optimize beyond the click, for lead quality, completed signups, KYC completion, and first investments, not just traffic.

*Measurement & Growth*

* Set and own weekly and monthly acquisition, activation, and retention targets.
* Maintain clean tracking and attribution across GA4, ad platforms, and our product analytics, so every rupee can be traced to an outcome.
* Work with funnels, cohorts, and A/B test results to decide where budget goes next.
* Use WhatsApp, email, community, and content to turn acquired users into active, repeat investors.

*Team Leadership*

* Lead and mentor the marketing team, delegate responsibilities with clarity, and review output rigorously.
* Build a culture of ownership, accountability, and high performance.
* Act as the bridge between Marketing, Product, and Sales to ensure alignment and effective execution.

*Content & Brand*

* Oversee ad creative and content that make private market investing simple, relevant, and accessible to retail users.
* Keep all campaigns consistent with the brand and compliant for an investment product.

**Who You Are**

* 2 to 5 years of marketing or growth experience, with hands-on paid media at the center of it, preferably in a startup.
* Have managed or mentored at least one direct report.
* Have personally built and optimized Google and Meta campaigns, not only overseen agencies.
* Understand the full funnel: acquisition → activation → retention → referral.
* Target-driven, comfortable with a lean budget, and quick to act on data.

**Must-Haves**

* Proven experience leading or managing a marketing or growth team.
* Hands-on experience running Google Ads and Meta Ads, with ownership of monthly budgets and accountability for CAC, CPA, or ROAS.
* A track record of improving paid efficiency, such as lowering CAC or CPL or raising ROAS, that you can explain with numbers.
* An analytical mindset, with the ability to work with dashboards, attribution, funnels, cohort data, and A/B testing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Startup experience, preferably at a small or mid-sized company.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience running influencer or creator campaigns measured on conversions (signups, installs, transactions), not reach.
* Experience with app install campaigns (Google App campaigns, Meta app install campaigns) and mobile measurement partners such as AppsFlyer or Branch.
* Familiarity with stock markets or alternative investment products.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as Mixpanel, CleverTap, MoEngage, or HubSpot.
* An existing network of finance content creators.

**Why Precize**

* Own and shape the marketing function, with a clear path to Head of Marketing as we scale.
* Gain exposure to one of India’s most exciting and underexplored investment categories.
* Work closely with the founders and leadership team.
* Be part of a tight-knit, high-performance team that moves with genuine startup energy.

title: Marketing Manager (Oil & Gas)
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION: MARKETING MANAGER – OIL & GAS**

**Location:**
Vashi, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra

**CTC:**
Upto 12 LPA

**Experience:**
8–10 Years

**Department:**
Sales & Marketing / Business Development

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Industry:**
Oil & Gas / Oilfield Services / Industrial Equipment

**1. Job Overview**

**We are looking for an experienced Marketing Manager with a strong background in the Oil & Gas industry, combining technical knowledge of oilfield products, equipment, and services with proven expertise in marketing, B2B sales, and business development.**

**The ideal candidate should understand oilfield operations and product applications while identifying market opportunities, developing customer relationships, positioning technical solutions, and driving business growth. They must be comfortable interacting with oilfield operators, drilling contractors, EPC companies, procurement teams, and technical decision-makers.**

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Marketing Strategy & Business Development**

* Develop and execute marketing strategies to increase market presence and generate business opportunities.
* Identify new markets, customer segments, and potential business opportunities.
* Conduct market research and competitor analysis to understand industry trends, customer requirements, and pricing.
* Build a strong business development pipeline through customer outreach, industry networking, and strategic partnerships.
* Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts and acquire new customers.

**B. Technical Product Knowledge**

* Develop a strong understanding of the company's oilfield products, equipment, technical specifications, applications, and services.
* Understand product applications across upstream, midstream, and downstream operations, as relevant.
* Translate technical product features into commercial value propositions.
* Coordinate with engineering and technical teams to address customer requirements and provide accurate product information.
* Participate in technical discussions and recommend suitable products or solutions.
* Prepare and support technical presentations, product catalogues, proposals, and commercial submissions.
* Stay updated on oilfield technologies, equipment developments, and relevant industry standards.

**C. B2B Sales & Customer Relationship Management**

* Develop relationships with oil and gas companies, E&P operators, drilling contractors, EPC companies, oilfield service providers, and equipment distributors.
* Engage with procurement managers, technical managers, project managers, operations personnel, and senior decision-makers.
* Identify customer requirements and develop suitable product and service proposals.
* Lead commercial discussions, negotiate pricing, and support order conversion.
* Manage key accounts and build long-term customer relationships.
* Track enquiries, quotations, follow-ups, purchase orders, and sales opportunities.

**D. Tendering & Commercial Proposals**

* Identify relevant tenders, RFQs, RFPs, and procurement opportunities.
* Review technical specifications, commercial requirements, eligibility criteria, and submission deadlines.
* Coordinate with technical, finance, and operations teams to prepare competitive bids.
* Prepare or coordinate technical bids, quotations, compliance documents, and commercial proposals.
* Evaluate pricing, profitability, and competitive positioning.
* Maintain records of tenders, quotations, and business outcomes.

**E. Marketing & Brand Positioning**

* Develop targeted B2B marketing campaigns for oilfield products and services.
* Prepare technical brochures, company profiles, product presentations, case studies, and marketing collateral.
* Improve brand visibility among oil and gas industry stakeholders.
* Represent the company at industry exhibitions, trade shows, conferences, and networking events.
* Build relationships with distributors, channel partners, and industry associations.
* Use industry-specific platforms, professional networks, and digital marketing channels to generate qualified leads.

**F. Market Intelligence & Reporting**

* Monitor industry developments, upcoming projects, drilling activities, and procurement opportunities.
* Analyse competitor products, pricing, market positioning, and commercial strategies.
* Identify potential supply contracts, vendor registration opportunities, and new business prospects.
* Maintain databases of target companies, decision-makers, customer enquiries, and project opportunities.
* Track sales pipelines, forecast business, monitor performance, and report progress to management.
* Recommend strategies to improve lead generation, conversion rates, and revenue growth.

**3. Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in Marketing, Business Management, or Sales will be an advantage.
* Candidates with relevant technical qualifications and substantial oilfield industry experience may also be considered.

**4. Required Experience & Skills**

* 8–10 years of relevant experience in oil and gas, oilfield services, drilling equipment, industrial equipment, or technical B2B sales and marketing.
* Proven experience in marketing, business development, technical sales, or commercial management within the oil and gas industry.
* Strong technical understanding of oilfield products, equipment, applications, or services.
* Ability to interpret technical specifications and product documentation.
* Experience in B2B sales, customer acquisition, account management, and business development.
* Familiarity with tenders, RFQs, RFPs, technical proposals, and commercial negotiations.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to engage with both technical professionals and senior commercial decision-makers.
* Strong market research, competitor analysis, and business planning capabilities.
* Proficiency in MS Office and CRM or sales pipeline management tools.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple opportunities, and deliver measurable business results.

**5. Preferred Industry Experience**

**Candidates with experience in the following areas will be preferred:**

* Oilfield equipment, machinery, and drilling tools.
* Well completion, intervention, and servicing products.
* Valves, pumps, fittings, flow-control equipment, and oilfield consumables.
* Upstream oil and gas exploration and production.
* Offshore and onshore oilfield operations.
* Oilfield maintenance, inspection, testing, and technical services.
* EPC projects and industrial procurement.
* Oil and gas equipment distribution and technical sales.
* Vendor registration, tender management, and institutional procurement.

**6. Key Competencies**

* **Technical Knowledge:**
  Ability to understand oilfield products, applications, and technical requirements.
* **Business Development:**
  Ability to identify opportunities, acquire customers, and generate revenue.
* **Strategic Marketing:**
  Ability to develop effective marketing plans and improve market penetration.
* **Commercial Acumen:**
  Understanding of pricing, margins, negotiations, and business profitability.
* **Relationship Management:**
  Ability to build lasting relationships with customers and industry stakeholders.
* **Analytical Skills:**
  Ability to evaluate market trends, competition, and business performance.
* **Ownership:**
  Ability to manage opportunities from identification through proposal development and order closure.

**7. Ideal Candidate Profile**

**The ideal candidate will combine technical oilfield expertise with strong marketing, B2B sales, and business development experience**
. They must understand the products being offered, where and how they are used, and how to communicate their technical and commercial benefits to customers.

Candidates with only general digital marketing or consumer marketing experience, without meaningful exposure to oilfield products, technical sales, or industrial B2B business development, will not be suitable.

**8. Job Location & Travel**

**Location:**
Vashi, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra.

The candidate should be willing to attend customer meetings, visit industrial clients, participate in industry events, and travel for business development when required.

**9. Application Requirements**

**Candidates should highlight their oil and gas industry experience, technical product knowledge, key accounts handled, business development achievements, tendering experience, and commercial contributions in their resumes.**

* Work with marketing teams on events, webinars, campaigns, and lead-generation initiatives.

* Conduct product training sessions, technical workshops, and partner enablement programs.
* Develop sales kits, presentations, solution briefs, and competitive battle cards.
* Assist sales teams in strategic opportunities and large deal closures.

* Track industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive developments.
* Analyze market demand and customer requirements.
* Develop competitive positioning strategies to strengthen market presence.
* Provide insights and recommendations for portfolio expansion.

* Engage with key customers, system integrators, and channel partners.
* Participate in customer meetings, solution discussions, and business reviews.
* Support the development of strategic customer relationships.
* Work closely with partners to create and close business opportunities.

* Collaborate with Sales, Pre-Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Vendor teams.

* Prepare business reports, forecasts, dashboards, and management presentations.

* Inventory planning and working capital management knowledge.
* Data-driven and analytical approach to decision-making.
* Excellent presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong communication and relationship-building capabilities.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

title: Lead - Strategy
description:
**Who are we and what do we do?**
BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000+ real devices and browsers.
  
  
With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
  
  
Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.
  
  
**Location: This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.**
**Role In a Nutshell**
Strategy team is responsible for identifying short-term & long-term opportunities across developer markets & product lines to accelerate BrowserStack’s revenue growth & to develop the vision for BrowserStack with a strong strategy plan & hypotheses backed by data. description:

**Position:**
Product Manager, Cx Ops
  
  
**Location:**
Airoli
  
  
**Level:**
PM
  
  
**Experience:**
7+ years
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Product Manager to own a product line from strategy through execution and into the market. This is a technical product built on contact center and customer experience infrastructure, so the role requires enough technical fluency to work credibly with engineering on scope, feasibility and tradeoffs. This person will define the product, establish its value to clients, position it against competing offerings, and ensure predictable delivery at scale. The role carries significant visibility with senior stakeholders and requires equal comfort in client conversations, pricing strategy and technical scoping discussions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the strategy and roadmap for the product line, translating client needs and business priorities into a prioritized, sequenced plan
* Partner with engineering to translate business requirements into clear technical specifications, understanding at a working level how the underlying systems, integrations, and data flows support the product
* Develop the product's value proposition and structure it into a pricing and packaging model aligned with the outcomes delivered to clients
* Partner with engineering and delivery teams to plan and pace releases, balancing speed to market with quality and predictability
* Maintain a thorough understanding of the competitive landscape and apply that knowledge to product and pricing decisions
* Serve as the primary product point of contact for clients, internal stakeholders, and senior sponsors, managing expectations through clear and proactive communication
* Partner with marketing to develop go-to-market and positioning materials that communicate client value
* Present product strategy, roadmap, and business impact to senior leadership on a regular cadence

**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a product or product line from strategy through launch
* Working knowledge of contact center technology stacks (e.g., CCaaS platforms, IVR, ACD/routing systems, WFM, and QA/analytics tools), gained through experience in customer service, contact center, or BPO/outsourced service environments
* Comfort working with technical concepts such as APIs, integrations, and data flows at a level sufficient to scope requirements and evaluate tradeoffs with engineering
* Experience developing pricing or packaging models aligned with client value and business outcomes
* Demonstrated experience conducting structured competitive analysis to inform product decisions
* Experience managing relationships across clients, executive sponsors, and engineering teams
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership and external clients

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in omnichannel customer care, specifically across voice, chat, and email
* Experience writing or reviewing technical requirements or PRDs in partnership with engineering
* MBA or equivalent experience in business, strategy, or analytics
* Experience operating in a matrixed organization with influence over engineering priorities

title: UX Researcher (Behavioural, Anthropology, Ethanography) (GB03/04)
description:
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

The User Researcher is responsible for generating deep, psychology-backed insights into user behavior, motivations, and decision-making within fintech and digital financial products. The role focuses on applying behavioral science, cognitive psychology, and quantitative/qualitative research methods to uncover latent user needs and translate them into actionable inputs for design, product, and business strategy. The role ensures user-centric, evidence-based decision-making across the organization.

**A - Minimum required Accountabilities for this role-**

* Conduct in-depth moderated and unmoderated user interviews using psychological frameworks (e.g., Prospect Theory, Cognitive Dissonance, System 1 & 2) to uncover latent motivations, emotional drivers, and behavioral barriers.
* Design, deploy, and analyze quantitative research studies (surveys, questionnaires, experiments) grounded in validated psychological models such as Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB), Big Five Personality Traits, and Self-Determination Theory.
* Synthesize qualitative and quantitative data into actionable insights by identifying underlying cognitive and behavioral patterns (e.g., loss aversion, anchoring bias, trust erosion).
* Translate research findings into structured outputs such as personas, mental models, journey maps, and behavioral frameworks that predict user behavior.
* Test UI/UX prototypes through usability and concept validation studies using tools like Figma, Maze, and UserTesting, leveraging models such as Fogg’s Behavior Model.
* Own end-to-end research execution including study design, participant recruitment, psychometric segmentation, data analysis, and insight storytelling.

**B - Additional Accountabilities pertaining to the role-**

* Partner closely with design, product, and business teams to convert behavioral insights into bias-aware recommendations, nudges, and experience improvements.
* Monitor fintech and behavioral science trends (e.g., hyperbolic discounting, decision fatigue) through diary studies, ethnographic research, and secondary analysis.
* Support business KPIs such as conversion, engagement, retention, and trust through evidence-backed research inputs.
* Contribute to the development of internal research standards, methodologies, and best practices.

Requirements
  
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  

* Strong Behavioral Research / Behavioral Insights / Consumer Behavior Research Profiles
* Mandatory (Experience 1): Must have 2+ years of experience in Behavioral Research, Consumer Behavior Analysis, Behavioral Science, or Market Research, focusing on understanding user motivations, decision patterns, and digital behavior
* Mandatory (Experience 2): Must have hands-on experience conducting primary and secondary research, including qualitative and quantitative research methods such as interviews, ethnographic studies, surveys, behavioral experiments, and observational research
* Mandatory (Experience 3) : Experience analyzing user behavior patterns, engagement trends, and digital interaction journeys to generate insights that influence product design, feature development, or platform experience improvements
* Mandatory (Experience 4): Must have exposure to data analysis or data mining of user behavior datasets, combining research insights with behavioral data to identify patterns, anomalies, or opportunities for product innovation
* Mandatory (Skills 1): Strong understanding of Behavioral Science principles such as Cognitive Bias, Cognitive Dissonance, System 1 & System 2 Thinking, Decision Science, or Consumer Psychology
* Mandatory (Skills 2): Experience in testing concepts, prototypes, or product ideas through usability testing, concept validation, or behavioral experimentation to evaluate user response and product effectiveness
* Mandatory (Skills 3): Ability to synthesize research findings into actionable insights, hypotheses, and recommendations for Product, Design, or Business teams
* Mandatory (Skills 4): Basic understanding of UI/UX and digital product journeys, including how users interact with mobile apps or web platforms, though this is not a design role
* Candidates from institutes with strong behavioral research exposure are preferred
* Mandatory (Company): Candidates from B2C consumer product organizations where user behavior is closely tracked and analyzed, such as consumer tech, fintech, e-commerce, or digital platforms
* Mandatory (Note):This is not a pure UX Researcher or Data Analyst role. The client is looking for Design Thinking–oriented Behavioral Researchers who combine behavioral science, research methodologies, and behavioral data analysis to generate insights
* Preferred (Skills): Exposure to behavioral experimentation, usability testing, journey analysis, or consumer psychology frameworks used to improve digital product experience
* Preferred (Education): Background in Behavioral Science, Psychology, Sociology, Anthropology, Ethnography, Cognitive Science, or related fields (BA/MA/MSc/BSc)
* Mandatory (Age)—The candidate's age should be below 28 years

Experience: 2–7 years · Work from office · 5 days a week + alternate Saturdays · Notice period up to 30 days

Benefits

Bajaj Finance Limited is one of India’s most diversified Non-banking financial companies, and among Asia’s top 10 Large workplaces. If you have the drive to get ahead, we can help find you an opportunity at any of the 500+ locations we’re present in India.

description: Roles & Responsibilities We’re building a central Design Thinking function at Bajaj Finance - a team that will play a defining role as the organisation pivots into a direct-to-consumer company. This role sits at the intersection of data and human understanding, and thrives in that grey zone. You’ll be the person who can stare at a funnel and see a human story. Who can sit with a field research readout and spot what’s missing. Who treats data not as an answer, but as a better question - and turns both into something the team can act on. What Your Work Looks Like- You’ll operate across the Design Thinking lifecycle — from signal to solution: Insight & Evidence: Journey analytics, Mining session replays, heatmaps, and behavioural data to surface where customers struggle and why. You bring statistical rigour — you know the difference between a pattern and noise, between correlation and causation, and you know when to trust the data and when to trust instinct. Challenge & Synthesis: You consume field research from dedicated research teams and stress-test it. You triangulate digital signals against qualitative findings, competitive benchmarks, and business metrics to build problem statements that hold up under scrutiny. You craft How Might We statements from clustered signals — framing the right questions that give the team a clear direction to solve against. Prototyping & Testing: You participate in solutioning — helping the team move from problem to prototype, designing tests, and closing the loop between what was hypothesised and what customers actually do. What Makes Someone Right for This- 4–8 years in consumer insights, CX analytics, product analytics, UX research, or a similar role in B2C or consumer-facing companies, where you’ve worked across quantitative and qualitative inputs Comfortable in analytics platforms — session replay, web/app analytics, funnel analysis, segmented and cohort analysis. Can layer behavioural data over system-of-record data to move beyond surface-level insights. Specific tools matter less than your ability to get depth from any tool quickly Understands statistical thinking — hypothesis testing, significance, when to apply rigour and when to move on intuition Can read, challenge, and build on qualitative research even if you’re not the one conducting it — you know what good methodology looks like and can spot when a finding is thin Structures findings into clear, concise arguments. You’ve presented to senior stakeholders and know the difference between showing data and making a case Thinks in systems — you connect a drop-off at step 3 to an upstream design choice, a policy constraint, and a downstream business metric without being told to SQL-literate — you can pull what you need or speak to data teams in their language Brings critical reasoning that stress-tests assumptions rather than confirming them RequirementsIdeal Candidate Strong Consumer Insights / CX Analytics / Product Insights profile (behavioral/user/product/UX analytics) Mandatory (Experience 1) - Must have 4+ years of experience in Customer Experience (CX) Analytics, Consumer Insights, Product Analytics, Behavioral Analytics, or UX Analytics, working on B2C digital products (Web/App) with a focus on understanding customer behavior, customer journeys, and experience improvement. Mandatory (Experience 2) - Must have hands-on experience analyzing customer journeys, behavioral funnels, digital interactions, session-level behavior, clickstream data, and experience metrics to identify pain points, drop-offs, and optimization opportunities. Mandatory (Experience 3) - Must have experience using CX and Digital Experience Analytics platforms such as Medallia, ContentSquare, Google Analytics (GA4) or similar tools for customer behavior analysis, journey mapping, and insight generation. Mandatory (Experience 4) - Must have experience working closely with Product, Design, CX, Business, Marketing, and Research teams to generate insights, validate hypotheses, and drive customer experience improvements. Mandatory (Experience 5 ) - Strong working knowledge of SQL and Python for data extraction, querying, analysis, exploratory data analysis, automation, and behavioral data interpretation. Ability to independently analyze large datasets, identify patterns, and generate actionable business insights. title: Head of PBU - Vantage AI
description: About UsHead of Product Business Unit, Anchanto Vantage AIAnchanto | Pune, India | Reports to the Chief Executive Officer | Unit of 10 to 30 people, growing with each bet About AnchantoAnchanto is an e-commerce and supply chain technology company headquartered in Singapore, with offices in twelve countries across Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Europe and its largest engineering center in Pune. Brands, retailers and logistics service providers use our purpose built SaaS products to run and scale their e-commerce and omnichannel operations: Order Management, Warehouse Management, Anchanto Grid with more than 200 ready integrations to marketplaces, carriers and enterprise systems, Parcel Tracking, Control Tower and Operations Experience. Our AI enabled agentic services, launching soon, help customers run their commerce operations with less manual work and faster decisions. More than 360 enterprise customers, including L'OrÃ©al, Panasonic, EstÃ©e Lauder, DKSH, Toll and Bosch, process over 200 million orders a year through Anchanto across more than 700 warehouses. Anchanto is an Asendia portfolio company.THE UNITAnchanto Vantage AI is the data, intelligence and economics business of Anchanto, and the Product Business Unit that builds our new products. Every customer runs their operation on our software, so we hold the most complete operational and financial data they have: orders, inventory, fulfilment events, carrier performance, marketplace performance, settlements and cost to serve, correlated in one place. Vantage AI is built on that asset. It owns the central data layer across every Anchanto product and the products that monetize it: data access for enterprise data and AI teams through MCP, connectors and streaming; operational, business and market insights; Anchanto Settle and Anchanto E-commerce Economics, the financial operations and economics products for e-commerce, starting with marketplace settlement reconciliation and extending to cost to serve, channel contribution and the financial health of the operation; and agentic decisioning for e-commerce and supply chain, where the system sees the stock out, the SLA breach or the margin leak before the customer does and acts or recommends the action.A Product Business Unit (PBU) at Anchanto is Product Management and Engineering for one business, brought together as a single threaded organization with one head, one backlog and one set of priorities. This unit is different from the other PBUs in one respect: it takes bets. It builds more than one new product, runs each through stage gates, and either spins it out as its own PBU or closes it on evidence. The first bet in build is Anchanto Settle and E-commerce Economics; the data foundation and the agentic products follow.THE ROLEYou build a product business from the data Anchanto already holds. You set where each product goes, build it with your own product and engineering team, take it to the first paying customers with the revenue teams, and answer for what it earns. This is not a pure product management role and it is not a data platform role: you lead the engineers who build the data layer and the products on it, you own the technical quality of what ships, and you are measured on outcomes, not activities. It is also not a role that protects its bets. You propose them, you fund them against a gate, and you close the ones that fail.WHAT YOU OWN: STRATEGY, ROADMAP, ENGINEERING, BETS AND RESULTS Product strategy. For each product in the unit you know the market, the buyer and the competitors better than anyone in the company, set the strategy and the positioning ambition with the industry research leaders, and give the CROs your input on pricing, packaging and the entitlement model (included, paid module, download and page level) before anything is built. The portfolio of bets. You propose which products the unit builds, in what order, with what envelope and against what gate. Each bet moves through the same gates: problem validated with named design partners; first paying customer; ten paying customers; gross margin at scale; then spin out as its own PBU or close. You take the close decision yourself and put it in writing with the evidence. The data foundation. The central data lake and pipelines from every Anchanto product, the warehouse model, shard discipline, access and entitlement, and the MCP, connector and streaming layer that gives enterprise customers their data back. Nothing above it works without it, so it is built first and kept to an internal SLA for every other unit that consumes it. Roadmap, decisions and execution. One backlog per bet; what gets built, in what order and how; technical design within the architecture and security guardrails; release decisions; and whether a product can meet a scope and a date. Customer priorities and asks on live products come to you from the Delivery team, your internal customer. The way we build. Specs based, AI assisted engineering from the first line of code. Two pizza teams per bet, forward deployed engineers with design partners, built on Anchanto Grid and the Vantage data layer rather than on new plumbing. A bet does not get its own infrastructure. Results and people. The unit's P&L and the spend envelope of each bet; reliability and customer satisfaction for live products; unit structure, hiring, promotions and the final interview of every person joining the unit. Your people are not a bench for other units; a transfer out of the unit is your decision. CUSTOMERS, DESIGN PARTNERS AND THE REVENUE TEAMSThis is not a sales role and carries no quota. The CROs set market priorities, the go to market and what and how each product is sold; the revenue teams own the customer connect and close every deal. A 0 to 1 unit needs discovery, so the rule here is wider than in the other units: you run design partner and discovery conversations with enterprise data teams, finance teams and operations leaders, with the account owner in the room and informed before and after, and you bring the revenue teams the product story, the demos and the answers. You never price, negotiate or close alone, and you never go around the account owner to reach a customer.How You Manage Your People Every person in the unit has written objectives and two or three KPIs for the quarter, reviewed monthly; nobody is without them thirty days after joining. Everyone in the unit is full time on the unit; nobody works on Vantage on the side of another job. Feedback is direct, factual and given within the week, in writing when it matters. You represent the company to your team, not the team to the company. Management debt, wrong decisions, undelivered feedback and unaddressed interpersonal issues, is fixed within thirty days of knowing about it. Performance is measured against objectives, not effort or tenure. An underperformer gets a written plan and a date; if it passes you take the decision yourself, including exit. People are confirmed and promoted only after a documented assessment and a direct conversation. The unit reports in numbers, weekly in writing and monthly in the outcome review. You talk to your N-1, your N-2 and every individual contributor, with skip level one to ones at least quarterly, and the unit runs on a written meeting cadence you publish in your first thirty days and keep. OWNING CUSTOMER ESCALATIONSAn escalation on a live product of the unit is yours from the moment it is raised until the customer confirms it is closed. You do not trivialize it, and you do not expect the CEO or the CROs to lead it. You own the fix and the communication: first written update within the hour, a fixed written cadence until closed, root cause and corrective action within five working days after. For the data layer, an outage or a data quality failure felt by another unit's customer is your escalation too.How You Are MeasuredYou own outcomes, not activities. Products without customers cannot be judged on retention and margin yet, so the outputs below are built for a unit that takes bets. You run the unit on five to eight controllable input metrics that you propose, prove move the outputs, and review every week. Numbers are baselined in your first month and verified by Finance. Gate progress Each bet against the gate committed in the quarterly plan: design partners signed, first paying customer, ten paying customers, gross margin at scale; bets closed on evidence count as progress, bets kept alive without evidence do not. Time to revenue and ARR per bet Months from start to first paying customer; ARR, net revenue retention and churn per product once live; deals unblocked or lost on product capability. Data foundation Products connected to the central data layer, data freshness and quality, enterprise customers on MCP, connector or streaming access, internal SLA met for the other units. Time to market Weeks from bet approved to a product early adopters can use; weeks from first build to first paying customer; early adopters signed and live with the revenue and account management teams each quarter; planned versus actual on the quarterly plan with variances explained in writing. Reliability and customer satisfaction Availability, incidents and time to resolve, data quality incidents, escalations by count, root cause and time to close, NPS or CSAT on live products. AI leverage and AI first approach Share of work built specs based and AI assisted, automation percentage by activity, and whether every product is designed AI first and agentic rather than as a dashboard. Team EPS and health Team EPS score, attrition and regretted attrition, skills coverage, and whether the unit runs without you in the room.PLANNING AND CADENCEYou write the product plan for the unit as a portfolio: which bets, the thesis and the buyer of each, the envelope, the gate and the date it is reviewed. The annual plan each October is a six page narrative with targets and resource scenarios. Four weeks before each quarter you write a ninety day plan derived from both, presented to and aligned with the leadership team; execution is measured against it. Weekly unit review on the inputs in writing, monthly outcome review with the CEO, quarterly gate review per bet, and a review of the two or three CEO goals for the unit.Skills And Prior ExperienceMust haves for every candidate. Candidates without all of these will not be shortlisted. At least fifteen years of industry experience, and at least one product taken personally from zero to paying customers in B2B SaaS, fintech or commerce technology, with accountability for its results. Global experience. Has worked in, and built or run operations outside India, with customers or teams in more than one country. India only experience does not qualify. Education. Engineering from IIT or NIT, or an MBA from IIM or a top ranked global business school. Data and AI products. Has built or run a product whose value is data, analytics or AI driven decisions, and can sit with an enterprise data team and a finance team in the same week and be credible with both. Domain. E-commerce, marketplaces, logistics or supply chain, or the finance and operations functions they serve. Decides and manages directly. Makes the call quickly, takes the trade off and answers for the outcome; has closed a product or a project of their own on evidence; has set objectives for every person, given hard feedback in time, taken exit decisions personally and owned the communication in a customer crisis. Career paths we are open to. Nobody arrives with product, technology, data and business skills at the same depth, so we hire from four paths and test for the second skill in each. Technology or data leader with product skills. CTO, Director of Engineering, Head of Data or equivalent who has built, released and commercialized data or AI systems, and has also owned a roadmap, met the market and made product trade offs. Product leader with technology depth. Head of Product for a data, analytics, fintech or commerce product in B2B SaaS, who has led or closely directed engineering and has shipped and commercialized what they defined. Operations or finance practitioner from a large 3PL, retailer, brand or marketplace. Has run e-commerce finance, settlements, supply chain or fulfilment operations at scale and has specified, bought or built the data and systems behind it well enough to direct a product team. Consultant or transformation leader. Head of a data, analytics, supply chain or commerce practice who has delivered data platforms, decisioning systems and operating models for clients end to end rather than advised from the side. title: Research Associate / Sr Research Associate (Heat Forecast)
description:
Title: Research Associate / Senior Research Associate (Heat Forecast)
  
  
Location: Delhi, India preferred. Applicants must hold Indian citizenship and valid authorization to work in India. Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications from OCI (Overseas Citizen of India) cardholders for this role.
  
  
Salary: Salary will be competitive and commensurate with the candidate's skills, experience, and the local labor market in India.
  
  
Position: Full-time
  
  
Application deadline: Nov 10, 2026, at 5 pm IST (applications may be reviewed as they are submitted)
  
  
**About The Role**
Precision Development (PxD) is looking for a Research Associate / Senior Research Associate to join our weather initiative in India. The successful candidate will lead formative research on how AI-based heat forecasts can help agriculture and livestock farmers prepare for and respond to heat. Working closely with PxD and affiliated researchers, they will help define a concrete heat-advisory use case and pilot it with farmers and government partners — testing new ideas and measuring their impact.
  
  
The role calls for someone who is curious about how farmers make decisions under climate risk, comfortable moving between fieldwork and data, and who understands how digital technology is adopted and scaled within government.
  
  
If you're passionate about turning advances in AI weather forecasting into practical, evidence-based services for farmers, and committed to driving positive change in the agricultural sector, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
We're hiring for this role at either the Research Associate or Senior Research Associate level. The specific level will be determined based on the candidate's years of experience, demonstrated seniority, and scope of past responsibilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
These will evolve as the role develops; key initial areas are outlined below.
  
  
Formative Research
  
  

* Design and conduct formative research (qualitative interviews, focus group discussions, rapid surveys) with crop and livestock farmers to understand how extreme heat affects their livelihoods, decisions, and coping strategies
* Map farmers' current sources of weather information, the timing and lead time they need, and the actions they could take in response to a heat forecast.
* Engage with government agencies, meteorological departments, extension systems, and livestock/veterinary services to understand existing heat early-warning systems and gaps
* Review literature and existing evidence on heat-stress impacts and heat early-warning interventions in agriculture and livestock
* Synthesize findings into clear research briefs and presentations for internal teams and partners.

Use Case Definition & Design
  
  

* Translate formative research insights into a well-defined use case for AI-based heat forecasts, specifying target users, decisions supported, forecast variables, lead times, and thresholds
* Work with data science and forecasting partners to assess the skill and suitability of AI-based heat forecast products for the target geographies
* Co-design heat advisory content and delivery channels with farmers, agronomists, and livestock experts

Data & Analysis
  
  

* Design and program survey instruments (SurveyCTO/ODK)
* Oversee data collection quality, including field visits, back-checks, and high-frequency checks
* Analyze pilot data on farmer engagement, comprehension, trust, behavior change, and early outcomes
* Clean, merge, and analyze weather, forecast, survey, and administrative data (Stata, R, or Python)
* Assess the relationship between heat exposure and agricultural and livestock outcomes using existing data where available
* Monitor forecast performance against observed weather data and flag issues to technical partners
* Contribute to dashboards and data pipelines supporting PxD's weather initiative, as needed

What You'll Bring
  
  

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in economics, agricultural economics, public policy, development studies, statistics, environmental/climate science, or a closely related field
* Demonstrated experience conducting field research in LMIC settings, including qualitative methods (interviews, FGDs) and quantitative surveys
* Strong understanding of economics and econometrics, and familiarity with randomized evaluations
* Excellent knowledge of Stata, R, Python, or similar software for data analysis
* Demonstrated experience using SurveyCTO/ODK or a similar program for survey design
* Understanding of research ethics for human subjects in the social sciences
* Interest in climate adaptation, weather and climate services, or digital agriculture; familiarity with weather/forecast data or heat-stress impacts on crops or livestock is a strong plus
* Ability to translate research insights into practical product or service design, working with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent organizational skills, detail-oriented, and ability to work both independently and collaboratively
* Fluency in English with strong oral and written communication skills; knowledge of Hindi or another Indian language is a plus
* Ability to work under time pressure and solve problems creatively
* Willingness to travel frequently to project sites and conduct fieldwork, including during summer months

How to Apply
  
  
To apply, please visit the PxD website and use the online application form to submit a CV, cover letter, and brief responses to the screening questions. Applications may be reviewed on a rolling basis. The final deadline to apply is 10 November 2026, 5 pm IST.
  
  
In line with our values, we evaluate candidates on merit alone, without regard to gender, gender identity, ethnicity, religion, disability, caste, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We offer flexible working arrangements to support your wellbeing. Personal data provided is used for recruitment purposes only.
  
  
**About Precision Development (PxD)**
PxD is a rapidly scaling global nonprofit working with governments across Africa and Asia to close the last-mile gap in smallholder farming. We deliver evidence-based information and tools — from timely farming and weather guidance to climate-resilient inputs — that millions of farmers use to improve their lives. In the last 12 months alone, we reached over 60 million farmers at a cost of just $0.47 per farmer per year, with our flagship program in India delivering a benefit-cost ratio of 12:1–19:1.
  
  
Operating in Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, and beyond, the majority of our team is based in our program countries, working directly alongside government partners and farming communities toward our goal of improving the lives of 100 million farmers by 2030.

This team, of highly motivated and insightful colleagues, will provide an opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial environment supported by a global management consulting firm, which is the world’s leading advisor on business strategy.
  
  
A BCG Senior Solution Analyst is someone who will work with product manager and senior leadership in various business groups to help drive capabilities and support increased commercialization of BCG proprietary data and software assets. This person will work together with technical and commercial teams from the initial business case to roadmap delivery, launch, and ongoing support operations. We want someone with an entrepreneurial drive and demonstrated experience leading enterprise or large-scale product efforts across product strategy, marketing, finance, engineering, support, and executive stakeholders.
  
  
Additionally, you will work in a growing global team, providing industry & topic expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, methodologies, software solutions, analysis and expert advisory. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues This is an exciting opportunity to jump into a unique position at a world class firm.
  
  
**YOU'RE GOOD AT**
**Product Management**

* Co-own the product roadmap with the Product Manager and keep it tied to business goals and user needs
* Conduct user research and usability tests, and use the results alongside market analysis and client feedback to improve the product
* Gather and prioritize requirements in stakeholder workshops, then write them up as user stories with acceptance criteria
* Build user personas and use AI design tools to prototype and iterate with the UI/UX team
* Run Scrum ceremonies with the engineering team and clear blockers to keep features shipping on time
* Join technical discussions and translate between engineering and business stakeholders so product decisions stay feasible
* Keep feature lists, user guides and release notes current, and update stakeholders on progress and milestones

**Product Delivery**

* As a thought partner to case teams and clients, define the business problem early and shape a solution around it

* Manage MVP-based implementation plans as the client’s day-to-day point of contact, and set realistic expectations about what the product covers today
* Lead demos and training sessions that get case teams and client users working in the product
* Triage client issues and work them through to resolution with Engineering and Support
* Convert case learnings into proprietary assets and input for the roadmap

**AI-Native ways of working**

* Set up and maintain the team’s AI harness, including a product knowledge base that captures context, personas, business rules and past decisions, plus connectors to Azure DevOps, Confluence and SharePoint
* Create a library of reusable skills, such as a story writer, BRD generator and release notes generator, and update/maintain them as the product changes
* Convert routine product owner work (backlog refinement, story writing and edge-case testing, sprint review prep, stakeholder updates) into repeatable AI workflows with defined inputs and a standard output format
* Help design agentic workflows that chain AI tools and models to automate repetitive, multi-step tasks
* Coach clients and case teams on building AI dashboards and structuring outputs data through prompts
* Test new AI tools, models and agentic techniques against client use cases and recommend which ones to adopt
* Make sure every product decision and AI-generated output has a named human owner, and protect client data under BCG’s AI usage and responsible AI guidelines

What You'll Bring
  
  
**Technco-Functional Proficiency and Collaboration**

* 2-3 years of consulting experience (preferred) or 3-4 years in industry, ideally in a business analysis or product role on a SaaS product
* Exposure to transformation, restructuring, change management or PMI, with an appetite to build depth in these topics
* Solid grasp of P&L and balance sheet KPIs plus proficiency in PowerPoint and financial modelling in Excel
* A good understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile delivery (no coding required); Tableau or Alteryx skills are an advantage
* Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot, including prompt engineering, skill building, and agentic workflow design
* Structured problem solving and analytical rigor, with the planning discipline and attention to detail to follow through on commitments
* Experience communicating with and influencing senior stakeholders across global teams, and the judgment to know when to escalate
* Entrepreneurial drive and a record of hitting stretch goals in fast-moving environments
* Comfortable working independently or in distributed teams, and quick to pick up new tools and methods.

Who You'll Work With
  
  

* Client, Case, & BCG Vantage team members
* Product Engineering, Product Delivery, and Infrastructure Support team
* Helpdesk, Reporting & Data Analytics team
* Topic/Product/Case Leadership

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Assistant Fraud Strategy Manager
description:
Join us as a an Assistant Fraud Strategy Manager at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.

**Critical / Essential Skills**

* Define clear business requirements, manage prioritised backlogs and support feature teams through delivery using Agile ways of working and JIRA.

* Investigate complex customer and fraud-related issues and translate findings into strategic and operational change initiatives.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of risk, control and governance practices, including Operational Risk and Control Assessments, issue management, Consumer Duty, control monitoring, evidence gathering and escalation.
* Exercise sound judgement on when to act, align or escalate, particularly where customer harm or regulatory risk may arise.
* Build effective relationships with stakeholders across the United Kingdom and India, including Product, Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Controls and Customer Experience teams.

* Produce high-quality governance materials, management information, presentations and written recommendations for senior decision-makers.
* Apply structured problem-solving, strategic thinking, attention to detail and ownership to resolve complex business challenges.
* Demonstrate commercial acumen and knowledge of market trends and the competitor landscape to benchmark performance and inform priorities.
* Use artificial intelligence-enabled tools responsibly to improve analysis, insight generation, backlog quality and documentation, while retaining accountability for outcomes.
* Use Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint to at least an intermediate level.

**Desirable Skillsets/ Good To Have**

* Fraud and scam domain knowledge.
* SQL skills
* Experience supporting AI-enabled processes or transformation.
* Fraud and scam loss management.
* Ability to monitor and interpret loss performance, emerging fraud trends and portfolio risk indicators.
* Experience conducting root cause analysis (RCA) to identify key drivers of fraud and scam losses and define improvement actions.
* Experience supporting loss management, portfolio reviews or performance governance forums.

This role will be based out of Gurugram.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
Product Managers are responsible for the leading the strategic focus of the product(s), defining the product vision, market strategy, and competitive analysis. They think about the product's future and how it will evolve over time. They work with various teams, including marketing, engineering, operations, and sales, to ensure everyone is aligned on the product strategy. They use data and market research to inform their decisions and prioritize product features.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Define Product Strategy: Accountable for defining a product strategy that aligns with business vision, managing capabilities, balancing short-term with long-term goals, ensuring that products meet market demands and drive growth.
* Cross functional alignment: Leadership of cross functional relationships, working with various cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of product strategy and goals.
* Risk and Control: Accountable for overseeing product risk management, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to mitigate those risks, and maintenance of alignment between the product management and control functions.
* Product Development Lifecycle: Own product development lifecycle, from concept to launch, ensuring efficient processes, on-time delivery, and alignment with E2E customer expectations and experience. – working with product owners to drive change objectives.
* Deliver Product Goals and Performance: Deliver clear objectives and key outcomes to steer the product vision and ensure alignment with company’s business goals, financial targets, and strategic vision, driving long-term business success.
* Data driven decisions: Monitor product performance through data-driven analysis and insights, regularly assessing progress against objectives and adjusting the strategies as needed to optimise outcomes and maximise value for both business and customer.
* Customer-Centric Focus: Drive a customer -first approach across the product vision, ensuring customer insights, feedback, behaviours, and pain points are at the core of the product strategy and decision-making process.
* Business and financial acumen: Understanding pricing models, costs structures, and ROI to make financially grounded decisions regarding product development.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Copywriter
description:
We’re looking for a
**Copywriter**
who knows how to turn ideas into copy that captures attention, builds interest, and drives action.

This role is ideal for someone who understands
**D2C brands, consumer psychology, and performance marketing,**
and enjoys experimenting with different hooks, messaging and creative angles to influence buying decisions.

If you genuinely enjoy writing, love testing what works, and want to grow with a fast-paced D2C wellness brand, we’d love to hear from you.

**About Ayuvya**

Ayuvya is building a modern Ayurveda and wellness brand rooted in trust, authenticity, and innovation.

We believe great copy is more than just creative writing-it should communicate value, build credibility, connect with consumers, and ultimately drive measurable results and conversions.

**Key Responsibilities:-﻿**

* Write performance-driven copy and video ad scripts
  **for Meta, Google, YouTube, and other digital platforms, with a focus on attention, engagement and conversions.**
* Develop strong hooks, creative angles, headlines, storytelling, value propositions and CTAs tailored to different audiences and stages of the customer journey.

* Collaborate closely with the Performance Marketing, Design, Video, CRM and Creative teams to turn ideas and copy into engaging, on-brand, and execution-friendly creatives.
* Experiment with different hooks, messaging, formats and creative concepts, and continuously iterate based on campaign performance and audience response.
* Analyse key performance metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPM, ROAS, Hook Rate and Hold Rate to understand creative performance and improve copy effectiveness.
* Research competitor communication, advertising strategies, consumer behaviour, and emerging content trends, including using platforms such as Meta Ads Library to identify insights and creative opportunities.
* Maintain the quality, clarity, accuracy and consistency of brand communication across all touchpoints while proofreading and editing copy and creatives before execution.

**Requirements:-**

* 1–3 years of experience in
  **Copywriting, preferably with D2C, Wellness, FMCG, Beauty, Lifestyle or E-commerce brands.**
* Strong portfolio showcasing performance ad copy, video scripts, landing pages, product copy, social media email or CRM campaigns.
* Excellent command of English with strong storytelling, conceptual thinking and communication skills.
* Understanding of performance marketing, consumer psychology, customer behaviour and conversion-focused communication.
* Ability to write strong hooks, headlines, benefits, value propositions and persuasive CTAs.
* Comfortable working with performance metrics and using data and audience insights to improve creative communication.
* Ability to balance creativity with business and performance objectives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

**We’re Looking For Someone Who**

* Thinks consumer-first and understands what makes people stop, read, watch, click and buy.
* Enjoys writing for performance and conversions not just engagement.
* Can turn product features into clear, relatable and persuasive benefits.
* Is comfortable testing multiple copy angles and learning from performance data.
* Brings ideas and initiative to the table instead of relying entirely on detailed briefs.
* Is open to feedback, iteration, and continuously improving their craft.

**This Role May Not Be the Right Fit If**

* **﻿**
  You think copywriting is limited to captions, hashtags and social media posts.
* You’re not interested in performance, testing or conversion metrics.
* You’re uncomfortable rewriting copy based on feedback or campaign performance.
* You focus only on how copy sounds without considering who it is for, why they should care and what action they should take.

title: Lead, User-Led Growth (Referrals & Affiliates)
description:
**About Atlys**
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
  
  
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
  
  
Atlys is changing that.
  
  
We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
**1M+ travellers across 127 countries**
. But we’re still early.
  
  
**The Role**
We’re looking for a
**User-Led Growth Lead**
to turn our 1M+ travellers into one of Atlys’s most powerful growth channels.
  
  
You’ll own the referral & affiliate program end to end, from how it is constructed and how it shows up in the product to the data and operations that make it run, working closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing and Data.
  
  
This is a high-ownership role for someone who has built something from scratch and can own both the strategy and the execution.
  
  
**The Job**

* Own the referral program construct, the incentives, reward economics and placement in the traveller journey, rebuilt from first principles and extended with new levers like an affiliate program.
* Reimagine the referral experience with Product and Engineering, from discovery and sharing to reward redemption across the app and website, shipping experiments that move the numbers.
* Understand who refers and why, digging into data on non-referrers, new referrers and power referrers and running motivation studies that turn into targeted interventions.
* Build the processes behind the program, from reward fulfilment to reporting, so it runs reliably at scale.
* Run a tight ship on delivery, executing referral and UGC campaigns relentlessly, paying every reward on time and catching fraud before it scales.

**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have 3–4 years of experience in growth, product or strategy roles at a startup.
* Have built something from 0 to 1, ideally a referral, loyalty or user-led growth program, and taken it from idea to scale.
* Are a first-principle thinker who is deeply data-driven and lets numbers, not opinions, guide decisions.
* Have a strong grasp of consumer psychology and product, and understand how incentives, timing and UX shape user behaviour.
* Are execution-heavy with strong ops diligence: you sweat the details, close loops and ship fast.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
  
  
**Here’s What You Can Expect**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
  
  
*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*
