title: R&D Technical Writer - IDC - Entry Professional
description:
As a Technical Writer, you will create clear, concise, and comprehensive high-quality technical documentation for various products of Automation & Communication Product group within Grid Automation Business Unit of Hitachi Energy.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Do you enjoy writing and turning complex technical concepts into clear, structured documentation?
  
  
We are looking for a technical writer to join our User Documentation team in Bangalore. You will be part of a highly motivated, energetic, enthusiastic, collaborative, ever-learning team who are proud of their work at Hitachi Energy.
  
  
You will be part of the team which creates and maintains technical documentation for various products of Automation & Communication product group within Grid Automation Business Unit of Hitachi Energy.
  
  
You will collaborate closely with subject matter experts (SMEs), product managers, engineers, and quality assurance teams to gather information, understand product functionality, and accurately translate complex technical concepts into easily understandable content.
  
  
Your work will play a key role in making our technology accessible and usable for internal teams, customers, and partners worldwide.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* You will have opportunity to interact with subject matter experts (SMEs), product managers and others to translate complex technical concept into easily understandable content.
* Conduct thorough research and analysis to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of all documentation.
* Adhere to established documentation standards, style guides, and terminology to maintain a consistent brand voice and quality across all deliverables.
* Review and edit documentation for grammar, spelling, punctuation, clarity, and adherence to technical specifications.
* Handling translation co-ordination activities for various languages like German, French, Spanish, Czech, Japanese and others.
* Create / edit images in Visio and Snagit editor.
* Enthusiastically learn AI tools (GPT, Copilot, etc) for authoring and review.
* Manage multiple documentation projects simultaneously, prioritizing tasks and meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Continuously seek opportunities to improve documentation processes, tools, and content quality.
* Participate and identify areas for documentation improvement.
* Utilize various authoring tools, content management systems (CMS), and version control software effectively.
* Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Hitachi Energy’s core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

**Your Background**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical engineering, Computer Science Engineering, or a related field.
* 2-5 years of proven experience as a Technical Writer, preferably in the energy, industrial automation, or software development sectors.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a strong command of English grammar, style, and vocabulary.
* Proficiency in creating clear, concise, and user-friendly technical documentation for diverse audiences.
* Experience with various documentation tools such as Oxygen XML, or similar.
* Familiarity with DITA XML, preferably Tridion Docs or similar, structured authoring, and component content management systems (CMS) is highly desirable.
* Ability to understand and interpret complex technical concepts and specifications.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
* Experience with Agile development methodologies is a plus.
* Knowledge of electrical engineering and power systems will be a significant advantage.

title: Specialist - BPM Process Optimisation
description:
Job Title: Specialist - BPM Process Optimisation
  
  
GCL:D2
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to turn rigorous process design into enterprise outcomes that unlock time for discovery and better serve patients? As a Specialist - BPM Process Optimisation based in Chennai, you will report to the Process Optimisation Director and support the end-to-end management and evolution of our BPM platform. This permanent role blends deep analytical thinking with clear, impactful communication across a diverse global collaborator community.
  
  
You will help shape our strategy and standards, strengthen governance, and build a thriving BPM community of practice that delivers consistent, high-quality models ready for automation and insight. Your work will enable faster, smarter decision-making across the business by connecting process clarity to measurable efficiency and effectiveness. How will you translate complex operations into simple, reusable assets that scale across the enterprise?
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* BPM Strategy and Framework: Co-develop the direction of our BPM approach; maintain methodologies, modeling standards, governance and guidelines so process assets are consistent, trusted and reusable.
* Platform Governance and Administration: Act as tool administrator; manage configurations, metadata and access; ensure data integrity; and communicate directly with software providers and internal technology teams to prioritize enhancements and resolve issues at pace.
* Process Modelling Excellence: Model and document end-to-end business processes using BPMN 2.0; guide strategic projects with high-quality process maps that drive efficiency, quality and compliance outcomes.
* Community Enablement and Training: Lead onboarding of new users to the BPM platform; deliver training and certification; run clinics and office hours to build capability and foster a collaborative, supportive community.
* Insight-Driven Optimisation: Analyse and redesign business processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness; identify daily work optimisation opportunities using AI and link process insights to automation, mining and continuous improvement.
* Agile Delivery and Ways of Working: Operate within Agile methodology; manage backlogs and status analyses; work virtually across time zones with strong time management, balancing multiple initiatives without losing momentum.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Solid understanding of process modelling techniques, tools, frameworks and standards
* Strong experience in at least one BPM platform (e.g. BIC, Bizagi, Aris, Signavio etc.)
* Ability to model and document end to end business processes using BPMN 2.0
* Capable of acting as tool administrator and performing requirement gatherings and status analyses
* Ability to communicate/articulate requests directly to software providers, alongside other internal technological teams
* Analysing and designing business processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness
* Ability to seek daily work activities optimisation with AI utilization
* Energetic and self-motivated
* Strong time management skills with ability to work at pace, handling multiple initiatives at one time
* Comfortable with working virtually in a global environment
* Proficiency in English
* Experience of working in Agile methodology

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience of various related BPM capabilities such Process/Task Mining, Robotics Process Automation, Low Code automation, BPM, workflow tools.
* Experience of working in Agile methodology
* Six Sigma or Lean Management Green Belt certified
* Experience in change management projects and process optimization initiatives

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca**
Here you will power a global enterprise by building the process foundation that lets teams run faster and achieve more for patients. You’ll collaborate in a connected community that prizes thoughtful challenge, quick decision-making and shared learning, working with modern platforms and data to drive real-world impact. We blend ambition with support, valuing kindness alongside high standards, and we trust our people to take ownership, take smart risks and see things through. Your contribution will be visible and meaningful—turning clear processes into the engine of innovation across the company.
  
  
**Call To Action**
If you are ready to scale a global BPM capability, elevate efficiency and enable teams to focus on what matters most, submit your application today.

title: Product Support Engineer
description: About the jobFounded in 2021, Complyance is a developer-first e-invoicing SaaS company. Through a single API, we help businesses connect their invoicing workflows and meet e-invoicing mandates across markets, including the UAE and Saudi Arabia’s ZATCA requirements, without rebuilding e-invoicing every time they enter a new market.After five years of bootstrapped investment in engineering, we recently raised US$1.5 million in pre-series funding to accelerate an already-operating platform serving enterprise customers. We support e-invoicing projects for brands including L’Occitane, Mothercare Malaysia, LC Waikiki and RedBus, alongside Abu Dhabi-based Tadweer Group. Behind those names are real integrations, busy finance teams and business workflows that need to keep moving.We connect ERP, billing and business systems with the tools to map invoice data, validate documents, submit invoices and track their status. Product work such as ERP Reconciliation, AI Reports and our AI Support Assistant shows the range of practical problems we are building for.Life at Complyance :We take initiative, write down what matters and share what we learn. We ask good questions, communicate uncertainty honestly and use feedback to improve.Ownership also means judgement: we protect customer information, respect tenant boundaries and use approved access. And Support and Core Engineering are complementary specialisms, not junior and senior tiers.The mission :Product Support Engineering at Complyance is not about forwarding queries or closing as many tickets as possible. It is about understanding why something isn’t working, helping the customer through it, and improving the product or tools behind the experience.You will build technical depth by investigating APIs, integrations and invoicing workflows alongside Core Product Engineering, and own the customer’s conversation through a verified resolution or an accepted handover. When you are not handling client issues, you will keep building, maintaining and enhancing our internal support bot.If you enjoy helping people and want writing code to remain part of your work, this role brings both together.Where you’ll leave your mark :• Get to the bottom of technical problems: Reproduce issues in a safe environment, test hypotheses and connect evidence across browser developer tools, APIs, logs and product behaviour. Learn to tell configuration issues, integration failures, product defects and expected behaviour apart.• Own the customer’s experience: Explain what you know in clear language, agree the next action and update, keep customers informed while engineering investigates, and verify the affected workflow before calling it restored.• Write code that makes support better: Write and debug diagnostic or reproduction scripts, regression tests and support-tool improvements, and, as your skills grow, contribute reviewed bug fixes.• Build and own our internal support bot: Turn recurring support needs into useful capabilities, fix defects, add tests and keep documentation current.• Work alongside Core Product Engineering: Bring clear evidence, useful reproduction steps and a specific technical request, while keeping the customer conversation.• Make the next case easier: Turn recurring patterns into better troubleshooting guides, diagnostics, automation and product feedback that help the next person.• Learn how e-invoicing works in practice: Build knowledge of supported-country workflows, customer integrations and document journeys, working with Product, Customer Success, delivery and the ERP/Integration role.The kind of builder we’re looking for :You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:• Have experience in product support, software engineering or API/integration troubleshooting, or are a fresher with strong foundations and learning potential.• Genuinely want to work in a customer-facing product support environment.• Like understanding how systems work, not simply following a script, and can break an unfamiliar problem into useful checks.• Have a working understanding of HTTP, JSON, APIs, authentication, client-server behaviour and databases, gained through study, projects, internships or employment.• Can write, debug and test small programs, read unfamiliar code, and use logs or queries to reason about a problem.• Can explain a technical issue clearly to technical and non-technical people, and keep others updated.• Take ownership after escalation, distinguish facts from assumptions, and ask for help before an unsafe action.• Research independently, respond well to feedback and show what you learned from one problem to the next.Prior Product Support experience is not required. A particular degree or previous e-invoicing specialisation is not required either. We care about your foundations, curiosity, communication and learning potential.Bonus points :• ERP/accounting integrations, webhooks and asynchronous systems.• MongoDB or SQL, and browser developer tools.• Customer-facing troubleshooting experience.• TypeScript/JavaScript, Bun, React/Next.js and automated testing.This is useful experience, not a checklist. Complyance workflows, country-specific product behaviour and our tools are learnable; we do not expect you to arrive knowing the whole stack.What growth and success look like :You will build product understanding, diagnostic depth, customer communication and engineering skills through coaching and practical work, with learning goals that reflect your starting point.Success means sound diagnosis, safe decisions, kept communication commitments, useful tools and verified customer progress, not ticket, fix, article or pull-request quotas.Why Complyance? • Competitive base salary. The range will be shared with shortlisted candidates.• Comprehensive benefits, including health insurance for you and your family and paid time off.• The chance to build for a category that is being shaped by regulation right now, across some of the fastest-moving e-invoicing markets in the world.• A lean, collaborative team where your work is visible and your decisions matter.How to applyApply on LinkedIn with your CV, or share the profile of someone you think is a strong fit.

title: Demo Engineer / Presales Solutions Consulting
description:
Here at Appian, our values of
**Intensity**
and
**Excellence**
define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.

**Demo Engineer**

Here at Appian, our core values of Excellence and Intensity define who we are. In short, this means we constantly seek to understand the best for our customers, we go beyond completion in our work, we strive for excellence with intensity, and we embrace candid communication. These values guide our actions and shape our culture every day. When you join Appian, you'll be part of a passionate team that's dedicated to accomplishing hard things.

SC 2.0 is the engine powering our vision
. Appian's
**Sales Solutions Consulting**
team is in the midst of an exciting transformation -- redefining what it means to be a trusted advisor in today's fast-paced, mission-driven environment. Our SCs don't just demo features -- they tell stories, co-create with customers, and help shape strategy with technical credibility and business insight.
Read More About SC 2.0 Here

You can listen to our Global SSC leader, Gregg Aldana discuss SC 2.0
here
.

The
**SPEAR Team**
(Strategic Presales Execution and Readiness) is the operational engine behind Appian's global Presales organization -- the team that builds the tools, assets, governance, and infrastructure that let Solutions Consultants do their best work. As a Demo Engineer on SPEAR, you are not on the sidelines of SC 2.0 -- you are one of the people making it possible at scale.

**The Role**

Behind every great demo is a great demo asset, and that's where you come in. As a Demo Engineer on Appian's SPEAR Team in Chennai, you are the technical backbone that turns one-off sales demos into a polished, reusable, continuously evolving library that powers hundreds of sales engagements each year. While our Solutions Consultants are out in the field telling stories and co-creating with customers, you ensure they always have the right asset, in the right shape, ready to go.

In this role, you'll capture, refine, and expand Appian product demos -- de-branding prospect-specific work, modernizing older assets with the latest platform capabilities, and packaging everything into reusable demos, clickable demo experiences, walkthrough videos, and scripts. You'll also contribute directly to DemoHub, Appian's centralized demo catalog and governance system -- helping evolve the application itself, not just the content inside it.

You will be coached and guided by the Lead Demo Engineer based in Chennai, reporting to the SPEAR Team leadership in the US -- giving you both strong local support and direct visibility into Appian's global Presales strategy.

This is a unique opportunity to develop deep expertise in the Appian platform while making a tangible, measurable impact on global sales. If you're detail-oriented, technically curious, and excited about shaping how Appian shows up to the market, this role is for you.

What you'll be doing...

* Demo Ingestion and Cataloging: Capture product demos developed during live sales engagements and ingest them into DemoHub, ensuring they are organized, tagged, discoverable, and reusable across the global Solutions Consulting organization.
* De-branding and Refinement: De-brand prospect-specific demos, clean up their design and functionality, and prepare them for broader organizational use -- turning one-off assets into reusable gold.
* Demo Enhancement: Refresh and extend existing demos by incorporating advanced new Appian features and functionality, keeping the library current with the latest product releases, GTM narratives, and industry trends.
* DemoHub Application Development: Contribute to the ongoing development and maintenance of the DemoHub Appian application itself -- the platform that stores, governs, and surfaces demo content to the global SC team. This includes building new features, fixing bugs, and improving usability.
* Clickable Demo Production: Record, edit, and continually update interactive clickable demos in a commercial third-party demo platform, ensuring our self-service and accelerated demo experiences stay accurate, on-brand, and aligned with current product capabilities.
* Demo Artifact Creation: Produce supporting artifacts including walkthrough videos, demo scripts, talk tracks, and quick-reference guides that help SCs adopt and adapt assets quickly.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with Solutions Consultants worldwide, the SPEAR Team, and other Presales stakeholders to ensure demo assets reflect the latest go-to-market priorities and customer outcomes.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline demo ingestion, cataloging, and maintenance workflows, and help bring those ideas to life.
* Additional SPEAR Initiatives: Contribute to other Presales enablement and readiness initiatives as the SPEAR Team's portfolio evolves.

Who you are...

* Strong experience with Appian or a similar low-code application development platform, including design, development, and debugging of applications.
* Excellent technical and programming skills are a must, with concrete examples of times you have applied them to deliver polished work.
* Attention to detail and a focus on delivering high-quality output -- the kind that other people see and immediately want to copy.
* Excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize tasks in a high-volume, dynamic environment (think hundreds of demos per year flowing through your pipeline).
* Comfortable working on a cross-functional team and collaborating with global stakeholders across multiple time zones. Solid verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills are a must.
* Familiarity with interactive demo platforms (Storylane, Reprise, Navattic, Walnut, or similar) is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with video recording and editing tools for producing walkthrough content is a plus.
* Self-motivated, highly driven individual with a strong sense of urgency.
* B.S. or M.S. in Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Math, Physics, or equivalent work experience.

**Tools and Resources**

* Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.
* Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.
* Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.

**Benefits**

Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.

**About Appian**

Appian provides AI automation for mission-critical work. We automate complex processes in large enterprises and governments. Our platform is known for its unique reliability and scale. We’ve been automating processes for more than 25 years and understand enterprise operations like no one else. For more information, visit appian.com. [Nasdaq: APPN]

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
As a Senior Consultant in Deloitte’s Cyber practice, you will help clients strengthen data protection capabilities across strategy, design, and implementation efforts. You will support the delivery of data protection solutions that address security, privacy, and regulatory requirements while helping organizations operate with greater confidence in a changing risk landscape. This role offers the opportunity to work across assessments, solution design, deployment, integration, and client enablement in complex enterprise environments.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant - Data Protection on the Data and Digital Trust team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Assess client data protection environments, perform gap analyses, and support the development of remediation recommendations aligned to business and security requirements.
* Contribute to the design of data protection solutions, including technical requirements, high-level design, low-level design, and evaluation of technologies through proof-of-concept activities.
* Deploy, configure, and support data protection technologies across enterprise environments, including migrations, upgrades, high-availability configurations, and platform integrations.
* Develop detection use cases, workflows, and supporting documentation to help clients operationalize and sustain data protection capabilities.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, client stakeholders, and third-party vendors to deliver implementation activities, knowledge transfer, and project documentation.

**The team**
Data and Digital Trust practice is primarily focused on helping our clients to do effective utilization of data while safeguarding privacy and security. D&DT solutions prioritize transparency, privacy, and the ethical use of data, assisting organizations in driving sustainable digital transformation. Our solutions assist organizations in meeting the shifting expectations of consumers and create unprecedented business opportunities. We help our clients to define their overall Data protection and Privacy strategy, design global, pan-enterprise programs that focus on mitigating threats, evaluate their objectives, priorities, strengths and weaknesses and roll out large scale organizational changes to achieve goals. Our services capture work across advice, implement, and operate solutions. The Data and Digital Trust team delivers services to clients through following key areas:
  
  

* Privacy Governance & Compliance
* Data Protection & Compliance
* Digital Trust & Online Protection
* Risk & Controls Enablement
* Technology & Implementation

Our Data and Digital Trust solutions are designed to allow organizations to address requirements stemming from the ever-changing regulatory landscape, consumer expectations, and technological transformations and advancements.

The candidate will also support technical proposals, business development activities, and operational improvement initiatives across multiple project locations in India.

**Key Technical Competencies**

The candidate must possess sound working knowledge and hands-on experience in the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of the following systems:

**STP – Sewage Treatment Plant:** Treatment processes, biological systems, sludge management, equipment maintenance, and treated water quality.

**ETP – Effluent Treatment Plant:** Industrial wastewater treatment, chemical dosing, process control, effluent quality monitoring, and statutory compliance.

**WTP – Water Treatment Plant:** Clarification, filtration, softening, disinfection, and water quality management.

**RO – Reverse Osmosis Systems:** Membrane operations, pretreatment, CIP, recovery optimization, and troubleshooting.

**ATFD – Agitated Thin Film Dryer:** Drying operations, thermal performance, product handling, and equipment maintenance.

**MEE – Multiple Effect Evaporator:** Evaporation processes, steam consumption optimization, scaling control, and condensate management.

**MVR – Mechanical Vapor Recompression:** Vapor recompression systems, energy efficiency, process control, and operational troubleshooting.

**Boilers:** Boiler operations, preventive maintenance, combustion efficiency, water treatment, safety systems, and statutory requirements.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* **Operations & Maintenance Management**

Manage end-to-end O&M activities across water and wastewater treatment plants.

Ensure smooth plant operations, equipment reliability, process stability, and achievement of performance targets.

Implement preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs.

Monitor plant performance, energy consumption, chemical usage, water recovery, and operating costs.

* **Technical Troubleshooting and Optimization**

Identify and resolve operational, mechanical, electrical, and process-related issues in coordination with relevant technical teams.

Analyze plant performance data and implement corrective and preventive actions.

Improve plant efficiency, reduce downtime, and optimize resource utilization.

Ensure compliance with client-specific process parameters and treatment quality requirements.

* **Manpower Planning and Team Leadership**

Plan manpower requirements and deploy personnel across project sites.

Lead and supervise engineers, supervisors, technicians, and plant operators.

Conduct technical training, performance reviews, and safety awareness sessions.

Ensure effective shift management, work allocation, and workforce productivity.

* **Client Management and Coordination**

Maintain effective communication and professional relationships with clients.

Attend technical meetings, review plant performance, and address operational concerns.

Coordinate with project, engineering, procurement, service, and management teams.

Ensure timely resolution of client complaints and achievement of agreed service levels.

* **Technical Proposals and Business Development Support**

Assist in preparing technical and commercial proposals for O&M contracts and water/wastewater treatment projects.

Review technical specifications, process requirements, scope of work, and operating costs.

Support technical presentations, client discussions, site assessments, and tender submissions.

Provide technical inputs to the marketing and business development teams.

* **Safety, Quality, and Environmental Compliance**

Ensure adherence to applicable safety procedures, environmental regulations, and statutory requirements.

Implement safe operating practices, risk assessments, and emergency response procedures.

Monitor treatment quality, operational records, maintenance logs, and compliance documentation.

Promote a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.

* **Reporting and Performance Monitoring**

Prepare periodic operational, maintenance, manpower, and performance reports.

Monitor KPIs, plant availability, downtime, operating expenditure, and service quality.

Identify opportunities for cost reduction and process improvement.

Ensure proper documentation and reporting to senior management and clients.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

Strong technical understanding of water and wastewater treatment technologies.

Proven experience in managing plant operations, maintenance, and troubleshooting.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Strong leadership, manpower management, and decision-making abilities.

Good client relationship management and coordination skills.

Ability to prepare technical proposals and support business development.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and operational planning skills.

Knowledge of EHS practices, environmental standards, and relevant statutory compliance.

Willingness to travel extensively or relocate anywhere in India based on project requirements.

**Educational Qualifications**

B.E. / B.Tech in Chemical, Mechanical, Environmental, Civil, or a relevant engineering discipline.

Diploma in a relevant technical or engineering discipline.

Science Graduate with substantial relevant industry experience.

**Experience Requirements**

Minimum 10 years of relevant industry experience in water and wastewater treatment plant operations and maintenance.

Experience in handling multiple treatment technologies and managing teams across project sites will be an advantage.

Candidates with experience in industrial wastewater treatment, ZLD systems, evaporation and drying technologies, RO plants, and boiler operations are encouraged to apply.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

Experienced O&M professional with strong technical and managerial capabilities.

Capable of independently managing plant operations and client expectations.

Comfortable working across different industrial sectors and project locations.

Commercially aware, service-oriented, and focused on plant performance and cost optimization.

Available to join immediately or at short notice.

Interested candidates who meet the above requirements are invited to share their updated resume, highlighting relevant plant experience, technical expertise, current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and willingness to travel or relocate across India.

description:

Amgen is a leading human therapeutics company in the biotechnology industry. For more than 40 years, the company has tapped the power of scientific discovery and innovation to advance the practice of medicine. As a Fortune 500 company serving millions of patients, Amgen continues to be an entrepreneurial, science-driven enterprise dedicated to helping people fight serious illness.
  
  
Regulatory Affairs, Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls (RA CMC) facilitates product development and global registration by developing and executing regulatory strategies and managing effective regulatory agency interactions for product manufacturing and quality programs throughout product lifecycle. Amgen’s CMC submission execution team, Regulatory Optimization of Tactical and Strategic Support (ROOTS2), is seeking to expand its capacity in India. The ROOTS2 staff member will interface with the Amgen Global, Site, Biosimilars, and/or Device RA CMC teams for specific strategies or activities that impact a product. The ROOTS2 staff member will be responsible for varying levels of product support, including leading projects, based upon their experience level.
  
  
Additional job responsibilities include:
  
  

* Lead submission for annual reports, facility registrations, facility renewals, and product renewals
* Interact with authors/reviewers and subject matter experts with respect to delivery of CMC and/or Device documents required for regulatory submissions
* Preparing submission content plans for CMC submissions including, CMC IND/CTAs and amendments, Investigational Device Exemption (IDE)/Performance Study Application (PSA)/ Clinical Investigation Application (CIA), new marketing applications, facility registration and renewals, post‑market supplements/variations, product renewals, Module 3 baselines, and annual report/notifications

* Initiate and maintain CMC product and/or Device timelines at the direction of product lead
* Interface with the regulatory operations team
* Train staff on select procedures and systems
* Provide report status of activities and projects to teams and department
* Participate in cross-functional special project teams

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree and 5-9 years of experience in manufacture, QA/QC, or regulatory CMC in the Pharmaceutical/Biotechnology industry

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* BS degree in Life Science
* Experience in manufacture, Process Development, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, or Analytical development
* Experience in IVD, Device or Combination Product regulatory submission process
* Regulatory CMC specific knowledge and experience
* Mature project management and organizational skills
* Strong and effective oral and written communication skills
* Experience in Veeva Vault platforms

Ability to build/learn scientific knowledge (e.g. statistics, disease area).Ability to search for public data on labeling elements (enabling digital capabilities)

title: Industrial Trainee - Financial Operations
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a resourceful candidate to join our Financial Operations group, based out of the firm’s Hyderabad office. The Financial Operations (FinOp) group forms part of our global operations and provides comprehensive financial, operational, and analytical support across investment activities. The group plays a critical role across the entire trade lifecycle, ensuring robust financial control, transparency, and operational resilience. FinOp teams leverage data science, automation, and advanced analytics to generate insights, enhance decision making, reduce risk, and deliver scalable solutions that support firm’s growing and evolving business needs.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will collaborate with a number of senior stakeholders at the time of new fund launches, assist in setting up complex fund structures and transactions, conduct historical as well as projected analyses of fund performance, technical accounting analysis for complex financial instruments, and handle bespoke requests from various internal and external stakeholders. You will work closely with the office of the Chief Operating Officer (COO), the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), business unit (BU) heads, government regulators, and portfolio managers to provide key performance metrics to facilitate effective Decision-making through insightful reporting, analyses, and recommendations within the MCA team. This involves P&L analysis, expense allocation, budgeting, cash management, financial and regulatory reporting, finalization of audits for global management company entities. Additionally, the above roles will involve handling change management processes while understanding and analyzing changes in the firm’s businesses and incorporating these changes into the firm’s financial reporting infrastructure. Furthermore, you will drive technology projects to develop reporting and analysis tools (including Power BI, Power Query and Alteryx), streamline workflows and enhance user experience. Finally, you will also be involved in staying abreast of developments in technical accounting, primarily US GAAP, UK GAAP, and HK GAAP to provide accounting guidance, adopt new accounting standards, and maintain the firm's accounting policy manual.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold:
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* CA Inter/IPCC cleared in the first or second attempt, along with at least 1 year of articleship experience
* The ability to uphold high standards, analyze rigorously, communicate clearly and concisely, thrive on collaboration, and should demonstrate a high degree of intellectual curiosity
* High motivation and be an individual who can handle high levels of ownership in the respective areas of operation while being comfortable functioning in an agile environment that entails timebound, high-quality deliverables

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Knowledge of business intelligence tools, along with an understanding of global accounting frameworks

Interested candidates can apply through our website:
  
  
https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/IndTraineeFinOpJune26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers

title: Lead Consultant IT-OT
description:
**About Us**
TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. As part of our team, you’ll discover a world of opportunities to connect with innovative thinkers, forge your path, and have fun tackling the world’s most challenging projects. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level.
  
  
TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow-through of an industry leader.
  
  
We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.
  
  
**Overview**
We are looking for a dynamic and client-focused Senior Solution Lead with experience in the Utilities domain and strong consulting capabilities. The ideal candidate should have expertise in bid management, proposal development, market research, and digital transformation initiatives across the Energy & Utilities sector. Experience in SCADA/ADMS programs will be considered a strong advantage.
  
  
The candidate will support business growth initiatives, client engagements, strategic transformation programs, and solution development for utilities clients across transmission, distribution, and smart grid domains.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support end-to-end bid management and proposal development activities (RFP/RFI/RFQ responses).
* Collaborate with sales, solution architects, and delivery teams to create compelling client proposals and value propositions.
* Develop presentations, POVs (Points of View), capability decks, and strategic solution documents.
* Conduct effort estimation, risk analysis, and solution positioning for utility transformation programs.
* Support client discussions, workshops, and strategic pursuits.
* Perform market analysis, competitor benchmarking, and industry trend assessments in the utilities sector.
* Research emerging technologies, regulatory trends, and digital utility transformation initiatives.
* Prepare strategic insights and recommendations for utilities clients.
* Develop business cases and transformation roadmaps for utility modernization initiatives.
* Work with electric, gas, or water utilities on modernization initiatives.
* Understanding of utility business processes
* Support solution development aligned with utility operational and business objectives.
* Exposure to SCADA, ADMS, EMS, OMS, or DERMS platforms will be an added advantage.
* Understanding of utility operational technologies and IT-OT integration.
* Familiarity with OEM platforms such as GE Vernona, Aspen tech OSI, Schneider Electric, or Hitachi Energy is preferred.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Technology, Business, or related field.
* MBA or equivalent consulting/business qualification preferred.
* 5–8 years of experience in Utilities consulting, digital transformation, or strategic advisory roles.
* Experience with Smart Grid, SCADA, ADMS, EMS, OMS, or DERMS.
* Experience with AMI / Smart metering/ intelligent Asset management
* Knowledge of IT-OT integration and utility operational technologies.
* Strong communication and storytelling capability.
* Consulting mindset with client-first approach.
* Ability to work in cross-functional and global teams.
* Strong documentation and executive presentation skills.
* Experience working with system integrators, OEMs, or large utility clients.

EEO Statement

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior IT Training Specialist
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
Medtronic is seeking a highly motivated Senior IT Training Specialist to support enterprise technology adoption and end-user enablement across a global organization. This role will partner with business stakeholders, project teams, and technical experts to design, develop, and deliver effective learning solutions that help employees maximize the value of enterprise IT tools and digital workplace technologies.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines expertise in adult learning principles, technology training, and stakeholder engagement with a passion for coaching users and driving successful adoption of new technologies.
  
  
**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.**

* Design, develop, and deliver instructor-led, virtual, on-demand, and digital learning experiences for enterprise IT solutions.
* Facilitate engaging training sessions for end users and targeted audiences across the organization.
* Create and maintain training materials, user guides, job aids, performance support resources, and assessment tools.
* Serve as a learning coach by guiding users through technology adoption and helping improve their proficiency with enterprise software.
* Partner with business stakeholders, project teams, and subject matter experts to identify learning needs and develop effective training solutions.
* Review, validate, and update training content to ensure technical accuracy and alignment with business requirements.
* Support technology change initiatives through training, communication, and adoption activities.
* Evaluate training effectiveness and recommend improvements based on learner feedback and business outcomes.
* Stay current on enterprise technologies, digital workplace tools, adult learning methodologies, and training best practices.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* 7+ years of IT experience with a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, MCA, MSc or MBA.
* Bachelor's degree in Adult Learning or Learning & Development preferred.
* Experience designing and delivering training programs for enterprise software or technology solutions.
* Knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies.
* Experience facilitating classroom, virtual, or blended learning sessions.
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies quickly and independently.
* Bachelor's degree in Adult Learning, Learning & Development, Instructional Design, Education, or a related field preferred.
* Experience coaching end users in the effective use and adoption of enterprise technology solutions.
* Experience supporting a broad range of enterprise IT software and digital workplace technologies.
* Business Analyst experience, including gathering requirements and translating business needs into learning solutions.
* Strong technical aptitude with experience reviewing and validating technical training content.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Microsoft Teams, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Word, and other collaboration tools.
* Experience leveraging AI-powered tools and technologies to improve learning effectiveness and business outcomes.
* Learning mindset with strong self-directed learning capability.
* Ability to quickly develop expertise in new technologies and software platforms.
* Passion for coaching and enabling others to succeed.
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills across technical and business teams.
* Comfortable working independently while managing multiple priorities in a global environment.

title: Group Lead - Medical Information
description:
**Job title**
: Group Lead – Medical Information
  
  

* Hiring Manager: Head – Scientific Communications, Medical Information & Graphics
* Location: Hyderabad
* % of travel expected: As per business need
* Job type: Permanent and Full time

**About The Job**
**Our Team:**
Sanofi Business Operations (BO) is an internal Sanofi resource organization setup to centralize processes and activities to support Specialty Care, Vaccines, General Medicines, CMO, and R&D, Data & Digital functions. BO strives to be a strategic and functional partner for tactical deliveries to Medical, HEVA, and Commercial organizations in Sanofi, globally.
  
  
Our Hubs are a crucial part of how we innovate, improving performance across every Sanofi department and providing a springboard for the amazing work we do. Build a career and you can be part of transforming our business while helping to change millions of lives. Ready?
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**
The overall purpose and main responsibilities are listed below:
  
  
Provides functional and operational leadership to the Medical Information Writing Team, acting as the domain expert for the relevant activities within the Medical Information team, engaging stakeholders, developing the team members, and acting as a strategic thought partner aligned with the vision of the Medical Writing team. Independently research and authors response documents, reviews compendia, and prepares US FDA Annual reports with minimal guidance or supervision by the global and local Medical Information team. Proficient understanding of Medical Information achieved through a combination of product knowledge, along with editing, writing, and document management.
  
  
**Essential Job Duties And Responsibilities**

* Acts as a strategic thought partner to the Global Medical Information function aligned with the vision of Medical Writing.
* Proficient in Conducting literature searches and reviews; and extracting/ summarizing complex data from the scientific literature.
* Independently works to generate evidence-based, accurate, current, and fair-balanced summaries of data for the creation/maintenance of scientific response documents for products in multiple therapeutic areas, develops US FDA Annual Reports, and reviews compendia
* Ability to produce medical documents according to all Sanofi relevant global guidelines, country guidelines and policies.
* Acts as a Subject Matter Expert maintaining expertise in the processes, templates, and guidelines, and key deliverables aligned with the key trends and developments in the industry.
* Provides operational and functional leadership in producing high-quality deliverables from the medical writing team.
* Peer reviews, coaches, mentors, and develops expertise within the team motivating people to excellence (on key deliverables, processes, templates, and guidelines). 8) Guides and have oversight of the end-to-end process as captured in the activity catalogue.
* Works in alignment with line function visions, demonstrating great collaboration with the team.
* Agile and knowledgeable to be able to work across different therapeutic areas and new deliverable types, willing to stretch and be the front-runner.
* Demonstrates resolve and urgency to accomplish tasks without direct authority or control. Participate in cross-functional project teams as needed. Ensure that assigned projects are completed on schedule.
* Collaborates effectively with Global Medical Information teams to execute content plans
* Demonstrates a deep understanding and/or experience of working in a regulated GXP environment

To create synergies and provide functional and operational direction across global business units, segments and key markets operations across various therapeutic areas and processes so that cost savings up to 10 mil euros are achieved with deliveries optimized through multi-layered teams
  
  

* People: 1) Maintain effective relationships with the end stakeholders (Medical scientific community) across multiple Global business units and products – with an end objective to develop medical information content as per requirement. 2) Interact effectively with stakeholders in medical and pharmacovigilance departments. 3) Constantly assist other medical information writers in developing knowledge and sharing expertise.
* Performance: 1) Act as a strategic thought partner, operational and functional leader, providing coaching, mentoring, and expertise support. 2) Provide functional expert support and oversight of deliverables (local and custom scientific response documents, US FDA Annual Reports, and Compendia Reviews) as per agreed timelines and quality. 3) Supports delivery of projects in terms of resourcing, quality, timeliness, efficiency, and high technical standards. 4) Implement relevant elements of the medical information writing plan and associated activities for the year identified for the countries and regions.
* Process: (1) Support delivery of projects in terms of resourcing, quality, timeliness, efficiency, and high technical standards for deliveries made by the group, including scientific documents and clinical/medical reports; (2) Contribute to overall quality enhancement by ensuring high scientific standards for the output produced by the group; (3) Secure adherence to compliance procedures and internal/operational risk controls in accordance with any and all applicable regulatory standards; (4) Implement relevant elements of content plans and associated activities for the year identified for the assigned countries. 5) Work with selected vendors within the region to deliver the required deliverables as per the defined process. 6) Design an overall plan of action basis end-customers feedback & improve course content and delivery, continuous improvement and efficiency.
* Stakeholder: Work closely with medical teams globally across GBUs as well as in countries/regions/areas to identify medical information needs and assist in developing assigned deliverables. 2) Liaise with the Medical department to prepare relevant & customized deliverables. 3) Collaborate with the Global Medical Information team and country medical information teams as relevant. 4) Support regulatory interactions with various health authorities for inspections.

**About You**

* Experience: ≥10 years of experience in content creation in medical information or scientific writing for the pharmaceuticals/healthcare industry, or equivalent experience in the clinical setting, pharmacovigilance; At least 10 years of direct medical information writing experience in the pharmaceutical company; Minimum 3 years of experience in managing global, cross-functional teams and working in, a Matrix environment; strong ability in managing a multi-layered team of ≥10 members; and ability to influence and negotiate difficult situations.
* Soft skills: Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation), Team management, and Stakeholder management; communication skills; and ability to work independently and within a team environment, demonstrated ability to motivate, coach, or mentor people, work as an SME, develop and manage high performing teams
* Technical skills: As applicable (Including but not limited to Expert knowledge of medical information documents including Response documents, Compendia review and FDA Annual Reports, Medical operational excellence, time, and risk management skills, Excellent technical (medical) editing and writing skills, Knowledge about literature evaluation and multilevel response development). Understanding of the local country legal requirements with regards to Medical Information document provision for customers including health care professionals, patients, carers and other relevant decision makers (such as ABPI Code of Practice for UK) is desirable.
* Education: Advanced degree in life sciences/pharmacy/similar discipline (Ph.D., Master, or bachelor’s in science, D Pharms) or medical degree (MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, MD)
* Languages: Excellent knowledge of the English language (spoken and written)

Pursue Progress, discover Extraordinary
  
  
Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

title: IT Technical Intern
description:
We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented, and technically curious IT Technical Intern to join our Information Technology team. The intern will gain hands-on experience in IT support, systems administration, troubleshooting, networking, cybersecurity, hardware and software management, documentation, and technology operations while collaborating with IT professionals and business users.
  
  
Our intent is to develop an IT professional who can understand the organization’s technology environment end to end, translate user and business requirements into practical technical solutions, resolve issues efficiently, support reliable IT operations, and contribute to the continuous improvement of systems, processes, and security practices.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Understand the organization’s IT infrastructure, systems, applications, networks, devices, users, technical requirements, dependencies, and operational challenges.
* Assist in providing first-level technical support to employees and users through ticketing systems, email, chat, phone, or in-person support.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, network, connectivity, access, printing, and application-related issues.
* Install, configure, maintain, and support computers, laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, operating systems, and business applications.
* Assist with user account provisioning, access management, password resets, permissions, onboarding, offboarding, and identity-related tasks.
* Support Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, collaboration tools, enterprise applications, and other productivity platforms, as applicable.
* Monitor IT systems, services, devices, and alerts and escalate incidents or risks according to established procedures.
* Assist with network troubleshooting involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Wi-Fi, firewalls, switches, routers, and related infrastructure.
* Maintain accurate records of hardware, software, licenses, warranties, configurations, users, and IT assets.
* Use IT service management and ticketing tools to document incidents, service requests, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and follow-up actions.
* Assist with software deployment, patching, updates, endpoint configuration, backups, and routine maintenance activities.
* Support cybersecurity practices such as endpoint protection, access control, phishing awareness, vulnerability remediation, secure configuration, and incident reporting.
* Follow established IT policies, procedures, change management practices, security controls, and data protection requirements.
* Assist with system administration tasks across Windows, Linux, cloud platforms, virtual machines, or other environments, as applicable to the assigned team.
* Use scripting or automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies to improve repetitive IT processes and operational efficiency.
* Investigate recurring technical issues, identify root causes, and recommend improvements to systems, documentation, workflows, and user experience.
* Contribute to IT projects such as system upgrades, migrations, deployments, infrastructure improvements, asset refreshes, and technology evaluations.
* Explore the responsible use of AI tools, automation, and intelligent assistants for IT support, documentation, troubleshooting, monitoring, and knowledge management.
* Evaluate AI-generated recommendations and outputs for accuracy, security, privacy, reliability, and alignment with organizational policies.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, standard operating procedures, user guides, network diagrams, and troubleshooting references.
* Communicate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical users and provide professional, timely, and customer-focused support.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of computer hardware, operating systems, networking concepts, troubleshooting methodologies, and IT service management principles.
* Knowledge of programming fundamentals and design algorithms.
* Working knowledge of at least one operating system, such as Windows, Linux, or macOS.
* Foundational understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Wi-Fi, user accounts, access permissions, and common enterprise IT services.
* Basic familiarity with productivity applications, collaboration tools, cloud services, endpoint devices, and software installation or configuration.
* Ability to diagnose problems logically, research solutions, follow procedures, document work accurately, and escalate issues appropriately.
* Strong attention to detail, customer service orientation, ownership, curiosity, collaboration skills, and willingness to learn and accept feedback.
* Understanding of basic cybersecurity, data privacy, password security, phishing risks, and responsible handling of confidential information.

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Hands-on experience supporting Windows, Linux, macOS, mobile devices, printers, scanners, and other IT equipment.

title: IT&D Executive Assistant
description:

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Information Technology & Digital
  
  
In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
  
  
**About The Role**
Explore the forefront of purposeful technology and innovation as an IT & D Business Analyst at Reckitt. Within our collaborative IT & Digital team, every day is a chance to create meaningful impact. Here, you'll be ensuring excellence across a global network that's dedicated to a cleaner, healthier world. If you possess a blend of strategic thinking and technical expertise, and you're ready to transform business needs into cutting-edge IT & D solutions, we would love to hear from you. Be the catalyst for change in a company committed to making a difference.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Analyse business needs, translating them into precise IT & D solutions, ensuring alignment with our strategic vision.
* Engage in data analysis, user research, and other studies to bolster product development and enhancements.
* Collaborate with key stakeholders such as product managers, data scientists, and engineers to deliver exemplary products.
* Navigate complex data landscapes, interpreting and defining specifications for technological processes.
* Act as a steward of change, facilitating communication between technical teams and business users for clarity and successful solution implementation.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* Proficient in analysing requirements and translating business processes into clear specifications.
* Familiar with manufacturing processes and a deep understanding of IT systems, cybersecurity, and data analytics.
* Well-versed in project and programme management, design thinking, and IT service management.
* Skilled in change management practises with a focus on stakeholder relationship management and user adoption.
* Strong communication skills, capable of advising and guiding diverse teams and stakeholders.

The skills for success
  
  
Project Management, Programme Management, Design Thinking, IT Service Management, Innovation Processes, Innovation, User Experience Design, Change Analyst, Change Management, Digital Transformation, Value Analysis, Change Management, Adoption, Technology Adoption Lifecycle, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Data Driven Practices, Advanced Analytics, Data Analytics, Governance.

title: Product Expert - Clinical Data Management - India
description:

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
  
  
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
  
  
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

Veeva is looking for a highly motivated individual with life science industry experience within the Clinical Data domain. You will drive impactful product communication and champion customer success with our Clinical Data Management applications, Veeva EDC and Veeva DQS, partnering closely with our customers in India. As part of the global Product Expert team, you will play a key role in the Product organization. Most importantly you will:
  
  

* Build and foster highly engaged Users Communities; regularly engage with the customers in a range of forums to provide clear and impactful communication that drives shared understanding & education, promotes product adoption, and delivers customer value.
* Represent the Product organization in customer meetings, online communities, and at industry events.
* Drive increased customer value through release education and product capability promotion.

+ AI & Digital transformation
+ Risk-based decision making
+ Regulatory compliance
+ A culture of continuous improvement
+ Excellence across the pharmaceutical industry

* Collaborate effectively with Veeva field teams to drive customer success, product excellence, best practices, and Veeva Product success.

To apply for this role, you must have recent hands-on experience in either Veeva EDC or Veeva DQS.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Be the product evangelist and provide subject matter expertise for the Veeva EDC and Veeva DQS products, staying up to date with the latest features and communicating Product roadmap directions.
* Act as a champion for Veeva's key product enhancements (for example, learning the overarching Veeva AI and RBQM visions to effectively guide customers through their transformation journeys together with Veeva colleagues).
* Provide product education to Veeva Clinical Data customers in meetings (in a range of forums) and our online communities (Veeva Connect); Ensuring we are communicating the problems we are solving, value delivered and product functionality.
* Be the customer advocate internally. Gather, analyze, and prioritize customer feedback. Feed these insights into release planning, contributing to future product innovations.
* Collaborate with Product teams to deliver valuable content and resources for product and release communication.
* Provide cross-functional support to internal teams, including Services, Strategy, Sales, and Product Support.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years working in the Clinical Management space, usually from Product Management, Consulting or Professional Services/Implementation roles
* Recent hands-on experience with Veeva EDC and/or Veeva DQS. Do not apply if you do not have this experience.
* Ability to understand customer business requirements and to translate them to technical product requirements, preferences, and limitations
* Ability to understand Product Vision, Technical Specifications and Software Development Documentation, and translate them into language and content for both business and technical stakeholder
* Experience in interacting with customers from business users, IT departments, and executive suite, as well as internal teams, both in-person and remote (including software demonstrations and presentations).
* Strong analytical skills and English skills (written, verbal, and formal presentations).
* A strong passion for emerging technologies (specifically AI) and the ability to quickly grasp, articulate, and conceptualize how AI-driven features solve clinical trials challenges.
* Self-directed team player with a positive attitude.
* Willingness to travel between 15-30%.
* Based in India.

****Nice to Have****

* Preferred location: Bengaluru or Hyderabad
* SQL knowledge
* Fluency in at least one widely used Indian language

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Analyst - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.
  
  
You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.
  
  
**THE WORK**
Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:
  
  
**Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development**

* Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states.
* Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context.
* Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools.
* Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives.

**Client Engagement & Advisory Support**

* Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions.
* Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders.
* Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams.
* Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples.

**Data & AI Foundations**

* Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems.
* Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations.
* Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows.
* Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

title: Customer Support Engineer
description:
**About MasterControl:**
MasterControl Inc. is a leading provider of cloud-based quality and compliance software for life sciences and other regulated industries. Our mission is the same as that of our customers to bring life-changing products to more people sooner. The MasterControl Platform helps organizations digitize, automate and connect quality and compliance processes across the regulated product development life cycle. Over 1,000 companies worldwide rely on MasterControl solutions to achieve new levels of operational excellence across product development, clinical trials, regulatory affairs, quality management, supply chain, manufacturing and postmarket surveillance. For more information, visit www.mastercontrol.com.
  
  
**SUMMARY**
The Customer Support Engineer (CSE) provides in-depth application technical support to MasterControl customers. The CSE carries out troubleshooting and root cause analysis while resolving advanced technical issues for our customers. CSEs work with fellow team members, service consultants, sales operations, and other company resources to increase customer satisfaction and loyalty. CSEs act as the customer's first point of contact and are responsible for the identification of software defects as well as the reporting of such to development, while providing interim solutions when available and necessary.
  
  
This position works with other internal resources to ensure that issues are resolved in a timely fashion. CSEs follow technical support industry-standard best practices, concepts, and procedures. A certain degree of creativity and latitude is required. Full product training will be part of the onboarding process for the successful candidate
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Exceeding customer expectations by providing a tailored service experience.
* Identify and resolve customer issues via incoming calls, emails, etc.
* Provide customers with knowledge regarding software functionality and best practices.
* Identify and reproduce software defects for submission to development.
* Provide Customers with root cause analysis and in-depth troubleshooting.
* Meet and exceed Service Level Agreements through effective incident management.
* Writing Technical Documentation (i.e. Knowledge Base Articles).
* Contributes to the departments' Key Performance Indicators (KPI)
* Performs software implementation, installation, and upgrades to MasterControl customers.
* Updates and maintains reports for customers and key internal contacts.
* Provides backup support to other CSE team members.
* Works directly with escalation engineers to assure resolution of critical customer issues.
* Provide and participate in technical training and knowledge transfer for new or complex products.
* Contribute to overall content and quality of knowledge base utilizing the Knowledge-Centered Support principles.
* As directed, performs special projects.

**PREFERRED SKILLS**

* Excellent customer relationship and advocacy skills.
* Advanced application troubleshooting skills.
* Database management knowledge / MS SQL experience required.
* Attention to detail.
* Professional-level writing and communication skills.
* Professional English language, speaking/writing skills
* LDAP & Active Directory experience / knowledge desirable
* Understanding virtual environments. Strong experience desirable.
* Programming experience / knowledge (Java Script, HTML) helpful
* Proficient with Claude Code or similar

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS**

* May work a variety of schedule hours, as required
* Must be willing to work USA hours of operation on a consistent basis
* Travel may be required

**Why Work Here?**
#WhyWorkAnywhereElse?
  
  
MasterControl is a place where Exceptional Teams come together to do their best work. In fact, hiring Exceptional Teams is a core value of ours. MasterControl employees are surrounded by intelligent, motivated, and collaborative individuals. We like to call it #TheBestTeamOnThePlanet.
  
  
We work hard to develop and challenge our employees' skillsets, recognize their contributions, encourage professional development, and offer a one-of-a-kind culture. This is why we say #WhyWorkAnywhereElse?
  
  
MasterControl could be your next (and last) career move!
  
  
Here are some of the benefits MasterControl employees enjoy:
  
  

* Competitive compensation
* Schedule flexibility
* Fitness clubs (you get paid to have fun and be active!)
* Company parties and employee recognition programs
* Wellness programs
* Much, much more!
