title: eTMF System Manager
description:
**Description**
eTMF System Manager
  
  
Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  
  
Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.
  
  
Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.
  
  
Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  
  
Why Syneos Health
  
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

**Job Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
eTMF System Ownership & Administration
  
  

* Serve as the primary business owner and SME for Veeva Vault eTMF.
* Lead governance, configuration oversight, and lifecycle management of the eTMF platform.
* Manage system enhancements, user requirements, prioritization, and release planning.
* Partner with technology teams and vendors to resolve complex system issues and implement improvements.
* Oversee TMF system integrations, data migrations, archival activities, and document transfers.
* Ensure system compliance with regulatory requirements, company procedures, and industry standards.

AI Innovation & Digital Transformation
  
  

* Lead the evaluation, implementation, and expansion of AI-enabled TMF capabilities.
* Drive innovation initiatives focused on automated document classification, metadata population, quality checks, and workflow optimization.
* Collaborate with AI vendors, technology teams, and operational stakeholders to define use cases, requirements, and success metrics.
* Monitor AI performance, identify improvement opportunities, and maintain feedback loops to improve model accuracy.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to enhance TMF operational efficiency and inspection readiness.

System Testing, Validation & Release Management
  
  

* Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and business validation activities for Veeva Vault releases and enhancements.
* Develop testing strategies, test scripts, execution plans, and defect management processes.
* Coordinate testing across functional stakeholders and ensure timely completion of validation activities.
* Assess business impact of system changes and ensure readiness for deployment.
* Support validation documentation and change control activities in accordance with applicable quality requirements.

TMF Process Excellence
  
  

* Act as a TMF SME supporting business process design, optimization, and standardization.
* Partner with operational teams to improve TMF quality, completeness, timeliness, and inspection readiness.
* Support implementation of TMF Reference Model updates, TMF standards, and metadata governance.
* Develop and maintain system-related procedures, job aids, training materials, and best practices.
* Provide expert consultation on TMF processes, technology capabilities, and risk mitigation strategies.

Compliance, Quality & Risk Management
  
  

* Monitor eTMF system compliance and data integrity.
* Conduct audit trail reviews, system risk assessments, and trend analyses.
* Support internal audits, regulatory inspections, and customer audits as required.
* Investigate system-related deviations and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure inspection-ready system documentation and operational controls are maintained.

Training & Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Develop and deliver training for system users and business stakeholders.
* Provide expert consultation and support for study teams, TMF Operations, and external customers.
* Lead communication and change management efforts associated with new system capabilities.
* Facilitate governance meetings and provide updates on system performance, enhancement priorities, risks, and innovation initiatives.

**Get to know Syneos Health**
Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.
  
  
No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
  
  
http://www.syneoshealth.com
  
  
**Additional Information**
Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.
  
  
**Summary**
The eTMF Systems Manager, AI & Innovation is responsible for the strategic leadership, administration, optimization, and continuous improvement of electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) systems, with a primary focus on Veeva Vault eTMF. This role serves as the subject matter expert (SME) for TMF technology, ensuring system compliance, inspection readiness, operational efficiency, and alignment with evolving industry standards. The position leads system enhancements, testing and validation activities, AI-driven innovation initiatives, and process transformation efforts designed to improve TMF quality, completeness, timeliness, and user experience. The role partners closely with Clinical Operations, Quality, Technology Solutions, Data Analytics, and external technology vendors to ensure eTMF capabilities continue to support business growth and regulatory requirements.

This role provides the opportunity to work across multi vendor environments, influence strategic business decisions, and contribute to large scale transformation initiatives for insurance careers.

* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

* Strong business acumen combined with deep expertise in life and annuity insurance domains.
* Ability to collaborate effectively and bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions.
* A strategic problem‑solver who challenges assumptions and recommends innovative, future‑ready approaches.
* A committed team player focused on delivering value, driving transformation, and building lasting client relationships

* Bachelors degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.)

* Hands‑on experience with policy lifecycle processes and insurance operational workflows.
* Ability to produce high‑quality process maps, data flows, and requirement documentation.
* Proficiency in managing multi‑vendor engagements and navigating complex project environments.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify gaps, and propose practical solutions.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills for client‑facing interactions.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical, functional, and business stakeholders.

**Ideally, good to have**

* Experience working on data migration projects and applying data governance best practices.
* Knowledge of insurance COTS platforms such as FAST, ALIP, OIPA, wmA etc
* Certifications such as AAPA or LOMA.
* Understanding of upstream and downstream integrations across the policy lifecycle

As a professional in Deloitte’s Tax Technology Consulting (TTC) team, you will be a part of a team that provides an integrated approach to technology implementations, automation, data wrangling, managed legal services and analytics that help tax and legal departments maximize the strategic value to the organization. title: Senior Technical Writer, Actimize
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
  
  
**So, what’s the role all about?**
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Technical Writer to lead documentation initiatives across multiple product lines within NiCE Actimize R&D. This is an advanced contributor role with strategic influence—requiring content planning, cross-functional collaboration, and process improvement.
  
  
**How will you make an impact?**

* Own end-to-end documentation for complex enterprise software products.
* Partner with SMEs, developers, and product managers to deliver high-quality, user-focused content.
* Create and maintain structured content: user guides, developer/API docs, and contextual help.
* Simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences including customers, support, and developers.
* Create and integrate visual aids and videos to enhance comprehension.
* Align deliverables with Agile sprints and release timelines.
* Provide editorial and mentoring support to other writers and content contributors
* Champion best practices in technical communication and drive process efficiencies within the team

**Have you got what it takes?**

* 4-7 years of experience as a technical writer in an enterprise software development environment.
* Experience working with large-scale enterprise products and understanding the nuances of multi-tenant, cloud-native platforms.
* Ability to translate functional specifications and test scenarios into user-friendly documentation, ensuring alignment with product behavior.
* Skilled at documenting user workflows, product configurations, and system integrations within enterprise ecosystems.
* Deep experience in Agile environments and topic-based authoring.
* Strong grasp of APIs and developer-centric documentation.
* Ability to learn complex technology and tools.
* Experience creating clear and structured guides for different audiences, including developers (API documentation).
* Experience with Madcap Flare, Git, and Atlassian tools (JIRA and Confluence), SnaGit, Camtasia, Clip Champ, Litmos, and XML authoring
* Experience creating videos for technical documentation. Experience with ClipChamp or Camtasia is an advantage.
* Passionate about quality, great communication skills, and excellent teamwork capabilities.
* Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills.

**What’s in it for you?**
Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!
  
  
**Enjoy NICE-FLEX!**
At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.
  
  
**Requisition ID:**
11928
  
  
**Reporting into:**
Tech Manager, Technical Writing, Actimize
  
  
**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor
  
  
**About NiCE**
*NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.*
*Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.*
*NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.*

title: Manufacturing Curriculum Architect

* Adhere to “Next Gen” curriculum development processes and standards
* Work under light supervision
* Work on projects/assignments of moderate to complex scope, making key decisions for the project/assignment

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

* Quickly acquire new technical and software knowledge and able to share this with others efficiently
* Proactive, creative and critical thinking. Possess analytical capabilities, customer orientation and team working, presentation and interpersonal skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Passionate about producing high-quality and engaging learning content
* At least 2 years of project management experience
* Willing to travel occasionally
* Excellent English language skills

**Preferred Knowledge/Skills, Education, And Experience**

* Computer science/Mechanical engineering/Manufacturing engineering or equivalent degree, and ideally have previous experience in both technical and sales/consulting environments
* Knowledge on the full Siemens PLM portfolio of products
* 2-3 years of training and instructional develop experience, corporate training and adult training

* Quality analysis
* Graphic design
* Release management
* Experience with Camtasia, Audiate, Share Point, and Polarion

title: RC FS -BTI INS -Life and Annuity -Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS Business Consulting – Life & Annuity Senior position:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As part of our Consulting team, you will play a key role in supporting clients across the individual and group life insurance and annuity value chain. You will contribute to complex transformation programs by applying deep product, process, and platform knowledge, while helping clients achieve their business objective. This role provides the opportunity to work across multi vendor environments, influence strategic business decisions, and contribute to large scale transformation initiatives for insurance careers.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support clients across the full policy lifecycle, including new business, underwriting, policy servicing, billing, claims, disbursements, and regulatory updates.
* Create comprehensive business process maps, future state architectures, and work breakdown structures (WBS) for conversion and transformation programs.
* Lead requirements elicitation through JAD sessions, workshops, and collaboration with product owners to develop BRDs, FSDs, and other documentation.
* Challenge new requirements and change requests by proposing optimized, value driven solutions that align with business strategy and operational readiness.
* Collaborate with product design and development teams to evaluate functional enhancements and ensure they meet business objectives.
* Support clients through product configuration decisions, acceptance criteria definition, and user acceptance testing.
* Contribute to data migration and data governance activities, ensuring quality, compliance, and seamless system transitions.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by delivering clear insights, process improvements, and best practice recommendations
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A proactive, detail‑oriented professional who thrives in fast‑paced, dynamic environments.
* Strong business acumen combined with deep expertise in life and annuity insurance domains.
* Ability to collaborate effectively and bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions.
* A strategic problem‑solver who challenges assumptions and recommends innovative, future‑ready approaches.
* A committed team player focused on delivering value, driving transformation, and building lasting client relationships

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelors degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.)
* Approximately 5 to 10 years of experience working in Life & Annuity insurance domain.

**Additionally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands‑on experience with policy lifecycle processes and insurance operational workflows.
* Ability to produce high‑quality process maps, data flows, and requirement documentation.
* Proficiency in managing multi‑vendor engagements and navigating complex project environments.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify gaps, and propose practical solutions.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills for client‑facing interactions.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical, functional, and business stakeholders.

**Ideally, good to have**

* Experience working on data migration projects and applying data governance best practices.
* Knowledge of insurance COTS platforms such as FAST, ALIP, OIPA, wmA etc
* Certifications such as AAPA or LOMA.
* Understanding of upstream and downstream integrations across the policy lifecycle
* Knowledge of project management tools like JIRA, TFS, Azure DevOps

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

* Collaborate closely with the other members of the team both locally and globally to solve customer problems and to exchange knowledge and best practices

description:
**Organization: Indian Social Responsibility Network (ISRN)**

**Position: Program Officer – Operations & Implementation**

**Location: As per project requirements; field travel to project locations will be required**

**Position Type: Full-time**

**Reporting To: Project Manager/designated ISRN management representative**

**About ISRN**

Indian Social Responsibility Network (ISRN), established in 2014, is a multi-stakeholder network promoting inclusive and sustainable development through collaboration among corporates, government institutions, NGOs, and communities.

With over 840 member organizations, ISRN facilitates impactful CSR initiatives, strengthens grassroots organizations, and advances sustainable development through capacity building, research, and strategic partnerships, guided by its philosophy of “Relationship Building Beyond Funding.”

**Job Purpose**

The Program Officer – Operations & Implementation will support the effective planning, coordination, execution and monitoring of ISRN projects. The role will ensure that project activities are implemented in line with approved proposals, work plans, budgets, timelines, donor requirements and organisational procedures. The incumbent will coordinate with internal teams, implementation partners, government departments, community stakeholders, vendors and other relevant institutions, and will maintain accurate project records and timely progress reporting.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**1. Project Planning and Implementation**

* Support project planning, scheduling, execution, and field-level implementation in line with approved work plans, timelines, and quality standards.
* Monitor progress, coordinate with implementation teams, resolve operational challenges, and flag delays or risks.

**2. Operations and Logistics**

* Coordinate logistics for project activities, field visits, trainings, workshops, meetings, and stakeholder consultations.
* Support procurement, vendor management, travel, resource planning, and related administrative processes in accordance with organisational policies.

**3. Stakeholder and Partner Coordination**

* Coordinate with government departments, NGOs, CSR partners, donors, community organisations, and internal teams. Organise meetings, document discussions, track action points, and ensure timely follow-up.

**4. Monitoring, Evaluation and Reporting**

* Track project milestones, outputs, indicators, and deliverables against approved plans.
* Maintain MIS, activity records, field data, beneficiary information, and evidence; prepare periodic progress reports and document outcomes, case studies, and success stories.

**5. Donor Reporting and Compliance**

* Support donor reporting, presentations, project documentation, and audit requirements.
* Ensure accurate record-keeping, timely submissions, and compliance with donor conditions and organisational policies.

**6. Budget and Resource Monitoring**

* Track project expenditure against approved budgets in coordination with the Finance team.
* Maintain activity-wise cost records and report budget variances, resource gaps, and unplanned expenses.

**7. Training and Capacity Building**

* Coordinate training programmes, workshops, and orientations, including materials, participant records, feedback, outcome documentation, and follow-up.

**8. Communication and Knowledge Management**

* Share verified project updates and field inputs with the Communications team.
* Maintain organised project records and document lessons learned, good practices, and knowledge for wider dissemination and replication.

**9. Other Responsibilities**

* Undertake additional project-related duties as assigned by the reporting manager or ISRN management.

**Essential Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Social Work/ Rural Development/ Development Studies/ Public Administration/ Public Health/Management or another relevant discipline.
* Candidates with a relevant bachelor’s degree and substantial experience may also be considered.

**Experience**

* Minimum 4–5 years of relevant experience in project implementation, operations, coordination, or monitoring within the NGO, CSR, development, or social-impact sector.
* Experience in stakeholder coordination, field operations, MIS, documentation, and progress reporting. Exposure to donor-funded projects, procurement, budget tracking, or ISRN’s thematic areas will be an advantage.

**Essential Skills**

* Strong planning, coordination, execution, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in written and verbal communication in English and Hindi, report writing, and MS Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).
* Ability to manage data, documentation, multiple deadlines, and stakeholder relationships.
* Willingness to travel to project locations as required.

**Key Competencies**

* Project planning and implementation; operational and stakeholder coordination; monitoring and reporting; teamwork; time management; attention to detail; accountability; and adaptability.

**Performance Expectations**

* Timely delivery of project activities and reports, accurate MIS and documentation, effective stakeholder coordination, adherence to approved budgets and organisational and donor requirements, and proactive identification of implementation risks and delays.

title: Urban Transport Specialist - req38813
description:
**Urban Transport Specialist**
Job #: req38813
  
  
Organization: World Bank
  
  
Sector: Transportation
  
  
Grade: GF
  
  
Term Duration: Open-Ended Staff (OPEN-OP)
  
  
Recruitment Type: Local Recruitment
  
  
Location: New Delhi,India
  
  
Required Language(s): English
  
  
**Preferred Language(s)**
Closing Date: 11/9/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC
  
  
**Description**
At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd
  
  
**South Asia Region Context**
The South Asia Region, comprising Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, and Sri Lanka, is at a pivotal stage of development. Rapid economic growth, driven by urbanization and demographic trends, has reduced poverty, but significant disparities persist. The region also faces growing climate risks, environmental pollution, informality, and low female labor force participation.
  
  
Sustained, private sector-led growth, anchored in investments in infrastructure, logistics, energy, and connectivity, is critical to creating jobs for South Asia’s sizeable youth population. At the same time, continued investment in human capital is needed to equip people for the jobs of the future.
  
  
The South Asia Infrastructure program supports countries in building sustainable, resilient, and inclusive infrastructure systems through an integrated, cross-sectoral approach to growth, job creation, connectivity, resilience, and service delivery. Infrastructure engagements increasingly combine public and private sector solutions, including collaboration across the World Bank Group, to maximize development impact.
  
  
India, the largest economy in South Asia, is undergoing a profound urban and economic transformation. Meeting the country’s growing demand for sustainable mobility, efficient logistics systems, and climate-resilient infrastructure will be important for improving access to jobs and services, enhancing competitiveness, supporting decarbonization, and attracting private investment. The World Bank Group’s engagement in India increasingly calls for integrated solutions that combine public and private financing, policy reform, institutional strengthening, and collaboration with IFC and MIGA.
  
  
**Transport And Logistics Practice**
The Transport and Logistics Practice supports efficient, safe, resilient, and low-carbon connectivity across road, rail, urban transport, maritime transport, inland waterways, and aviation. Working with public and private sector partners, it combines investment and policy support to improve access, trade, economic integration, and the performance of transport services and supply chains.
  
  
In India, the Practice’s urban transport program promotes compact, connected, inclusive, and low-carbon development through better public transport, multimodal integration, transit-oriented development, electric mobility, safer streets, stronger institutions, and sustainable financing. The program brings together lending, analytics, technical assistance, policy dialogue, and partnerships with national, state, and city governments.
  
  
**About The Position**
ISAT1 seeks to recruit an Urban Transport Specialist (GF), based in New Delhi, to support the preparation and implementation of urban mobility operations and analytical and advisory work in India and, as needed, elsewhere in South Asia. The position requires a strong combination of urban transport expertise, operational capability, client engagement, analytical judgment, and the ability to work effectively across disciplines and institutions.
  
  
The selected candidate will be expected to contribute materially to the design and delivery of complex programs, including public transport and institutional reform, urban rail and bus systems, integrated mobility, electric mobility, accessibility and inclusion, climate resilience, road safety, digitalization, infrastructure financing, and private sector participation. The Specialist will work closely with government counterparts, World Bank Group teams, development partners, consultants, and other stakeholders, and will report to the Practice Manager for Transport and Logistics in South Asia.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**
The Urban Transport Specialist will perform a full range of technical, operational, analytical, and coordination functions, including but not limited to the following:
  
  

* Urban Transport Operations
* Support and, as appropriate, lead or co-lead the identification, preparation, appraisal, and implementation of lending and non-lending activities in urban transport.
* Contribute to project design, results frameworks, implementation arrangements, cost and economic analysis, risk assessment, procurement planning, and implementation support.
* Help resolve implementation bottlenecks and provide practical, timely advice to clients on institutional, technical, contractual, and operational issues.
* Work with environmental, social, procurement, financial management, legal, and other specialists to ensure integrated and high-quality project delivery.
* Monitor progress, results, risks, disbursements, and agreed actions, and prepare concise, decision-useful reporting for task teams and management.
* Technical and Policy Support
* Provide technical advice on urban mobility planning, public transport networks and operations, urban rail and bus systems, multimodal integration, first- and last-mile connectivity, walking and cycling, transit-oriented development, and demand management.
* Support reforms related to public transport institutions, governance, service contracting, fare policy, funding and financing, data systems, performance management, and service quality.
* Contribute to electric mobility programs, including public transport electrification, enabling infrastructure, institutional arrangements, and coordination with energy and private sector stakeholders.
* Integrate climate mitigation and resilience, road safety, gender, universal accessibility, social inclusion, and environmental considerations into transport strategies and investments.
* Assess opportunities for private capital mobilization and innovative financing, including PPPs, blended finance, guarantees, land value capture, and collaboration with IFC and MIGA, where appropriate.
* Analytics, Knowledge, and Innovation
* Lead or contribute to analytical and advisory work, policy notes, investment frameworks, sector diagnostics, and city-level mobility studies.
* Collect, assess, and interpret quantitative and qualitative data; use evidence to diagnose mobility constraints, compare options, and formulate implementable recommendations.
* Promote the use of digital tools, geospatial analysis, transport modeling, open data, and other technologies where they improve planning, operations, monitoring, or user outcomes.
* Prepare clear technical reports, briefing notes, presentations, talking points, and other knowledge products for varied technical and senior audiences.
* Share lessons across projects, cities, countries, and Global Practice networks, and contribute to knowledge events and professional communities.
* Client Engagement and Partnerships
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with national ministries, state governments, urban local bodies, transport authorities, operators, development partners, private sector participants, academia, and civil society.
* Participate in policy dialogue and technical discussions, providing evidence-based and practical advice that is responsive to client priorities and implementation capacity.
* Plan and support missions, workshops, consultations, training activities, and high-level visits, including timely documentation and follow-up.
* Coordinate effectively across World Bank Group practices and institutions to develop integrated solutions relevant to India’s urban transformation.
* Team Contribution
* Work collaboratively in diverse, multidisciplinary, and geographically dispersed teams, contributing constructively to shared outcomes.
* Guide consultants and junior colleagues, review technical outputs, and contribute to quality assurance and capacity development.
* Support country and regional strategy work and other Transport and Logistics Practice priorities, including assignments outside the immediate urban transport portfolio when required.
* Undertake other related responsibilities assigned by the Practice Manager.

Selection Criteria
  
  

* Master’s degree or higher in transport planning, transport or civil engineering, urban planning, economics, public policy, finance, or a closely related field.
* At least 5 years of progressively responsible professional experience in urban transport, with demonstrated experience in project preparation, implementation, and/or advisory work.
* Substantial experience in at least three of the following areas: public transport planning and reform; urban rail or bus systems; integrated and multimodal mobility; electric mobility; active mobility and road safety; transport institutions and policy; infrastructure financing or private sector participation.
* Experience working with national, state, or city governments on complex transport programs. Experience in India or comparable federal and rapidly urbanizing settings is highly desirable.

**Technical And Operational Capabilities**

* Strong understanding of urban mobility systems, including the interactions among land use, accessibility, public transport, non-motorized transport, road networks, technology, institutions, financing, and user needs.
* Demonstrated ability to translate technical analysis into practical project design, policy advice, and implementable actions.
* Experience managing or supporting complex infrastructure or service-delivery projects, including coordination across technical, fiduciary, environmental, social, and institutional dimensions.
* Familiarity with economic and financial analysis, procurement and contract management, results monitoring, and risk management in infrastructure projects.
* Experience with World Bank or other MDB operations is desirable. Familiarity with IPF, PforR, or other development finance instruments would be an advantage.

**Client, Communication, And Team Skills**

* Excellent client orientation and the ability to build trust, work through differing perspectives, and provide candid, evidence-based advice in complex institutional settings.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills in English, including the ability to present complex issues clearly and concisely to technical and senior audiences.
* Proven ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and multicultural teams, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality outputs under tight deadlines.
* Strong judgment, initiative, attention to detail, resourcefulness, and results orientation.
* Ability to mentor colleagues, manage consultants, and contribute to an inclusive and collaborative working environment.

**Critical Success Factors**

* Sound understanding of India’s urban transport challenges, institutions, and political economy, with the ability to identify feasible pathways for reform and investment.
* Capacity to connect technical quality with implementation realities, financing constraints, institutional incentives, and user outcomes.
* Ability to move comfortably between detailed operational work and higher-level strategic and policy dialogue.
* Credibility with clients and colleagues, combined with humility, collaboration, and a strong focus on results.
* Commitment to sustainable, safe, resilient, inclusive, and low-carbon urban mobility.

**WBG and Transport GP Competencies**
The position requires strong alignment with World Bank Group Core Competencies, including Deliver Results for Clients, Collaborate Within Teams and Across Boundaries, Lead and Innovate, Create, Apply and Share Knowledge, and Make Smart Decisions. Relevant Transport GP competencies include transport policy and institutions, general transport planning, transport systems and technologies, operational project management, project design for impact and sustainability, client orientation, and knowledge and communication.
  
  
As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:
  
  

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.
* Bring experience working in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent (FCV) contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.

**WBG Culture Attributes**

* Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.
* Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
* Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

World Bank Group Core Competencies
  
  
The World Bank Group offers comprehensive benefits, including a retirement plan; medical, life and disability insurance; and paid leave, including parental leave, as well as reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities.
  
  
We are proud to be an equal opportunity and inclusive employer with a dedicated and committed workforce, and do not discriminate based on gender, gender identity, religion, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability.

title: Research Associate / Sr Research Associate (Heat Forecast)
description: Title: Research Associate / Senior Research Associate (Heat Forecast)Location: Delhi, India preferred. Applicants must hold Indian citizenship and valid authorization to work in India. Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications from OCI (Overseas Citizen of India) cardholders for this role.Salary: Salary will be competitive and commensurate with the candidate's skills, experience, and the local labor market in India.Position: Full-timeApplication deadline: Nov 10, 2026, at 5 pm IST (applications may be reviewed as they are submitted)About The RolePrecision Development (PxD) is looking for a Research Associate / Senior Research Associate to join our weather initiative in India. The successful candidate will lead formative research on how AI-based heat forecasts can help agriculture and livestock farmers prepare for and respond to heat. Working closely with PxD and affiliated researchers, they will help define a concrete heat-advisory use case and pilot it with farmers and government partners — testing new ideas and measuring their impact.The role calls for someone who is curious about how farmers make decisions under climate risk, comfortable moving between fieldwork and data, and who understands how digital technology is adopted and scaled within government.If you're passionate about turning advances in AI weather forecasting into practical, evidence-based services for farmers, and committed to driving positive change in the agricultural sector, we encourage you to apply.We're hiring for this role at either the Research Associate or Senior Research Associate level. The specific level will be determined based on the candidate's years of experience, demonstrated seniority, and scope of past responsibilities.ResponsibilitiesThese will evolve as the role develops; key initial areas are outlined below.Formative ResearchDesign and conduct formative research (qualitative interviews, focus group discussions, rapid surveys) with crop and livestock farmers to understand how extreme heat affects their livelihoods, decisions, and coping strategiesMap farmers' current sources of weather information, the timing and lead time they need, and the actions they could take in response to a heat forecast. Engage with government agencies, meteorological departments, extension systems, and livestock/veterinary services to understand existing heat early-warning systems and gapsReview literature and existing evidence on heat-stress impacts and heat early-warning interventions in agriculture and livestockSynthesize findings into clear research briefs and presentations for internal teams and partners.Use Case Definition & DesignTranslate formative research insights into a well-defined use case for AI-based heat forecasts, specifying target users, decisions supported, forecast variables, lead times, and thresholdsWork with data science and forecasting partners to assess the skill and suitability of AI-based heat forecast products for the target geographiesCo-design heat advisory content and delivery channels with farmers, agronomists, and livestock expertsData & AnalysisDesign and program survey instruments (SurveyCTO/ODK)Oversee data collection quality, including field visits, back-checks, and high-frequency checksAnalyze pilot data on farmer engagement, comprehension, trust, behavior change, and early outcomesClean, merge, and analyze weather, forecast, survey, and administrative data (Stata, R, or Python)Assess the relationship between heat exposure and agricultural and livestock outcomes using existing data where availableMonitor forecast performance against observed weather data and flag issues to technical partnersContribute to dashboards and data pipelines supporting PxD's weather initiative, as neededWhat You'll BringA Bachelor's or Master's degree in economics, agricultural economics, public policy, development studies, statistics, environmental/climate science, or a closely related fieldDemonstrated experience conducting field research in LMIC settings, including qualitative methods (interviews, FGDs) and quantitative surveysStrong understanding of economics and econometrics, and familiarity with randomized evaluationsExcellent knowledge of Stata, R, Python, or similar software for data analysisDemonstrated experience using SurveyCTO/ODK or a similar program for survey designUnderstanding of research ethics for human subjects in the social sciencesInterest in climate adaptation, weather and climate services, or digital agriculture; familiarity with weather/forecast data or heat-stress impacts on crops or livestock is a strong plusAbility to translate research insights into practical product or service design, working with technical and non-technical stakeholdersExcellent organizational skills, detail-oriented, and ability to work both independently and collaborativelyFluency in English with strong oral and written communication skills; knowledge of Hindi or another Indian language is a plusAbility to work under time pressure and solve problems creativelyWillingness to travel frequently to project sites and conduct fieldwork, including during summer monthsHow to ApplyTo apply, please visit the PxD website and use the online application form to submit a CV, cover letter, and brief responses to the screening questions. Applications may be reviewed on a rolling basis. The final deadline to apply is 10 November 2026, 5 pm IST.In line with our values, we evaluate candidates on merit alone, without regard to gender, gender identity, ethnicity, religion, disability, caste, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We offer flexible working arrangements to support your wellbeing. Personal data provided is used for recruitment purposes only.About Precision Development (PxD)PxD is a rapidly scaling global nonprofit working with governments across Africa and Asia to close the last-mile gap in smallholder farming. We deliver evidence-based information and tools — from timely farming and weather guidance to climate-resilient inputs — that millions of farmers use to improve their lives. In the last 12 months alone, we reached over 60 million farmers at a cost of just $0.47 per farmer per year, with our flagship program in India delivering a benefit-cost ratio of 12:1–19:1.Operating in Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, and beyond, the majority of our team is based in our program countries, working directly alongside government partners and farming communities toward our goal of improving the lives of 100 million farmers by 2030.

title: Workday Integration Specialist
description:
**About Us**
Dyson is a global technology enterprise. We solve the problems others choose to ignore, with surprising new inventions that defy convention and simply work better. We’re growing fast and our ambition is huge – more categories, more locations and more people.
  
  
Pioneering technology takes more than just inventive engineers. At Dyson, we take a problem-solving approach to everything we do. And across our support teams, we’re proud to be different. And importantly, we support change to maintain our rapid growth
  
  
Digital HRIS function organization provides process and service excellence to support Dyson’s growth ambitions with a goal of innovating and enhancing employee services over time to meet the changing needs of the business.
  
  
**About The Role**
Part of a team of functional managers and specialists, the role is fundamental to supporting and advancing Dyson’s usage of the core Human Capital Management system (Workday). This role will serve as an HR Technology point of contact for HR functional areas and assists HR subject matter experts to identify, plan and implement systems and process improvements. The specialist will have responsibility for the successful implementation, integration, configuration, and support of Workday applications from project initiation to production roll-out.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you will strive to deliver a 'best in class', efficient service and will be a valued member of the wider People and Dyson Business Services communities at Dyson.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Support global business users and HR by troubleshooting system issues, resolving defects, maintaining system data structures, assisting with ad-hoc reporting requests, and administering biannual Workday-related processes.
* Take ownership of queries and actively manage them, providing best-in-class technical solutions and stakeholder support while ensuring compliance with policies and procedures.
* Act as a subject matter expert (SME) with deep knowledge of Workday integrations and modules, including configuration, testing, and implementation across HCM, Reporting & Analytics, Compensation, Talent and Performance, Absence Management, Time Tracking, Recruiting, Security, and related areas.
* Conduct working sessions with stakeholders to gather, understand, and analyze business and technical requirements, recommending solutions based on best practices and feasibility.
* Collaborate with requestors, project managers, business analysts, HR business partners, and QA staff to ensure requirements are fully understood, including reviewing technical designs and testing documentation.
* Configure and implement changes or updates to Workday integrations and modules, managing and promoting these through the appropriate technical (solution) development and change management processes.
* Support delivery of key projects, including Workday integration enhancements, HR system changes, and improvements to stakeholder experience.
* Develop and implement scalable, flexible integration solutions that can adapt to future business needs.
* Advise stakeholders on industry standards and best practices, ensuring clean configuration and streamlined processes.
* Ensure users leverage Workday best practices effectively.
* Maintain up-to-date process documentation and learning materials, including GWIs, FAQs, and training guides.
* Engage in continuous self-learning through Workday Community and other available channels.
* Actively contribute to HR-wide and cross-functional initiatives as required.

**About You**
The successful candidate will demonstrate strong experience in requirements gathering, solution design, delivery, and ongoing support of Workday integration projects. This includes hands-on expertise in tools such as Workday Studio, Core Connectors, EIBs, and APIs, applied across multiple functional areas (e.g., Talent and Performance, Absence Management, Recruiting, etc).
  
  
**Experience**

* Degree in Information Technology / Computer Science/ Business or other related fields
* Minimum 3–5 years of Workday integration experience
* Hands-on involvement in at least one full lifecycle Workday integration and implementation project
* Strong background in Workday Studio, Core Connectors, EIBs, and Workday APIs
* Experience working in a multinational technology organization with complex system landscapes
* Demonstrated ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with maturity
* Knowledge and experience across a range of SaaS HRIS and web-based talent management or HR service delivery tools, with emphasis on system integration and data flows
* Extensive HR systems reporting, HR process, and project management experience
* Familiarity with HCM concepts, HR processes, and a basic understanding of HR policies and procedures (ensure integration design aligns with business requirements)
* Workday Integration certification is a must.

Personal Attributes
  
  

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail in technical configurations
* Strong organizational and time management skills, able to react quickly to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment
* A collaborative team player with the ability to work independently and cross-functionally with HR, other stakeholders, and third-party vendor
* Proactive approach to delivering effective technical solutions, troubleshooting, and stakeholder engagement.
* Results-oriented, with awareness of goals and standards, ensuring quality and productivity are consistently met
* Ability to prioritize workload, analyse complex problems, and demonstrate resilience in overcoming technical barriers

Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

title: Associate-Digital Content Producer-Policy
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Career Family**
Risk Management Services
  
  
**Role Type**
Associate
  
  
**Associate - Policy, Risk Management Services**
Risk Management team at EY plays an important role in managing the internal risks of the firm associated with accepting a new client or an engagement or risks associated with any of our on-going audit/ non audit engagement. Formed in the Year 2007, the Risk Management team is growing rapidly as a Centre of Excellence for all standardized quality / compliance related activities that can be efficiently undertaken from Global Delivery Services location.
  
  
**The opportunity**
The volume and complexity of legal and regulatory requirements which EY is required to meet, continues to grow, and as a result the quality of EY policies is required to continually improve. The current opportunity to join the Executive Risk Management (RM) Policy team provides the successful candidate an opportunity to learn and grow while understanding the best practices in corporate policy and support the delivery of new and refreshed policies across the organization.
  
  
The role also offers the successful candidate the opportunity to work with senior members of the Policy team and across business enablement functions, and service lines more broadly to increase visibility and awareness of EY policies.
  
  
This position is ideal for a team player who likes to maintain daily virtual contact with people across locations and teams. This position is designed for people who like to be challenged and want to grow in a dynamic, multi-cultural environment with modern tools. They will report to the Assistant Manager in the Policy team.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Expertise:**

* Perform initial review of submissions from client teams, evaluate completeness, accuracy, and appropriateness of proposed policy requests
* Deliver high quality, client-ready output with minimal supervision
* Knowledge of web publishing technologies like Adobe CMS, Adobe AEM, HTML, CSS, JS will be added advantage
* Work independently to drive the process requests to completion
* Individual will reference existing policies, will need to research on EY platforms and propose solutions to issues
* Support strategic and complex processes as well as ad hoc projects at GDS-RMS
* Assist in transitioning new processes from Risk Management at Global or Regions to GDS
* Support and manage key operational activities at the RM Executive

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Be able to manage client expectations in changing environment while maintaining a professional working style
* Ability to work in a deadline driven environment
* Possess excellent communication skills (oral and written)
* Bring innovation to improve processes and work products, and have the ability to learn/ adapt quickly when required
* Ability to manage multiple projects with accuracy, timeliness, and problem-solving skills
* Strong commitment to quality and self-motivated learning
* Client-focused with an eye for detail and potential issues/ conflicts to manage the risks before they occur
* Willingness to work more than standard hours, as needed

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* MBA degree with 0-4 years of experience
* Absolute fluency in spoken and written English; excellent listening comprehension skills
* Ability to work independently with well-developed problem-solving skills and understanding of processes
* Excellent knowledge of MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook and Teams)
* Tableau, Power Bi or other data visualization skills would be an added advantage
* Technical understanding of, and experience in the RM function would be preferred

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Knowledge on difference between risk advisory and risk management
* Presentation skills
* Critical thinking skills with the ability to independently solve problems with data analysis

**Technologies and Tools**

* Experience in MS office suites like Microsoft Office Suite i.e. Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams, Power Bi, Power Automate etc

**What You Can Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* A team which has its foundation in the core values of trust, respect and teaming
* The team which focuses on supporting its colleagues to excel in their respective domains and provides avenues to help acquire and demonstrate new skills
* Opportunities to work with Global risk management teams on strengthening and monitoring EY policies and compliance framework

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly a global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants, to coders, to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

title: Delivery AI Product Analyst
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
We are seeking exceptional candidates with experience and passion to fill Senior Solution Analyst Position in BCG’s new business unit, BCG X. This global business unit brings together cutting-edge AI, visionary business ventures, and unique software and products in the most strategic industry applications to deliver superior value and sustained impact. All of BCG’s core product capabilities are housed within the business unit including product management, design, development, support, and data analytics experts who work in deep collaboration with BCG practice areas, consulting teams, and clients. This team, of highly motivated and insightful colleagues, will provide an opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial environment supported by a global management consulting firm, which is the world’s leading advisor on business strategy.
  
  
A BCG Senior Solution Analyst is someone who will work with product manager and senior leadership in various business groups to help drive capabilities and support increased commercialization of BCG proprietary data and software assets. This person will work together with technical and commercial teams from the initial business case to roadmap delivery, launch, and ongoing support operations. We want someone with an entrepreneurial drive and demonstrated experience leading enterprise or large-scale product efforts across product strategy, marketing, finance, engineering, support, and executive stakeholders.
  
  
Additionally, you will work in a growing global team, providing industry & topic expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, methodologies, software solutions, analysis and expert advisory. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues This is an exciting opportunity to jump into a unique position at a world class firm.
  
  
**YOU'RE GOOD AT**
**Product Management**

* Co-own the product roadmap with the Product Manager and keep it tied to business goals and user needs
* Conduct user research and usability tests, and use the results alongside market analysis and client feedback to improve the product
* Gather and prioritize requirements in stakeholder workshops, then write them up as user stories with acceptance criteria
* Build user personas and use AI design tools to prototype and iterate with the UI/UX team
* Run Scrum ceremonies with the engineering team and clear blockers to keep features shipping on time
* Join technical discussions and translate between engineering and business stakeholders so product decisions stay feasible
* Keep feature lists, user guides and release notes current, and update stakeholders on progress and milestones

**Product Delivery**

* As a thought partner to case teams and clients, define the business problem early and shape a solution around it
* Apply BCG Transformation and Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) methodology on cases and configure the product for each client’s program
* Manage MVP-based implementation plans as the client’s day-to-day point of contact, and set realistic expectations about what the product covers today
* Lead demos and training sessions that get case teams and client users working in the product
* Triage client issues and work them through to resolution with Engineering and Support
* Convert case learnings into proprietary assets and input for the roadmap

**AI-Native ways of working**

* Set up and maintain the team’s AI harness, including a product knowledge base that captures context, personas, business rules and past decisions, plus connectors to Azure DevOps, Confluence and SharePoint
* Create a library of reusable skills, such as a story writer, BRD generator and release notes generator, and update/maintain them as the product changes
* Convert routine product owner work (backlog refinement, story writing and edge-case testing, sprint review prep, stakeholder updates) into repeatable AI workflows with defined inputs and a standard output format
* Help design agentic workflows that chain AI tools and models to automate repetitive, multi-step tasks
* Coach clients and case teams on building AI dashboards and structuring outputs data through prompts
* Test new AI tools, models and agentic techniques against client use cases and recommend which ones to adopt
* Make sure every product decision and AI-generated output has a named human owner, and protect client data under BCG’s AI usage and responsible AI guidelines

What You'll Bring
  
  
**Technco-Functional Proficiency and Collaboration**

* 2-3 years of consulting experience (preferred) or 3-4 years in industry, ideally in a business analysis or product role on a SaaS product
* Exposure to transformation, restructuring, change management or PMI, with an appetite to build depth in these topics
* Solid grasp of P&L and balance sheet KPIs plus proficiency in PowerPoint and financial modelling in Excel
* A good understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile delivery (no coding required); Tableau or Alteryx skills are an advantage
* Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot, including prompt engineering, skill building, and agentic workflow design
* Structured problem solving and analytical rigor, with the planning discipline and attention to detail to follow through on commitments
* Experience communicating with and influencing senior stakeholders across global teams, and the judgment to know when to escalate
* Entrepreneurial drive and a record of hitting stretch goals in fast-moving environments
* Comfortable working independently or in distributed teams, and quick to pick up new tools and methods.

Who You'll Work With
  
  

* Client, Case, & BCG Vantage team members
* Product Engineering, Product Delivery, and Infrastructure Support team
* Helpdesk, Reporting & Data Analytics team
* Topic/Product/Case Leadership

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Business Development Manager

**Company:**
Sotase Seatings LLP

**Location:**
Gurgaon / Fatehpur Beri, South Delhi

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, On-site

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

Company Description

Sotase Seatings LLP is a five-year-old, growing company specializing in the design, manufacturing, supply, and installation of seating solutions. Our product portfolio includes cinema chairs, auditorium seating, stadium chairs, school and college furniture, institutional furniture, recliners, and sofas.

We provide customized seating solutions for commercial, institutional, and project-based requirements across India. As a growing business, we offer an entrepreneurial work environment where initiative, accountability, and the ability to build business opportunities are highly valued.

Role Description

We are looking for a proactive, target-oriented Business Development Manager to drive sales growth, generate new business opportunities, and develop long-term client relationships.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a growing company, capable of independently managing the complete sales cycle, and willing to take ownership of business development activities from lead generation to order closure.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who can lead from the front, work independently with minimal supervision, and adapt to the dynamic requirements of a growing business.

Key Responsibilities

* Generate new business leads through cold calling, networking, email outreach, market research, and client visits.
* Identify and develop business opportunities for auditorium chairs, cinema seating, stadium seating, institutional furniture, recliners, and sofas.
* Build and maintain relationships with architects, interior designers, contractors, consultants, dealers, distributors, corporate clients, and institutions.
* Identify upcoming projects, tender opportunities, and potential customers in relevant markets.
* Manage CRM activities, maintain customer databases, track sales pipelines, and ensure timely follow-ups.
* Prepare quotations, proposals, and commercial offers and follow up to convert enquiries into confirmed orders.
* Conduct client meetings, understand customer requirements, present suitable solutions, and negotiate commercial terms within company guidelines.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets and contribute to overall business growth.
* Coordinate with design, production, and installation teams to ensure smooth project execution.
* Maintain sales reports, forecasts, customer records, and regular updates on business development activities.

Qualifications & Skills

* 3–5 years of experience in business development, B2B sales, or project sales.
* Strong communication, negotiation, client acquisition, and relationship-management skills.
* Experience in lead generation, CRM management, sales pipeline tracking, and order conversion.
* Ability to independently identify prospective customers and develop new business opportunities.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, email, CRM tools, and basic sales reporting.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities, solve problems, and work with minimal supervision.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings and project visits as required.
* A bachelor's degree in business, marketing, management, or a related field is preferred.

Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with experience in
**any furniture industry or interior design and interior fit-out sales**
are encouraged to apply.

Relevant backgrounds include office furniture, home furniture, modular furniture, sofas, recliners, commercial furniture, institutional furniture, turnkey interiors, and interior solutions.

Experience in B2B sales, project sales, dealer development, client acquisition, and relationship management will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate Profile

* Self-driven, proactive, flexible, and comfortable working in a growing business.
* Willing to take ownership and lead from the front rather than depend entirely on management for direction.
* Capable of handling the complete sales cycle independently, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiations and order closure.
* Comfortable managing multiple responsibilities and adapting to changing business priorities.
* Practical, resourceful, and focused on achieving measurable results.
* Able to communicate directly with management and coordinate effectively with internal teams.
* Comfortable working from either our Gurgaon or Fatehpur Beri, South Delhi office.

Our Work Culture

Sotase Seatings LLP is a growing, entrepreneurial company where initiative, accountability, flexibility, and results matter. We value people who take ownership, work independently, solve problems, and actively contribute to business growth.

We are looking for a hands-on professional who can build business opportunities from the ground up, lead by example, and grow with the company.

* **If you are a self-motivated sales professional who enjoys taking responsibility, developing new markets, and turning opportunities into business, we would like to hear from you.**

title: National Sales Head
description:
About Qreanova Kitchen Appliances

Qreanova Kitchen Appliances is an emerging premium brand backed by the industrial legacy and manufacturing expertise of the Presco-Mec Group.

With a focus on innovative design, dependable quality, and high performance, Qreanova offers a range of products including chimneys, hobs, and built-in kitchen appliances.

Guided by the vision “A New Perspective on Premium Living,” Qreanova aims to redefine modern kitchen experiences through thoughtful innovation and refined aesthetics. As the brand expands its presence in the premium segment, this is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping its national sales growth and market presence.

Role Overview

We are seeking an accomplished, commercially astute, and growth-oriented National Sales Head to lead Qreanova’s Pan-India sales strategy and execution.

The role will be responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding distribution and channel networks, strengthening dealer and distributor relationships, and building a high-performing national sales organisation aligned with the brand’s premium positioning.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and execute national sales strategies to achieve revenue, profitability, and market expansion objectives.
* Build and strengthen Pan-India distribution networks across distributors, dealers, retailers, and key accounts.
* Lead, mentor, and drive performance across regional sales managers and field sales teams.
* Expand market presence and strengthen channel partnerships in the premium kitchen appliance segment.
* Drive sales planning, forecasting, budgeting, target setting, and periodic performance reviews.
* Develop strategic relationships with channel partners and key business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with marketing and product teams on product launches, sales campaigns, and brand visibility.
* Analyse market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and emerging business opportunities.
* Establish sales KPIs, monitor execution, and provide strategic performance updates to senior leadership.

Mandatory Candidate Requirements

* 20–25 years of overall sales experience, preferably in consumer durables or related industries.
* Proven Pan-India sales leadership experience is mandatory.
* Demonstrated success in national sales strategy, business growth, and market expansion.
* Extensive expertise in channel sales, distributor and dealer development, and trade management.
* Proven ability to lead regional sales leaders and build high-performing teams.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience in sales forecasting, budgeting, profitability, and market penetration.
* Excellent leadership, negotiation, strategic planning, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India.

Preferred industry experience: Kitchen appliances, home appliances, electrical appliances, and related consumer durable categories.

The Opportunity

Join Qreanova at an exciting stage of its growth journey and help shape the next phase of a premium kitchen appliance brand. This role offers the opportunity to build national market reach, strengthen channel partnerships, and contribute meaningfully to the brand’s long-term growth.

How to Apply

Interested professionals who meet the mandatory criteria may share their updated CV/profile directly with me. Further details regarding the opportunity, business vision, and role expectations will be discussed following an initial profile review.

* Know a suitable leader? Referrals and relevant profile recommendations are welcome.
