title: Zonal Sales Manager (CAPEX), New Delhi
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.
  
  
As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The primary objective of the Zonal Sales Manager ZSM (Capital Equipment) is to ensure achievement of sales objectives by providing excellent service and advice to current customers within an assigned geographic area, whilst also leveraging new and existing business with the aim of growing market share. Additionally, this role acts as a mentor for new Sales Colleagues and Clinical Support Representatives within a designated geographic area. Case support coordination, conversion of new business opportunities and some business analysis are required in this role.
  
  
The role is intended to provide a development pathway for experienced and successful Sales Personnel moving toward a career in sales management.
  
  
This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent within strategic key accounts tertiary care hospitals – Corporate, Stand alone and Government institutes and the incumbent must demonstrate an understanding of B2B and B2G environment. The ZSM is responsible for supporting current business and to actively grow the business by gaining new accounts and increasing Market Share.
  
  
This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent both enhancing current business and development of future business opportunities.
  
  
The ZSM (Capital Equipment) should possess a strong working knowledge of Zimmer and competitor products. As a pivotal role within the organization, the ZSM acts as a liaison point between the customer and the various internal departments (eg. Marketing, Finance, Operations) whose work impacts or is impacted by field activity.
  
  
As a conduit of information to and from the field, ZSM must also facilitate the flow of information regarding changes in the industry, customer environments, or competitor activity to others within the larger Zimmer organization.
  
  

* Drive sales of Capital Surgical Equipment to hospitals, healthcare institutions, and corporate healthcare groups.
* Develop and manage relationships with key decision-makers, including hospital administrators, procurement teams, biomedical engineers, surgeons, and healthcare professionals.
* Identify new business opportunities and expand the customer base.
* Manage the complete tender lifecycle, including identifying opportunities, preparing documentation, coordinating submissions, participating in bidding processes, and ensuring compliance.
* Handle institutional sales with government hospitals, private hospital chains, medical colleges, defence institutions, and other healthcare organizations.
* Achieve assigned sales targets and revenue objectives.
* Prepare and deliver product presentations, demonstrations, and commercial proposals.
* Coordinate with internal teams for order processing, installation, training, and after-sales support.
* Monitor competitor activities, market trends, pricing, and customer requirements to develop effective sales strategies.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer records, and pipeline reports using CRM tools.
* Ensure timely collections and maintain healthy customer relationships.

Principal Responsibilities & Duties
  
  
**Support and Review Current Business (40%)**

* Actively contact current and potential customers and attend to resulting customer requests.
* Conduct in-servicing and workshops on products.
* Maintain good relationships with key accounts & seek to continue leverage of existing business relationships.

**Targeting and Conversion of Business (50%)**

* Establish relationships with key decision makers at national level
* Present proposal to decision makers and executive presence to represent Zimmer to CXO level in hospitals
* Responsible for the preparation of quotations for sales query as well as documentation for submission of tenders. To engage in the negotiation of prices in line with the guidelines from management.

**Management Reporting (5%)**

* Completion of reports as required by Business unit director including monthly reports & expenses.
* Prepare ad-hoc reports on an as-required basis.

**Technical Learning and Skill Development (5%)**

* Attendance at relevant workshops and, where required, completion of learning assessment exercises.
* Study relevant clinical articles & data to build knowledge base and provide relevant advice to customers & staff.

***This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and may not necessarily comprise all of the "essential functions" for purposes of the ADA.***
Expected Behaviour
  
  
The incumbent will be required to demonstrate behavior in accordance with Zimmer Biomet’s Guiding Principles, as listed below;
  
  
We respect you for your individual contributions and your diverse perspectives. We support your professional growth and provide you with opportunities to share in the company's success.
  
  
Commit to the highest standards of patient safety, quality and integrity.
  
  

* We commit to the highest standards of patient safety and quality in our products and services and to be recognized for world-class integrity and ethical business practices.

Focus our resources in areas where we will make a difference.
  
  

* We focus our resources in areas where we will make the greatest impact for our customers and patients through our collective knowledge of the disease state or market, established infrastructure, relevant engineering expertise and skillsets.

Ensure the company's return is equivalent to the value we provide our customers and patients.
  
  

* We innovate to provide value through effective and efficient solutions for customers and improved outcomes for patients to ensure the company's return is equivalent to the value we provide our customers and patients.

Give back to our communities and people in need.
  
  

* We partner with communities where we live and work and support causes and programs that forward our mission for people in need.

**Education/Experience Requirements**
**The successful candidate must possess the following:**

* Qualifications in Business, Commerce, Marketing or Paramedical discipline.
* Qualifications in nursing/pharma/ science or a related discipline or compensating work experience.

**The candidate must have the following level of experience in, or knowledge of:**

* Previous experience in capital equipment sales – Neurology, Capital, Equipment
* Demonstrated sales abilities & a track record of successful selling directly to corporate tertiary care hospital, stand alone tertiary care and tertiary care government institutes

**Expected Areas of Competence**

* Working level of proficiency in English
* B2B and B2G Direct sales
* Product/Technical Knowledge
* Commercial Acumen
* Result Orientation
* Inter-personal and communication skills
* Tenacity

title: Delivery AI Product Analyst
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

We are seeking exceptional candidates with experience and passion to fill Senior Solution Analyst Position in BCG’s new business unit, BCG X. This global business unit brings together cutting-edge AI, visionary business ventures, and unique software and products in the most strategic industry applications to deliver superior value and sustained impact. All of BCG’s core product capabilities are housed within the business unit including product management, design, development, support, and data analytics experts who work in deep collaboration with BCG practice areas, consulting teams, and clients. This team, of highly motivated and insightful colleagues, will provide an opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial environment supported by a global management consulting firm, which is the world’s leading advisor on business strategy.

A BCG Senior Solution Analyst is someone who will work with product manager and senior leadership in various business groups to help drive capabilities and support increased commercialization of BCG proprietary data and software assets. This person will work together with technical and commercial teams from the initial business case to roadmap delivery, launch, and ongoing support operations. We want someone with an entrepreneurial drive and demonstrated experience leading enterprise or large-scale product efforts across product strategy, marketing, finance, engineering, support, and executive stakeholders.

Additionally, you will work in a growing global team, providing industry & topic expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, methodologies, software solutions, analysis and expert advisory. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues This is an exciting opportunity to jump into a unique position at a world class firm.

**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

**Product Management**

* Co-own the product roadmap with the Product Manager and keep it tied to business goals and user needs
* Conduct user research and usability tests, and use the results alongside market analysis and client feedback to improve the product
* Gather and prioritize requirements in stakeholder workshops, then write them up as user stories with acceptance criteria
* Build user personas and use AI design tools to prototype and iterate with the UI/UX team
* Run Scrum ceremonies with the engineering team and clear blockers to keep features shipping on time
* Join technical discussions and translate between engineering and business stakeholders so product decisions stay feasible
* Keep feature lists, user guides and release notes current, and update stakeholders on progress and milestones

**Product Delivery**

* As a thought partner to case teams and clients, define the business problem early and shape a solution around it
* Apply BCG Transformation and Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) methodology on cases and configure the product for each client’s program
* Manage MVP-based implementation plans as the client’s day-to-day point of contact, and set realistic expectations about what the product covers today
* Lead demos and training sessions that get case teams and client users working in the product
* Triage client issues and work them through to resolution with Engineering and Support
* Convert case learnings into proprietary assets and input for the roadmap

**AI-Native ways of working**

* Set up and maintain the team’s AI harness, including a product knowledge base that captures context, personas, business rules and past decisions, plus connectors to Azure DevOps, Confluence and SharePoint
* Create a library of reusable skills, such as a story writer, BRD generator and release notes generator, and update/maintain them as the product changes
* Convert routine product owner work (backlog refinement, story writing and edge-case testing, sprint review prep, stakeholder updates) into repeatable AI workflows with defined inputs and a standard output format
* Help design agentic workflows that chain AI tools and models to automate repetitive, multi-step tasks
* Coach clients and case teams on building AI dashboards and structuring outputs data through prompts
* Test new AI tools, models and agentic techniques against client use cases and recommend which ones to adopt
* Make sure every product decision and AI-generated output has a named human owner, and protect client data under BCG’s AI usage and responsible AI guidelines

What You'll Bring

**Technco-Functional Proficiency and Collaboration**

* 2-3 years of consulting experience (preferred) or 3-4 years in industry, ideally in a business analysis or product role on a SaaS product
* Exposure to transformation, restructuring, change management or PMI, with an appetite to build depth in these topics
* Solid grasp of P&L and balance sheet KPIs plus proficiency in PowerPoint and financial modelling in Excel
* A good understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile delivery (no coding required); Tableau or Alteryx skills are an advantage
* Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot, including prompt engineering, skill building, and agentic workflow design
* Structured problem solving and analytical rigor, with the planning discipline and attention to detail to follow through on commitments
* Experience communicating with and influencing senior stakeholders across global teams, and the judgment to know when to escalate
* Entrepreneurial drive and a record of hitting stretch goals in fast-moving environments
* Comfortable working independently or in distributed teams, and quick to pick up new tools and methods.#LI-RA1

Who You'll Work With

* Client, Case, & BCG Vantage team members
* Product Engineering, Product Delivery, and Infrastructure Support team
* Helpdesk, Reporting & Data Analytics team
* Topic/Product/Case Leadership

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Assistant Fraud Strategy Manager
description:
Date live: 10/23/2026

Business Area: In Business BSS

Area of Expertise: Product Development & Management

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000132094

  

Join us as a an Assistant Fraud Strategy Manager at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
  
  
You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with Product owner, Analytical Skills, Business Acumen, and Stakeholder Management as well as job-specific skillsets.

You will work closely with business, operations and cross-functional partners to solve complex problems, shape scalable solutions, and ensure efficient delivery. Acting as the key interface between business and functional stakeholders, you will support the development of product propositions, and/or service strategies—from concept and release.

To be successful as an Assistant Fraud Strategy Manager, you should have experience with:

  
  

**Critical / Essential Skills:**

* Define clear business requirements, manage prioritised backlogs and support feature teams through delivery using Agile ways of working and JIRA.
* Extract and analyse data from Barclays Information Warehouse using Structured Query Language, translating complex datasets into clear, business-focused insights and recommendations.
* Apply statistical and analytical techniques to identify fraud loss trends, performance drivers, root causes, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Use management information, dashboards, funnel data, complaints, contact drivers and customer feedback to support evidence-based decision-making.
* Own and assess customer journeys end to end, map pain points and conduct journey health checks to improve customer and colleague outcomes.
* Establish, monitor and interpret journey and customer-outcome measures, including Net Promoter Score, complaints, customer effort, fraud losses and operational performance.
* Investigate complex customer and fraud-related issues and translate findings into strategic and operational change initiatives.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of risk, control and governance practices, including Operational Risk and Control Assessments, issue management, Consumer Duty, control monitoring, evidence gathering and escalation.
* Exercise sound judgement on when to act, align or escalate, particularly where customer harm or regulatory risk may arise.
* Build effective relationships with stakeholders across the United Kingdom and India, including Product, Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Controls and Customer Experience teams.
* Coordinate cross-functional and cross-skilled teams to deliver sustainable journey, fraud strategy and customer-outcome improvements.
* Produce high-quality governance materials, management information, presentations and written recommendations for senior decision-makers.
* Apply structured problem-solving, strategic thinking, attention to detail and ownership to resolve complex business challenges.
* Demonstrate commercial acumen and knowledge of market trends and the competitor landscape to benchmark performance and inform priorities.
* Use artificial intelligence-enabled tools responsibly to improve analysis, insight generation, backlog quality and documentation, while retaining accountability for outcomes.
* Use Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint to at least an intermediate level.
  

  

**Desirable skillsets/ good to have:**

* Fraud and scam domain knowledge.
* SQL skills
* Experience supporting AI-enabled processes or transformation.
* Fraud and scam loss management.
* Ability to monitor and interpret loss performance, emerging fraud trends and portfolio risk indicators.
* Experience conducting root cause analysis (RCA) to identify key drivers of fraud and scam losses and define improvement actions.
* Experience supporting loss management, portfolio reviews or performance governance forums.

This role will be based out of Gurugram.

**Purpose of the role**

Product Managers are responsible for the leading the strategic focus of the product(s), defining the product vision, market strategy, and competitive analysis. They think about the product's future and how it will evolve over time. They work with various teams, including marketing, engineering, operations, and sales, to ensure everyone is aligned on the product strategy. They use data and market research to inform their decisions and prioritize product features.

**Accountabilities**

* Define Product Strategy: Accountable for defining a product strategy that aligns with business vision, managing capabilities, balancing short-term with long-term goals, ensuring that products meet market demands and drive growth.
* Cross functional alignment: Leadership of cross functional relationships, working with various cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of product strategy and goals.
* Risk and Control: Accountable for overseeing product risk management, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to mitigate those risks, and maintenance of alignment between the product management and control functions.
* Product Development Lifecycle: Own product development lifecycle, from concept to launch, ensuring efficient processes, on-time delivery, and alignment with E2E customer expectations and experience. – working with product owners to drive change objectives.
* Deliver Product Goals and Performance: Deliver clear objectives and key outcomes to steer the product vision and ensure alignment with company’s business goals, financial targets, and strategic vision, driving long-term business success.
* Data driven decisions: Monitor product performance through data-driven analysis and insights, regularly assessing progress against objectives and adjusting the strategies as needed to optimise outcomes and maximise value for both business and customer.
* Customer-Centric Focus: Drive a customer -first approach across the product vision, ensuring customer insights, feedback, behaviours, and pain points are at the core of the product strategy and decision-making process.
* Business and financial acumen: Understanding pricing models, costs structures, and ROI to make financially grounded decisions regarding product development.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Account Manager North India
description:
Looking for a challenge in one of the world’s largest airfreight logistics organisations?

At IAG Cargo we are in the business of moving things. From antibiotics to groundbreaking tech, gold bullion to avocados and everything in between. We move cargo that positively impacts society worldwide. Whatever people need, wherever they are. At IAG Cargo we open the skies and fly the world to bring people the things they really need.

We are the logistics and cargo brand of International Airlines Group (Aer Lingus, British Airways, Iberia, Level and Vueling). Powered by five airlines, our reach is truly global – but it’s the impact we make that defines us. At IAG Cargo, we believe in keeping the world’s economies turning, and do everything with determined attitudes, curious minds, collaborative actions and heartfelt pride. Join us at our globally recognised logistics business, that is Trusted to Deliver.

#### **About the role**

As a Cargo Sales Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing customer relationships in Delhi, working with both local and global clients. Your focus will be on driving sales growth by promoting digital tools like eBookings, drive Joint Business, improving the quality and profitability of cargo revenue, and ensuring that retained business remains financially strong. You’ll represent IAG Cargo in the local market, setting a high standard of service and professionalism. Using tools like Salesforce CRM, you’ll stay organized and efficient while promoting the IAG Cargo network and any future cargo partners to support business expansion.

#### **What you’ll do**

* Manage around 35 SME customer accounts, aligning their needs with our commercial strategy.
* Act as the key link between customers and internal customer service teams to deliver tailored solutions and added value.
* Promote and sell a wide range of cargo products based on customer requirements.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities to grow the customer base.
* Convert potential business into formal contractual agreements.
* Collaborate closely with the local GSSA team for daily operational decisions.
* Conduct at least 15 face-to-face customer meetings per week and log all sales activities in Salesforce CRM.
* Drive adoption of the eBooking platform to increase digital engagement.
* Prepare and present weekly and monthly commercial performance reports.
* Achieve and exceed targets for MC1 (Marginal Contribution) and tonnage.
* Build a profitable customer portfolio and improve marketing efficiency.
* Ensure timely debt recovery and manage financial follow-ups.
* Use a consultative sales approach focused on customer needs rather than just pushing products.
* Maintain a professional image of IAG Cargo within the industry.
* Comply with competition laws, business integrity policies (BASI 17), and all internal compliance standards.

#### **It's all about you**

What you’ll bring to IAG Cargo:

We’re looking for a motivated and results-oriented professional who’s passionate about logistics and sales. You’re someone who thinks strategically, works well with others, and enjoys solving problems creatively. You communicate clearly, take pride in doing things the right way, and are always open to learning and improving. You’re a true team player who’s not afraid to challenge the norm and help drive positive change in the business.

Skills and Experience:

* Have the right to live and work in India.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Confident public speaker and able to articulate and summarize complexity in a high level of numeracy
* Excellent oral and written skills in English
* Strong commercial acumen and analytical skills
* Working knowledge of tools such as Tableau, Excel and CRM - Salesforce
* Commercial experience essential
* Air cargo experience is preferred

#### **We’ll treat you right**

Wherever you work within IAG Cargo, you’ll play a part in helping us deliver what the world needs and join a diverse and inclusive business that’s making a difference.

As well as a competitive salary, bonus, we offer a range of benefits to support our colleagues, which include:

* From the day you join us, you’ll get access to brilliant staff travel benefits including unlimited basic and premium standby tickets on British Airways and group airlines. You’ll also receive up to 30 discounted ‘Hotline’ airfares per year for yourself, friends, and family.
* 15 days Bank holidays.
* All our colleagues get access to LinkedIn learning and Rosetta Stone Language courses.

**Diversity and Inclusion**

Our recruitment procedures positively support our diversity and inclusion agenda.

All candidates are considered strictly on their merits in relation to the criteria for the role, treated fairly and consistently, and have their individual needs responded to throughout the process.

title: Delivery AI Product Analyst
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

We are seeking exceptional candidates with experience and passion to fill Senior Solution Analyst Position in BCG’s new business unit, BCG X. This global business unit brings together cutting-edge AI, visionary business ventures, and unique software and products in the most strategic industry applications to deliver superior value and sustained impact. All of BCG’s core product capabilities are housed within the business unit including product management, design, development, support, and data analytics experts who work in deep collaboration with BCG practice areas, consulting teams, and clients. This team, of highly motivated and insightful colleagues, will provide an opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial environment supported by a global management consulting firm, which is the world’s leading advisor on business strategy.

A BCG Senior Solution Analyst is someone who will work with product manager and senior leadership in various business groups to help drive capabilities and support increased commercialization of BCG proprietary data and software assets. This person will work together with technical and commercial teams from the initial business case to roadmap delivery, launch, and ongoing support operations. We want someone with an entrepreneurial drive and demonstrated experience leading enterprise or large-scale product efforts across product strategy, marketing, finance, engineering, support, and executive stakeholders.

Additionally, you will work in a growing global team, providing industry & topic expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, methodologies, software solutions, analysis and expert advisory. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues This is an exciting opportunity to jump into a unique position at a world class firm.

**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

**Product Management**

* Co-own the product roadmap with the Product Manager and keep it tied to business goals and user needs
* Conduct user research and usability tests, and use the results alongside market analysis and client feedback to improve the product
* Gather and prioritize requirements in stakeholder workshops, then write them up as user stories with acceptance criteria
* Build user personas and use AI design tools to prototype and iterate with the UI/UX team
* Run Scrum ceremonies with the engineering team and clear blockers to keep features shipping on time
* Join technical discussions and translate between engineering and business stakeholders so product decisions stay feasible
* Keep feature lists, user guides and release notes current, and update stakeholders on progress and milestones

**Product Delivery**

* As a thought partner to case teams and clients, define the business problem early and shape a solution around it
* Apply BCG Transformation and Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) methodology on cases and configure the product for each client’s program
* Manage MVP-based implementation plans as the client’s day-to-day point of contact, and set realistic expectations about what the product covers today
* Lead demos and training sessions that get case teams and client users working in the product
* Triage client issues and work them through to resolution with Engineering and Support
* Convert case learnings into proprietary assets and input for the roadmap

**AI-Native ways of working**

* Set up and maintain the team’s AI harness, including a product knowledge base that captures context, personas, business rules and past decisions, plus connectors to Azure DevOps, Confluence and SharePoint
* Create a library of reusable skills, such as a story writer, BRD generator and release notes generator, and update/maintain them as the product changes
* Convert routine product owner work (backlog refinement, story writing and edge-case testing, sprint review prep, stakeholder updates) into repeatable AI workflows with defined inputs and a standard output format
* Help design agentic workflows that chain AI tools and models to automate repetitive, multi-step tasks
* Coach clients and case teams on building AI dashboards and structuring outputs data through prompts
* Test new AI tools, models and agentic techniques against client use cases and recommend which ones to adopt
* Make sure every product decision and AI-generated output has a named human owner, and protect client data under BCG’s AI usage and responsible AI guidelines

What You'll Bring

**Technco-Functional Proficiency and Collaboration**

* 2-3 years of consulting experience (preferred) or 3-4 years in industry, ideally in a business analysis or product role on a SaaS product
* Exposure to transformation, restructuring, change management or PMI, with an appetite to build depth in these topics
* Solid grasp of P&L and balance sheet KPIs plus proficiency in PowerPoint and financial modelling in Excel
* A good understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile delivery (no coding required); Tableau or Alteryx skills are an advantage
* Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot, including prompt engineering, skill building, and agentic workflow design
* Structured problem solving and analytical rigor, with the planning discipline and attention to detail to follow through on commitments
* Experience communicating with and influencing senior stakeholders across global teams, and the judgment to know when to escalate
* Entrepreneurial drive and a record of hitting stretch goals in fast-moving environments
* Comfortable working independently or in distributed teams, and quick to pick up new tools and methods.#LI-RA1

Who You'll Work With

* Client, Case, & BCG Vantage team members
* Product Engineering, Product Delivery, and Infrastructure Support team
* Helpdesk, Reporting & Data Analytics team
* Topic/Product/Case Leadership

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: PMO Analyst
description:
**Position Summary:**
The Analyst - PMO (GCC) is a critical execution-layer role within the Program Management Office, responsible for supporting end-to-end program governance, process documentation, knowledge transfer (KT) coordination, and data management across the GCC delivery lifecycle. The incumbent will act as a custodian of program master data, ensuring accuracy, traceability, and timely updates across all program repositories.
  
  
This role requires a detail-oriented professional who can translate business requirements into structured records, design SOPs and process flows, track KT milestones, and provide advanced Excel-based reporting support across multiple interlinked trackers and stakeholder files. The analyst will interface closely with vendors, project teams, functional leads, and business stakeholders to drive operational accuracy and process compliance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Master Data & Program Governance:
* Own and maintain program master files and working trackers throughout the program lifecycle.
* Ensure all records remain accurate, structured, and aligned with current business requirements.
* Perform regular data validation and quality checks across all program repositories.
* Support governance reviews and audits through accurate maintenance of program information.
* Maintain version control and change logs for master files to enable traceability.
* Requirement Intake & Management:
* Capture, validate, and enter new business requirements into relevant master files and tracking systems.
* Maintain complete and up-to-date requirement records with status, owner, and resolution details.
* Track requirement lifecycle from intake to closure and flag overdue or unresolved items.
* Support periodic reporting on requirement status for stakeholder reviews.
* Coordinate with business owners to clarify, prioritize, and close requirement backlogs.
* Vendor & Unique ID Governance:
* Allocate vendors and unique identifiers based on approved functional and sub-functional mappings.
* Maintain consistency and accuracy of vendor allocation records across all program trackers.
* Ensure traceability and governance compliance for all vendor-related mapping information.
* Support audit readiness through well-maintained vendor and ID allocation logs.
* Escalate mapping conflicts or anomalies to the PMO Lead for timely resolution.
* SOP Design & Process Documentation:
* Design and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for KT, onboarding, and operational processes.
* Translate business requirements into structured process documentation and workflow diagrams.
* Create swimlane diagrams, process flowcharts, and RACI matrices as required.
* Periodically review and update SOPs to reflect process changes or improvements.
* Maintain a centralized process documentation repository accessible to all stakeholders.
* Knowledge Transfer (KT) Coordination & Tracking:
* Review submitted KT forms and trackers to verify completeness and accuracy.
* Monitor KT schedules and completion status against agreed timelines and milestones.
* Follow up with candidates, vendors, and team leads to ensure timely KT execution.
* Escalate delays, risks, or compliance issues impacting KT progress to the PMO Lead.
* Maintain KT governance records, status dashboards, and exception reports for leadership reviews.
* Advanced Excel & Reporting Support:
* Develop and maintain complex Excel-based trackers: master files, candidate files, and vendor files.
* Troubleshoot issues across interlinked workbooks — including two candidate files and two vendor files linked to master files.
* Build and maintain XLOOKUP / INDEX-MATCH formulas, pivot tables, dynamic dashboards, and data validation rules.
* Ensure data integrity and consistency across all linked reporting files.
* Automate repetitive reporting tasks using advanced Excel features such as Power Query and macros where applicable.
* Stakeholder Reporting & Presentations:
* Prepare management-ready reports and PowerPoint presentations for governance reviews and milestone meetings.
* Convert complex tracker data into executive-level dashboards and visual summaries.
* Support weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reporting requirements for program leadership.
* Maintain presentation templates and ensure consistency of formatting across all program decks.

**Educational Qualification:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Engineering, Information Systems, Operations Management, or a related field.
* MBA or Post-Graduate Diploma in Management (preferred).

**Work Experience**

* 3–5 years of experience in PMO, Process Excellence, Shared Services, GCC, Reporting, or Program Coordination roles.
* Prior experience in a Global Capability Center (GCC) or Offshore Delivery Center environment preferred.
* Exposure to cross-functional stakeholder management and multi-vendor program environments.
* Experience in Knowledge Transfer (KT) coordination or transition management is a strong advantage.

**Functional Skills**

* Data Governance & Master Data Management
* Requirement Management & Lifecycle Tracking
* Knowledge Transfer (KT) Coordination & Tracking
* Vendor Mapping & Unique ID Governance
* SOP Development & Process Documentation
* Program Governance & Compliance Reporting
* Advanced Reporting & Analytics
* Stakeholder Communication & Escalation Management

description:

MS Solutions is an innovative online marketing agency providing integrated web marketing services to businesses worldwide. The company focuses on delivering measurable results through data-driven strategies and creative digital campaigns. Team members collaborate with diverse clients across industries, gaining exposure to various marketing challenges and solutions. MS Solutions emphasizes continuous learning, professional growth, and the use of modern tools to optimize online performance. The work environment supports initiative, accountability, and client-centric thinking.

The Sales and Marketing Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Delhi, India. title: Performance/Growth Marketing Manager
description:
**About Vihara**

Vihara is building a simpler way to buy and sell real estate. We run online auctions of bank-owned properties on behalf of banks and servicers, and connect them with investors and home buyers. We’re small, fast, and built around AI.

**The role**

You’ll own paid acquisition at Vihara. That means running our Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads end to end, from creative and copy to audiences, budgets, tracking, and landing pages. You’ll be measured on registered bidders and cost per qualified lead, not impressions.

**What you’ll do**

* Plan, launch, and scale Meta campaigns for live property auctions
* Run a constant creative testing cycle across hooks, angles, copy, and formats (static, video, Reels, carousel)
* Produce ad creative with AI tools and iterate quickly on what the data shows
* Manage budgets and bidding, and decide when to kill, hold, or scale
* Own tracking (Pixel, Conversions API, events, attribution) so every number can be trusted
* Build and test landing pages and lead forms to lift conversion
* Set up retargeting and lookalike audiences
* Help build a buyer and partner referral program
* Report weekly on what’s working, what isn’t, and what you’re testing next

**What we’re looking for**

* Hands-on experience running Meta ads for lead generation, with results you can show in numbers
* Strong creative instincts: you can write a scroll-stopping hook and recognize a winning ad
* Working knowledge of Pixel and CAPI setup, attribution, and fixing broken tracking
* A test-and-learn mindset, backed by clear thinking with data
* Sharp, concise copywriting
* Daily use of AI tools for creative, copy, and analysis
* High ownership: you find the next test without being told
* Bonus: experience in real estate, fintech, or marketplaces

**How we work**

* Fully remote
* 6 days a week, 9 hours a day
* Fast timelines, real deadlines, real ownership

**How to apply**

* **Apply at**
  https://www.vihara.ai/careers/marketing-manager. Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical assignment so we can see how you think and what you build.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Social Media & Brand Marketing Manager
  

**Infinity Marketing | Delhi, India | Full-time | On-site**

About Infinity Marketing

Infinity Marketing is a marketing and brand-building company focused on creating distinctive consumer brands for the next generation. We're looking for a creative, ambitious and strategically minded Social Media & Brand Marketing Manager to help build the digital presence of an upcoming consumer brand under our portfolio.

The Role

This is an opportunity to help build a brand's identity and social media presence from the ground up.

You'll own the brand's Instagram strategy, creative direction, content planning and execution. We're looking for someone who understands premium aesthetics, Gen Z culture, digital storytelling and how to turn social media attention into genuine consumer interest and sales.

**We don't want someone who simply manages a content calendar. We want someone who knows how to make a brand stand out.**

Key Responsibilities
  

**Brand Strategy & Creative Direction**

* Develop and execute the social media strategy for a new consumer brand.
* Establish a distinctive brand voice, visual identity and digital personality.
* Maintain consistency across all social media communication and campaigns.
* Translate brand positioning into compelling, culturally relevant content.

**Content Strategy & Execution**

* Own Instagram content planning, including Reels, Stories, carousels and campaign content.
* Develop creative concepts, strong hooks, scripts, captions and content briefs.
* Plan and coordinate shoots with designers, photographers, videographers and content creators.
* Maintain high standards of visual storytelling, creative quality and brand consistency.
* Build a structured content calendar while leaving room for timely creative opportunities.

**Gen Z Culture & Trend Research**

* Stay ahead of emerging internet culture, aesthetics, fashion, lifestyle and social media trends.
* Identify trends and formats that align with the brand rather than following every viral trend.
* Develop original content ideas that feel current, shareable and authentic.
* Understand how younger consumers discover, engage with and purchase from brands online.

**Campaigns & Product Launches**

* Develop social media campaigns for upcoming product launches, from pre-launch teasers to launch-day execution and post-launch growth.
* Build anticipation, product desirability and consumer demand through storytelling.
* Plan influencer collaborations, creator campaigns, UGC initiatives and digital activations.
* Work closely with the internal team to execute campaigns within agreed timelines.

**Growth & Performance**

* Drive relevant audience growth and improve engagement through consistent creative experimentation.
* Track reach, watch time, shares, saves, profile visits, website traffic and sales performance.
* Use analytics to identify successful formats and improve future content.
* Collaborate on creative assets for paid campaigns and performance marketing.
* Understand the relationship between brand awareness, audience engagement and conversions.

**Community & Creator Management**

* Build meaningful relationships with the brand's audience through Instagram interactions.
* Research and coordinate with relevant creators and potential collaborators.
* Identify opportunities to build a loyal, engaged community around the brand.

What We're Looking For

* A strong portfolio demonstrating creative thinking, content execution and measurable results.
* Excellent understanding of Instagram and short-form video.
* A strong eye for premium aesthetics, contemporary design and visual storytelling.
* A genuine understanding of Gen Z culture, digital behaviour and emerging trends.
* A balance of creative instinct and analytical thinking.
* Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* A proactive, hands-on mindset and the ability to take ownership from ideation to execution.

You'll Stand Out If You Have

* Experience working with lifestyle, fashion, beauty, accessories or other consumer-facing brands.
* Experience building a brand's social media presence from scratch.
* Demonstrated success with organic content, product launches or social media campaigns.
* Experience working with creators, influencers and creative production teams.
* A portfolio that demonstrates strong taste, original thinking and an understanding of what makes content effective.

What Success Looks Like

* Building a distinctive and recognisable digital brand identity.
* Consistently producing high-quality, original content.
* Growing a relevant and engaged audience.
* Increasing product discovery and driving measurable traffic and sales through social media.
* Executing successful product launches and creative campaigns.
* Establishing a repeatable, insight-led content strategy that improves over time.

What We Offer

* The opportunity to build a consumer brand from its early stages.
* Creative ownership and the freedom to experiment with ideas and formats.
* Direct collaboration with the founding team.
* The opportunity to influence brand positioning, campaigns and growth strategy.
* A fast-moving environment that values initiative, original thinking and high-quality execution.

How to Apply

Apply through LinkedIn with your CV and portfolio OR e-mail on contact@infinitymarketingindia.com

Please include:

* Links to social media accounts or brands you've managed.
* Two or three examples of content or campaigns you've worked on, ideally with performance results.
* A brief explanation of what makes you a strong fit for this role.

We're interested in what you've built, how you think and the quality of your work.

**Company:**
 Infinity Marketing

**Location:**
 Delhi, India

**Work mode:**
 On-site

* **Employment type:**
   Full-time

title: Freelance Performance Marketing Head - Edtech
description:
**Company Description**
Eduplier Education Services is a fast-growing education consultancy focused on transforming career journeys through expert academic counseling and end-to-end admission support. The organization helps students, graduates, and working professionals choose the right higher education pathways, including Online MBA, distance learning, executive programs, and industry-relevant certifications from reputed universities. As a student-first company, Eduplier offers personalized guidance, transparent counseling, and continuous support from course discovery to enrollment and beyond. The team combines deep program expertise with real-world career insights to ensure learners make clear, confident, and career-focused decisions. Eduplier is building a community of passionate education professionals who are committed to empowering learners and creating meaningful impact in their careers.

**Role Description**
The Freelance Performance Marketing Head – Edtech will lead performance marketing initiatives to drive student inquiries, applications, and enrollments across Eduplier’s program portfolio. This part-time role is hybrid, with core responsibilities based in West Delhi and flexibility for some work-from-home activities. Day-to-day tasks include planning and executing data-driven campaigns across digital channels (such as search, social, and display), optimizing marketing funnels, managing budgets, and tracking key performance metrics. The role involves collaborating closely with counseling and admissions teams to align marketing strategies with learner needs, testing creatives and messaging for different audience segments, and using analytics to improve campaign efficiency and return on ad spend. The Performance Marketing Head will also recommend new growth opportunities, refine targeting strategies, and contribute to an outcome-driven, student-focused marketing approach.

**Qualifications**

* Strong performance marketing skills, including paid search, paid social, and campaign optimization across major digital platforms.
* Experience with analytics and measurement tools (e.g., Google Analytics, ad platform dashboards) and the ability to interpret data to guide decisions.
* Proficiency in marketing strategy, funnel design, audience segmentation, and conversion rate optimization within an edtech or education context.
* Ability to develop and test ad creatives, landing pages, and messaging tailored to students, graduates, and working professionals.
* Comfort with budget management, forecasting, and reporting on key performance indicators such as leads, cost per acquisition, and ROI.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with counseling, admissions, and leadership teams.
* Proven experience in performance or growth marketing; prior work in edtech, higher education, or career counseling domains is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field; advanced certifications in digital marketing or analytics are a plus.
* Self-driven, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, impact-focused environment with part-time, freelance flexibility.

title: Channel Marketing Manager
description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
  
  
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
  
  
**The Role**
The Server Marketing Leader will own the strategy, planning, and execution of integrated marketing programs that drive awareness, customer engagement, pipeline creation, and revenue growth for the company's Data Center, AI Infrastructure, Cloud, and Server portfolio. This individual will partner closely with Sales, Product Management, OEMs, Channel Partners, ISVs, and Executive Leadership to accelerate market adoption and strengthen the company's position as a trusted technology leader.
  
  
The role requires a highly strategic marketer with strong business acumen, deep understanding of enterprise infrastructure and AI ecosystems, and a proven track record of delivering measurable business impact through demand generation, partner marketing, and thought leadership initiatives.
  
  
**The Person**
You are a passionate technology marketer with 10 years of experience in enterprise technology, data center, cloud, infrastructure, or AI-related industries. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment and possess the ability to translate complex technologies into compelling business value propositions.
  
  
You are equally comfortable engaging with CIOs and C-suite executives, collaborating with sales and product teams, and driving execution through agencies, partners, and internal stakeholders. You are data-driven, customer-centric, and have a strong bias for action while maintaining strategic focus on long-term business growth.
  
  
**You Bring**

* Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Deep understanding of enterprise IT, servers, cloud, AI, and digital transformation trends.
* Proven experience managing large-scale marketing programs and budgets.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills.
* A track record of driving pipeline, revenue influence, and measurable ROI.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to convert insights into action.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategic Marketing Leadership

+ Develop and execute the annual marketing strategy and go-to-market plan for the Server and Data Center business.
+ Align marketing initiatives with business objectives, revenue targets, and market growth priorities.
+ Identify market opportunities, customer trends, and competitive insights to shape business strategies.

Demand Generation & Revenue Marketing
  
  

* Lead integrated marketing campaigns to generate qualified pipeline and support revenue growth.
* Execute account-based marketing (ABM), digital demand generation, content marketing, and nurture programs.
* Establish and track marketing KPIs, pipeline contribution, and ROI metrics.

Ecosystem & Alliance Development
  
  

* Build relationships with ISVs, cloud providers, technology alliances, and industry associations.
* Develop joint solution-led campaigns and workload-focused GTM initiatives.
* Drive ecosystem collaboration to increase solution adoption and market reach.

Executive Engagement & Thought Leadership
  
  

* Lead flagship events, executive roundtables, industry conferences, and customer engagement programs.
* Create compelling thought leadership platforms around AI, cloud, data center modernization, and enterprise innovation.
* Engage with senior business and technology decision-makers to enhance market influence.

Product & Solution Marketing
  
  

* Develop differentiated messaging, positioning, and value propositions.
* Support new product launches and strategic announcements.
* Enable sales teams through content, training, competitive insights, and customer success stories.

Budget & Performance Management
  
  

* Own annual marketing budgets and investment planning.
* Measure marketing effectiveness using data-driven insights and reporting frameworks.
* Optimize investments based on performance and business outcomes.

Cross-functional Leadership
  
  

* Work closely with Sales, Product Management, Corporate Marketing, PR, and Regional Teams.
* Lead agencies, vendors, and marketing partners to ensure flawless execution.
* Mentor team members and foster a high-performance marketing culture.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in B2B technology marketing.
* Experience in Server, Data Center, Cloud, AI Infrastructure, Enterprise IT, Storage, Networking, or Semiconductor industries.
* Proven success in demand generation, partner marketing, product marketing, and revenue-focused marketing roles.
* Experience working with OEMs, cloud service providers, distributors, channel partners, and ISVs.
* Strong understanding of enterprise workloads including AI, virtualization, cloud, analytics, databases, and high-performance computing.
* Demonstrated experience managing multimillion-dollar marketing budgets and delivering measurable business results.
* Experience engaging with C-level executives and enterprise decision-makers.
* MBA or equivalent business qualification preferred.
* Experience leading regional or country-level marketing organizations is highly desirable.

title: Head - Social Media
description:
**Role : Head – Social Media**

**Industry Preference:**
Luxury, premium lifestyle, fashion, watches, beauty, jewellery, hospitality or premium consumer brands

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a dynamic, digitally savvy and creatively driven
**Head – Social Media**
to lead the social media strategy, content direction, community engagement and performance across Ethos and its relevant brand and lifestyle platforms.

The incumbent will build a distinctive social media presence that reflects the sophistication of luxury watchmaking while remaining contemporary, culturally relevant and commercially effective.

The role requires a strong blend of luxury brand sensibility, creative storytelling, platform expertise, audience understanding, influencer marketing and data-led decision-making. The individual will lead the social media ecosystem end-to-end, partnering closely with marketing, content production, creative, CRM, e-commerce, retail and brand partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Social Media Strategy & Brand Positioning**

* Develop and execute the overarching social media strategy aligned with Ethos’s brand positioning, marketing priorities and business objectives.
* Build differentiated social media identities for Ethos, Officially Ethos and other relevant business or lifestyle platforms.
* Translate the heritage, craftsmanship, design, innovation and exclusivity of luxury watch brands into engaging digital narratives.
* Establish platform-specific strategies for Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest and emerging social platforms, based on audience relevance.

**B. Content Strategy, Storytelling & Creative Direction**

* Lead the development of compelling social-first content, including reels, short-form videos, carousels, stories, editorial content, interviews and campaign-led assets.
* Build content pillars across horology education, brand heritage, watchmaking craftsmanship, product discovery, collectors’ stories, luxury lifestyle, gifting, styling and retail experiences.
* Drive content innovation through creator-led storytelling, original series, episodic formats and community-driven narratives.
* Ensure content meets the visual, editorial and brand guidelines of Ethos and its international brand partners.

**C. Social Media Growth & Audience Development**

* Drive sustainable growth in relevant followers, reach, engagement, video views, watch time, saves, shares and qualified audience interactions.
* Build strategies to attract affluent, aspirational and horology-oriented audiences, including younger luxury consumers and emerging collectors.
* Improve content discoverability through platform algorithms, social SEO, relevant keywords, hashtags and search-led content strategies.
* Design and run rapid, structured growth experiments (A/B tests on hooks, formats, posting cadence, creatives and CTAs), scaling what works and quickly retiring what does not.
* Build growth loops and full-funnel journeys from social to website, WhatsApp, CRM and boutique appointments, using referral mechanics, lead magnets, UGC, collabs and community-led virality, without diluting brand exclusivity.
* Optimise conversion points across bio links, landing pages, social commerce and lead forms, using UTM tracking, pixels and attribution to cut cost per qualified lead.

**D. Influencer, Creator & Brand Collaborations**

* Develop and manage an influencer and creator strategy spanning luxury, horology, fashion, lifestyle, culture and premium consumer segments.
* Build long-term creator relationships and ambassador programmes rather than relying solely on transactional collaborations.
* Establish clear measurement frameworks for creator effectiveness, content usage rights, engagement quality and commercial impact.

**E. Community Management & Consumer Engagement**

* Build a strong, engaged community of luxury watch enthusiasts, collectors, prospective buyers and existing customers.
* Partner with retail, CRM and customer experience teams to route qualified product enquiries and relevant leads to the appropriate channels.
* Monitor brand sentiment, customer conversations and emerging reputational risks.

**F. Campaign Management & Integrated Marketing**

* Lead social media strategy for new store openings, product launches, brand campaigns, festive periods, gifting occasions, luxury events and exclusive experiences.
* Partner with the marketing and performance marketing teams to integrate organic social, paid social, influencer activity and broader digital campaigns.
* Develop social-first campaigns that complement retail activations, e-commerce initiatives, CRM programmes and offline brand experiences.

**G. Social Media Analytics & Business Impact**

* Establish a robust performance measurement framework covering awareness, engagement, audience quality, consideration and conversion.
* Track and analyse platform-wise performance, content effectiveness, campaign ROI and creator contribution.
* Develop monthly and quarterly dashboards for leadership, highlighting performance, insights, key learnings and corrective actions.
* Demonstrate the contribution of social media to brand salience, website traffic, store discovery and business outcomes wherever measurable.

**H. Team Leadership & Operating Excellence**

* Build, lead and mentor a high-performing social media team comprising relevant capabilities across strategy, content, community management, influencer marketing and analytics.
* Manage external agencies, creators, production partners and specialist vendors.
* Introduce tools and processes for social listening, content scheduling, analytics, workflow management and AI-enabled content optimisation.

**Candidate Profile**

**Education**

* Graduate or postgraduate qualifications in Marketing, Mass Communication, Digital Media, Advertising or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* Experience in digital marketing, social media, content or brand communications (5–12 years), including at least 3–4 years leading social media teams.
* Proven experience building and scaling social media platforms for premium, aspirational or consumer-facing brands.
* Demonstrated expertise in Instagram-first content strategy, short-form video, creator marketing and community development.
* Proven growth-hacking track record: hypothesis-led experimentation, viral and referral loops, funnel and conversion optimisation, and examples of fast, measurable audience or lead growth achieved on lean budgets.
* Hands-on familiarity with growth and analytics tools such as Meta Business Suite, GA4, social listening and scheduling platforms, and A/B testing or attribution tools.
* Experience managing agencies, production partners, budgets and cross-functional stakeholders.

**WHO SHOULDNT APPLY**

**Note:**
Career stability is a mandatory screening criterion for this role. if you have been jumping roles every 2 years, this is not the place for you to interview

* Candidates must demonstrate a stable and consistent career trajectory, with a
  **minimum tenure of 2 years with each organisation**
  being the expected benchmark.
* Candidates with frequent job changes, repeated short tenures or a pattern of moving between organisations every few months will generally not be considered suitable.

title: Manager, Product Management
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Manager, Product Management
  
  
Manager (Commercialization), Global Product Management, Operational Intelligence Program
  
  
**Job Title**
Manager (Commercialization), Global Product Management
  
  
**Overview**
Masterard Data & Services enables customers across industries and geographies to make smarter decisions and reach better outcomes with a tailored portfolio of solutions beyond the transaction.
  
  

* We harness the power of real-time, anonymized, aggregated transaction data; powerful software platforms; and a wealth of expertise
* We empower customers to make better data-driven decisions by unlocking a holistic view of consumer behavior beyond their four walls and distilling actionable insights from data
* We work with financial institutions, retailers, telecommunications organizations, travel companies, and more

We are looking for a seasoned product manager within the Operational Insights Program Global Product Management team to play a key role in the commercialization/go-to-market strategy for its products. This person will be part of a team of product managers and drive key activities including development of the go-to-market strategy, defining the product value proposition and pricing, create sales and delivery materials and play a key role in sales and delivery enablement.
  
  
This individual will partner closely with other members of the Global Product Management technical team to ensure product strategy, roadmap and vision is aligned with the go-to-market strategy and product business priorities.
  
  
Product Managers in Data & Services at Mastercard
  
  

* Build revolutionary products that advance how businesses all over the world derive the most value from their data assets
* Translate a deep understanding of our customers into products and solutions that drive significant customer value
* Balance the long-term direction of a product with today’s needs and constraints by fully understanding the technical, competitive, and commercial contexts of our products
* Act as connectors to ensure the commercial success of our products by working with Sales and Marketing while ensuring technical success through close partnership with Technology teams
* Drive globally relevant solutions by understanding regional needs and tradeoffs, and build scalable products that serve an array of customer segments
* Set product direction with coordination, not isolation—considering how our products all work together to serve customer needs

Role
  
  

* Act as an expert, advocate, and champion for OI program products
* Lead global product management team efforts with analytically driven input into strategic business plans and product roadmaps
* Coordinate across cross-functional teams for product sales, usage, and continuous product enhancement
* Lead developing the product business strategy including customer segmentation, pricing, sales, and marketing strategy
* Play a key role in rolling out new solutions focused on new segments (e.g., Fintechs), use cases (e.g., real time alerts, crypto payments), networks (e.g., open banking, Blockchain)
* Manage the product P&L and lead the forecasting/budgeting discussions for the products
* Effectively communicate strategy and vision up and down the organization
* Prioritize development efforts as they align against business strategy

**All About You**

* Agile product management experience in analytical products and business intelligence solutions
* Strong experience with analytical solutions designed for payments or a related financial services sectors preferred
* Analytical, solutions-oriented skillset with the ability to drive thought leadership
* Strategic mind set to solve complex and ambiguous problems
* Keen understanding of competitive offerings and industry trends in the self-service analytics space, and the ability to translate that understanding into meaningful actions and enhancements
* Proven track record collaborating in cross-functional teams to deliver outstanding products and features
* Highly organized and able to deal with multiple and competing priorities
* Knowledge and skills using product management tools, (e.g., market and product plans, project timelines, marketing research, pricing, business case development)
* Bachelor’s degree in business or relevant experience
* Experience in strategy consulting or developing go-to-market strategies for products
* Experience of developing and driving end to end execution of initiatives – particularly in a cross-functional environment, managing and prioritizing competing initiatives
* Strong communication & influencing skills to work with internal and external stakeholders, with ability to clearly articulate problem statements and opportunity areas
* Strong understanding of the Mastercard products & services and key revenue drivers

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Director, Commercial Strategy // Business Services Insights
description:
Portage Point Partners is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States.
  
  
The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transitions and transformations.
  
  
Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm’s platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.
  
  
The Commercial Strategy team is responsible for optimizing the firm’s go-to-market strategy, commercial operations and business development infrastructure. The team partners closely with firm leadership and practice leaders to drive revenue growth, enhance client engagement, improve pipeline visibility and strengthen decision-making through technology, data and process optimization. By leveraging platforms such as Intapp DealCloud and related business systems, the Commercial Strategy team delivers scalable solutions that improve collaboration, increase operational efficiency and support the firm’s continued expansion.
  
  
The Director, Commercial Strategy // Business Services Insights is a credentialed industry Subject Matter Expert (SME) who owns the commercial agenda for the Business Services vertical within the firm's Commercial Enablement (CE) function. Reporting to the Head of Commercial Enablement, this leader is the firm's sector SME and the source of market insight that equips MDs, Practice Line Leaders (PLLs) and Account Teams to drive origination in the sector.
  
  
The role owns the vertical's commercial point of view (POV) – the market updates, sector analysis and origination-focused thought leadership that position the firm with prospects and clients – working closely with PLLs, MDs, Account Teams and Marketing to translate that insight into firm-facing content and external presence.
  
  
Success is measured by the firm's positioning in the Business Services sector, the quality and timeliness of the vertical's commercial intelligence, its presence in firm marketing and external content, and the degree to which market-facing teams treat the vertical as the firm's authoritative source for sector insight.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the commercial agenda for the Business Services vertical, serving as the firm’s sector SME
* Partner with senior team members across the firm to drive recurring deliverables, including sector POVs, quarterly outlooks, market maps, origination theses, account whitespace analysis, MD briefing packs and pitch / proposal support
* Equip MDs, PLLs and Account Teams with the sector context and briefings needed to pursue whitespace and cross-sell opportunities ahead of priority meetings and pursuits
* Monitor industry trends, market signals and competitive dynamics specific to the Business Services sector and translate them into actionable commercial direction
* Support business development efforts with sector-specific positioning, insight and supporting analysis
* Provide the expertise to maintain a credible external presence in the Business Services sector by developing materials and content to be used for bylined content, conference participation and other public-facing channels
* Partner with Marketing to align vertical content, campaigns and external presence with firm go-to-market strategy and thought leadership
* Coordinate with peer industry vertical leaders to maintain a consistent commercial POV format and cadence across the CE function
* Partner with the VP, Account and VP, Pipeline to ensure sector insight is reflected in account plans and pursuit strategy
* Share and manage best practices as well as lead internal trainings where required
* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
* Contribute to creating a high-performing and inclusive culture

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree from a top undergraduate program required
* Willing to relocate to or be primarily present in Gurgaon
* 10 plus years in the Business Services sector, in commercial strategy, business development, consulting, investment banking or an industry-facing advisory role
* Recognized subject matter expertise in Business Services, with a credible origination, investment banking or advisory track record in that sector
* Demonstrated track record of producing credible, market-facing commercial content for an external audience
* Experience operating within professional services, consulting, investment banking or private equity environments
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and a process- and ownership-oriented mindset
* Strong project management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
* Experience within the middle market private equity and advisory ecosystem, preferably serving U.S. clients
* Familiarity with Intapp DealCloud, HubSpot or equivalent commercial platforms preferred
* Experience producing thought leadership or market commentary published in industry-recognized channels preferred
* Superior written and verbal communication, including executive-ready presentation and reporting, with the ability to influence stakeholder and work effectively across technical and non-technical teams
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high-pressure, client-facing environments
