By leveraging platforms such as Intapp DealCloud and related business systems, the Commercial Strategy team delivers scalable solutions that improve collaboration, increase operational efficiency and support the firm’s continued expansion.
  
  
The Director, Commercial Strategy // Consumer Insights is a credentialed industry Subject Matter Expert (SME) who owns the commercial agenda for the Consumer vertical within the firm's Commercial Enablement (CE) function. Reporting to the Head of Commercial Enablement, this leader is the firm's sector SME and the source of market insight that equips MDs, Practice Line Leaders (PLLs) and Account Teams to drive origination in the sector.
  
  
The role owns the vertical's commercial point of view (POV) – the market updates, sector analysis and origination-focused thought leadership that position the firm with prospects and clients – working closely with PLLs, MDs, Account Teams and Marketing to translate that insight into firm-facing content and external presence.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate with peer industry vertical leaders to maintain a consistent commercial POV format and cadence across the CE function

* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts

* Bachelor's degree from a top undergraduate program required
* Willing to relocate to or be primarily present in Gurgaon

* Recognized subject matter expertise in Consumer, with a credible origination, investment banking or advisory track record in that sector
* Demonstrated track record of producing credible, market-facing commercial content for an external audience

title: Senior Manager/Director - Product, Survey CoE, PEG Alpha
description:
**About us**

Bain & Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

 

**Who you will work with**

BCN Private Equity Group CoE at Bain & Company provides specialized support to global teams across the private equity value chain, enabling clients to make key investment decisions. Our expertise lies in addressing critical diligence questions through a range of products such as survey analytics, digital diagnostic, workforce analytics and disruption assessment. Our teams work in a fast-paced environment delivering consistent and impactful results at scale. In the last decade, we have witnessed an exponential growth, reaching >250 members today from ~10 members in 2013. We operate from 3 locations – 2 in India and 1 in Poland, and operate across all 3 regions (EMEA, Americas and APAC). BCN PEG provides an opportunity to solve challenging business problems in a dynamic set-up working closely with global Bain teams, acting as a thought-partner with daily deliverables.

**What you’ll do**

**Set product vision & strategy**

 — Define and evolve a clear product vision grounded in user needs and Survey CoE priorities; identify where AI, automation, and new technology can most meaningfully improve the survey workflow; ensure products evolve as a coherent portfolio with defined success measures.

* **Own the roadmap & priorities**
  — Continuously prioritize initiatives across products balancing user value, strategic fit, technical feasibility, and capacity; make clear trade-offs and communicate rationale to stakeholders; partner with the Engineering Lead on constraints and dependencies.
* **Lead product discovery**
  — Build strong feedback loops with Survey CoE leadership and practitioners; structure ambiguous problems, develop hypotheses, and validate ideas through user research, product data, and prototypes before committing engineering capacity.
* **Turn strategy into execution**
  — Translate roadmap priorities into clear direction for Product Owners; review requirements for major initiatives; maintain delivery visibility and proactively address risks; ensure released capabilities solve the intended problem.
* **Drive adoption & performance**
  — Own overall portfolio success; define meaningful adoption and impact metrics; identify and address barriers to adoption; establish a continuous improvement cycle fed by user insights.
* **Shape AI-enabled experiences**
  — Identify where GenAI, agentic workflows, and automation create genuine value in the survey workflow; partner with Data/AI specialists to translate capabilities into reliable product experiences; define expected behaviors, success measures, and evaluation mechanisms for AI-powered features.
* **Lead across the product team**
  — Act as primary product counterpart to Survey CoE stakeholders; coach and develop Product Owners; establish consistent PM practices across squads; communicate direction and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership.

**About You**

An experienced product manager with strong user orientation, structured problem-solving, and sound commercial and technical judgment. Comfortable owning ambiguous problems, setting team direction, and operating at both the strategic and execution level simultaneously. Credible working with engineers and technical specialists on feasibility and trade-offs.

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Design, or a related field
* 8–10+ years of relevant experience with significant time in product management or digital product delivery
* Demonstrated ownership of software/digital product roadmaps from problem identification through launch and iteration
* Experience managing multiple products or complex multi-module products strongly preferred
* Background in consulting, enterprise tech, SaaS, or fast-paced environments; experience with analytics, research, or survey products a plus

**Key Skills**

* Full product lifecycle ownership — discovery, prioritization, delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement
* Strong Agile/Scrum and Lean product-development practices; experience with Jira/Azure DevOps, Confluence
* Data-driven PM skills — KPI definition, usage/adoption analysis, experiment design; SQL or BI tool familiarity a plus
* Technical fluency across web applications, APIs, databases, cloud architectures, and SDLCs
* Strong understanding of AI/LLM product patterns — RAG, copilots, agentic workflows, human-in-the-loop design, responsible AI
* Familiarity with AI-powered development tools (Synthetic Users, V0, Lovable or equivalent)
* Working knowledge of Figma or similar prototyping tools
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint proficiency for senior stakeholder communication

**Leadership**

* Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional influence skills
* Strong written and verbal English communication with senior and non-technical audiences
* Experience coaching Product Owners or APMs; high ownership and comfort with ambiguity
* Ability to collaborate across functions, seniority levels, and geographies in a fast-paced environment

title: Content Manager
description:
**About The Opportunity**
**Role:**
Content
  
  
**Level:**
Manager
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Director - Content
  
  
**Location:**
Gurugram
  
  
**About The Function**
With a deep understanding of Indian consumers' travel preferences, the MMT Holidays team curates a wide array of holiday packages for destinations across the globe.
  
  
As a leading name in the leisure travel space, MMT Holidays serves over 3 lakh travelers annually. Our offerings span both domestic and international markets, covering more than 50 destinations worldwide. With a strong focus on delivering seamless and memorable travel experiences, we have become a trusted choice for holiday packages among Indian travelers.
  
  
**About The Role**
MakeMyTrip’s Holidays & Experiences Content team is looking for a content lead who can turn content from a communication function into a growth and conversion lever. The role will lead content strategy across Holiday Packages, Tours & Attractions and Cruises – categories where customers need not just inspiration, but the right information, context and confidence to make a purchase decision.
  
  
The incumbent will combine strong people leadership, customer understanding, content craft, AI-led scale and an instinct for emerging trends to build content that helps customers discover, decide and ultimately book. This is a role for someone who can think strategically, build and motivate a high-performing team, challenge the status quo and get things done
  
  
**What Will You Be Doing**

* Define and drive the overall content strategy for Holiday Packages, Tours & Attractions and Cruise.
* Identify customer needs, content gaps and opportunities across these businesses, and initiate new projects based on customer insights, market trends and industry benchmarks.
* Lead a team of writers, editors and analysts to develop accurate, persuasive and user-centric content across the app, website, post-sales communication and other customer touchpoints.
* Manage content production and end-to-end project execution, ensuring high quality, timely delivery and adherence to content guidelines across team members, agencies and third-party stakeholders.
* Translate complex travel products, inclusions, itineraries and experiences into clear, engaging and customer-friendly content across short and long-form formats
* Partner with key stakeholders including Category, Product, SEO, Marketing and Business Development to deliver content requirements and support business priorities.
* Ensure consistency across content in terms of style, format, tone, imagery and videos , while maintaining factual accuracy and alignment with MakeMyTrip's brand communication principles.
* Apply industry best practices, competitive benchmarking and customer insights to identify ideas that improve content strategy, customer experience and funnel efficacy.
* Monitor and analyse content performance indicators and customer signals to identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Explore and implement AI-led tools and workflows to improve content quality, productivity, scalability and operational efficiency

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Master's degree in English, Mass Communication, Journalism or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience in content, editorial, brand, digital or related roles, with significant experience in customer-facing content and 3+ years of experience managing and developing teams.
* Strong understanding of content strategy, brand communication, customer journeys and digital experiences.
* Demonstrated ability to connect content with business metrics, customer behaviour and conversion.
* Strong writing, editing, storytelling and communication skills.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, SEO, Analytics and Business teams.
* Strong working knowledge of AI tools and emerging content technologies, with a demonstrated curiosity to experiment, build and scale.
* Experience in travel, e-commerce, hospitality, consumer internet or lifestyle brands is preferred.
* Comfortable working with CMS platforms, content workflows, analytics and productivity tools.

**Key Success Factors For The Role**

* Content that moves the funnel: Measurable impact on discovery, engagement, decision-making and conversion.
* A stronger content engine: Better quality, greater speed and significantly more scale through technology and AI.
* A high-performing team: Strong ownership, capability, collaboration and talent development.
* A differentiated content experience: Content that gives MMT customers a genuine advantage in discovering and choosing travel.
* A future-ready function: Consistently experimenting with new formats, technologies, trends and ways of working.

title: Account Director, Digital Natives
description:

In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. * Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects

* Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies
* Working directly with c-level executives
* Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders
* Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence

* Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor.

title: ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist
description:
**Company Description**

Shree Rakhi is India’s largest manufacturer of Rakhis, dedicated year-round to supporting the festival of Raksha Bandhan. With over 70 years of experience, the company has been a consistent part of this cultural tradition, focusing on quality, variety, and wide accessibility. Shree Rakhi is recognized as India’s only Rakhi brand with reach across villages, towns, and cities nationwide. The organization combines heritage with modern operations, offering opportunities to contribute to a well-established, fast-moving consumer goods business.

**What We’re Looking For**

 

We are looking for an ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist with 4–6 years of relevant experience to bridge the gap between our business operations and the technical development team. We are specifically looking for someone with a deep background in the
**manufacturing industry (especially high-volume manufacturing)**

who can analyze our shop-floor processes, design robust workflows, and translate those needs into clear, actionable Product Requirement Documents (PRDs).

This is a full-time leadership position for a strategic thinker who understands how a manufacturing business runs and knows how to map those operations flawlessly into ERPNext.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Business Analysis & PRD Creation:**

  Deeply understand our high-volume manufacturing operations, gather requirements from stakeholders, and write detailed, comprehensive Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for the development team to execute.
* **Workflow & SOP Management:**

  Design, map, and optimize end-to-end business workflows. Develop, document, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across all departments (production, inventory, procurement, etc.) to ensure seamless ERP adoption.
* **Functional Solution Design:**

  Act as the architect for how ERPNext modules should be structured to solve our specific business challenges, ensuring standard out-of-the-box features are utilized effectively before requesting custom development.
* **Developer Liaison & Technical Product Management:**

  Act as the core bridge between the business stakeholders and the software developers. Prioritize the development backlog, explain business logic to coders, and guide the technical team on
  *what*

  needs to be built and
  *why*

  .
* **Testing & Quality Assurance:**

  Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that the modules developed by the technical team perfectly match the PRDs and business requirements.
* **ERPNext Configuration:**

  Handle the functional configuration and master data setup within ERPNext (e.g., BOMs, Workstations, Routing, Item Groups, Chart of Accounts).
* **User Training & Support:**

  Create training materials and provide hands-on guidance to shop-floor staff and management on how to follow the newly established ERP workflows and SOPs.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**

  Coordinate seamlessly with production, supply chain, and management teams to ensure the ERP system accurately reflects real-world manufacturing constraints and goals.

**Candidate Requirements**

* **Experience:**

  4–6 years of relevant experience in ERPNext functional consulting, business analysis, or technical product management.
* **Industry Knowledge:**

  Proven, extensive background in the
  **manufacturing industry**

  , with specific experience handling the complexities of
  **high-volume manufacturing**

  (production planning, inventory bottlenecks, supply chain logistics).
* **Product Management Skills:**

  Exceptional ability to write clear, structured PRDs, Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), and user stories.
* **Functional Expertise:**

  Deep understanding of standard ERPNext modules (Manufacturing, Buying, Selling, Stock, Accounting) and how they interact with one another.
* **Process Mapping:**

  Strong capability in designing business workflows, process flowcharts, and implementing SOPs.
* **Analytical Skills:**

  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to foresee business edge-cases and incorporate them into system designs.
* **Soft Skills:**

  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Must be able to speak the language of both business operators and technical developers.
* **Execution-Oriented:**

  A hands-on, structured approach to managing product timelines and ensuring development matches business goals.

**Added Advantage (Nice to Have)**

* **AI for Productivity & Coding:**

  Ability to use AI coding assistants (such as
  **Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools**

  ) to generate code snippets, prototype modules, or accelerate the development team's execution is a major plus.

**What We Value**

﻿
We value people who build trust through integrity, earn loyalty through consistency, and take ownership with a bias for action. Someone who is curious, patient, adaptable, and eager to learn, works as a team player, uses technology intelligently, and has the stability and genuine intent to grow with the organization.

title: Food Technologist
description:
**Company Description**
Spoonfool is a cereal-focused food company committed to making high-quality, great-tasting breakfast products. The team combines food science, sensory expertise, and careful ingredient selection to deliver cereals that meet modern consumer expectations for flavor, texture, and consistency. The company emphasizes innovation in recipes and production methods to continuously improve its product range. Spoonfool offers an environment where food professionals can contribute to product development that reaches a broad consumer base. Team members collaborate closely across functions to turn cereal concepts into reliable products on store shelves.
  
**Role Description**
The Food Technologist at Spoonfool will support the development, testing, and improvement of cereal products from concept to scale-up. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting sensory evaluations, performing laboratory analyses, and collaborating with R&D to optimize formulations and processing conditions. The role involves monitoring quality control parameters, documenting test results, and ensuring that products meet safety and regulatory standards. The Food Technologist will work closely with production teams to troubleshoot issues, validate process changes, and help maintain consistent product quality. This is a contract position and a hybrid role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area, with regular on-site work at facilities and some work-from-home flexibility for documentation, data analysis, and planning tasks.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Food Technology and cereal product development.
* Hands-on Laboratory Skills, including sample preparation, analytical testing, and data recording.
* Experience with Sensory Evaluation methods and panel coordination.
* Knowledge of Quality Control processes for food manufacturing and familiarity with safety and regulatory standards.
* Background in Research and Development (R&D), including formulation trials and process optimization.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Food Technology, Food Science, or a related discipline.
* Ability to work effectively in a hybrid setup within the Kolkata metropolitan area, including time on the production floor.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accurate documentation.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for cross-functional work with R&D, quality, and production teams.
* Experience in cereal or grain-based products is an advantage.

title: SEO Executive
description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

* Perform keyword research and identify high-intent keywords for software development and B2B services.
* Optimize website pages, title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, images, and internal links.
* Implement on-page, off-page, and technical SEO strategies.
* Improve organic rankings, website traffic, and search visibility.
* Conduct competitor analysis and identify new keyword opportunities.

2. Technical SEO

* Conduct regular website SEO audits and identify technical issues.
* Monitor indexing, crawling, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, and redirects.
* Improve website performance, Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, and site structure.
* Implement and validate structured data and schema markup.
* Coordinate with developers to resolve technical SEO issues.

3. Content SEO

* Develop SEO-friendly content plans for service pages, blogs, landing pages, and case studies.
* Work with content writers and designers to create optimized website content.
* Identify content gaps and opportunities to improve existing pages.
* Ensure content meets search intent and supports business objectives.

4. AEO and GEO Optimization

* Optimize content to answer user questions and improve eligibility for featured snippets and answer-based search results.
* Improve brand visibility and discoverability across AI-powered search platforms.
* Create FAQ content, comparison pages, informative articles, and authoritative service content.
* Monitor brand mentions and available referral or visibility data from AI-driven platforms.

5. Off-Page SEO and Link Building

* Build high-quality, relevant backlinks through ethical SEO practices.
* Identify industry directories, business listings, guest-posting opportunities, and relevant partnerships.
* Monitor backlink quality and online brand reputation.

6. B2B Lead Generation

* Optimize service pages and landing pages to attract potential business clients.
* Identify keywords related to software development, web applications, mobile applications, and other company services.
* Improve website conversion opportunities through effective calls to action.
* Collaborate with the digital marketing team on content marketing and LinkedIn visibility.
* Align SEO activities with qualified inquiries and business growth.

7. Analytics and Reporting

* Monitor website performance using Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and relevant SEO tools.
* Track keyword visibility, organic traffic, indexed pages, conversions, and leads.
* Prepare weekly progress updates and monthly SEO reports.
* Maintain an SEO action plan with task owners, priorities, deadlines, and completion status.
* Recommend improvements based on data and measurable results.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Knowledge of on-page, off-page, and technical SEO.
* Practical understanding of keyword research and competitor analysis.
* Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4.
* Familiarity with Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or similar tools.
* Understanding of WordPress or other content management systems.
* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and schema markup.
* Good writing, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Understanding of AEO and GEO is preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Improvement in organic search visibility and relevant keyword rankings.
* Growth in qualified organic website traffic.
* Technical SEO issues identified and resolved.
* Growth in relevant, quality backlinks and referring domains.
* SEO content published and existing pages optimized.
* Improvement in qualified inquiries and organic lead conversions.
* Increased brand visibility across search engines and AI-powered platforms.
* Timely completion of assigned tasks and monthly reports.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of SEO activities, works independently, follows ethical SEO practices, and understands that SEO is not just about rankings. It is also about generating relevant traffic and business opportunities.

How to Apply

Please share your resume, relevant SEO project experience, and examples of websites you have worked on, along with measurable results where available.

Join Altron Technologies and help us build stronger organic visibility, brand authority, and sustainable B2B growth.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹31,000.00 per month

title: Head of ERP Product Design & Functional Architecture
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**A. ERP Product Strategy & Functional Design**

* Own the functional design and product experience of complex ERP systems and interconnected enterprise applications.
* Translate business objectives, customer requirements, and operational challenges into scalable ERP functionality.
* Define product modules, features, user journeys, business rules, workflows, and system behavior.
* Ensure all modules work together as one cohesive product rather than disconnected features.
* Identify functional gaps, redundant processes, and inefficiencies; propose simplifications.
* Challenge unclear, conflicting, or unnecessary requirements and propose better solutions.
* Balance business value, customer needs, usability, technical feasibility, scalability, and timelines in design decisions.
* Maintain consistency in business logic, terminology, functionality, and user experience across the platform.

**B. ERP Functional Architecture & Cross-Module Integration**

* Design and structure multi-module ERP platforms covering departments, user roles, business processes, and workflows.
* Translate finance, accounting, procurement, sales, inventory, HR, project management, operations, and customer management processes into software functionality.
* Define module relationships and dependencies, including shared entities, data dependencies, transaction flows, approvals, permissions, and business rules.
* Define master data relationships, transaction lifecycles, status transitions, validations, and cross-module interactions.
* Ensure transactions in one module trigger the appropriate updates, actions, and workflows in other modules.
* Account for multi-company structures, multiple branches, role-based permissions, configurable business rules, and audit requirements.
* Identify architectural and functional gaps before they become development or implementation problems.
* Collaborate with Engineering and Solution Architecture to ensure designs are feasible, scalable, and maintainable.

**C. End-to-End Workflow & Business Process Design**

* Analyze existing business processes and design optimized future-state workflows.
* Create workflows covering user actions, system responses, business rules, decision points, approvals, validations, and outcomes.
* Design approval hierarchies, notifications, escalations, task assignments, automated actions, and exception handling.
* Map process ownership and handoffs between departments, users, modules, and external systems.
* Define alternate flows, failure scenarios, reversals, cancellations, retries, and exceptional conditions.
* Produce process diagrams, flowcharts, swimlane, state-transition, and sequence diagrams where appropriate.
* Ensure workflows are logically complete, operationally practical, and minimize manual work, duplication, and bottlenecks.

**D. API Requirements & System Integrations**

* Define functional API requirements and integration specifications in collaboration with Engineering.
* Define API operations, request/response structures, input requirements, business validations, and expected outcomes.
* Document integration triggers, data mappings, dependencies, authentication requirements, and error-handling expectations.
* Define expected behavior for failed requests, duplicate transactions, missing data, timeouts, retries, and synchronization issues.
* Map data and information flows between internal modules and third-party platforms.
* Assess integration feasibility, dependencies, security implications, and implementation complexity with Engineering.
* Review API and integration documentation for alignment with approved functional requirements. (Direct backend coding is not mandatory.)

**E. UI/UX Design Leadership**

* Lead UI/UX Designers responsible for ERP interfaces, user journeys, interaction design, and visual consistency.
* Guide information architecture, navigation, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.
* Establish reusable design systems, components, patterns, and product-wide UX standards.
* Review and approve designs before engineering handoff.
* Ensure designs cover all interface states: loading, empty, success, error, validation, access restrictions, and exceptions.
* Balance usability with the data density and operational complexity typical of ERP applications.
* Encourage user research, usability testing, and customer feedback; measure design quality by functional effectiveness and usability.

**F. Business Analysis & Requirements Management**

* Lead the BA function and set standards for requirements gathering, analysis, and specification.
* Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria, and business rules.
* Ensure requirements cover normal flows, alternate scenarios, exceptions, dependencies, permissions, and edge cases.
* Identify contradictions, ambiguities, missing requirements, and scope gaps before development begins.
* Maintain traceability between business objectives, requirements, workflows, designs, API specifications, and test scenarios.
* Review and approve functional specifications before development handoff.

**G. Technical Documentation & Product Specifications**

* Lead the Technical Documentation Writer and set documentation standards.
* Ensure preparation and maintenance of PRDs, functional specifications, API specifications, process documentation, and user guides.
* Maintain a single source of truth for approved product functionality and functional decisions.
* Ensure consistency between requirements, process diagrams, interface designs, API specifications, and implementation details.
* Review and approve documentation before sharing with Engineering, QA, Implementation, Support, or clients.
* Keep documentation current as product functionality evolves.

**H. Client Communication & Requirements Discovery**

* Act as a primary product-facing contact for clients on business requirements, ERP functionality, workflows, and functional design.
* Lead client meetings, requirements-gathering sessions, discovery workshops, and design walkthroughs.
* Ask structured questions to identify the actual business problem behind each requested feature.
* Demonstrate workflows, wireframes, prototypes, or functional concepts to clients.
* Professionally challenge unclear, conflicting, or unnecessarily complex client requests.
* Manage client expectations on functionality, dependencies, limitations, timelines, and scope.
* Maintain records of meeting outcomes, approved requirements, functional decisions, open questions, and change requests.
* Obtain appropriate approvals and manage clarifications through development handoff.

**I. Core Product vs. Client-Specific Customization Decisions**

* Evaluate every client requirement and classify it as core product, configurable, integration-based, client-specific customization, deferred, or rejected (see Section 5).
* Assess business value, strategic alignment, relevance to the broader customer base, effort, feasibility, scalability, maintenance cost, and commercial implications.
* Identify recurring client requirements that could become reusable features.
* Assess the impact of changes on existing modules, business rules, data structures, APIs, workflows, permissions, reporting, and other customers.
* Establish clear boundaries between standard product functionality and client-specific deliverables.
* Document the rationale for major decisions and communicate outcomes to clients and internal teams.
* Ensure customizations do not compromise maintainability, scalability, upgradeability, or consistency of the core product.

**J. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Define clear roles, responsibilities, deliverables, quality standards, and performance expectations for the team.
* Allocate work based on business priorities, dependencies, complexity, and capacity.
* Establish a structured process from client discovery through requirements, functional design, UI/UX, documentation, handoff, and validation.
* Review deliverables across disciplines for consistency between workflows, specifications, designs, and documentation.
* Resolve functional disagreements, remove blockers, and make timely decisions.
* Coach team members and build a culture of accountability, analytical thinking, and end-to-end ownership.
* Coordinate with Product Management, Engineering, QA, Implementation, Sales, and business stakeholders.

**K. Decision-Making & Problem-Solving**

* Take ownership of product design and functional decisions without requiring constant senior management intervention.
* Break down complex, ambiguous business problems into structured, actionable solutions.
* Evaluate alternatives on business impact, customer value, feasibility, risk, complexity, and maintainability.
* Resolve conflicts between modules, workflows, stakeholders, and business rules.
* Identify risks early and recommend corrective actions.
* Escalate strategic, contractual, financial, or high-impact decisions outside the role’s authority.

**Experience Required:**

7–10+ years in ERP / enterprise software product design, functional architecture, or business systems analysis; minimum 2–3 years leading multidisciplinary teams or owning significant product design initiatives

Pay: ₹150,000.00 - ₹200,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Sales Executive
company: JEE TOURS AND TRAVELS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
description:
**What You’ll Be Doing**

You’ll be one of the first people our travellers speak to — and your job is to make that conversation count.

You will:

* Speak with prospective travellers and understand what they are really looking for
* Ask thoughtful questions about their interests, preferences, travel style and expectations
* Help them discover Nordic experiences they may not have considered
* Work with our travel planning team to shape recommendations around the traveller
* Present itineraries and explain why particular experiences have been chosen for them
* Guide travellers through questions, concerns and decisions
* Follow up through calls, WhatsApp and email in a warm and professional way
* Build trust and convert conversations into confirmed bookings
* Stay updated on Nordic destinations, stays, experiences and travel possibilities

**You’ll Probably Love This Role if**

* You genuinely enjoy speaking with new people
* You are naturally curious and like understanding what people really want
* Travel excites you
* You enjoy recommending experiences and helping people make decisions
* You communicate warmly, confidently and clearly
* You are comfortable following up and staying connected with prospects
* You enjoy the challenge of turning a great conversation into a booking
* You notice details and understand that small things can make a big difference
* You like learning constantly
* You take ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do next

**This Role Is Not About Selling Standard Packages**

You will not simply send an itinerary and wait for a response.

The role is about understanding the traveller well enough to make the conversation, recommendation and follow-up feel personal.

We want people to feel:

**“They understood what I was looking for.”**

That is what makes the sale happen.

**What We’re Looking For**

Experience in travel, hospitality, luxury, customer service, relationship sales or another people-facing role is useful — but the right mindset matters just as much.

You should have:

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Good listening and questioning skills
* A genuine interest in travel
* Confidence speaking with customers on calls
* Comfort using WhatsApp and email professionally
* Strong follow-up discipline
* The ability to guide and influence decisions without being pushy
* Comfort working towards sales and conversion targets
* Attention to detail
* A willingness to learn the Nordic region deeply
* A strong sense of ownership

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role is not just about how many calls you make.

It means:

* Travellers enjoy speaking with you
* You understand what matters to them
* Your recommendations feel relevant and personal
* Your follow-ups feel helpful, not transactional
* Travellers trust you
* More conversations turn into confirmed journeys

And most importantly:

**Travellers choose JeeTravels because they feel their holiday is being built around them.Why You May Enjoy Working Here**

If you love travel, this role gives you the opportunity to be immersed in it every day.

You’ll learn about incredible Nordic destinations, discover beautiful stays and unique experiences, speak with different kinds of travellers and build strong consultative sales skills along the way.

* Every conversation is different.
* Every traveller is different.
* And every booking starts with understanding the person behind the trip.

**Think This Sounds Like You?**

Don’t just send us your CV.

Tell us:

**Someone says, “I want to travel to the Nordics, but I don’t know what kind of trip I want.” What would you want to know about them before suggesting anything?**

Your answer may tell us more about whether you’re right for this role than your CV will.

* Experience mentoring, coaching, or formally managing junior partner development managers or account teams.
* Ability to pitch to, negotiate with, and influence C-suite executives externally and senior VPs internally.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Equipped with your business acumen and extensive product knowledge, you are right on the front line of interacting with our partners, and helping them find ways to grow using Google's newest product offerings. Your knowledge of relevant verticals and relationships with key industry players will help shape our great applications and content for products such as YouTube, Google TV and Commerce.

As the Lead for RCS for Business Partnerships, you will be the strategic architect for the next generation of mobile conversational commerce. Google is transforming consumer-to-business interaction through Rich Communication Services (RCS) across both Android and iOS devices. You will be responsible for defining the growth trajectory, commercial frameworks, and ecosystem strategy to make RCS the leading business-to-consumer messaging channel.  
  
In this role, you will navigate a consolidated communications and conversational AI ecosystem. You will lead engagements with the executive leadership spanning AI-native botbuilders and CSPs, Martechs, Communications Platform as a Service (CPaaS) providers, messaging aggregators, and enterprise brands. You will architect the commercial and policy environments required to scale the business ecosystem sustainably. You will act as a critical bridge between local market realities and global product and business leadership.

The Global Partnerships organization is responsible for exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Google’s Global Partnerships team works with a wide range of partners to bring the best of Google to power their business. The Global Partnerships team supports Google’s own Product teams with essential partnerships to help Google’s user experiences in advertising, Search, Assistant, Maps, Travel, Shopping, Payments and more. Teams create product-enabling partnerships, go-to-market strategies and incubate business growth for a variety of products.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own business health, revenue enablement strategy, and adoption metrics for RCS for Business. Formulate and execute the multi-year partner roadmap.
* Drive alignment across competing market players to build a frictionless RCS ecosystem. Accelerate enterprise brand adoption by partnering with companies to launch flagship, industry-first conversational commerce experiences with leading brands.
* Serve as a strategic advisor to global Product and Engineering leadership, translating local market regulatory nuances, technical hurdles, and partner dynamics into high-priority product requirements.
* Represent Google as the preeminent thought leader for RCS and business messaging at major European industry events, regulatory discussions, and executive roundtables.
* Mentor and strategically guide local and regional partner managers. Establish best practices, repeatable commercial frameworks, and negotiation playbooks for the broader India partnerships team.

**Req ID:** 388591
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Sales Lead Generation Analyst to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
**Role Overview:**  
We are looking for a highly driven and commercially oriented Inside Sales professional to accelerate pipeline growth across strategic industry verticals. This role will be responsible for planning and executing targeted sales campaigns, identifying and qualifying opportunities, engaging senior decision-makers, and generating qualified pipeline for the sales organization.
  
  
Working closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Business Unit Leaders, and Account Teams, the individual will play a pivotal role in driving demand generation initiatives that contribute directly to revenue growth.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Pipeline Generation
  
  

* Develop and execute strategic outbound sales campaigns aligned with business priorities.
* Generate qualified sales opportunities and build a healthy pipeline through proactive prospecting.
* Identify, engage, and nurture C-level executives and key decision-makers across target accounts.
* Qualify leads using defined sales qualification frameworks before handing them over to sales teams.

Sales Campaign Management
  
  

* Design and execute account-based and industry-focused outreach campaigns.
* Partner with marketing to leverage campaigns, events, webinars, thought leadership, and digital programs for lead generation.
* Build personalized outreach strategies using email, LinkedIn, phone, and other digital channels.
* Continuously optimize campaign performance based on insights and analytics.

Sales Collaboration
  
  

* Work closely with Sales Leaders and Account Directors to understand growth priorities and whitespace opportunities.
* Participate in account planning sessions and identify expansion opportunities within existing and new logos.
* Support strategic pursuits by coordinating follow-up activities and stakeholder engagement.

Opportunity Management
  
  

* Maintain accurate opportunity and pipeline data in CRM.
* Track campaign performance, conversion rates, and sales funnel metrics.
* Prepare regular reports and dashboards highlighting pipeline contribution and campaign effectiveness.
* Ensure timely follow-up on marketing-qualified leads (MQLs) and sales-qualified leads (SQLs).

Market Intelligence
  
  

* Conduct account and industry research to identify buying signals, market trends, and competitive insights.
* Build targeted prospect lists aligned to priority industries and growth accounts.
* Stay informed about client priorities, industry challenges, and emerging technology trends.

Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related discipline.
* 5–10 years of experience in Inside Sales, Business Development, Demand Generation, or Lead Generation in a B2B services environment.
* Experience supporting global markets, particularly North America and Europe, is preferred.
* Prior experience in IT Services, Digital Transformation, Consulting, BPM, or Technology Services is highly desirable.

Skills Competencies
  
  

* Strong prospecting and consultative selling skills.
* Demonstrated ability to generate qualified pipeline and influence revenue growth.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience engaging senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of account-based marketing (ABM) and strategic sales campaigns.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce, Dynamics, HubSpot, etc.) and sales engagement tools.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret campaign and pipeline metrics.
* Highly collaborative with strong stakeholder management skills.
* Self-motivated, resilient, and results-oriented.

Success Measures
  
  

* Qualified pipeline generated.
* Sales-qualified opportunities created.
* Opportunity-to-win conversion support.
* Campaign response and conversion rates.
* Speed of lead qualification and follow-up.
* Contribution to business growth and revenue targets.
* Accuracy and hygiene of CRM and pipeline reporting

About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.
  
  
NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us. This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. **Job title: Assistant Sales Manager**

Ingersoll Rand is a Fortune 500 company with a passion for making lives better. We do this by living our values, and through a relentless focus on the success of our customers and partnering with our employees to think and act like owners. title: Managing Consultant Corporate Strategy & Development
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**  
Corporate Strategy professionals shape Kyndryl's long-term direction and growth by leading high-impact, cross-functional initiatives and supporting executive decision-making. They partner closely with senior leaders to develop and execute enterprise strategies, leverage market, financial, customer, and competitive insights, and solve complex business challenges that drive growth and enterprise value.

Combining strategic thinking, analytical rigour, financial expertise, business case development, and executive communication skills, they support strategic planning, growth initiatives, investment decisions, and enterprise transformation programs that strengthen competitive advantage and deliver sustainable business outcomes.Are you a strategic thinker with a passion for shaping the future of a global technology company? Are you energized by the opportunity to work directly with senior leaders on high-impact initiatives that influence growth, investment decisions, and long-term enterprise strategy? Then we have a unique opportunity for you as a Managing Consultant, Corporate Strategy.

In this role, you will lead and support some of Kyndryl's most important strategic priorities, helping define the choices that shape the company's future direction and growth. Working closely with senior executives, business-unit leaders, finance teams, and cross-functional stakeholders, you will evaluate complex business challenges, identify opportunities for value creation, and develop recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes.

  
  

**What You Will Do**

  

* As a Managing Consultant, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact across the enterprise.
* You will partner with leadership teams to develop corporate and business-unit strategies, assess growth opportunities, evaluate investment priorities, and support critical executive decisions.
* You will conduct rigorous market research, competitive benchmarking, strategic assessments, and financial analyses to identify emerging opportunities, address key business challenges, and help position Kyndryl for long-term success in a dynamic and rapidly evolving marketplace.
* You will play a central role in strategic planning, business case development, and enterprise transformation initiatives.
* Leveraging your analytical rigor, structured problem-solving capabilities, and financial expertise, you will develop executive-level recommendations, strategic roadmaps, investment theses, and implementation plans that enable leadership teams to make informed, fact-based decisions.
* You will also help ensure alignment across stakeholders, monitor progress against strategic objectives, and support the successful execution of critical initiatives.
* Our consultants are restless for innovation.
    
  They thrive at the intersection of business strategy, technology, and transformation, helping shape the future of Kyndryl and our customers.
    
  So, if you are a problem-solver, an analytical thinker, and a self-starter who enjoys working on high-visibility assignments with senior leadership, we want to hear from you. Apply today to join our dynamic team and help solve the strategic challenges that will define Kyndryl's next chapter.

  
  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Becoming a Project Manager at Kyndryl is an excellent gateway to many different paths. You’ll be creating a well-rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications.You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non-technical areas such as Technical Service Architect, or you can move vertically to become a Senior Project Manager or program manager. There are many different types and flavors of project manager roles, so everyone can find the opportunity that suits them best.

**Who You Are**

You are an experienced corporate strategy, business consulting professional - you are good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important - you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are commercially minded and customer-focused - someone who prioritizes customer success, understands enterprise buying behaviour, brings extensive stakeholder-facing exposure, and applies critical thinking to complex business problems. And finally, you are open and borderless - naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Advanced graduate degree (e.g., MBA, PhD) in business, economics, finance, engineering, analytics, or a related field
* Over 7 years of experience in corporate strategy, pricing strategy, go-to-market strategy, commercial strategy, or management consulting, with 4+ years preferably with leading management consulting firms or technology services / software companies
* Demonstrated expertise developing GTM and pricing strategies for managed services, cloud services, software / SaaS, IT infrastructure, or hybrid technology offerings
* Ability to build robust business cases, price waterfalls, margin analyses, elasticity assessments, unit economics models, total cost of ownership models, and customer ROI frameworks
* Experience shaping go-to-market strategies, including sales and channel motions, portfolio positioning, launch planning, customer segmentation, partner monetization, and KPI frameworks
* Skilled in gathering and synthesizing data, conducting market research, competitive benchmarking, customer research, and translating insights into actionable recommendations
* Strong critical thinking, data analysis, financial modeling, and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize ambiguity into clear executive choices
* Ability to lead independent workstreams within larger corporate strategy initiatives and influence stakeholders across Offering, Sales, Finance, Delivery, Legal, and executive leadership
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for developing executive and board-level presentations, pricing recommendations, decision memos, and implementation roadmaps
Extensive customer-facing or stakeholder-facing exposure with strong commercial acumen, including familiarity with enterprise procurement dynamics, deal economics, and technology services / software sales cycles  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience in global technology services, managed infrastructure, cloud, software / SaaS, cybersecurity, IT modernization, or hyperscale partner ecosystems
* Experience supporting pricing transformations, portfolio simplification, commercial governance, go-to-market redesign, sales enablement, or partner monetization programs
* Familiarity with pricing analytics, CRM / CPQ workflows, cloud financial management / FinOps, product management practices, or software licensing operations
Industry certifications or training in cloud platforms, FinOps, pricing, product management, strategic finance, or related disciplines  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

* Demonstrated achievement of progressively higher quota, diversity of business customer, and higher level customer interface.
* Extensive selling experience within industry and on similar products.
* Typically 8-12 years of advanced sales experience.
* Project management skills required.

* Deep knowledge of products, solution or service offerings as well as competitor's offerings.

**GROWTH & MARKET EXPANSION LEAD**

Build Markets. Build Brands. Build Impact.

Most sales roles ask you to execute a playbook someone else has already written.  
This role asks you to build the playbook.

B.Bindi brings products made by rural women, self-help groups, and farmer producer organisations to customers across urban India. We're looking for an ambitious, hands-on Growth & Market Expansion Lead to take BBindi to the next level — both online and offline — working directly with the founding team.

**WHAT YOU'LL BUILD**

* Retail & Distribution General Trade, Modern Trade, retail, wholesale, distributors, super-stockists, institutional sales — starting in Bengaluru, expanding to new cities. Your scoreboard: distribution, shelf visibility, revenue.
* Online & E-commerce Growth Website, product listings, online sales, traffic, conversions, social commerce. You don't need to code — you need to be comfortable running it.
* Digital Campaigns Meta & Google Ads, lead-gen and conversion campaigns. Comfortable with Reach → Clicks → Leads → Conversion → Sales → ROI.
* Full-Funnel Thinking Connect marketing to actual revenue across Awareness → Interest → Lead → Customer → Repeat Customer — not just likes and views.
* Relationships Retailers, distributors, super-stockists, institutional buyers, online platforms — trust that turns into long-term business.
* Market Intelligence Track competitors, pricing, trends — and tell us what to do about it, not just what happened.
* Test → Learn → Scale New products, formats, channels, and campaigns. Double down on what works; move fast from what doesn't.

**WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT**

Real ownership — no waiting on a 12-layer hierarchy. You'll work with the founding team and influence what we sell, where we sell, how we market, and how we grow.

**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

A Growth Builder, not just a Sales Manager. 3–7 years in Sales, Marketing, Business Development, FMCG, Retail, E-commerce, D2C, or Startups. Ideally with experience in:

Building sales channels **managing retailers/distributors**  e-commerce & website ownership **Meta Ads & digital** campaigns **lead generation**  customer acquisition **campaign & sales performance tracking**  market research The kind of person who thrives: Entrepreneurial, hands-on, commercially minded, curious, data-aware, relationship-driven, action-oriented, adaptable — someone who meets a distributor in the morning, checks online sales at noon, launches a Meta campaign in the afternoon, and comes back tomorrow with a new growth idea.

We're not looking for someone who wants to manage a territory. We're looking for someone who wants to build one.

**WHY B. BINDI?**  
B. Bindi is the market-facing wing of EMP Bindi International Association, a social enterprise creating sustainable livelihoods for rural women through entrepreneurship, renewable energy, digital education, and agri-livelihoods.

Your work here won't only create sales — it can create markets, livelihoods, and a brand with purpose.

**WHAT YOU GET**

Founder exposure  
**Real ownership**   
Multi-channel experience (retail, distribution, e-commer digital)  
**Build from the ground up**   
Freedom to experiment **Purpose + business**  
Car growth as BBindi grows

Designation: Growth & Market Expansion Lead |  
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka |  
Experience: 3–7 years |  
Employment: Full-Time |  
Travel: Required |  
Languages: English & Kannada, Hindi a plus |  
Education: Graduate/Postgraduate in Marketing, Business Admin, or related — but what you've built matters more than where you studied.

**READY TO BUILD SOMETHING?**

If you want a routine 9-to-5 role with an existing playbook, this probably isn't it. If you want to build a market, a distribution network, digital sales, campaigns, a brand, and your career — we'd love to hear from you.

The eFront Insight business, a part of Aladdin, is a fast-growing part of BlackRock’s Private Markets technology strategy, focused on building a best-in-class Private Markets Data and Analytical platform. The Insight business is a front-office platform for alternative investment professionals, creating an ecosystem connecting Limited Partners (Asset Owners / Funds of Funds), General Partners (Asset Managers), and Asset Servicers.

  
  

The Private Data Services (PDS) team is the backbone of this business, providing world-class expertise in the collection and validation of investment data for investors in alternative assets.

  
  

The Aladdin Business brings together professionals responsible for implementing and supporting our Aladdin clients, sales and marketing, and ensuring the Aladdin Community maximizes Aladdin products through engagement and education.

  
  

**Your role and impact**

We are seeking an experienced leader to play a key role in the global leadership of Private Data Services. The role spans three core areas: global operations management, client management, and artificial intelligence (AI)-led transformation.

  
  

The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering high-quality operations at scale, strengthening the client experience, managing complex service and operational escalations, and driving the evolution of the operating model. The role will also lead opportunities to apply AI, automation and process improvement to simplify workflows, strengthen controls, enhance productivity, and deliver better outcomes for clients and the business.

  
  

**Your responsibilities**

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

  
  

* Provide global leadership for Private Data Services operations, with accountability for timely and high-quality delivery, effective workforce and capacity management, operational resilience and scalable operating practices.

* Lead client engagement and manage complex client escalations, partnering across client, product, technology and operations teams to drive timely resolution while identifying and addressing underlying systemic issues

* Establish strong operating discipline across service quality, productivity, controls and operational risk, using appropriate metrics and governance to continuously improve performance.

* Lead AI-enabled transformation and automation initiatives, identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual intervention, and improve the quality, efficiency and scalability of service delivery.

* Drive end-to-end process improvement and operating model transformation, translating operational challenges and client needs into sustainable solutions and measurable business outcomes.

* Build and develop a high-performing global organization by strengthening leadership capabilities, succession and talent pipelines, establishing clear accountability, and fostering an inclusive and collaborative culture.
  

  

**Your experience**

* University degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business or related discipline.

* MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualification preferred.

* 16–20 years of relevant experience in financial services, including significant leadership experience across operations, managed services, investment data, or related functions.

* Strong understanding of private markets, financial instruments, investment data and valuation concepts, with experience operating in complex, high-volume environments.

* Demonstrated experience in client management and complex escalations, with the ability to influence stakeholders, navigate competing priorities and drive issues through to resolution.

* Demonstrated track record of leading large-scale transformation, AI and automation adoption, and process improvement, with a focus on delivering measurable improvements in quality, efficiency, scalability and client outcomes.

* Strong strategic thinking, analytical and problem-solving capabilities, combined with experience in operational governance, change management, developing high-performing teams, and communicating effectively across functions and geographies.

**Our benefits**
  
  
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

  

**About BlackRock**

  
  

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

  
  

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

  
  

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window).

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

**Your impact**
---------------

**This role combines business intelligence, market intelligence, strategic analysis, and data-driven decision support. The ideal candidate is highly curious, proactive, comfortable working in ambiguity, skilled in Excel-based modeling, and able to partner with different business units e.g., Business Management and Product Leaders to translate market, customer, and competitive insights into strategic recommendations.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Own the problem. Scope analytics and business intelligence initiatives supporting strategic, operational, market, and quality programs. Frame the question, develop hypotheses, gather data, design the analysis, and carry recommendations through to decision-making.**

title: Manager - Engineering (E-commerce)
description:
**INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT**

Chalhoub Group’s Capability Hub is our technology and innovation hub set up with the vision to unite exceptional talent to build technology and capabilities that elevate luxury experiences and define the future of luxury retail.

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

**What you'll be doing**

Lead the E-Commerce Engineering capability across Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC/Demandware) and Shopify, owning technical execution, full-stack delivery, and operational reliability across all brand websites while building and developing a high-performing engineering team.

* Own platform technical execution and codebase governance across SFCC (Demandware) multi-brand realms and Shopify Plus applications.
* Oversee end-to-end frontend and backend code delivery using Node.js, ISML, SFRA (Storefront Reference Architecture), and modern JavaScript frameworks across all brand websites.
* Drive migration from monolithic SFCC setups toward composable, decoupled frontend microservices and API-first integrations.
* Enforce secure coding standards, peer code reviews, automated unit and integration testing, and DevSecOps practices across e-commerce squads.
* Lead multi-squad engineering delivery within two-week agile sprints and 8-week Program Increment (PI) planning cycles. Engineering Reports to Director of Engineering Bengaluru.
* Ensure peak site availability, fast page-load speeds, and zero-downtime checkouts during high-volume retail trading events.
* Oversee technical interfaces connecting e-commerce applications with middleware (MuleSoft), Order Management (Fluent OMS), POS (Oracle XStore), and payment gateways, and track DORA metrics (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes,Defect Escape Rate, MTTR).
* Manage production code deployments and implementations releases, constantly improving the process to reach a goal of multi releases per day.
* Own SFCC and Shopify platform from maintenance perspective making sure that everything is operationally working as expected without any disruptions.
* Direct, mentor a high-performing team of full-stack e-commerce engineers and tech leads, run performance reviews, career development paths, and adoption of AI-assisted engineering tools (Claude Code).
* Partner with the Architecture, Omnichannel, Product, and QA on workforce and capacity planning.
* Own end-to-end e-commerce engineering delivery across SFCC and Shopify, including integrations, release readiness, and production stability.
* Remain hands-on: contribute to complex implementation and plan, design, execute, and document functional, integration, end-to-end, and regression testing across integrated SFCC and Shopify systems for assigned scope.

**What you’ll need to succeed**

* Minimum 10 years of total software engineering experience, including 5 years hands-on e-commerce full-stack development and 3 years directly managing engineering teams of 15+ people.
* Experience leading complex e-commerce platforms across SFCC and Shopify Plus in multi-brand retail environments, with strong ownership of integrations, performance, and operational reliability.
* Deep expertise in SFCC (Business Manager, SFRA, Controllers, Pipelines, Job Frameworks) and Shopify Plus, with mastery of ISML, HTML5, CSS3/SASS, JavaScript (ES6+), and React.
* Strong command of Node.js, RESTful API design, GraphQL, headless architecture, and microservices integration.
* Experience with e-commerce search engines (Algolia, Constructor.io), CDN/caching (Fastly/Cloudflare), catalog indexing, GitLab CI/CD, Git workflows, and automated build and release pipelines.
* Practical experience with observability and APM tools (Datadog, Splunk) for site health, error logging, and incident response, and SAFe/Agile delivery (Jira/Confluence); familiarity with Claude Code for AI-assisted engineering.

**What we can offer you**

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.

**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.

**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.
