title: Sr. Program Manager Enablement
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re looking for a Senior Program Manager to enable our revenue teams in India. You will have previous experience as Account Executive or Enablement Program Manager with a strong track record of executing strategic sales enablement initiatives. This role will be responsible for enabling our New logo Sales Account Executives.

You’ll partner with sales leaders to diagnose sales performance gaps, choose the right intervention, and take programs from an initial brief through adoption and measurement. That might mean a live training, a practice workshop, a certification, a manager reinforcement plan, a playbook, or a process change. You will be responsible for delivering relevant, consumable content to our teams.

You’ll make complex product and sales concepts usable for the teams you support, and help managers reinforce behavior after launch.You’ll jointly identify opportunity areas for new training approaches, certifications, processes, and assets for the sales team. After you deploy programs to sales teams, you’ll develop systems to measure business impact and iterate as necessary. This is an opportunity to meaningfully play a role in driving Rippling’s growth by developing and testing strategies for all segments of our sales teams to improve their respective close rates and average contract values.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who can act as a strategic partner and still deliver excellent work at pace. This role will directly impact and improve our buyer journey across all sales segments.

You’ll work across multiple cross functional stakeholders like Sales implementation, Product launch teams, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Experience, and the broader Revenue Enablement team.

You’ll love this role if you’re passionate about revenue growth and Enablement, getting into the details, deeply understanding why an enablement program is or isn’t resonating, using data to motivate your peers, and making a significant impact on revenue.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Program Manage & Own Enablement Functional Expertise:
* + Oversee multiple enablement projects, ensuring timely execution and alignment with strategic goals. Thrive in fast paced, highly ambiguous environments and get projects to completion
  + Develop and manage end-to-end enablement programs, including onboarding LPs, everboarding programs, sales documentation, and ongoing comms to ensure your programs stick
  + You will become a domain expert in all things Rippling New logo Sales so you can have a meaningful impact on strategic decision making
* Communication & Stakeholder Management:
* + Set clear expectations, foster collaboration & execute on deliverables autonomously.
  + Partner with Sales leadership & broaden enablement team to drive large initiatives.
* Presentation / Facilitation Skills:
* + Design clean, non-text heavy presentations that deliver sales-consumable information to audiences
  + Utilize various adult learning modalities (interactivity, polling, questioning, role play, etc.) to ensure information transfer
  + Excel in live sales training facilitation ( sales skills training, new process updates, product rollouts )
* Analytical Skills:
* + Review and analyze data to inform enablement recommendations based on business gaps.
  + Define baseline & leading indicators before launch, review adoption & performance with stakeholders, share what’s working, what’s not & iterate.
  + Interpret key performance metrics to identify opportunities for impact and ensure rapid AE ramp-up and effectiveness.
* Content Development:
* + Create & maintain concise, polished, accessible playbooks, guides & reference materials for the sales teams.
  + Create and update onboarding content for new sales reps, ensuring relevance and accessibility.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* At least 5 years of relevant experience in Enablement, Program Management, Product Marketing, and / or Sales, with examples of complex programs you led from diagnosis through measurable adoption.
* Strong facilitation & instructional design judgement, including the ability to make complex material clear, practical, and engaging for sales audiences
* Ability to thrive in very fast-paced environments, effectively managing shifting priorities and handling multiple tasks without becoming easily overwhelmed
* Ability to build trusted relationships, influence without authority & drive quick decisions
* Excellent program management : prioritisation, backward planning, crisp documentation, navigating ambiguity & escalating risks early.
* An aptitude for problem-solving and working cross-functionally with others
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and organizational skills including high attention to detail, high speed & high ownership
* Self-starter with a bias towards action
* SaaS sales acumen and the curiosity to become a credible expert in Rippling’s products, customers & sales motions.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: Sales Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Cavintek develops cloud-based SaaS business process automation software for small and medium enterprises, helping organizations streamline and digitize their workflows. Its flagship product, Cflow, enables companies to move from email- and spreadsheet-driven operations to structured business applications that improve productivity and reduce costs. Cflow allows users to build approval-based workflows quickly without coding, supporting use cases such as Capex approvals, travel requests, expense reimbursements, procurement, invoicing, and purchase orders. Cavintek serves customers across industries including food processing, logistics, banking, energy, and education, with reported improvements of 70% to 200% in cycle time and throughput.

Employment Type: Full-time

**About MrMed**

MrMed is a fast-growing digital healthcare platform committed to making specialty and life-saving medicines accessible and affordable across India. We support patients battling chronic and critical illnesses by simplifying access to high-cost therapies and providing end-to-end assistance throughout their treatment journey.

At MrMed, we work closely across multiple teams including warehouse operations, logistics, billing, and city operations to ensure timely and safe delivery of medicines to patients. Our operations team plays a critical role in maintaining accuracy, speed, and quality across the supply chain.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Billing Executive with 1–2 years of pharmacy billing experience to manage billing, inward checking and purchase entries accurately and on time. The role focuses on preventing financial discrepancies through accurate billing, GRN entry and timely reconciliations.

You will maintain billing process discipline and compliance, keep all billing documents audit-ready, and support smooth vendor and customer settlements, working closely with warehouse, logistics and city operations teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Inward Checking, Purchase Entries & GRN**

· Complete inward checking and purchase entries on time.

· Ensure 100% accuracy in GRN (Goods Receipt Note) entry for all received shipments each month.

· Immediately identify, report and help correct any billing or GRN mismatches daily.

**Billing Accuracy & Credit Notes**

· Prevent financial discrepancies through accurate billing and timely reconciliations.

· Process and post all credit notes (RTO, sales returns) within the same working day.

· Ensure all batch corrections and billing updates are posted accurately, on the same day.

**Process Discipline & Compliance**

· Print and file daily GRN and audit reports before shift end, on 100% of workdays.

· Complete scheduled reporting and filing activities precisely as per calendar.

· Maintain billing process discipline and compliance to support operational efficiency.

**Invoice Filing, Settlements & Audit Readiness**

· Maintain error-free invoice filing for all vendor and customer transactions, keeping the monthly spot-check error rate at or below 1%.

· Ensure all billing documents (invoices, batch corrections, credit notes) are audit-ready at month-end.

· Support smooth vendor and customer settlements.

**Learning & Process Improvement**

· Attend at least one billing / compliance, ERP or Excel training session per month.

· Submit at least one process or automation improvement idea for billing, reporting or filing every month.

**What We're Looking For**

· Min graduate preferred.

· 1–2 years of experience in pharmacy billing.

· Working knowledge of billing software / ERP systems.

· Basic understanding of GST.

· Strong invoice-checking skills and attention to detail.

· Proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

· Ability to meet daily and month-end deadlines with accurate documentation.

**Why Join MrMed?**

At MrMed, accurate billing keeps the supply chain for specialty and life-saving medicines running smoothly. Every correctly posted entry and audit-ready record supports reliable service to patients.

We value people who bring ownership, discipline, attention to detail and a willingness to keep learning and improving processes.

If you take pride in accuracy and well-kept records, we would love to meet you.

Candidate across India can apply for this role, but fluency in English and willing to relocate to chennai is mandatory, so please share updated resume to **hr@mrmed.in**

**Farm Operations Management**: Overseeing day-to-day operations of the farm, including crop cultivation, livestock care, and maintenance of farm facilities.

1. **Staff Management**: Hiring, training, scheduling, and supervising farm workers or labourers to ensure efficient operation of the farm.

2. **Crop Planning and Management**: Developing crop rotation plans, selecting appropriate crops for planting, and managing planting, harvesting, and post-harvest activities.

3. **Livestock Care**: Ensuring the health and well-being of livestock, including feeding, watering, monitoring for illness, and coordinating with veterinarians as needed.

4. **Equipment Maintenance**: Maintaining farm equipment and machinery to ensure they are in good working condition. This includes scheduling regular maintenance and repairs as needed.

5. **Budgeting and Financial Management**: Developing and managing the farm budget, including monitoring expenses, tracking revenues, and making financial decisions to ensure the profitability of the farm.

6. **Marketing and Sales**: Identifying market opportunities for farm products, developing marketing strategies, and managing sales channels such as farmers' markets, CSA (Community Supported Agriculture) programs, or direct sales to restaurants and retailers.

7. **Environmental Stewardship**: Implementing sustainable farming practices to minimize environmental impact, conserve natural resources, and promote soil health and biodiversity.

8. **Compliance and Regulation**: Ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal regulations related to farming, food safety, labour, and environmental protection.

9. **Record Keeping**: Maintaining accurate records of farm activities, including crop yields, livestock inventory, financial transactions, and regulatory compliance documentation.

10. **Facility Management**: Managing farm buildings, infrastructure, and utilities to ensure they are well-maintained and operational.

11. **Pest and Disease Management**: Implementing integrated pest management strategies to control pests and diseases while minimizing the use of chemical pesticides.

12. **Community Relations**: Building positive relationships with neighbours, community organizations, and local authorities to foster goodwill and address any concerns related to the farm's operations.

13. **Emergency Response**: Developing and implementing emergency response plans to address situations such as severe weather, livestock emergencies, or equipment failures.

14. **Continued Learning and Professional Development**: Staying informed about advancements in farming techniques, technologies, and regulations through on-going education and professional development opportunities.

description:
**About the Role**

Devi Polymers is looking for an experienced Plant Manager to take charge of its compression and injection moulding operations, including post-processing and finishing.

The person will be accountable for production output, quality, delivery, manufacturing costs, machine utilisation and workforce productivity. The role requires hands-on shop-floor leadership and experience translating customer orders into achievable production plans.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Own production and delivery:** Plan and execute production against the open order book, aligning machine capacity, mould availability, materials and manpower with customer delivery dates.
* **Drive productivity:** Set and review targets for machine utilisation, cycle times, output per shift and operator throughput across moulding and post-processing.
* **Control manufacturing costs:** Manage labour, overtime, energy, consumables, scrap and rework against budgets and product cost targets.
* **Ensure product quality:** Work with quality and technical teams to control process parameters, reduce rejections and resolve recurring defects and customer complaints.
* **Improve machine and mould availability:** Coordinate preventive maintenance, breakdown resolution and mould upkeep to reduce downtime and interruptions.
* **Lead the workforce:** Manage supervisors, operators and contract manpower across shifts; strengthen skills, accountability, discipline and shift handovers.
* **Manage post-processing:** Ensure deflashing, finishing, inspection and packing keep pace with moulding output and dispatch requirements.
* **Drive corrective actions:** Review production losses, quality issues and downtime trends; assign owners and follow through on interim and permanent corrective actions.
* **Maintain reliable reporting:** Ensure accurate daily records and review target versus actual production, rejection, downtime, manpower and delivery performance.
* **Maintain safe operations:** Enforce shop-floor safety, housekeeping, standard operating procedures and applicable quality system requirements.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Experience managing compression and/or injection moulding operations, preferably with thermoset materials such as SMC and DMC.
* Strong knowledge of moulding processes, process settings, moulds, machinery and defect troubleshooting.
* Proven ability to improve output, reduce rejection and downtime, and meet delivery commitments.
* Experience in production planning, capacity assessment, manpower deployment and manufacturing cost control.
* Ability to lead supervisors and operators across multiple shifts.
* Working knowledge of preventive maintenance, root-cause analysis, ISO quality systems and continuous improvement.
* Strong coordination skills across production, quality, maintenance, procurement and dispatch.

**Key Performance Measures**

* On-time delivery against customer commitments.
* Production achievement against plan.
* Machine utilisation and cycle-time achievement.
* Labour productivity in moulding and post-processing.
* Rejection, scrap and rework levels.
* Machine and mould downtime.
* Manufacturing cost against budget.
* Safety performance and corrective-action closure.

title: Regional Manager - Customs & Field Operations
description:
**ABOUT CUSTOMS BROKAGE AND COMPLIANCE**

DHL Global Forwarding CBC team oversees shipments complying with the relevant customs laws and regulations, facilitating the smooth movement of goods across borders. Collaborating with AFR and OFR teams, custom department officials, and other external stakeholders for maintaining efficiency and compliant customs processes.

  

**JOB SUMMARY**

As a Regional Manager of CBC team, an incumbent plays a crucial role in overseeing and ensuring compliance with customs regulations across west region. Responsible for managing vendor relationships, coordinating shipment processing, and maintaining quality standards, the role entails driving organizational goals, achieving profitability targets, and optimizing operational efficiency. This position involves stakeholder management, including subcontractors, customs officials, and customers, while also overseeing team performance, fostering a culture of excellence, and staying updated on regulatory changes to advise and adapt operations accordingly.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Operational Excellence**

* Drive organizational goals and strategies through effective leadership and team collaboration.
* Take charge of Profit and Loss (P&L) management, ensuring achievement of Earnings Before Interest and Taxes (EBIT) and Gross Profit (GP) goals. Develop action plans to achieve these targets.
* Lead and prepare strategies to achieve budgeted targets
* Identify and implement efficiency-driving measures to reduce processing time and increase productivity.
* Collaborate with the sales team to provide inputs on Requests for Quotations (RFQs) and quotations to secure new customers.
* Manage relationships with vendors and ensure their compliance with applicable regulations.
* Facilitate smooth coordination between teams involved in the processing of shipments and handling of associated documents.
* Strict implementation of Quality Management Systems to uphold service standards.
* Ensure timely clearance of cargo without incurring penalties consistently.
* Oversee back-office customs clearance activities to ensure compliance.
* Maintain error-free documentation in Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) systems.
* Manage a large volume of files while maintaining high-quality standards.
* Ensure the team performs optimally and delivers high-quality services.
* Conduct frequent visits to operational sites, such as ports, to interact with field team members and assess operational efficiency.
* Monitor CW1 reports via Freight Revenue Perishable (FRP) data and station matrix to track performance.
* Stay updated on customs rules and public notices, disseminating relevant information to the team, and keeping the EDI team informed. Handle customer reviews regularly, addressing feedback and concerns.
* Manage vendor relationships, ensure contract renewals, and monitor vendor reconciliations.
* A comprehensive perspective on the operational dynamics of handling one file by a single operator in the business operations.

  

**Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for subcontractor relationships, monitoring their performance.
* Proactively communicate customs-related issues with peers/superiors.
* Interface with customs department officials to maintain positive relationships and resolve issues.
* Liaise with customers in case of escalations and advise them about changes in government regulations.

  

**Team Management**

* Lead weekly Performance Dialogs to understand team issues and devise solutions collaboratively.
* Ensure clear and effective communication within the team and among team members.
* Delegate duties and tasks effectively, ensuring proper demarcation of responsibilities.
* Take ownership of staffing and contractor management at the station level.
* Foster a culture of high performance, service excellence, and compliance within the functional department.

  

**COMPETENCIES**

**Functional Competencies**

* Customs Clearance Expertise: In-depth knowledge and proficiency in customs procedures and regulations.
* Customer Service: Strong customer service skills to address inquiries, provide updates, and resolve issues related to shipments.
* Technology Proficiency: Implementing CW1 and other tools for optimizing operations.
* Customs Regulations Acumen: Understanding of customs procedures, tariff and international trade laws for industry regulations and standards.
* Performance Monitoring: Track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and metrics for team members, assess operational effectiveness, and implement corrective actions as needed.

  

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Resilience and Adaptability: Handling diverse tasks and challenges effectively.
* Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams for seamless operations.
* Team Leadership: Effectively leading and motivating all the team members.
* Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and improve skills to enhance performance.
* Attention to Detail: Consistently maintaining accuracy and precision in tasks.
* Quality Orientation: Commitment to delivering high-quality results and services.
* Initiative: Taking proactive steps to improve processes or address issues.

**WHO CAN APPLY?**

**Must Have**

* Bachelor’s Degree in any field.
* 12 years of experience in a customs role.
* Experience in handling team members.
* Problem-solving skills to address operational challenges.
* Proficient in Email writing and verbal communication with internal and external coordination.
* Efficiently manage tasks to meet deadlines and priorities.

**Preferred**

* G or F Card customs pass holder.

* Experience of working at a multinational freight forwarding company.

GAEC ABROAD is an international education consulting firm specializing in academic counseling for students aspiring to study abroad and providing comprehensive global education services. We are committed to offering personalized guidance to students across India, helping them make informed decisions about their international academic journeys.

Our team works closely with students to understand their academic backgrounds, career aspirations, and personal goals, recommending suitable universities and programs worldwide. At GAEC ABROAD, we prioritize personalized counseling, ethical practices, effective marketing, and long-term student success in the global education landscape.

**Role Description**

GAEC ABROAD is seeking an experienced and results-driven
**Senior Consultant – Overseas Education & Marketing**
to join our team in Hyderabad. This is a full-time, on-site position requiring a minimum of
**4 years of relevant experience**
in overseas education consulting, student recruitment, marketing, or related fields.

The candidate will be responsible for student counseling, university admissions, lead generation, marketing campaigns, and business development. The role requires an individual who can effectively counsel students, develop marketing strategies, generate quality leads, convert inquiries into enrollments, and contribute to the overall growth of GAEC ABROAD.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Student Counseling & Admissions**

* Provide personalized counseling to students regarding international universities, courses, admission requirements, and career opportunities.
* Evaluate student profiles and recommend suitable universities and programs based on academic backgrounds, budgets, and career goals.
* Guide students through applications, documentation, offer letters, and admission timelines.
* Provide updated information on international education trends, admission policies, and visa procedures.
* Follow up with students and parents to convert inquiries into successful enrollments.
* Maintain accurate student records, application updates, and follow-up activities using CRM systems.

**Marketing & Lead Generation**

* Plan and execute marketing strategies to promote GAEC ABROAD's overseas education services.
* Generate student leads through digital marketing, social media, educational events, seminars, webinars, and other promotional activities.
* Coordinate with digital marketing teams to develop campaigns across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google.
* Support the creation of marketing content, promotional materials, advertisements, and student success stories.
* Identify new marketing opportunities, student segments, and potential business partnerships.
* Organize and participate in education fairs, school and college visits, workshops, and student recruitment events.
* Monitor marketing campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and return on investment.
* Build brand awareness and strengthen GAEC ABROAD's presence in the overseas education market.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Minimum
  **4 years of relevant professional experience**
  in overseas education consulting, student recruitment, marketing, or business development.
* Strong knowledge of international education destinations, university admissions, and student visa processes.
* Experience in lead generation, student conversion, digital marketing, or promotional campaign management.
* Excellent communication, counseling, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Understanding of social media marketing, online advertising, and marketing campaign performance.
* Ability to manage multiple student cases, marketing activities, and deadlines.
* Proficiency in CRM platforms, student management systems, and standard office software.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Marketing, Management, Business Administration, Education, or a related field.
* A proactive, target-oriented mindset with strong organizational and relationship-building skills.
* Commitment to ethical counseling, transparent marketing, and delivering a positive student experience.

title: Customer Relationship Management Manager
description:
**Company Description**
At Vamsi Art Printers Pvt. Ltd., we provide comprehensive, end-to-end printing solutions across Pre-Press, Press, and Post-Press stages. Our advanced in-house production facility manages everything from printing and binding to final delivery, allowing streamlined workflows and consistent quality. We operate to international standards, focusing on reliability, precision, and customer satisfaction. Clients benefit from our flexibility in order handling, fast turnaround times, and competitive pricing. This integrated approach makes Vamsi a trusted partner for diverse printing and packaging needs.

**Role Description**
The Customer Relationship Management Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad. This position is responsible for overseeing customer relationship strategies, managing key accounts, and ensuring a high level of client satisfaction across the printing lifecycle. Day-to-day activities include tracking and analyzing customer data, segmenting markets, coordinating sales and service teams, and following up on orders from pre-press through delivery. The Manager will collaborate with production, sales, and logistics teams to align customer expectations with operational capabilities and support business growth.

* Strong Analytical Skills to interpret customer data, identify trends, and support data-driven decision-making.

* Project Management capabilities to oversee customer projects, manage timelines, and ensure smooth delivery across pre-press, press, and post-press stages.
* Experience using CRM systems and basic proficiency in MS Office or similar productivity tools.
* Proven background in customer-facing roles, preferably in printing, manufacturing, or related industries.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field; relevant certifications in CRM or project management are an advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in Hyderabad, prioritize multiple accounts, and maintain a customer-focused approach under tight deadlines.

**National ownership, deep-technology engagement and the freedom to shape go-to-market priorities**

—rather than merely manage an inherited territory. You will operate at the intersection of business strategy, customer engineering and a growing electronics market.

Share your résumé or LinkedIn profile with a short note on major accounts, segments handled and your current location.

title: Regional Manager
description:
**Job Title: Regional Manager**

**Location:**
City-Based Field Role for Hyderabad

**Company:**
Beauty Beyond Borders (BBB)

**About Beauty Beyond Borders**

Beauty Beyond Borders (BBB) is India’s exclusive distributor of globally respected luxury and dermacosmetic skincare brands including LA Fervance (France), Elementre Dermo Cosmetics (Switzerland), Future Cosmetics (Israel), Valmont (Switzerland), and possibly more and We partner with leading dermatologists, aesthetic clinics, premium hotels, and wellness centers across India, offering science-backed skincare supported by structured education and brand positioning.

This is a field-intensive position requiring:

● Disciplined daily activity

● Strong product understanding

● Professional engagement with dermatologists and clinic owners

● Structured follow-ups and reporting

● Travel outside Hyderabad for 2 Weeks

**Role Overview:**

The
**Regional Manager**
is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving regional revenue, overseeing high-ticket clinic acquisitions.

This is a high-impact, field-intensive leadership position requiring a blend of strategic territory planning and hands-on mentorship. The RM ensures that the entire regional team reflects the credibility and sophistication of our premium international brands while maintaining rigorous operational discipline.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Regional Strategy & Revenue Leadership (80%)**

* Revenue Growth: Take full ownership of regional sales targets, ensuring steady and predictable growth across all territories.(56%)
* High-Ticket Management: Oversee the positioning and sales execution of luxury, high-value skincare portfolios to top-tier dermatologists and premium wellness chains. (12.8%)
* Strategic Planning: Develop and implement regional business plans to improve brand penetration and market share. (11.2%)

Objective: Achieve regional financial milestones through structured growth and retention.

**2. Team Supervision & Performance Mentorship (2%)**

* Performance Monitoring: Audit CRM data, weekly reports, and visit logs to ensure field discipline and conversion accuracy. (2%)

Objective: Build a high-performing, self-disciplined sales force.

**3. Key Relationship Management & Acquisition (5%)**

* VIP Account Management: Personally manage relationships with KOLs (Key Opinion Leaders), high-profile aesthetic physicians, and key decision-makers. (2.5%)
* Acquisition Oversight: Guide the team in identifying and onboarding "Grade A" dermatology clinics and premium partners. (1.5%)
* Conflict Resolution: Act as the senior point of contact for operational or service escalations to ensure 100% client satisfaction. (1%)

Objective: Secure long-term loyalty from the region’s most influential accounts.

**4. Market Intelligence & Cross-Functional Coordination (5%)**

* Insights: Aggregate competitor pricing, clinical trends, and doctor feedback to provide actionable insights to senior management. (2.5%)
* Operational Synergy: Liaise with Trainers for large-scale CMEs (Continuing Medical Education) and coordinate with logistics/stockists to eliminate supply chain gaps. (1.5%)
* Compliance: Ensure the regional team adheres to all corporate reporting, attendance, and grooming standards. (1%)

Objective: Maintain absolute market visibility and operational excellence.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree required (B Pharm or Science background highly preferred).
* Experience: Minimum 2-3 years in Dermatology, Aesthetic, or Luxury Skincare sales.
* Communication: Exceptional fluency in spoken and written English is mandatory; must be capable of leading high-level scientific and commercial discussions.
* Leadership Style: Professional, composed, and capable of representing high-ticket international brands with maturity.
* Travel: High willingness to travel extensively across the assigned region and out of Hyderabad for at least 2 weeks

**What We Value**

* Strategic Consistency: A focus on long-term sustainability over short-term aggressive tactics.
* Executive Presence: Professional grooming and articulation aligned with premium global standards.

title: Events Lead – Brand Activations
description:
About Roligt Foods

Roligt Foods is building a next-gen clean-label beverage brand out of Hyderabad. We make drinks with short, honest ingredient lists and nothing we cannot defend. We are pre-launch, running live activations across the city and rolling out smart vending kiosks. As we scale, we are building a small team that owns outcomes, not tasks.

Role Description

The Events Lead runs every activation we do: flea markets, food fests, community carnivals and corporate campuses. Based in Hyderabad, you work with the revenue team, the brand promoters and the brand team. Every event has to produce sampling numbers, sales and leads. This role suits someone who is happiest on the ground and obsessive about the details of a good stall.

Key Responsibilities

1. Build and run the events calendar, with 4 to 8 activations a month.
2. Find organisers and venues, negotiate stall fees and close bookings.
3. Own stall setup, stock, collateral, permissions and teardown.
4. Hire, brief and roster the brand promoter team. Run the on-ground script.
5. Capture leads with consent at every event and hand them over to the CRM team on the same day.
6. Report on each event: footfall, samples, conversions, leads and cost per lead.
7. Feed customer reactions back to the brand and product teams.

The Ideal Candidate Will Have

1. 2 to 4 years of experience in events, BTL activations or on-ground marketing for an FMCG or F&B brand.
2. An existing network of Hyderabad organisers and vendors.
3. Experience leading a field team, even a small one.
4. A two-wheeler and a valid licence.
5. The attitude of "if it needs to get done, I will make sure it gets done."

What We Offer

1. **Fair, competitive compensation.**
   Pay is in line with industry standards and based on your experience, capability and track record. Strong performers grow faster than a standard annual cycle.
2. **Fast-track growth.**
   You work directly with the leadership team and see how a consumer brand is built from zero. Good people grow into bigger roles as the business scales.
3. **Broad exposure.**
   You see product, brand, events, retail and operations, not one narrow slice.
4. **Real ownership.**
   Small team, fast decisions. Your work shows up in the numbers.

Please Do Not Apply If

1. You are not based in, or willing to relocate to, Hyderabad.
2. You are not available most weekends.
3. You prefer planning from a desk to running things on the ground.

We are selective about who we hire. If you do not hear back within three weeks of applying, please assume your application has not been taken forward this time.

title: Co-Founder, Supply & Sales (Commercial Real Estate) · Veneraa · Hyderabad
company: Veneraa | Own Slice of Commercial Real Estate
description:
**About Veneraa**

Veneraa (veneraa.in) is building a new way to own commercial real estate in India. We identify premium commercial properties that are eligible for an SPV structure, so investors can co-own them through the SPV and share the rental income. We also help clients buy, sell, and lease commercial properties. We’re at the very start, launching in Hyderabad, and you’ll build our property pipeline from day one.

**The role**

We’re looking for a co-founder to own the real estate side of the business: bringing in the right properties and getting them in front of the right investors. You’ll be the on-ground face of Veneraa with developers, owners, and buyers in Hyderabad.

**What you’ll own**

* **Supply:**
  Source and onboard Grade-A and pre-leased commercial properties from developers, landlords, and existing investors.
* **Asset evaluation:**
  Assess whether each property is SPV-eligible by checking clear title, approvals, tenant quality, lease terms, and rental yield. Then decide what’s worth taking forward.
* **Investor sales:**
  Build and close a pipeline of HNIs, NRIs, family offices, and first-time commercial investors.
* **Partner network:**
  Grow and manage our channel partners and agents.
* **Company building:**
  Shape pricing, deal structure, and the investor experience alongside the founder.

**You’re a fit if you have**

* 5+ years in commercial real estate in Hyderabad, in leasing, sales, investment advisory, or developer-side business development.
* Personal relationships with developers and landlords in Gachibowli, Hitech City, Financial District, Kokapet, or Madhapur.
* A track record of closing commercial deals of ₹1 Cr and above with individual investors.
* A working understanding of pre-leased assets, including lock-in periods, escalations, yields, and due diligence.
* The drive to build something from zero, without a big brand behind you.

**Strong bonus**

* Experience at an IPC (CBRE, JLL, Cushman & Wakefield, Colliers, Knight Frank, Anarock) or on a developer’s commercial sales team.
* Experience with SPV-based or fractional ownership deals, or familiarity with SEBI’s SM REIT framework.
* An existing investor base, or NRI investor connections.

**What we offer**

* 10% equity, vesting over 2 years.
* An equity-only role for now, with no salary or stipend.
* A true co-founder seat with real say in how the company is built.

to build and fill the new-business pipeline for 8 Views.

**This is a pure outbound role.**
Your job is to start conversations with the right prospects and hand over qualified, meeting-ready leads. You will not handle proposals, negotiation or closing. The Business Development team picks up from your handover.

You will source leads from LinkedIn and other channels, build relationships with consultants and potential partners, and run a consistent weekly outreach cadence. If you enjoy research, outreach and the discipline of hitting activity and meeting targets, this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Source leads**
  from LinkedIn, referrals, events, directories, industry databases and other channels, with a focus on our core sectors: Real Estate, Education, Healthcare and other lead-generation businesses.
* Run structured
  **LinkedIn outreach**
  : build prospect lists, send connection requests, follow up and start conversations that lead to meetings.
* Build and nurture relationships with
  **consultants, agencies and other potential partners**
  to create referral and collaboration channels.
* Research each prospect's business, competitors and current digital presence so every outreach message is relevant and personalised.
* Qualify leads on budget, need, timeline and decision-maker access before handing them over.
* Book discovery calls and meetings for the BD team, with clear notes on the prospect's context and needs.
* Maintain a steady weekly outreach cadence and hit defined targets for connections, conversations and meetings booked.
* Keep the CRM updated daily with lead status, outreach activity and follow-ups.
* Track outreach performance (reply rates, meeting conversion, source-wise quality) and refine messaging and targeting based on the numbers.
* Use outreach and lead-generation tools, including LinkedIn automation, enrichment and email tools, to scale outreach without losing quality.
* Share weekly reports on pipeline activity and lead quality with the BD lead.

**What We're Looking For**

* **2-4 years of experience**
  in outbound lead generation, business development, inside sales or SDR roles, ideally in a digital marketing agency or similar service business.
* Strong command of
  **LinkedIn as a prospecting tool**
  , including Sales Navigator, search filters and connection-led conversations.
* Proven ability to source leads from multiple channels and book qualified meetings consistently.
* Excellent written communication: you can write short, personalised messages that get replies.
* Basic understanding of digital marketing and performance marketing, enough to hold a credible first conversation with a prospect.
* Comfort with numbers: reply rates, conversion rates and lead-to-meeting ratios.
* Hands-on experience with a CRM and outreach or lead-generation tools.
* Strong research skills and attention to detail.
* Self-driven and comfortable working to weekly activity and meeting targets.
* Comfortable using AI tools to improve research, outreach and productivity.

**What Will Make You Successful**

* You enjoy outreach and are not discouraged by silence or rejection.
* You research before you reach out, and your messages reflect it.
* You build genuine relationships with consultants and partners, not just send cold messages.
* You track your own numbers and keep improving what works.
* You stay disciplined with your daily and weekly cadence.
* You are curious about how performance marketing works and how it drives leads for clients.

**Bonus Points If You Have**

* Experience selling digital marketing or performance marketing services.
* An existing network of consultants, agencies or channel partners.
* Experience with Real Estate, Education or Healthcare clients.
* Experience with LinkedIn automation tools, Clay, Apollo, Lusha or similar platforms.

**Prior experience in outbound lead generation is mandatory. Candidates with agency experience will be preferred.**

title: Institutional Sales Manager (B2B / Government Sales)
description:
****About The Role****
**Institutional Sales Manager (Government & Institutional Sales)**
**Company:**
Marut Drones
  
  
**Position:**
Institutional Sales Manager
  
  
**Function:**
Government & Institutional Sales
  
  
**Experience:**
5–10 Years
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Zonal Sales Manager
  
  
****About The Role****
Marut Drones is looking for an experienced
**Institutional Sales Manager to drive business with Government Departments, PSUs, Defence Organizations, Police & Law Enforcement Agencies, public institutions and other large institutional customers**
. The primary objective of this role is to identify business opportunities, build strong customer relationships, develop key accounts, manage the sales pipeline and convert opportunities into orders and revenue.
  
  
The candidate should have strong experience in Government or Institutional Sales, preferably in drones, agricultural equipment, defence/security solutions, surveillance systems, technology products or related sectors.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Institutional Sales & Business Development**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities across Government Departments, PSUs and institutional customers.
* Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers, government officials, procurement stakeholders and technical teams.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable Marut Drones products and solutions.
* Develop new institutional accounts and expand business from existing customers.
* Conduct regular customer meetings, follow-ups and opportunity reviews.
* Manage opportunities from initial engagement through commercial discussion and order closure.
* Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline aligned with assigned targets.

**Key Account Management**

* Manage strategic Government and Institutional accounts within the assigned territory.
* Develop account-wise business plans and identify opportunities for repeat orders and account expansion.
* Maintain strong long-term relationships with customers and key stakeholders.
* Act as the primary sales contact for assigned institutional customers.
* Ensure regular engagement with customers throughout the sales and order lifecycle.

**Product Presentations & Demonstrations**

* Conduct product presentations, demonstrations, trials and customer meetings.
* Understand operational requirements and propose appropriate drone solutions.
* Coordinate demonstrations and Proof of Concept activities wherever required.
* Gather customer feedback and communicate relevant requirements internally.
* Work closely with technical and operational teams to address customer requirements.

**Commercial & Opportunity Management**

* Prepare and present commercial proposals in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Participate in pricing discussions and commercial negotiations.
* Understand Government procurement processes, GeM and institutional purchasing requirements.
* Coordinate required commercial and procurement-related inputs for opportunities.
* Maintain visibility on opportunity value, expected closure dates and customer decision timelines.

**Order Execution & Collections**

* Coordinate with relevant teams after order confirmation to support smooth execution.
* Maintain regular communication with customers regarding order progress and commitments.
* Follow up for timely invoicing, payment realization and outstanding collections.
* Support resolution of customer issues related to order execution and commercial commitments.

**Market Development**

* Identify emerging applications and business opportunities for drone solutions.
* Track market developments, customer requirements and competitor activities.
* Develop new institutional markets and customer segments.
* Provide regular market and customer feedback to management.
* Identify opportunities to increase Marut Drones' presence within key Government and Institutional accounts.

**CRM & Sales Reporting**

* Maintain accurate customer and opportunity information in CRM.
* Update sales pipeline, expected order values and closure timelines regularly.
* Prepare periodic reports on customer meetings, opportunities, orders and collections.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts and account plans.

****Required Qualifications & Experience****

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology or a related discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Sales, Marketing, or Business Management is preferred.
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in Government Sales, Institutional Sales, B2G Sales or Key Account Management.
* Experience dealing with Government Departments, PSUs, Defence, Police, Law Enforcement Agencies or large institutional customers is preferred.
* Experience in drones, defence/security equipment, surveillance solutions, technology products or related industries will be an advantage.
* Proven experience managing high-value institutional sales opportunities.
* Good understanding of Government procurement processes and platforms such as GeM is preferred.
* Experience managing the complete sales cycle from opportunity identification to order closure and payment realization.

****Key Skills Required****

* Government & Institutional Sales
* B2G Business Development
* Key Account Management
* Customer & Stakeholder Relationship Management
* Sales Pipeline Management
* Opportunity Development & Conversion
* Commercial Negotiation
* Product Presentation & Demonstration
* CRM & Sales Forecasting
* Market Development
* Cross-Functional Coordination
* Communication & Presentation Skills
* Order Closure & Payment Follow-Up

****About Marut Drones****
Marut Dronetech Pvt Ltd is a leading Indian drone technology company focused on developing and deploying advanced unmanned aerial solutions across agriculture, public safety, disaster response, logistics, and environmental restoration. With a strong emphasis on indigenous innovation and real-world problem solving, Marut Drones combines engineering excellence with field-driven insights to create scalable and reliable drone ecosystems.

title: Growth & Marketing Executive (Founder's Associate)
description:
Growth & Marketing Executive (Founder's Office)

**Company:**
AataBox

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Job Type:**
3-Month Contract (Potential Full-Time Opportunity)

**Experience:**
6 years +

**Work Mode:**
On-site / Field-based as required

About AataBox

AataBox is an early-stage gaming startup building exciting, interactive arcade gaming experiences designed to bring people together through fun and friendly competition.

We're developing our own arcade gaming machines and games for events, parties, entertainment venues, and other social spaces.

As we prepare to launch, we're looking for an energetic, creative, and resourceful individual to work closely with the founder and help bring AataBox to market.

About the Role

This is a hands-on, multifaceted role for someone who enjoys wearing multiple hats.

You'll help us find our first customers, build our brand, identify new business opportunities, plan marketing campaigns, organize events, and coordinate activities involved in bringing our arcade gaming machines to market.

We're looking for a self-starter who can take an idea, figure out what needs to be done, and make it happen.

Key Responsibilities

**Growth & Customer Acquisition**

* Identify potential customers, partners, and venues for AataBox.
* Reach out to event organizers, party planners, gaming venues, malls, resorts, residential communities, and corporate event companies.
* Generate leads, build relationships, and help secure initial customers and bookings.
* Identify new revenue opportunities and creative ways to reach our target audience.

**Marketing & Brand Development**

* Help develop and execute our initial go-to-market (GTM) strategy.
* Create and coordinate marketing materials, presentations, brochures, flyers, and social media content.
* Identify advertising opportunities, promotional channels, and potential brand partnerships.
* Bring creativity and a good visual sense to our branding and marketing efforts.

**Events & Exhibitions**

* Research relevant exhibitions, carnivals, festivals, and promotional events where AataBox can participate.
* Coordinate with event organizers and manage participation logistics.
* Plan and oversee exhibition booths, branding, promotional displays, and event activities.
* Help execute events and convert visitor interest into business opportunities.

**Prototype & Production Coordination**

* Assist in coordinating the development and production of our arcade gaming cabinet prototypes.
* Communicate with fabricators, vendors, designers, and suppliers.
* Follow up on procurement, fabrication, deliveries, and production timelines.
* Help resolve coordination issues and keep activities moving forward.

**What We're Looking For**

* Ideally 1–3 years of experience in marketing, business development, events, operations, or related roles.
* Experience in at least some of the responsibilities listed above.
* Good communication, networking, and organizational skills.
* Creative thinking and a good eye for design and visual presentation.
* Basic familiarity with Canva, PowerPoint, or similar design tools is an advantage.
* Comfortable meeting customers, visiting venues, coordinating vendors, and working on the ground.
* Self-driven, proactive, resourceful, and comfortable working in an early-stage startup.

You don't need experience in everything listed above. We value initiative, adaptability, creativity, and the ability to get things done.

**What We Offer**

* An opportunity to work directly with the founder and help build a consumer entertainment brand from the ground up.
* Exposure to marketing, business development, events, product development, and startup operations.
* Freedom to contribute ideas, experiment, and take ownership of initiatives.
* An initial
  **3-month contract**
  , with the possibility of transitioning into a full-time position depending on performance and the company's business progress.
* Compensation based on experience and capabilities.

How to Apply

Share your resume along with a brief introduction explaining why you'd be interested in working with an early-stage startup like AataBox.

* We're looking for someone who enjoys creating things, meeting people, solving problems, and making things happen.

title: Brand Manager
description:
**About Roligt Foods**

Roligt Foods is building a next gen clean label beverage brand out of Hyderabad. We make drinks with short, honest ingredient lists and nothing we cannot defend. We are pre-launch, running live activations across the city and rolling out smart vending kiosks. As we scale, we are building a small team that owns outcomes, not tasks.

**Role Description**

The Brand Manager takes our brand from agency deck to market. Based in Hyderabad, you work with the branding agency, the events team, the video editor and leadership. Packaging, content, launch and the brand voice on every surface go through you. This is our first brand hire, and it suits someone who wants to launch a brand, not maintain one.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Work with the branding agency to land identity, packaging and the launch campaign.
2. Own brand guidelines across every touchpoint: kiosk screens, stalls, social and pack.
3. Run the content calendar across Instagram, WhatsApp and kiosk screens.
4. Brief and review the video editor and other creative partners.
5. Plan BTL campaigns with the events team.
6. Plan the launch across quick commerce, modern trade and our own channels.
7. Track brand and campaign performance. Report monthly.

**The Ideal Candidate Will Have**

1. 2 to 5 years in brand or marketing at an FMCG, F&B or D2C brand. Launch experience is a strong plus.
2. Experience managing agencies and production.
3. Strong copy judgement and a clear point of view.
4. Working knowledge of FSSAI rules on packaging and advertising claims.
5. High ownership and comfort with ambiguity.

**What We Offer**

1. **Fair, competitive compensation.**

   Pay is in line with industry standards and based on your experience, capability and track record. Strong performers grow faster than a standard annual cycle.
2. **Fast-track growth.**

   You work directly with the leadership team and see how a consumer brand is built from zero. Good people grow into bigger roles as the business scales.
3. **Broad exposure.**

   You see product, brand, events, retail and operations, not one narrow slice.
4. **Real ownership.**

   Small team, fast decisions. Your work shows up in the numbers.

﻿

**Please Do Not Apply If**

1. You are not based in, or willing to relocate to, Hyderabad.
2. You prefer a large brand team with fixed processes.
3. You are not comfortable being hands-on with execution.

*We are selective about who we hire. If you do not hear back within three weeks of applying, please assume your application has not been taken forward this time.*

title: Senior Manager, Growth and Commercial Delivery
description:
**Opportunity Overview**
We are seeking a high-caliber, results-oriented
**Senior Manager, Growth and Commercial Delivery**
to sit at the intersection of sales, account management, and implementation. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end commercial lifecycle for health plan (payer) clients—from driving growth and supporting late-stage sales cycles to leading complex, cross-functional implementations. You will be responsile for ensuring that our commercial commitments translate into operational success and long-term revenue growth.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Growth & Commercial Strategy: Partner with executive leadership and sales teams to accelerate the growth pipeline, design commercial proposals, and define go-to-market strategies for health plan clients.
* Deal-to-Delivery Transition: Serve as the primary bridge between the sales pipeline and operations, owning the transition from contract signing to live operational delivery.
* Implementation & Delivery Leadership: Oversee cross-functional teams (including Product, Engineering, Clinical, and Data Science) to deploy our AI-driven utilization management solutions on time, within scope, and aligned with client metrics.
* Relationship Management: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives and clinical leaders at partner health plans, managing governance structures and steering committees.
* Value Realization & Retention: Define, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) and clinical value metrics to prove ROI, drive contract renewals, and identify upsell opportunities.
* Process Scaling: Build and refine repeatable playbooks, governance models, and delivery frameworks to support rapid company scaling.

**ISMS Roles And Responsibilities**

* Good knowledge of Information security

title: Senior Manager Talent Acquisition
description:
**Associate Manager, Talent Sourcing (GBS)**

About Randstad Enterprise

As the leading global talent solutions provider, Randstad Enterprise enables companies to create sustainable business value and agility by keeping people at the heart of their organizations. Part of Randstad N.V., we combine unmatched talent data and market insights with smart technologies and deep people expertise. Our integrated talent solutions — delivered by Randstad Advisory, Randstad Sourceright and Randstad RiseSmart — help companies build skilled and agile workforces that move their businesses forward. Randstad Enterprise supports some of the world's most renowned brands to build their talent acquisition and management models that not only meet their business needs today but also in the future. We offer solutions in Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA) region, Asia Pacific (APAC) region as well as in North America (NAM) region. This results in a digital way of working and requires a proactive mind-set.

● Our solutions know no limits, we have proven experience delivering market-leading MSP, RPO, Total Talent, and Services Procurement Solutions including technology, talent marketing, talent intelligence, and workforce consulting services.

● We create the best talent experience, from attraction to onboarding and onto ongoing career development, we understand the human and digital touchpoints that compel talent to join and stay with a company.

● We know where the talent of tomorrow is, how they behave, what they are looking for, and how to build their loyalty toward a specific company employer brand.

● We push the boundaries of our industry to be able to see around the corner for our clients, continually investing in innovation to stay ahead in our market.

**About Team**

Our team is a group of talented and dedicated professionals who are passionate about our work and committed to delivering exceptional results. We are a global group that values collaboration, open communication, and a supportive work environment. Our team is responsible for Full Life Cycle Recruiting and Recruiting Operations for partnering with a global fortune-500 client and we take pride in the important role we play in achieving the goals of our client's business. We are a diverse group with a range of skills and backgrounds, and we believe that our differences make us stronger. We are committed to fostering a culture of learning and growth, and we encourage each other to take on new challenges and develop our skills. We believe in working hard and having fun, and we enjoy celebrating our successes together as a team.

Purpose of the Role

● Develops sourcing strategies that enhance candidate experience, ensuring a personalized approach to project-based job opportunities.

● Works closely with the clients' hiring teams, ensuring all KPIs and SLA requirements regarding order-based sourcing and talent conversion from passive candidates are met.

● Monitors and analyzes recruitment metrics and data to identify areas for improvement and optimize the recruitment process for passive and active candidates, considering candidates with limited online presence.

● Stays informed of industry best practices and trends in the career/hiring space, continually assessing where Randstad can tap into project-based jobs.

● Leads sourcing activities/projects and drives to meet the key metrics goals as set by leadership, focusing on proactive engagement and headhunting of passive talent.

● Drives continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing sourcing efficiency and effectiveness.

● Manages candidates and ensures that the most qualified candidates are shortlisted for clients' short-term engagements.

**Key Responsibilities**

● SLA & KPI Management: You will track the team's daily and monthly hiring targets. You'll look at the data to make sure candidates are moving through the hiring stages quickly and efficiently.

● Capacity & Demand Planning: You will look at incoming hiring requests and assign work to your team fairly, making sure they can handle sudden rushes of new job openings.

● Upskilling & Mentorship: You will coach and train your team members to improve their sourcing skills, teaching them how to find hard-to-reach tech professionals.

● Advanced Sourcing Frameworks: You will build smart plans to find passive candidates (people who aren't actively looking for a job) for complex IT roles like Cloud, Infrastructure, and Security.

● AI & Tech Stack Optimization: You will guide the team on how to best use modern recruitment tools, databases, and AI sourcing technology to work faster and smarter.

● Process Agility & Continuous Improvement: You will find ways to fix delays or blockers in the sourcing process so everything runs smoothly and quickly.

● Client & Stakeholder Management: You will work closely with the client’s hiring managers, sharing updates regularly, building strong relationships, and making sure we meet their expectations.

● Quality Assurance: You will check the quality of candidates your team finds to ensure only the best-vetted profiles are sent to the client.

Grade Descriptor

● Good understanding of procedures and concepts within own discipline and knowledge of these elements in other disciplines.

● Provides management and operational oversight to large and/or moderately complex business or technical support team members, potentially including work leaders.

● Sets priorities for the team to ensure task completion; coordinates work activities with other supervisors/team leaders.

● Responsible for end results of the team.

● Provides input on resource planning, guidelines, processes and procedures.

● Solves problems guided by policies and procedures; receives guidance from manager.

Business Development Manager – US IT Staffing & Client Acquisition

**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Work arrangement:** Full-time, office-based  
**Market:** United States  
**Experience:** Preferably 3–7 years in US IT staffing business development or client acquisition  
**Working hours:** Must overlap with US business hours; night-shift availability required.

Role Objective

Softcom is looking for a results-driven Business Development Manager to acquire new US clients and staffing partners. The individual will own the client acquisition process, from prospect outreach and relationship development to vendor onboarding, MSA execution and obtaining active staffing requirements.

AI-assisted lead generation is already available. This role is focused on converting researched prospects into business opportunities, not merely collecting leads.

Key Responsibilities1. Direct Client Acquisition

* Identify and establish relationships with US companies requiring IT staffing services.
* Reach hiring managers, talent acquisition leaders, HR leaders and procurement decision-makers.
* Conduct cold calls, personalized email campaigns and LinkedIn outreach.
* Present Softcom’s capabilities and develop long-term client relationships.
* Secure new accounts and obtain active staffing requirements.

2. Staffing Partner and Prime Contractor Development

* Build relationships with US staffing firms, recruitment vendors and prime contractors.
* Identify subcontracting and vendor partnership opportunities.
* Complete vendor registration and onboarding processes.
* Negotiate and coordinate MSAs and other required agreements.
* Develop recurring sources of qualified staffing requirements.

3. Opportunity Conversion

* Review qualified company and hiring intelligence generated through Softcom’s AI-assisted research process.
* Identify the appropriate decision-makers and personalize the outreach strategy.
* Schedule discovery meetings and conduct follow-ups.
* Move prospects through the pipeline: contacted, engaged, meeting, vendor onboarding, agreement signed and active requirements received.
* Coordinate with recruitment to ensure smooth handoff of requirements.

4. Pipeline Management and Reporting

* Maintain an accurate prospect and opportunity tracker.
* Record all outreach, conversations, meetings, follow-ups and next steps.
* Provide daily activity reports and weekly pipeline reviews.
* Report measurable progress in client acquisition, agreements, active requirements and revenue potential.

Initial Performance Expectations

* 15–20 personalized emails per working day.
* 15–20 LinkedIn outreach activities per working day.
* 15–25 cold calls per working day.
* 3–5 meaningful prospect conversations per day as an initial target.
* 4–6 qualified client meetings during the first 30 days.
* Build a measurable pipeline of new client and staffing-partner opportunities.
* Work toward obtaining 1–2 genuine staffing requirements within the first 30 days, recognizing that results depend on the sales cycle and market response.

Targets will be reviewed against lead quality, conversion rates and actual progress.

Required Experience and Skills

* Proven experience in US IT staffing business development or new client acquisition.
* Experience with cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn prospecting and relationship building.
* Familiarity with US staffing vendors, direct clients and vendor onboarding processes.
* Understanding of staffing agreements, MSAs, subcontracting and staffing requirements.
* Excellent spoken and written English.
* Strong follow-up discipline, negotiation skills and ability to handle rejection.
* Ability to work independently and meet measurable targets.

Preferred Qualifications

* Existing relationships with US staffing companies or direct clients.
* Experience with prime contractors, federal contractors, MSPs or VMS programs.
* Experience using CRM systems, LinkedIn Sales Navigator or similar sales tools.

Success Measures

The successful candidate will be evaluated on qualified meetings, new client relationships, vendor onboarding, executed agreements, active staffing requirements and eventual revenue—not simply the number of calls or emails sent.

**This is a client acquisition role. The primary responsibility is to bring new business to Softcom.**

title: Performance Marketing Executive
description:
Job description:

# Hiring: Performance Marketing Specialist / Manager

\*\*Company:\*\* Absolute Marketing Agency

\*\*Location:\*\* Hyderabad, Telangana

\*\*Experience:\*\* Minimum 2+ years of relevant hands-on experience

\*\*Department:\*\* Marketing & Growth

\*\*Reports to:\*\* Head of Marketing

## About Absolute Marketing Agency

Absolute Marketing Agency helps businesses grow through performance marketing, creative campaigns, content and digital marketing. Our team includes content creators, video editors, graphic designers, project management and business development professionals.

We are looking for an experienced Performance Marketing Specialist / Manager who can independently manage paid advertising campaigns, improve lead generation and deliver measurable results for our clients.

This is a hands-on execution role. We need someone who understands the numbers behind campaigns, takes ownership of performance and can work closely with our marketing and creative teams.

## Key Responsibilities

### 1. Paid Advertising

- Plan, set up and manage Meta Ads campaigns across Facebook and Instagram.

- Manage Google Ads campaigns, including Search and other relevant campaign types where appropriate.

- Handle campaign structure, audience targeting, budgets, bidding, placements, retargeting and optimization.

- Monitor daily spend, cost per lead, conversion rates, lead quality and return on ad spend.

- Identify underperforming campaigns and take corrective action.

- Scale campaigns that consistently deliver results while staying within approved budgets.

- Manage campaigns across multiple clients and industries simultaneously.

### 2. Lead Generation and Conversion Tracking

- Build and optimize lead generation campaigns using Meta Instant Forms, landing pages and WhatsApp where appropriate.

- Ensure leads are delivered correctly to the designated Google Sheets, CRM or other approved destinations.

- Monitor tracking and troubleshoot issues involving pixels, conversion events, GTM, GA4 and platform integrations.

- Analyze lead quality, not just lead volume or low cost per lead.

- Work with the client-facing and sales teams to understand which leads convert and use that feedback to improve campaigns.

### 3. Campaign Reporting and Analytics

- Monitor campaigns daily and maintain an accurate campaign performance tracker.

- Prepare weekly performance updates by Saturday afternoon.

- Prepare monthly client performance reports by the agreed deadlines.

- Report spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, CPL, conversion rates and ROAS where relevant.

- Explain what worked, what failed, why performance changed and what actions should follow.

- Make data-backed recommendations instead of reporting numbers without analysis.

### 4. Creative Strategy and Testing

- Develop clear advertising briefs for the creative team.

- Identify suitable hooks, messaging, offers, formats and calls to action.

- Work with designers, video editors and content creators to develop performance-focused ad creatives.

- Test different creative concepts, audiences, landing pages and offers systematically.

- Use campaign results to inform the next round of creative production.

- Maintain a structured record of tests, learnings and winning creatives.

### 5. SEO and Local SEO

- Execute keyword research, on-page SEO and local SEO tasks where assigned.

- Manage Google Business Profile updates and monitor local rankings.

- Identify technical and on-page issues and coordinate website fixes with the development team.

- Track relevant keywords, competitor activity and organic search performance.

### 6. Absolute Marketing Agency's Own Growth

- Manage approved paid campaigns for Absolute Marketing Agency.

- Support lead generation for the agency's own sales pipeline.

- Test campaign offers and creatives to attract qualified business prospects.

- Coordinate with the business development team to ensure leads are handed over properly.

### 7. Account Management and Process Discipline

- Maintain a central tracker of campaigns, budgets, results, account ownership and lead destinations.

- Document campaign settings, tracking configurations and key optimization decisions.

- Follow access-control and data-security procedures for all client accounts.

- Flag campaign risks, overspending, tracking failures and lead-delivery issues immediately.

- Work under the direction of the Head of Marketing, with approvals required for material budget changes.

## Required Skills and Experience

- Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns.

- Strong practical experience with Meta Ads Manager.

- Demonstrable experience with Google Ads, or the ability to show strong relevant campaign results across the platforms required for the role.

- Experience managing lead generation campaigns for businesses.

- Good understanding of conversion tracking, pixels, GA4, GTM and campaign analytics.

- Strong understanding of CPL, CPA, CTR, CPC, conversion rates, ROAS and lead quality.

- Ability to interpret campaign data and turn it into actionable decisions.

- Experience working with creative teams to improve ad performance.

- Strong spreadsheet skills and reporting discipline.

- Ability to manage multiple client accounts, prioritize work and meet deadlines.

- Clear written communication and a high level of ownership.

## Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in a digital marketing agency.

- Experience across multiple industries and local lead generation businesses.

- Experience with landing page optimization, retargeting and funnel analysis.

- Experience with CRM integrations, Google Sheets lead flows and marketing automation.

- Experience with Google Business Profile and Local SEO.

- A portfolio of campaigns showing measurable business outcomes.

## What Success Looks Like

- Campaigns launch correctly and on schedule.

- No unplanned budget overspend.

- Lead destinations and tracking remain functional.

- CPL and lead quality improve against agreed baselines and targets.

- Campaigns are optimized using actual data and sales feedback.

- Weekly and monthly reports are delivered on time.

- Winning creatives and audiences are identified through structured testing.

- Absolute Marketing Agency generates qualified leads through its own campaigns.

- Every account has documented settings, results and operational handover information.

Candidates should be able to explain their own contribution to the results, not just present screenshots from an advertising dashboard.

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

We are looking for a responsible, organised and proactive Operations Executive to coordinate nurses and attendants, manage deployments, communicate with patient families and ensure smooth daily operations.

* Handle service concerns calmly, document complaints and escalate clinical or serious operational issues promptly.
* Keep CRM records, deployment trackers and daily reports accurate and up to date.
* Coordinate with clinical, equipment, sales and accounts teams whenever required.
* Build professional relationships with reliable freelancers to encourage repeat assignments.
* Maintain confidentiality of patient, family and staff information at all times.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Graduate in any discipline; healthcare-related qualifications are an advantage.
* Strong communication in Hindi and working English; Marathi is an advantage.
* Comfortable making calls, following up and managing multiple assignments.
* Working knowledge of Excel, Google Sheets, WhatsApp and basic CRM systems.
* Ability to remain calm during cancellations, complaints and urgent staffing requirements.
* Empathy towards patients and families, with strong ownership of assigned work.
* Willingness to support a roster-based operation, including agreed weekend or escalation duties.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Timely deployment of suitable staff.
* Accurate attendance and assignment records.
* Prompt coordination of replacements.
* Clear communication with families and staff.
* Growth and retention of a dependable freelancer network.
* Timely escalation and follow-through on service concerns.

Work directly with the management team, take ownership of meaningful healthcare operations and build your career in home patient management.

Apply through Indeed with your updated CV, and mention your current location, relevant experience, expected salary and notice period or earliest joining date.
