description:
Sales Executive – Showroom

Hakimi Oud & Perfumes · Mumbai · 23 Oct 2026

About Hakimi

Hakimi Oud & Perfumes is the retail house of A. Kaderali & Co., a Mumbai trading firm founded in 1938. The firm began in spices and herbs and grew into perfumery; Hakimi was launched in 2021 as its retail brand.

We make Arabian-quality perfumery from an Indian house: oud oils, attars, musks, perfumes and bakhoor, sold to customers in India and the Gulf.

The role

We are hiring one target-driven Sales Executive to own evening sales at our Mumbai showroom, 1 pm to 10 pm. These are the busiest hours of our day.

Your job is to turn walk-ins into buyers, raise the value of every bill, and turn first-time buyers into repeat clients. This is a selling role, not a counter role: your earnings grow with what you sell.

Key responsibilities

* **Close sales:** greet every walk-in promptly, understand what they want, guide them through scent trials and close the sale.
* **Sell the full range:** oud oils, attars, musks, perfumes, bakhoor and gift sets, matching the right size and price to each customer.
* **Raise every bill:** suggest add-ons, larger sizes, combinations and gift packing.
* **Build your client book:** with the customer's consent, record name and WhatsApp number for every buyer; follow up after purchase and invite them back for launches and festival seasons.
* **Capture bulk and gifting enquiries:** take full details of wedding, corporate and bulk orders and hand them over the same day.
* **Bill correctly:** bill every sale on the store billing system under your own salesperson code. No unbilled sales, ever.
* **Respect discount limits:** give discounts only within the limits set by management; any exception needs approval before the bill.
* **Keep the floor ready:** displays, testers and shelves full, clean and presentable through the shift.
* **Know the product:** notes, origin, strength and lasting power of every key fragrance.
* **Report daily:** close each shift with a short report of bills, sales value, walk-ins, new contacts and fast-moving stock.
* **Peak seasons:** extra hours during Ramadan, Eid, Milad, Diwali and wedding season, planned in advance.

How performance is measured

You will be judged on sales results, not effort. Your monthly target is given in writing at joining, with a lower target in the first two months while you learn the range.

Measure

What it means

Monthly sales vs target

Your billed sales after discounts and returns

Walk-ins converted

How many visitors you turn into buyers

Average bill value

Rupees per bill

Repeat clients

Buyers from your client book who come back

Billing and discount discipline

Every sale billed under your code; no unapproved discounts

Targets are reviewed every quarter.

Who we're looking for

We want a proven closer with at least 2 years of target-based retail selling.

**Must have**

* 2+ years in retail sales with a monthly target: fragrance, attar, jewellery, watches, cosmetics, apparel or other premium retail.
* A record of hitting targets, with numbers you can share.
* Comfortable in Hindi and Gujarati; workable English.
* Confident and persistent with customers, without being pushy; comfortable asking for the sale.
* Presentable, punctual and fully honest with cash and stock.
* At ease with a smartphone, WhatsApp and a billing screen.
* Available for the 1 pm to 10 pm shift, including weekends and festival days.

**Good to have**

* Knowledge of oud, attars or perfume oils.
* Arabic or Urdu, for our Gulf customers.
* An existing customer network in the area.
* Experience handling bulk, wedding or corporate gifting orders.

Shift, location and pay

Fixed pay is ₹18,000 to ₹25,000 a month, plus a monthly sales incentive with no upper limit.

description:
**Role Overview**

The Executive Assistant will act as the CEO’s right hand, managing day-to-day priorities, coordinating with internal teams, tracking important tasks and ensuring timely follow-ups across departments.

This role requires someone who can anticipate requirements, handle confidential information, communicate professionally and bring structure to a fast-moving business environment.

The ideal candidate is not someone who simply takes instructions, but someone who takes ownership, follows through and ensures that nothing important slips through the cracks.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Calendar and Time Management**

* Manage the CEO’s daily calendar, appointments, meetings and commitments.
* Schedule internal and external meetings, ensuring adequate preparation and time allocation.
* Coordinate travel arrangements, hotel bookings, itineraries and meeting schedules for domestic and international travel.
* Prioritise requests and help the CEO focus on the most important business activities.
* Maintain a daily agenda and share a concise schedule and priority list with the CEO.

**2. Coordination with Department Heads**

* Coordinate with project management, design, production, accounts, sales, operations and administration teams.
* Follow up with department heads on pending tasks, commitments and deadlines assigned by the CEO.
* Maintain a central tracker of important action items and escalate delays or unresolved issues.
* Ensure that instructions given during meetings are communicated clearly and acted upon.
* Help the CEO monitor progress on key business priorities without getting involved in routine execution.

**3. Meeting Management and Follow-ups**

* Prepare meeting agendas, briefing notes and relevant documents.
* Record meeting minutes, decisions, responsibilities and deadlines.
* Circulate action points to the concerned team members and follow up until closure.
* Prepare a daily or weekly summary of pending decisions and overdue tasks.
* Organise documents and information required for client meetings, internal reviews and business discussions.

**4. Business and Administrative Support**

* Draft and review professional emails, letters, WhatsApp messages and internal communications.
* Prepare presentations, reports, spreadsheets and summaries as required.
* Coordinate with clients, vendors, consultants and other business stakeholders on behalf of the CEO.
* Assist with documentation, approvals, quotations, payment follow-ups and other matters requiring the CEO’s attention.
* Maintain an organised digital filing system for important business documents.
* Support special projects, business initiatives and assignments delegated by the CEO.

**5. CEO’s Office and Priority Management**

* Maintain a master task tracker covering the CEO’s key priorities and outstanding commitments.
* Identify pending approvals, delayed responses and tasks requiring intervention.
* Prepare a daily briefing highlighting the CEO’s priorities, urgent matters and important updates.
* Ensure that important communications are brought to the CEO’s attention promptly.
* Anticipate requirements and resolve routine coordination issues independently wherever authorised.

**6. Confidentiality and Professional Conduct**

* Handle sensitive business, financial, employee and client information with discretion.
* Maintain professionalism when interacting with senior management, clients and external stakeholders.
* Exercise sound judgement when prioritising communications and sharing information.
* Maintain accurate records and ensure that confidential documents are handled appropriately.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Management or a related field preferred.
* 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Management Assistant, Executive Coordinator or in a similar role.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook and Google Workspace.
* Ability to prepare professional emails, presentations, trackers and reports.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and follow-up discipline.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities and work with tight deadlines.
* Professional conduct, discretion and the ability to handle confidential information.
* Comfortable coordinating with multiple departments and senior stakeholders.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

*The ideal candidate will be:*

* **Proactive:** Identifies pending matters and follows up without being reminded.
* **Highly organised:** Keeps calendars, tasks, documents and commitments in order.
* **Assertive yet diplomatic:** Can follow up with senior team members professionally and firmly.
* **Solutions-oriented:** Brings solutions instead of merely reporting problems.
* **Dependable:** Ensures commitments are tracked and completed.
* **Tech-savvy:** Comfortable using spreadsheets, task management tools and AI tools to improve productivity.
* **Trustworthy:** Understands the importance of confidentiality and professional boundaries.
* **Adaptable:** Comfortable working in a growing, owner-led business where priorities can change quickly.

**What We Offer**

* Direct exposure to the CEO and senior-level business decisions.
* An opportunity to work closely with the leadership of an established and growing business.
* Scope to take ownership of the CEO’s office and progressively assume greater responsibility.
* A professional environment that values accountability, initiative and execution.

title: (VF-JA) Learning & Development Manager
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About The Role**
------------------

We are seeking an experienced Talent, Learning & Performance Business Partner to translate business strategy and workforce priorities into integrated capability plans that enable organisational performance, future skills development and transformation outcomes. The role partners with senior business leaders and HR stakeholders to diagnose capability needs, shape talent and learning priorities, and ensure the successful adoption and evaluation of capability interventions across a global and matrix environment.

Location: India, Egypt or Hungary

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Build trusted partnerships with business leaders and HR partners to understand strategic priorities, transformation plans and workforce implications.
* Diagnose current and future talent, performance, leadership, learning and skills requirements using business and people insights.
* Develop and own integrated capability plans with clear priorities, outcomes, measures and dependencies.
* Translate business demand into strategic briefs and connect stakeholders to the appropriate Centres of Expertise.
* Provide evidence-based advice on options, trade-offs, priorities and sequencing of talent and capability initiatives.
* Identify, assess and escalate workforce, talent, skills and capability risks.
* Drive stakeholder engagement, sponsorship and adoption of agreed interventions.
* Evaluate programme adoption, application and business impact, using insights to improve future capability planning.
* Use workforce, learning and people data responsibly, ensuring privacy, fairness, transparency and appropriate human oversight.
* Lead quarterly capability reviews, supporting decision-making, prioritisation and continuous improvement.

**Who you are**
---------------

* Experienced in talent, learning, leadership, performance and skills-related practices within complex organisations.
* Skilled in capability consulting and organisational diagnosis, with the ability to identify root causes and define integrated solutions.
* Experienced in strategic workforce planning and translating business priorities into workforce and capability plans.
* Proficient in learning needs analysis, performance consulting and intervention evaluation.
* Strong analytical and data storytelling capabilities, using evidence to influence decisions and demonstrate measurable outcomes.
* Effective at building credibility and influencing senior stakeholders across global and matrix environments.
* Knowledgeable in responsible AI, privacy, fairness and ethical use of people data.
* Demonstrated strengths in strategic thinking, commercial awareness, facilitation, collaboration, change leadership and delivery excellence.
* Experience working within transformation-focused and multinational organisations is highly desirable.
* Relevant professional qualification or equivalent professional experience.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

* Opportunity to influence workforce capability and organisational transformation at scale.
* Exposure to senior business leaders and strategic decision-making processes.
* Work across diverse international markets and functions within a global organisation.
* Contribute to future skills, leadership and performance initiatives that drive measurable business outcomes.
* Operate in a collaborative environment focused on innovation, technology, data and continuous improvement.

**Not a perfect fit?**

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What Skills You will learn**
------------------------------

* Advanced strategic workforce planning and capability consulting.
* Organisational diagnosis and evidence-based decision-making.
* Stakeholder management and executive-level influencing.
* Talent, learning, leadership and performance integration methodologies.
* Data-led workforce insights and impact measurement.
* Responsible AI application, governance and ethical people data practices.
* Change leadership and large-scale transformation delivery.

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------

At Vodafone, we’re not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we’re shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.

title: Retail Operations Executive (On-Field)
description:
**Location:** Mumbai | Full-time | On-field

Company Description

Hullo is a clean-label food brand on a mission to make honest, thoughtful nutrition accessible to everyone. Born from a parent's struggle to find convenient yet nutritious snacks for children, Hullo creates delicious products using real, recognisable kitchen ingredients, without artificial preservatives or additives.

We're growing our presence across retail stores in Mumbai and are looking for someone who can ensure our products receive the visibility, attention, and care they deserve.

Role Description

We're looking for an energetic, proactive, and organised **Retail Operations & Merchandising Executive** to manage Hullo's presence across existing retail stores.

This is an on-field role focused on visiting retail outlets where Hullo products are already available, ensuring proper product placement, maintaining strong retailer relationships, coordinating in-store promotional activities, and monitoring product availability and performance.

**This is not a traditional sales role focused on cold calling or acquiring new retailers.** The primary responsibility is to strengthen our existing retail presence, improve in-store execution, and ensure our products are consistently visible, well-stocked, and presented correctly.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Retail Store Visits & Merchandising**

* Visit assigned retail outlets regularly to monitor Hullo's product presence.
* Ensure products are displayed neatly, prominently, and according to brand guidelines.
* Check shelf placement, product visibility, pricing labels, and promotional displays.
* Identify opportunities to improve product positioning and visibility within stores.
* Ensure products are clean, undamaged, and displayed with appropriate branding.

**2. Retailer Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with store owners, managers, and retail staff.
* Conduct regular follow-ups with existing retail partners.
* Address retailer concerns regarding product availability, deliveries, displays, and other operational issues.
* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve retailer queries and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.
* Gather feedback from retailers and store staff about customer preferences and product performance.

**3. Stock Monitoring & Replenishment**

* Monitor product availability and stock levels at retail outlets.
* Identify low-stock, out-of-stock, slow-moving, and near-expiry products.
* Coordinate replenishment requirements with the internal sales and dispatch teams.
* Ensure proper stock rotation and adherence to FEFO (First Expiry, First Out).
* Track product movement and share updates on store-level performance.

**4. In-Store Promotions & Brand Activities**

* Coordinate and execute product sampling, tasting sessions, and other promotional activities at retail outlets.
* Ensure promotional materials, display stands, and point-of-sale branding are placed correctly.
* Work with the marketing team to execute in-store campaigns and product launches.
* Educate store staff about Hullo's products, ingredients, flavours, and key differentiators.
* Gather customer reactions and feedback during sampling activities.

**5. Retail Audits & Reporting**

* Take photographs of product displays and share regular store visit updates.
* Maintain records of store visits, stock availability, product placement, and retailer feedback.
* Monitor competitor product placement, pricing, promotions, and in-store visibility.
* Identify issues affecting product visibility or movement and recommend improvements.
* Prepare daily visit reports and coordinate follow-up actions with the team.

Required Skills

* Good communication and interpersonal skills, particularly when interacting with retail store owners and managers.
* Strong organisational and follow-up skills.
* Basic understanding of retail merchandising, product placement, and store operations.
* Ability to identify and resolve on-ground operational issues.
* Comfortable using WhatsApp, Google Sheets, and basic reporting tools.
* Ability to travel regularly across assigned retail locations in Mumbai.
* Proactive attitude, attention to detail, and willingness to take ownership.

Experience & Qualifications

* 0–2 years of experience in retail operations, merchandising, field marketing, FMCG, or modern trade is preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and an interest in retail operations are welcome to apply.
* Experience working with FMCG, food and beverage, D2C, or consumer brands is an advantage.
* A bachelor's degree or diploma in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field is preferred.
* Familiarity with Mumbai's retail market and modern trade stores is an added advantage.

Who We're Looking For

Someone who enjoys being on the field, interacting with people, and making things happen.

You should be observant enough to notice when a product is poorly displayed, proactive enough to get it corrected, and organised enough to ensure the issue doesn't repeat.

We're looking for someone who takes pride in how Hullo is represented in every store and understands that great retail execution is just as important as getting a product onto the shelf.

Employment Details

**Industry:** Food & Beverage / FMCG

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday

**Role Type:** Retail Operations, Merchandising & Brand Activation

Datastraw Technologies is an AI operating company that helps modern businesses scale through a combination of people, technology, data, automation and AI. We currently specialise in customer experience (CX), helping brands manage and improve their customer interactions across channels while building the systems and AI-powered solutions that make their operations faster, more efficient and scalable.

**Who We’re Looking For**

**What This Role Can Become**  
This role offers the opportunity to grow beyond recruitment execution into broader Talent, People & Culture, and talent systems ownership. As Datastraw scales, you’ll have the opportunity to help shape how we discover, evaluate, engage and hire talent.

We value people who think independently, take ownership, solve problems and keep pushing improvements forward without waiting for every step to be defined.

**Don’t just go abroad. Grow abroad.**

As Aarnell continues to expand its presence across colleges in Pune, we are looking for someone who can represent us and build meaningful relationships with students and institutions.

We are looking for an International Education Associate to lead Aarnell’s student engagement and business development efforts across colleges in Pune.

You will be the face of Aarnell on campus - building relationships with college stakeholders, engaging students, conducting counselling sessions and converting interested students into Aarnell students.

The role involves a combination of student counselling, institutional relationship management, outreach, follow-ups and sales, with significant interaction across our partner college network.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Represent Aarnell across colleges and build strong relationships with Deans, TPOs, faculty, student leaders and management.
* Engage with students through one-on-one counselling, group sessions, seminars, workshops and webinars.
* Understand students' academic, career and international education goals and provide relevant guidance.
* Generate and qualify student leads through college engagement and other outreach initiatives.
* Follow up with prospective students and drive conversions into Aarnell's programs.
* Maintain consistent communication with students and ensure timely follow-ups throughout the decision-making process.
* Coordinate and execute student engagement activities across colleges.
* Represent Aarnell at relevant educational events and networking opportunities.
* Build and nurture relationships with colleges to create long-term student engagement opportunities.

* Stay updated on international education trends, destinations, admission processes and student opportunities.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* **2–3 years of experience**
  in overseas education, education consulting, student counselling, business development or a related field.

* Strong understanding of international education and major study destinations.
* Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills.
* Confident in speaking with students as well as senior college stakeholders.
* Strong counselling, presentation and relationship-building skills.
* Comfortable with follow-ups, targets and converting prospective students into paying clients.

title: Sales Associate
description:
**Associate Sales**

**Coliving | Zolo**

**Own the cluster. Drive occupancy. Run the properties. Deliver the numbers.**

**Compensation:**
₹6.75 LPA (₹3.75 LPA Fixed + ₹3 LPA Performance-Linked Variable)

**Why this role exists**

Zolo's Coliving business operates through properties that need to perform every single day — commercially and operationally.

A property can be clean and well managed, but if beds remain vacant, the business does not perform.

It can achieve strong occupancy, but if resident experience and operations break down, customers leave.

As we scale, we need strong on-ground business owners who can bring
**Sales and Operations together**
and take responsibility for the complete performance of a cluster.

Each Cluster Business Manager will typically own
**approximately three Zolo properties**
.

This role exists to ensure that every property in the cluster:

* Maintains strong occupancy
* Converts available demand into bookings
* Creates local sales opportunities
* Delivers a strong resident experience
* Operates with discipline every day
* Resolves customer and operational issues quickly
* Has an accountable and high-performing property team

If the Cluster Business Manager is strong,
**beds get filled, residents stay, teams perform, and properties run well.**

If the Cluster Business Manager is weak,
**vacancies increase, sales opportunities get missed, complaints rise, and execution starts slipping.**

**Your mandate is clear**

* Own business performance across approximately 3 properties
* Drive Sales, bookings, and occupancy
* Convert walk-ins, leads, referrals, and local opportunities
* Identify and create new demand around your properties
* Own day-to-day property Operations
* Deliver strong resident experience and retention
* Lead and manage property-level teams
* Resolve customer and operational escalations
* Track performance numbers and take action when the cluster is behind target

This is not a property coordination role.

**You are the business owner for your cluster — responsible for both filling the properties and running them well.**

**About Zolo and Coliving**

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.

People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.

Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living by bringing together professionally managed homes, essential services, technology, and community into one seamless experience.

Z Hotels serves the modern traveller with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.

Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation — delivering experiences customers can rely on while building properties that perform sustainably.

**What you will be responsible for**

**1. Own Cluster Business Performance**

* Take ownership of business performance across approximately 3 assigned properties
* Track occupancy, bookings, vacancies, move-ins, move-outs, and other key property metrics
* Understand which properties are performing and where intervention is required
* Build clear action plans for properties falling behind target
* Balance Sales performance with strong property Operations and resident experience
* Review numbers regularly and act quickly when performance moves off track

**2. Drive Sales, Conversion & Occupancy**

* Take direct ownership of occupancy across assigned properties
* Handle property walk-ins and convert prospects into bookings
* Follow up actively with interested prospects until closure
* Coordinate closely with Inside Sales teams on leads and conversions
* Understand customer requirements and recommend the right property / offering
* Track available inventory and actively work towards filling vacant beds
* Ensure leads do not get lost because of poor follow-up or property-level execution

**3. Build Local Demand**

* Understand the micro-market around each assigned property
* Identify colleges, offices, institutions, brokers, local businesses, and other potential demand sources
* Build relationships that can generate enquiries and referrals
* Drive resident referrals and other local lead-generation initiatives
* Identify opportunities to improve property visibility in the local market
* Continuously look for new ways to generate demand rather than depending only on centrally generated leads

**4. Own Property Operations**

* Ensure smooth day-to-day Operations across assigned properties
* Maintain property readiness, cleanliness, safety, and service standards
* Ensure rooms and beds are ready for prospective and incoming residents
* Identify operational gaps and drive quick resolution
* Coordinate Housekeeping, Maintenance, Security, and other property services
* Ensure operating issues do not negatively affect Sales, occupancy, or resident experience

**5. Own Resident Experience & Retention**

* Build strong relationships with residents across the cluster
* Handle complaints and escalations with ownership and urgency
* Ensure issues are resolved completely rather than simply forwarded to another team
* Identify recurring complaints and work towards permanent solutions
* Understand reasons for dissatisfaction and potential churn
* Build resident trust through visibility, responsiveness, and consistent follow-through
* Support resident engagement and community initiatives

**6. Lead the Property Team**

* Manage property-level staff across the assigned cluster
* Set clear expectations around Sales, service, discipline, and execution
* Allocate responsibilities and ensure daily activities are completed
* Review individual and property-level performance
* Coach team members where performance needs improvement
* Address underperformance and execution gaps early
* Build a team capable of running properties consistently without constant supervision

**7. Manage Through Numbers**

* Track Sales, occupancy, conversion, vacancy, customer experience, and Operations metrics
* Maintain visibility into performance across all assigned properties
* Understand why targets are being missed rather than only reporting the gap
* Prioritise properties and issues requiring immediate intervention
* Maintain required trackers, systems, and reporting accurately
* Use numbers to decide where time and effort need to be focused

**What success looks like after 6–12 months**

* Strong and stable occupancy across assigned properties
* Consistent achievement of Sales and business targets
* Higher conversion of leads and walk-ins into bookings
* Strong local demand and referral pipeline
* Vacant beds are actively identified and worked upon
* Properties operate smoothly and consistently
* Resident complaints and recurring escalations reduce
* Resident satisfaction and retention remain strong
* Property teams have clear ownership and accountability
* Business and operational gaps are identified and corrected quickly
* The cluster performs without requiring constant intervention from senior leadership

The cluster operates through:

**Sales Hustle + Operational Discipline + Customer Ownership + Strong Execution**

**Who this role is for**

You will likely thrive here if:

* You enjoy Sales and get energy from converting opportunities
* You want your performance to directly influence what you earn
* You are comfortable being accountable for clear monthly targets
* You take ownership rather than waiting for someone to tell you what to do
* You enjoy being on the ground and interacting with customers
* You can manage both people and problems
* You are comfortable moving between multiple properties
* You can balance selling with running strong Operations
* You remain persistent when targets are difficult
* You want responsibility early in your career

**Experience we value**

We are open to
**high-potential freshers as well as candidates with 6 months – 1 year of Sales experience.**

Relevant exposure can include:

* Inside Sales
* Field Sales
* Business Development
* Real Estate / Property Sales
* Hospitality Sales
* Customer Acquisition
* Retail / High-Interaction Sales

For freshers, we will look strongly at:

* Sales orientation
* Communication and confidence
* Energy and hustle
* Comfort with targets
* Ownership mindset
* Ability to influence and convince people
* Willingness to work on ground and move across properties

**We are looking for someone who wants to sell, own outcomes, lead people, and eventually run a business — not someone looking only for an Operations role.**

**Compensation & Performance**

This is a strongly performance-linked role.

**Total Compensation: ₹6.75 LPA**

**₹3.75 LPA Fixed + ₹3 LPA Performance-Linked Variable**

The variable component will be linked to defined monthly performance outcomes.

This means strong performance has a
**direct and meaningful impact on your monthly**

**The impact you will have**

You will directly influence:

* Occupancy
* Sales & Revenue
* Lead Conversion
* Resident Experience
* Retention
* Property Operations
* Team Performance
* Cluster Business Performance

You won't own one small part of the customer journey.

**You will own what happens from prospect → booking → move-in → resident experience → retention across your cluster.**

**Why join now**

For someone early in their career, most roles ask you to execute one part of a business.

This role gives you the opportunity to
**own one.**

You will get hands-on exposure to:

**Sales + Operations + Customers + People + Business Numbers**

You will manage multiple properties, lead on-ground teams, own targets, solve customer and operational problems, and see the direct impact of your decisions on business performance.

Strong performers can grow into larger
**Area / City / Business Operations leadership roles**
as their scope expands.

**If you want responsibility early, enjoy Sales, and want your performance to determine both your growth and your earnings — this role is built for that.**

title: Oracle Fusion HCM Application Consultant - Recruitment
description:
**About Us**
We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
  
  
As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
  
  
**About GSS**
As the internal support organization for DNV and DNV owned companies, we deliver shared services within Human Resources, Finance, IT and Real Estate & Procurement to DNV globally. Our mission is to enable DNV to grow, succeed with its business goals and improve competitiveness. Customer experience is at the core of everything we do. GSS is responsible for many of the tools, processes and daily routines that create the backbone of DNV.
  
  
**About The Role**
The focus of this role will be to support, maintain and continuously enhance DNV’s global HR application landscape and participate in GSS IT projects and initiatives related to HR processes.
  
  
As an Oracle Fusion HCM Consultant, you will work closely with the HR community, IT teams and external partners, ensuring alignment between business requirements, application capabilities and the overall DNV system landscape.
  
  
DNV utilizes Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud across several HR processes, together with related PaaS services and other integrated HR solutions. For this position, we are particularly looking for strong experience with Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), combined with broader hands-on experience across Oracle Fusion HCM.
  
  
The position combines application management, functional and technical consulting, configuration, integrations, operational support and continuous improvement. You will have the opportunity to contribute both to stable day-to-day operations and to initiatives further developing our global HR technology landscape.
  
  
Be part of our long-term journey to continuously develop and improve the global HR IT landscape at DNV.
  
  
**As An Oracle Fusion HCM Consultant, You Will**

* Ensure stable, reliable and well-performing Oracle Fusion HCM applications and services.
* Provide functional and technical application support, including analysis, troubleshooting and resolution of complex application issues.
* Configure, maintain and continuously improve Oracle Fusion HCM functionality based on business requirements.
* Analyze HR business requirements and translate them into appropriate functional and technical solutions.
* Support integrations between Oracle Fusion HCM and other internal and external systems.
* Work with REST APIs, HCM Data Loader (HDL), SQL and other relevant Oracle HCM technologies for integrations, data management, troubleshooting and application maintenance.
* Coordinate with Oracle and other vendors on incidents, product issues, enhancements and technical topics.
* Communicate and collaborate with HR users, stakeholders and other IT teams across the organization.
* Provide consulting to the HR business regarding application capabilities, enhancements and future development of HR processes and IT solutions.
* Execute and manage configuration enhancements and technical changes based on new or evolving business requirements.
* Contribute to Oracle Fusion HCM release management, including impact assessment, regression testing and review of relevant release documentation.
* Participate in HR technology projects, implementations and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure alignment of solutions and services within the broader GSS IT application environment and DNV system landscape.
* Maintain appropriate functional and technical documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing within the HR Applications team.

**Why this role matters**
Our HR application landscape supports critical HR processes globally. As an Oracle Fusion HCM Consultant, you will contribute directly to the stability, development and continuous improvement of these solutions.
  
  
You will work at the intersection of HR processes, Oracle Fusion HCM and technology, helping translate business needs into sustainable solutions while supporting the continued evolution of DNV’s global HR technology landscape.
  
  
What we offer
  
  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On-The-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.

\*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*
  
  
DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
  
  
**About You**
**Must have:**

* Strong hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud, including application configuration, support, maintenance and continuous improvement.
* Strong experience with Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), including configuration and integrations with other systems.
* Hands-on experience with additional Oracle Fusion HCM areas such as Core HR, Compensation,
* Benefits, Security, Talent or other HCM modules.
* Hands-on experience with HCM Data Loader (HDL).
* Experience working with REST APIs and system integrations.
* Experience with SQL for analysis and troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of end-to-end HR business processes and their implementation within HR technology solutions.
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective functional and technical solutions.
* Experience with standard IT application support processes, including incident, request and change handling.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to independently take ownership of topics and drive them through to completion.
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple activities and deliver against agreed timelines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across cultures, functions and organizational boundaries.
* Willingness to continuously learn and keep up with changes within the Oracle Fusion HCM platform.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with Oracle HCM reporting, extracts and related integration technologies.
* Experience with Oracle PaaS services and extensions.
* Experience participating in Oracle Fusion HCM implementations, rollouts or major enhancement initiatives.
* Experience working within a global HR technology or enterprise application environment. Personal qualities

**We Are Looking For Someone Who**

* Is self-driven, proactive and well organized.
* Demonstrates a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Has a hands-on and pragmatic approach to problem solving.
* Is comfortable working independently while contributing actively to a global team.
* Is customer and business oriented and able to understand HR needs beyond purely technical requirements.
* Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Is collaborative and able to build strong working relationships across organizational and cultural boundaries.
* Is curious and motivated to continuously learn and develop.
* Can balance operational responsibilities, continuous improvement activities and project deliveries.

TeleSales Executive - Work From Home (Commission-Based)

**Company:**
Smotect Private Limited (Smotect Azaadi)

**Job Location:**
Remote / Work From Home

**Job Type:**
Full-Time Availability | Commission-Based

**Working Days:**
Monday to Saturday (6 Days/Week)

**Working Hours:**
10:00 AM – 7:00 PM (IST)

**Compensation:**
100% Commission-Based (No Fixed Salary)

**Website:**
www.smotect.com

About Smotect Azaadi

Smotect Azaadi is a wellness-focused Indian company dedicated to helping people overcome smoking and tobacco habits through natural, nicotine-free alternatives.

Our product range includes Azaadi Pop, Azaadi Mix, and Azaadi Tablets, designed to support individuals on their journey towards a tobacco-free lifestyle.

We are looking for enthusiastic, confident, and result-oriented
**TeleSales Executives**
to join our remote sales team.

Job Overview

As a TeleSales Executive, your primary responsibility will be to contact potential customers, understand their needs, explain our products, and convert leads into successful sales.

**The company will provide leads. You do not need to find or generate customers yourself.**

This is a fully remote, commission-based opportunity where your earnings depend on your sales performance.

Key Responsibilities

* Contact company-provided leads through outbound calls and convert them into paying customers.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable Smotect Azaadi products.
* Explain product features, benefits, pricing, and available offers clearly and professionally.
* Handle customer questions and sales objections confidently.
* Follow up with interested customers to improve conversion rates.
* Assist customers throughout the order-booking process.
* Maintain accurate records of calls, lead statuses, follow-ups, and sales.
* Work towards achieving sales and conversion targets.
* Maintain professional and empathetic communication with customers.

Work Structure & Availability

* **100% Work From Home:**
  No office attendance required.
* **Working Days:**
  Monday to Saturday.
* **Working Hours:**
  10:00 AM to 7:00 PM (IST).
* **Online Availability:**
  Candidates must remain available online during their scheduled working hours.
* **Lead Allocation:**
  New leads will be assigned only while the executive is online and available.
* **Company-Provided Leads:**
  No independent lead generation or cold prospecting required.

Eligibility & Requirements

* Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome to apply.
* Previous experience in telesales, telecalling, inside sales, or customer conversion is preferred.
* Strong communication, persuasion, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to communicate confidently in Hindi and/or English.
* Good listening skills and the ability to understand customer requirements.
* Comfortable handling objections, following up with customers, and closing sales.
* Basic computer knowledge and ability to use online calling and lead-management tools.
* **Must own a personal laptop and have a stable, reliable internet connection.**
* Self-motivated, disciplined, and capable of working independently.
* Willingness to work in a 100% commission-based role.

Compensation & Commission Structure

**This is a 100% commission-based position with no fixed monthly salary.**

* Earn commission on every qualifying successful sale.
* Commission will be payable only on orders that have been successfully delivered and paid for.
* Earnings depend on individual sales performance and successful conversions.
* The applicable commission rate and payment schedule will be communicated during the selection process.

**Please apply only if you are comfortable working without a fixed salary and earning entirely through sales commissions.**

Why Join Smotect Azaadi?

* Work from home with no daily office commute.
* Receive company-generated leads without having to source customers yourself.
* Earn commissions based on your sales performance.
* Gain experience in telesales, customer communication, and sales conversion.
* Work with a growing Indian wellness brand.

How to Apply

If you are confident in your communication skills, enjoy interacting with customers, and have the ability to convert leads into sales, we would like to hear from you.

**Freshers with strong communication and convincing skills are encouraged to apply.**

Apply now to join the Smotect Azaadi sales team!

That means making sure every lead is called quickly, qualified properly and handed to the closing team ready to convert. You set the pace, coach the callers and own the numbers at the top of the funnel.

**What you will own:**

* **Team performance:**
  Lead and coach a team of pre-sales executives against daily and weekly targets for calls, connects, qualified leads and site visits.
* **Lead management:**
  Make sure every lead, whether from digital, channel partners, events or walk-ins, is contacted within the agreed response time and followed up until it closes out, with the CRM kept accurate.
* **Funnel conversion:**
  Track the funnel from lead to connect, qualified lead, visit scheduled and visit done. Spot where leads drop off and fix it.
* **Quality:**
  Build and refresh pitch scripts and objection handling for each project. Run regular call audits and give feedback.
* **Working with sales:**
  Coordinate with closing managers and site heads on visit scheduling, and feed their visit outcomes back into how the team qualifies leads.
* **Working with marketing:**
  Share lead-quality insights by source and campaign so spend goes where leads actually convert.
* **Reporting:**
  Send daily and weekly reports on team performance and funnel health to the cluster head.
* **Building the team:**
  Hire, onboard and train new pre-sales team members.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 4–6 years in real estate pre-sales or tele-sales, including at least 1–2 years leading a team.
* A strong grip on funnel metrics, and comfort working in a CRM and Excel every day.
* A coach's mindset: you make callers better, not just busier.
* Fluency in English, Hindi and Marathi.
* Knowledge of Pune's residential market is a strong plus.
* A graduate degree in any discipline.

**Location:**
Baner, Pune

**Note:**
Its a 6-day WFO role

**Why Sellability**

* **Growth without limits**
  — Real leadership scope from day one: shape the brand strategy for a portfolio scaling toward INR 5000 Cr+, with direct exposure to marquee developers and large-scale launches.
* **Performance with rewards**
  — A merit-driven culture where your strategy, your calls and your outcomes are visible at the top, not buried in a hierarchy.
* **Collaborative culture**
  — Work directly with founder-level leadership, in a transparent, "one team" environment built for people who want to build, not just execute.
* **Purpose & impact**
  — Own the brand for one of the most ambitious portfolios in the market, with the mandate to redefine how real estate is sold and marketed in India.

**Don’t just go abroad. Grow abroad.**

As Aarnell continues to expand its presence across colleges in Pune, we are looking for someone who can represent us and build meaningful relationships with students and institutions.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an International Education Associate to lead Aarnell’s student engagement and business development efforts across colleges in Pune.

You will be the face of Aarnell on campus - building relationships with college stakeholders, engaging students, conducting counselling sessions and converting interested students into Aarnell students.

The role involves a combination of student counselling, institutional relationship management, outreach, follow-ups and sales, with significant interaction across our partner college network.

* Represent Aarnell across colleges and build strong relationships with Deans, TPOs, faculty, student leaders and management.

* Understand students' academic, career and international education goals and provide relevant guidance.
* Generate and qualify student leads through college engagement and other outreach initiatives.
* Follow up with prospective students and drive conversions into Aarnell's programs.
* Maintain consistent communication with students and ensure timely follow-ups throughout the decision-making process.
* Coordinate and execute student engagement activities across colleges.
* Represent Aarnell at relevant educational events and networking opportunities.
* Build and nurture relationships with colleges to create long-term student engagement opportunities.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, counselling conversations, follow-ups and conversions.
* Stay updated on international education trends, destinations, admission processes and student opportunities.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* **2–3 years of experience**
  in overseas education, education consulting, student counselling, business development or a related field.

* Strong understanding of international education and major study destinations.
* Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills.
* Confident in speaking with students as well as senior college stakeholders.
* Strong counselling, presentation and relationship-building skills.
* Comfortable with follow-ups, targets and converting prospective students into paying clients.
* Proactive, organised and able to take ownership of responsibilities.
* Comfortable using Excel/Google Sheets, CRM or other digital tools.
* Willingness to travel across Pune for college meetings and student engagement is mandatory.
* A student-first mindset with the ability to learn, adapt and grow with the organisation.

We value people who take ownership, build genuine relationships and are excited about helping students make better decisions about their future.

title: Purchase Executive
description:
**ABOUT ADVISTA TECHNOSOLUTIONS**

Advista Technosolutions Pvt. Ltd. is a **Pune-based engineering services company** specialising in Industrial Instrumentation, Process Automation, and Turnkey Engineering Projects. Founded by an engineer with 20+ years of domain expertise, we serve **100+ clients across India and internationally** (UAE, Sri Lanka, Trinidad & Tobago, Vietnam). We are MSME Udyam Registered, DPIIT Recognised Startup, and SC-ST Hub Honoured by the Ministry of MSME.

We are a small, growing team at an exciting inflection point. The person joining in this role will work directly with the founder in a hands-on environment where **initiative, accuracy, and ownership** are valued above all else.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

This is a **dual-function role** combining **Accounts & Invoicing** with **Purchase & Vendor Management.** The Executive will handle the complete order-to-invoice cycle on the accounts side, and the enquiry-to-dispatch cycle on the purchase side. Both functions operate simultaneously — this role is suited for a candidate who is **organised, fast-paced, and comfortable with numbers, vendor communication, and documentation.**

*This is not a split role. Both functions are active daily. The ideal candidate treats both with equal ownership.*

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**PURCHASE & VENDOR MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Purchase Lead Register** on the same day of receipt without exception
* Check the internal rate/vendor database before floating any enquiry externally — mandatory first step for every new enquiry
* Float purchase enquiries to a minimum of 2 relevant vendors within 4 working hours if rates are unavailable in the database; ensure complete technical inputs are shared with vendors
* **24–48 hours** of receiving the enquiry — this is a non-negotiable TAT
* **Weboo workflow** on the same day; keep Biziverse CRM in sync with order status
* **Purchase Orders (POs)** on the confirmed vendor within 1 working day of sales confirmation — correct specifications, price, delivery date, and payment terms
* Take structured weekly follow-ups with vendors on all open POs until material is physically received at Advista — log every follow-up in Weboo
* **Monday Order Status Updates** to the sales executive by 12:00 PM every Monday covering all open orders — real-time, accurate information
* On material receipt: verify material against PO (quantity, specification, make); verify all associated documents (invoice, test report, calibration certificate) on the same day
* Ensure received material is inspected for damage and repacked securely before dispatch
* Arrange appropriate courier or transport for dispatch as per client requirement and urgency — within committed dispatch date and approved cost limits
* **Client Dispatch Intimation** on the same day of dispatch — email + WhatsApp with all three: Tax Invoice, material photographs, and courier docket/tracking number

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* B.Com / M.Com / BBA or equivalent graduate; commerce background preferred
* 1 – 3 years of hands-on work experience in accounts and/or purchase in an engineering, manufacturing, or industrial trading company
* Biziverse ERP — training provided on joining; strong preference for candidates with any ERP/accounting software background; basic accounting concepts (journal entries, GST invoicing) are mandatory
* Microsoft Excel and Word — working proficiency; able to maintain registers, prepare statements, and format documents
* Basic working knowledge of GST (invoice format, HSN codes, GSTR-1 data); TDS awareness is a plus
* Comfortable with vendor communication over email and WhatsApp in a professional manner
* Marathi and Hindi fluency required; basic written English for email communication

**Key Behavioural Attributes We Value**

* **Ownership mindset:** treats both accounts and purchase as their own department — does not wait to be reminded
* **Accuracy over speed:** checks before submitting; zero tolerance for invoice errors or wrong POs
* **Discipline with deadlines:** Monday updates go out on Monday; invoices go out on dispatch day; no exceptions
* **Proactive communication:** updates the manager on delays before the manager asks
* **Adaptability:** comfortable switching between accounts work in the morning and vendor follow-ups in the afternoon — this is a multi-task role
* **Growth orientation:** willing to learn new tools (Weboo, Biziverse CRM) and take on additional responsibilities as the company grows

**This Role Is NOT a Fit If You...**

* Have only done data entry with no ownership of the full accounts or purchase cycle
* Are looking for a work-from-home or flexible-hours arrangement — this is a full-time on-site role
* Are not comfortable with direct vendor and client communication
* Expect a large team and dedicated IT support — we are a lean, growing company

title: Principal Enablement Experience Consultant - India
description:
**We're looking for a**

**Principal Enablement Experience Consultant - India**
======================================================

**This role is** **Office Based, Pune Office**

Job Description | Product Manager & Architect, Enablement Experience

Location: India / In Person Team: Cornerstone University

  

**About Cornerstone:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

  

**About the role:**

Today, our customers and partners learn through Cornerstone University training and courses, our knowledge base, live events, community forums, certifications, and conversations with their Customer Success team. These experiences are centralized through the Cornerstone Community, but they live in separate systems and can feel like separate journeys.

As Product Manager & Architect, Enablement Experiences, you will define and own the enablement platforms vision, strategy, architecture, and execution for one unified Cornerstone University experience: a single front door where customers, partners, and employees find answers, connect with experts and peers, learn in the flow of their work, and prove what they can do. You’ll see where information flows, where it breaks, and where the opportunities are, and you’ll turn that into a roadmap, an architecture, and shipped experiences that drive customer adoption, partner readiness, and renewal.

This is a senior, high-ownership role: one part product leader, one part architect, one part builder. You’ll report to the leader of Enablement & Community Experiences, who owns the business outcomes for the function. You own the platform that delivers them. You’ll also act as Customer Zero for Cornerstone’s own Workforce AI and learning technology, running our education business on our own products and feeding what we learn back to Product.

The role joins Cornerstone at an exciting moment, helping shape the company’s future through our Workforce AI tools. This is a new role on the Cornerstone University team for someone with clear vision, sound judgment, and the cross-functional leadership to bring bold ideas to life.

This role is based in India, with teammates based in global geographic hubs. Weekday hours require flexing to provide overlap with members in EMEA and the Americas.

  

**Scope and Decision Rights:**

* **You own:** Cornerstone University product roadmap; prioritization; target-state architecture and standards; integrations and data flows; design and build of AI-powered experiences; build-vs-buy recommendations and vendor evaluations; technical direction for learning system administrators.
* **You partner on:** enablement and community strategy, program priorities, budget, and executive alignment, content (Learning Design & Content) measurement and insights (Strategy, Insights & Operations); identity and security (IT and Security); CRM and customer health data (Salesforce and Gainsight teams).
  

**In this role, you will…**

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Platform Vision, Strategy & Product Management*

* Define and own the platform vision and multi-year roadmap for the Cornerstone University ecosystem (learning platforms, community, knowledge base, certifications, events, in-product learning, and AI experiences), tied directly to customer adoption and retention, partner readiness, and education as a growth function.
* Map the current customer learning landscape, including platforms, data flows, identity, content, search, and handoffs, and identify where users hit friction, fragmentation, duplication, or unnecessary cost.
* Run continuous product discovery with customers, partners, Customer Success, Services, and Support. Prioritize by business impact and say no clearly.
* Lead build vs. buy vs. partner decisions and platform vendor strategy, backed by business cases. Evaluate vendor roadmaps and market shifts in customer education and community platforms.
* Present the platform roadmap, investment cases, and trade-offs to executives in clear business language.

*Architecture & Standards*

* Define the target-state architecture and standards for the learning ecosystem, including data models, integration patterns, identity and SSO design, content and search, and security and privacy. Partner with Product, IT, and Security to put them into practice.
* Own the shared taxonomy and metadata framework covering products, skills, roles, audiences, and content types, as the foundation for search, personalized learning paths, reporting, and AI retrieval.
* Instrument the ecosystem: define event-level learning telemetry (e.g., xAPI and a learning record store) and data pipelines so learning, community, and certification activity can be measured at account and capability level and connected to adoption, retention, and revenue.
* Ensure the experience is accessible, localized, and performs well for a global audience.

*AI-Powered Experiences*

* Lead the strategy, design, and build of AI-powered experiences across Cornerstone University and Community, such as an authenticated answer experience that blends learning, community, and support content; personalized learning paths and nudges; and AI-assisted practice and assessment. Use native Cornerstone AI first and third-party solutions where justified.
* Own the retrieval approach behind these experiences, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over a governed content corpus, permission-aware retrieval, and content freshness, working closely with Content and Product teams.
* Establish evaluation and responsible AI practices: accuracy and hallucination testing, guardrails, human-in-the-loop review, privacy, and cost monitoring.
* Design for an agentic future, including integration through emerging standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and partner agent ecosystems.

*Integration & Execution*

* Own and drive the integrations between the learning ecosystem including Cornerstone platform, Salesforce and Gainsight so learning, community, and certification data syncs to the right account and contact records and appears in Customer Success, Sales, and partner workflows, giving a complete picture of adoption, health, and renewal.
* Lead delivery of platform programs end to end: plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, vendor and implementation-partner management, testing, launch, and change management.
* Own the certification and credentialing platform infrastructure, including proctored exams, digital badges, and certification maintenance and renewal flows, in partnership with the Certification team.
* Deliver learning in the flow of work, including in-product guidance within Cornerstone and experiences embedded in the tools customers, partners, and employees already use.
* Set technical priorities for learning system administrators, review configuration decisions, evaluate platform changes, and define release and testing standards.

*Partnership & Leadership*

* Partner with your manager to translate business goals into platform priorities and to report progress and outcomes.
* Work across Cornerstone University, Customer Success, Services, Support, Alliances, Product, Marketing, and IT.
* Act as Customer Zero: run Cornerstone University on Cornerstone products and give structured feedback to Product.
* Explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and executives.
  

**What Success Looks Like:**

* **First 30-60 days:** current-state map, target-state architecture, prioritized roadmap, and investment case agreed with leadership; quick wins identified and underway.
* **By 6 months:** unified identity and single front door in delivery; agentic experiences serving 60+% of the audience’s needs through agentic front door, learning and community data flowing to Salesforce and Gainsight account records at an agreed data-quality level; telemetry standards in place; first AI experience piloting with defined success metrics.
* **By 9-12 months:** single front door live for customers and partners serving 80+% of the needs; AI answer experience in production with measured resolution and satisfaction; fewer platforms and lower platform cost; learning engagement visible in account health and used by Customer Success; certification infrastructure supporting proctored, role-based credentials at scale.
* **Ongoing measures:** front-door adoption, time to answer, integration reliability, data quality, AI resolution rate, and platform cost, plus clear contribution to customer adoption, retention, and partner readiness.

**You've Got What It Takes If You Have…**

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* 10+ years in learning technology, customer education, or enterprise SaaS platforms, including significant time as a platform owner, product manager, or architect who set strategy, not only configured tools.
* Proven ownership of a multi-platform learning ecosystem. You were accountable for the vision, architecture, integrations, and roadmap across learning, community, knowledge, and certification platforms, with evidence that it improved customer and business outcomes.
* Product management depth: discovery, prioritization, road mapping, business cases, build vs. buy decisions, and adoption metrics.
* A track record of leading large-scale, multi-system implementations or consolidations from strategy through delivery, including vendors and cross-functional teams.
* Deep integration experience across learning systems and Salesforce CRM, including REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, SSO (SAML/OIDC), data syncs, and learning standards (SCORM, xAPI, cmi5, LTI).
* Hands-on expertise with at least one enterprise or customer education LMS, preferably Cornerstone, or Skilljar, Docebo, Thought Industries, Intellum, Absorb, or similar.
* AI shipped in production: you have designed and delivered at least one AI-powered experience (e.g., agents, RAG-based answers, or AI workflows) used by real users with measured outcomes, and can speak to evaluation, guardrails, data governance, and cost.
* Ability to set strategy independently and communicate it at executive level.
* Comfort moving between strategy and configuration in the same day.
  

**Strongly Preferred:**

* Experience integrating online community platforms (Gainsight preferred), including SSO, data, and how learning and community intersect.
* Experience with Gainsight or similar customer success platforms and customer health data.
* Customer and partner education experience at a B2B SaaS company, including certification programs.
* Experience with agent interoperability standards (such as MCP) and enterprise AI platforms.
* Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Integration Architect).
  

**How You Work:**

* **Customer obsessed:** you start from the learner’s and the account’s problem, not the tool.
* **Innovate and transform:** you challenge the status quo and retire systems and processes that don’t earn their place.
* **Proactive leadership:** you see the problem and act before you’re asked.
* **Get it done:** you ship, measure, and iterate.
* **Forward looking:** you plan for where the technology and the business are going, not where they have been.
* **AI native:** you use AI every day to rethink your own work, not just to speed it up.
* **Get uncomfortable to succeed:** you take on hard, ambiguous problems and stay with them.
  

#LI-Onsite

**Our Culture:**

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

**Who We Are:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

description:
**Job Description**

**Pipeline & Market Intelligence Manager**

**Job title**

Pipeline & Market Intelligence Manager

**Location**

Pune, India

**Function**

Marketing (central function, global remit)

**Reports to**

Marketing Director

**Direct reports**

Three Research Analysts, based in Pune

**Working pattern**

Office-based

**Contract**

Permanent, full-time

**Salary**

Competitive

**About Optimas International**

Optimas International is a global specialist in engineering and industrial distribution, providing fastener distribution and supply chain solutions to manufacturers across the UK, Europe, India and South East Asia, and China. We are entering a period of focused growth, built around six priority global verticals, our existing customer base in each country, and a programme of acquisitions.

To deliver that growth we are building a strong central marketing function with the skills and discipline to generate leads, control the pipeline and give the business clear visibility of new wins. This role sits at the centre of that function.

**About the role**

This is a Revenue Operations role in all but name. You will own the master global pipeline in HubSpot: what goes into it, how accurate it is, and how actively it is worked. You will lead a small research team that identifies new opportunities, and you will hold regional sales and business development teams to account for working those opportunities through to a clear outcome.

It is not a research-only or administrative position. We are looking for a senior, commercially minded operator who is equally comfortable building a reporting framework, challenging a sales leader on stale pipeline, and presenting findings to senior management.

**Purpose**

Control the master pipeline. Own the report-out of leads per vertical and per region, feed HubSpot, and remain accountable for the accuracy of active leads in the system. Hold sales teams in every region to account for pipeline activity and data accuracy.

**Key responsibilities**

**Pipeline control and HubSpot ownership**

* Own the master global target file in HubSpot, combining strategic targets, regional targets and newly identified leads into a single source of truth.
* Maintain a live queue of 10 to 20 active leads per region, ensuring that as one opportunity closes or is lost, the next qualified lead is brought into play.
* Own the report-out of leads by vertical and region, and the process that feeds them into HubSpot.
* Define and enforce pipeline stages, qualification criteria and data standards, working with the external HubSpot consultant, who owns technical build, automation and system configuration.

**Sales accountability and compliance**

* Hold regional business development teams and P&L leads accountable for HubSpot workflow compliance, pipeline activity and data accuracy across the UK, Europe, India and South East Asia, and APAC.
* Run regular pipeline reviews with regional sales teams, challenging inactive or poorly qualified opportunities and agreeing clear next actions.
* Escalate persistent non-compliance constructively and with evidence, working with the Marketing Director and senior sales leadership.

**Market intelligence and research leadership**

* Direct two Research Analysts covering the six global verticals (three verticals each) to identify and qualify new targets.
* Direct one Research Analyst focused on cross-sell, share-of-wallet and global account plant mapping: identifying where an existing global customer has manufacturing sites in regions we do not yet serve.
* Own communication of research findings and market intelligence to sales leads and the Marketing Manager and regional Marketing Executives, so the business stays on the front foot in every region.
* Provide a regular market intelligence and topic feed to the Communications and Brand team to inform content and campaigns.

**Reporting and performance**

* Produce clear, consistent pipeline reporting by region and vertical for the Marketing Director and senior leadership.
* Work with the BI and data governance team, who own dashboards, win reporting and board reporting, to ensure definitions and data are consistent across all regions.
* Support marketing performance reporting by linking campaign and digital lead generation activity to pipeline outcomes.

**Key relationships**

* **Internal:** Marketing Director, Marketing Manager and regional Marketing Executives, Communications and Brand Manager, regional P&L leads and BD teams, BI and data governance.
* **External:** HubSpot consultant (technical build and governance), data and research providers.

**Skills and experience**

**Essential**

* Demonstrable significant experience in revenue operations, sales operations, pipeline management or a closely related commercial function, including at least 3 years in a management role.
* Proven track record of owning a CRM pipeline end to end and driving adoption and compliance across a sales organisation.
* Strong hands-on HubSpot experience (or Salesforce or Dynamics with clear evidence of rapid transfer to HubSpot).
* Demonstrable experience of holding sales teams and senior stakeholders to account, including across multiple countries and cultures.
* Experience leading and developing analysts or researchers, setting priorities and quality standards.
* Highly analytical, with advanced Excel skills and confidence building pipeline and performance reporting.
* B2B experience, ideally in industrial, manufacturing, engineering or distribution markets with long, complex sales cycles.

**Desirable**

* HubSpot certifications (for example Sales Hub or Revenue Operations).
* Experience of market research, account-based marketing or target account mapping.
* Familiarity with BI tools such as Power BI.
* Experience integrating acquired businesses into a central pipeline and reporting framework.
* Degree in business, marketing, economics or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
* Experience working with UK and European stakeholders.

**Communication requirements**

Communication is central to this role. You will be the person who tells sales teams, in every region, what the pipeline really looks like and what needs to happen next.

* Highly proficient written and spoken English is essential. You will write reports, pipeline summaries and briefings for senior UK and international stakeholders, and these must be clear, accurate and professional without editing.
* Excellent and confident verbal communicator, able to lead calls and meetings with UK, European and APAC sales teams and senior leaders, and to hold your position under challenge.
* Comfortable working across time zones, with a regular overlap with UK working hours.
* Able to turn complex data into clear, concise messages and actions.

**Personal attributes**

* Assertive and resilient, with the credibility to challenge senior sales colleagues constructively.
* Commercially curious, with a genuine interest in markets, customers and where growth will come from.
* Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to data.
* A collaborative leader who builds trust across functions and regions.
* Self-motivated and comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy in a growing business.

**Measures of success**

* A complete, accurate and current master pipeline in HubSpot, trusted by sales and leadership.
* 10 to 20 qualified active leads maintained per region at all times.
* High HubSpot workflow compliance across all regional BD teams.
* Steady growth in new targets identified across the six verticals and in cross-sell plant opportunities.

This role is based in Pune, India, and works UK hours to align with the Marketing, Communications and Brand team and colleagues in the UK and Europe.
