title: Senior Marketing Manager
description:
**About the job**

Complyance is a fast-growing e-invoicing and tax compliance SaaS company. Through a single API, we help businesses meet e-invoicing mandates across markets, including the UAE and Saudi Arabia’s ZATCA requirements, without rebuilding their finance systems every time a regulation changes.

With a strong and growing MENA footprint, we work with finance and tax teams who need compliance to be reliable, fast and invisible. Our platform is live across 10+ jurisdictions, we have built a strong base in MENA and India, and we are now expanding into Europe and the US.

**Life at Complyance:**

We are building a lean, high-ownership team that cares about doing the basics exceptionally well. Our work is visible, our decisions matter, and we are looking for people who want to shape how a company grows, not just keep it running.

**The mission:**

Pipeline comes first. As Marketing Manager, you will own and drive our demand generation and growth engine across MENA, while giving strategic direction to content and brand.

This is a hands-on, strategic role for someone who can think across the whole marketing function. You will be part of the founding go-to-market leadership team, working closely with the VP – Growth, sales leadership and the founders. You will own a dedicated marketing budget, lead a small existing team, and bring in freelancers and partners where it makes sense.

**Where you’ll leave your mark:**

**•**
**Build the pipeline engine:**

 Own pipeline generation across MENA and work closely with sales leadership to hit qualified pipeline and revenue targets.

**•**
**Run multi-channel growth programmes:**

 Build and run demand generation across paid, organic, email, events, partnerships and product-led motions.

**•**
**Let the data decide where to invest:**

 Define and track the marketing funnel, including conversion rates, CAC and pipeline contribution by channel.

**•**
**Open up new segments:**

 Identify and prioritise target segments and verticals across MENA, starting with the UAE and Saudi e-invoicing mandates, extend those playbooks to adjacent markets, and partner with sales on account-based marketing for enterprise and mid-market accounts.

**•**
**Set the content direction:**

 Own content strategy and editorial direction across the funnel, from top-of-funnel education to mid-funnel nurture and bottom-funnel sales enablement. You will direct a small content team and freelancers, leading and shaping content rather than writing it day to day, and make sure it speaks credibly to finance and tax audiences.

**•**
**Be the strategic marketing voice:**

 Shape how Complyance positions itself as we scale, own brand consistency and market positioning across MENA and India, and represent marketing in cross-functional planning with Sales, Product and the VP – Growth.

**•**
**Own the budget and the team:**

 Be accountable for spend efficiency and ROI across channels, lead and develop the existing team, manage freelancers and agencies, and work with a modern marketing technology stack covering automation, CRM and paid and organic channels.

**The kind of leader we’re looking for**

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

**•**

Have 7+ years of marketing experience (10+ preferred), with real ownership of demand generation and growth outcomes, not just execution.

**•**

Have proven experience marketing a SaaS or subscription business, and are comfortable with SaaS metrics such as MRR/ARR, CAC, pipeline velocity and funnel conversion.

**•**

Come from tax-tech, compliance, advisory or another regulated B2B SaaS category (strongly preferred), and can credibly market a compliance and e-invoicing proposition to finance and tax buyers.

**•**

Have hands-on exposure to the MENA market (UAE and Saudi Arabia preferred), including regional buyer behaviour, channels and go-to-market nuances.

**•**

Have experience directing content resources, teams or freelancers.

**•**

Are a strategic thinker who is comfortable with autonomy in a lean, fast-scaling startup, and can move between hands-on execution and big-picture planning.

**•**

Bring strong stakeholder management and the confidence to work directly with sales leadership and founders.

If you have 7–9 years of experience, we would want to see scope and impact that match a strategic, largely autonomous mandate.

**Bonus points :**

**•**

Experience marketing specifically into finance, tax or audit functions.

**•**

Familiarity with product-led growth (PLG) motions.

**•**

Experience as part of a founding or early go-to-market team at a startup.

**What success looks like in your first 6–12 months**

**•**

A working demand generation engine with clear, channel-by-channel pipeline contribution and improving conversion rates.

**•**

A content function that is strategically directed and consistently supports the funnel, even when largely executed by others.

**•**

Stronger brand credibility and sharper market positioning for Complyance across MENA.

**•**

You are a trusted strategic partner to the VP – Growth and sales leadership on go-to-market decisions.

**Why Complyance?**

**•**

Competitive base salary plus a performance-linked variable component tied to pipeline and growth targets. The range will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

**•**

A seat on the founding go-to-market leadership team, with real ownership of budget, strategy and outcomes.

**•**

The chance to build marketing for a category that is being shaped by regulation right now, across some of the fastest-moving e-invoicing markets in the world.

**•**

Comprehensive benefits, including health insurance for you and your family, paid time off and relocation support as required.

**•**

A lean, collaborative team where your work is visible and your decisions matter.

**How to apply**

* Apply on LinkedIn with your CV, or share the profile of someone you think is a strong fit.

title: General Manager Buisness Development - Channel / Distribution Buisness
description:
**Company Description**
Qmax Test Equipments Pvt Ltd is a leading Automated Test Equipment (ATE) company specializing in advanced test engineering solutions for populated PCBs and electronic components. The organization delivers comprehensive test solutions including Boundary Scan Test, PCB Mixed Signal In-Circuit Functional Test (ICFT), and PCB troubleshooting, aligned with evolving industry needs. Qmax has established a strong global presence as a premier PCB test provider through innovation and adherence to high technical standards. The company maintains a dedicated focus on research and development across its portfolio of test equipment for the semiconductor industry, board functional testers, and high-end automated probing systems.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai for National level a General Manager Business Development – Channel / Distribution Business. The role involves developing and executing strategic business plans to expand channel and distribution networks in domestic and international markets. The General Manager will identify new business opportunities, nurture and manage key partner relationships, and drive sales growth through effective channel strategies. Responsibilities include overseeing contract negotiations with distributors, establishing performance metrics, and ensuring alignment of business development initiatives with organizational goals. The role also requires close collaboration with internal technical and marketing teams to position Qmax solutions effectively and support partners with product training, market intelligence, and sales enablement.

* Relevant bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related field; an advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is an advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in Chennai and travel as needed for partner visits, industry events, and customer meetings.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a results-driven Manager – Digital Marketing to plan, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies across social media, search engines, websites, email, and other digital platforms. The role involves managing paid and organic promotions, increasing audience reach and engagement, driving campaign conversions, and strengthening the organization's digital presence through data-driven marketing initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Digital Marketing Strategy**

* Develop and implement digital marketing strategies aligned with organizational goals.
* Plan digital campaigns to increase brand awareness, audience reach, engagement, website traffic, and conversions.
* Identify target audiences and develop platform-specific marketing strategies.
* Stay updated on digital marketing trends, emerging technologies, and industry best practices.

**2. Paid Promotions & Advertising**

* Plan, execute, and optimize paid campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
* Manage campaign budgets, audience targeting, bidding strategies, and advertising schedules.
* Monitor campaign performance and optimize cost per lead, cost per acquisition, reach, and conversions.

**3. Organic Marketing & Social Media**

* Improve audience engagement, follower growth, video views, watch time, and content reach.

**4. SEO & Website Management**

* Monitor keyword rankings, website performance, landing pages, and conversion pathways.

**5. Analytics & Performance Reporting**

* Prepare periodic reports on reach, impressions, engagement, traffic, leads, conversions, and advertising expenditure.
* Evaluate campaign effectiveness against defined KPIs and recommend corrective actions.
* Use data insights to improve targeting, content performance, and marketing ROI.

**6. Campaign & Content Coordination**

* Coordinate with Media, Promotions, Content, Design, and other departments to plan and execute digital campaigns.
* Develop digital promotional plans for organizational events, programs, initiatives, and special campaigns.
* Ensure timely delivery of campaign creatives, videos, advertisements, landing pages, and other digital assets.
* Maintain consistency in brand communication across digital platforms.

**7. Team Management & Budget Control**

* Lead and guide the digital marketing team, assign responsibilities, and monitor performance.
* Plan and manage digital marketing budgets and ensure effective allocation of resources.
* Establish campaign targets, review results, and ensure timely execution.
* Coordinate with external agencies, vendors, and platform representatives when required.

* Digital marketing strategy and campaign management

* Team leadership, communication, and project management

title: Proposal Engineer
description:
**Job Description – Proposal Engineer (Water & Wastewater Treatment)**

**Job Title:** Proposal Engineer – WTP / STP / ETP / RO / UF

**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Experience:** 2–5 Years

**Department:** Proposal & Engineering / Technical Sales

**Industry:** Water Treatment / Wastewater Treatment / Environmental Engineering

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a technically skilled and detail-oriented **Proposal Engineer** with experience in water and wastewater treatment projects, including Water Treatment Plants (WTP), Sewage Treatment Plants (STP), Effluent Treatment Plants (ETP), Reverse Osmosis (RO), Ultrafiltration (UF), and desalination systems.

The candidate will be responsible for preparing technical and commercial proposals, reviewing customer enquiries, understanding project requirements, conducting equipment sizing and cost estimations, and coordinating with engineering, procurement, sales, and project execution teams.

The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of water treatment technologies, process equipment, tendering, costing, and technical documentation.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Technical Proposal Preparation**

* Review customer enquiries, tender documents, technical specifications, and project requirements.
* Prepare technical and commercial proposals for WTP, STP, ETP, RO, UF, MBR, and desalination projects.
* Develop preliminary process schemes, equipment lists, and technical specifications.
* Prepare technical datasheets, Bill of Quantities (BOQ), and Bill of Materials (BOM).
* Coordinate the preparation of Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs), Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), and preliminary plant layouts.
* Prepare technical clarifications, deviations, and compliance statements based on tender requirements.

**2. Cost Estimation & Commercial Proposals**

* Prepare detailed cost estimates for water and wastewater treatment systems.
* Estimate costs for pumps, blowers, filters, membranes, pressure vessels, tanks, piping, valves, instrumentation, and other equipment.
* Obtain and evaluate quotations from vendors and suppliers.
* Prepare cost sheets, pricing summaries, and commercial offers.
* Coordinate with procurement and engineering teams to optimise project costs.
* Support commercial negotiations and proposal revisions.

**3. Tendering & Bid Management**

* Analyse RFQs, RFPs, tender documents, and client specifications.
* Prepare tender submissions in accordance with customer requirements.
* Ensure timely submission of technical and commercial bids.
* Maintain tender documentation, proposal records, and bid trackers.
* Prepare responses to technical queries and clarifications from clients and consultants.
* Support the sales team during technical discussions and pre-bid meetings.

**4. Process & Equipment Engineering**

* Assist in preliminary equipment sizing and selection for water treatment systems.
* Understand treatment processes such as clarification, filtration, biological treatment, membrane filtration, RO, UF, and chemical dosing.
* Review process design inputs, hydraulic requirements, and equipment specifications.
* Coordinate with process, mechanical, piping, electrical, and instrumentation teams.
* Ensure proposed equipment and systems comply with technical specifications and project requirements.

**5. Engineering & Sales Coordination**

* Coordinate with sales, engineering, procurement, and project execution teams.
* Liaise with vendors and suppliers for technical quotations and equipment specifications.
* Support technical presentations and discussions with customers.
* Assist in proposal handover to the project execution team after order confirmation.
* Maintain accurate proposal documentation and revision records.

Required Skills

* Good understanding of water and wastewater treatment processes.
* Experience in preparing technical and commercial proposals.
* Knowledge of WTP, STP, ETP, RO, UF, and membrane treatment technologies.
* Experience in BOQ, BOM, equipment costing, and project estimation.
* Ability to read and interpret PFDs, P&IDs, GA drawings, and technical specifications.
* Knowledge of pumps, blowers, filters, membranes, piping, valves, and instrumentation.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD will be an added advantage.
* Strong analytical, communication, and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple proposals and meet tender deadlines.

Educational Qualifications

* B.E. / B.Tech in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Diploma holders with relevant water treatment proposal experience may also be considered.

Experience Requirements

* **2–5 years of experience** in technical proposals, tendering, estimation, or application engineering.
* Relevant experience in water treatment, wastewater treatment, environmental engineering, or EPC projects.
* Hands-on experience in technical bid preparation, equipment costing, and commercial proposals is preferred.
* Candidates from water treatment equipment manufacturers, environmental engineering companies, and EPC contractors will be preferred.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for a technically competent Proposal Engineer who can independently review enquiries, prepare technical and commercial offers, coordinate with vendors, and support the sales team in securing projects.

The candidate should have practical knowledge of water and wastewater treatment technologies, equipment selection, proposal preparation, and project costing.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Consultant
description:
GAEC ABROAD is an international education consulting firm specializing in academic counseling for students aspiring to study abroad and providing comprehensive global education services. We are committed to offering personalized guidance to students across India, helping them make informed decisions about their international academic journeys.

Our team works closely with students to understand their academic backgrounds, career aspirations, and personal goals, recommending suitable universities and programs worldwide. At GAEC ABROAD, we prioritize personalized counseling, ethical practices, effective marketing, and long-term student success in the global education landscape.

**Role Description**

GAEC ABROAD is seeking an experienced and results-driven
**Senior Consultant – Overseas Education & Marketing**
to join our team in Hyderabad. This is a full-time, on-site position requiring a minimum of
**4 years of relevant experience**
in overseas education consulting, student recruitment, marketing, or related fields.

The candidate will be responsible for student counseling, university admissions, lead generation, marketing campaigns, and business development. The role requires an individual who can effectively counsel students, develop marketing strategies, generate quality leads, convert inquiries into enrollments, and contribute to the overall growth of GAEC ABROAD.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Student Counseling & Admissions**

* Provide personalized counseling to students regarding international universities, courses, admission requirements, and career opportunities.
* Evaluate student profiles and recommend suitable universities and programs based on academic backgrounds, budgets, and career goals.
* Guide students through applications, documentation, offer letters, and admission timelines.
* Provide updated information on international education trends, admission policies, and visa procedures.
* Follow up with students and parents to convert inquiries into successful enrollments.
* Maintain accurate student records, application updates, and follow-up activities using CRM systems.

**Marketing & Lead Generation**

* Plan and execute marketing strategies to promote GAEC ABROAD's overseas education services.
* Generate student leads through digital marketing, social media, educational events, seminars, webinars, and other promotional activities.
* Coordinate with digital marketing teams to develop campaigns across platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google.
* Support the creation of marketing content, promotional materials, advertisements, and student success stories.
* Identify new marketing opportunities, student segments, and potential business partnerships.
* Organize and participate in education fairs, school and college visits, workshops, and student recruitment events.
* Monitor marketing campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and return on investment.
* Build brand awareness and strengthen GAEC ABROAD's presence in the overseas education market.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Minimum
  **4 years of relevant professional experience**
  in overseas education consulting, student recruitment, marketing, or business development.
* Strong knowledge of international education destinations, university admissions, and student visa processes.
* Experience in lead generation, student conversion, digital marketing, or promotional campaign management.
* Excellent communication, counseling, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Understanding of social media marketing, online advertising, and marketing campaign performance.
* Ability to manage multiple student cases, marketing activities, and deadlines.
* Proficiency in CRM platforms, student management systems, and standard office software.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Marketing, Management, Business Administration, Education, or a related field.
* A proactive, target-oriented mindset with strong organizational and relationship-building skills.
* Commitment to ethical counseling, transparent marketing, and delivering a positive student experience.

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Analyst - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.
  
  
You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.
  
  
**THE WORK**
Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:
  
  
**Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development**

* Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states.
* Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context.
* Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools.

* Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions.

**Data & AI Foundations**

title: Product Expert - Clinical Data Management - India
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
  
  
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
  
  
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
  
  
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
  
  
The Role
  
  
Veeva is looking for a highly motivated individual with life science industry experience within the Clinical Data domain. You will drive impactful product communication and champion customer success with our Clinical Data Management applications, Veeva EDC and Veeva DQS, partnering closely with our customers in India. You will also continuously grow your own expertise by staying at the absolute cutting edge of AI and digital transformation in clinical trials.
  
  
As part of the global Product Expert team, you will play a key role in the Product organization. Most importantly you will:
  
  

* Build and foster highly engaged Users Communities; regularly engage with the customers in a range of forums to provide clear and impactful communication that drives shared understanding & education, promotes product adoption, and delivers customer value.
* Represent the Product organization in customer meetings, online communities, and at industry events.
* Drive increased customer value through release education and product capability promotion.
* As a Voice for the Customers, capture and relay their needs, and industry-specific learnings, to our Product Management team based in the US, helping them to inform product decisions and improve designs that ultimately create better Clinical Data products that enable:

+ AI & Digital transformation
+ Risk-based decision making
+ Regulatory compliance
+ A culture of continuous improvement
+ Excellence across the pharmaceutical industry

* Collaborate effectively with Veeva field teams to drive customer success, product excellence, best practices, and Veeva Product success.

To apply for this role, you must have recent hands-on experience in either Veeva EDC or Veeva DQS.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Be the product evangelist and provide subject matter expertise for the Veeva EDC and Veeva DQS products, staying up to date with the latest features and communicating Product roadmap directions.
* Act as a champion for Veeva's key product enhancements (for example, learning the overarching Veeva AI and RBQM visions to effectively guide customers through their transformation journeys together with Veeva colleagues).
* Provide product education to Veeva Clinical Data customers in meetings (in a range of forums) and our online communities (Veeva Connect); Ensuring we are communicating the problems we are solving, value delivered and product functionality.
* Be the customer advocate internally. Gather, analyze, and prioritize customer feedback. Feed these insights into release planning, contributing to future product innovations.
* Collaborate with Product teams to deliver valuable content and resources for product and release communication.
* Provide cross-functional support to internal teams, including Services, Strategy, Sales, and Product Support.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years working in the Clinical Management space, usually from Product Management, Consulting or Professional Services/Implementation roles
* Recent hands-on experience with Veeva EDC and/or Veeva DQS. Do not apply if you do not have this experience.
* Ability to understand customer business requirements and to translate them to technical product requirements, preferences, and limitations
* Ability to understand Product Vision, Technical Specifications and Software Development Documentation, and translate them into language and content for both business and technical stakeholder
* Experience in interacting with customers from business users, IT departments, and executive suite, as well as internal teams, both in-person and remote (including software demonstrations and presentations).
* Strong analytical skills and English skills (written, verbal, and formal presentations).
* A strong passion for emerging technologies (specifically AI) and the ability to quickly grasp, articulate, and conceptualize how AI-driven features solve clinical trials challenges.
* Self-directed team player with a positive attitude.
* Willingness to travel between 15-30%.
* Based in India.

****Nice to Have****

* Preferred location: Bengaluru or Hyderabad
* SQL knowledge
* Fluency in at least one widely used Indian language

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
  
  
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

description:

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, or technical consulting, infrastructure with 2 years of experience in building and deploying GenAI applications, intelligent agents, or LLM-powered solutions to production.
* Experience building and orchestrating agents using ADKs, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen and in designing modern application architectures, including API design, microservices, and integrating AI models into existing enterprise software systems.
* Experience with Python.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* Google Cloud Professional certifications.
* Experience implementing scalable RAG architectures and securely connecting LLMs with external productivity tools (e.g., Google Workspace) and complex enterprise databases in high-traffic environments.
* Experience leading technical project deployments, working with engineering teams, or acting as the technical lead on large-scale cloud transformations.
* Experience deploying, configuring, and managing enterprise-grade generative AI platforms (particularly Gemini Enterprise), with an understanding of AI security, Large Language Models (LLM) governance, guardrails, and enterprise compliance requirements (e.g., data privacy regulations).

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As a Cloud AI Engineer, you will play a key leadership role in ensuring that strategic customers have the best experience adopting Gemini Enterprise alongside the broader Google Cloud Agentic AI suite of products. You will design and implement robust, production-ready application architectures to support customer use cases, leveraging Gemini Enterprise and core Google AI products. You will work with customers to identify opportunities to transform their workflows with autonomous agents, actively removing technical barriers to ensure successful deployment and high adoption rates of Gemini Enterprise. You will have access to Google’s technology to monitor application performance, debug and troubleshoot complex agent behaviors, and address customer and partner needs. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end and timely execution of adopting Google Cloud Platform solutions to the customer.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the delivery, deployment, and implementation of Gemini Enterprise solutions, utilizing Agent Development Kits (ADKs) to solve complex, enterprise-scale technical customer challenges.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to Google’s most strategic customers to shape their AI strategy, drive, and accelerate the adoption of Gemini Enterprise.
* Provide architectural guidance on existing product challenges, collaborate closely with the engineering team to address gaps, and architect scalable workarounds for edge cases.
* Deliver leading practice recommendations and technical presentations adapted to different levels of key business and technical stakeholders (including C-suite executives) to proactively foster Gemini Enterprise adoption and enablement.

title: Consulting Solutions Engineer
description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**
At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.
  
  
Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Consulting Solution Engineer within NetApp's Sales organization, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, channel partners, and internal stakeholders. You will play a critical role in driving revenue growth by aligning NetApp's technology solutions with customer business objectives and leading technical sales engagements across a high-value account portfolio.
  
  
This is a highly visible, customer-facing role offering significant opportunities for career growth and exposure to strategic enterprise customers. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, consultative selling skills, executive presence, and the ability to build lasting relationships with customers, partners, Client Executives, and Sales Leaders.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Partner with Client Executives to develop and execute account strategies that drive revenue growth and market expansion.
* Build trusted relationships with technical stakeholders, business leaders, and C-level executives.
* Lead technical discovery sessions to understand customer challenges, requirements, and business objectives.
* Architect, demonstrate, and position NetApp solutions aligned to customer outcomes.
* Provide technical leadership throughout the sales cycle, including solution design, POCs, validation, and closure.
* Collaborate with channel partners and internal teams to drive opportunities and achieve territory goals.
* Present NetApp’s technology vision, value proposition, and competitive differentiation.

Job Requirement
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Experience in presales, solutions consulting, or sales engineering.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise storage, data protection, disaster recovery, and hybrid cloud solutions.
* Ability to present complex technical solutions to both technical and executive audiences.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and customer engagement skills.
* Experience influencing enterprise technology buying decisions and driving technical wins.

**Education & Experience**

* Minimum 15 years of experience in Technical Presales, Solution Engineering, or a related customer-facing technology role.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate degree or equivalent advanced qualification preferred. Cross-Functional Skills:
* Nvidia Certification, exposure to AI workloads and solutioning skills, worked on solutions with CSPs for AI Cloud. Knowledge on sizing solutions for AI workload and able to converse on solution stack. Basic understanding of machine learning fundamentals, deep learning, LLMs, and vector/streaming databases. Act as the knowledge bridge between infra stakeholders, data scientists, ML engineers, and DevOps/security teams and able to bring in skills to stitch complex solutions together. Proficiency in Kubernetes, big data platforms, and cloud-native architecture.

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.

NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.
  
  
**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**
At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.
  
  
NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.
  
  
**Our culture**
We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.
  
  
If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.

title: Presales Director-Trade Finance
description:
**Job Description**

Position Vice President – Trade Finance Solutions

Experience 10–15 years

Grade- VP Location Mumbai

Project-Fuel

**Mandatory**
-MBA-Tier 1

About FuEL

FuEL is Intellect's Flagship program designed to develop the next generation of transformation leaders for the global Fintech/Insuretech industry. Created for high-potential professionals, the program equips participants to help financial institutions reimagine business models, accelerate digital and AI transformation, and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

**The Opportunity**

This role is for a Trade Finance leader who combines deep domain expertise with hands-on technology and process experience. You will shape solution propositions for banks, actively demonstrate Intellect’s Trade Finance capabilities, and work closely with Engineering and Delivery to evolve the solution in response to market needs and client requirements. The role spans consultative engagement, product solutioning, sales support, and ongoing product

development—not just domain advisory or relationship management.

You will engage business, product, operations, and technology leaders to understand their objectives, diagnose process and business challenges, and translate them into practical, differentiated solutions. You should be equally comfortable leading a client workshop, running a product demonstration, developing a solution approach, and working with internal teams on the changes needed to deliver it.

**Role Definition**

The Vice President – Trade Finance Solutions owns domain-led solutioning and supports growth across Intellect’s Trade Finance portfolio. The role combines customer discovery, process analysis and reengineering, product demonstrations, solution design, bid support, and collaboration with Product, Engineering and Delivery to ensure that proposed solutions are credible, differentiated, feasible, and aligned with customer needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

● 1. Prospect Understanding and Process Reengineering: Engage bank and financial-institution executives, business heads, product owners, operations and technology leaders to understand business models, workflows, pain points and strategic priorities. Analyse existing processes and identify opportunities for simplification, automation, control improvement and business transformation.

● 2. Domain Expertise and Solutioning: Apply strong Trade Finance knowledge to translate business requirements

into practical solution propositions. Map customer processes and requirements to product capabilities, identify

gaps, distinguish standard product functionality from client-specific changes, and define appropriate solution options, assumptions and dependencies.

● 3. Product Demonstrations and Client Workshops: Personally lead high-quality demonstrations of Intellect’s Trade

Finance solution across the trade lifecycle, solution walkthroughs, discovery workshops, use-case discussions, proof-of-concept sessions and technical/business presentations. Tailor demonstrations to the prospect’s requirements and articulate business value, product capabilities and competitive differentiation.

● 4. Solution Design and Proposal Development: Develop customer-specific solution approaches, scope documents, functional solution notes, implementation considerations, effort-estimation inputs, assumptions, exclusions and proposal content. Ensure that proposed solutions are commercially sound, implementable and aligned with the client’s objectives.

● 5. RFP/RFI and Deal Support: Lead or contribute to RFPs, RFIs, questionnaires, bid responses and presentations. Work with Sales and Pre-sales teams to qualify opportunities, articulate value propositions, address objections and support deal progression and closure.

● 6. Product and Engineering Collaboration: Work hands-on with Product, Business Analysts, Engineering, Architecture and QA teams to assess requirements, clarify business rules, prioritize enhancements and guide solution changes. Participate in solution reviews and relevant agile ceremonies; help ensure that requirements and acceptance criteria are clear and that changes address the underlying business need.

● 7. Delivery and Implementation Collaboration: Partner with Delivery, Implementation and Support teams to validate feasibility, integrations, dependencies, customization needs, effort assumptions and delivery risks. Support transition from sales to delivery and help resolve domain or solution issues during implementation where required.

● 8. Market and Customer Feedback Loop: Capture feedback from prospects, clients, demonstrations, implementations and competitive situations. Convert insights into actionable recommendations for product enhancements, roadmap priorities, solution assets and market positioning.

● 9. Commercial and Market Development: Support new sales, cross-sell and upsell across new and existing accounts. Engage senior stakeholders, contribute to pipeline development, and build trusted-advisor relationships

by connecting domain knowledge and technology capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

● 10. Sales Enablement and Knowledge Management: Develop and maintain reusable demo flows, solution notes, product collateral, proposal content, case studies, FAQs and competitive insights. Enable Sales, Pre-sales,

Product and Delivery teams through knowledge sharing and product training.

● 11. Innovation and Industry Awareness: Track market, regulatory and technology developments relevant to Trade Finance, including opportunities to apply AI and automation. Recommend practical enhancements and differentiated capabilities based on client needs and competitive trends.

**Experience and Qualifications**

● Extensive experience in Trade Finance, with a strong track record in one or more of technology development, technology sales, pre-sales/solution consulting, product consulting, business analysis, process transformation or implementation roles. Domain knowledge alone, without meaningful process or technology solutioning experience, is not sufficient.

● Deep working knowledge of Letters of Credit, Guarantees, Documentary Collections, Open Account, trade loans/financing, amendments, limits, document handling, settlement and reporting, plus relevant SWIFT/ICC and regulatory requirements, with the ability to understand end-to-end business processes, operating models, controls, products and client-specific requirements.

● Demonstrated experience in process analysis, reengineering or transformation, and translating business challenges into functional/technology solutions for banks or financial institutions.

● Proven ability to personally conduct product demonstrations, lead customer discovery and workshops, explain solution design, and respond confidently to business and technology questions from senior stakeholders.

● Experience working directly with Product, Engineering, Architecture and Delivery teams to define requirements, evaluate feasibility, shape enhancements and support implementation.

● Strong commercial acumen and experience contributing to complex sales pursuits, RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, executive presentations and deal conversion.

● Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to engage CXOs, business leaders, operations teams and technology stakeholders.

● Experience in banking technology, fintech or financial-services transformation is strongly preferred. Familiarity with agile product development and APIs/integrations is an advantage.

● Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent post-graduate qualification preferred.

**Why This Role**

You will work at the intersection of banking domain expertise, process transformation and technology—helping financial institutions solve real business problems while shaping the evolution of Intellect’s Trade Finance solutions.

The role offers direct customer exposure and the opportunity to influence solution design, product enhancements, sales outcomes and successful delivery.

description:
**Job Description**

Position Vice President – Trade Finance Solutions

Grade- VP Location Mumbai

Project-Fuel

About FuEL

FuEL is Intellect's Flagship program designed to develop the next generation of transformation leaders for the global Fintech/Insuretech industry. Created for high-potential professionals, the program equips participants to help financial institutions reimagine business models, accelerate digital and AI transformation, and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

**The Opportunity**

This role is for a Trade Finance leader who combines deep domain expertise with hands-on technology and process experience. You will shape solution propositions for banks, actively demonstrate Intellect’s Trade Finance capabilities, and work closely with Engineering and Delivery to evolve the solution in response to market needs and client requirements. The role spans consultative engagement, product solutioning, sales support, and ongoing product

development—not just domain advisory or relationship management.

You will engage business, product, operations, and technology leaders to understand their objectives, diagnose process and business challenges, and translate them into practical, differentiated solutions. You should be equally comfortable leading a client workshop, running a product demonstration, developing a solution approach, and working with internal teams on the changes needed to deliver it.

**Role Definition**

The Vice President – Trade Finance Solutions owns domain-led solutioning and supports growth across Intellect’s Trade Finance portfolio. The role combines customer discovery, process analysis and reengineering, product demonstrations, solution design, bid support, and collaboration with Product, Engineering and Delivery to ensure that proposed solutions are credible, differentiated, feasible, and aligned with customer needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

● 1. Prospect Understanding and Process Reengineering: Engage bank and financial-institution executives, business heads, product owners, operations and technology leaders to understand business models, workflows, pain points and strategic priorities. Analyse existing processes and identify opportunities for simplification, automation, control improvement and business transformation.

● 2. Domain Expertise and Solutioning: Apply strong Trade Finance knowledge to translate business requirements

into practical solution propositions. Map customer processes and requirements to product capabilities, identify

gaps, distinguish standard product functionality from client-specific changes, and define appropriate solution options, assumptions and dependencies.

● 3. Product Demonstrations and Client Workshops: Personally lead high-quality demonstrations of Intellect’s Trade

Finance solution across the trade lifecycle, solution walkthroughs, discovery workshops, use-case discussions, proof-of-concept sessions and technical/business presentations. Tailor demonstrations to the prospect’s requirements and articulate business value, product capabilities and competitive differentiation.

● 4. Solution Design and Proposal Development: Develop customer-specific solution approaches, scope documents, functional solution notes, implementation considerations, effort-estimation inputs, assumptions, exclusions and proposal content. Ensure that proposed solutions are commercially sound, implementable and aligned with the client’s objectives.

● 5. RFP/RFI and Deal Support: Lead or contribute to RFPs, RFIs, questionnaires, bid responses and presentations. Work with Sales and Pre-sales teams to qualify opportunities, articulate value propositions, address objections and support deal progression and closure.

● 6. Product and Engineering Collaboration: Work hands-on with Product, Business Analysts, Engineering, Architecture and QA teams to assess requirements, clarify business rules, prioritize enhancements and guide solution changes. Participate in solution reviews and relevant agile ceremonies; help ensure that requirements and acceptance criteria are clear and that changes address the underlying business need.

● 7. Delivery and Implementation Collaboration: Partner with Delivery, Implementation and Support teams to validate feasibility, integrations, dependencies, customization needs, effort assumptions and delivery risks. Support transition from sales to delivery and help resolve domain or solution issues during implementation where required.

● 8. Market and Customer Feedback Loop: Capture feedback from prospects, clients, demonstrations, implementations and competitive situations. Convert insights into actionable recommendations for product enhancements, roadmap priorities, solution assets and market positioning.

● 9. Commercial and Market Development: Support new sales, cross-sell and upsell across new and existing accounts. Engage senior stakeholders, contribute to pipeline development, and build trusted-advisor relationships

by connecting domain knowledge and technology capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

● 10. Sales Enablement and Knowledge Management: Develop and maintain reusable demo flows, solution notes, product collateral, proposal content, case studies, FAQs and competitive insights. Enable Sales, Pre-sales,

Product and Delivery teams through knowledge sharing and product training.

● 11. Innovation and Industry Awareness: Track market, regulatory and technology developments relevant to Trade Finance, including opportunities to apply AI and automation. Recommend practical enhancements and differentiated capabilities based on client needs and competitive trends.

**Experience and Qualifications**

● Extensive experience in Trade Finance, with a strong track record in one or more of technology development, technology sales, pre-sales/solution consulting, product consulting, business analysis, process transformation or implementation roles. Domain knowledge alone, without meaningful process or technology solutioning experience, is not sufficient.

● Deep working knowledge of Letters of Credit, Guarantees, Documentary Collections, Open Account, trade loans/financing, amendments, limits, document handling, settlement and reporting, plus relevant SWIFT/ICC and regulatory requirements, with the ability to understand end-to-end business processes, operating models, controls, products and client-specific requirements.

● Demonstrated experience in process analysis, reengineering or transformation, and translating business challenges into functional/technology solutions for banks or financial institutions.

● Proven ability to personally conduct product demonstrations, lead customer discovery and workshops, explain solution design, and respond confidently to business and technology questions from senior stakeholders.

● Experience working directly with Product, Engineering, Architecture and Delivery teams to define requirements, evaluate feasibility, shape enhancements and support implementation.

● Strong commercial acumen and experience contributing to complex sales pursuits, RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, executive presentations and deal conversion.

● Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to engage CXOs, business leaders, operations teams and technology stakeholders.

● Experience in banking technology, fintech or financial-services transformation is strongly preferred. Familiarity with agile product development and APIs/integrations is an advantage.

● Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent post-graduate qualification preferred.

**Why This Role**

You will work at the intersection of banking domain expertise, process transformation and technology—helping financial institutions solve real business problems while shaping the evolution of Intellect’s Trade Finance solutions.

The role offers direct customer exposure and the opportunity to influence solution design, product enhancements, sales outcomes and successful delivery.

title: Investment Associate – Venture Capital
description:
**Investment Associate – Venture Capital**

**Location: Mumbai | Full-time | On-site**

**About Rockstud Capital**

**Rockstud Capital is an India-focused investment platform managing SEBI-registered Category I and Category II Alternative Investment Funds. Our current investment focus centres on manufacturing-led businesses and applied deep technology, including advanced manufacturing, industrial systems, defence, aerospace, space technologies, industrial sustainability and manufacturing-led consumer businesses.**

**We assess opportunities through commercial and operating fundamentals: engineering capability, competitive differentiation, unit economics, capital efficiency, governance and the ability to scale. We work closely with founders on investment strategy, business priorities and long-term growth.**

**About the Role**

**We are looking for an Investment Associate who can independently identify promising businesses, build relationships with founders and industry participants, and develop well-reasoned investment recommendations.**

**This is a sourcing-led investment role within a lean, founder-led team. You will take ownership of opportunities from identification and initial engagement through preliminary evaluation and preparation for deeper diligence, working closely with colleagues responsible for transaction execution and portfolio management.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Originate investment opportunities:**
  Build a consistent pipeline aligned with Rockstud’s investment focus through direct founder outreach, sector research and relationships with investors, incubators, accelerators and industry networks.
* **Own founder engagement:**
  Lead initial discussions, ask commercially relevant questions, maintain timely follow-ups and build constructive relationships.
* **Develop sector insight:**
  Map industries, value chains and emerging businesses to identify attractive investment themes and sourcing opportunities.
* **Evaluate businesses:**
  Assess business models, market opportunities, competitive positioning, technology differentiation, customer adoption, unit economics and scalability.
* **Analyse financial performance:**
  Review financial statements, build appropriate projections and valuation analyses, and assess working-capital requirements, capital intensity and funding needs.
* **Prepare investment recommendations:**
  Write clear screening notes and investment memos that explain the opportunity, key risks, unresolved questions and recommended next steps.
* **Support diligence and transactions:**
  Coordinate with the investment team, founders and relevant specialists, ensuring a clear handover of findings, documents and outstanding issues.
* **Maintain investment records:**
  Keep pipeline information, meeting notes, source documents and next actions current and organised.
* Contribute to selected portfolio and strategic projects where your sector knowledge or relationships can add value.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Relevant experience in venture capital, private equity, investment banking, transaction advisory, consulting or an industrial/technology business.
* Evidence of independently identifying opportunities, developing relationships and taking work through to a clear outcome.
* A strong interest in manufacturing and applied technology, with the ability to understand unfamiliar businesses and distinguish technical claims from commercial potential.
* Sound financial analysis, modelling and valuation skills.
* Clear writing and communication, including the ability to form and defend an investment view.
* Initiative, sound judgement and disciplined follow-through in a lean team.
* Comfort working from our Mumbai office and travelling for founder meetings, industry engagement and site visits when required.
* A degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Business or a related discipline. CA, CFA progress or an MBA would be an advantage.
* Candidates should be able to explain their individual contribution to previous sourcing, evaluation or transaction work, including the decisions made and outcomes achieved.

eam & Stakeholder Management

title: Assistant Manager, Accounts Payable
description:
**Overview**
Cactus Life Sciences is a remote-first organization, and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.
  
  
We are looking for an Assistant Manager , Accounts Payable to join our Finance team and play a key role in managing day-to-day invoice processing and Accounts Payable activities.
  
  
In this role,you will own end-to-end Accounts Payable operations across our US, India, UK and Swiss entities, and the reporting that gives management visibility into payables, vendor exposure and cash commitments. You are required to set the standard for AP accuracy, control, and timeliness. You work closely with procurement, business users, taxation, and the month-end close team
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the full procure-to-pay AP cycle across markets: invoice validation, PO matching, coding, approvals, payment runs and reconciliations.
* Review and approve payment proposals against due dates, priorities, and cash availability.
* Review vendor ageing, advances and open balances, and ensure timely vendor statement reconciliations.
* Act as the escalation point for vendors and internal queries, resolving issues quickly with procurement and business users.
* Govern vendor master data, including onboarding checks and bank detail changes
* Ensure correct withholding tax and indirect tax treatment on vendor invoices (TDS and GST in India, 1099 reporting in the US, VAT in the UK and Switzerland).
* Reconcile GSTR-2B with the purchase and vendor ledgers each month.
* Coordinate with the tax team on AP-related filings and queries.
* Identify control gaps and drive corrective action.
* Prepare AP schedules, reconciliations and supporting documents for statutory, internal and tax audits, and close audit observations related to AP.
* Maintain controls against duplicate, incorrect, and unauthorized payments.
* Deliver AP sub-ledger reconciliations, accruals, prepayments and GRNI reviews within close timelines.
* Resolve open items and ensure AP-related journals are accurate and supported.
* Produce a regular AP reporting pack covering ageing, DPO, payment commitments, vendor concentration, statutory liabilities, and cash outflow forecasts.
* Provide inputs to treasury and the CFO for cash flow planning and working capital decisions.
* Track and report AP KPIs such as invoice cycle time, first-pass match rate, overdue payables, and late-payment exposure.
* Identify and implement improvements in AP workflow, invoice capture, approvals, and reconciliations.
* Drive effective use of Oracle Fusion and work with IT on automation initiatives.
* Document and maintain SOPs for AP and reconciliation processes.

**Qualifications And Prerequisites**

* CA, MBA (Finance) or equivalent, with 6 to 8 years of AP experience, preferably across multiple geographies.
* Hands-on experience with month-end close and audit support
* Strong working knowledge of withholding tax and indirect tax (India required; US, UK and Swiss exposure preferred).
* Working knowledge of accounting principles (Ind AS, US GAAP, or IFRS).
* Proficiency in an ERP, with Oracle or Oracle Fusion preferred, and advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, reconciliations). Power BI or similar is a plus.
* Strong analytical, reconciliation, and reporting skills.
* Attention to detail, ownership, and the ability to work tight deadlines across time zones.
* Clear communication with vendors, auditors, and senior management.

Application Process
  
  
Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, the process starts with a recruiter screening, followed by 4 interview rounds, including the HRBP interview.
  
  
**AI at Cactus Life Sciences**
The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.
  
  
AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.
  
  
We believe in Human-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline - science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.
  
  
You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
  
  
**About CACTUS**
At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange—leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyze their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.

title: Data Steward, SAPAC (contract)
description:
**With a passion for life**
Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
  
  
Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.
  
  
**Please Note - This is a 24-month contractual position**
**Job Purpose**
The Data Steward is the operational execution lead for commercial data quality across SAPAC, supporting the Data Coordinator and the respective business data owners. The role performs recurring data verification, audits, sampling and correction activities, directly supports designated markets, and produces the reporting required to identify and resolve data quality issues — flagging the underlying cause of each issue so that it can be addressed at source.
  
  
**Output: accurate data, completed corrections under owner approval, managed exceptions, root causes flagged, and timely data quality reporting.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Recurring verification and reporting (all markets, under the agreed allocation)**

* Post-load price verification after every price load: sample SKUs against the approved price file and flag mismatches for correction (accuracy — distinct from the Data Coordinator's quarterly audit of timeliness)
* All cost-to-price reconciliation: spare parts each price-increase cycle (selling price versus current transfer price per part, flagging negative or below-threshold margins) and completeness checks on capital and consumables reconciliation
* Monthly contract-expiry report per market: contracts expiring within 90 days with no renewal action, and the on-time renewal rate
* Monthly preventive-maintenance completion reporting using the regional tracker template
* Quarterly customer-master-to-pricing audits where applicable: affiliations, hierarchies and classifications that drive pricing conditions
* Quarterly customer master hygiene runs: duplicate detection, entity and payer verification, classification checks
* Quarterly point-of-sale service-contract reconciliation and warranty-versus-installation allocation sampling
* Rotating monthly contract-record completeness sampling by market (expiry, pricing and coverage fields)
* For every recurring exception, record the likely underlying cause (process, ownership, system) alongside the correction, so patterns can be addressed by the Data Coordinator and the business owner

**Direct execution for designated markets (primary executor)**

* Prepare, validate and load price files into SAP for designated markets — reviewed by the Data Coordinator, verified and signed off by the market's Finance Director
* Execute installed base corrections and cleansing, customer master de-duplication and corrections, and contract-record completion, each under business-owner approval
* Capture point-of-sale service contracts into the portfolio and maintain preventive-maintenance tracking where local capacity is limited
* Enter and maintain distributor installation and end-customer data received under the regional collection standard
* Keep the execution log: every change, its approving data owner, and turnaround — reported to the Steering Committee via the Lead

**Installed base (all markets)**

* Execute the corrections arising from the installed base accuracy programme coordinated by the Data Coordinator; maintain the underlying data for the country accuracy score

**Support and enablement**

* Handle hands-on support requests from non-designated markets — price-file validation, IB corrections, de-duplication — logged and reported, with the Steering Committee managing the balance against verification work
* Maintain the single current repository of data SOPs using existing global platforms (GetBasic, GetLibrary, GetQMS, the Finance Manual) rather than local copies
* Produce one-page filter, currency and refresh-cycle guides for the global dashboards and support market training

**Phase 2 (from month 6, gated)**

* Zone and region performance reporting for India, building on work already under way with the Service Director
* Account-history and customer summary requests for sales and service teams, once scoped by the Steering Committee

**Requirements**
**Must have:**

* 4–8 years in data operations, master data maintenance, finance operations, order management or service administration
* Hands-on SAP experience in at least two of: customer master, material master, pricing conditions, equipment and service-contract records — including creating and maintaining records, not only reporting on them
* Advanced Excel (lookups, pivots, reconciliations); Power BI a strong advantage
* Meticulous attention to detail and the persistence to work through large record sets methodically
* The habit of asking why an error occurred — able to recognise when a data problem is really a process or ownership problem, and to say so
* Good written and spoken English; able to explain an exception clearly to a colleague in another country
* Comfortable working across cultures and time zones with people who do not report to you

**Good To Have**

* An analytics background or interest — the role has a Phase 2 pathway into reporting and analytics work
* Medical-device, pharmaceutical or other regulated-industry experience
* Exposure to service-contract or installed-base administration
* Experience with distributor or channel data

**About Us**
With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: Investment Analyst, Portfolio Management

Suburban office campuses, strata offices, data centres, senior living and infrastructure assets follow, each as its own strategy, sequenced on delivery and each in a white space others have left open, with a clear path to REITs and InvITs. Real assets only, across every class the platform grows into, in sequence.WHY THIS ROLE EXISTSThe portfolio management company needs clean research, accurate data and books that close every day. Real estate development, leasing or consulting does not count towards this.Excel models you have built yourself.You use AI tools every day in your work and can show what you have done with them.Mumbai, on site.AdvantageousAn MBA, a CA, or the CFA at any level.NISM certifications, such as XXI-B or XIX-D.Real estate or infrastructure investing, REITs or InvITs.Bloomberg, Capitaline, ACE Equity or similar tools.Portfolio accounting or back-office systems.What this role is notIt is not a decision-making seat. You do not approve investments or vote at the Investment Committee.It is not an investment banking seat. Deal preparation and investor coordination for the platform sit with the capital formation team.It is not a finance or accounts seat. Accounts and treasury sit with the finance team.STANDING REQUIREMENTSAI proficiency is a standing requirement in every seat at Vantrock. You use AI tools daily as force multipliers, and you judge their output rather than forwarding it. This is tested for every appointment through a supervised assessment. There are no exceptions by seniority.Partner command is the second standing requirement. Vantrock runs on outsourced partners, so every person here must be able to scope, brief, hold to an SLA, score and commercially discipline a partner, and must know what should never be delegated.COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHYThe people who build the platform own a piece of it, vesting over time. A market salary covers the month. The rest of what you earn here is built: pay on what you bring in, for land, leases and capital, so a good year in your seat is yours and not only the company's, and a stake in a platform designed to be worth more for every rupee it manages than one assembled the old way. * Benefits: An attractive salary package including additional extralegal vacation days, and other competitive benefits.
* Well-being: Thrive in a workplace that supports your physical and mental health by promoting a wide range of facilities and activities like birthday events, sports sessions, in-house coaches and healthy meal options.
* Innovation: Fuel innovation through collaboration, experimentation, and out of the box thinking.

**Our Company**
We’re a leading game changer that optimizes supply chains with our very own smart software and services. With a team of 1,400+ passionate, creative minds from over 70 nationalities, we help the world’s largest companies to run their supply chains more efficiently and sustainably. Our customers include BASF, Johnson & Johnson, L’Oréal, Nestlé, and Procter & Gamble.
  
  
Ready to be smart with heart? Join our team where technical expertise and human connection create solutions that scale globally and make a lasting impression.

title: Record to Report Accountant
description:
We are looking for a
**Record to Report Accountant**
to join our Group Finance team, with a strong focus on
**R2R governance, financial controls, reconciliations and process oversight**
.
  
  
The role will support the design, implementation and monitoring of finance controls across the R2R function, while maintaining a strong understanding of accounting processes, systems and month-end activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the R2R framework, including monitoring of key financial controls and adherence to established policies and procedures.
* Perform and monitor ICOFR / internal control activities, including control execution, evidence review, exception identification and remediation tracking.
* Support BlackLine governance and controls, including reconciliation compliance, journal controls, workflow monitoring, exception reporting and follow-up of outstanding actions.
* Review Balance Sheet reconciliations and accounting processes to identify control gaps, unusual movements, aged/open items and potential financial reporting risks.
* Assess the design and operational effectiveness of controls and support documentation of control procedures, testing and conclusions.
* Prepare and maintain control workpapers, process documentation, evidence packs and management reporting in line with governance requirements.
* Identify control exceptions and process gaps, perform root-cause analysis, and work with process owners to drive timely remediation.
* Support internal and external audits, including preparation of audit schedules, supporting documentation, walkthroughs and responses to audit queries.
* Assist in drafting and documenting audit findings, control observations and remediation actions for discussion with senior stakeholders.
* Monitor R2R governance metrics and prepare dashboards and management reports covering areas such as reconciliation compliance, BlackLine performance, control exceptions, aged items and action closure.
* Support month-end and year-end close activities, including journals, accruals, prepayments, reclassifications, FX and Balance Sheet accounting, where required.
* Maintain a strong understanding of the underlying accounting processes and General Ledger, ensuring that governance and controls remain connected to the accounting activity.
* Work with Finance teams to identify opportunities for standardisation, automation and process improvement.

**Technical Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce or a related field.
* 5–8 years of experience in Record to Report, General Ledger, Financial Controls, Internal Audit or a similar finance environment.
* Strong understanding of R2R accounting processes, Balance Sheet reconciliations and month-end close.
* Experience in control testing, control monitoring and assessment of control design and operational effectiveness.
* Exposure to Internal Audit, SOX/ICOFR, risk and control frameworks is preferred.

**System Knowledge**

* Understanding of BlackLine or similar reconciliation/journal management platforms.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting and dashboard preparation.
* Experience working with ERP systems such as Oracle NetSuite, SAP, Navision or similar.
* Experience with Power BI or other reporting/dashboard tools would be an advantage.

Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right.
