title: Principal Officer- PMS
description: ABOUT VANTROCKVantrock is an operator-led real assets platform, built to work in the white space of every strategy it enters. A real asset is three jobs: finding the land, building and running the asset, managing the capital that owns it. Vantrock does all three with one team. Headquartered in Mumbai, it originates, develops, operates and manages institutional-grade real assets from land to operations. Warehousing, industrial and logistics parks are the first strategy. The platform is run by operators, and it is built to run lean. Suburban office campuses, strata offices, data centres, senior living and infrastructure assets follow, each as its own strategy, sequenced on delivery and each in a white space others have left open, with a clear path to REITs and InvITs. Real assets only, across every class the platform grows into, in sequence.WHY THIS ROLE EXISTSWe are launching the platform's portfolio management company. It will manage discretionary and non-discretionary portfolios and advisory mandates for investors, in listed and unlisted securities, within the rules. Those rules require one person to answer for every decision made for a client and for how the business runs. That person is the Principal Officer.This seat is that person. You design the investment approaches, build the process and the operating platform, make the portfolio decisions and keep the record of why each one was made. You bring a securities-market discipline to a platform whose roots are in real assets.You should not apply if your recent years have been spent in coverage or product while someone else ran the portfolios. We are looking for the person who ran them.WHAT YOU WILL OWN1. Investment Strategy and Portfolio ManagementDevelop and execute the PMS investment strategy, with a focus on listed real estate and real estate-linked companies.Identify investment opportunities across market capitalisations, sectors and investment styles, based on fundamental research and valuation discipline.Lead portfolio construction, security selection, position sizing, capital allocation and portfolio rebalancing.Develop investment theses based on business fundamentals, earnings growth, asset quality, management capability, balance-sheet strength and valuation.Monitor market conditions, sector developments, interest-rate movements, liquidity and macroeconomic factors affecting portfolio performance.Make investment recommendations and decisions in accordance with the approved investment mandate, client objectives and risk parameters.2. Real Estate and Sector ResearchConduct detailed research on listed real estate developers, REITs, warehousing and industrial park operators, construction companies, cement and building-material manufacturers, and other real estate-related businesses.Analyse real estate market cycles, residential and commercial demand, office leasing, rental growth, vacancy levels, absorption, project launches and inventory.Understand the business models of asset-heavy companies, developers, landlords, REITs and real estate service providers.Evaluate land banks, development pipelines, project-level economics, pre-sales, collections, rental yields, occupancy, lease expiries and capital expenditure requirements, wherever relevant.Assess the implications of interest rates, financing costs, leverage, refinancing requirements and regulatory changes on sector participants.Track listed-company disclosures, earnings announcements, corporate actions, industry data and competitor performance to identify emerging opportunities and risks.3. Financial Analysis and ValuationBuild and review financial models, forecasts, scenario analyses and valuation frameworks for investment opportunities.Apply relevant valuation methodologies, including discounted cash flow (DCF), comparable-company analysis, EV/EBITDA, price-to-earnings, NAV-based valuation and cap-rate-based valuation, as appropriate to the business.Analyse revenue recognition, earnings quality, operating cash flows, working capital, debt maturity profiles and capital allocation.Evaluate the relationship between market prices and underlying business fundamentals, asset values and future earnings potential.Perform sensitivity analysis to assess downside risks arising from lower sales, rental pressure, delayed projects, higher financing costs or valuation multiple compression.Establish clear investment theses, target valuations, downside scenarios, investment horizons and exit criteria.4. Investment Research and Due DiligenceLead fundamental research on prospective investments and prepare detailed investment notes for internal review.Review annual reports, quarterly results, investor presentations, credit ratings, exchange disclosures and relevant industry publications.Conduct management interactions, analyst calls, industry expert discussions and other permitted research activities.Assess corporate governance, promoter track records, related-party transactions, auditor observations, capital allocation practices and other material risks.Maintain a documented investment process covering the rationale for entry, ongoing monitoring, changes in thesis and exit decisions.Track the performance of investment recommendations against relevant benchmarks and evaluate the effectiveness of the investment process.5. Portfolio Risk Management and Performance MonitoringMonitor portfolio concentration, sector exposures, liquidity, volatility, drawdowns and security-specific risks.Establish and review appropriate portfolio risk limits, monitoring triggers and escalation procedures.Assess correlations between holdings and the portfolio's sensitivity to interest rates, credit conditions, real estate cycles and broader equity-market movements.Conduct portfolio stress tests and downside scenario analyses.Review portfolio performance against the appropriate benchmark and evaluate the contribution of individual securities, sectors and investment decisions.Take timely action when the investment thesis weakens, valuations become unattractive or risk parameters are breached.6. Regulatory Responsibilities and GovernanceDischarge the responsibilities assigned to the Principal Officer under the applicable SEBI Portfolio Managers Regulations and other relevant regulatory requirements.Ensure that investment activities are undertaken within the PMS's approved investment mandate, applicable client agreements and internal investment policies.Work closely with the Compliance Officer to support compliance with SEBI requirements, disclosure obligations, reporting requirements and applicable internal controls.Ensure that investment decisions and material portfolio actions are appropriately documented and supported by the investment process.Promote fair treatment of clients, appropriate handling of conflicts of interest, confidentiality and adherence to applicable conduct standards.Participate in regulatory reviews, internal audits, compliance reviews and inspections, as required.Oversee the implementation of appropriate investment controls, escalation mechanisms and governance processes in coordination with the relevant functions.7. Client and Stakeholder EngagementExplain investment strategy, portfolio positioning, sector outlook and performance drivers to senior management and relevant stakeholders.Contribute to periodic investment updates, portfolio commentary and performance reviews.Support the preparation of investment-related content for client communications and marketing materials, subject to applicable regulatory requirements.Coordinate with the Compliance Officer, operations team, research analysts, custodians and other service providers to ensure smooth functioning of the PMS business.WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOREssentialOne of these qualifications: a CFA charter. A Chartered Accountant or Cost and Management Accountant. A graduate degree with a professional qualification in finance, law, accountancy or business management, such as an MBA, PGDM or LLB. Or the one-year NISM Post Graduate Program in Securities Market (Portfolio Management). CFA Level I or II, FRM or CFP alone do not qualify.8+ years work experience in the securities market, at a portfolio manager, alternative investment manager, asset manager, stock broker, investment adviser or research analyst, with at least 2 of those years in portfolio management, investment advisory or fund management. Real estate development, leasing or consulting does not count towards this.A current NISM-Series-XXI-B Portfolio Managers certificate when you join.A clean record: no adverse securities-market proceedings, no relevant conviction and no regulatory debarment.You use AI tools every day in your work and can show what you have done with them.Mumbai, on site.AdvantageousReal estate, infrastructure or credit portfolios at an alternative investment manager, a REIT or an InvIT.NISM-Series-XIX-C or XIX-D certification.Setting up or scaling a portfolio management or advisory business.Credit analysis of debentures and structured debt.What this role is notIt is not the co-investment seat. Co-investment alongside the investment manager sits with the investment manager's own team.It is not a capital-raising seat. Investor and capital-partner coverage for the platform sits with the capital formation team.It is not a land origination seat. Land sits with the land and investments team.It is not a finance or treasury seat. Accounts, treasury and banking relationships sit with the finance team.STANDING REQUIREMENTSAI proficiency is a standing requirement in every seat at Vantrock. You use AI tools daily as force multipliers, and you judge their output rather than forwarding it. This is tested for every appointment through a supervised assessment. There are no exceptions by seniority.Partner command is the second standing requirement. Vantrock runs on outsourced partners, so every person here must be able to scope, brief, hold to an SLA, score and commercially discipline a partner, and must know what should never be delegated.COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHYThe people who build the platform own a piece of it, vesting over time. A market salary covers the month. The rest of what you earn here is built: pay on what you bring in, for land, leases and capital, so a good year in your seat is yours and not only the company's, and a stake in a platform designed to be worth more for every rupee it manages than one assembled the old way. Most careers in this industry pay you for your time. This one is built to make you wealthier for what you build. Run your seat like it is yours, because part of it is.CULTURAL FITWe're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.We don't fill seats. We build the platform.

title: Business Manager
description:
Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem.
  
  
With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to business-to-business technology experts.
  
  
Our market reach, diverse solutions and services portfolio, and digital platform Ingram Micro Xvantage™ set us apart
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Business Manager to manage and grow the assigned technology portfolio. The role will be responsible for driving vendor relationships, business planning, product lifecycle management, demand generation, profitability, and market growth across Server, Storage, Backup, and Data Protection solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess strong technical knowledge, vendor management experience, and the ability to work closely with Sales, Pre-Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Channel Partners to achieve revenue and profitability objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product & Vendor Management**

* Own and manage the complete product portfolio for Server, Storage, Backup, and Data Protection solutions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with OEMs and technology vendors.
* Develop and execute business plans to drive revenue growth, profitability, and market penetration.
* Manage vendor programs, rebates, incentives, pricing, and business reviews.
* Drive quarterly and annual business planning with technology vendors.

**Revenue & Profitability Management**

* Achieve assigned revenue, gross margin, and market share targets.
* Monitor business performance and implement strategies to maximize profitability.
* Identify growth opportunities across existing and new customer segments.
* Work with sales teams to accelerate pipeline creation and opportunity conversion.

**Demand Planning & Inventory Management**

* Forecast demand and manage inventory levels to ensure product availability.
* Optimize working capital through effective stock planning and inventory control.
* Monitor inventory ageing and implement corrective actions.
* Coordinate with operations and procurement teams to ensure timely product availability.

**Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy**

* Develop and execute go-to-market plans for new product launches and technology solutions.
* Plan promotions, channel programs, incentives, and partner engagement activities.
* Work with marketing teams on events, webinars, campaigns, and lead-generation initiatives.
* Monitor effectiveness of marketing programs and recommend improvements.

**Channel & Sales Enablement**

* Support channel partners and internal sales teams with product positioning and competitive strategies.
* Conduct product training sessions, technical workshops, and partner enablement programs.
* Develop sales kits, presentations, solution briefs, and competitive battle cards.
* Assist sales teams in strategic opportunities and large deal closures.

**Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis**

* Track industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive developments.
* Analyze market demand and customer requirements.
* Develop competitive positioning strategies to strengthen market presence.
* Provide insights and recommendations for portfolio expansion.

**Customer & Partner Engagement**

* Engage with key customers, system integrators, and channel partners.
* Participate in customer meetings, solution discussions, and business reviews.
* Support the development of strategic customer relationships.
* Work closely with partners to create and close business opportunities.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Sales, Pre-Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Vendor teams.
* Drive alignment between business objectives and execution plans.
* Prepare business reports, forecasts, dashboards, and management presentations.
* Ensure smooth execution of commercial and operational processes.

**Desired Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of Server, Storage, Backup, Disaster Recovery, and Data Protection solutions.
* Excellent vendor and product management skills.
* Business planning and revenue management expertise.
* Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills.
* Inventory planning and working capital management knowledge.
* Data-driven and analytical approach to decision-making.
* Excellent presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong communication and relationship-building capabilities.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

title: Billing Analyst
description:
**Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?**
At
**Aleph**
, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.
  
  
Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.
  
  
With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Billing Analyst in our Finance team, you will keep Aleph’s client billing accurate and on time. You will work in SAP across invoicing, accounts receivable (AR) operations, reconciliation and financial reporting, including month-end close.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Prepare, verify and issue client invoices accurately and on schedule, including during high-volume billing cycles.
* Review bills and billing data before processing to confirm they are complete and correct.
* Resolve complex billing issues using the Dispute application in SAP.
* Post bank receipt entries in the books of account and apply them to customer accounts in SAP, making sure all bank offset accounts and bank-in-transit items are cleared on a weekly basis.
* Reconcile customer accounts and receivables.
* Review, monitor and control the accrued revenue balance to ensure that all accruals are settled.
* Support month-end closing for the billing group and prepare billing and AR financial reports.
* Respond to client queries and revise invoices when needed; send hard-copy invoices and Release Orders (ROs) to clients where required.
* Apply basic tax knowledge when preparing invoices and reconciling accounts, in line with local requirements.
* Support internal and external auditors with billing data, documentation and bill verification, and liaise with other stakeholders as needed.
* Follow billing procedures and quality checks, and suggest practical improvements to how we bill and reconcile.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration or a related field.
* 4–5 years of relevant experience in billing, accounts receivable or finance operations.
* At least 2 years of hands-on SAP experience (any version, for example SAP ECC or S/4HANA).
* Strong accounting fundamentals, including reconciliations, accruals and month-end close.
* Basic tax knowledge (a tax specialist background is not needed).
* Ability to handle large-volume invoicing with accuracy and attention to detail.
* Basic English proficiency
* Flexibility to work across time zones and to put in extended hours during seasonal peaks.
* Professional certifications (for example CPA or CFA) are not required.
* Nice to have: prior experience in the media or advertising industry; an MBA in Finance.

**Why Join Aleph**

* Impact: Your work keeps billing and revenue flowing for partnerships that help platforms like TikTok, Amazon and Google grow advertising in 130+ markets.
* Growth: We give our internal talent room to grow and learn together; this role builds depth in SAP, AR operations, accrual control and month-end close.
* Team culture: Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives and talents, where people support each other and value open communication and partnership.
* Market context: Digital advertising changes fast, and our finance team sits at the centre of a global, multi-market business. You will join a market with a deep finance and shared-services talent community.
* Curiosity welcome: We stay flexible and adaptable, move with the speed of change, and encourage everyone to keep learning and seeking out new opportunities.

**Why Join Us?**
Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.
  
  
We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.

description:

title: Account Manager - Aerospace & Defense
description:

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
At Emerson Test & Measurement Business Group (Formerly known as National Instruments), we help the world’s leading innovators engineer and validate next-generation technologies with confidence. We are looking for a driven, technically credible, and growth-oriented Aerospace & Defense Account Manager to lead strategic customer engagement and business expansion across India’s rapidly growing Aerospace & Defense ecosystem.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Aerospace & Defense Account Manager will be responsible for driving growth across strategic A&D accounts by building strong customer relationships, influencing complex solution opportunities, and developing scalable partnerships with System Integrators.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings strong domain understanding of Aerospace & Defense programs, experience navigating large and complex organizations, and the ability to collaborate with ecosystem partners to drive long-term business growth.
  
  
This role requires a blend of business development expertise, technical acumen, partner ecosystem management, and executive stakeholder engagement.
  
  
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Drive revenue growth through consultative selling and solution-led engagement
* Develop trusted relationships with government organizations, defense labs, PSUs, private aerospace companies, and ecosystem partners
* Work closely with System Integrators to build scalable go-to-market models and expand business reach
* Identify opportunities across radar, RF & microwave, electronic warfare, avionics, communications, validation, HIL, automated test, and embedded systems
* Collaborate with System Integrators to influence specifications, solution architectures, and large program opportunities
* Lead account planning, pipeline development, forecasting, and executive business reviews
* Coordinate with application engineering, services, partners, and global teams to deliver customer success
* Lead customer presentations, technical discussions, workshops, and commercial negotiations
* Engage technical and leadership stakeholders through workshops, solution presentations, and strategic discussions
* Understand customer roadmaps, procurement cycles, compliance requirements, and program priorities
* Track industry trends, defense modernization initiatives, and competitive activity to shape growth strategies

**Who You Are:**
You are a proactive, strategic problem solver who establishes last relationships and delivers exceptional results. You’re comfortable managing complex accounts and driving account growth at both tactical and strategic levels.
  
  
**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering is mandatory (Electronics, Electrical, ECE, Instrumentation, Aerospace, or related disciplines preferred)
* 6–10 years of experience in Aerospace & Defense sales, account management, business development, or technical consulting
* Strong understanding of Aerospace & Defense test, validation, or embedded system workflows
* Proven experience working with or managing System Integrators as business partners
* Ability to build and scale ecosystem-driven business models
* Experience engaging with defense organizations, labs, PSUs, OEMs, or strategic government programs
* Strong communication, commercial negotiation, and executive engagement skills
* Ability to manage long sales cycles and complex stakeholder environments
* Willingness to travel based on business requirements
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to drive strategic growth
* Technical credibility with customer engineering and program teams
* Strong collaboration skills across customers, partners, and internal teams
* Ability to influence complex multi-stakeholder opportunities
* High energy, execution focus, and customer obsession
* Strategic thinker with a bias for action and results

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**

* Prior experience with National Instruments / Emerson Test & Measurement solutions will be a strong advantage
* Familiarity with PXI, RF test systems, HIL platforms, modular instrumentation, or automated validation architectures
* Exposure to Aerospace & Defense standards, mission systems, or electronic test systems
* Experience working on large strategic programs through ecosystem and partner-led models
* Knowledge of LabVIEW, TestStand, Python, or automated test software frameworks is an added advantage

**Our Culture & Commitment to You:**
At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
  
  
We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
  
  
**About Us**
**WHY EMERSON**
**Our Commitment to Our People**
At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.
  
  
We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.
  
  
At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.

title: Consultant
description:

* Existing network with HVAC/MEP consultants and contractors

**Contract / Consultant (Fixed salary + Commission on successful orders)**

title: Strategic Key Account(s) Manager
description:
**About us:**

Restroworks (formerly Posist) is a leading cloud-based enterprise technology platform that powers over 20,000 restaurants globally. Restroworks offers a unified cloud technology platform that streamlines restaurants' Front-of-House (FOH), Back-of-House (BOH), Integrations, Analytics, and CRM. Renowned restaurant chains, including Taco Bell, Subway, Carl’s Jr, Sbarro Pizza, are powered by the platform.

Restroworks is certified with ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27701, SOC1 Type 2, SOC 2 Type 2, and GDPR compliant. The company is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ organization, placing it among one of the top employers of choice.

If you are someone who picks up customer calls anytime anywhere.

Be a partner to your key accounts in their good, bad and ugly times.

Juggle between various teams to stuff done.

Doing the difficult job of saying no to customer requests while fully aligned with splicing their key problem requires product and domain knowledge as well as conviction.

Carrying 4-8 years of work exp.

Empathy and understanding that any issue hampering operations needs to be resolved in a timely manner.

Good account managers run business great ones build further, we expect you to get new logos through customer references.

Conducting MBR/QBR’s is a

vital part of the role, mind of a project manager and heart of customer relations.

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Consultant - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description: You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.THE WORKUtilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate:Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case DevelopmentIdentify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states. Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context. Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools. Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives. Client Engagement & Advisory SupportSupport client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions. Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders. Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams. Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples. Data & AI FoundationsDevelop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems. Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations. Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows. Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

title: Utilities Field Product Leader
description:
Founding Head — Utilities Field Product

**Build, roll out and grow OriginBluy's new field platform for gas utilities, from the first site to the next client.**

About OriginBluy

OriginBluy is building a new product: a field work platform that connects a city gas company's contractors, customer care and customers in one live job record. Contractors update each job on WhatsApp with photo proof. The status flows into the utility's SAP, and customers hear what is happening before they have to ask.

Our first deployment is a 90-day pilot with a leading Gujarat gas utility that completes about 38,500 new connections a quarter. You will be the person who makes that pilot work on the ground, and the template for every city we expand to after it.

The role

You own the success of a new product, end to end. First, you make our pilot with a leading Gujarat gas utility a clear success. Then you take that proof to other utilities and lead the sale. In the morning you may be on a site with a plumbing crew; in the afternoon, presenting results to an MD or pitching a new client.

This is a product-building role as much as an execution role. The platform is new, and contractors and their crews are the people who use it every day. You will help build it with them: what you observe and hear in the field decides what we build next.

You are the face of the product to contractors, to our first client's leadership and to every new utility we pursue. Contractors should trust you because you understand their work; senior leaders should trust you because you bring facts, not excuses. You report to the Founder and CEO and work as a partner in building the business.

**Title:**
 Founding Head – Utilities Field Product · 
**Type:**
 Contract to start then full time · 
**Base:**
 Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar

What you will do

**With contractors and crews**

* Onboard every contractor in the pilot area and get their crews updating jobs on WhatsApp with photo and GPS proof.
* Conduct field trainings for supervisors and plumbers, on site, in Gujarati or Hindi, and retrain crews where inspections fail.
* Demonstrate the product to contractors and their crews in 15 minutes, and get them using it the same day.
* Visit sites every week so contractors know the work is checked.
* Settle disputes between contractors, customers and the utility using the job evidence.
* Keep contractor capacity honest: jobs accepted only up to the number of certified crew available.

**With the utility's teams**

* Run a short daily review of the at-risk job list with the utility's area owner, and chase each delay until it is resolved.
* Work with care and service centre heads so their teams use the live job status in SAP.
* Present pilot progress to the MD and senior leadership: what moved, what is stuck, what you need from them.

**Building the product with OriginBluy**

* Shadow crews on real jobs and record structured observations: where time is lost, what confuses users, what workarounds they use.
* Turn those observations into clear product requirements with the product team.
* Test new features with contractors and crews before they are released, and bring back their feedback.
* Report what breaks in the field within days, with evidence.
* Track the pilot scorecard every week and own the numbers.
* Recruit and manage one or two field coordinators as the pilot scales.
* Document the playbook so the next city can be launched faster.

**Growing the business**

* Turn the pilot results into a clear, evidence-backed case for other gas utilities.
* Build a pipeline of target utilities, in Gujarat first and then other states.
* Run demos and discussions with MDs and heads of operations, projects and customer care.
* Shape proposals, pricing and pilot terms with the Founder.
* Lead new pilots and convert them into long-term contracts.
* Keep the first client a strong, willing reference.

Who you are

* **Mandatory: real, hands-on ground experience.**
   8–12 years doing field work yourself in city gas distribution, a utility, or an EPC or pipeline contractor, as a site engineer, site manager or operations manager. You have stood on sites, managed crews and contractors, and know how a PNG connection is built, from survey to gas-on. Desk-only or consulting backgrounds will not be considered.
* **Deep relationships across PSUs, government and utilities.**
   You have strong, active links with decision-makers in gas, power and other utility companies, PSUs and the government departments that oversee them, and you know how they evaluate, approve and buy.
* **Commercial instinct.**
   You have sold to, or won business from, utilities, PSUs or large industrial clients, or you are clearly ready to. You can open a door, run a meeting and follow through to a decision.
* **Equally at home on a site and in a boardroom.**
   You can win over a plumbing supervisor, and you can present calmly and crisply to an MD.
* **Fluent in Gujarati and Hindi,**
   with clear spoken and written English for leadership meetings and proposals.
* **A natural trainer and explainer.**
   You can take a non-technical crew through a new app and get them using it the same day.
* **A sharp observer.**
   You notice how work really gets done, and you can describe it clearly enough for a product team to act on.
* **Firm and fair with contractors.**
   You hold people to commitments without breaking the relationship.
* **Comfortable with data.**
   You live in dashboards and Excel, and you act on what the numbers show.
* **A builder.**
   You want to create something new, are comfortable with ambiguity, and own outcomes rather than tasks.
* **Graduate engineer**
   (mechanical, civil, chemical or petroleum preferred), or equivalent field experience.

Good to have

* Experience at a Gujarat city gas company, or with contractors who work for one.
* Experience with PSU and government procurement: tenders, empanelment and approval processes.
* Exposure to SAP in a utility (service orders, contractor billing or customer service).
* Experience rolling out a field app or digital process to a distributed, non-office workforce.
* Experience in a startup, or in a new-business role inside a larger company.
* A network of contractors, plumbers and site supervisors in Gujarat.

Location, pay and how to apply

* **Base:**
   Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar.
* **Travel:**
   frequent day trips to pilot sites and service centres in Gujarat (for example Surat and Bharuch), plus travel to other states for client meetings.
* **Ownership:**
   [ESOPs or equity, to be discussed].
* **Growth:**
   as the product scales, you build and lead the field and client team across utilities.

**To apply,**
 send your CV to Vivek.slaria@originbluy.com with a short note on one field rollout you led and one client you helped win: what was stuck, what you did, and what changed.

title: Manager - Student Recruitment & Outreach
description:
**Company Description**
ECA Global is a leading private higher education group founded in Australia, with multiple higher education brands across Sydney, Brisbane, Melbourne, Perth, and Parramatta. The group has expanded internationally with new campuses in the UK and operational hubs in Europe, China, the Philippines, Brazil, Nepal, and India. Each year, ECA Global welcomes around 15,000 students from diverse backgrounds into its global network of campuses. The organization focuses on delivering high-quality education, international pathways, and student-centric support services. ECA Global offers a multicultural work environment and opportunities to engage with learners and partners worldwide.

Position Summary: The Manager – Student Recruitment will lead and execute student recruitment strategies to achieve enrolment targets, expand market presence, strengthen institutional partnerships, and improve student conversion rates. The role is responsible for driving recruitment operations, developing effective outreach initiatives, managing recruitment channels, and building strong relationships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, and other institutional partners.

The successful candidate will combine strategic planning, commercial acumen, market intelligence, operational excellence, and people leadership to deliver sustainable student recruitment growth. The role will also work closely with academic teams, Admissions, Student Services, and other internal stakeholders to ensure a seamless prospective student journey from initial enquiry through enrolment and onboarding.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Recruitment Strategy, Market Development & Partnerships**

* Develop and implement comprehensive student recruitment strategies aligned with institutional enrolment targets and business growth objectives.
* Identify priority markets, student segments, recruitment channels, and opportunities for market expansion.
* Build and maintain strategic partnerships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, academic institutions, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Develop articulation agreements, feeder relationships, and student progression pathways to strengthen recruitment pipelines and improve conversion.
* Collaborate with academic teams to align recruitment campaigns, messaging, and market positioning with programme offerings and institutional priorities.
* Lead relationship development and stakeholder engagement across key domestic and international markets.
* Leverage market research, CRM insights, competitor analysis, and enrolment trends to inform recruitment strategies and identify new growth opportunities.
* Represent the institution at recruitment fairs, school visits, industry events, partner meetings, presentations, and other outreach activities.
* Identify and develop innovative recruitment channels, partnership models, and market penetration initiatives.
* Monitor the effectiveness of recruitment partnerships and implement strategies to improve partner engagement and performance.

**2. Recruitment Operations, Student Conversion & Performance Management**

* Manage the end-to-end student recruitment pipeline, from enquiry generation and application follow-up through offer acceptance, enrolment, and onboarding.
* Drive timely, accurate, and high-quality communication with prospective students, applicants, and recruitment partners.
* Monitor recruitment funnel performance and implement initiatives to improve enquiry-to-application, application-to-offer, and offer-to-enrolment conversion rates.
* Plan, coordinate, and oversee recruitment campaigns, marketing communications, outreach activities, open days, education fairs, and student engagement events.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), recruitment targets, pipeline metrics, and channel performance.
* Analyse recruitment data, identify conversion bottlenecks, and recommend corrective actions to improve enrolment outcomes.
* Prepare regular performance reports, market insights, pipeline updates, and strategic recommendations for senior management.
* Manage education agent performance, evaluate channel effectiveness, and implement appropriate performance improvement measures.
* Work closely with Admissions, Student Services, Marketing, and academic teams to ensure efficient application processing and a seamless student experience.
* Establish and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), process documentation, reporting frameworks, and quality assurance practices.
* Coordinate recruitment calendars, campaign timelines, event logistics, and competing operational priorities to ensure timely execution.
* Ensure recruitment activities deliver against agreed enrolment targets, service standards, and institutional growth objectives.

**3. Leadership, Team Management & Capability Development**

* Lead, motivate, and manage recruitment and outreach teams, where applicable, to achieve individual and collective performance targets.
* Set clear objectives, allocate responsibilities, monitor performance, and provide regular coaching and feedback.
* Build a high-performing, accountable, student-focused, and commercially driven recruitment culture.
* Develop team capabilities through training, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and continuous professional development.
* Foster collaboration across recruitment, marketing, admissions, academic, and student support functions.
* Introduce innovative recruitment approaches, student engagement initiatives, and outreach models to enhance productivity and market penetration.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen recruitment processes.
* Oversee recruitment-related budgets, campaign expenditure, event planning, and resource allocation, as applicable.
* Promote data-driven decision-making, continuous improvement, and accountability for recruitment outcomes.
* Support succession planning, capability development, and the effective use of team resources to meet evolving business needs.

**4. Compliance, Governance & Stakeholder Management**

* Ensure recruitment practices comply with institutional policies, applicable regulatory requirements, and relevant quality assurance standards.
* Uphold equal opportunity, workplace health and safety (OSH), data privacy, and information security requirements.
* Ensure appropriate handling of prospective student and applicant information in accordance with applicable data protection requirements, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA), where applicable.
* Maintain accurate recruitment records, partner documentation, performance reports, and operational records.
* Promote ethical recruitment practices, transparent communication, and a positive student experience throughout the recruitment journey.
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal teams, external partners, and senior stakeholders.
* Escalate recruitment risks, operational challenges, compliance concerns, and performance gaps in a timely manner.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be assessed against agreed institutional and departmental objectives, including:

* Achievement of student enrolment targets by programme, market, and recruitment channel.
* Improvement in enquiry-to-application and application-to-enrolment conversion rates.
* Growth in qualified student enquiries and recruitment pipeline volume.
* Effectiveness and productivity of education agents and institutional partnerships.
* Delivery and performance of recruitment campaigns, outreach activities, and events.
* Timeliness and quality of applicant communication and follow-up.
* Accuracy of recruitment data, reporting, and pipeline forecasting.
* Compliance with institutional policies, recruitment processes, and applicable regulations.
* Team productivity, target achievement, and professional development.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Education, International Relations, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification or relevant professional certification will be an advantage.
* Significant experience in student recruitment, education management, business development, institutional partnerships, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience in developing and executing recruitment strategies and achieving measurable enrolment or business growth targets.
* Proven experience managing recruitment pipelines, conversion processes, performance metrics, and stakeholder relationships.
* Experience developing and managing relationships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, or institutional partners.
* Previous experience leading or supervising teams, setting performance targets, and driving accountability will be highly desirable.
* Experience in higher education, international education, or a multi-campus education environment will be an advantage.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* **Strategic thinking:**
  Ability to translate institutional growth objectives into practical recruitment strategies and actionable plans.
* **Business development:**
  Strong partnership-building, networking, negotiation, and market expansion capabilities.
* **Performance management:**
  Ability to establish KPIs, analyse recruitment data, identify trends, and drive measurable improvements.
* **Communication and presentation:**
  Excellent written and verbal communication, public speaking, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* **Leadership:**
  Ability to motivate teams, manage performance, develop talent, and foster a results-oriented culture.
* **Operational management:**
  Strong planning, organisational, prioritisation, budgeting, and execution capabilities.
* **Analytical ability:**
  Proficiency in interpreting market intelligence, CRM data, conversion metrics, and performance reports.
* **Relationship management:**
  Ability to establish and maintain productive relationships with diverse internal and external stakeholders.

title: AI Consultant
description:
**About the E2M:**

E2M Solutions works as a trusted white-label partner for digital agencies. We support agencies with consistent and reliable delivery through services such as website design, web development, eCommerce, SEO, AI SEO, PPC, AI automation, and content writing. Founded on strong business ethics, we are an equal opportunity organization powered by 300+ experienced professionals, partnering with 400+ digital agencies across the US, UK, Canada, Europe, and Australia. At E2M, we value ownership, consistency, and people who are committed to doing meaningful work and growing together. If you’re someone who dreams big and has the gumption to make them come true, E2M has a place for you.

**About the Role**

* You will own AI engagements for our agency clients, from the first discovery call to live, adopted solutions. Our clients know AI matters but are held back by manual work, inconsistent AI output, and disconnected tools.
* You will find where time and money are being lost, define what to build and in what order, make sound architecture and security calls, and lead an engineering pod to ship production-ready systems. You are the person clients trust when things go right, and just as importantly, when they go wrong.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Discovery and Assessment**

* Run a structured 3 to 4 week AI assessment with stakeholders across PPC, SEO, content, project management, sales, and leadership.
* Use pre-call audit sheets to quantify manual work (task, frequency, hours) and steer toward the highest-value workflows.
* Map workflows end to end (tools, handoffs, data sources, failure points) and reframe solution-first requests into the real underlying problem.

**2. AI Blueprint and Proposal**

* Author the client AI Blueprint: 10 to 30+ use cases, each with current process, proposed solution and stack, dependencies, expected outcome, and timeline.
* Prioritise with an Impact vs. Effort matrix and recommend 2 to 3 high-impact starting automations.
* Design phased roadmaps (quick wins, leadership visibility, revenue and lead generation, then agentic systems) that build on existing tools.
* Present the plan to founders, covering team model, delivery cadence, testing approach (for example shadow mode), and pricing.

**3. Solution Architecture**

* Lead platform, hosting, and build vs. buy decisions with client technical teams (Azure AI Foundry, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, multi-model).
* Define secure access: least privilege, read-only API scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit trails, and exclusion of sensitive data.
* Design knowledge systems: RAG pipelines, vector search trade-offs, tiered context management, MCP connectors, and reusable Claude Skills.
* Test feasibility on client APIs before scoping, manage cost-to-serve, and make deliberate "prototype now, re-architect later" calls.

**4. Delivery and Account Management**

* Run weekly syncs per account: demo progress, collect feedback, manage change requests, and reprioritise.
* Turn feedback into clear, testable requirements for the pod and hold the line on MVP dates.
* Own AI output quality: lead root cause analysis on failures, put safe interim processes in place, and track accuracy over time.
* Lead client communication on security incidents, covering impact, actions, and timelines.

**5. Adoption and Training**

* Train client teams through live sessions, SOPs, and follow-up coaching so solutions are used after launch.
* Ensure AI output matches each client’s brand voice and coach clients on giving feedback that improves it.

**6. Team Leadership**

* Direct the delivery pod: set requirements, review builds, and enforce a production-ready definition of done, edge cases included.
* Mentor junior team members toward client-facing roles through frameworks, scenario reviews, and call shadowing.

**Requirements:**

**1. Experience**

* 2+ years building custom AI solutions (LLM apps, RAG, agents, workflow automation) that reached production.
* 4+ years in client-facing delivery (Project or Program Manager, Solutions Consultant, CSM, or Account Manager), ideally in an agency or services company.
* Track record of owning multiple concurrent client engagements end to end.

**2. Technical Skills**

* **AI:** Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, prompt and context engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search, output evaluation.
* **Build:** Python with FastAPI or LangGraph, MCP servers and connectors.
* **Integration:** APIs, webhooks, OAuth scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, secure credential handling, plus one cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and Supabase or Postgres.
* **Agency stack:** GA4, Search Console, Google, Meta and Bing Ads, Klaviyo, SEO data providers, HubSpot, and PM tools (Teamwork, Basecamp, ClickUp, Monday, Productive).
* **Judgment:** Can sketch an architecture, estimate effort, and spot feasibility risks without an engineer in the room.

**3. Consulting Skills**

* Facilitates discovery workshops that surface the real problem.
* Quantifies ROI (hours saved, turnaround time, cost avoided) and uses it to prioritise.
* Writes clear proposals, Blueprints, requirements, and SOPs.
* Presents confidently to executives and discusses pricing, phasing, and scope in plain business language.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience productising a custom AI solution across multiple clients.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent delivery certification.
* Consulting background with exposure to process improvement and quality frameworks.
* Experience with AI search visibility, SEO intelligence, or marketing analytics.

title: Guest Relation Executive
description:
* **Title:** Guest Relations Executive (or similar: Travel Consultant / Guest Service Associate)
* **Mostly Prefer:** Freshers with a background in Hospitality Management
* **Location:** Panampilly Nagar, Kochi (full-time, office-based)
* **Core mandate:** Turn leads (calls, messages, emails) into confirmed bookings and maintain strong relationships with clients and guests.
* **Scope:** You’ll be assigned specific holiday-home properties across India and act as the main point of contact for those assets.

Key responsibilities

From your text and similar listings in Kochi, the day-to-day likely includes:

* **Lead conversion**
* Responding to enquiries via **calls, WhatsApp/messages, and email**.
* Explaining property features, pricing, policies, and availability.
* Guiding guests through the booking process and payment.
* **Guest & client relationship management**
* Pre-arrival coordination (check-in instructions, special requests, upsells).
* During-stay support and issue resolution.
* Post-stay follow-up, feedback collection, and encouraging repeat bookings.
* **Escalation handling**
* Managing complaints (cleanliness, maintenance, host issues, refund disputes, etc.).
* Coordinating with operations/housekeeping/maintenance teams to resolve issues quickly.
* Documenting escalations and ensuring they don’t recur.
* **Inventory & listing management**
* Updating availability, rates, and restrictions across channels (website, OTAs, social media, internal tools).
* Ensuring photos, descriptions, and policies are accurate and consistent.
* Basic coordination with property owners/managers for block dates or maintenance.
* **Digital & communication tasks**
* Handling basic updates on **website listings, social media handles**, and possibly responding to reviews/messages on platforms like Instagram/Facebook/Google.
* Using CRM / property management software to track leads, bookings, and guest history.

Typical requirements for this profile

* **Excellent English communication** (spoken & written) – mandatory.
* Comfort with **phones, WhatsApp, email**, and basic office software.
* Ability to learn and manage **booking systems, property dashboards, and simple website/OTA updates**.
* Strong **customer service orientation**, patience, and problem-solving skills for escalations.
* Preference for candidates with exposure to **hospitality, travel, real estate, or sales**

If you’re preparing an application or interview:

* Emphasize any experience in:
* **Sales / lead conversion** (targets, follow-ups, closing deals).
* **Customer support / guest handling** (hotels, homestays, travel agencies, e-commerce support).
* Using tools like Excel/Google Sheets, basic CMS, or any booking/CRM software.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time

title: Account Manager
description:
Job Description: Account Manager

**Company:** Shanva Media  
**Department:** Digital Marketing & Client Servicing  
**Job Title:** Account Manager – Social Media & Digital Marketing

Job Summary

Shanva Media is looking for a proactive and organized Account Manager to manage client accounts, oversee social media platforms, coordinate content creation, and ensure smooth execution of digital marketing activities. The candidate will act as the primary point of contact between clients and the internal creative team to maintain strong client relationships and achieve marketing objectives.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Social Media Management**

* Manage clients' social media accounts, including Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
* Schedule and publish posts, reels, stories, carousels, and other content as per the monthly content calendar.
* Monitor comments, messages, engagement, and overall account activity.
* Ensure consistent branding, communication, and posting schedules across all platforms.

**2. Client Relationship Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
* Understand client requirements, business goals, and marketing expectations.
* Communicate regularly with clients regarding content approvals, campaign updates, and deliverables.
* Handle client feedback, queries, and concerns professionally.
* Maintain strong client relationships to ensure satisfaction and long-term retention.

**3. Content Planning & Coordination**

* Prepare monthly social media content calendars in coordination with the creative team.
* Coordinate with graphic designers, video editors, content writers, and performance marketers.
* Collect content references, captions, brand assets, product details, and other required information from clients.
* Ensure all content is reviewed, approved, and published on time.
* Follow up with the internal team to ensure timely delivery of creatives and videos.

**4. Digital Marketing & Campaign Coordination**

* Coordinate Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns with the performance marketing team.
* Assist in planning promotions, offers, seasonal campaigns, and brand awareness activities.
* Monitor campaign progress and communicate updates to clients.
* Support lead generation activities and ensure leads or enquiries are forwarded to the appropriate client representative.

**5. Reporting & Performance Analysis**

* Track social media metrics such as reach, impressions, engagement, follower growth, profile visits, and leads.
* Prepare monthly performance reports for clients.
* Analyze content performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Provide actionable suggestions to improve engagement, visibility, and brand growth.

**6. Account Operations & Documentation**

* Prepare and share monthly content calendars, reports, and other client deliverables.
* Maintain client documents, brand guidelines, approval records, and communication history.
* Coordinate the preparation and sharing of MOUs, onboarding documents, and other account-related paperwork.
* Track project deadlines, deliverables, and pending approvals.
* Ensure all work is aligned with the agreed scope of services and timelines.

**7. Additional Responsibilities**

* Stay updated on social media trends, platform updates, and digital marketing best practices.
* Identify opportunities to upsell relevant services such as paid advertising, website development, branding, and video production.
* Attend client meetings and internal review meetings.
* Perform other marketing, coordination, and account management duties assigned by the management.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Basic knowledge of Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other social media platforms.
* Understanding of content calendars, social media engagement, and digital marketing.
* Strong organizational, coordination, and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.
* Familiarity with Meta Business Suite and social media scheduling tools is preferred.
* Problem-solving ability and a client-focused mindset.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely delivery and publishing of scheduled content.
* Client satisfaction and retention.
* Timely collection of content approvals and required client materials.
* Accuracy and punctuality of monthly reports.
* Effective coordination between clients and internal teams.
* Achievement of agreed social media and campaign objectives.

**Reporting To:** Account Director / Operations Manager / Management

**Work Type:** Full-time

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
Hiring: Social Media Executive

**Location:** Pune, Maharashtra  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office  
**Industry:** Digital Marketing | Hospitality

About the Role

We are looking for a creative, proactive, and detail-oriented **Social Media Executive** to join our digital marketing agency. The role involves managing social media accounts for hospitality clients, including restaurants, cafés, hotels, bars, and lifestyle brands.

The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of social media trends, content creation, shoot planning, client coordination, and day-to-day social media management.

Key Responsibilities

* **Social Media Management:** Manage day-to-day social media activities for hospitality clients across Instagram, Facebook, and other relevant platforms.
* **Content Creation:** Develop creative content ideas, reels concepts, captions, post copy, stories, and engaging social media content.
* **Content Calendar:** Plan and maintain monthly content calendars aligned with client goals, campaigns, events, and brand identity.
* **Shoot Planning & Coordination:** Plan photoshoots and video shoots, coordinate with photographers, videographers, influencers, and internal teams, and ensure smooth execution.
* **Client Communication:** Communicate with clients regularly, understand their requirements, share updates, collect feedback, and coordinate content approvals.
* **Posting & Publishing:** Schedule and publish posts, reels, stories, and other content according to the planned calendar.
* **Instagram Stories:** Create and manage daily stories, including interactive polls, offers, promotions, events, and behind-the-scenes content.
* **Trend Research:** Stay updated with Instagram trends, trending audio, viral reel formats, and creative ideas relevant to the hospitality industry.
* **Team Coordination:** Work closely with designers, video editors, performance marketers, and account managers to ensure timely content delivery.
* **Performance Tracking:** Monitor social media performance, engagement, reach, and growth, and suggest improvements based on insights.
* **Brand Consistency:** Ensure all content follows the client's brand guidelines, tone of voice, and communication style.

Requirements

* 1–3 years of experience in social media management or digital marketing is preferred.
* Good understanding of Instagram, reels, stories, and other social media formats.
* Strong communication, coordination, and organisational skills.
* Creative thinking and an eye for engaging visual content.
* Ability to manage multiple client accounts and meet deadlines.
* Good command of written English; knowledge of Hindi and Marathi is an advantage.
* Familiarity with Canva, Meta Business Suite, and content scheduling tools is a plus.
* Prior experience working with restaurants, cafés, hotels, or other hospitality brands will be an added advantage.

What We’re Looking For

Someone who is creative, organised, hands-on, and passionate about social media. You should be comfortable coordinating with clients, planning shoots, working with creative teams, and ensuring that every brand stays active, relevant, and engaging online.

**Interested candidates can share their CV along with links to social media accounts or work samples they have managed.**

title: Principal Enablement Experience Consultant - India
description:
**We're looking for a**

**Principal Enablement Experience Consultant - India**
======================================================

**This role is** **Office Based, Pune Office**

Job Description | Product Manager & Architect, Enablement Experience

Location: India / In Person Team: Cornerstone University

  

**About Cornerstone:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

  

**About the role:**

Today, our customers and partners learn through Cornerstone University training and courses, our knowledge base, live events, community forums, certifications, and conversations with their Customer Success team. These experiences are centralized through the Cornerstone Community, but they live in separate systems and can feel like separate journeys.

As Product Manager & Architect, Enablement Experiences, you will define and own the enablement platforms vision, strategy, architecture, and execution for one unified Cornerstone University experience: a single front door where customers, partners, and employees find answers, connect with experts and peers, learn in the flow of their work, and prove what they can do. You’ll see where information flows, where it breaks, and where the opportunities are, and you’ll turn that into a roadmap, an architecture, and shipped experiences that drive customer adoption, partner readiness, and renewal.

This is a senior, high-ownership role: one part product leader, one part architect, one part builder. You’ll report to the leader of Enablement & Community Experiences, who owns the business outcomes for the function. You own the platform that delivers them. You’ll also act as Customer Zero for Cornerstone’s own Workforce AI and learning technology, running our education business on our own products and feeding what we learn back to Product.

The role joins Cornerstone at an exciting moment, helping shape the company’s future through our Workforce AI tools. This is a new role on the Cornerstone University team for someone with clear vision, sound judgment, and the cross-functional leadership to bring bold ideas to life.

This role is based in India, with teammates based in global geographic hubs. Weekday hours require flexing to provide overlap with members in EMEA and the Americas.

  

**Scope and Decision Rights:**

* **You own:** Cornerstone University product roadmap; prioritization; target-state architecture and standards; integrations and data flows; design and build of AI-powered experiences; build-vs-buy recommendations and vendor evaluations; technical direction for learning system administrators.
* **You partner on:** enablement and community strategy, program priorities, budget, and executive alignment, content (Learning Design & Content) measurement and insights (Strategy, Insights & Operations); identity and security (IT and Security); CRM and customer health data (Salesforce and Gainsight teams).
  

**In this role, you will…**

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Platform Vision, Strategy & Product Management*

* Define and own the platform vision and multi-year roadmap for the Cornerstone University ecosystem (learning platforms, community, knowledge base, certifications, events, in-product learning, and AI experiences), tied directly to customer adoption and retention, partner readiness, and education as a growth function.
* Map the current customer learning landscape, including platforms, data flows, identity, content, search, and handoffs, and identify where users hit friction, fragmentation, duplication, or unnecessary cost.
* Run continuous product discovery with customers, partners, Customer Success, Services, and Support. Prioritize by business impact and say no clearly.
* Lead build vs. buy vs. partner decisions and platform vendor strategy, backed by business cases. Evaluate vendor roadmaps and market shifts in customer education and community platforms.
* Present the platform roadmap, investment cases, and trade-offs to executives in clear business language.

*Architecture & Standards*

* Define the target-state architecture and standards for the learning ecosystem, including data models, integration patterns, identity and SSO design, content and search, and security and privacy. Partner with Product, IT, and Security to put them into practice.
* Own the shared taxonomy and metadata framework covering products, skills, roles, audiences, and content types, as the foundation for search, personalized learning paths, reporting, and AI retrieval.
* Instrument the ecosystem: define event-level learning telemetry (e.g., xAPI and a learning record store) and data pipelines so learning, community, and certification activity can be measured at account and capability level and connected to adoption, retention, and revenue.
* Ensure the experience is accessible, localized, and performs well for a global audience.

*AI-Powered Experiences*

* Lead the strategy, design, and build of AI-powered experiences across Cornerstone University and Community, such as an authenticated answer experience that blends learning, community, and support content; personalized learning paths and nudges; and AI-assisted practice and assessment. Use native Cornerstone AI first and third-party solutions where justified.
* Own the retrieval approach behind these experiences, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over a governed content corpus, permission-aware retrieval, and content freshness, working closely with Content and Product teams.
* Establish evaluation and responsible AI practices: accuracy and hallucination testing, guardrails, human-in-the-loop review, privacy, and cost monitoring.
* Design for an agentic future, including integration through emerging standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and partner agent ecosystems.

*Integration & Execution*

* Own and drive the integrations between the learning ecosystem including Cornerstone platform, Salesforce and Gainsight so learning, community, and certification data syncs to the right account and contact records and appears in Customer Success, Sales, and partner workflows, giving a complete picture of adoption, health, and renewal.
* Lead delivery of platform programs end to end: plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, vendor and implementation-partner management, testing, launch, and change management.
* Own the certification and credentialing platform infrastructure, including proctored exams, digital badges, and certification maintenance and renewal flows, in partnership with the Certification team.
* Deliver learning in the flow of work, including in-product guidance within Cornerstone and experiences embedded in the tools customers, partners, and employees already use.
* Set technical priorities for learning system administrators, review configuration decisions, evaluate platform changes, and define release and testing standards.

*Partnership & Leadership*

* Partner with your manager to translate business goals into platform priorities and to report progress and outcomes.
* Work across Cornerstone University, Customer Success, Services, Support, Alliances, Product, Marketing, and IT.
* Act as Customer Zero: run Cornerstone University on Cornerstone products and give structured feedback to Product.
* Explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and executives.
  

**What Success Looks Like:**

* **First 30-60 days:** current-state map, target-state architecture, prioritized roadmap, and investment case agreed with leadership; quick wins identified and underway.
* **By 6 months:** unified identity and single front door in delivery; agentic experiences serving 60+% of the audience’s needs through agentic front door, learning and community data flowing to Salesforce and Gainsight account records at an agreed data-quality level; telemetry standards in place; first AI experience piloting with defined success metrics.
* **By 9-12 months:** single front door live for customers and partners serving 80+% of the needs; AI answer experience in production with measured resolution and satisfaction; fewer platforms and lower platform cost; learning engagement visible in account health and used by Customer Success; certification infrastructure supporting proctored, role-based credentials at scale.
* **Ongoing measures:** front-door adoption, time to answer, integration reliability, data quality, AI resolution rate, and platform cost, plus clear contribution to customer adoption, retention, and partner readiness.

**You've Got What It Takes If You Have…**

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* 10+ years in learning technology, customer education, or enterprise SaaS platforms, including significant time as a platform owner, product manager, or architect who set strategy, not only configured tools.
* Proven ownership of a multi-platform learning ecosystem. You were accountable for the vision, architecture, integrations, and roadmap across learning, community, knowledge, and certification platforms, with evidence that it improved customer and business outcomes.
* Product management depth: discovery, prioritization, road mapping, business cases, build vs. buy decisions, and adoption metrics.
* A track record of leading large-scale, multi-system implementations or consolidations from strategy through delivery, including vendors and cross-functional teams.
* Deep integration experience across learning systems and Salesforce CRM, including REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, SSO (SAML/OIDC), data syncs, and learning standards (SCORM, xAPI, cmi5, LTI).
* Hands-on expertise with at least one enterprise or customer education LMS, preferably Cornerstone, or Skilljar, Docebo, Thought Industries, Intellum, Absorb, or similar.
* AI shipped in production: you have designed and delivered at least one AI-powered experience (e.g., agents, RAG-based answers, or AI workflows) used by real users with measured outcomes, and can speak to evaluation, guardrails, data governance, and cost.
* Ability to set strategy independently and communicate it at executive level.
* Comfort moving between strategy and configuration in the same day.
  

**Strongly Preferred:**

* Experience integrating online community platforms (Gainsight preferred), including SSO, data, and how learning and community intersect.
* Experience with Gainsight or similar customer success platforms and customer health data.
* Customer and partner education experience at a B2B SaaS company, including certification programs.
* Experience with agent interoperability standards (such as MCP) and enterprise AI platforms.
* Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Integration Architect).
  

**How You Work:**

* **Customer obsessed:** you start from the learner’s and the account’s problem, not the tool.
* **Innovate and transform:** you challenge the status quo and retire systems and processes that don’t earn their place.
* **Proactive leadership:** you see the problem and act before you’re asked.
* **Get it done:** you ship, measure, and iterate.
* **Forward looking:** you plan for where the technology and the business are going, not where they have been.
* **AI native:** you use AI every day to rethink your own work, not just to speed it up.
* **Get uncomfortable to succeed:** you take on hard, ambiguous problems and stay with them.
  

#LI-Onsite

**Our Culture:**

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

**Who We Are:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.
