title: Content Writing & Copywriting Intern
description:
Content Writing & Copywriting Intern — SEO, Ads & Scripts

The Night Marketer | In-office, Wazirpur/Shalimar Bagh, Delhi

Monthly stipend: ₹10,000–₹15,000, based on writing skills and relevant work samples.

We are looking for a curious writer who can understand a marketing brief and turn it into clear, useful content. You will work with our marketing, SEO and creative teams on scripts, ad copy and search-focused content for brands and websites.

What you will work on

* Write short video/Reel scripts, opening hooks, on-screen text and clear calls to action.

* Develop ad-copy variations, headlines, landing-page copy and social captions for different audiences and offers.

* Write and edit SEO articles, introductions, page copy, titles, meta descriptions and heading outlines that match search intent.

* Research a topic, check facts, work from approved product information and avoid unsupported claims.

* Improve drafts using feedback, maintain a consistent brand voice and explain why a line or angle fits the brief.

* Collaborate with designers, marketers and SEO colleagues and keep drafts organised in Google Docs or similar tools.

What we are looking for

* Clear English writing, sound grammar, editing ability and attention to detail.

* Understanding of audience, benefits, hooks, offers and calls to action.

* Practical SEO basics: search intent, natural keyword use, useful headings, metadata and helpful content.

* Some exposure to digital marketing through an internship, college project, freelance work, a personal page/blog or a writing portfolio. Strong beginners can apply; no previous full-time job is required.

* Ability to accept feedback and revise your own work. Hinglish writing is useful for some campaigns, but optional.

* Availability for an in-office internship in Wazirpur/Shalimar Bagh, Delhi. Share your current locality, commute/relocation plan and college or other scheduling commitments.

How to apply

Share your CV and two or three writing samples, ideally one SEO article/page and one ad or script. Personal or college samples are welcome. For each, explain the audience, objective and your own contribution. Use public or view-access links and do not share confidential client work. If you have no portfolio, you may submit a short self-created sample and label it clearly.

Also tell us your current city/locality, full-time office availability, expected monthly stipend, earliest joining date and internship availability/duration. We will discuss duration and work schedule during screening; no conversion to a permanent role is promised.

Selection process

Portfolio review, a 45–60-minute fictional writing exercise and a brief live discussion/rewrite. The exercise tests ad/script writing, SEO content, editing, factual accuracy and reasoning. No real client work is requested or used. AI and research tools may be used with disclosure; you must be able to explain and revise the final work.

Practical exercise: https://thenightmarketer.com/client/hiring/content-copywriting-intern-v1.html

Apply through our careers page or email jobs@thenightmarketer.com with “Content Intern” in the subject. You can WhatsApp Raghav on +91 9717884659 with your name, locality and writing-sample links.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Please share your current city/locality, confirm whether you can attend our Wazirpur/Shalimar Bagh, Delhi office full-time, your expected monthly stipend (budget ₹10,000–₹15,000), earliest joining date, internship availability/duration and any college or scheduling commitments.
* Share 2–3 writing samples using public or view-access links, ideally one SEO article/page and one ad or short script. For one piece, explain the audience, objective, your own contribution and how you considered SEO/search intent. Personal or college samples are welcome. If you have no portfolio, provide a short self-created sample and label it clearly.

description:

Job Title: Vertical Head – Sales

Sutra Luminis is a premium decorative lighting brand catering to high-end residential, hospitality, and commercial projects across India. We work closely with architects, interior designers, hotel groups, developers, contractors, and other key stakeholders to deliver bespoke lighting solutions.

* Develop and execute quarterly and annual sales strategies.
* Drive project and solution-based sales across hospitality, commercial, institutional, and luxury residential segments.
* Ensure consistent achievement of revenue and profitability targets.

* Coordinate with design, production, supply chain, and finance teams for smooth execution.

6. Client Engagement & Business Development

* Experience handling high-value accounts and large projects.

title: HRIS Business Analyst – AI & Digital Transformation (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.
  
  
You will join the People & Organization Digital Transformation team as a bridge between HR and technology — deeply understanding how HR works end to end and translating business challenges into scalable technology, automation and AI solutions.You will work across the hire-to-retire employee lifecycle, partnering with HR teams to challenge existing processes, identify opportunities for improvement and turn business needs into clear functional and technical requirements. You will then help take those solutions from idea through design, build and implementation — using our HR technology landscape, automation platforms and AI.
  
  
The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation, who is part of the HR Senior Leadership Team, and works closely with the People Enablement Tech stream, FlixTech, IT Security, Data Privacy and HR teams across all regions.
  
  
This role is based in Gurugram or Bangalore (India), with a minimum office presence of 3 days per week. Given the global scope, regular collaboration with colleagues across European, APAC and US time zones is required.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Act as a trusted technology partner to HR teams across the end-to-end employee lifecycle — conduct process and technology gap analyses, challenge existing ways of working, identify improvement and automation opportunities, and translate business needs into functional and technical requirements implemented through HRIS, AI or automation solutions.
* Help build, deploy and maintain Claude-based applications and AI-powered internal tools, working with our cloud and technology teams to ensure appropriate authentication (RBAC/ABAC), governance and HRIS-aligned access controls including MCPs, APIs and custom connectors that securely connect AI applications with the wider HR Tech landscape.
* Design and build AI and automation workflows using technologies such as n8n, UiPath, Python-based automation and GenAI/LLMs, creating scalable solutions with appropriate orchestration, exception handling, monitoring and governance.
* Drive HR Tech initiatives end to end, from requirements engineering and process/solution design through build, SIT/UAT, implementation and go-live across areas such as HR service delivery model, HRIS security model improvements, payroll transformations, HRIS revamp or migration.
* Bring a strong product mindset to HR technology — turning business problems into scalable products and frameworks, including Jira-based HR service desks, Rovo Agents and AI-enabled employee/HR experiences, and continuously improving them based on user needs and business value.

**About You**

* 6+ years of experience as an HR Tech Analyst, HR Business/Process Analyst, AI & Automation Analyst or similar role, with deep, demonstrable HR & Workday domain knowledge across hire-to-retire processes. This is a must-have for the role. A degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, HR Technology, Business Technology or a related field is preferred.
* Strong ability to analyse HR processes, translate business problems into functional and technical requirements, and implement solutions across a complex Workday technology landscape.
* Hands-on experience building AI and automation solutions using technologies such as n8n, Python scripts, UiPath and GenAI/LLM tooling. n8n certification is a plus.
* Experience building and deploying internal applications in cloud environments, including working with APIs, MCPs, custom connectors and integrations to securely move data between enterprise systems.
* Hands-on understanding of Claude/GenAI application deployment and enterprise security, including RBAC/ABAC, authentication, access governance and protection of sensitive HR data.
* Strong working knowledge of Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Rovo Agents and BPMN, with the ability to build service desks, portals, workflows, process frameworks and technology-enabled HR services.
* Fluency in English. Mandatory Workday experience is essential; certifications in Workday, business/process analysis, automation or agile delivery (e.g. Six Sigma, SAFe, Scrum, PMP, Archimate) are a plus.
* Comfort working across European, APAC and US time zones, with a primary collaboration focus on a Berlin-based team.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
* Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
* Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
* Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career
  
  
**Why Join Flix?**
At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
  
  
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.
  
  
If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Mass Communication Expert / Intern
description:
**We're Hiring:**

MASS COMMUNICATION EXPERT IEC & BCC Intern 

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

 Duration: Long Term opportunity.          Salary : Upto INR 9 LPA

 Stipend For Intern : Upto INR 40000

About the Role

We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys engaging with people and driving real habit change specifically around waste segregation and home composting. This is a ground-level, community-facing role under our IEC (Information, Education, Communication) and BCC (Behaviour Change Communication) project on solid waste management.

You'll spend a good chunk of your time at ward meetings, RWA gatherings, government events, and street-level awareness drives explaining why segregation matters, demonstrating how home composting works, and helping citizens actually adopt these practices rather than just hear about them once and forget. Alongside that, you'll be building relationships with local leaders, coordinating with government officials, and mentoring your own team on the ground.

This role suits someone equally comfortable speaking to 50 strangers at a public event and sitting with one hesitant household explaining why wet and dry waste need separate bins.

Why This Role Exists

Many citizens don't yet know what waste segregation means, why it matters, or how to practise it correctly at home. This role exists to close that gap first through basic awareness, then through consistent daily habit.

The larger goal is civic sense, not just information. Citizens need to see cleanliness and segregation as their own responsibility toward their locality not a one-off task done only for a campaign or a government inspection. Once that mindset takes hold, the habit sticks and spreads to neighbours on its own.

You'll need to keep the explanation simple and practical: why wet and dry waste must be kept separate, how home composting helps, and why a clean neighbourhood benefits everyone living in it. The same explanation should make sense to a housewife, a shopkeeper, or a schoolchild alike.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

**Public engagement & training**

* Speak at public gatherings, ward meetings, and government-organised events on waste segregation and its importance
* Conduct hands-on home composting demonstrations and training sessions for households
* Simplify technical waste-management concepts into language that lands with everyday citizens
* Build basic awareness on what waste segregation is and why it matters, for citizens who may not know this already
* Build citizens' understanding of civic sense why cleanliness and segregation are a shared community responsibility, not just a rule to follow
* Help households move from awareness to consistent daily practice, and eventually to encouraging their neighbours to do the same
* Use relatable, local examples to explain what happens to waste after it leaves the house, so citizens understand the real impact of not segregating

**Campaign planning & execution**

* Plan and lead IEC/BCC campaigns at ward level, government events, and public spots
* Design daily/weekly awareness drive plans and adjust them based on ground feedback
* Track campaign reach and effectiveness, and course-correct where engagement is low

**Local relationship building**

* Identify ward-level local leaders (councillors, RWA heads, community influencers) and build working relationships with them
* Use these relationships to create ground-level buzz and credibility for the campaign
* Liaise regularly with government officials for event approvals, logistics, and coordination

**Team & people management**

* Build the capacity of your ground team training them subject-wise on segregation, composting, and communication techniques
* Handle day-to-day citizen disputes or resistance at the ground level with patience and problem-solving, rather than escalating everything upward
* Motivate the team to sustain energy across long, repetitive field campaigns

**Documentation & reporting**

* Maintain daily/weekly activity reports of field visits, training sessions, and campaigns
* Prepare presentations and reports for internal review and for government stakeholders
* Document best practices and replicate them across other wards/zones

We're Looking For a Mass Communicator Who Cares About Clean Cities

This role is first and foremost a communication role we need someone who can command a room, simplify a message, and get it to stick across ward meetings, government events, and street-level campaigns. Waste segregation happens to be the subject, but the core skill we're hiring for is the ability to move people to action through communication.

That said, this work lands far better coming from someone who actually cares about seeing their city get cleaner someone who notices civic issues around them, has an opinion on why cleanliness matters, and brings genuine energy to the subject rather than just delivering a script. That combination a strong communicator who's personally invested in the cause is what makes the message land and stick with citizens, rather than sounding like another government announcement.

.

Who We're Looking For

* Strong communicator confident on stage, but equally comfortable in a one-on-one conversation; soft-spoken with the ability to hold a room
* Fluency in Gujarati (spoken and conversational) is essential, along with working proficiency in Hindi/English
* A genuine environment enthusiast someone who actually cares about cleaner localities and sustainable habits, not just someone reciting talking points about waste management
* Able to connect the "why" of segregation to everyday civic sense, and make that connection feel personal to the citizen, not preachy
* Genuine interest in environment, sustainability, or waste management (prior exposure is a plus, not mandatory)
* Comfortable with public speaking and unafraid of large, unfamiliar crowds
* Good report-writing skills able to convert field observations into clear, structured reports
* Working knowledge of MS Office / Google Slides for presentations
* Someone who thinks on their feet able to de-escalate a disagreement with a citizen without waiting for instructions
* Self-driven and comfortable working primarily on ground, not from a desk
* Prior experience in community mobilisation, social work, or field campaigns is a strong plus

Good to Have

* Prior experience working with government departments or on government-funded projects
* Basic understanding of composting techniques or urban local body (ULB) functioning

How to Apply Interested candidates can share their resume at
**Sindhuja@civitasws.com**

title: Revenue Operations Hubspot Specialist
description:
**RevOps HubSpot Specialist**

**Department & Reporting Line**

Department: Revenue Operations / GTM Team

Location: Ahmedabad, India — Onsite

Reports to: RevOps Lead

Works with: Business CRM Analyst (Driver on delivery) and the RevOps Strategist / Client Owner (Approver) on every ticket, per the DACI model in the RevOps Delivery Process. Escalates directly and ad hoc to the RevOps Lead when stuck on a technical brief.

Role Summary

We are hiring a RevOps HubSpot Specialist to execute hands-on CRM configuration and GTM process builds for York IE's client engagements. This role is the core technical Contributor in the RevOps Delivery Process — building against well-defined Jira stories across HubSpot's core hubs, self-certifying QA, and growing into ownership of increasingly complex, multi-hub builds under the guidance of a RevOps Lead.

Key Responsibilities

HubSpot CRM Configuration & Build

1. Configure and administer core HubSpot modules — Sales Hub and Marketing Hub as the primary scope, with growing, guided exposure to Service Hub, Operations Hub, and CMS Hub.
2. Build workflows, sequences, lead scoring, list segmentation, pipelines, and property/field configuration against documented acceptance criteria.
3. Set up lead routing rules, lifecycle-stage automation, and standard Marketing → Sales → Customer Success handoff logic.
4. Support HubSpot-to-Salesforce (or another adjacent tool) field mapping and sync troubleshooting under guidance from the Lead or a senior Specialist.

GTM Execution Support

1. Execute campaign tracking (UTMs), nurture flow builds, and sequence design per Marketing/Sales requirements.
2. Assist with waterfall enrichment logic and match-rate troubleshooting in coordination with data/enrichment tools (Clay, Apollo.io, ZoomInfo, Clearbit).
3. Support first-touch/last-touch attribution reporting and funnel conversion tracking.

Reporting & Analytics

1. Build standard HubSpot reports and dashboards tracking pipeline, campaign performance, and activity metrics.
2. Flag data-quality issues (duplicates, missing fields, broken syncs) to the Business CRM Analyst or RevOps Lead promptly.

Delivery Process (Contributor per DACI)

1. Configure/build each assigned story in HubSpot against acceptance criteria set by the Business CRM Analyst.
2. Complete the Self-QA Checklist — functional test, data validation, regression check, access/permissions check, evidence attached — before moving a story to Ready for UAT.
3. Give the standing Delivery & Build Update on weekly client calls: what was configured, what passed Self-QA, what's blocked.
4. Escalate directly and promptly to the RevOps Lead when stuck on a technical brief or needing core technical guidance — an ad hoc coaching step, not a formal workflow stage.

Data Governance & Quality

1. Follow the deduplication, normalization, and data hygiene standards set for the account.
2. Maintain clean documentation and evidence trails on every ticket per the Self-QA standard.

Required Qualifications

1. 4+ years of hands-on RevOps, Sales Ops, Marketing Ops, or CRM Admin experience, with solid working expertise in HubSpot (Sales Hub and Marketing Hub required; exposure to Service Hub, Operations Hub, or CMS Hub is a strong plus).
2. Comfortable independently building workflows, sequences, lead scoring, and reporting on well-scoped tickets.
3. Basic familiarity with Salesforce or another secondary CRM (Zoho) is a plus.
4. Exposure to GTM data/enrichment tools (Clay, Apollo.io, ZoomInfo, Clearbit) is helpful but not required.
5. Comfort working in a Jira/DACI-based delivery model — clear on when to build independently versus when to escalate.
6. Solid communication skills; comfortable giving a live build update on client calls.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications

1. HubSpot certifications (Sales Hub Implementation, Marketing Hub Implementation, or RevOps).
2. Experience in a B2B SaaS environment.
3. Exposure to Gong, Outreach, Salesloft, or Segment.
4. Basic reporting/BI tool familiarity (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Position: Customer Success Manager

Location: Bengaluru / Gurugram

Working Days: Monday to Saturday

Experience Required: 1 - 2 years

The Role

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager who thinks about revenue first. You will own customer outcomes, ensuring clients not only stay but grow. This is not a support role; it is a growth role. You will drive adoption, expansion, and retention across our portfolio of D2C and e-commerce brands.

Key Metrics

* **Net Revenue Retention:** Maintain >100% through cross-sells, upsells, and adoption.
* **Revenue Realization:** Ensure billing hygiene and predictable cash flows.
* **Account Retention:** Minimize churn through proactive engagement.
* **Product Adoption:** Drive feature usage and deepen value delivery.

Key Responsibilities

* **Customer Onboarding and Account Growth**
  + Lead smooth onboarding for new accounts and ensure early success.
  + Identify opportunities for upsell or cross-sell based on customer usage and goals.
  + Collaborate with founders and sales to grow account revenue.

* **Relationship Management and Retention**
  + Conduct monthly reviews with key accounts to surface wins and gaps.
  + Maintain a deep understanding of customer business goals and align product value accordingly.
  + Proactively identify churn risks and execute recovery plans.

* **Adoption and Enablement**
  + Educate customers on new features and AI use cases to drive adoption.
  + Build advocacy by driving success stories, testimonials, and case studies.
  + Partner with marketing to co-create webinars, product showcases, and user stories.

* **Revenue Operations and Reporting**
  + Track usage, retention, and billing metrics for each account.
  + Maintain accurate forecasting and ensure timely renewals and payments.
  + Provide structured feedback loops to product and growth teams.

Who You Are

You have a revenue-first mindset and get energy from growth numbers. You have managed accounts in a SaaS environment and understand client lifecycles. You love solving problems and spotting upsell opportunities before anyone else. You communicate clearly, think analytically, and act fast. You believe in ownership, not waiting for instructions.

Must-Have Skills

* Strong communication (written and verbal).
* Customer relationship management.
* Analytical problem solving.
* Project and stakeholder management.
* Data-driven decision-making.

Culture and Perks

* Once-a-year international offsite.
* High-trust, action-biased environment.
* Work directly with founders and leadership.
* Ownership of experiments from idea to revenue.

**Role Title: VP, IAM End User Operations (L14)**

  
  

**Company Overview:**

Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are

shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.

  
  

**Organizational Overview:**

The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony, led by the Head of IAM reporting to the CISO, oversees key security functions. Direct reports specialize in authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This structure ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization. This role will be a direct report into the Head of IAM.

  
  

**Role Summary/Purpose:**

The Synchrony Identity and Access Management (IAM) team is seeking an experienced IAM End User Operations leader to oversee and drive the operations and support of End User IAM Services. This role will lead a team responsible for delivering secure, efficient, and seamless identity and access management experiences for our end users across the organization. Acting as a critical bridge between technology, security, and business stakeholders, you will ensure operational excellence of IAM solutions, streamline user lifecycle processes, and enhance service delivery aligned with our digital transformation goals.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

The ideal candidate for this role will embrace the exciting blend of technical expertise, program management, engagement ability and leadership that is required to be successful.

Specifically,

* Lead and manage the IAM End User Operations team focused on End User Services, including IAM automation engineers, administrators, and support specialists.
* Oversee day-to-day operations of user identity lifecycle management, access provisioning/de-provisioning, access reviews, self-service workflows, and password management tools.
* Drive continuous improvement in IAM operations by optimizing automation, workflows, and integration with IT service management (ITSM) platforms.
* Collaborate closely with IAM Solution Architects, Security, IT infrastructure, and business partners to ensure operational readiness, platform health, and scalability of IAM solutions.
* Develop and enforce operational standards, SLAs, and KPIs to monitor service performance and user experience quality.
* Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and problem resolution efforts related to end-user identity and access issues.
* Ensure compliance with security policies, privacy regulations, and audit requirements (SOX, GDPR, PCI, NIST).
* Champion adoption of best practices around zero trust, privileged access, and identity governance in daily operations.
* Provide leadership, mentorship, and professional development opportunities for the operations team.
* Partner with automation and DevSecOps teams to deploy and maintain infrastructure-as-code and automated IAM provisioning processes.
* Facilitate communication and training for end-users and support teams to improve IAM awareness and compliance.
* Stay current with emerging IAM operational technologies, tools, and industry trends to continuously enhance the IAM service portfolio.
  

  

**Required Skills/Knowledge**:

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; Master’s degree preferred with 10+ years of IT experience with a minimum of 8 years focused on IAM operations and end-user services management.
* Proven experience leading or managing teams responsible for IAM service delivery, identity lifecycle management, and end-user access support.
* Strong communication skills and executive presence needed.
* Knowledge of IAM tool platforms used for standard and privileged access management as well as authentication (ie. Delinea, Okta, SailPoint IIQ)
* Strong working knowledge of IAM tools such as SailPoint, Okta, Beyond Identity, Delinea, Microsoft Entra ID, and directory services like Active Directory.
* Experience managing identity provisioning, password resets, authentication services, and access governance activities at scale.
* Solid understanding of identity protocols (SAML, OAuth2, OIDC, LDAP, SCIM) in operational contexts.
* Familiarity with cloud IAM models (AWS, Azure, GCP) and integrating hybrid IAM ecosystems operationally.
* Knowledge of automation tools and DevSecOps principles applied in IAM environments (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD).
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with proven stakeholder management experience.
* Demonstrated commitment to exceptional customer service and continuous operational improvement.
* Experience working within regulatory frameworks affecting IAM operations such as SOX IT-404, GDPR, PCI, and financial industry controls.
  

  

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**:

* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, Okta Certified Administrator, SailPoint IdentityIQ Engineer, or similar.
* Experience managing large-scale IAM operational teams in financial services or regulated industries.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust principles as applied to IAM operations.
* Self-starter, able to adapt and thrive in a fast-changing, dynamic environment.
  

  

**Eligibility Criteria:**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; Master’s degree preferred with 10+ years of IT experience with a minimum of 8 years focused on IAM operations and end-user services management.

title: Account Manager
description:
Job Description: Account Manager

**Company:** Shanva Media  
**Department:** Digital Marketing & Client Servicing  
**Job Title:** Account Manager – Social Media & Digital Marketing

Job Summary

Shanva Media is looking for a proactive and organized Account Manager to manage client accounts, oversee social media platforms, coordinate content creation, and ensure smooth execution of digital marketing activities. The candidate will act as the primary point of contact between clients and the internal creative team to maintain strong client relationships and achieve marketing objectives.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Social Media Management**

* Manage clients' social media accounts, including Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
* Schedule and publish posts, reels, stories, carousels, and other content as per the monthly content calendar.
* Monitor comments, messages, engagement, and overall account activity.
* Ensure consistent branding, communication, and posting schedules across all platforms.

**2. Client Relationship Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
* Understand client requirements, business goals, and marketing expectations.
* Communicate regularly with clients regarding content approvals, campaign updates, and deliverables.
* Handle client feedback, queries, and concerns professionally.
* Maintain strong client relationships to ensure satisfaction and long-term retention.

**3. Content Planning & Coordination**

* Prepare monthly social media content calendars in coordination with the creative team.
* Coordinate with graphic designers, video editors, content writers, and performance marketers.
* Collect content references, captions, brand assets, product details, and other required information from clients.
* Ensure all content is reviewed, approved, and published on time.
* Follow up with the internal team to ensure timely delivery of creatives and videos.

**4. Digital Marketing & Campaign Coordination**

* Coordinate Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns with the performance marketing team.
* Assist in planning promotions, offers, seasonal campaigns, and brand awareness activities.
* Monitor campaign progress and communicate updates to clients.
* Support lead generation activities and ensure leads or enquiries are forwarded to the appropriate client representative.

**5. Reporting & Performance Analysis**

* Track social media metrics such as reach, impressions, engagement, follower growth, profile visits, and leads.
* Prepare monthly performance reports for clients.
* Analyze content performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Provide actionable suggestions to improve engagement, visibility, and brand growth.

**6. Account Operations & Documentation**

* Prepare and share monthly content calendars, reports, and other client deliverables.
* Maintain client documents, brand guidelines, approval records, and communication history.
* Coordinate the preparation and sharing of MOUs, onboarding documents, and other account-related paperwork.
* Track project deadlines, deliverables, and pending approvals.
* Ensure all work is aligned with the agreed scope of services and timelines.

**7. Additional Responsibilities**

* Stay updated on social media trends, platform updates, and digital marketing best practices.
* Identify opportunities to upsell relevant services such as paid advertising, website development, branding, and video production.
* Attend client meetings and internal review meetings.
* Perform other marketing, coordination, and account management duties assigned by the management.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Basic knowledge of Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other social media platforms.
* Understanding of content calendars, social media engagement, and digital marketing.
* Strong organizational, coordination, and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.
* Familiarity with Meta Business Suite and social media scheduling tools is preferred.
* Problem-solving ability and a client-focused mindset.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely delivery and publishing of scheduled content.
* Client satisfaction and retention.
* Timely collection of content approvals and required client materials.
* Accuracy and punctuality of monthly reports.
* Effective coordination between clients and internal teams.
* Achievement of agreed social media and campaign objectives.

**Reporting To:** Account Director / Operations Manager / Management

**Work Type:** Full-time

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Developer Relations Manager - Conglomerates
description:
NVIDIA is the leading full-stack accelerated computing company, powering the next wave of generative AI, agentic AI, deep learning, data science, cloud-native AI, and edge AI. This role will lead hands-on Developer Relations with India's AI Labs, helping researchers, ML infrastructure teams, and startup CTOs adopt NVIDIA platforms for model development, training, optimization, deployment, and production inference.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a senior technical DevRel leader who can earn credibility with ML researchers and platform engineers. This person should be comfortable reading code, writing examples, building demos, running benchmarks, explaining architecture tradeoffs, profiling workloads, and translating developer feedback into useful product input.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Build and execute a technical Developer Relations strategy to grow NVIDIA platform adoption across AI Labs in India.
* Develop trusted relationships with founders, CTOs, ML researchers, ML infrastructure teams, platform leaders, and developer communities.
* Identify and accelerate high-value workloads such as foundation model training, fine-tuning, speech AI, retrieval augmented generation, multimodal AI, inference optimization, and production model serving.
* Assess which AI Lab workloads are a strong fit for GPU acceleration by profiling bottlenecks and distinguishing compute-bound problems from memory-bound, IO-bound, network-bound, or orchestration-bound issues.
* Build and adapt technical demos, sample code, notebooks, benchmark plans, reference architectures, and performance guides.
* Run deep technical workshops, code labs, architecture reviews, office hours, developer sessions, technical webinars, and executive briefings.
* Work hands-on with developers to debug integration issues, profile workloads, improve inference performance, and identify the right NVIDIA software stack for each use case.
* Explain why similar model workloads may perform differently across labs due to model architecture, data pipeline design, batch size, latency targets, storage/network behavior, software stack, or deployment environment.
* Capture developer feedback, technical blockers, competitive insights, and product requirements for NVIDIA product and engineering teams.

**What We Need To See**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, business technology, or a related technical discipline—or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, enterprise technology, solution architecture, technical sales, business development, product management, or developer ecosystems.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise and private AI, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, modern application architecture, and AI deployment lifecycles.
* Ability to engage senior executives and hands-on engineering or architecture teams with equal credibility.
* Experience working across complex, matrixed organizations involving sales, technical, product, marketing, and partner teams.
* Strong commercial judgment, structured account planning, and the ability to translate technical capabilities into measurable business outcomes.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, cross-functional collaboration, and execution skills.
* Working knowledge of NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NIM, Triton, TensorRT, TensorRT-LLM, CUDA, NGC, GPU Operator, and cloud and data-center deployment patterns.
* Ability to position NVIDIA technologies across private AI, industrial AI, digital twins, simulation, accelerated analytics, computer vision, and enterprise AI factories.
* Familiarity with Omniverse, Isaac Sim, and synthetic-data workflows, with the ability to map NVIDIA platform components to business workloads and explain implementation paths to executive and technical audiences.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience with large conglomerates or global strategic enterprise accounts.
* Knowledge of industrial AI, manufacturing systems, automotive technology, telecom infrastructure, digital twins, simulation, accelerated analytics, or private AI.
* Prior experience shaping executive or business-unit adoption plans around NVIDIA AI, data center, simulation, edge, or enterprise software platforms.
* Ability to create lighthouse use cases that can scale across multiple business units.

title: Cluster Manager
description:
**Position Summary**

The Cluster Manager is responsible for the overall performance of a group of QSR outlets (typically 5 to 10 stores) in an assigned geography. The role owns sales growth, profitability, customer experience, food safety and people development across the cluster, and ensures every outlet runs to brand standards consistently.

**Key Responsibilities**

Operations and Standards

\* Ensure all outlets follow SOPs for food preparation, service, hygiene, equipment use, packaging and opening and closing procedures.

\* Conduct regular outlet visits and audits (operations, quality, hygiene, safety) and close all gaps within agreed timelines.

\* Maintain consistency of product quality, portion control, taste and presentation across the cluster.

\* Ensure uninterrupted outlet operations through timely equipment maintenance, repairs and vendor coordination.

\* Ensure fire safety, workplace safety and emergency preparedness at every outlet.

Sales and Profitability

\* Achieve monthly and annual sales, margin and EBITDA targets for the cluster.

\* Analyse daily, weekly and monthly MIS to identify trends, and take corrective action on underperforming outlets.

\* Control key costs: food cost, wastage, manpower cost, utilities and consumables.

\* Drive average bill value, footfall, delivery and aggregator sales through upselling, combos and local activations.

\* Manage inventory, ordering and stock audits to keep variances within limits.

Customer Experience

\* Monitor customer feedback, ratings (including delivery platforms) and complaints, and ensure timely resolution.

title: Amazon PPC Executive – Advertising & Operations
description:
Sellers Umbrella is an Amazon SPN Partner, Amazon Ads Partner, and Software Partner, helping brands build, manage, and scale their businesses across global Amazon marketplaces.

With 9+ years of experience, 350+ brands supported, and $200M+ in client revenue, we specialize in Amazon Advertising, Account Management, Listing Optimization, Product Launches, Creative Content, Brand Registry, FBA Logistics, and International Marketplace Expansion.

We combine marketplace expertise with advanced analytics, AI tools, and automation to drive measurable, profitable growth for our clients.

About the Position

We are hiring an **Amazon PPC Executive** who can independently manage Amazon advertising campaigns, analyze performance, and identify opportunities for profitable growth.

This position is primarily focused on **Amazon Advertising (70%)**, with supporting responsibilities in **Seller Central Operations (30%)**.

We are looking for someone who goes beyond routine campaign monitoring, understands advertising performance, and takes ownership of results.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Amazon Advertising & PPC Optimization – 70%**

* Plan, create, manage, and optimize Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns.
* Perform keyword research, competitor analysis, product targeting, and search term optimization.
* Manage campaign structures, bidding strategies, placement adjustments, and advertising budgets.
* Monitor ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CPC, CTR, conversion rates, and advertising-attributed sales.
* Identify underperforming campaigns, wasted spend, and profitable scaling opportunities.
* Conduct regular keyword harvesting, negative targeting, bid optimization, and campaign restructuring.
* Analyze business reports, advertising data, and product-level performance to make informed decisions.
* Support new product launches, ranking strategies, promotional campaigns, and seasonal advertising.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights.
* Balance advertising growth with profitability, organic performance, and inventory availability.

**2. AI Tools, Analytics & Automation**

We actively encourage the use of AI and technology to improve advertising performance and operational efficiency.

Candidates should be comfortable learning and working with tools such as:

* **ChatGPT & Google Gemini:** Data interpretation, reporting, research, content analysis, and workflow assistance.
* **Manus AI:** AI-assisted research, campaign analysis, and reporting workflows.
* **Helium 10, Jungle Scout & Data Dive:** Keyword research, competitor insights, market intelligence, and listing analysis.
* **Microsoft Excel & Google Sheets:** Advanced reporting, data analysis, bulk operations, and performance tracking.
* **Amazon Ads Console & Bulk Sheets:** Campaign management, large-scale optimization, and advertising reporting.

The ideal candidate should be able to identify repetitive tasks suitable for automation, use AI to assist decision-making, and validate recommendations against actual marketplace data.

Experience with every listed tool is not mandatory, but a willingness to learn and adopt new technology is essential.

**3. Amazon Seller Central Operations – 30%**

* Monitor account health, listing status, catalog issues, and operational notifications.
* Assist with product listing optimization, variations, keywords, and catalog updates.
* Monitor FBA inventory availability, stranded inventory, and replenishment requirements.
* Create and follow up on Amazon Seller Support cases.
* Coordinate with creative teams for A+ Content, Storefronts, product images, and listing improvements.
* Support product launches, promotional activities, and marketplace compliance.
* Coordinate with project managers and operations teams to resolve issues affecting advertising performance.

**4. Reporting, Communication & Accountability**

* Track daily advertising performance and identify required actions.
* Maintain campaign change logs, performance records, and task updates.
* Communicate campaign progress, challenges, and recommendations clearly.
* Coordinate with internal teams across multiple client accounts.
* Take responsibility for assigned tasks, deadlines, and measurable outcomes.

**Required Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of hands-on experience in Amazon PPC advertising.
* Strong understanding of Amazon Ads Console and campaign optimization.
* Working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
* Ability to interpret advertising reports and identify performance improvement opportunities.
* Good written English communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to independently manage tasks and multiple priorities.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Amazon USA, UK, Canada, Australia, or European marketplaces.
* Previous experience working with an Amazon agency or multiple seller accounts.
* Knowledge of Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Data Dive, or similar research tools.
* Familiarity with ChatGPT, Gemini, Manus AI, or automation platforms.
* Experience with Amazon Ads bulk operations and advanced reporting.
* Exposure to Amazon DSP, Amazon Marketing Cloud, or Amazon Ads API-based reporting.
* Amazon Advertising certifications.

**Why Join Sellers Umbrella?**

* Work directly with international Amazon brands and marketplaces.
* Gain practical experience with advanced advertising strategies and performance analytics.
* Explore modern AI tools, automation, and eCommerce technology.
* Collaborate with experienced marketplace specialists.
* Build your career in a data-driven, performance-focused environment.
* Enjoy a five-day working week.

**Apply Now**

If you have hands-on Amazon PPC experience, enjoy working with data, and want to develop your skills in AI-assisted advertising and global eCommerce, we would like to hear from you.

Apply through Indeed with your updated resume.

**Website:** www.sellersumbrella.com

description:
**Company Description**
A career here is life-enhancing.
  
  
At Syner-G, we enable our people to build careers that impact positively on their quality of life. Through our expertise, insight, consulting and management skills, we accelerate breakthrough science and delivery of life-enhancing therapies to more patients. We work across a diverse range of clients and projects, supporting many organizations from the most critical phases of the drug discovery and approval process through to commercialization. It is meaningful, varied and thought-provoking work with a strategic emphasis, a solutions-driven approach and significant, real-world outcomes, from science to delivery/success. To learn more about who we are and what drives us, watch our company video
**here**
.
  
  
Underpinning this mission is a culture that aligns perfectly with what we want to achieve. We enable our people to grow, we support them in their learning and we reward them in so many different ways. In return, they play an instrumental role in maintaining our reputation across the globe as a strategic biopharma product development and delivery partner.
  
  
Syner-G was recently honored with BioSpace's prestigious "Best Places to Work" 2026 award, for the third consecutive year, along with many other award-winning programs to make a career here truly life-enhancing. These recognitions are a testament to our commitment to fostering a positive and engaging work environment for our employees, with a particular emphasis on culture, career growth and development opportunities, financial rewards, leadership and innovation.
  
  
At Syner-G, we recognize that our team members are our most valuable asset. Join us in shaping the future, where your talents are valued, and your contributions make a meaningful impact.
  
  
For more information, visit www.Synergbiopharma.com
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist plays a critical role in leading end-to-end recruitment efforts, ensuring the organization attracts, engages, and hires top talent aligned with business needs and culture. This role partners closely with senior leadership, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams to design and execute recruitment strategies, streamline processes, and drive efficiency. The Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist contributes to strategic HR and organizational initiatives and supports the continuous improvement of recruitment practices, employer branding, and talent pipeline development.
  
  
**WORK LOCATION:**
Remote position based in Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad, or Mumbai, with pan-India operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
(This list is not exhaustive and may be supplemented or adjusted as needed.)
  
  

* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for India-based hiring, including intake meetings, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, candidate assessment, and offer management.
* Partner with senior leadership and hiring managers in India and globally to develop recruitment strategies aligned with business priorities and workforce planning needs.
* Utilize Applicant Tracking System (Greenhouse) and sourcing platforms (e.g., LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed) to effectively manage recruitment activities and identify qualified talent.
* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines through proactive sourcing, networking, and ongoing candidate relationship management.
* Ensure timely communication and consistent updates throughout the recruitment process to deliver a positive and professional candidate experience.
* Collaborate closely with business functions, to recruit for technical and business-critical roles across India.
* Support or contribute to organizational initiatives beyond core recruitment responsibilities, including onboarding workstreams, process alignment, and the development of tools and resources that support the broader organization.
* Identify opportunities to improve, standardize, and streamline recruitment processes while supporting consistency across India and global talent acquisition practices.
* Serve as a trusted talent advisor to hiring teams by providing insights on the India talent market, candidate availability, compensation trends, sourcing strategies, and recruitment best practices.
* Ensure recruitment activities are conducted in alignment with company policies, established processes, and applicable employment practices and requirements in India.

**Education**
**QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s degree required (Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field preferred); MBA or postgraduate qualification in Human Resources or a related field preferred.

**Experience**

* 5+ years of recruitment or talent acquisition experience, with demonstrated experience recruiting within the India talent market.
* Proven experience supporting technical and business functions in a corporate or professional services environment
* Experience within life sciences, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, engineering, or consulting industries required.
* Strong knowledge of Applicant Tracking Systems (e.g., Greenhouse), sourcing platforms (e.g., LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed), and end-to-end recruitment workflows.
* Experience partnering with hiring managers and stakeholders across different functions, geographies, and time zones.
* Skilled in leveraging recruitment data and metrics to track performance, identify trends, and improve hiring outcomes.

**Skills And Attributes**

* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to effectively engage candidates, hiring managers, and senior leaders.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with experience supporting cross-functional and global initiatives.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and operate effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
**About Astellas**
Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com (https://www.astellas.com/en) .
  
  
**Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?**
We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.
  
  
**Purpose And Scope**
The Talent Acquisition Partner enables Astellas to secure the high-quality talent it needs to deliver its business and workforce priorities. The role leads the delivery of complex and senior-level hiring, partnering with business leaders to translate workforce priorities into effective hiring strategies. Acting as a trusted adviser, the role brings recruitment expertise, market insight and constructive challenge throughout the hiring lifecycle, to drive timely, high-quality and informed hiring decisions.
  
  
The role champions consistent, compliant and high-quality recruitment practices and contributes to the continuous improvement and evolution of Talent Acquisition globally and locally.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Accountabilities**

* Partner with business leaders to define talent needs, challenge requirements and develop effective hiring strategies, primarily for senior-level roles.
* Lead recruitment from requisition to offer, coordinating the RPO provider and wider Astellas teams.
* Deliver a professional, fair, consistent and engaging experience for candidates and Hiring Managers.
* Ensure recruitment activities comply with company policies and employment legislation.
* Resolve escalated recruitment issues with relevant stakeholders.

**Stakeholder and Business Partnering**

* Build trusted relationships with hiring managers and key business stakeholders, providing regular hiring reviews and progress updates.
* Develop a robust understanding of the business priorities, our values and behaviours, and organizational context.
* Advise and influence stakeholders using talent market insight, sourcing expertise and recruitment best practice.

**Global Process And Experience Excellence**

* Monitor recruitment metrics and identify opportunities to improve candidate and hiring manager experience and hiring outcomes.
* Contribute to global and local TA projects, employer branding and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Maintain knowledge of recruitment trends, analytics and employment legislation.

**Experience**

* Significant experience managing full-cycle recruitment in an in-house, RPO or agency environment.
* Recruitment experience within the pharmaceutical or life sciences sectors, preferably with a focus on Development or Commercial capabilities.
* Experience operating in complex, global organisations and influencing senior stakeholders.
* Preferably with focus on Clinical Research Development, Supply Chain, Commercial Customer Engagement Excellence, Digital hiring capabilities for GCCs

**Capabilities**

* Recruitment expertise: Knowledge of recruitment best practice, including sourcing, interviewing and candidate assessment techniques.

* Collaboration : Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships across teams and collaborate to deliver outcomes.
* Strategic thinking: Connects immediate hiring needs with longer-term business and workforce priorities.
* Data and digital fluency: Uses data, market insight and technology to inform decisions and improve recruitment.
* Stakeholder influence: Builds trusted relationships and communicates clearly to advise and influence senior leaders.
* Growth mindset: Embraces change and actively adopts new tools, technologies and ways of working to drive continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

**Working Environment**
At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility

* Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide.
* Real-world patient impact: Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day.
* Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare.

**Our Organizational Values and Behaviors**

Innovation, Integrity and Impact sit at the heart of what we do.

We come together as ‘One Astellas’, working with courage and a sense of urgency. We are outcome focused and consistently take accountability for our personal contribution.

title: Human Resources Manager (Generalist)
description:
The Role

We are hiring a Generalist HR Manager to own the entire people and office function for a 140-member team across 3 branches, working side by side with the founders. This is a full-time role based at our Bangalore office.

You will run HR and Admin end to end, from payroll, compliance and hiring to performance, engagement and exits. You will also shape how the company feels to work in: healthier, more motivated and more connected.

**Why this is a rare opportunity**

* **A profitable startup.**
  We are growing and running profitably, so you build on a stable base, not on burn-rate anxiety.
* **Founder access.**
  You work directly with the founders and your decisions shape company culture from day one.
* **Full ownership.**
  One person owns the whole HR and Admin charter. You will not be a cog in a large HR department.
* **A growing company.**
  With 140 people and 3 branches today, you will build the processes, policies and culture that carry us to the next stage.

About Us

We build tools and systems that help Indian users save and earn money. Our family of products includes:

* **PaisaWapas:**
  a cashback and rewards platform where users earn cashback on online shopping.
* **ExtraPe:**
  a social deal-sharing platform where users earn by sharing eCommerce and fintech deals with friends and family.
* **Haulpack:**
  a creator monetization platform where creators get paid to drive sales, supported by tools such as Auto DM on Instagram.
* **CardGrid:**
  an AI-powered credit card recommendation and discovery platform.
* **LoanGrid:**
  a loan marketplace where users discover, compare and apply for personal, home and business loans.

Today we are about 140 people across 3 branches, and the business is profitable.

Key Responsibilities

**1. HR operations, payroll and leave**

* Own monthly payroll end to end: attendance and leave inputs, salary processing, payslips, reimbursements and full-and-final settlements.
* Manage leave policy and tracking, and maintain accurate employee records and HRMS data across all branches.
* Handle onboarding, documentation, confirmations and the full employee lifecycle.

**2. Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with employment laws and regulations, including PF, ESI and other statutory requirements, and coordinate with our external consultancy firm that handles the filings.
* Work with the consultancy firm to make sure returns and challans are filed on time, and stay audit-ready.
* Draft and update HR policies, employment contracts and the employee handbook.

**3. Talent acquisition**

* Run end-to-end hiring: workforce planning with the founders, sourcing, screening, interviews, offers and joining.
* Build a strong hiring pipeline through job boards, referrals, campuses and agencies.

**4. Performance, appraisal and exit**

* Set up and run performance management: goals, tracking, periodic reviews and the annual appraisal cycle.
* Manage promotions, increments and role changes with the founders.
* Run exit formalities: resignations, notice period, exit interviews, handover, clearances and final settlement. Share exit insights with leadership.

**5. Employee feedback and workplace health**

* Collect regular feedback through one-on-ones, surveys and skip-level conversations. Turn it into action.
* Act as the first point of contact for employee concerns and resolve grievances fairly and confidentially.
* Build a healthy, respectful and inclusive work environment.

**6. Engagement, culture and growth**

* Plan and run team engagement activities, celebrations and events.
* Drive team bonding and cross-functional engagement across teams and branches.
* Launch new initiatives for employee motivation, learning and growth, fitness and wellness, and personality building.

**7. Office and administration**

* Manage day-to-day office operations across all 3 branches: facilities, seating, housekeeping, pantry, security and maintenance.
* Handle vendors, contracts, purchases, assets, IT and equipment coordination, and office budgets.
* Work closely with the office boys and office coordinators at each branch: guide them, monitor their work, and make sure every branch runs smoothly so teams can focus on their work.

What We Are Looking For

* 5+ years of experience in generalist HR and admin, ideally in a startup or fast-growing company with 100+ employees.
* A graduate or postgraduate degree, preferably an MBA or PGDM in HR.
* Hands-on experience running payroll, including PF, ESI, professional tax and other statutory compliance.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and employment regulations.
* Experience handling hiring, appraisals, performance management and exits end to end.
* Experience managing multi-branch operations and office administration.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the maturity to handle sensitive matters with confidentiality.
* A proactive, ownership-driven mindset. You are comfortable working with founders, and with both strategy and execution.
* Comfort with HRMS and payroll tools, and good command of Excel or Google Sheets.
* Passion for building culture, engagement and employee wellbeing.

What You Get

* **Founder-level exposure.**
  You work directly with the founders on people strategy, not behind layers of management.
* **Real ownership.**
  You build and own the HR and Admin function for the whole company.
* **A stable, profitable company.**
  You grow with a business that is already earning.
* **Room to grow.**
  As we scale, your role can grow with the company.
* **Compensation**
  that matches your experience and impact. Open to discussion.

**Role details:**
Generalist HR Manager · Full time · Bangalore (on-site) · Reports to the founders

**How to apply:**
Send your resume to shankar@paisawapas.com with a short note on why this role excites you.

title: HR Manager - U.S. Operations
description:
**Overview**
TekWissen Group is a workforce management provider throughout India and many other countries in the world.
  
  
**Position: HR Manager – U.S. Operations
  
  
Location: Bengaluru / Visakhapatnam
  
  
Work Mode: Onsite (5 days)
  
  
Shift Timings: 1:30 PM – 10:30 PM**
**Experience: 10+ Years**
**Job Description**
**Position Summary**

* The HR Manager – U.S. Operations will manage and execute key HR operational activities supporting the company's U.S. corporate employees and contingent workforce.
* The role will serve as a centralized HR operations function from India, with responsibility for employee administration, HRIS accuracy, benefits coordination, payroll support, workforce compliance, contingent-worker lifecycle management, audits, reporting, and employee support.
* The position will work closely with U.S. HR leadership, Payroll, Finance, Recruitment, Account Management, Benefits providers, and other internal teams.
* Matters requiring U.S. legal interpretation, sensitive employee-relations decisions, investigations, or executive approval will be escalated appropriately.
* HRIS & Employee Data Management
* Own day-to-day administration and accuracy of U.S. employee information within the HRIS.
* Maintain employee master data, including job title, department, supervisor, work location, employment classification, start date, termination date, and employment status.
* Process approved compensation and pay-rate changes.
* Maintain employee personal-information changes, emergency contacts, employment documents, and personnel files.
* Process employee transfers, promotions, reporting-line changes, and other employment-status changes.
* Conduct routine HRIS audits to identify missing, inaccurate, or inconsistent employee information.
* Identify incorrect employee classifications, reporting relationships, locations, and employment statuses.
* Maintain appropriate documentation supporting all HRIS changes.
* Produce recurring employee and workforce reports for U.S. HR and management.
* Employee Onboarding (HQ EE)
* Coordinate the HR portion of onboarding for U.S. corporate employees and contingent workers.
* Ensure required onboarding documentation is collected and completed.
* Track completion of employment forms, policy acknowledgments, background checks, drug screens, and client-specific requirements.
* Coordinate employee setup between HRIS, Payroll, Benefits, Recruitment, and Account Management.
* Track outstanding onboarding items and proactively follow up with employees and internal stakeholders.
* Maintain an onboarding audit checklist for every employee.
* Confirm onboarding audit completion before closing the employee's onboarding file.
* Maintain documentation required for client and internal compliance audits.
* Coordinate benefits eligibility notifications for newly eligible employees.
* Contingent Workforce HR Administration Manage the HR lifecycle of U.S. contingent employees assigned to client locations, including:
* Assignment onboarding.
* Assignment extensions and renewals.
* Assignment changes.
* Client/site transfers.
* Approved pay-rate changes.
* Shift changes.
* Employment-status changes.
* Attendance documentation.
* Client holiday-calendar administration.
* PTO inquiries.
* Benefits inquiries.
* Assignment-ending communications.
* Employee offboarding.
* Rehire processing.
* Employment verification.
* Unemployment documentation collection.
* Personnel-file maintenance.
* Employee HR inquiries and issue routing.

Partner with Recruitment and Account Management while maintaining clear separation between client/recruiting responsibilities and HR employment administration.
  
  

* Payroll HR Support & Pre-Payroll Auditing Serve as the HR operational partner to U.S. Payroll and Finance.

**Responsibilities Include**

* Provide accurate new-hire information to Payroll.
* Process approved employee changes and terminations.
* Validate PTO and other HR-related payroll inputs.
* Coordinate benefits deductions and employee-status changes.
* Route garnishment documentation to the appropriate Payroll resource.
* Maintain documentation supporting approved pay-rate changes.
* Research employee payroll discrepancies from the HR side.
* Coordinate retroactive adjustment requests.
* Escalate timesheet and payroll exceptions to the appropriate teams.
* Respond to routine employee payroll inquiries or route them appropriately.
* Maintain documentation and resolution status for payroll-related HR issues.

**Pre-Payroll Rate Audit**
  
  

* Conduct recurring audits to ensure alignment across:

+ VMS/Client Assignment Rate → Employee Offer Letter → HRIS Pay Rate → Payroll Pay Rate

* Identify discrepancies before payroll processing whenever possible and immediately escalate exceptions for correction.
* Maintain an audit trail showing identified discrepancies, corrective actions, responsible owners, and resolution dates.
* Weekly Bare Hours & Workforce Exception Reporting
* Prepare and review the weekly Bare Hours Report.
* Identify employees with active assignments but missing or zero reported hours.
* Investigate whether missing hours relate to attendance, assignment status, timesheet issues, PTO, leave, assignment completion, or administrative errors.
* Coordinate with Account Management, Recruitment, Payroll, and employees to resolve exceptions.
* Track unresolved cases through closure.
* Identify recurring patterns by employee, client, account, or internal team.
* Escalate aging exceptions to HR leadership.
* Benefits Administration (Future)

**Manage Routine U.S. Employee Benefits Administration, Including**

* Benefits eligibility tracking.
* New-hire benefits eligibility notifications.
* Enrollment communications.
* Open-enrollment coordination.
* Routine employee benefits questions.
* Addition and removal of eligible dependents.
* Life-event documentation.
* Benefits carrier data reconciliation.
* Benefits deduction reconciliation with Payroll.
* 401(k) administrative support.
* HSA/FSA administrative support.
* COBRA event notification to the designated administrator.
* Employee termination notification to benefits carriers.
* Benefits invoice reconciliation support.
* Employee benefits communications.
* Maintenance of benefits-related employee records.

Escalate complex ERISA, ACA, COBRA, benefits disputes, or legal interpretations to designated U.S. HR leadership, benefits advisors, or counsel.
  
  

* Attendance, PTO & Leave Administration
* Maintain employee PTO records.
* Monitor and reconcile attendance information.
* Review PTO requests against applicable company policies.
* Maintain employee leave records.
* Track employee absences and return-to-work dates.
* Coordinate routine leave administration.
* Ensure Payroll receives appropriate approved leave/PTO information.
* Maintain supporting leave documentation.
* Escalate FMLA, ADA, state-specific leave, accommodation, and other complex cases to designated U.S. HR resources.
* OPT & Work Authorization Audits
* Conduct recurring OPT and work-authorization audits.
* Maintain accurate work-authorization expiration information.
* Track upcoming expiration dates and required employee follow-ups.
* Maintain supporting documentation within appropriate employee records.
* Generate advance expiration reports.
* Follow up with employees for updated documentation as permitted by company procedures.
* Escalate potential employment-authorization issues before expiration.
* Support internal I-9 and work-authorization compliance audits.

Any immigration or employment-eligibility determination requiring legal interpretation will be escalated to designated U.S. HR leadership or immigration counsel.
  
  

* Workers' Compensation Coding & Administration
* Maintain workers' compensation classification/code information for employees and assignments.
* Review employee and assignment information for appropriate workers' compensation coding based on established company procedures.
* Coordinate corrections with Payroll, Finance, insurance brokers, or other responsible parties.
* Maintain supporting records for workers' compensation classifications.
* Assist with workers' compensation audits.
* Support incident-report administration and documentation.
* Track open workers' compensation administrative matters.
* Escalate disputed classifications, claims, significant incidents, or legal questions to appropriate U.S. resources.
* Employee Offboarding Manage the administrative offboarding process for U.S. corporate and contingent employees, including:
* Process approved terminations and assignment completions.
* Update HRIS employment status.
* Notify Payroll and Benefits.
* Coordinate benefits termination.
* Initiate appropriate COBRA notification workflow.
* Coordinate IT/system-access removal.
* Coordinate company equipment return.
* Track final timesheets.
* Maintain separation documentation.
* Complete personnel-file closure.
* Maintain rehire eligibility status based on approved direction.
* Coordinate employment-verification records.
* Ensure all required offboarding steps are completed and documented.
* HR Compliance Audits

**Establish Recurring HR Operational Audits Covering**

* Employee records.
* Personnel-file completeness.
* HRIS accuracy.
* Onboarding completion.
* Work authorization.
* OPT expiration.
* Background-check completion.
* Benefits eligibility.
* Employee classifications.
* Workers' compensation codes.
* Pay-rate accuracy.
* Assignment status.
* PTO/attendance records.
* Offboarding completion.
* Required employee acknowledgments.

Maintain an exception report identifying issue, employee/client, date identified, responsible owner, corrective action, target completion date, and closure date.
  
  

* HR Reporting & Management Dashboard

**Prepare Weekly And Monthly U.S. HR Operational Reporting, Including**

* Active corporate employee headcount.
* Active contingent employee headcount.
* New hires.
* Terminations.
* Assignment starts and endings.
* Turnover.
* Benefits eligibility.
* Benefits enrollment.
* PTO/attendance exceptions.
* Bare-hours exceptions.
* OPT/work-authorization expirations.
* Onboarding exceptions.
* Offboarding exceptions.
* Workers' compensation coding exceptions.
* Payroll/pay-rate discrepancies.
* HRIS data-quality exceptions.
* Open employee HR issues.

Highlight aging issues, compliance risks, recurring operational problems, and items requiring U.S. leadership intervention.
  
  

* Recruitment Coordination – U.S. Corporate/HQ Hiring As required, support future U.S. corporate and HQ hiring by:
* Posting approved positions.
* Coordinating candidate sourcing.
* Conducting initial resume screening against approved criteria.
* Scheduling interviews.
* Coordinating candidate communication.
* Maintaining interview status and recruiting records.
* Supporting offer-document preparation following management approval.
* Transitioning successful candidates into the onboarding process.

Final hiring and compensation decisions remain with the designated hiring manager and leadership.
  
  

* Employee HR Help Desk Serve as a primary HR operations contact for routine U.S. employee questions involving:
* Benefits.
* PTO.
* Attendance.
* Payroll coordination.
* HRIS information.
* Employment verification.
* Assignment status.
* HR policies.
* Employee records.
* Onboarding.
* Offboarding.

Resolve routine administrative matters directly and escalate employee-relations, legal, compliance, or sensitive employment matters according to the established escalation matrix.
  
  
**Key Accountability of the Role**
  
  

* The HR Manager – U.S. Operations is expected to create a disciplined, auditable HR operating environment in which employee transactions are completed accurately and on time.
* The role should operate under three core principles:

+ Accuracy: HRIS, payroll, VMS, assignment, benefits, and employee records must remain synchronized.
+ Compliance: Every employee should have complete and auditable onboarding, employment, work-authorization, benefits, and offboarding records.
+ Ownership: HR operational issues should be tracked from identification through resolution rather than simply being forwarded to another department.

* The position will serve as the operational control point connecting Employee → HRIS → VMS/Client Assignment → Benefits → Payroll → Compliance → Offboarding for the U.S. workforce.
* For this hire, I would also build the performance expectations around specific SLAs/KPIs rather than a conventional HR Manager job description—for example, 100% onboarding audit completion, zero unexplained VMS-to-payroll rate mismatches, work-authorization alerts 90/60/30 days before expiration, weekly bare-hours closure, benefits reconciliation accuracy, and defined turnaround times for employee requests. That would make the India position an accountable U.S. HR Operations Manager, rather than primarily an administrative HR role

**TekWissen® Group is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity.**
