title: Plant Human Resources Manager
description:
**Role:**
Head of HR

***Industry:***
*A leading Indian manufacturer of engineered capital equipment*

**ABOUT THE COMPANY:**

Our client is a well-established Indian manufacturer of high-precision, engineered capital equipment, with several decades of engineering heritage as part of a larger industrial group. The Company designs and supplies complex systems to customers across aerospace, defence, automotive, and advanced materials.

With a full-fledged in-house design centre and internationally recognised quality and compliance certifications, the Company sits at the intersection of deep technical expertise and growing global demand. It is entering a phase of accelerated growth and is building its leadership team, including its people function, to match that ambition. The Company's identity will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

The Head of HR is a senior leadership role reporting to the Managing Director, responsible for building the people function that the Company's next phase of growth requires. The role owns the full employee lifecycle, from workforce planning and hiring through development, performance, rewards, employee relations, and statutory compliance, for a workforce that spans engineers, skilled shop-floor technicians, and commercial and support teams.

The position will be offered at a level between Senior Manager and General Manager, depending on the experience and calibre of the selected candidate. The right candidate will run HR operations reliably day to day while acting as a true business partner to the Managing Director and the functional GMs: shaping organisation design, building leadership depth, and making the Company a place where strong engineering and operations talent chooses to build a career.

The Company is looking for a builder, not just a manager. The right candidate will be entrepreneurial by disposition — willing to roll up their sleeves, set up what does not yet exist, and take ownership of whatever is needed to strengthen the organisation and put the Company in a competitive position.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**HR strategy & business partnership:**

* Develop and own the HR strategy and annual people plan, aligned to the Company's growth plans and agreed with the Managing Director
* Partner with the Managing Director and functional GMs on organisation design, role clarity, reporting lines, and succession for critical positions
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the leadership team on people decisions, and as a member of the leadership team in business reviews and budgeting discussions
* Track and report people KPIs — headcount vs. plan, attrition, time-to-hire, training coverage, and engagement — with clear actions to the Managing Director

**Talent acquisition & workforce planning:**

* Translate business plans into rolling workforce plans across engineering, fabrication, assembly, quality, supply chain, sales, and support functions
* Own end-to-end recruitment for senior, specialist, and shop-floor roles, with clear hiring processes, structured interviews, and strong employer branding in the local talent market
* Build talent pipelines through campus hiring, internships, and graduate programmes, and strengthen the quality of leadership and critical-skill hiring
* Run onboarding and early-tenure retention that helps new hires, particularly experienced leaders joining a growing company, become productive quickly

**Performance, rewards & compensation:**

* Design and run a fair, simple performance management system with clear goals, regular reviews, and visible links to development and rewards
* Build a role-grading and compensation framework benchmarked to market, balancing internal equity with the need to attract scarce technical talent
* Oversee payroll, benefits, and variable-pay schemes, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and cost control against the people budget
* Develop recognition and retention approaches for critical engineering, design, and skilled-trade talent

**Learning, development & capability building:**

* Own the learning and development agenda, building structured programmes across classroom training, on-the-job training, and internships
* Build leadership development pathways, including an engineering leadership programme for new graduates and a pipeline of first-line managers and supervisors on the floor
* Maintain skills matrices, competency records, and training evidence that support quality and industry audit requirements, working closely with the Quality GM
* Partner with functional heads to identify capability gaps and link training to measurable business improvements

**Employee relations, culture & engagement:**

* Build a culture of ownership, accountability, and open communication as the Company scales across functions and shifts
* Handle employee relations, grievances, disciplinary matters, and exits with fairness, consistency, and discretion
* Run regular engagement and feedback mechanisms — surveys, skip-levels, town halls — and drive action on what they surface
* Work with Operations and EHS leaders to support a safe, respectful workplace across the shop floor and offices

**HR operations, compliance & systems:**

* Ensure full compliance with labour and employment laws, including statutory registrations and returns, contract labour requirements, and workplace policies such as POSH
* Maintain current HR policies, employee handbook, and standard processes, and keep the Company audit-ready
* Implement and manage an HRIS and digital HR processes — attendance, leave, payroll, appraisals, and employee records — so that data is accurate and decisions are data-informed
* Manage the HR team and external partners such as recruiters, payroll and compliance consultants, and training vendors; develop the team's capability as the function grows

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Experience:**

title: Manager, Onboarding
description:
**Purpose in Every Position**
Pebl puts a world of talent at your fingertips. With our AI-powered Global Work Platform™, companies can hire, pay, and manage employees in 185+ countries—removing risk, red tape, and guesswork from global growth. Backed by more than a decade of compliance leadership and local expertise, Pebl helps businesses move fast, stay compliant, and scale with confidence. With Pebl, companies everywhere can hire great talent anywhere.
  
  
**Where Your Work Moves the Needle.**
At Pebl, every team member drives our success. Joining us means more than filling a role—you’re accountable for results and impact. Our values guide how we operate, execute, and collaborate across borders. By putting them into action, you’ll help us scale faster, compete harder, and lead the future of global work.
  
  
**What Makes You A Great Fit**
Customers expect flawless execution at scale. As Manager, Onboarding, you’ll lead the team that owns the operational outcome for some of Pebl’s most strategic customers and their employees, across the full onboarding and off-boarding lifecycle: offer completion, onboarding, payroll setup, and clean, compliant off-boarding. You’ll gain deep exposure to customer operations, payroll, product, and process improvement while helping build the operating model behind Pebl’s largest customers.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**

* Lead a team of 8-10+ delivering end-to-end onboarding and off-boarding for customers and their employees.
* Own the core metrics: cycle time, CSAT, accuracy, and SLA adherence.
* Analyze operational data, trace issues to root cause, and build lasting fixes through process, automation, tooling, and playbooks.
* Work closely Product to surface customer and employee issues and see fixes through to launch.
* Partner with Sales, Payroll, Legal, Client Services, People Operations, and Immigration to resolve challenges and stay compliant across jurisdictions.
* Build trusted relationships with customers.
* Plan and roll out team initiatives, and develop the team through clear expectations, direct feedback, and coaching.

**Let's Connect If You Have**

* 7-10 years of experience, including 4+ years managing a team, ideally a Background in EOR/global employment, customer-facing operations, product and engineering.
* Proven record of owning and improving operational metrics (efficiency, CSAT, accuracy, SLA).
* Exceptional analytical ability and a record of learning quickly.
* Experience working with Product teams to resolve customer and employee issues.
* Ability to diagnose root causes and ship durable process, tooling, or automation improvements.
* Strong attention to detail, ownership, and execution, with the ability to bring structure to ambiguity.
* Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in a technical or analytical discipline, ideally Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, or Economics. Human Resources degrees or equivalent experience are also welcome.

**We'd Especially Love To Hear From You If You**

* Considered consulting, engineering, or technology before choosing to build and operate within a high-growth company.
* Are motivated by high ownership, steep learning curves, and outsized impact.

* Flexible Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge.
* Parental Leave – Support for growing families.
* Health and Dental Insurance – Where applicable, to cover you and your loved ones.
* Retirement Savings + Employee Incentive Plan – Plan for the future while sharing our success.

Please visit our career page for more information.
  
  
**Pebl is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
We power global teams and believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and impact. Employment decisions at Pebl are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive culture where every teammate can thrive and do the best work of their career—anywhere in the world.

title: Human Resources Manager (Generalist)
description:
The Role

We are hiring a Generalist HR Manager to own the entire people and office function for a 140-member team across 3 branches, working side by side with the founders. This is a full-time role based at our Bangalore office.

You will run HR and Admin end to end, from payroll, compliance and hiring to performance, engagement and exits. You will also shape how the company feels to work in: healthier, more motivated and more connected.

**Why this is a rare opportunity**

* **A profitable startup.**
  We are growing and running profitably, so you build on a stable base, not on burn-rate anxiety.
* **Founder access.**
  You work directly with the founders and your decisions shape company culture from day one.
* **Full ownership.**
  One person owns the whole HR and Admin charter. You will not be a cog in a large HR department.
* **A growing company.**
  With 140 people and 3 branches today, you will build the processes, policies and culture that carry us to the next stage.

About Us

We build tools and systems that help Indian users save and earn money. Our family of products includes:

* **PaisaWapas:**
  a cashback and rewards platform where users earn cashback on online shopping.
* **ExtraPe:**
  a social deal-sharing platform where users earn by sharing eCommerce and fintech deals with friends and family.
* **Haulpack:**
  a creator monetization platform where creators get paid to drive sales, supported by tools such as Auto DM on Instagram.
* **CardGrid:**
  an AI-powered credit card recommendation and discovery platform.
* **LoanGrid:**
  a loan marketplace where users discover, compare and apply for personal, home and business loans.

Today we are about 140 people across 3 branches, and the business is profitable.

Key Responsibilities

**1. HR operations, payroll and leave**

* Own monthly payroll end to end: attendance and leave inputs, salary processing, payslips, reimbursements and full-and-final settlements.
* Manage leave policy and tracking, and maintain accurate employee records and HRMS data across all branches.
* Handle onboarding, documentation, confirmations and the full employee lifecycle.

**2. Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with employment laws and regulations, including PF, ESI and other statutory requirements, and coordinate with our external consultancy firm that handles the filings.
* Work with the consultancy firm to make sure returns and challans are filed on time, and stay audit-ready.
* Draft and update HR policies, employment contracts and the employee handbook.

**3. Talent acquisition**

* Run end-to-end hiring: workforce planning with the founders, sourcing, screening, interviews, offers and joining.
* Build a strong hiring pipeline through job boards, referrals, campuses and agencies.

**4. Performance, appraisal and exit**

* Set up and run performance management: goals, tracking, periodic reviews and the annual appraisal cycle.
* Manage promotions, increments and role changes with the founders.
* Run exit formalities: resignations, notice period, exit interviews, handover, clearances and final settlement. Share exit insights with leadership.

**5. Employee feedback and workplace health**

* Collect regular feedback through one-on-ones, surveys and skip-level conversations. Turn it into action.
* Act as the first point of contact for employee concerns and resolve grievances fairly and confidentially.
* Build a healthy, respectful and inclusive work environment.

**6. Engagement, culture and growth**

* Plan and run team engagement activities, celebrations and events.
* Drive team bonding and cross-functional engagement across teams and branches.
* Launch new initiatives for employee motivation, learning and growth, fitness and wellness, and personality building.

**7. Office and administration**

* Manage day-to-day office operations across all 3 branches: facilities, seating, housekeeping, pantry, security and maintenance.
* Handle vendors, contracts, purchases, assets, IT and equipment coordination, and office budgets.
* Work closely with the office boys and office coordinators at each branch: guide them, monitor their work, and make sure every branch runs smoothly so teams can focus on their work.

What We Are Looking For

* 5+ years of experience in generalist HR and admin, ideally in a startup or fast-growing company with 100+ employees.
* A graduate or postgraduate degree, preferably an MBA or PGDM in HR.
* Hands-on experience running payroll, including PF, ESI, professional tax and other statutory compliance.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and employment regulations.
* Experience handling hiring, appraisals, performance management and exits end to end.
* Experience managing multi-branch operations and office administration.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the maturity to handle sensitive matters with confidentiality.
* A proactive, ownership-driven mindset. You are comfortable working with founders, and with both strategy and execution.
* Comfort with HRMS and payroll tools, and good command of Excel or Google Sheets.
* Passion for building culture, engagement and employee wellbeing.

What You Get

* **Founder-level exposure.**
  You work directly with the founders on people strategy, not behind layers of management.
* **Real ownership.**
  You build and own the HR and Admin function for the whole company.
* **A stable, profitable company.**
  You grow with a business that is already earning.
* **Room to grow.**
  As we scale, your role can grow with the company.
* **Compensation**
  that matches your experience and impact. Open to discussion.

**Role details:**
Generalist HR Manager · Full time · Bangalore (on-site) · Reports to the founders

**How to apply:**
Send your resume to shankar@paisawapas.com with a short note on why this role excites you.

title: Lead HR Compliance and Governance
description:
Phonepe is the leader in the UPI based payments in India with a market share of more than 47%. Our goal is to make payments so easy, safe and universally accepted that people never feel the need to carry cash or cards again. We believe India is at the cusp of a new mobile revolution, which will change the way we manage our money on the go. We see ourselves facilitating this change, through technology and dogged customer centricity. PhonePe went live in 2016 and till date has got over 600 mn registered users and 38 mn merchants. PhonePe has forayed into diverse areas with its offerings in almost all fintech segments including insurance, lending, mutual funds and stock broking. In 2024, PhonePe also launched Indus AppStore - its own native Android-based mobile app store built for Indian consumers providing app discovery and content in 12 Indian languages.
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Overview:
  
  
We are seeking a Lead - HR Compliance & Governance to manage our statutory compliance, regulatory reporting, and internal audit processes across an employee base of over 45,000 headcount. This role will oversee end-to-end compliance operations across our group entities, ensuring accurate filings and proactive risk management. You will work closely with internal and external stakeholders to maintain operational discipline and ensure the organization remains compliant with all labour laws and regulations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategic Compliance & Governance
  
  

* Oversee comprehensive statutory compliance across all group entities, ensuring timely registration, accurate remittances, and mandatory filings (PF, ESI, PT, LWF, S&E, etc.).
* Ensure complete adherence to government schemes and statutory benefits (e.g., PMVBRY).
* Monitor the evolving regulatory landscape to proactively mitigate risks; develop, implement, and maintain robust internal controls.
* Ensure a complete, reconciled record of statutory registrations for all locations/ offices, maintaining relevant updates or controls in the HRMS.
* Ensure all HR operations, record-keeping, and data handling processes rigorously adhere to data privacy laws and internal security standards.

Audit Readiness & Regulatory Relations
  
  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for internal, statutory, and external audits, including third-party payroll partner audits, coordinating seamless data sharing across cross-functional teams (e.g., Finance, Legal, Payroll, TA, BGV).
* Support internal investigations related to compliance breaches or policy violations, providing documentation and subject matter expertise as required.
* Cultivate and manage collaborative relationships with key stakeholders, including Finance, Legal, Auditors, and Payroll partners, to ensure proactive issue resolution and alignment.
* Act as the primary liaison with local Labour Authorities and government bodies, proactively managing inspections, audits, and regulatory inquiries.
* Conduct periodic audits of HR policies, third-party payroll partners, and internal processes to identify gaps and drive corrective actions.

Employee Relations & Compliance Support
  
  

* Provide direct support to employees on compliance-related requirements, including PF, ESI, and other statutory benefits.
* Manage and resolve employee grievances and handle legal notices related to HR matters in coordination with Legal.
* Ensure the timely finalization and publishing of state-wise holiday calendars, manage necessary changes, and monitor compliance regarding holiday working.

Operational Excellence & Leadership
  
  

* Provide strategic direction to the compliance team, fostering a culture of functional excellence and continuous improvement.
* Act as a key subject matter expert, partnering with Business HR and key stakeholders to resolve complex, business-aligned compliance challenges.
* Manage the vendor ecosystem by defining clear SLAs, KPIs, and performance standards to optimize costs and service quality.
* Develop high-impact MIS dashboards for leadership, providing actionable insights into risk trends, audit status, and key performance metrics.
* Define and enforce standardized SOPs and compliance checklists to guarantee operational discipline across HR functions.
* Lead the adoption of advanced compliance management systems to streamline data capture, tracking, and reporting efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* 6-8 years of progressive experience in HR compliance and statutory management, preferably within large, multi-state organizations.
* Master’s degree in Human Resources, Labour Law, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Proven track record of managing end-to-end Labour Law or Payroll Compliances across multiple entities.
* In-depth expertise in statutory labour laws, statutory filings, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Demonstrated experience interfacing and liaising with labour authorities to successfully navigate inspections and regulatory reviews.
* Extensive experience managing internal and external audits across HR Operations, Payroll, and HR Compliance functions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify systemic compliance risks and execute effective corrective actions.
* Exceptional negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and handle sensitive legal or regulatory situations with discretion.
* Detail-oriented with strong organization, prioritization, and project management skills to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* High proficiency in MS Excel. Experience with HR compliance tools and management systems is a plus.

**Additional Information**
**PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)**

* Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance
* Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System
* Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program
* Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy
* Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment
* Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

title: Digitalization Consultant
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.
  
  
We provide our Hire-to-Retire services along the complete lifecycle of an employee from onboarding to pension services and leverage our powerful ecosystem of leading external and internal partners and our network of key delivery centers. We believe in the value of industry best-practice standards achieved through evolving technology and digitalization. We focus on employee experience as a key driver of our actions. In doing so, we deliver flexibility, quality and efficiency for the businesses we partner with.
  
  
**Position Overview**
As Team Lead / Manager, you will own a portfolio of digital enablement initiatives within the H2R space and lead a team of Digital Process Enablement Associates and Consultants. You will be the connective tissue between HR business teams and technology — translating pain points into scalable, AI-powered solutions, and mentoring your team to do the same.
  
  
**You’ll Make a Difference By**
**Team Leadership & Delivery Management**

* Lead a team of DPE Associates / Consultants; manage workload, priorities, quality of output and career development.
* Set delivery cadence, review technical designs, and hold the team to a high standard of solutioning and execution.
* Coach team members on AI tooling, process thinking, solution design and stakeholder handling.
* Own the pipeline of transformation initiatives within your portfolio — sequencing, resourcing and prioritisation.

**Problem Discovery & Solution Design**

* Drive end-to-end diagnostic reviews across H2R sub-processes — recruitment, onboarding, core HR, payroll, time & attendance, benefits, performance, learning, offboarding.
* Identify bottlenecks, manual touchpoints, compliance gaps and redundancy through data analysis, process mining, stakeholder interviews and design thinking.
* Architect solutions ranging from workflow automations to AI-powered agents — leveraging GenAI, LLMs, RPA, intelligent chatbots, NLP and predictive analytics.
* Produce solution blueprints, process flows, functional specs and user stories that are precise enough to build from.
* Benchmark against Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, ADP and emerging AI-native HR tools.

**Hands-on Build & Technical Ownership**

* Prototype solutions yourself in AI tools, low-code platforms and automation stacks — you do not delegate every build.
* Evaluate emerging AI platforms, run proofs-of-concept, and make build-vs-buy calls with clear rationale.
* Own solution architecture, integration design and non-functional considerations (security, data, scale, cost).
* Partner with IT / engineering on integration patterns, data models and deployment.

**Project Ownership & Stakeholder Management**

* Drive projects from ideation through go-live and value realisation; own timelines, risks and change management.
* Collaborate across HR COEs, payroll, compliance, IT and external vendors to land outcomes.
* Report progress, KPIs, adoption metrics and value delivered to senior leadership on a regular cadence.

**Storytelling & Communication**

* Craft executive-quality decks and narratives that communicate transformation vision, progress and impact.
* Facilitate design thinking workshops and working sessions with business stakeholders.
* Create thought leadership content and internal case studies to drive AI adoption across the function.

**Your Success Is Grounded In**

* Experience: 7–12 years overall experience in digital transformation or project consulting with an automation focus. MBA in any stream
* Team leadership: Prior experience leading a small team or a workstream, with demonstrated ability to coach and grow talent.
* Domain: Solid working knowledge of the Digital initiatives and problem solving
* Technical edge: Hands-on exposure to AI/ML, GenAI tools, LLM-based solutions, RPA or intelligent workflows. You have built or shipped something, not only reviewed it.
* Delivery: Proven track record of owning a project end-to-end and shipping outcomes, not just recommendations.
* Communication: Strong executive presentation and storytelling skills.
* Good-to-haves: Certifications in AI/ML, Digital Transformation, Lean Six Sigma, Design Thinking, Agile/Scrum or HR Technology.
* Experience with prompt engineering, agentic AI patterns, or LLM evaluation.
* Exposure to change management and adoption playbooks at scale.

**Join us and be yourself!**
We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
  
  
This role is based in
**Bangalore.**

All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow. #STS

title: Total Rewards Analyst
description:
**About PayJoy**

  
  

PayJoy, a Public Benefit Corporation, is a mission-first credit provider dedicated to helping under-served customers in emerging markets to achieve financial stability and success.  Our patented technology for secured credit provides an on-ramp for new customers to enter the credit system.  Through PayJoy’s point-of-sale financing and card offerings, customers gain access to a modern quality of life.  PayJoy’s credit also allows our customers to seize opportunities as micro-entrepreneurs, and acts as insurance for tough times. Through our cutting-edge machine learning, data science, and anti-fraud AI, we have served over 18 million customers as of 2025 while achieving solid profitability for sustainable growth.

  
  

**This role**

The Compensation & Total Rewards Analyst is a hands-on analytical role at the center of how PayJoy pays, recognizes, and rewards its people. You will own the data and analysis behind our base pay, bonus, and equity programs; help maintain and evolve our global job architecture; support benefits and global mobility across the countries where we operate; and make sure our practices stay competitive, equitable, and compliant. You will partner closely with People Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Legal, and you will translate market data into clear recommendations that the team can act on.

  
  

**Key responsibilities**
  

  
* Support the end-to-end annual compensation review (merit, promotion, and bonus), including budget modeling, manager guidelines, system configuration, data audits, and final payout reconciliation.
  
* Conduct job evaluations and market pricing for new and existing roles; recommend salary ranges, grade placement, and offer levels for Talent Acquisition and hiring managers.
  
* Assist with administration and maintenance of salary structures across countries and currencies; propose annual range movements based on market data and local inflation trends.
  
* Model the cost and impact of compensation proposals (offers, retention adjustments, geographic differentials, new-market entry) and present clear options to leadership.
  
* Support the design and administration of variable pay plans, including sales incentive plans and corporate bonus programs; validate plan calculations and payouts.
  
* Help maintain PayJoy's global job architecture: job families, sub-families, career levels, and leveling criteria for individual contributor and management tracks.
  
* Partner with People Business Partners and leaders to slot new and changed roles into the framework, ensuring consistency of titles, levels, and pay grades across countries.
  
* Keep job codes, job profiles, and level mappings accurate in the HRIS; run periodic audits and drive cleanup of legacy or non-conforming titles.
  
* Maintain documentation and manager-facing guides so that leveling and promotion decisions are transparent and defensible.
  
  

  
  

**Qualifications**
  

  
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  
* +3 years proven experience in HR analytics and compensation design.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Location: Bangalore, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

**Primary Purpose of the Role**

The Talent Acquisition Partner will sit in the Bangalore/Delhi/Noida/Gurgaon of the India Talent Acquisition Centre of Excellence (CoE) and will ensure that the countries managed by the Hub have the right people, in the right place, at the right time to execute their strategy. The Talent Acquisition team will work together to provide the business with the highest quality talent, within the right timescales and at the right cost. The Talent Acquisition Partner will hold full accountabilities for all stages of the hiring process, from attraction to onboarding whilst ensuring the candidates have a quality experience throughout every step.

**Principal Relationships:**

* Talent Acquisition Manager/ Lead
* Head of Talent Acquisition India
* Management teams across Thales ECC/DIS
* Global Sourcing Team
* Other HR Function

**Key Responsibilities and Tasks:**

### **Recruiting and Sourcing**

* Implement and deliver the resourcing strategy within the assigned perimeter
* Responsible for the full recruitment lifecycle for all personally assigned requisitions from requirements definition, sourcing, selection through to on boarding and for the first 3 months of employees’ tenure
* Support hiring managers in defining their needs and specifying requirements
* As a partner, coach, challenge and advise Hiring Managers using recruitment and market data to inform and influence local and key hiring decisions
* Manage all channels to the active candidate market including employee referral, e-sourcing, on and off line advertising, events and agencies
* Accountable for proactively building talent pools and pipeline for future recruitment needs identifying new channels and bringing innovative ideas

### **Change Management & Continuous Improvement**

* Champion compliance with Group policies and procedures throughout the resourcing lifecycle, including ensuring comprehensive and accurate information is maintained in key systems (e.g. Workday) to consistent standards across the team
* Collaborate with the other Talent Acquisition Partners of the Indian Talent Acquisition Centre of Excellence as required and share best practices and innovative solutions which could benefit to all.
* Work in a collaborative manner with the various Talent Acquisition Centers of Excellence in the Group and the Global Talent Acquisition Team to build a cohesive approach to managing talent across the Group

### **Employer Branding**

* Ensure all marketing channels used meet Group Global Talent Branding guidelines
* Represent the Group at industry events in line with the company strategy
* Participate actively to HR Communication actions: Career Fairs, internal or external events, campaign, etc.

**Competencies required for role**

* Proven talent acquisition experience within a complex environment
* Experience in the engineering and Technology skills market
* Experience of identifying both passive and active candidates across a variety of attraction channels
* Lead, model, manage and coach the organization in best practice selection techniques
* Able to positively influence at all levels of an organization up to senior levels, and to develop valued relationships with managers and Candidates alike

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Global Recruitment Operations Manager
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**About the team**

People Solutions Excellence exists to drive executional excellence in HR operations, services and transactions. We help improve how People Solutions operates by making processes simpler, services better, decisions more data-driven, and change more successful.

We're a global team of experts in process improvement, people experience, service excellence, data and analytics, reporting, and project delivery. Working closely with our HR Centres of Excellence and People Solutions teams, we solve problems, streamline ways of working, and drive continuous improvement.

Our role is to create consistent, scalable solutions that work globally while allowing for local needs where required. We bridge the gap between business requirements and operational delivery; helping People Solutions deliver better experiences, stronger outcomes, and lasting adoption of change.

**About the role**

The **Global Recruitment Operations Manager** will play a pivotal role in leading and continuously improving Haleon’s global recruitment operations capability. You will manage the operating rhythm, standards, governance and controls that enable reliable, efficient and candidate-focused delivery across the end-to-end hiring lifecycle.

Partnering closely with Talent Acquisition, Global Process Owners, Digital & Technology, Quality & Effectiveness and PS regional teams, you will translate strategy and business need into clear operational plans, scalable ways of working and measurable service outcomes.

Success will be measured through service performance, process compliance, candidate and hiring leader experience, team capability and the sustainable value delivered through simplification, standardisation, automation and continuous improvement.

This position demands a strategic approach to streamline processes, enhance efficiency, and ensure seamless co-ordination between various operational functions. You will possess strong operational skills to effectively manage a dispersed team, drive performance, and ensure global operations activity is appropriate, timely and focused on user experience.

Key responsibilities:

* Lead, develop and engage a high-performing TA coordination team with clear priorities, accountabilities and service standards – ensuring the team is set up to effectively support Talent Acquisition colleagues and hiring managers across the globe and in different time zones.

* Own the global operations plan, capacity and day-to-day delivery across requisition administration, interview scheduling, checks, offers, pre-boarding and candidate queries.

* Resolve complex issues and escalations quickly, addressing root causes and strengthening service resilience.

* In partnership with the Global Head of People Solutions Excellence, Global Head of TA and Global Process Owners, set and embed global processes, controls, service measures and governance, with localisation only where required.

* In partnership with Talent Acquisition and Global Process Owners, clarify roles, simplify and standardise recruitment processes, hand-offs and operational assets to enable joined-up delivery and a consistent experience.

* Use technology, automation and AI to reduce effort, improve quality and expand self-service.

* Responsible for the operational implementation and adoption of recruitment process, system and service changes.

In partnership with Talent Acquisition, Quality & Effectiveness and Data & Insights teams, use operational dashboards, routine reviews, data and customer insight to provide senior stakeholders with clear reporting on performance, priorities, risks and measure impacts.  



**About you**

Technical and functional expertise:

* Significant experience leading recruitment operations, talent acquisition coordination, HR shared services or a comparable global service function.

* Proven success leading global or multi-region teams in a complex matrix organisation.

* Strong knowledge of the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle, operational controls and candidate and hiring leader experience.

* A track record of simplifying processes, improving service performance and delivering change at scale.

* Experience using recruitment technology, workflow automation and operational data to improve outcomes. Workday and ServiceNow experience is highly advantageous.

Experience managing risk, compliance, governance and third-party delivery, ideally across multiple markets.  



Leadership and behavioural capabilities:

* Demonstrable people leadership skills, with the ability to create clarity, direction and focus to build a high-performing, engaged and inclusive team.

* Exceptional stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

* Strong communication and influencing capabilities across global and cross-functional environments, ideally with the ability to also speak French, Spanish or Polish.

* Ability to influence without direct authority and align multiple stakeholders around shared outcomes.

A continuous improvement mindset, with curiosity, practical problem-solving skills and a focus on making services simpler and better.  



**Job Posting End Date**

2026-11-23  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

title: Facility Manager - Soft
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Facility Manager
  
Work Dynamics
  
  
**What this job involves:**  
Leading on-site operations
  
Are you a pro at giving on-site support? Working with a team, you’ll oversee the day-to-day client activities for the assigned property or facility. You’ll also implement building procedures and performance measures—and ensure that they are maintained at all times. Likewise, you’ll boost on-site operations by promoting best practices and creating better processes. This job will also entail the question “How do I ensure the safety of my colleagues?” You will do this by promoting adherence to health and safety standards.
  
  
Winning our clients’ trust
  
As the facilities manager, you’ll be working frequently with clients, so you’ll need to build strong relationships with them. Likewise, you’ll need to be proactive and engaging; and make sure that the clients’ expectations are met each and every time. You will also be the go-to person for any facilities-related concerns.
  
  
Keeping an eye on budget and contracts
  
Do you have a solid background in finance management? As the person in charge, you will take care of the site’s financial operations. Also part of your job is to coordinate with vendors and suppliers, and make sure that they deliver quality work practices according to the contract, and at the right cost.
  
  
Promoting teamwork across the board
  
At JLL, we strongly believe that teamwork is the secret behind every successful company. Do you share our thoughts? If so, then you are what we’re looking for. In this role, you will support our people’s growth and development through effective training and coaching sessions. Likewise, you’ll promote a culture that upholds the ‘I am JLL’ core behaviours and fosters teamwork, cooperation and performance excellence. Also part of your job is to ensure that the team is constantly motivated, and that trust and work ethics prevail among members.
  
  
**Sound like you? To apply, you need to be:**  
Competent and goal-driven
  
Do you have three to five years’ experience of managing a property? If so, you will be a perfect fit for the role. Likewise, an experience in managing commercial contracts and budgets may just help you land this job. You’ll also need to be a goal-oriented individual who’s an ace in health and safety requirements, vendor management and property technical systems management
  
  
Organised and analytical
  
We’re looking for a self-motivated and quick-thinking facilities manager who can solve problems using quantitative methods and holistic approaches. Likewise, we’re on the lookout for well-organised leaders who plan tasks in advance and constantly stay ahead of deadlines.
  
Engaging and professional
  
A passion for excellence is what makes a great facilities manager. We’ll need someone who can do more than the bare minimum to meet our clients’ expectations. In this role, you’ll also be working with different kinds of people, so you’ll need to be an expert in handling them professionally. Likewise, you’ll need to effectively manage, train and inspire the team to always do better. You’ll also need to take the time to listen to your people to create better work impact.
  
  
What you can expect from us
  
  
At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
  
Apply today!
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Senior Manager - Content Operations
description:
We are seeking an experienced and inspiring leader to lead our global Private Market Operations organisation, supporting multiple LSEG businesses, primarily within the Data & Analytics division.

This role leads a globally distributed team of more than 130 colleagues responsible for delivering authoritative entity reference data that powers critical customer workflows, supports regulatory use cases, and enables the success of a broad portfolio of LSEG products and services.

As Senior Manager, you will shape strategy, drive operational excellence, champion transformation, and build an high-performing culture. You will play a pivotal role in advancing our Private Markets growth ambitions through scalable operations, innovation, client focus, and strong cross-functional partnership.

**What You'll Do**

**Lead a Global Organisation**

* Provide inspirational leadership to a large global operations team, creating transparency, alignment, and accountability across regions and functions.
* Nurture a culture of speak up where colleagues can grow, chip in, and perform at their best.
* Enable leaders and teams to deliver consistently against operational, strategic, and customer outcomes.

**Deliver Exceptional Customer Outcomes**

* Ensure the timely delivery of high-quality data, products, and services that meet customer expectations and commercial commitments.
* Use customer insights, market trends, and performance data to continuously improve service delivery and customer experience.
* Develop a customer-first approach.

**Shape and Implement Strategy**

* Define and deliver the strategic roadmap for Private Market Operations, aligning priorities with business objectives and growth opportunities.
* Lead initiatives that expand content coverage, enhance service capabilities, improve scalability, and strengthen competitive advantage.
* Translate long-term strategy into clear operational plans and measurable outcomes.

**Drive Transformation and Innovation**

* Lead business transformation through process improvement, automation, artificial intelligence, and technology-enabled change.
* Find opportunities to simplify, transform, and scale operations while improving quality and efficiency.
* Build a culture that accepts innovation, continuous improvement, and learning.

**Deliver Business Performance**

* Lead budgets responsibly and optimise resources to achieve financial, operational, and customer goals.
* Monitor and improve key performance indicators, ensuring sustainable delivery against targets and commitments.
* Balance operational excellence with strategic investment and long-term growth.

**Provide Leadership**

* Offer strategic guidance and subject matter expertise to support sound decision-making across the organisation.
* Anticipate emerging trends, risks, and opportunities within Private Markets and related data ecosystems.
* Enable informed decisions through data-driven insights and business expertise.

**Develop Talent and Capability**

* Attract, develop, and retain diverse talent through coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and capability-building initiatives.
* Create opportunities for career growth and leadership development across the organisation.
* Recognise and celebrate achievements while maintaining high performance standards.

**Build Strong Partnerships**

* Work-closely with Product, Technology, Commercial, Strategy, and Operations leaders to shape future capabilities and deliver customer value.
* Influence business outcomes through effective collaborator engagement and partnership.
* Foster productive relationships that accelerate innovation and execution.

**Represent the Function**

* Act as a trusted leader and advocate for Private Market Operations across senior leadership forums.
* Chip in to broader business, operational, and strategic priorities that support the success of LSEG.

**Why This Role Matters**

Private market data is a critical growth area for LSEG. This role leads a business-critical capability that enables customers to discover, connect, and use trusted entity data across products, services, and regulatory solutions.

You will have the opportunity to influence strategy, shape future operating models, drive transformation at scale, and deliver measurable impact for customers, colleagues, and the business. Your leadership will directly chip in to strengthening LSEG's position as a trusted provider of high-quality data and insights.

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for a strategic and customer-focused leader with deep experience in financial data, content operations, information services, or related environments. You combine operational perfection with strong commercial competence & shown track record to lead large-scale transformation.

**Key Qualifications and Experience**

* Significant leadership experience in large-scale operations, data, content, information services, or related environments.
* Proven understanding of financial markets, entity data, reference data, private markets, or comparable information domains.
* Shown success leading global teams through growth, transformation, organisational change, and business evolution.
* Demonstrated experience delivering against operational, financial, quality, and customer performance objectives.
* Strong background of improving business performance through process excellence, automation, technology adoption, and innovation.
* Experience influencing senior collaborators and driving alignment across Operations, Product, Commercial, Strategy, and Technology functions.
* Exceptional people leader skills with a consistent record to build capability, develop future leaders, and create highly engaged teams.
* Excellent communication, partnership, collaborator management, and executive influence skills.
* Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Ability to navigate complexity, prioritise effectively, and drive execution in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

**Success in This Role**

Successful candidates will:

* Lead with curiosity, kindness, and accountability.
* Create clarity and alignment across complex priorities.
* Inspire teams through change and transformation.
* Build trusted partnerships across the organisation.
* Deliver outstanding customer, operational, and commercial outcomes.
* Shape the future of Private Market Operations through innovation, scalability, and continuous improvement.

This is a unique opportunity to lead a high-impact global function, influence the future of Private Markets at LSEG, and make a lasting difference for our customers, colleagues, and business.

  

**Career Stage:**

Manager

**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of **Integrity, Partnership** , **Excellence** and **Change** underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.

LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

title: Lead - Mainframe Operations
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a Mainframe Operations SME at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.

  

**What you will do**

  

* Manage and support mainframe operations environments, ensuring system availability, stability, and performance for client applications.
* Perform day-to-day system monitoring, data management, and security compliance activities to maintain operational excellence.
* Handle and prioritize a queue of incidents, service requests, and operational assignments to meet client SLAs.
Collaborate with technicians and support teams to troubleshoot issues, resolve tickets, and deliver effective solutions to clients  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.  
  
  
  
**Your Future at Kyndryl**

The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

**Required Skills and Experience**

  

* 10 to 15 years of experience in Mainframe Operations. Monitoring and maintaining production LPARS 24/7, handling all console-related alerts, and performing scheduled outages, IPLs, and clock changes.
* Managing JES spool, diagnosing hardware and software problems, and informing the support team.Handling service restoration teams and root cause analysis of abends.
* Perform root cause analysis, resolution, and/or escalation for production systems (excluding business applications).Automated startup and shutdown of the production operating system.
* Execute production subsystem (e.g., IMS, CICS, DB2, IDMS) started tasks restarts, as per support team specifications during special activity changes and upgrading.
* Should have good understanding of zOS operating system and experience working on HMC / Control-M / Netview / Netcool
Expertise in Job Control Language (JCL) and job abend codes. IBM z/OS, JES2, VTAM, TCP/IP, CICS, DB2, MQ, RACF. Strong knowledge of batch processing tools Control-M & Experience with performance monitoring tools (OMEGAMON, RMF, SMF).  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Familiarity with ITIL processes and mainframe modernization strategies.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills for troubleshooting complex mainframe issues.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and share knowledge effectively. Adaptability and continuous learning to stay updated with mainframe technologies.
Certifications such as IBM Certified zOS system operation.Scripting & automation using Rexx, JCL, CLIST, or Python.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Hiring for Fintech client.**

***Key Responsibilities***

**End-to-End Recruitment**

* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for assigned positions across the financial year, from requisition approval to offer rollout and joining.
* Ensure adherence to agreed TATs, hiring plans, and recruitment budgets.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with functional heads, hiring managers, and HR leadership to understand role requirements, competencies, and hiring priorities.
* Provide regular hiring updates, market insights, and closure forecasts.

**Sourcing & Pipeline Management**

* Source and screen candidates through job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn), internal databases, referrals, and empanelled consultants.
* Allocate requirements to empanelled consultants and drive daily follow-ups to ensure quality and volume of profiles.
* Maintain strong talent pipelines for critical and recurring roles.

**Interview Coordination & Assessment**

* Coordinate interview schedules between candidates and interview panels.
* Collect, document, and track interview feedback using standardized Interview Feedback Forms.
* Ensure timely feedback closure and decision-making.

**Offer Management & Pre-Joining**

* Lead pre-offer discussions and internal coordination regarding offer.
* Coordinate documentation and initiate pre-offer processes.
* Engage with candidates during notice period to minimize dropouts.

**MIS, Reporting & Compliance**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date MIS including:
* Recruitment tracker
* Interview status and feedback reports
* Consultant performance and duplicity checks
* Ensure compliance with internal recruitment policies and data confidentiality norms.

**Candidate Experience**

* Deliver a professional and positive candidate experience across all touchpoints.
* Act as a single point of contact for candidates throughout the hiring process.

***Key Skills & Competencies***

* Strong understanding of recruitment and talent market dynamics.
* Effective stakeholder and vendor management skills.
* High attention to detail and strong follow-up discipline.
* Proficient in recruitment MIS and reporting.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple requisitions in a fast-paced environment.

***Educational Qualification & Experience***

* Any Graduate / Post-Graduate.
* 2–7 years of experience in Talent Acquisition
* Prior experience working with recruitment consultants and job portals is essential.

title: Senior Associate Staffing
description:
**Job Description**
The Supply Partner is responsible for staffing a pod\* of up to 250-300 people throughout their tenure at Publicis Sapient providing them with great experiences throughout their stay in regards to their utilization, their career and growth aspiration preferences, feedbacks and performances. Staffing Partner proactively offers and nominates the individuals from their Pod across books/account/projects to the right opportunity/role.
  
  

* Pod: Group of people in a specific geography and potentially possessing similar skill set.

Staffing partner owns the pod and is responsible to staff them to the right opportunity/role throughout their tenure at Publicis Sapient keeping in mind their individual career aspirations, business requirements and utilization.
  
  
**Your Impact OR Responsibilities:**
**Pod Management**

* Deploys a pod of capacity 250-300 people to the right opportunity/role throughout their tenure at Publicis Sapient keeping in mind the individual career aspirations, business requirements and utilization.
* Provides nominations and guidance for filling open needs- either directly in the system or in collaboration with the respective Capacity Partners.
* Maintains the data accuracy and continuity of context (history of roles, feedbacks, performance, etc.), roll off dates, competencies, primary capabilities, resumes, time-cards, Supervisor Assignment, travel readiness (Visa process with GPM) for the Pod.
* Provides visibility about skills and availability to the business/delivery organization with respect to pod people.
* Holds meaningful discussions/ difficult conversations with pod people with respect to individual career aspirations, business requirements and utilization.
* Reaches out to business/delivery/account leadership directly, if additional clarity on roles/skills is needed.
* Proactively offers and nominates people from the pod to respective Capacity Partners and provides alternatives to improve utilization.
* Ensures billable utilization meets the target set for the assigned
* Pod/individual and geography.
* Actively facilitates the on-boarding of New Hires in their pod
* Provides input on growth and development options in collaboration with the supervisors, People Strategists, Learning Strategists etc. to ensure continuous development of skills of individuals in the Pod
* Supports the supervisors and people strategists in the Performance Management process and the related outcomes (feedback processes, assessment, promotion readiness, PIP etc.)
* Be the point of contact for all individuals in their pod for any concerns and issues regarding utilization, deployment and growth aspirations throughout their association with the pod.
* Cooperates /supports /escalates to People Strategist on all people issues outside of staffing focus such as Leave of absence, accidents, harassment, etc.
* Bench Management - Manages individuals on the bench actively by finding opportunities for internal assignments, growth and development conversations, checking motivational issues and potential attrition issues with stakeholders approving Time Cards for bench time.
* Stakeholder Management - Collaborates with multiple stakeholders across People Strategy, L&D, domain/capability leads, supervisors on feedbacks, people development, performance management, training needs, domain changes, attrition, etc. for people in the Pod.
* Informs and supports the capacity planning issues and resolutions
* People Operations and Quality - Analyze and provide early visibility into roll-offs/supply
* Keep abreast of overall pod strategic and tactical staffing and skill needs by analyzing the ongoing Staffing operation, i.e. utilization, open needs reports etc.
* Manages the existence and correctness of people data in the systems: roll off dates, competencies, primary capabilities, resumes, Time cards etc.
* Proactively work on Travel readiness (India) and support VISA processes in collaboration with GPM
* Keeps the quality check with respect to staffing right people on the right places, based on business, client and individual feedback.
* Company Contribution - Actively participates in, and assists with, company events such as hiring, training and internal initiatives.

**Qualifications**
**Your Skills & Experience**
**:**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in bench management and staffing.
* Preferred MBA in HR
* Strong expertise in excel.
* Good understanding of bench deployment.

**Additional Information**
**Tip from Hiring Manager:**

* This person should be highly organized, adapt quickly to change, and thrive in a fast-paced organization.
* This is a job for the curious, make-things-happen kind of person. Someone who thinks like an entrepreneur and can motivate and move their team to achieve and drive impact.

**Benefits of Working Here:**

* Gender-Neutral Policy
* 18 paid holidays throughout the year.
* Generous parental leave and new parent transition program
* Flexible work arrangements
* Employee Assistance Programs to help you in wellness and well-being.

**Company Description**
Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally-enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

And it has achieved this with one belief, the right people, in the right roles, with the right ownership, can build anything.But here is the truth: growth has outpaced the ability to hire at the speed and quality needed. The company is hiring across every vertical: Retail Broking, Investment Banking, Institutional Equities, AIF, PMS, Wealth Management, Compliance, Technology, and its upcoming AMC. Each role demands a specific kind of person - not just qualified, but entrepreneurial. Not just experienced, but hungry.The company doesn't need an HR recruiter. People don't leave the company. Your job is to ensure the people who join are the reason others stay, not the reason they leave. 8 verticals, each with distinct hiring needs.
