title: HR Operations Partner(tickets, performance, labour laws, workforce transformation)
description:
**Basic Function**
The HR Operations Partner serves as a trusted operational and advisory partner to People Managers, HR Business Partners, HR Operations Specialists and Centers of Excellence, providing practical HR guidance and ensuring consistent and effective delivery of HR services.
  
  
The role combines broad HR generalist capability with a strong understanding of end-to-end employee lifecycle processes. It supports People Managers in navigating HR policies, processes, systems and employee matters, while coordinating across the HR organization to ensure issues are addressed through the appropriate channels.
  
  
As a senior individual contributor, the HR Operations Partner is expected to independently manage complex manager queries and escalations, exercise sound judgement, identify operational and compliance risks, and drive matters through to resolution. The role will also contribute to strengthening manager capability, improving HR processes and supporting the continued evolution of the HR operating model.
  
  
The role requires good knowledge of India employment and statutory requirements and an ability to translate regulatory and policy requirements into practical HR Operations execution.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
**People Manager Partnership & Advisory**

* Act as a trusted HR Operations partner to People Managers, providing practical guidance on HR policies, processes, systems and employee lifecycle matters.
* Own and manage HR cases raised by People Managers, including complex queries and escalations on HR Policies and Process (hire to retire), driving cases through to resolution and engaging HR Business Partners, Employee Relations, Legal or COEs where specialist support is required.
* Strengthen manager capability through proactive guidance, coaching and practical tools that enable managers to navigate HR processes more effectively.
* Guide performance management processes ensuring alignment with organizational goals.

**HR Generalist & HR Business Partner Support**

* Apply broad HR generalist knowledge when supporting managers and HR colleagues across a range of employee and organizational matters.
* Partner closely with HR Business Partners, COEs in the operational execution of key people priorities and annual HR programs, including promotion and year-end cycles, organizational changes, workforce movements/transformation, talent processes and manager communications.
* Work across HR Operations, HR Business Partners, Employee Relations, Payroll, Compensation & Benefits, Talent, Mobility, Legal and other Centers of Excellence to coordinate effective solutions.

**End-to-End Employee Lifecycle**

* Possess a strong working knowledge of end-to-end hire-to-retire processes and the interdependence between HR Operations, HR Business Partners, Centers of Excellence, Payroll and HR systems.
* Coordinate complex employee lifecycle activities that require inputs from multiple HR teams, ensuring clarity of ownership, timely execution and a consistent employee and manager experience.
* Assess the operational impact of HR process or policy changes and support implementation readiness across systems, processes, communications and manager enablement.

**India Compliance & Governance**

* Working knowledge of relevant Indian employment legislation, statutory requirements and HR compliance obligations and understand their implications for HR Operations processes.
* Link relevant employment law and regulatory developments and support translation of changes into HR policies, processes, systems, documentation and manager guidance.
* Identify potential compliance, employee relations, process or governance risks arising through HR Operations activities and escalate them appropriately.

**HR Operations Excellence & Continuous Improvement**

* Use HR dashboards, reporting and available operational data to support data-driven recommendations and measure the effectiveness of improvements.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize or automate HR processes and reduce unnecessary manual activity or local variation.
* Partner with Global Process Owners and HR Operations teams to support consistent global practices, retaining local customization where required for legal or regulatory reasons.

**Other Duties**
Perform other duties and participate in HR programs, projects or initiatives as required, consistent with the nature and level of the role.
  
  
**Job Qualifications**
**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Industrial Relations, Organizational Development or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources, Business or a related area would be advantageous but is not essential.

**Experience:**

* Minimum of ten years of progressive HR experience
* Demonstrated experience within an HR generalist, HR Operations Partner, People Partner or HRBP-support capacity.
* Practical experience across multiple aspects of the end-to-end hire-to-retire employee lifecycle.
* Experience supporting People Managers directly and providing guidance on HR policies, processes and employee matters.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex or escalated HR queries requiring coordination across multiple HR stakeholders.
* Experience partnering with HR Business Partners and working across HR Operations, Centers of Excellence and specialist functions.
* Working knowledge of Indian employment legislation and statutory HR compliance requirements.
* Experience supporting HR process improvement, change implementation or HR operating-model initiatives.
* Experience using HR information systems, preferably Workday, together with case-management, reporting and analytical tools.
* Experience in a regional, multi-country or APAC HR environment would be advantageous.
* Previous experience coordinating projects, coaching colleagues or providing functional guidance would be advantageous.

**Other Knowledge, Skills, Abilities or Certifications:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Detail oriented and highly organized individuals demonstrate a high level of initiative
* Proficiency with HR information systems, preferably Workday and the Microsoft Office Suite
* Ability to analyze information and convert related activities into a comprehensive work plan
* Ability to communicate and make recommendations to all levels and roles within the organization.
* Demonstrated ability to deal with confidential information
* Demonstrated problem solving, time management and priority setting skills
* Strong resolve to manage client issues in a timely manner and collaborate with the team to ensure programs run smoothly with a client experience focus

title: (VF-JA) Learning & Development Manager
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced Talent, Learning & Performance Business Partner to translate business strategy and workforce priorities into integrated capability plans that enable organisational performance, future skills development and transformation outcomes. The role partners with senior business leaders and HR stakeholders to diagnose capability needs, shape talent and learning priorities, and ensure the successful adoption and evaluation of capability interventions across a global and matrix environment.
  
  
Location: India, Egypt or Hungary
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Build trusted partnerships with business leaders and HR partners to understand strategic priorities, transformation plans and workforce implications
* Diagnose current and future talent, performance, leadership, learning and skills requirements using business and people insights
* Develop and own integrated capability plans with clear priorities, outcomes, measures and dependencies
* Translate business demand into strategic briefs and connect stakeholders to the appropriate Centres of Expertise
* Provide evidence-based advice on options, trade-offs, priorities and sequencing of talent and capability initiatives
* Identify, assess and escalate workforce, talent, skills and capability risks
* Drive stakeholder engagement, sponsorship and adoption of agreed interventions
* Evaluate programme adoption, application and business impact, using insights to improve future capability planning
* Use workforce, learning and people data responsibly, ensuring privacy, fairness, transparency and appropriate human oversight
* Lead quarterly capability reviews, supporting decision-making, prioritisation and continuous improvement

**Who You Are**

* Experienced in talent, learning, leadership, performance and skills-related practices within complex organisations
* Skilled in capability consulting and organisational diagnosis, with the ability to identify root causes and define integrated solutions
* Experienced in strategic workforce planning and translating business priorities into workforce and capability plans
* Proficient in learning needs analysis, performance consulting and intervention evaluation
* Strong analytical and data storytelling capabilities, using evidence to influence decisions and demonstrate measurable outcomes
* Effective at building credibility and influencing senior stakeholders across global and matrix environments
* Knowledgeable in responsible AI, privacy, fairness and ethical use of people data
* Demonstrated strengths in strategic thinking, commercial awareness, facilitation, collaboration, change leadership and delivery excellence
* Experience working within transformation-focused and multinational organisations is highly desirable

Location: A-83, Pocket D, Okhla Phase 2, New Delhi (on-site)

Industry: Media & Entertainment · Tech-enabled Marketplace · Startup

Timings: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM · Mon–Sat (last Saturday of every month off)

**About StarClinch**

StarClinch is India's largest artist booking and discovery platform. Since 2015 we've owned the full booking journey - shortlist, availability, negotiation, booking, payment, and escrow - for singers, bands, dancers, photographers, and performers across weddings, corporate, and private events. We're a lean, tech-first team building fast.

**About the Role**

You own hiring end to end, across every function, from engineering and product through sales, marketing, and ops. You're the first and most consistent StarClinch voice a candidate hears, so you can explain what we do, why it's a real market, and what the tech and business actually look like. Small team, so you run the whole cycle yourself.

**What you'll own**

* Full-cycle recruitment across all roles: intake, sourcing, screening, offers, close.
* Source and screen credibly for both tech and sales, holding a real first conversation with an engineer or a sales candidate, not just scheduling one.
* Run Zoho Recruit as the single source of pipeline truth.
* Partner with hiring managers to scope roles and drive feedback SLAs so candidates don't stall.
* Manage offers to close and, critically, to join. No-show is the real risk here, not the accept.
* Hand off cleanly to onboarding (BGV, GreytHR); you own everything up to the close.

**What we're looking for**

* 2+ years of full-cycle
  **in-house**
  recruiting at a startup (agency background fine, but in-house ownership is the bar).
* Proven strength hiring
  **tech, sales and other non-tech roles**
  . Non-negotiable; our pipeline is genuinely mixed.
* Comfortable owning an ATS end to end.
* Strong written and spoken English; you represent StarClinch clearly and warmly to candidates.
* Startup fluency: ambiguity, speed, multiple hats, hiring managers who aren't full-time recruiters.
* Can explain StarClinch's business and tech to a candidate without hand-holding.

**Nice to have**

* GreytHR familiarity (our HRIS/payroll).
* Hiring for marketplace, consumer-tech, or events businesses.
* Campus / intern pipeline experience.

**Benefits**

* 27 days of paid leave a year - generous time off to rest and recharge, well above the statutory minimum.
* Health and accidental insurance coverage - so you and your peace of mind are protected from day one.
* Startup exposure — a young, dynamic team and the kind of fast, ownership-driven environment where you see your work land.
* Learn and own the HR tech stack - get hands-on with modern HRMS, ATS, and AI-driven HR tools, with the freedom to adopt what makes the function smarter.
* Mentoring and coaching from a senior HR leader - direct access to experienced guidance as you take on bigger calls.
* Build from scratch - freedom to experiment and design HR systems, not inherit red tape.
* Real influence - a high-impact role shaping team building and company culture from the front.

**Global Talent Impact Partner**
**About The Role**
In this role, you will join an agile team of highly skilled HR professionals responsible for shaping and advancing Bayer’s enterprise talent strategy. You will work across a broad and evolving portfolio of talent priorities, partnering with leaders, HR colleagues, and key stakeholders to design and deliver scalable solutions that strengthen organizational capability, leadership effectiveness, and business performance. The role offers the opportunity to build a strong global network, deepen an end-to-end enterprise mindset, and create sustainable impact on Bayer’s talent agenda.
  
  
**Your Tasks And Responsibilities**

* Listen to and identify talent and business needs across the organization, translating them into scalable solutions that drive enterprise outcomes.
* Lead global projects, workstreams, and design teams, ensuring successful delivery of strategic talent initiatives from concept through implementation, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a trusted talent expert and consultant across the HR community, providing thought partnership and guidance on talent, leadership, and organizational priorities.
* Build strong partnerships with senior leaders, HR colleagues, and key stakeholders to influence talent decisions, connect perspectives, and align on enterprise priorities.
* Design, pilot, launch, scale, and continuously improve talent management products, processes, and experiences that support Bayer’s talent strategy.

* Use talent insights, data, research, external trends, and stakeholder feedback to develop recommendations, assess impact, and improve talent outcomes.
* Lead change, communication, and adoption efforts to enable sustainable implementation of talent solutions across countries, functions, and stakeholder groups.
* Build Talent Management and broader HR capability by sharing expertise, coaching and supporting colleagues, and contributing to a culture of continuous learning.
* Collaborate across HR and the business to connect talent priorities, manage interdependencies, and deliver integrated solutions that support key business outcomes.
* Apply digital and AI-enabled approaches, where appropriate, to improve the relevance, scalability, and employee experience of talent solutions.
* Balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, adapting focus as enterprise talent priorities evolve.

**Who You Are**
**Required qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

* Proven track record of leading complex projects, programs, or cross-functional teams from concept through implementation and adoption.
* Strong consulting and problem-solving skills, including the ability to analyze complex issues, develop hypotheses, synthesize diverse perspectives, and translate insights into practical recommendations.
* Ability to prioritize based on enterprise value, expected impact, feasibility, and return on investment.
* Ability to work effectively in ambiguity, adapt to evolving priorities, and balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build trust and productive relationships across cultures, functions, and organizational levels.

* Experience managing large-scale, complex, or enterprise-wide initiatives in a global and matrixed organization.
* Experience using talent analytics, digital platforms, or AI-enabled tools to inform or improve talent solutions.

title: HR Business Partner
description:
**Company Description**
  
**Work with Us. Change the World.**
  
At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.
  
  
There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.
  
  
We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.
  
  
**Job Description**
  
Position Overview
  
  
The HR Business Partner (HRBP) will serve as the primary HR partner for a large strategic client account, supporting approximately 400-500 employees across multiple project sites and offices. The role will work closely with project leadership, operational managers, employees, client stakeholders, and HR partners to deliver people solutions that support project delivery, workforce effectiveness, employee engagement, and a positive employee experience.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategic Business Partnership
  

* Partner with Account Leadership, Project Managers, and Functional Leaders to support business objectives through effective people solutions.
* Provide HR guidance on workforce planning, staffing requirements, resource deployment, and talent retention.
* Support leaders in managing team performance, employee development, and organizational effectiveness.
* Act as a trusted advisor on employee-related matters, balancing business priorities with employee experience and engagement.
* Use workforce insights and employee feedback to identify trends and recommend actions that improve performance, retention, and workforce effectiveness.
  

Employee Relations & Workforce Management
  

* Serve as the primary HR point of contact for employee relations matters across project sites and office locations.
* Proactively identify and address workplace concerns, employee issues, and team dynamics before they escalate.
* Conduct and support investigations into employee grievances, disciplinary matters, and workplace conflicts, ensuring timely and appropriate resolution.
* Coach managers on employee relations, performance management, and effective people leadership practices.
* Monitor workforce trends and provide recommendations to improve employee engagement, retention, and workplace culture.
* Support organizational change, workforce transitions, and project-related people impacts.
  

HR Advisory & Employee Support
  

* Serve as the primary HR contact for managers and employees across the account, providing guidance on AECOM policies, practices, programs, systems, and people processes.
* Support managers in the consistent application of performance management, talent, compensation, employee relations, and workforce management practices.
* Advise employees on HR policies, benefits, employee programs, career-related processes, and available support resources.
* Partner with HR Operations and wider HR teams to ensure timely resolution of employee and manager inquiries.
* Promote understanding and adoption of AECOM's people policies, systems, values, and organizational practices across project teams and locations.
* Act as an advocate for both the business and employees while ensuring alignment with company policies and governance requirements.
  

Employee Engagement & Retention
  

* Develop and implement engagement initiatives aligned with the specific needs of the account workforce.
* Partner with managers and leaders to foster a positive, inclusive, and high-performing work environment.
* Analyze employee feedback, survey results, retention data, and workforce insights to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Support wellbeing, recognition, inclusion, and employee experience initiatives across the account.
* Drive engagement activities across multiple sites and locations while ensuring alignment with broader organizational objectives.
* Support initiatives aimed at improving retention, manager effectiveness, employee development, and workforce morale.
  

Project & Client Support
  

* Collaborate with project leadership to support workforce mobilization, onboarding, deployment, and project staffing requirements.
* Provide HR support during project ramp-ups, expansions, organizational changes, and workforce transitions.
* Interface with client representatives, where required, on people-related matters that impact project delivery and workforce effectiveness.
* Support workforce reporting, people analytics, and account-level metrics required by business and project leadership.
* Ensure people considerations are effectively integrated into project planning and delivery activities.
  

HR Operations & Compliance
  

* Ensure consistent implementation of company policies, procedures, and HR programs across all project locations.
* Partner with HR Operations, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Total Rewards, and other HR functions to deliver integrated HR solutions.
* Support recruitment efforts and workforce planning activities in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and business leaders.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws, statutory requirements, client obligations, and company governance standards.
* Support audits, compliance reviews, workforce documentation requirements, and risk management activities.
  

Stakeholder Management
  

* Build strong relationships with account leaders, project managers, site leadership teams, employees, and HR colleagues.
* Establish credibility as a responsive and trusted HR partner across geographically dispersed teams.
* Support communication, change management, and employee engagement initiatives across the account.
* Collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders to support strategic workforce outcomes.
  

Qualifications
  

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 10-15 years of progressive HR experience, preferably within engineering, infrastructure, consulting, construction, manufacturing, or other project-based environments.
* Proven experience as an HR Business Partner supporting large, distributed, multi-site workforces.
* Strong experience in employee relations, conflict resolution, and stakeholder management.
* Experience supporting client-facing operations, strategic accounts, or project-based businesses is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to influence leaders and build strong partnerships across multiple organizational levels.
  

Additional Information
  

* Strong knowledge of Indian labor laws, employment practices, and HR governance requirements.
* Experience managing complex employee relations matters, investigations, and workplace conflict resolution.
* Strong communication, facilitation, coaching, stakeholder management, and analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, project-driven environment.
* Experience supporting geographically dispersed and multi-location workforces is highly desirable.
* Willingness and ability to travel frequently to project sites, client locations, and regional offices to support employees, leaders, and business priorities.
  

**Qualifications**
  
**Additional Information**
  
At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously.

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. * Partner with senior stakeholders to identify capability priorities that support business strategy, performance and future workforce needs

What you’ll do
  
  
As a Business Capability Manager, you’ll help the business build the capabilities needed to deliver current priorities and future ambitions. Working closely with business leaders, you’ll identify capability gaps, develop targeted plans and recommend the interventions most likely to improve performance and business outcomes. You’ll drive adoption and application of capability solutions, making sure colleagues can build skills and apply learning effectively in their day-to-day roles and maximise business impact and value.

* Prioritising capability activity based on business value, strategic importance and risk considerations
* Managing and optimising capability portfolios, making sure investment is focused on the areas of greatest impact

* Driving the adoption and application of capability solutions through learning, coaching, practice, communities and workplace support
* Representing business capability priorities across the wider Learning & Development community and enterprise network

The skills you'll need
  
  
To thrive in this role, you’ll bring experience partnering with senior stakeholders to identify capability needs, influence decisions and drive meaningful outcomes. You’ll have a strong understanding of capability planning, learning methodologies and behaviour change principles, paired with experience diagnosing performance challenges and recommending solutions that extend beyond formal learning where appropriate.
  
  
**We’ll Also Expect You To Have**

* Experience using data, insight and business measures to evaluate impact and inform decision-making
* Experience managing complex capability portfolios, programmes and competing priorities
* A strong understanding of learning technologies, AI-enabled tools and approaches that improve capability application and performance

title: Manager - Student Recruitment & Outreach
description:
**Company Description**
ECA Global is a leading private higher education group founded in Australia, with multiple higher education brands across Sydney, Brisbane, Melbourne, Perth, and Parramatta. The group has expanded internationally with new campuses in the UK and operational hubs in Europe, China, the Philippines, Brazil, Nepal, and India. Each year, ECA Global welcomes around 15,000 students from diverse backgrounds into its global network of campuses. The organization focuses on delivering high-quality education, international pathways, and student-centric support services. ECA Global offers a multicultural work environment and opportunities to engage with learners and partners worldwide.

Position Summary: The Manager – Student Recruitment will lead and execute student recruitment strategies to achieve enrolment targets, expand market presence, strengthen institutional partnerships, and improve student conversion rates. The role is responsible for driving recruitment operations, developing effective outreach initiatives, managing recruitment channels, and building strong relationships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, and other institutional partners.

The successful candidate will combine strategic planning, commercial acumen, market intelligence, operational excellence, and people leadership to deliver sustainable student recruitment growth. The role will also work closely with academic teams, Admissions, Student Services, and other internal stakeholders to ensure a seamless prospective student journey from initial enquiry through enrolment and onboarding.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Recruitment Strategy, Market Development & Partnerships**

* Develop and implement comprehensive student recruitment strategies aligned with institutional enrolment targets and business growth objectives.
* Identify priority markets, student segments, recruitment channels, and opportunities for market expansion.
* Build and maintain strategic partnerships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, academic institutions, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Develop articulation agreements, feeder relationships, and student progression pathways to strengthen recruitment pipelines and improve conversion.
* Collaborate with academic teams to align recruitment campaigns, messaging, and market positioning with programme offerings and institutional priorities.
* Lead relationship development and stakeholder engagement across key domestic and international markets.
* Leverage market research, CRM insights, competitor analysis, and enrolment trends to inform recruitment strategies and identify new growth opportunities.
* Represent the institution at recruitment fairs, school visits, industry events, partner meetings, presentations, and other outreach activities.
* Identify and develop innovative recruitment channels, partnership models, and market penetration initiatives.
* Monitor the effectiveness of recruitment partnerships and implement strategies to improve partner engagement and performance.

**2. Recruitment Operations, Student Conversion & Performance Management**

* Manage the end-to-end student recruitment pipeline, from enquiry generation and application follow-up through offer acceptance, enrolment, and onboarding.
* Drive timely, accurate, and high-quality communication with prospective students, applicants, and recruitment partners.
* Monitor recruitment funnel performance and implement initiatives to improve enquiry-to-application, application-to-offer, and offer-to-enrolment conversion rates.
* Plan, coordinate, and oversee recruitment campaigns, marketing communications, outreach activities, open days, education fairs, and student engagement events.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), recruitment targets, pipeline metrics, and channel performance.
* Analyse recruitment data, identify conversion bottlenecks, and recommend corrective actions to improve enrolment outcomes.
* Prepare regular performance reports, market insights, pipeline updates, and strategic recommendations for senior management.
* Manage education agent performance, evaluate channel effectiveness, and implement appropriate performance improvement measures.
* Work closely with Admissions, Student Services, Marketing, and academic teams to ensure efficient application processing and a seamless student experience.
* Establish and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), process documentation, reporting frameworks, and quality assurance practices.
* Coordinate recruitment calendars, campaign timelines, event logistics, and competing operational priorities to ensure timely execution.
* Ensure recruitment activities deliver against agreed enrolment targets, service standards, and institutional growth objectives.

**3. Leadership, Team Management & Capability Development**

* Lead, motivate, and manage recruitment and outreach teams, where applicable, to achieve individual and collective performance targets.
* Set clear objectives, allocate responsibilities, monitor performance, and provide regular coaching and feedback.
* Build a high-performing, accountable, student-focused, and commercially driven recruitment culture.
* Develop team capabilities through training, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and continuous professional development.
* Foster collaboration across recruitment, marketing, admissions, academic, and student support functions.
* Introduce innovative recruitment approaches, student engagement initiatives, and outreach models to enhance productivity and market penetration.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen recruitment processes.
* Oversee recruitment-related budgets, campaign expenditure, event planning, and resource allocation, as applicable.
* Promote data-driven decision-making, continuous improvement, and accountability for recruitment outcomes.
* Support succession planning, capability development, and the effective use of team resources to meet evolving business needs.

**4. Compliance, Governance & Stakeholder Management**

* Ensure recruitment practices comply with institutional policies, applicable regulatory requirements, and relevant quality assurance standards.
* Uphold equal opportunity, workplace health and safety (OSH), data privacy, and information security requirements.
* Ensure appropriate handling of prospective student and applicant information in accordance with applicable data protection requirements, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA), where applicable.
* Maintain accurate recruitment records, partner documentation, performance reports, and operational records.
* Promote ethical recruitment practices, transparent communication, and a positive student experience throughout the recruitment journey.
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal teams, external partners, and senior stakeholders.
* Escalate recruitment risks, operational challenges, compliance concerns, and performance gaps in a timely manner.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be assessed against agreed institutional and departmental objectives, including:

* Achievement of student enrolment targets by programme, market, and recruitment channel.
* Improvement in enquiry-to-application and application-to-enrolment conversion rates.
* Growth in qualified student enquiries and recruitment pipeline volume.
* Effectiveness and productivity of education agents and institutional partnerships.
* Delivery and performance of recruitment campaigns, outreach activities, and events.
* Timeliness and quality of applicant communication and follow-up.
* Accuracy of recruitment data, reporting, and pipeline forecasting.
* Compliance with institutional policies, recruitment processes, and applicable regulations.
* Team productivity, target achievement, and professional development.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Education, International Relations, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification or relevant professional certification will be an advantage.
* Significant experience in student recruitment, education management, business development, institutional partnerships, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience in developing and executing recruitment strategies and achieving measurable enrolment or business growth targets.
* Proven experience managing recruitment pipelines, conversion processes, performance metrics, and stakeholder relationships.
* Experience developing and managing relationships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, or institutional partners.
* Previous experience leading or supervising teams, setting performance targets, and driving accountability will be highly desirable.
* Experience in higher education, international education, or a multi-campus education environment will be an advantage.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* **Strategic thinking:**
  Ability to translate institutional growth objectives into practical recruitment strategies and actionable plans.
* **Business development:**
  Strong partnership-building, networking, negotiation, and market expansion capabilities.
* **Performance management:**
  Ability to establish KPIs, analyse recruitment data, identify trends, and drive measurable improvements.
* **Communication and presentation:**
  Excellent written and verbal communication, public speaking, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* **Leadership:**
  Ability to motivate teams, manage performance, develop talent, and foster a results-oriented culture.
* **Operational management:**
  Strong planning, organisational, prioritisation, budgeting, and execution capabilities.
* **Analytical ability:**
  Proficiency in interpreting market intelligence, CRM data, conversion metrics, and performance reports.
* **Relationship management:**
  Ability to establish and maintain productive relationships with diverse internal and external stakeholders.

title: Group Manager - Physical Security Operations
description:
**Site Security Lead**

Physical Security Operations

**Function**

Corporate / Physical Security

**Location**

Assigned HCLTech site

**Reporting to**

Regional Chief Security Officer (RCSO) / designated Corporate Security leader

**Role type**

Site-based security operations leadership

**Key interfaces**

GWS/Admin, HR, EHS/Fire & Safety, IT, Facilities, Transport, business teams, clients and security service partners

1. Role Purpose

The Site Security Lead is accountable for the end-to-end management of physical security at the assigned site. The role safeguards people, assets, information, facilities and business operations by translating corporate security policy into disciplined site execution, maintaining emergency readiness, overseeing security service partners, and providing timely risk and incident reporting to leadership.

2. Key Accountabilities

**Security governance and site control**

* Implement Corporate Security policies, SOPs, post orders and site security instructions; maintain site-specific documentation and ensure consistent compliance across all posts and shifts.
* Own the daily security operating rhythm, including shift briefings, deployment checks, site rounds, open-observation closure and escalation of unresolved risks.
* Provide accurate and timely operational reports, dashboards and exception updates to the RCSO/designated security leader.

**People, access and movement control**

* Control and monitor the movement of employees, clients, visitors, contractors, vendors and vehicles through approved access-control and verification processes.
* Ensure only authorised persons, vehicles and materials enter or leave the premises after prescribed checks, approvals and documentation.
* Oversee visitor management, access cards, keys, restricted-area permissions, parking, traffic flow and transport-security coordination.

**Asset and material protection**

* Protect company property and assets through effective gate controls, material-movement governance, asset/scrap checks, loss-prevention measures and exception escalation.
* Maintain secure custody, issue, return and reconciliation controls for keys, access credentials and other security-controlled inventory.
* Support fact-based investigation of loss, theft, unauthorised access, policy violations and other physical security incidents; preserve records and evidence as required.

**Incident and emergency management**

* Act as the site security focal point for security breaches, medical emergencies, fire alarms, bomb threats, intrusion alarms, workplace violence and other emergencies.
* Activate response and escalation protocols, coordinate with internal stakeholders and emergency services, and ensure clear incident communication and documentation.
* Plan and conduct drills, tabletop exercises and post-incident reviews; track corrective and preventive actions to closure.

**Security systems and control-room oversight**

* Ensure effective operation and monitoring of CCTV, Electronic Access Control Systems (EACS), alarms, visitor-management systems and other deployed security technologies.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance and fault escalation; maintain downtime, service-call and restoration records.
* Use system and operational data to identify vulnerabilities, trends and opportunities for control improvement.

**Security partner and workforce management**

* Lead the on-site security service partner and deployed personnel, ensuring approved manning, post coverage, discipline, turnout, conduct and service quality.
* Verify attendance and supporting records, review deployment gaps, conduct performance and compliance reviews, and escalate repeated non-conformance.
* Validate monthly invoices and supporting documentation in line with approved process, attendance records and service delivery evidence.

**Training, capability and awareness**

* Ensure all new security personnel complete document verification, induction, post briefing and competency checks before deployment.
* Deliver or coordinate training on security procedures, emergency response, fire safety, access control, visitor/material management, systems operation and customer service.
* Maintain training plans, attendance, assessment and drill records.

**Audit, compliance and continuous improvement**

* Maintain registers, records and evidence in audit-ready condition; support internal, client, statutory and certification audits.
* Monitor relevant statutory and contractual compliance of the security service partner and promptly report deviations.
* Conduct risk assessments, security reviews and trend analysis; recommend practical control improvements and track approved actions.

3. Decision Rights and Escalation

* Initiate immediate protective actions within approved emergency and security protocols to safeguard life, assets and business continuity.
* Stop or restrict access, material movement or unsafe activity where required controls or approvals are absent, while promptly informing authorised stakeholders.
* Escalate security breaches, significant control failures, system outages, staffing shortfalls, repeated service-partner non-compliance and incidents with legal, client or reputational impact.
* Recommend corrective actions, process improvements, training interventions and service-partner remedies; obtain approval where expenditure or policy change is involved.

4. Key Deliverables / Success Measures

**Outcome area**

**Expected evidence of effective performance**

**Operational readiness**

Required posts staffed; shift handovers and site rounds completed; open observations tracked and closed.

**Access and material control**

Authorised movement supported by complete records, approvals and reconciliations.

**Incident management**

Prompt response, escalation, reporting, evidence preservation and corrective-action closure.

**System availability**

Security-system health monitored; faults logged, escalated and restored with documented follow-up.

**Vendor governance**

Attendance, deployment, training, statutory records and invoices validated with supporting evidence.

**Audit readiness**

Mandatory registers, records, drill evidence and compliance documents current and retrievable.

**Risk reduction**

Recurring vulnerabilities identified through review and addressed through approved preventive actions.

**Stakeholder service**

Clear communication, professional conduct and dependable support to employees, clients and site functions.

5. Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent recognised qualification.
* Typically 8-10 years of progressive experience in physical security operations, including at least 3 years leading security at a comparable large corporate, technology, IT/ITES or multi-tenant site.
* Demonstrated experience managing guarding operations, access control, CCTV/EACS, incident response, emergency preparedness, investigations, audits and security-vendor performance.
* Working knowledge of security documentation, statutory compliance, service-level monitoring, invoice/attendance validation and data-based reporting.
* Proficiency in standard office productivity tools and the ability to prepare clear reports, presentations, trackers and incident summaries.
* Good written and spoken English; local-language capability is desirable for effective site coordination.
* Relevant professional certification in security, safety, fire, risk or business continuity is desirable.

6. Core Competencies

**Operational leadership**

Plans, prioritises and maintains disciplined execution across shifts and posts.

**Risk judgement**

Recognises threats, assesses impact and selects proportionate controls within authority.

**Incident command**

Remains structured during emergencies and coordinates response, communication and recovery.

**Integrity and confidentiality**

Handles sensitive information, investigations and access privileges responsibly.

**Vendor management**

Sets clear expectations, validates evidence and addresses non-performance fairly and promptly.

**Stakeholder management**

Works effectively with business, support functions, clients, authorities and service partners.

**Communication**

Provides concise instructions, accurate reports and timely escalation.

**Digital orientation**

Uses security systems and operational data to improve visibility, control and decision-making.

**Customer service**

Balances strong security controls with professional and respectful user experience.

**Continuous improvement**

Uses audits, incidents, observations and trends to strengthen preventive controls.

7. Working Requirements

* Site-based role with willingness to work flexible hours and remain available for critical incidents, emergencies, audits and business requirements.
* Ability to conduct regular site rounds, inspect security posts and operate effectively in indoor and outdoor operational areas.
* Ability to meet role-related fitness, background-verification and statutory requirements prescribed by applicable law and company policy.
* Frequent interaction with employees, contractors, visitors, clients, service partners and local authorities, as authorised.

8. Role Governance

The Site Security Lead is the overall on-site owner for physical security operations and is expected to act within HCLTech policies, approved SOPs, delegated authority and applicable law. The role may be assigned additional related responsibilities based on site risk, business needs or leadership direction. This job description describes the primary accountabilities and is not an exhaustive list of all duties.

title: Art Gallery Manager

The Gallery of Gnani Arts is a fine art company with a presence in both Singapore and Bengaluru, India. title: General Manager Operations
description:
**Job Title: General Manager – Operations**

**JOB OVERVIEW**

The General Manager – Operations will lead and scale end-to-end business operations for a 'work as a service' organisation. This role typically involves execution of multiple large projects that could be field-based or remote execution across grey-collar domains. The ideal candidate brings strong execution rigour, delivery of results, the ability to build scalable operational systems, and proven experience managing large, distributed teams in a high-growth environment.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Operational Strategy & Execution: Define and execute operational strategies to drive efficiency, scalability, service quality, and cost optimisation across business operations. Translate business objectives into structured operating plans with clear ownership, governance, and measurable outcomes.
* Leadership & Team Management: Lead, mentor, and scale multi-layered operations teams including central operations, field leadership, and partner/vendor networks. Build a high-ownership, performance-driven culture with strong accountability and collaboration.
* Service Quality & Process Excellence: Design and implement SOPs, quality frameworks, audits, and continuous improvement mechanisms to meet client SLAs and service standards. Drive root-cause analysis and corrective action planning to improve execution reliability.
* Client Experience & Stakeholder Management: Own client satisfaction by proactively managing escalations, strengthening communication, and ensuring consistent service delivery. Act as the primary operational interface between clients, service providers, and internal stakeholders.
* Resource Planning & Deployment: Plan and optimize workforce deployment, vendor capacity, territory coverage, and operational infrastructure to meet business demand. Oversee onboarding, performance management, and productivity of service providers and partners.
* Financial & Cost Ownership: Own operational budgets, P&L, track expenses, and identify cost-efficiency and productivity improvement opportunities. Improve unit economics without compromising service quality.
* Performance Management & Analytics: Define, monitor, and report key operational KPIs covering productivity, quality, turnaround time, cost, and client satisfaction. Use data-driven insights to guide decisions and scale best practices.
* Risk, Compliance & Governance: Identify operational risks and implement mitigation strategies to ensure business continuity. Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, legal, and industry standards.
* Process Documentation & Enablement: Build and maintain detailed process documentation, SOPs, and playbooks for operations, field execution, and partner onboarding.

**DESIRED EXPERIENCE**

7 Years - 10 Years

**FUNCTION**

Project Management

**DESIRED SKILLS**

* Graduation from Tier 1 Institutions (IITs/NITs) preferred.
* 7–10 years of proven experience in B2B operations, field operations (on-ground workforce deployment, territory management, vendor onboarding, service fulfillment, quality audits), vendor management, and gig workforce operations, with strong negotiation and decision-making skills.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication abilities.
* Strong leadership skills with experience managing diverse and distributed teams, including on-ground workforce and partner networks.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and familiar with marketplace management and field operations tools.
* Ability to multitask, adapt, and perform effectively under pressure in a dynamic and fast-paced business environment.

title: Animal Rescue & Response Manager (Animal Shelter)
description:
**Every rescue starts with a phone call. Could you be the person who answers it?:**

It is 6 a.m. and a call comes in: a dog has been hit by a vehicle and is lying at the side of the road. Someone needs to stay calm, send the right team, keep the caller informed and have the vet ready when the animal arrives. At Sarvoham, that someone is our
**Animal Rescue & Response Manager.**

If you care deeply about animals and you are brilliant at keeping a team and a process running smoothly under pressure, we would love to hear from you.

**A little about us:**

Sarvoham Welfare Trust is dedicated to the welfare of underprivileged animals in Bengaluru. Our co-founders, Haris Ali and Madhusmita Sahu, started Sarvoham in April 2017 with a simple but big idea: a world where people and animals live side by side, and every animal is treated with respect.

Nine years on, we have grown from a small charitable effort into a well-established animal welfare organisation. We have rescued more than 3,500 street animals and provide shelter for over 200 dogs.

The name says it all. Sarvoham stands for harmony between all elements of nature, human and non-human alike, and that spirit guides everything we do.

**Why this role matters:**

Every animal we help passes through this role first. Whether an animal is sick, injured, abandoned or in danger, you are the link between the person who reported it, the veterinary, the rescue teams and shelter teams who will care for it. This is not a support function. It is the front line of why Sarvoham exists.

You will take our mission, to rescue, treat, rehabilitate and rehome dogs from the streets of Bengaluru and turn it into reliable, repeatable action on the ground. You will work closely with our leadership team, the Board and other civil society organisations, building relationships that bring more people into the work and widen our impact across India.

We are at a defining moment in our journey, and we are building a lasting network of partnerships and philanthropy so that many more lives can be saved. You will help shape how our rescue operations are designed and led, and you will leave a mark on our veterinary and sanctuary work for years to come.

**What you will be doing:**

**Planning and Responding:**

* Plan rescue operations around the needs of each case, and work with the relevant teams to keep everyone aligned.
* Answer rescue and distress calls promptly, decide what is most urgent and dispatch help accordingly.
* Carry out a proper risk assessment before every rescue, and put sensible measures in place to keep our teams, the public and the animals safe.

**Getting animals where they need to be:**

* Make sure injured or at-risk animals are transported safely, humanely and without delay.
* Schedule transport services for animals ready to go home after recovery.
* Keep pet owners and callers updated on the status of the rescued animals from pick-up until the animal recovered and successfully rehabilitated.
* Help pet owners find their way around our helpline's IVR system and answer their questions kindly and clearly.

**Following through:**

* Follow up on unresolved cases and see each one through to a proper resolution.
* Close cases once they are resolved, with the paperwork in order.
* Invite people involved in rescues to share their experience through reviews, to build trust towards the larger cause of animal rescue and welfare.

**Leading the team and the resources:**

* Lead and support our rescue teams, helping them do their best work.
* Look after the practical side of staffing, including approving timesheets, monitoring call queues and managing breaks.
* Identify and organise the resources each rescue needs, working with suppliers and partners to get them on time.
* Manage logistics so that vehicles, equipment and people are used well.
* Organise training sessions and workshops that build your team's skills in emergency response and rescue.

**Keeping good records:**

* Keep accurate records of rescue activity, including mission plans, medical treatment records and outcomes.
* Enter relevant information into our Rescue Management System and medical records.
* Pitch in wherever else the shelter and its residents need you.

**What success looks like:**

We will measure success by what happens to the animals and the people around them, not just by numbers. We will look at things like:

* **Speed and reliability:**

  how quickly calls are answered and teams dispatched, and how many calls are attended within our target response times.
* **Animal outcomes:**

  survival and recovery rates, how quickly rescued animals are seen by a vet, and how closely our veterinary protocols are followed.
* **Where animals go next:**

  how many are successfully rehomed, released or fostered, and how few return to us.
* **A safe, skilled team:**

  training completed, low safety incidents for both people and animals, and a team that wants to stay.
* **Strong partnerships and a happy community:**

  how quickly public complaints are resolved, and how well we work with municipal bodies, other NGOs and the authorities.
* **Good governance:**

  accurate, timely documentation, adherence to animal welfare law and our own protocols, and sensible management of costs, vehicles and supplies.

**Who we are looking for:**

You are a purpose-driven person who combines compassion with clear thinking and a talent for getting things done. You inspire the people around you and keep calm when needed the most.

**You will need:**

* Demonstrable compassion towards animals (Required).
* Ability to work a 6-day week, on-site (Required).
* Availability to respond to exigencies outside of working hours (Required).
* Language proficiency in English, Hindi and Kannada (Required).
* Experience in animal rescues (Preferred).
* A Bachelor's degree (preferred).
* At least four years of progressive experience in customer support.
* Comfort with Microsoft Office, email and presentation software.
* A good understanding of safety protocols and safe working procedures.
* Precise, reliable record-keeping.

**Why join Sarvoham?**

Because the work is real, and so is the difference you make. We are building a more compassionate society where animals can live with dignity. We want people who share that belief and trust their own experience and judgement to change outcomes for animals when they need it the most.

You will lead by example, work alongside a passionate team and help build a animal rescue practice that will last for generations.

**Ready to answer the call?**
Apply on LinkedIn and tell us why animals matter to you.

title: Senior Executive Secretary
description:

Badgefree.com is seeking a highly organized, discreet, and proactive Senior Executive Secretary to provide comprehensive administrative, operational, and strategic support to our senior leadership. Operating in a fast-paced, AI-driven HR-tech environment, you will act as the operational linchpin for our C-suite. Meeting & Board Coordination: Coordinate high-stakes internal meetings, external stakeholder interactions, and virtual board sessions. Prepare detailed agendas, attend sessions, record accurate meeting minutes, and track actionable items through to completion.

Confidential Correspondence & Documentation: Handle sensitive company and personnel information with utmost discretion, professionalism, and integrity. Draft, review, and format executive emails, formal correspondence, reports, and presentations.

Project & Workflow Coordination: Partner with leadership and internal teams to track ongoing initiatives, manage follow-ups, and support administrative workflows across hybrid, distributed environments.

Communication Excellence: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills capable of representing the C-suite with clarity, polish, and poise.

**B. Behavioral & Soft Skills**

Discretion & Integrity: Unwavering commitment to handling confidential information with absolute security and professional ethics.

Proactive Prioritization: Exceptional time-management and multi-tasking skills with the ability to anticipate executive needs before they arise.

Adaptability & Self-Management: High emotional intelligence and self-direction, thriving in a fast-paced, technology-driven, hybrid startup environment.

**4. Qualifications & Experience**

Education: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

Experience: Prior experience supporting C-level executives or senior leadership, preferably within fast-growing technology, SaaS, or HR-tech organizations.

Domain Bonus: Familiarity with HR processes, systems, or an interest in AI-driven HR solutions will be considered a strong advantage.

**5. Working Conditions**

Working Days: Monday to Friday.

Working Hours**:** 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM IST, with reasonable flexibility for meetings across time zones.

Work Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka.

Work Arrangement: Hybrid, with office attendance based on business requirements.

Travel: Occasional domestic travel may be required for leadership meetings or business events. International travel is not expected as a regular requirement.

**6. Compensation & Benefits**

Annual CTC: ₹8,00,000 to ₹12,00,000, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated skills.

Performance Incentives: No separate variable-pay component proposed; compensation will be structured within the stated CTC.

Benefits: Paid leave, medical insurance and applicable employee benefits as part of the overall employment package.

Travel Reimbursement: Business-related travel expenses will be reimbursed as per company policy.

**7. Reporting & Key Stakeholders**

**Reporting To:** CEO / designated senior executive.

The role will coordinate with senior leadership, internal teams, clients, business partners and vendors to ensure timely communication and smooth execution of executive priorities.

**8. Key Performance Indicators**

Performance will be evaluated on:

Calendar Management: Accuracy of schedules and timely resolution of conflicts.

Meeting Coordination: Timely preparation of agendas, minutes and action trackers.

Communication: Accuracy, clarity and professionalism of correspondence and documents.

Follow-through: Completion of assigned tasks and follow-ups within agreed deadlines.

Confidentiality: Responsible handling of sensitive company and personnel information.

**9. Application & Selection Process**

Candidates will undergo resume screening, a practical assessment of executive-support skills, and a structured interview. Shortlisting will be based on relevant experience, demonstrated competencies and a standardised evaluation scorecard.

**10. Equal Opportunity & Role Scope**

Badgefree.com will evaluate candidates on job-related qualifications, experience and competencies. The responsibilities listed above represent the main requirements of the role and may evolve with business needs.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bangalore City, Bengaluru, Karnataka

title: Digitalization Consultant
description:
**Hello Visionary!**

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.

We provide our Hire-to-Retire services along the complete lifecycle of an employee from onboarding to pension services and leverage our powerful ecosystem of leading external and internal partners and our network of key delivery centers. We believe in the value of industry best-practice standards achieved through evolving technology and digitalization. We focus on employee experience as a key driver of our actions. In doing so, we deliver flexibility, quality and efficiency for the businesses we partner with.

**Position Overview:**

As Team Lead / Manager, you will own a portfolio of digital enablement initiatives within the H2R space and lead a team of Digital Process Enablement Associates and Consultants. You will be the connective tissue between HR business teams and technology — translating pain points into scalable, AI-powered solutions, and mentoring your team to do the same.

**You’ll make a difference by:**

**Team Leadership & Delivery Management**

* Lead a team of DPE Associates / Consultants; manage workload, priorities, quality of output and career development.
* Set delivery cadence, review technical designs, and hold the team to a high standard of solutioning and execution.
* Coach team members on AI tooling, process thinking, solution design and stakeholder handling.
* Own the pipeline of transformation initiatives within your portfolio — sequencing, resourcing and prioritisation.

**Problem Discovery & Solution Design**

* Drive end-to-end diagnostic reviews across H2R sub-processes — recruitment, onboarding, core HR, payroll, time & attendance, benefits, performance, learning, offboarding.
* Identify bottlenecks, manual touchpoints, compliance gaps and redundancy through data analysis, process mining, stakeholder interviews and design thinking.
* Architect solutions ranging from workflow automations to AI-powered agents — leveraging GenAI, LLMs, RPA, intelligent chatbots, NLP and predictive analytics.
* Produce solution blueprints, process flows, functional specs and user stories that are precise enough to build from.
* Benchmark against Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, ADP and emerging AI-native HR tools.

**Hands-on Build & Technical Ownership**

* Prototype solutions yourself in AI tools, low-code platforms and automation stacks — you do not delegate every build.
* Evaluate emerging AI platforms, run proofs-of-concept, and make build-vs-buy calls with clear rationale.
* Own solution architecture, integration design and non-functional considerations (security, data, scale, cost).
* Partner with IT / engineering on integration patterns, data models and deployment.

**Project Ownership & Stakeholder Management**

* Drive projects from ideation through go-live and value realisation; own timelines, risks and change management.
* Collaborate across HR COEs, payroll, compliance, IT and external vendors to land outcomes.
* Report progress, KPIs, adoption metrics and value delivered to senior leadership on a regular cadence.

**Storytelling & Communication**

* Craft executive-quality decks and narratives that communicate transformation vision, progress and impact.
* Facilitate design thinking workshops and working sessions with business stakeholders.
* Create thought leadership content and internal case studies to drive AI adoption across the function.

**Your success is grounded in:**

* Experience: 7–12 years overall experience in digital transformation or project consulting with an automation focus. MBA in any stream
* Team leadership: Prior experience leading a small team or a workstream, with demonstrated ability to coach and grow talent.
* Domain: Solid working knowledge of the Digital initiatives and problem solving
* Technical edge: Hands-on exposure to AI/ML, GenAI tools, LLM-based solutions, RPA or intelligent workflows. You have built or shipped something, not only reviewed it.
* Delivery: Proven track record of owning a project end-to-end and shipping outcomes, not just recommendations.
* Communication: Strong executive presentation and storytelling skills.
* Good-to-haves: Certifications in AI/ML, Digital Transformation, Lean Six Sigma, Design Thinking, Agile/Scrum or HR Technology.
* Experience with prompt engineering, agentic AI patterns, or LLM evaluation.
* Exposure to change management and adoption playbooks at scale.

**Join us and be yourself!**

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

This role is based in **Bangalore.** You’ll also get to visit other locations in India and beyond, so you’ll need to go where this journey takes you. In return, you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.

description:

As the Functional Product Owner for Continuous Listening, the person is responsible for shaping, governing, and continuously improving various employee engagement surveys/projects capability enabled through Qualtrics. The role ensures that business needs are clearly understood and translated into scalable functional requirements, platform configurations, and actionable insights.  
The role partners closely with the digital team, People Analytics and HR leaders to design, configure and scale listening programs across the employee lifecycle, drives simplification and standardization of processes, and benchmarks market best practices to recommend improvements that turn employee feedback into meaningful action.

What will you do?  

* Own the functional vision, roadmap, backlog, and ongoing evolution of the Continuous Listening product.
* Translate business needs and employee experience objectives into clear functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and Qualtrics solution designs.
* Configure and optimize Qualtrics capabilities, including surveys, workflows, dashboards, reporting, role-based access, and distribution processes.
* Design and govern continuous listening approaches across key employee moments and business priorities, while avoiding survey fatigue and duplication.
* Partner with HR, Employee Experience, People Analytics, Digital, and business leaders to align listening initiatives with strategic priorities and measurable outcomes.
* Facilitate stakeholder workshops to identify business questions, define listening objectives, prioritize use cases, and agree success measures.
* Convert feedback and listening results into clear insights and recommendations that support business and people’s decisions.
* Drive simplification, standardization, reuse, and automation of listening processes across countries, functions, and business units.
* Manage the product backlog, prioritize enhancements, support release planning, and coordinate testing, deployment, adoption, and change activities.
* Define and maintain functional governance, design standards, data structures, survey templates, dashboard principles, and operating procedures.
* Ensure that listening solutions comply with data privacy, confidentiality, security, accessibility, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Monitor product adoption, data quality, user experience, platform performance, and business value; recommend continuous improvements.
* Act as the functional subject matter expert for Qualtrics and continuous listening, providing guidance and support to stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Benchmark external practices and emerging trends in employee listening, experience management, and people analytics.

* 8–10 years of hands-on functional experience with Qualtrics, preferably Qualtrics EmployeeXM.

* Strong business understanding of HR processes, employee experience and how listening insights drive business outcomes.

Job Description:

The **BTEX Transformation Project Lead** serves as the program delivery owner for strategic initiatives across Schneider Electric's global Business Travel & Expense program. The role is accountable for delivering BTEX transformation initiatives and converting travel, expense, payment, and operational data into actionable business intelligence, driving process optimization, digital innovation, and measurable business outcomes.

Working across regions and functions, the role will lead global delivery governance, conduct end-to-end T&E data and process mining assessments, and introduce AI-enabled innovation that improves employee experience, operational efficiency, cost transparency, compliance, and decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1. Program Delivery Ownership**
---------------------------------

* Own the end-to-end delivery of global BTEX transformation program projects from initiation through implementation, stabilization, and benefits realization.
* Define and maintain integrated delivery plans covering scope, milestones, budget, resources, dependencies, risks, decisions, and acceptance criteria.
* Establish delivery governance, workstream cadence, decision forums, executive status reporting, and escalation mechanisms.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams and external partners to ensure timely delivery, clear accountability, and rapid issue resolution.
* Monitor delivery performance and business outcomes; implement corrective actions when milestones, quality, adoption, or value realization are at risk.

**2. Global T&E Process Mining and Process Excellence**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Lead global process mining assessments across travel booking, corporate card, expense submission, approval, audit, reimbursement, accounting, and payment processes.
* Define process-mining scope, required event data, process variants, control points, performance indicators, and target outcomes in partnership with process and data owners.
* Identify bottlenecks, rework, manual activities, policy deviations, control gaps, and automation opportunities across countries and regions.
* Translate findings into prioritized improvement roadmaps, standardized processes, control enhancements, and measurable efficiency initiatives.
* Embed continuous monitoring and value tracking to sustain improvements after implementation.

**3. AI-Enabled Ways of Working and Project Delivery**
------------------------------------------------------

* Embed AI into BTEX ways of working to improve productivity, collaboration, decision-making, and execution.
* Apply AI tools across project management activities, including planning, meeting preparation, documentation, status reporting, risk identification, action tracking, and stakeholder communication.
* Identify repetitive or manual activities that can be simplified or automated using approved AI capabilities.
* Promote practical AI adoption by developing reusable prompts, templates, working practices, and guidance for the BTEX team.
* Partner with Digital, Data, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Legal, and Compliance teams to ensure responsible and secure use of AI.
* Track the adoption and measurable impact of AI on project efficiency, delivery quality, employee experience, and business outcomes.

**4. Business Analysis, Data and Value Realization**
----------------------------------------------------

* Translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories, process designs, data needs, and implementation priorities.
* Use travel, expense, card, supplier, policy, and operational data to validate improvement opportunities and support delivery decisions.
* Define program KPIs, baselines, target benefits, adoption measures, and post-implementation performance reviews.
* Partner with analytics teams to develop executive reporting and decision-support views that demonstrate progress and realized value.

**5. Stakeholder, Change and Adoption Management**
--------------------------------------------------

* Build alignment with global and regional stakeholders across Finance, Procurement, Treasury, Accounting, HR, Digital, Compliance, Security, Sustainability, and business operations.
* Lead requirements workshops, process reviews, design sessions, governance meetings, and executive steering updates.
* Develop change, communication, training, readiness, and adoption plans appropriate to impacted audiences.
* Act as a trusted delivery partner who balances global standardization, local requirements, user experience, governance, and implementation feasibility.

**6. Technology and Vendor Delivery Management**
------------------------------------------------

* Manage delivery coordination with technology providers, travel management companies, payment partners, and implementation vendors.
* Clarify deliverables, responsibilities, dependencies, quality expectations, testing requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* Support solution evaluation and ensure vendor commitments remain aligned with BTEX architecture, governance, integration, security, and business requirements.

Voiant is a global consulting firm specializing in **Sales Performance Management (SPM)** and **Revenue Operations (RevOps)**. We partner with enterprise organizations to design, implement, and optimize platforms that power how sales teams are planned, measured, and paid — working across leading EPM platforms.

Our clients are Fortune 500 and high-growth companies transforming how they manage their sales and revenue planning process. When you join Voiant, you work on high-impact engagements that sit at the intersection of business strategy, data, and technology.

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for a **Business Operations Manager** to join our growing team in India. As our India team grows, we need a dedicated owner for the operational backbone that keeps it running: HR, onboarding, IT and the everyday questions our people bring.

You'll take ownership of these areas, build scalable processes around them, and become the go-to point of contact for the team.

**This role is ideal for someone who:**

* Enjoys building processes from the ground up and making them run smoothly
* Is the person colleagues naturally turn to when they need something resolved
