title: Flight Operations Manager
description:
**Company Description**

**Are you looking to join an organization that is growing and dynamic? What about a high-energy, collaborative environment that rewards hard work?**

J.S. Held is a global consulting firm that combines technical, scientific, financial, and strategic expertise to advise clients seeking to realize value and mitigate risk. Our professionals serve as trusted advisors to organizations facing high stakes matters demanding urgent attention, staunch integrity, proven experience, clear-cut analysis, and an understanding of both tangible and intangible assets.

The firm provides a comprehensive suite of services, products, and data that enable clients to navigate complex, contentious, and often catastrophic situations.

 **Job Description**

We are seeking a Flight Operations Manager to coordinate J.S. Held's enterprise drone program. This role will help establish a scalable and well-governed operating environment by improving visibility into the fleet, supporting pilot and regulatory requirements, administering technology and vendor relationships, and enabling consistent billing and reporting practices.

The ideal candidate combines strong program-management and operational skills with practical knowledge of commercial drone operations. This role partners across Practices, Operations, Finance, Legal, Information Technology, and the firm’s pilot community. It provides enterprise coordination and does not have direct report pilots.

**Job Responsibilities**

**Program Management and Governance**

* Coordinate the enterprise drone program and maintain visibility into drone assets, pilots, certifications, utilization, and flight activity.
* Develop and maintain SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), training, practical policies, procedures, records, and controls that support consistent operations across the firm.
* Track program performance and provide concise reporting on utilization, compliance, billing, risks, and implementation progress.
* Entrepreneurial mindset towards continued refinement of Fleet Management and new revenue opportunities.

**Fleet Operations and Compliance**

* Coordinate drone inventory, registration, assignment, maintenance, insurance, and retirement activities.
* Monitor applicable FAA requirements, pilot credentials, renewals, authorizations, and recordkeeping obligations; escalate specialized matters to the appropriate internal or external experts.
* Support risk assessments, incident reporting, corrective actions, and periodic compliance reviews.

**Billing and Business Support**

* Partner with Finance and practice operations to establish consistent and transparent drone billing and documentation practices.
* Help connect flight activity to the appropriate project or engagement and maintain records needed for invoicing, audit, and client questions.
* Monitor billing adoption and exceptions and report on drone activity, billings, recoveries, costs, and program economics.

**Technology and Vendor Management**

* Lead requirements definition, RFP support, evaluation, and implementation of a drone fleet-management platform, subject to the firm’s approval and investment governance processes.
* Administer the selected platform, including data standards, user access, workflow design, data quality, vendor performance, and enhancement priorities.
* Coordinate relationships with drone technology, equipment, training, and compliance vendors in accordance with firm policies.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Partner with practice leaders, pilots, and corporate functions to support adoption, resolve issues, and align program priorities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

* Experience implementing standardized processes across multiple teams, locations, or business units.
* Experience selecting, implementing, or administering an operational, fleet, asset, compliance, or workflow technology platform.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting a multi-location drone, aviation, field-services, equipment-management, or other regulated operational program.

* Experience supporting billing, cost recovery, project accounting, or client documentation in a professional services environment.
* Familiarity with commercial insurance schedules, FAA waivers or authorizations, and specialized drone operating environments.
* Project management, safety management, process improvement, or change management certification or training.

**Physical and Mental Job Qualifications**

* Ability to work at a computer and review operational, regulatory, and financial information for extended periods.
* Ability to communicate effectively with geographically dispersed stakeholders and manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Ability to travel occasionally and access field or equipment-storage locations when needed.
* Ability to safely handle or move typical small-drone equipment and cases, with reasonable accommodation as applicable.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a dynamic, growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided companies of all sizes with an infrastructure platform in the cloud. Using AWS, companies can requisition compute power, storage, and other services – gaining access to a global computing infrastructure that is the backbone of Amazon.com’s multi-billion-dollar retail business. Today, AWS provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers millions of active monthly customers from start-ups to multi-national corporations to governments.  
  
At Amazon, we are committed to being Earth’s Best Employer and the most customer-centric company. To get there, we need exceptionally talented and empathetic leaders passionate about making every day better for all employees (Builders) – and you would play a key role in that journey! Our HR Partners care deeply about the employee experience and support builders and managers to focus on people through engagement, technology, and innovation.  
  
The HR Partner role in our Builder Experience Team (BeXT) focuses on the Builder experience. You will be working with business teams and other cross-functional HR teams in driving and deploying strategies. Great opportunity for a highly motivated, self-directed individual to gain valuable HR experience in a fast-paced, dynamic, globally scaling organization - and have fun doing it as an Amazonian!  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Consult, coach, develop, and support leadership through decision making with empathy and sound judgement; collaborating and actioning on talent management processes, people development and performance management, compensation, and Employee Relations issues.
* Foster and role model an environment of inclusion for all Builders.
* Advocate for Builders’ needs through end-to-end experiences that help Builders feel fully engaged in the work they do and valued for who they are.
* Equitably exercise high-judgement, manage through ambiguity and serve as first point of escalation for Builder concerns.
* Support Builder queries and situations with discretion and expertise navigating Amazon Policies and applying high judgement as necessary.
* Actively promote adoption of technology and self-service.
* Collaborate and influence multiple levels of the organization ranging from Builders to senior leaders.
* Conduct difficult workplace investigations in collaboration with Builder Relations.
* Coach HR new hires, mentor HR professionals, engaged in global projects and contribute to regional programs.

  
A day in the life  

* Application of HR fundamentals.
* Problem solving and influencing in diverse populations.
* Working in a rapid and complex changing environment driven by continuous innovation.
* Influence change and foster an environment of inclusion for our Builders.
* Partnering with leaders at multiple levels of the organization to develop forward looking strategies and goals focused on the Builder experience.

  
About the team  
BeXT delivers personalized people-support to AWS Builders to amplify the voice of the Builder. In this role, you will collaborate with AWS business leaders and line HR teams to innovate, implement, and deploy HR strategies from customer service, talent and performance management, compensation, employee relations and other HR functions. In addition, you will provide support to our Builders and their leaders aligned to AWS flywheel(s) or region(s) calling on HR expertise and empathy.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in Human Resources, Human Resources Management, Labor Relations, Business/Management, Psychology, or a related field
* 7+ years of HR Generalist, HR Business Partner or HR manager experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience consulting with senior leadership and executives in a fast-paced environment
* Experience in employee relations, labor relations, or labor/employment law
* Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
* Experience working with and protecting confidential and sensitive HR information
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Experience working with teams across APAC region
* Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and ability to translate data into actionable insights
* Intellectual curiosity; brings insight and fresh thinking to the team and business
* Demonstrated empathy in navigating complex people situations

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Junior HRBP
description:
**Overview**
Stats Perform is the market leader in sports tech.  We provide the most trusted sports data to some of the world's biggest organizations, across sports, media, and broadcasting.
  
  
Through the latest AI technologies and machine learning, we combine decades' worth of data with the latest in-game happenings. We then offer coaches, teams, professional bodies, and media channels around the world, access to the very best data, content, and insights.  In turn, improving how sports fans interact with their favourite sports teams and competitions.
  
  
**How do we add value?**

* Media outlets add a little magic to their coverage with our stats and graphics packages.
* Sportsbooks can offer better predictions and more accurate odds.
* The world's top coaches are known to use our data to make critical team decisions.
* Sports commentators can engage with fans on a deeper level, using our stories and insights.

Anywhere you find sport, Stats Perform is there.  However, data and tech are only half of the package. We need great people to fuel the engine.
  
  
We succeeded thanks to a team of amazing people. They spend their days collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data from a wide range of live sporting events. If you combine this real-time data with our 40-year-old archives, elite journalists, camera operators, copywriters, the latest in AI wizardry, and a host of 'behind the scenes' support staff, you've got all the ingredients to make it a magical experience!
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Mission Statement: The Junior HR Business Partner supports the HRBP and wider HR team in delivering effective people support for the India business. The role partners with managers and employees on day-to-day HR activities, employee lifecycle processes, employee relations support, HR operations, and local compliance, helping ensure a consistent and positive employee experience aligned with company standards.
* Business Impact: This role contributes to organizational effectiveness by supporting managers and employees with timely HR guidance, accurate HR processes, and strong follow-through on people-related activities. The role helps improve employee experience, operational efficiency, compliance, and consistency across HR practices, while escalating risks and complex matters to the HRBP as needed.
* Decision-making Authority: The role provides guidance to employees and managers within established HR policies, processes, and statutory requirements. The position supports case preparation, process execution, documentation, and follow-up, while escalating complex employee relations matters, workforce decisions, compliance risks, and policy exceptions to the HRBP or appropriate HR leadership.

**Required Qualifications**

* Operational Support: Support day-to-day HR operations for the India population, working closely with the HRBP and HR Shared Services team to ensure employee lifecycle activities, HR documentation, data updates, and compliance processes are completed accurately and on time. Assist with employee relations case preparation, meeting coordination, documentation, and follow-up, escalating complex or sensitive matters as needed.
* HR Program Execution: Support the delivery of HR initiatives, including performance management, employee engagement, talent processes, policy rollouts, and organizational change activities. Help coordinate timelines, communications, manager follow-up, and tracking to ensure HR programs are executed consistently across the India business.
* Manager and Employee Support: Provide practical HR support to managers and employees on routine people matters, policies, processes, and employee lifecycle questions. Partner with global HR teams including Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Rewards, HR Operations, and Learning & Development to help resolve queries, coordinate actions, and deliver a consistent employee experience.
* Service Delivery: Support timely and accurate resolution of HR queries, employee requests, and HR operational activities. Identify opportunities to improve processes, documentation, handoffs, and employee communications, sharing recommendations with the HRBP or relevant HR teams.
* Team Collaboration: Work collaboratively with the HRBP, HR Shared Services, and wider HR teams to support priorities, manage follow-through, and maintain a high standard of HR service. Contribute to a compliant, responsive, and employee-focused HR culture through strong organization, communication, and attention to detail.
* Financial Responsibility and Revenue Impact: Support accurate headcount tracking, workforce data updates, and people process administration that contribute to effective cost management and operational decision-making. Help reduce risk and improve efficiency through accurate documentation, timely follow-up, and consistent application of HR processes.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline preferred. HR qualification or working toward an HR certification is desirable.
* Relevant HR experience in an HR Operations, HR Generalist, or junior HR Business Partnering environment, with exposure to employee lifecycle processes, employee relations support, HR systems, and policy application.

**Why work at Stats Perform?**
**We love sports, but we love diverse thinking more!**
We know that diversity brings creativity, so we invite people from all backgrounds to join us.  At Stats Perform you can make a difference, by using your skills and experience every day, you'll feel valued and respected for your contribution.
  
  
**We take care of our colleagues**
We like happy and healthy colleagues. You will benefit from things like Mental Health Days Off, ‘No Meeting Fridays,’ and flexible working schedules.
  
  
**We pull together to build a better workplace and world for all.**
We encourage employees to take part in charitable activities, utilize their 2 days of Volunteering Time Off, support our environmental efforts, and be actively involved in Employee Resource Groups.
  
  
**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Stats Perform**
By joining Stats Perform, you'll be part of a team that celebrates diversity. A team that is dedicated to creating an inclusive atmosphere where everyone feels valued and welcome. All employees are collectively responsible for developing and maintaining an inclusive environment. That is why our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion goals underpin our core values.
  
  
With increased diversity comes increased innovation and creativity. Ensuring we're best placed to serve our clients and communities. Stats Perform is committed to seeking diversity, equity, and inclusion in all we do.

title: People Operations - Sr. Advisor
description:
**Job Description**
About Maersk
  
  
Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and have been industry pioneers for over a century. Through innovation and transformation, we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.
  
  
At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organization reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.
  
  
With over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.
  
  
Join us as we harness cutting-edge technologies and unlock opportunities on a global scale. Together, let's sail towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.
  
  
What we Offer
  
  
This is an exciting career opportunity in an international, challenging business setting known for diversity and high paced environment. You will get to focus on creating valuable relations with stakeholders and work with highly professional teams in an environment where you will be valued, recognized and well rewarded.
  
  
You will work with amazing and diverse colleagues with a deep sense of commitment to live Our Values and together, go all the way for our customers, society and for each other.
  
  
Job Description:
  
  
As a People Operations Sr. Advisor ,You will be part of the team that is the first point of contact for employees and leaders, helping them solve HR queries online, on the phone or on site. Whether their issue is big or small, our people should feel cared for just the same and your role is making sure they have a great experience when they reach out to HR.
  
  
You will join the People Operations Advisory team with the new HR service delivery model, processes and technology. Your role as a People Operations Advisor will be to solve the HR-related queries of our employees and managers and make sure their interaction with HR results in a great experience.
  
  
Own to resolution people’s inquiries about HR policies and procedures, like compensation, benefits, performance management, leave, payroll and HR applications, and other matters related to the employee lifecycle.
  
  

* Respond to our employees and managers through a variety of channels (HR case management, phone, email, live chat)
* Guide employees and managers in using self-service in Workday and other HR systems, to facilitate technology adoption
* Promote the usage of the employee HR Portal by providing guidance on HR knowledge content, such as global & local HR policies, How-To, etc.
* Manage HR data quality and perform transactions in Workday and other HR applications
* Work together with People Partners and functional specialists to solve complex queries
* Prepare and handle HR documentation
* Coordinate and administer onboarding and offboarding processes
* Support improvement activities to simplify and standardize the HR processes
* Deliver on high employee satisfaction, accuracy, and timeliness.

As an SME you will furthermore support the delivery of the HR Cycle with administrative tasks related to onboarding, Employee life cycle, job moves, exit, etc.
  
  

* Knowledge of local labor law would be beneficial
* Experience working with HR systems, preferably Workday, workday case management & Process Optimization.
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills, ability to manage conflict, and attention to detail
* Drive to identify needs, investigate options, seek solutions and partner with other HR colleagues to resolve issues
* Ability to take initiative, manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to be an engaged member of a virtual team
* Closure orientation and low tolerance for delays and deviations
* A degree in Human Resources or similar and knowledge of HR concepts are a strong plus.
* Flexible to work varied hours based on business needs.

**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.
  
  
6+ years of experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, People Operations, or a customer support environment.
  
  
Experience working with HR systems, preferably Workday and HR case management platforms.
  
  
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain HR policies and processes clearly.
  
  
Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical skills with strong attention to detail.
  
  
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, service-oriented environment.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Knowledge of employee lifecycle processes, HR operations, and shared services environments.
  
  
Understanding of local labor laws and HR compliance requirements.
  
  
Experience supporting global or regional employee populations.
  
  
Familiarity with continuous improvement methodologies and process standardization initiatives
  
  
Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

title: Manager – PMS & OD
description:
**St. Mary's Rehabilitation University**
| Telangana | Full-time | 6 to 10 years preferred | ₹6–12 LPA, depending on experience

We need an HR professional who can build a performance-driven accountability system across our academic, administrative and operational functions. You will define roles, set KPIs/KRAs, run monthly performance reviews (JPA), and link results to confirmation, increments and progression.

**This is not a recruitment, attendance or payroll role.**

**To Apply:**

Interested candidates are requested to submit their updated CV, clearly highlighting at least one
**performance management, KPI, or appraisal system**
they have personally implemented. Please include your
**role, number of employees covered, and measurable outcome/result**
.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Review and design JDs, role responsibilities, reporting lines, and role-wise accountability/output matrices.

• Develop and implement KPIs/KRAs with clear targets, timelines, evidence, and review frequencies across academic, administrative, leadership, and operational roles.

• Create Role Execution Plans to translate responsibilities into tasks, deliverables, timelines, ownership, delegation, and escalation points.

• Conduct periodic Job Performance Assessments (JPA) covering target vs. actual performance, evidence, gaps, delays, and corrective actions.

• Prepare performance summaries and support probation, confirmation, increments, salary revisions, progression, reassignment, and Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs).

• Maintain employee-wise KPI, JPA, appraisal, and performance records while developing HR dashboards to track reviews, probation, confirmations, and appraisal cycles.

• Identify manpower, accountability, and role-duplication gaps and recommend improvements in organisational structure and reporting lines.

• Support HR policy implementation, standardise onboarding and performance-review processes, and coordinate with HRMS/ERP teams.

**Candidate Profile**

MBA/PGDM or Master's degree in HR with preferably
**4–10 years of relevant experience**
in Performance Management, PMS, HRBP, or Organization Development. Strong hands-on expertise in
**KPI/KRA setting, appraisal systems, JPA/PMS documentation, goal setting, performance dashboards, HR analytics, role design, and performance-linked decisions**
is expected.

Experience in a
**university, educational institution, hospital, or other people-intensive organisation**
will be an advantage.

**Key Skills:**
Analytical ability • Role & KPI Design • PMS/JPA • HR Analytics • Excel & HRMS • Documentation • Stakeholder Management • Leadership Coordination • Follow-up & Closure • Confidentiality

**Success Looks Like:**
Clear roles, measurable KPIs, timely evidence-based performance reviews, structured appraisal decisions, and identification of accountability or manpower gaps across the organisation.

**Company Description**
St. Mary’s Rehabilitation University (SMRU), established under the Telangana State Private Universities Act, 2018, is India’s first private university dedicated exclusively to rehabilitation sciences and related healthcare disciplines. The university offers specialized programs in physiotherapy, occupational therapy, audiology and speech language pathology, nursing, psychology, special education, biomedical and rehabilitation engineering, public health, and allied health technologies. Backed by the Joseph Sriharsha & Mary Indraja Educational Society with over 29 years of academic excellence, SMRU emphasizes research, clinical immersion, and skill-based training aligned with global standards such as WHO’s Rehabilitation 2030 and the UN SDGs. SMRU provides pathways to international licensing and placements in regions including the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Europe, and the Gulf, while advancing a strong social mission through scholarships and community-based rehabilitation outreach.

* 8+ years of progressive experience across Human Resources, including HR operations, employee services, payroll, compliance, workforce administration, or related disciplines

* Some Overlap with US Time zone for meetings and reporting (Daily)

* Strong knowledge of India labor legislation, payroll administration, employee lifecycle processes, HR governance, compliance requirements, and risk management practices

By applying for this position, candidates acknowledge and agree that:

title: Software Development Manager
description:
Do you want to advance your career with the world’s first cloud company? Since 1998, Oracle NetSuite has been on a mission to deliver an agile, unified application suite that gives leaders a complete view into their business. Our team is growing, and we’re looking for people like you to help us make a global impact.

As the leading cloud business system, NetSuite includes financials, inventory management, HR, professional services automation, commerce, and more. Tens of thousands of customers all over the world trust NetSuite to give their businesses the visibility, agility, and control needed to make data-informed decisions quickly. NetSuite is a place where you can build your career and have fun while doing so! We’re invested in our people, our customers, and the community. As part of Oracle, our benefits are second to none. Joining our passionate team means that you’re ready to take your career to the next level. With priceless learning opportunities, strong support, incredible innovation, and volunteer opportunities, NetSuite is committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels empowered and set up for success.

**Our company culture:**

* We help each other and foster collaboration across roles and teams.
* We lift each other up. We know how to celebrate our successes and learn from our failures.
* Ideas are fragile and we consider them no matter how simple or outlandish.
* We always try to do the right thing – for ourselves, for the product and ultimately for our customers.

**How will you crush it?**  
  
You'll work with awesome people that care about their craft and what they deliver. Your efforts will contribute to making things better for thousands of our customers.

You will collaborate strongly with our partners in Product Management, Security and Compliance – we’re all pulling in the same direction to deliver the secure, reliable software our customers want and need.

  

* People first.
* Manage a team of 7+ Engineers.
* Being open-minded for discussions and promoting team collaboration.
* Taking initiative, responsibility, and ownership of the projects.
* Driving continuous improvement of the team's productivity, product, and processes.
* Provide career growth and development opportunities for the team and build effective backup/succession plan to handle unanticipated attrition.
* Interact with product management and other engineering teams ( XD, Devops, Tech support, Release teams etc.) to develop / release software products which fulfill the requirements defined by the product owner.
* Provide technical leadership to the team for design, architecture, code reviews and incorporate engineering best practices into feature development, refactoring work and product maintenance.
* Determine the staffing required for scrum teams to complete assigned tasks. Facilitate the required trainings for the team to help them to complete their tasks.
* Experience working with Quality Leads.
* Responsible for hiring of software engineers for agile development teams.
* Mentor, train and motivate software engineers to increase overall technical skillsets and stay current with technology trends.
* Drive the annual performance reviews and appraisal process for the team.
* Participate in the campus / Industry hiring drives.
* Work with team to resolve customer issues as per defined service level agreements.
* Able to successfully deliver committed features on time and meeting project objectives/deadlines.
* Participate in various scrum ceremonies such as Daily scrum calls , Sprint Planning, Sprint Retrospection

Skills:

* Bachelor/Master degree in computer engineering or equivalent.
* 9+ years of software development experience in a technical capacity.
* Expertise in JavaScript and hand-on experience with TypeScript, with a basic understanding of modern web frameworks (React, Angular, Vue).
* Expertise in any of the development technologies : Java or C#.
* Experience in working with AI dev tools such as Cline, Codex and also have expertise in creating Agents / skills based on the project needs.
* Expertise in designing complex solutions, code reviews, providing architectural input on team-wide/cross-location projects, defining branching strategies and able to drive cross-team initiatives.
* Good familiarity with testing pyramid, test plans, automation, code coverage, continuous integration, performance and security testing.
* Monitoring the team productivity and maximizing utilization across various projects / initiatives.
* Keep up-to-date with technology trends & processes while driving adoption of the same , encourage innovation and lead knowledge sharing strategies. Should be able to pick up and deliver stories/tasks based on the project needs.
* Expertise in agile methodology and handling of scrum teams.
* Assist the team to unblock issues by providing effective resolutions.
* Delegate to engineers with clearly defined responsibility and empowerment.
* Expertise in dealing with performance management which includes regular 1-1's, performance /appraisal discussions with the engineer.
* Ensuring team is adhering to the organizational policies and guidelines.
* Proven ability to drive and enhance team engagement, fostering a collaborative and motivated work environment.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Experienced in managing high performance teams , understanding their feedback and guide them in their career path.
* Ability to attract/recruit/retain talent
* Be a coach, mentor and employee champion.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to abstract functional requirements.

title: HR Partner, AWS
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a dynamic, growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided companies of all sizes with an infrastructure platform in the cloud. Using AWS, companies can requisition compute power, storage, and other services – gaining access to a global computing infrastructure that is the backbone of Amazon.com’s multi-billion-dollar retail business. Today, AWS provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers millions of active monthly customers from start-ups to multi-national corporations to governments.  
  
At Amazon, we are committed to being Earth’s Best Employer and the most customer-centric company. To get there, we need exceptionally talented and empathetic leaders passionate about making every day better for all employees (Builders) – and you would play a key role in that journey! Our HR Partners care deeply about the employee experience and support builders and managers to focus on people through engagement, technology, and innovation.  
  
The HR Partner role in our Builder Experience Team (BeXT) focuses on the Builder experience. You will be working with business teams and other cross-functional HR teams in driving and deploying strategies. Great opportunity for a highly motivated, self-directed individual to gain valuable HR experience in a fast-paced, dynamic, globally scaling organization - and have fun doing it as an Amazonian!  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Consult, coach, develop, and support leadership through decision making with empathy and sound judgement; collaborating and actioning on talent management processes, people development and performance management, compensation, and Employee Relations issues.
* Foster and role model an environment of inclusion for all Builders.
* Advocate for Builders’ needs through end-to-end experiences that help Builders feel fully engaged in the work they do and valued for who they are.
* Equitably exercise high-judgement, manage through ambiguity and serve as first point of escalation for Builder concerns.
* Support Builder queries and situations with discretion and expertise navigating Amazon Policies and applying high judgement as necessary.
* Actively promote adoption of technology and self-service.
* Collaborate and influence multiple levels of the organization ranging from Builders to senior leaders.
* Conduct difficult workplace investigations in collaboration with Builder Relations.
* Coach HR new hires, mentor HR professionals, engaged in global projects and contribute to regional programs.

  
A day in the life  

* Application of HR fundamentals.
* Problem solving and influencing in diverse populations.
* Working in a rapid and complex changing environment driven by continuous innovation.
* Influence change and foster an environment of inclusion for our Builders.
* Partnering with leaders at multiple levels of the organization to develop forward looking strategies and goals focused on the Builder experience.

  
About the team  
BeXT delivers personalized people-support to AWS Builders to amplify the voice of the Builder. In this role, you will collaborate with AWS business leaders and line HR teams to innovate, implement, and deploy HR strategies from customer service, talent and performance management, compensation, employee relations and other HR functions. In addition, you will provide support to our Builders and their leaders aligned to AWS flywheel(s) or region(s) calling on HR expertise and empathy.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in Human Resources, Human Resources Management, Labor Relations, Business/Management, Psychology, or a related field
* 7+ years of HR Generalist or HR Business Partner experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience consulting with senior leadership and executives in a fast-paced environment
* Experience in employee relations, labor relations, or labor/employment law
* Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
* Experience working with and protecting confidential and sensitive HR information
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Experience working with teams across APAC region
* Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and ability to translate data into actionable insights
* Intellectual curiosity; brings insight and fresh thinking to the team and business
* Demonstrated empathy in navigating complex people situations

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: FBS HR Manager (India)
description:
FBS – Farmer Business Services is part of Farmers Insurance operations with the purpose of building a global approach to identifying, recruiting, hiring, and retaining top talent. By combining international reach with US expertise, we build diverse and high-performing teams that are equipped to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace.

We believe that the foundation of every successful business lies in having the right people with the right skills. That is where we come in—helping Farmers build a winning team that delivers consistent and sustainable results.

* A dynamic, diverse, and multicultural work environment
* Leaders with deep market knowledge and strategic vision

This position serves as the primary owner of HR execution and governance for the local legal entities, ensuring the effective delivery of HR programs, employee lifecycle processes, payroll administration, compliance, and workforce administration activities. The role bridges Farmers' strategy and policies and local business needs, ensuring that enterprise programs, policies, and practices are successfully implemented while maintaining compliance with local regulations and organizational requirements.

Acting as a key partner to ensure Farmers and Group standards at country level, in alignment with country leadership, HR Functions, Finance, and Legal in compliance with local requirements and regulations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Local execution of Farmers' HR programs, processes, and initiatives ensuring alignment with company policies, business objectives, and regulatory requirements.
* Serve as the primary HR representative for country-level governance and workforce administration matters, ensuring effective implementation of Farmers' HR programs, and policies.
* Provide leadership and oversight for payroll administration, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant payroll execution while maintaining effective controls and governance standards.
* Oversee employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, employee data management, organizational changes, transfers, leaves of absence, and offboarding activities.
* Act as the HR lead for legal entity governance matters, supporting audits, inspections, compliance reviews, corporate transactions, and organizational changes.
* Ensure compliance with labor legislation, statutory obligations, Farmers policies, and regulatory requirements while proactively identifying and mitigating risks.
* Partner closely with HR Centers of Excellence to ensure effective local implementation of compensation, benefits, talent, performance management, learning, and other enterprise HR programs.
* Advise business leaders on HR process execution, compliance, workforce administration, and employee relations matters requiring local expertise and support.
* Establish and maintain governance processes, controls, service standards, and performance metrics to ensure effective delivery of Farmers HR programs and compliance with local regulations.
* Drive process improvements, automation initiatives, and simplification efforts that enhance efficiency, scalability, and employee experience.
* Lead local HR activities associated with organizational changes, restructurings, acquisitions, divestitures, and other business transformation initiatives.
* Manage relationships with external providers, government agencies, auditors, and other stakeholders as required to support local HR execution and compliance obligations.
* Serve as the primary point of coordination between the local entity and enterprise HR functions, ensuring consistency in the execution of Farmers' policies, programs, and employee practices.

  
**Requirements**  

* 8+ years of progressive experience across Human Resources, including HR operations, employee services, payroll, compliance, workforce administration, or related disciplines.
* Full English Fluency

Staffing partner owns the pod and is responsible to staff them to the right opportunity/role throughout their tenure at Publicis Sapient keeping in mind their individual career aspirations, business requirements and utilization.

title: SAP SF Compensation and variable pay
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION- SAP Compensation, Variable Pay & Benefits Lead**
**NOTE- Immediate to 15 Days Notice Period Candidates will be considered.**
**Position Overview**
Oversee and execute the end-to-end Compensation, Variable Pay, and Employee Benefits architecture. Ensure competitive, compliant, and data-driven pay structures while driving operational accuracy, cost efficiency, and strong alignment with business performance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Compensation Management
* Lead annual increment, merit, promotion, and market-adjustment cycles.
* Perform salary benchmarking and role evaluations using market data (e.g., Mercer, Aon).
* Manage salary bands, pay structures, and internal pay equity audits.
* Provide data-backed compensation proposals for new hires, promotions, and retention cases.
* Variable Pay & Incentives
* Design, administer, and govern short-term incentive, bonus, and sales pay plans.
* Execute monthly, quarterly, and annual variable pay calculations, audits, and payouts.
* Partner with Finance and Business Unit leaders to define, track, and validate target KPIs.
* Benefits Administration & Vendor Management
* Manage health insurance, leaves, wellness initiatives, and retirement benefits.
* Lead vendor management, SLA tracking, broker negotiations, and program renewals.
* Resolve escalated employee queries and ensure clear benefit policy communications.
* Governance & Statutory Compliance
* Maintain C&B policy compliance with statutory regulations (PF, Gratuity, ESIC, LWF, Minimum Wages).
* Maintain complete documentation and process controls for internal and external audit readiness.
* Standardize and automate Total Rewards workflows.
* Analytics, Modeling & Budgeting
* Build executive dashboards tracking C&B cost impacts, headcount metrics, and payout trends.
* Perform financial modeling and scenario planning to support strategic decision-making.
* Assist in annual budgeting and cost forecasting for pay, incentives, and benefits.
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Act as the C&B Subject Matter Expert (SME) for HRBPs, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and Business Leaders.
* Drive communication and rollout plans for annual rewards, incentive cycles, and policy updates.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Execution: 100% timeliness and zero-error accuracy in increment and variable pay cycles.
* Compliance: 100% statutory compliance and clean audit reports.
* Competitiveness: Alignment of salary bands with target market percentiles.
* Cost Efficiency: Effective benefit program renewals within budget parameters.

**Requirements & ProfileExperience & Education**

* Experience: 7–12 years of core experience in Compensation & Benefits or Total Rewards in mid-to-large enterprise environments.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, or Finance. MBA/PGDM preferred.

**Key Skills**

* Technical: Deep C&B domain expertise, Indian C&B statutory rules, Mercer/Aon benchmarking tools, advanced Excel modeling, and HRIS/payroll platforms.
* Competencies: Analytical problem-solving, high data accuracy and confidentiality, strong execution discipline, and clear stakeholder communication.

description:

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Oct 23, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1752689

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Position Title:** **Resource Management – Supervising Associate**

  

**About Global Delivery Services:**

  

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

  

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

  

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

  

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

  

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

**The Opportunity:**

  

As a part of a team, you will act as a Resource Management Hub Deputy Manager who provides consistent, high quality services to key business stakeholders.

**Your Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Service Delivery:**

* Manage end-to-end resource fulfilment, ensuring alignment with delivery timelines and business priorities.
* Oversee billing and finance operations related to resource deployment, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
* Own headcount planning to support growth and efficiency.
* Champion and lead Strategic Resource Management initiatives, aligning resource strategy with long-term business objectives.
* Monitor and improve service levels, turnaround times, and stakeholder satisfaction.

  

**Planning & Optimization:**

* Forecastdemand and plan capacity across skill sets.
* Maximize bench utilization and redeployment efficiency.
* Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and HR to align hiring plans with pipeline and delivery needs.

  

**Performance Management:**

* Establish and track KPIs for resource performance, utilization, and productivity.
* Conduct regular reviews with delivery leads to assess individual and team performance.

  

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Act as a strategic partner to delivery, business leaders.
* Facilitate governance forums to review resource allocation, pipeline, and performance metrics.
* Resolve escalations related to staffing conflicts, skill mismatches, or delivery risks.

  

**Data & Analytics:**

* Maintain accurate dashboards and reports on resource availability, utilization, and forecasting.
* Use data-driven insights to inform decision-making and identify improvement opportunities.

  

**Skills and attributes for success:**

  

* Hands on knowledge on End to End Resource management
* Be proficient in MS Project/Word/PowerPoint/Excel - working knowledge of MS office
* Knowledge in Data Visualisation tools would be an added advantage
* Exceptional communication skills - both written and oral
* Demonstrate strong organizational skills and structured thinking abilities
* Demonstrate strong interpersonal and analytical skills
* Demonstrate an eye for detail
* Be flexible and willing to adjust responsibilities to align with developing business needs
* Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity and rapid change

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have:**

  

* Graduate / MBA (preferably HR) with 12-14 years of overall experience with 8+ years of relevant experience in E2E resource management, deployment, forecasting and scheduling concepts.
* Exposure of short term and long-term resource planning would be an added advantage.

  

**What we look for:**

  

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunity to work with EY GDS practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

  

**What we offer you:**

  

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

  

* **Our Commitment:** As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* **Professional Development:** From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* **People and Culture:** In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* **Benefits:** Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* **How to Apply**: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Customer Engagement Manager
description:
**About Ema**
Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.
  
  
We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.
  
  
**The Role**
The Customer Engagement Manager owns a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts end-to-end: every engagement, every outcome, every relationship, every expansion opportunity. Think of this as the McKinsey Associate Partner model applied to enterprise AI delivery.
  
  
You are the single point of accountability for your accounts. The customer calls you — not your manager — when they have a problem. You staff delivery teams, oversee solution quality, run executive readouts, measure ROI, drive adoption, rebuild trust when things break, and grow the book through proven production value.
  
  
**This is not a project management role.**
This is an account ownership role that combines delivery orchestration, outcome ownership, customer leadership, and commercial growth.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* Account Ownership
* Own your accounts end-to-end: every engagement, every outcome, every relationship. Everything good or bad stops with you.
* Be the single point of contact the customer calls for any problem — delivery, quality, adoption, escalation, or expansion.
* Maintain a holistic view of each account: engagement status, risk exposure, opportunity pipeline, and the customer’s strategic priorities for the quarter.
* Run account planning: engagement roadmaps, resource forecasting, risk assessment, and growth strategy.
* Delivery Orchestration
* Staff and direct delivery teams (Engineering Leads, Product Managers) across your accounts.
* Oversee delivery quality across all engagements: review solution architectures, attend go-live rehearsals, ensure evaluation rigor.
* Manage cross-engagement dependencies within an account (e.g., shared integration infrastructure between parallel deployments).
* Serve as the delivery escalation point: join war rooms, coordinate fixes across Engineering and Product, and communicate resolution to the customer.
* You don’t write code — but you review architectures, challenge unrealistic scope, and ensure go-live readiness. Your leverage is orchestration and judgment.
* Outcome Ownership & Continuous Improvement
* Own post-go-live outcomes: adoption, ROI, accuracy, and user trust. This role absorbs the Outcomes Manager function for your accounts.
* Run regular usage readouts: AI deflection rates, false positive/negative trends, HITL escalation patterns, user bypass rates, and trust signals.
* Separate product gaps from process, training, or expectation gaps. Not everything that looks broken is an engineering problem.
* Drive continuous improvement cycles: readout → diagnose → prioritize → fix → re-measure.
* Communicate outcomes in business language: efficiency gains, cost savings, error reduction — not just dashboards, but diagnosis and action plans.
* Executive Stakeholder Leadership
* Run QBRs with VP/C-level stakeholders: present outcomes, risks, improvement plans, and the strategic roadmap.
* Navigate internal customer politics: when the VP of IT and VP of Business disagree on priorities, facilitate alignment around shared success metrics.
* Communicate bad news credibly: present the data, the diagnosis, and the recovery plan — without losing trust.
* Handle C-level escalations. When the CTO threatens to terminate or the CFO questions ROI, you are the person in the room.
* Commercial Growth
* Grow your book through outcome-driven expansion: deliver the first SOW excellently, measure ROI rigorously, present evidence to the C-suite, then propose the next SOW grounded in proven value.
* Identify new use cases by deeply understanding customer business processes and pain points — not by pushing a product catalog.
* Know when to push for expansion vs. when to stabilize. Premature expansion erodes trust. You earn the right to grow by delivering first.
* Co-sell with Sales: provide the delivery credibility and outcome evidence that makes expansion proposals close.
* Product & Platform Partnership
* Act as the voice of your customers to Product and Core Engineering. Translate field patterns into structured, actionable feedback — not one-off requests.
* Identify cross-customer patterns that signal platform gaps or opportunities.
* Partner with Product on customer-facing roadmap discussions: what’s coming, what’s not, and how to manage expectations.
* Team Development
* Coach Engineering Leads and Implementation Managers on architecture quality, customer communication, delivery discipline, and outcome thinking.
* Promote shared standards and best practices across engagements.
* Build reusable account-level assets: engagement playbooks, QBR templates, outcome tracking frameworks, and expansion qualification criteria.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 15+ years in enterprise technology delivery, consulting, account management, or customer leadership.
* 5+ years owning enterprise accounts end-to-end: delivery, outcomes, relationship, and growth — not individual projects within someone else’s account.
* Track record managing or directing delivery teams (Engineering Leads, TPMs, consultants) assigned to their accounts.
* Post-go-live outcome ownership: measured ROI, tracked adoption, driven continuous improvement, and rebuilt trust after production issues.
* Commercial accountability: grown account revenue through outcome-driven expansion, not just retention.
* Enterprise stakeholder management at VP/C-level across multiple concurrent accounts.
* Production track record — beyond POCs. Scale and accountability required.

**Preferred**

* Experience with AI, automation, or agentic workflow platforms in production.
* Background at a consulting firm (McKinsey, BCG, Deloitte) or enterprise SaaS PS org (ServiceNow, Salesforce, UiPath) in a delivery-heavy account leadership role.
* Experience with partner-mediated delivery (delivering through consulting partners to end clients).
* Familiarity with enterprise integrations (APIs, auth, CRM/HRIS/ITSM platforms) at a judgment level, not implementation level.
* Experience in a scaling startup ($5M–$50M ARR) where account management practices were being built, not inherited.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
  
  
Ema Unlimited is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering

* The ability to learn and assimilate new information quickly

* The ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work within fixed deadlines
* The ability to foster customer relationships
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and Salesforce
* Culture Agility. Comfort working in a fast-paced, candid environment that values innovation, healthy debate, and follow-through
* AI Readiness. Curiosity and willingness to use AI and emerging technologies to elevate your work and deliver smarter outcomes
* Fuel performance and outcomes. Leverage your job competencies and champion NAVEX’s core values

**Our side of the deal:**  

* We’ll be clear, we’ll move fast, and we’ll invest in your success. You deserve to be supported, challenged, and rewarded for the impact you make—and we commit to doing that every step of the way.
* The starting pay rate for this role is 990,000 INR per annum. Shifts ending between 12:00 AM IST and 07:00 AM IST are eligible for a night shift differential of 500 INR/day. Discover how you can grow, lead, and make an impact by visiting our career page to learn more. title: Managing Consultant Corporate Strategy & Development
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**  
Corporate Strategy professionals shape Kyndryl's long-term direction and growth by leading high-impact, cross-functional initiatives and supporting executive decision-making. They partner closely with senior leaders to develop and execute enterprise strategies, leverage market, financial, customer, and competitive insights, and solve complex business challenges that drive growth and enterprise value.

Combining strategic thinking, analytical rigour, financial expertise, business case development, and executive communication skills, they support strategic planning, growth initiatives, investment decisions, and enterprise transformation programs that strengthen competitive advantage and deliver sustainable business outcomes.Are you a strategic thinker with a passion for shaping the future of a global technology company? Are you energized by the opportunity to work directly with senior leaders on high-impact initiatives that influence growth, investment decisions, and long-term enterprise strategy? Then we have a unique opportunity for you as a Managing Consultant, Corporate Strategy.

In this role, you will lead and support some of Kyndryl's most important strategic priorities, helping define the choices that shape the company's future direction and growth. Working closely with senior executives, business-unit leaders, finance teams, and cross-functional stakeholders, you will evaluate complex business challenges, identify opportunities for value creation, and develop recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes.

  
  

**What You Will Do**

  

* As a Managing Consultant, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact across the enterprise.
* You will partner with leadership teams to develop corporate and business-unit strategies, assess growth opportunities, evaluate investment priorities, and support critical executive decisions.
* You will conduct rigorous market research, competitive benchmarking, strategic assessments, and financial analyses to identify emerging opportunities, address key business challenges, and help position Kyndryl for long-term success in a dynamic and rapidly evolving marketplace.
* You will play a central role in strategic planning, business case development, and enterprise transformation initiatives.
* Leveraging your analytical rigor, structured problem-solving capabilities, and financial expertise, you will develop executive-level recommendations, strategic roadmaps, investment theses, and implementation plans that enable leadership teams to make informed, fact-based decisions.
* You will also help ensure alignment across stakeholders, monitor progress against strategic objectives, and support the successful execution of critical initiatives.
* Our consultants are restless for innovation.
    
  They thrive at the intersection of business strategy, technology, and transformation, helping shape the future of Kyndryl and our customers.
    
  So, if you are a problem-solver, an analytical thinker, and a self-starter who enjoys working on high-visibility assignments with senior leadership, we want to hear from you. Apply today to join our dynamic team and help solve the strategic challenges that will define Kyndryl's next chapter.

  
  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Becoming a Project Manager at Kyndryl is an excellent gateway to many different paths. You’ll be creating a well-rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications.You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non-technical areas such as Technical Service Architect, or you can move vertically to become a Senior Project Manager or program manager. There are many different types and flavors of project manager roles, so everyone can find the opportunity that suits them best.

**Who You Are**

You are an experienced corporate strategy, business consulting professional - you are good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important - you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are commercially minded and customer-focused - someone who prioritizes customer success, understands enterprise buying behaviour, brings extensive stakeholder-facing exposure, and applies critical thinking to complex business problems. And finally, you are open and borderless - naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Advanced graduate degree (e.g., MBA, PhD) in business, economics, finance, engineering, analytics, or a related field
* Over 7 years of experience in corporate strategy, pricing strategy, go-to-market strategy, commercial strategy, or management consulting, with 4+ years preferably with leading management consulting firms or technology services / software companies
* Demonstrated expertise developing GTM and pricing strategies for managed services, cloud services, software / SaaS, IT infrastructure, or hybrid technology offerings
* Ability to build robust business cases, price waterfalls, margin analyses, elasticity assessments, unit economics models, total cost of ownership models, and customer ROI frameworks
* Experience shaping go-to-market strategies, including sales and channel motions, portfolio positioning, launch planning, customer segmentation, partner monetization, and KPI frameworks
* Skilled in gathering and synthesizing data, conducting market research, competitive benchmarking, customer research, and translating insights into actionable recommendations
* Strong critical thinking, data analysis, financial modeling, and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize ambiguity into clear executive choices
* Ability to lead independent workstreams within larger corporate strategy initiatives and influence stakeholders across Offering, Sales, Finance, Delivery, Legal, and executive leadership
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for developing executive and board-level presentations, pricing recommendations, decision memos, and implementation roadmaps
Extensive customer-facing or stakeholder-facing exposure with strong commercial acumen, including familiarity with enterprise procurement dynamics, deal economics, and technology services / software sales cycles  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience in global technology services, managed infrastructure, cloud, software / SaaS, cybersecurity, IT modernization, or hyperscale partner ecosystems
* Experience supporting pricing transformations, portfolio simplification, commercial governance, go-to-market redesign, sales enablement, or partner monetization programs
* Familiarity with pricing analytics, CRM / CPQ workflows, cloud financial management / FinOps, product management practices, or software licensing operations
Industry certifications or training in cloud platforms, FinOps, pricing, product management, strategic finance, or related disciplines  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: MGR SYSTEMS ARCHITECT - INDIA
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

**The Role**
------------

Team Management: Mgr. Systems Architects manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects, lead architects, and associate managers, assigning them to the right Agile Release Trains (ARTs).
  
Guidance and Mentorship: They guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently, mentor reportees, and ensure they contribute towards achieving business goals and managing technical debt.
  
Architectural Oversight: They oversee system design and roadmap, drive architectural initiatives, identify opportunities for optimization, and ensure designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT guidelines.
  
Coordination Across ARTs: Mgr. Systems Architects ensure technology alignments across ARTs, confirm capabilities meet Definition of Ready (DoR), and review estimates and critical features by working with other architects.
  
Production Performance and Stability: They maintain full awareness of application performance in production environments, participate in SWAT calls to address stability issues, and help document root causes.
  
Engagement and Collaboration: They engage with system architects, outside vendors, and various teams to review and ensure the success of designs, and participate in Continuous Exploration processes.

**The Main Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects / lead architects / associate mgr system architects and assign to right ARTs.
* Guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently
* Enable system architects in the team to own and contribute towards achieving business goals and technical debt.
* Understand overall system design and roadmap
* Drive architectural initiatives and identify opportunities for optimization
* Oversee, mentor and guide reportees.
* Identify areas where POCs are required and assign to reportees as appropriate and track the same to completion.
* Mgr System Architects manage reportees working across ARTs.
* Ensure technology alignments across ARTs; align teams of multiple ARTs to a shared technical direction by working with respective ART System architects
* Confirm Capability meets Definition of Ready (DoR) before approving for multiple ARTs
* Attend and participate in Mass Markets Architecture Review Boards
* Review Capability estimates by working closely with other system architects across ARTs.
* Ensure ART system designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT roadmap, guidelines, principles
* Review critical enabler Features and NFRs created by ART architects
* Engage with other system architects and establish an integrated technical design
* Engage with outside vendors to ensure design success
* Engage system architects to review designs and ensure complete end to end success (ie. Omni channel, flow through, etc.)
* Actively participate in the Continuous Exploration (keeping up with the industry) process as part of the Continuous Delivery Pipeline, especially with Enabler Epics
* Collaborate with their application/service development team, Load and Performance team, chaos engineering team, SRE SPOC etc.
* Have full awareness of application/service performance in production environment, upstream / downstream applications, database performance characteristics etc.
* Participate in Proactive / Reactive SWAT calls to address production stability issues, help teams on identifying and documenting accurate root cause of issues.
* Review ART technical enabler Feature content
* Review ART environment performance, stability, and scalability targets
* Review critical nonfunctional requirements. Provide inputs based on production stability, performance issues, bottle necks, User experience issues, security etc.
* Review ART system designs focused on system components which align to the larger end state designs
* Review ART technical system design documents
* Review deisgn of subsystems and their interfaces; allocate responsibilities to subsystems; understand design deployment; communicate requirements for interactions within design context.
* Review ART data flow, sources, storage, format
* Review technical and architectural vision for the ARTs and provide inputs to system architects

**What We Look For in a Candidate**
-----------------------------------

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  

* Minimum 10 years of software development experience, with deep expertise in C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework / EF Core, and LINQ.
* At least 3 years in a solution/application architect role, an engineering manager role, or both.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise applications on Microsoft Azure.
* Strong expertise in microservices, API design, distributed systems, and design patterns (including SOLID, domain-driven design, CQRS, and event-driven architecture).
* Deep experience with Microsoft SQL Server: data modeling, complex T-SQL, stored procedures, indexing, query and performance tuning, execution plans, and transaction and locking behavior.
* Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, and modern CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Strong knowledge of application security, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, Azure AD / Entra ID, secrets management, and secure handling of sensitive financial data.
* Experience with observability and production support tools such as Application Insights and Azure Monitor.
* Experience leading Agile/Scrum teams using Jira (Confluence is a plus).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across time zones with US-based leadership and business teams.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills
  

* AI/ML: experience designing or delivering AI/ML or LLM-powered solutions (RAG, agents, Semantic Kernel, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning).
* Palantir: exposure to Palantir Foundry or AIP.
* Python: hands-on experience with Python for services, automation, or data work.
* Multi-cloud: experience architecting across AWS or Google Cloud in addition to Azure.
* Containers and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes (AKS).
* Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or Bicep.
* Front-end architecture experience with Angular, React, or Blazor.
* Experience with messaging and streaming platforms (Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Kafka).
* Domain knowledge in billing, payments, invoicing, collections, revenue management, or other financial systems, ideally in telecom or large enterprise.

  

What We're Looking For
  

* A leader who balances hands-on technical depth with strong people management.
* A strategic thinker who can set a clear technical direction and turn it into practical delivery plans.
* Someone who builds trust across teams and time zones through clear, proactive communication.
* A mentor who enjoys developing engineers and raising the bar for the whole team.
* Someone excited to help the team adopt cloud and AI in a responsible, business-focused way.

Requisition #: 343990

  

**Life at Lumen**

Life at Lumen is human and connected, even in a fast moving, AI‑focused organization. We set clear expectations and trust people to meet them. With real support and shared accountability, teams collaborate better, move faster, and deliver meaningful outcomes.

Our Lumen 8 behaviors guide how we interact, make decisions, and work together, shaping a culture built to perform and win.

To learn more about Life at Lumen and how we live the Lumen 8, please visit:
