title: Staff Technical Account Manager
description:
What You'll Do:

The Staff Technical Account Manager is responsible is a critical member of Avalara’s support organization, responsible for managing technical tickets, ensuring timely resolution, and driving customer satisfaction for our Enterprise. Involving complex product and connector issues that cannot be fully resolved through frontline troubleshooting alone, while improving the speed, quality, and consistency of engineering engagement. This is an engineering-aligned support talent that can reduce time to resolution, improve case quality, raise the standard of Jira submissions, and turn repeat issues into durable knowledge and process improvements. It also reflects Avalara’s broader need to embed AI into technical support in practical ways that improve investigation speed, communication quality, and team scalability. In addition to resolving complex issues, this role is expected to use AI in day-to-day work to accelerate research, strengthen technical analysis, improve case documentation, and identify opportunities to make technical support more effective and scalable over time.

The business outcome this role enables is straightforward: better customer experience, faster and more reliable resolution of complex cases, better use of engineering capacity, stronger support scalability, and fewer repeat incidents over time. By combining technical judgment with thoughtful AI adoption, this role also helps Avalara improve how support work is performed, not just how individual cases are resolved.

**How This Role Elevates Avalara**

* This role raises the technical bar of Enterprise Support by bringing stronger investigation discipline, better case documentation, cleaner handoffs, more effective Jira creation, and clearer collaboration with Product and Engineering. It also improves the capability of the broader support organization by turning difficult cases into reusable knowledge, troubleshooting actions, and support-ready guidance that reduces future rework.
* This role helps Avalara reduce unnecessary Jira volume, improve the quality of engineering escalations, and protect engineering capacity for the issues that truly require development effort. It also supports better operational performance through stronger SLA discipline, cleaner milestone adherence, faster TTR, and more predictable case outcomes.
* This role improves customer trust by ensuring that the most complex issues are handled with technical depth, clear communication, accurate diagnosis, and accountable resolution ownership. It also improves the long-term customer experience by reducing repeat incidents and strengthening self-service through better knowledge assets and preventative actions.
* Protect and increase Enterprise customer revenue and retention by resolving complex customer-impacting issues quickly and accurately.
* For customers, the TAM provides a trusted technical partner who understands their environment, anticipates risk, and delivers clarity during high-impact situations. This proactive, relationship-driven approach increases platform reliability, improves customer experience, and drives long-term success

What Your Responsibilities Will Be:

* Provide leadership and mentorship to TAMs – providing knowledge sessions, brown-bag training and advanced troubleshooting of APIs and ERPs.
* Own a portfolio of Avalara’s Enterprise customers with premium support entitlement.
* Own complex support cases from assignment through verified resolution, especially where advanced troubleshooting, reproduction, deep product analysis, or engineering coordination is required.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis across ERP/CRM/eCommerce platforms (NetSuite, D365, SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Shopify, Workday, etc.).

* Diagnose customer issues across AvaTax, connectors, and related workflows by reproducing issues, gathering diagnostics, isolating scope, documenting findings, and confirming business impact.
* Determine when engineering involvement is warranted and ensure Jira tickets are necessary, complete, technically credible, and supported by strong due diligence before submission.
* Create, refine, and manage Jira tickets that clearly describe the issue, expected and actual behaviour, troubleshooting completed, reproduction detail, supporting evidence, and urgency.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to drive defect resolution, maintain momentum on linked development work, and keep customer cases moving while internal work is in progress.
* Maintain strong customer communication discipline by meeting milestone expectations, providing proactive updates, responding quickly to new customer messages, and keeping status and documentation audit ready.
* Improve support effectiveness beyond the individual case by completing troubleshooting of the issues and analysis on major or repeat issues and contributing knowledge articles, playbooks, or reusable troubleshooting guidance that reduce repeat volume.
* Contribute to High priority support or production-support responsiveness where applicable by providing fast technical guidance, validating escalation paths, and helping the broader support organization make better decisions earlier in the case lifecycle.
* Act as a technical role model for quality, ownership, and judgment in how cases are investigated, escalated, documented, and resolved.
* Contribute to responsible AI adoption by using sound judgment, validating outputs, and ensuring that final recommendations, communications, and actions remain accurate and customer ready.
* Help embed AI into support ways of working by sharing effective use cases, improving repeatable practices, and supporting continuous improvement across the team.

**12-Month Success Signals**

* Consistently meets or exceeds SLA targets and maintains high CSAT scores.
* Reduces complex escalation backlog and improves average resolution time.
* Contributes documented root-cause fixes that decrease repeat incidents.
* Delivers measurable efficiency gains through AI-assisted workflows (e.g., reduced case handling time, improved documentation speed).

  
What You'll Need to be Successful:

**At Avalara, this role is expected to be a bar raiser for Support Engineering, leveraging technical expertise, data-driven insights, and AI-enabled capabilities to elevate troubleshooting, accelerate issue resolution, and prevent recurring customer problems. They continuously improve support operations, knowledge management, and team effectiveness while delivering exceptional customer outcomes.**

  

* Raise the bar for the team. Provide guidance, improve execution quality, and leave cases, routing, and knowledge resources better than you found them.
* Own complex cases end to end. Drive the issue forward, clarify ambiguity, follow up proactively, and make sure cases do not stall waiting on others.
* Identify and drove resolution of recurring product defects, resulting in improved customer experience and reduced support volume.
* Consistently achieve high customer satisfaction scores through effective issue ownership, technical expertise, and proactive communication.
* Reduce critical issue resolution time to 5 days through structured root cause analysis and cross-functional collaboration.

**AI Bar Raiser Expectations:**  
  
**This role is expected to be an AI Bar Raiser, applying AI in a deliberate and impactful way to improve how technical issues are diagnosed, resolved, and prevented, while elevating the team’s ability to use AI to drive meaningful gains in support efficiency, knowledge quality, technical troubleshooting, and customer outcomes.**

* Leverage AI-powered tools to accelerate root cause analysis and reduce troubleshooting time for complex customer issues.
* Identify and implement new AI-driven approaches to technical support (e.g., automated diagnostics, intelligent case triage, predictive risk identification) that go beyond current team practices
* Utilize Generative AI to create knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and customer-facing documentation, improving knowledge accessibility and consistency
* Develop AI-driven workflows that automated repetitive support tasks, increasing team productivity and reducing manual effort.
* Create AI-powered prompt libraries and support playbooks that standardized troubleshooting approaches across the team.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to integrate AI-driven customer feedback analysis into product improvement initiatives.
* Champion AI adoption across the support organization, driving measurable improvements in resolution efficiency and support quality.
* Use AI insights to prioritize critical customer issues based on business impact, severity, and historical trends.

**Qualifications A**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of proven experience in handling complex technical issues in SaaS, APIs, integrations, or similar environments, with strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.
* Expert experience with ERP/CRM/eCommerce platforms: NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, SAP S/4 Hana, SageX, Salesforce, Magento, Oracle, Shopify, Workday, or similar systems is required
* Demonstrated proficiency in API and workflow analysis across ERP, e-Commerce, and Marketplace platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with Engineering/Product teams and manage high-quality escalation artifacts (e.g., Jira) with clear technical detail.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working in SLA-driven support environments using tools such as Salesforce, Jira, and Confluence.
* Mandatory experience using AI tools and automation to improve support efficiency, diagnostics, communication quality, and scalability.

  
Avalara is an AI-first Company:

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

  
What You Need To Know About Avalara:

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Account Director, Digital Natives
description:
**About The Team**
OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.
  
  
In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.
  
  
**About The Role**
Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy.
  
  
You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI.
  
  
This role can be based in Delhi or Mumbai
  
  
**In This Role, You'll**

* Manage a portfolio of customer accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan
* Support your customer accounts from initial engagement to successful deployment and through to renewal
* Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects
* Own a revenue target
* Manage revenue forecasts
* Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders
* Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies
* Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering
* Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates
* Support the development of company culture

**We're Seeking Someone With Experience Including**

* 7+ years selling and renewing platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service
* Designing and executing complex deal strategies
* Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies
* Working directly with c-level executives
* Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders
* Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence

**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**

* Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor.
* Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future.
* Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision.
* Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re willing to experiment with new solutions.
* Are a strategist. You deeply understand go to market best practices and raise the bar for our organization. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy.

**About OpenAI**
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. title: Sr. Delivery Consultant, Customer Experience, Professional Services
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Delivery Consultant specializing in Amazon Connect Customer Experience to join AWS Professional Services. In this role, you will design, build, and deliver complex customer experience solutions on Amazon Connect, serving as the technical authority for enterprise-grade contact center transformations. You will spend \*\*80% of your time\*\* hands-on — architecting and implementing CX solutions — while leading pre-sales engagements, driving team capability development, and integrating AI-native approaches into every engagement.
  
  
This is a customer-facing delivery leadership role that combines deep technical execution with strategic consulting, pre-sales leadership, and practice development.
  
  
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
* Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
* Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
* Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
* Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts

## Required Qualifications
  
  
### Technical Expertise
  
  

* \*\*10+ years\*\* of hands-on experience designing and implementing Amazon Connect solutions (or equivalent enterprise contact center platforms with 3+ years on Connect)
* \*\*Deep proficiency\*\* in Amazon Connect ecosystem: Contact Flows, Routing Profiles, Contact Lens, Amazon Q in Connect, Lex, Outbound Campaigns, Tasks, Cases, and Customer Profiles
* \*\*Strong software engineering skills\*\* — Python, TypeScript/Node.js, AWS CDK/CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, serverless architectures (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS)
* \*\*AI/ML competency\*\* — practical experience implementing generative AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock, LLM-based agents, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and conversational AI (Lex, Q in Connect)
* \*\*Integration expertise\*\* — building production integrations with CRM/ITSM systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk), telephony (SIP/PSTN), and workforce management platforms
* \*\*Architecture at scale\*\* — designing multi-region, multi-tenant, highly available contact center architectures handling 10,000+ concurrent contacts

### Consulting & Leadership
  
  

* \*\*Pre-sales experience\*\* — led or co-led 5+ customer proposals/SOWs including effort estimation, delivery planning, and technical presentations to senior stakeholders
* \*\*Delivery leadership\*\* — managed end-to-end delivery on engagements with 5+ team members, navigating scope changes, customer escalations, and go-live coordination
* \*\*Stakeholder management\*\* — demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships with VP/C-level customer stakeholders
* \*\*Mentoring track record\*\* — coached or mentored 3+ junior consultants; contributed to team hiring decisions

### Certifications (Required or within 6 months of hire)
  
  

* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner or ML Specialty
* Amazon Connect Specialty (or equivalent demonstrated expertise)

\* \* \*
  
  
## Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with \*\*Amazon Connect Agent Workspace\*\*, \*\*Step-by-step Guides\*\*, and \*\*Connect APIs\*\* for custom CRM embedding
* Hands-on with \*\*agentic AI frameworks\*\* — multi-agent orchestration, MCP (Model Context Protocol), AgentCore, Strands SDK
* Knowledge of \*\*contact center operations\*\* — WFM, quality management, compliance recording, PCI-DSS, HIPAA considerations
* Experience \*\*migrating legacy platforms\*\* (Genesys, Avaya, Cisco, NICE) to Amazon Connect
* Background in \*\*voice AI\*\* — real-time STT/TTS, voice biometrics, IVR modernization, voicebot design
* Published \*\*thought leadership\*\* — blogs, conference talks, whitepapers, or reference architectures in the CX/contact center domain
* Familiarity with \*\*ProServe delivery mechanisms\*\* — PDLC, engagement management, CSAT frameworks, utilization tracking

\* \* \*
  
  
## Working Model
  
  

* \*\*80% Delivery:\*\* Hands-on customer engagements — designing, building, deploying Connect CX solutions
* \*\*10% Pre-Sales:\*\* Discovery workshops, proposals, estimations, customer presentations
* \*\*10% Practice:\*\* Team mentoring, capability uplift, TFC contributions, product team collaboration

\* \* \*
  
  
## About the Team
  
  
AWS Professional Services works with enterprise customers to accelerate cloud adoption and realize transformational business outcomes. The Connect CX practice delivers contact center modernization, AI-powered customer experience solutions, and omnichannel transformation programs for some of the world's largest organizations.
  
  
We are builders who are obsessed with customer outcomes, thrive in ambiguity, and believe the best solutions come from deep technical expertise combined with genuine curiosity about customer problems.
  
  
\* \* \*
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Delivery (80%)

Architect and deliver complex Amazon Connect implementations including multi-channel (voice, chat, email, task) contact center solutions for enterprise customers
  
  

* Design end-to-end CX solutions encompassing contact flows, routing strategies, agent workspaces, real-time and historical analytics, workforce management integration, and omnichannel orchestration
* Lead technical delivery on engagements valued at $1M+ — owning architecture decisions, HLD/LLD documentation, implementation patterns, and production go-live
* Build production-grade integrations with CRM systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow), backend applications, and third-party platforms using Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge, and Step Functions
* Implement AI-powered capabilities including Amazon Q in Connect, Contact Lens, Lex-based conversational AI, generative AI agents, sentiment analysis, real-time transcription, and intelligent routing
* Design and deploy agentic AI solutions multi-agent orchestration, tool-calling frameworks, prompt engineering, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows within the contact center context
* Ensure operational excellence establish monitoring (CloudWatch, Contact Lens), alerting, disaster recovery, and performance optimization for production contact center environments
* Create reusable delivery accelerators CDK constructs, solution patterns, reference architectures, and automation frameworks that reduce future engagement timelines
* Pre-Sales Leadership (10%)
* Lead customer discovery conduct workshops, ideation sessions, and technical deep-dives to understand customer pain points and define CX transformation roadmaps
* Create compelling proposals develop SOWs, technical architectures, effort estimations, and delivery plans for complex Connect engagements
* Present to C-suite and senior stakeholders articulate business value, ROI projections, and differentiated solution approaches during competitive evaluations

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Hiring: Customer Success Manager (CSM) – Gurugram

**Company:** TechMutant Software Solutions LLP  
**Position:** Customer Success Manager (CSM)  
**Department:** Customer Success & Client Relations  
**Final Work Location:** Sector 44, Gurugram, Haryana  
**Initial Training Location:** Ludhiana, Punjab  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Work from Office  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years Preferred  
**Industry:** SaaS / Software Products / EdTech  
**Training & Probation:** 3 Months (Mandatory In-Person Training in Ludhiana)  
**Salary:** Competitive, based on experience and skills

**About TechMutant**

TechMutant Software Solutions LLP is a growing product-based software company delivering technology-driven solutions designed to improve organizational efficiency, streamline business processes, and enhance operational productivity.

As part of our business expansion, we are looking for a capable and self-driven **Customer Success Manager** to manage client relationships, software implementation, customer onboarding, training, and ongoing customer success operations.

**Job Description:**

We are hiring a Customer Success Manager for our Gurugram office who will be responsible for managing the complete customer lifecycle and ensuring an excellent customer experience.

The selected candidate must be willing to complete **three months of mandatory in-person training and probation at our Ludhiana office** before transitioning to the Gurugram office.

This is a hands-on role requiring the candidate to independently manage customer success activities, including implementation, client support, training, issue resolution, and relationship management.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Customer Onboarding & Software Implementation**

* Lead the onboarding process for newly acquired customers.
* Understand customer business requirements and implementation expectations.
* Coordinate software setup, configuration, and customization requirements with the technical team.
* Track implementation activities, timelines, and completion status.
* Ensure smooth handover from the sales process to ongoing customer success operations.

**2. Client Training & Product Adoption**

* Conduct software demonstrations and structured training sessions for customers.
* Train client teams on product functionality, features, and operational workflows.
* Assist customers in using the software effectively.
* Monitor customer adoption and identify areas requiring additional guidance.

**3. Customer Support & Escalation Management**

* Serve as a primary contact for customer questions, requests, and concerns.
* Manage customer support calls, emails, and follow-up communications.
* Identify functional issues and escalate technical problems to the development team where necessary.
* Monitor issue resolution timelines and communicate progress to customers.
* Ensure customer complaints and support activities are properly documented.

**4. Client Relationship Management & Retention**

* Develop and maintain positive, long-term customer relationships.
* Conduct regular follow-ups to understand customer satisfaction and product usage.
* Identify customer concerns, service gaps, and potential retention risks.
* Support subscription renewals and continued customer engagement.
* Coordinate with internal teams to address customer feedback and improvement requests.

**5. Customer Success Operations & Reporting**

* Maintain detailed customer records, implementation updates, and issue trackers.
* Prepare regular reports on onboarding, customer support, client satisfaction, and retention activities.
* Track performance against defined customer success KPIs and service standards.
* Coordinate with management, sales, and development departments.
* Recommend process improvements to strengthen customer experience and operational efficiency.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, IT, Computer Applications, or a related discipline.
* Preferably 2–5 years of professional experience in Customer Success, SaaS Implementation, Software Support, or Account Management.
* Good understanding of software implementation and client onboarding processes.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple clients and responsibilities independently.
* Strong analytical thinking, customer-handling, and problem-solving abilities.
* Familiarity with CRM tools, Excel, Google Sheets, and operational reporting.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Willingness to work from the Gurugram office after completing the mandatory training period.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience working with B2B SaaS or EdTech software companies.
* Hands-on knowledge of ERP, LMS, CRM, or enterprise software implementation.
* Previous responsibility for customer onboarding, training, account retention, or implementation coordination.
* Familiarity with SLAs, escalation management, customer satisfaction metrics, and performance reporting.

**Mandatory Training & Probation – Important**

**All selected candidates for the Gurugram position must complete their initial three months of in-person training and probation at TechMutant's Ludhiana office in Punjab.**

The training will focus on:

* Understanding company software products and internal processes.
* Practical client onboarding and software implementation.
* Customer support handling, troubleshooting, and technical coordination.
* Client training, documentation, and customer relationship management.
* Customer Success KPIs, reporting, and operational procedures.

After successful completion of the initial training and probation period, the candidate will transition to the **Gurugram office in Sector 44, Haryana**.

**Candidates must be comfortable working in Ludhiana for the full initial three-month period before applying.**

How to Apply

Interested candidates may share their updated resumes at:

**Email:** Lovepreet@techmutant.com  
**Subject:** Application for Customer Success Manager – Gurugram

**Final Work Location:** Sector 44, Gurugram, Haryana (On-Site)  
**Initial Training Location:** Ludhiana, Punjab (3 Months – Mandatory)

Pay: ₹420,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Gurugram, Haryana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Experience:

* Customer relationship management: 2 years (Required)
* Customer support: 3 years (Required)
* Education administration: 1 year (Preferred)
* IT support: 1 year (Required)
* SaaS : 1 year (Required)

Location:

* Gurugram, Haryana (Preferred)

Willingness to travel:

* 50% (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Assistant Fraud Strategy Manager
description:
Date live: 10/23/2026

Business Area: In Business BSS

Area of Expertise: Product Development & Management

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000132094

  

Join us as a an Assistant Fraud Strategy Manager at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
  
  
You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with Product owner, Analytical Skills, Business Acumen, and Stakeholder Management as well as job-specific skillsets.

You will work closely with business, operations and cross-functional partners to solve complex problems, shape scalable solutions, and ensure efficient delivery. Acting as the key interface between business and functional stakeholders, you will support the development of product propositions, and/or service strategies—from concept and release.

To be successful as an Assistant Fraud Strategy Manager, you should have experience with:

  
  

**Critical / Essential Skills:**

* Define clear business requirements, manage prioritised backlogs and support feature teams through delivery using Agile ways of working and JIRA.
* Extract and analyse data from Barclays Information Warehouse using Structured Query Language, translating complex datasets into clear, business-focused insights and recommendations.
* Apply statistical and analytical techniques to identify fraud loss trends, performance drivers, root causes, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Use management information, dashboards, funnel data, complaints, contact drivers and customer feedback to support evidence-based decision-making.
* Own and assess customer journeys end to end, map pain points and conduct journey health checks to improve customer and colleague outcomes.
* Establish, monitor and interpret journey and customer-outcome measures, including Net Promoter Score, complaints, customer effort, fraud losses and operational performance.
* Investigate complex customer and fraud-related issues and translate findings into strategic and operational change initiatives.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of risk, control and governance practices, including Operational Risk and Control Assessments, issue management, Consumer Duty, control monitoring, evidence gathering and escalation.
* Exercise sound judgement on when to act, align or escalate, particularly where customer harm or regulatory risk may arise.
* Build effective relationships with stakeholders across the United Kingdom and India, including Product, Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Controls and Customer Experience teams.
* Coordinate cross-functional and cross-skilled teams to deliver sustainable journey, fraud strategy and customer-outcome improvements.
* Produce high-quality governance materials, management information, presentations and written recommendations for senior decision-makers.
* Apply structured problem-solving, strategic thinking, attention to detail and ownership to resolve complex business challenges.
* Demonstrate commercial acumen and knowledge of market trends and the competitor landscape to benchmark performance and inform priorities.
* Use artificial intelligence-enabled tools responsibly to improve analysis, insight generation, backlog quality and documentation, while retaining accountability for outcomes.
* Use Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint to at least an intermediate level.
  

  

**Desirable skillsets/ good to have:**

* Fraud and scam domain knowledge.
* SQL skills
* Experience supporting AI-enabled processes or transformation.
* Fraud and scam loss management.
* Ability to monitor and interpret loss performance, emerging fraud trends and portfolio risk indicators.
* Experience conducting root cause analysis (RCA) to identify key drivers of fraud and scam losses and define improvement actions.
* Experience supporting loss management, portfolio reviews or performance governance forums.

This role will be based out of Gurugram.

**Purpose of the role**

Product Managers are responsible for the leading the strategic focus of the product(s), defining the product vision, market strategy, and competitive analysis. They think about the product's future and how it will evolve over time. They work with various teams, including marketing, engineering, operations, and sales, to ensure everyone is aligned on the product strategy. They use data and market research to inform their decisions and prioritize product features.

**Accountabilities**

* Define Product Strategy: Accountable for defining a product strategy that aligns with business vision, managing capabilities, balancing short-term with long-term goals, ensuring that products meet market demands and drive growth.
* Cross functional alignment: Leadership of cross functional relationships, working with various cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of product strategy and goals.
* Risk and Control: Accountable for overseeing product risk management, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to mitigate those risks, and maintenance of alignment between the product management and control functions.
* Product Development Lifecycle: Own product development lifecycle, from concept to launch, ensuring efficient processes, on-time delivery, and alignment with E2E customer expectations and experience. – working with product owners to drive change objectives.
* Deliver Product Goals and Performance: Deliver clear objectives and key outcomes to steer the product vision and ensure alignment with company’s business goals, financial targets, and strategic vision, driving long-term business success.
* Data driven decisions: Monitor product performance through data-driven analysis and insights, regularly assessing progress against objectives and adjusting the strategies as needed to optimise outcomes and maximise value for both business and customer.
* Customer-Centric Focus: Drive a customer -first approach across the product vision, ensuring customer insights, feedback, behaviours, and pain points are at the core of the product strategy and decision-making process.
* Business and financial acumen: Understanding pricing models, costs structures, and ROI to make financially grounded decisions regarding product development.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

description: Founding Head — Utilities Field ProductBuild, roll out and grow OriginBluy's new field platform for gas utilities, from the first site to the next client.About OriginBluyOriginBluy is building a new product: a field work platform that connects a city gas company's contractors, customer care and customers in one live job record. with care and service centre heads so their teams use the live job status in SAP.Present pilot progress to the MD and senior leadership: what moved, what is stuck, what you need from them.Building the the pilot scorecard every week and own the numbers.Recruit and manage one or two field coordinators as the pilot scales.Document the playbook so the next city can be launched faster.Growing the businessTurn the pilot results into a clear, evidence-backed case for other gas utilities.Build a pipeline of target utilities, in Gujarat first and then other states.Run demos and discussions with MDs and heads of operations, projects and customer care.Shape proposals, pricing and pilot terms with the Founder.Lead new pilots and convert them into long-term contracts.Keep the first client a strong, willing reference.Who you areMandatory: real, hands-on ground experience. 8–12 years doing field work yourself in city gas distribution, a utility, or an EPC or pipeline contractor, as a site engineer, site manager or operations manager. You have sold to, or won business from, utilities, PSUs or large industrial clients, or you are clearly ready to. title: GENERAL MANAGER – AURAWILL BUSINESS
description:
We're Hiring: General Manager – Aurawill

📍 Location: Coimbatore

🏢 Full-time | On-site

Aurawill is one of India's fastest-growing nutrition brands, making traditional, science-backed nutrition simple and accessible for modern families.

In just over a year, we've earned the trust of 1,00,000+ customers and are expanding rapidly across D2C, marketplaces, quick-commerce and retail.

Aurawill is looking for a strong commercial General Manager to own the Brand’s business end-to-end and take responsibility for scaling the brand profitably. This role is for someone who is ready to own the full business rather than a single functional vertical.

The Opportunity

Aurawill is a natural health foods brand with an ambition to build a differentiated, trusted and scalable consumer business. The General Manager will be responsible for translating the brand ambition into business growth i.e owning the P&L, shaping strategy, setting priorities and leading the teams and functions required to deliver the plan.

What You Will Own

**P&L and Business Strategy:**
Own the overall Aurawill P&L and business plan; set revenue, gross margin, contribution, profitability and growth priorities; identify the biggest business levers and allocate resources and budgets accordingly.

**Sales channels:**
Own the D2C channel and other online/offline channels of business end-to-end including acquisition, retention, and channel profitability. Build a scalable growth engine rather than optimising only for topline.

**Marketing & Brand:**
Partner closely with the marketing team to translate the brand strategy into consumer growth. Own the commercial outcomes of marketing investments while protecting long-term brand equity, positioning and consumer relevance.

**Supply Chain & Operations:**
Own the operating rhythm from demand planning and procurement through production, inventory, fulfilment, quality and customer experience.

**Finance & Business Management:**
Work closely with finance to build budgets, forecasts, monthly business reviews, scenario building and investment cases.

**People & Organisation:**
Lead and align cross-functional teams across sales, marketing, supply chain, finance, operations and other business-critical functions. Build a high-accountability culture with clear goals, ownership and operating cadence.

**Growth & Innovation:**
Identify new consumer needs, occasions, products, channels and partnerships that can materially expand the business.

What We Are Looking For

Owned a D2C business, category, brand, business unit with full P&L responsibility.

Strong general-management orientation: able to lead revenue, margins, operations and people rather than operating only within one function.

Demonstrated ownership of business numbers and comfort being accountable for revenue, gross margin, contribution and profitability.

Strong understanding of D2C growth & metrics - acquisition, conversion, retention, repeat, CAC, blended CAC, LTV, AOV & Channel mix.

Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior stakeholders across marketing, sales, supply chain, finance and operations.

Strong commercial judgement: able to distinguish between growth that creates value and growth that merely creates topline.

Comfort working in an entrepreneurial environment with hands on experience where resources and budgets are tight

Data-fluent and financially rigorous, while retaining strong instinct for consumer and market.

High ownership, speed of decision-making and willingness to execute when needed.

A Tamil Speaking professional, preferably who lives in Tamil Nadu

Ideal Background:

We are interested in candidates who may currently be working as a D2C / E-commerce lead, Category Head, Growth Head, India Market lead or an equivalent role in a consumer business.

Minimum 5-6 years of relevant experience from D2C-first consumer brands, FMCG, food & beverage, health & wellness, beauty & personal care, nutrition, consumer tech or other categories where the candidate has had genuine commercial ownership and proven cross-functional leadership for a few years.

Entreprenuers who have built and scaled consumer businesses in the past are also welcome to apply.

*Preferred but not mandatory:*
From Tier 1 or Tier 2 business school in India

What you will get from us:

* Complete ownership and responsibility of business coupled with people leadership responsibility for a new-age brand that wants to build strong equity in the foods and nutrition business
* Freedom to experiment and decision-making autonomy
* A company with humble-people with good intention and make good quality products that serve consumer health

The right candidate:

This role is for someone who wants to build a business, not simply manage a function; be comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and be willing to take ownership when something is not working.

Must be able to hold the energy & range to discuss brand positioning in the morning, review a P&L in the afternoon, challenge inventory assumptions, diagnose a D2C funnel and align a cross-functional team around the next growth priority. The ability to zoom in and out is central to this role.

title: Senior Business System Support Analyst
description:
**Senior Business Systems Support Analyst (Workday Specialist)**
Location: Bangalore
  
  
**About Mimecast**
Mimecast is a leading cybersecurity company that helps organizations protect their people, data, and communications. With over 42,000 customers worldwide, Mimecast has a long history of excellence in Data Archiving and eDiscovery and is recognised as a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Digital Communications Governance and Archiving Solutions.
  
  
We are pioneers in Human Risk Management, recognizing that people are both an organization's greatest asset and its most significant security vulnerability. Our platform addresses the human element of cybersecurity through advanced threat detection, awareness training, Incydr risk management, and data governance. Our Governance, Compliance & Insight products play a critical role in this mission, ensuring that communications data is archived, discoverable, and compliant, enabling organizations to manage the risk that stems from human actions.
  
  
**AI-First Engineering at Mimecast**
Mimecast is an AI-First engineering organization. Our teams actively leverage AI-powered development tools across all facets of engineering, from code development to testing, documentation, and operations. We're looking for leaders who don't just use AI tools but champion their adoption and establish new ways of working.
  
  
Our AI leadership extends beyond how we build to what we build. Our Mihra AI agent delivers 7x faster threat response for customers, and we're recognized as "Agents of Change" in Human Risk Management. Engineers here work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI tooling and AI-powered security products that protect organizations worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are looking for a Senior Business Systems Support Analyst with strong Workday expertise to own Workday administration and production support as the core of this role. You will be the go-to specialist for Workday functional and admin support, including business process configuration, security groups, reporting, and troubleshooting, while also extending that support to other business platforms such as NetSuite, Boomi integrations, Partner Portal, and Docusign. This role is ideal for someone with deep hands-on Workday knowledge, strong application support experience, and the ability to manage support tickets, work with cross-functional teams, and support business operations across the wider systems landscape.
  
  
What You Will Work On
  
  
As a Senior Business Systems Support Analyst, you will support day-to-day business operations across key systems and processes, including:
  
  

* Workday Support (Primary Focus): user queries, access/security group requests, business process configuration, condition rules, calculated fields, HR data and reporting issues, workflow and approval errors, and process-related support across Workday.
* Workday Integrations Support: initial triage of Workday integration failures, data load issues, and coordination with technical/HRIS teams for resolution.
* Reporting & Dashboards: support users with Workday reports, dashboards, KPIs, saved views, and operational reporting requirements.
* Other Business Platforms: secondary support across connected platforms, including NetSuite (finance-related user requests, role/access issues, approval workflows, and transaction queries), Boomi integrations (initial investigation of failed syncs and data flow issues), Partner Portal (partner user access, login, and visibility support), and Docusign.
* Ticket & Incident Management: triage, prioritization, SLA-based resolution, escalation handling, documentation, and user communication.
* Process Improvement: identify recurring issues, support gaps, and opportunities to improve user experience and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Serve as the primary functional and administrative point of contact for Workday, supporting HR, Finance, Customer Experience, Partner Operations, and Go-To-Market teams.
* Investigate issues related to Workday business processes, security groups, condition rules, reports, calculated fields, workflows, approval steps, and data visibility.
* Triage, investigate, and resolve Workday-related support tickets within agreed SLA timelines, and support users with how-to queries, troubleshooting, and process guidance.
* Collaborate with Workday admins/HRIS teams, QA, business stakeholders, and technical teams to resolve complex or recurring Workday issues.
* Support Workday system enhancements, feature rollouts, process changes, testing activities, and business adoption.
* Extend support as needed across other business platforms, including NetSuite (access, approvals, finance workflows), Boomi integrations (initial issue analysis and coordination with technical teams), and Partner Portal (access and visibility support).
* Maintain SOPs, FAQs, resolution notes, knowledge articles, and support documentation, with a primary focus on Workday.
* Identify support trends, recurring issues, and process gaps across Workday and other platforms, and recommend improvements.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in business systems support, application support, or IT support operations, with a strong focus on Workday.
* Hands-on experience supporting Workday (HCM, Core HR, or related modules) in a production environment — this is a core requirement for the role.
* Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security groups, condition rules, calculated fields, and reporting.
* Experience working with ticketing tools such as Zendesk, ServiceNow, Jira, or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of incident management, SLA-based support, prioritization, and escalation handling.
* Ability to troubleshoot user issues, identify root causes, and provide clear resolutions.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users and technical teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced support environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

Good to Have
  
  

* Familiarity with Workday integration tools such as EIB, Workday Studio, Core Connectors, or reporting (RaaS) from a functional support perspective.
* Workday Pro certification (e.g., HCM, Core Compensation, Absence, or Security) or similar Workday certification.
* Experience supporting teams across HR, Sales, Finance, Customer Success, Partner Operations, Support, or Go-To-Market functions.
* Exposure to other business platforms such as NetSuite, Boomi, Partner Portal, ERP systems, or other HRIS/finance platforms.
* General understanding of integrations from a functional support perspective.
* Experience creating SOPs, support documentation, knowledge articles, and user training material.
* Experience supporting UAT, system enhancements, and process improvement initiatives.

Ideal Candidate
  
  
The ideal candidate is a Workday expert first — someone with strong Workday functional and admin knowledge who can own Workday support end-to-end, from business process configuration to security, reporting, and troubleshooting. They should also be comfortable extending that support to other business platforms as needed, understanding business impact, communicating clearly with users, coordinating with technical teams, and contributing to continuous improvement across support operations.
  
  
**Belonging at Mimecast**
Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.
  
  
We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.
  
  
We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won’t affect your application.

description:

**Who We're Looking For**
The Operations Engineer provides technical solutions to exceptionally difficult problems. * Conduct User Acceptance Tests in production and research relevant errors.
* Work with Product and Development for releases and enhancements.

**Experience, Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, electronics, telecommunication, or equivalent work experience.
* 5+ years of professional experience in application support, Production support, technical customer support, problem management, relational databases, programming, Cloud engineer, Application Operations etc.

title: Senior Support Specialist
description:
**About Copado**
Copado is the leading DevOps platform for Salesforce, revolutionizing how the world's largest organizations achieve success in their Salesforce deployments. Our mission is to accelerate the Salesforce development lifecycle, support digital transformation, and deliver unparalleled value to our customers. We continuously innovate, ensuring our platform meets the evolving needs of Salesforce developers and operations professionals.
  
  
**About The Role**
As part of our Copado Way and RAPID Support initiative, we are revolutionizing customer support by eliminating traditional, slow tiered escalation structures. Why should a customer wait through multiple support tiers to get the best help? At Copado, we ask: "Why wait? Let's get you the best, the fastest."
  
  
In this high-impact, front-line role, you will serve as a
****Senior Support Specialist****
. You will execute all frontline functions of DevOps support — including rapid triage, queue management, directing technical traffic, and troubleshooting — but with senior-level technical depth. You will connect directly with customers live on video/voice within our strict
****10-minute SLA****
, providing immediate, expert-level resolution and ensuring no customer ever sits waiting for technical answers.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* 10-Minute SLA & Rapid Live Triage: Act as the first responder for customer queries, meeting a strict 10-minute SLA to connect live (via Google Meet/voice) with human expertise right away.
* Frontline Traffic Control & Ownership: Walk case queues on a First-In, First-Out (FIFO) basis. Take immediate ownership of cases to ensure zero backlog and direct technical traffic efficiently.
* Technical Diagnosis & Problem Solving: Leverage senior-level technical knowledge to troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve complex issues with Salesforce environments, Copado deployments, CI/CD pipelines, APIs, and version control.
* The Copado Way Customer Engagement: Manage customer expectations with empathy, maintaining continuous engagement on critical issues and adhering to the "Rule of 3" (what we are doing now, what we are doing next, and when we will do it).
* AI-Driven Support & Feedback Loop: Utilize Copado Expert AI tools for rapid context preparation, live troubleshooting, and continuously fuel our AI training flywheel by documenting feedback entries on every case.
* Proactive Follow-Up & Resolution Verification: Maintain active follow-up until total resolution is confirmed, ensuring complete satisfaction and zero churn.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3+ years of experience in Salesforce Development and Salesforce DevOps or related DevOps experience..
* At least 2+ years of DevOps experience with Copado (or direct experience with comparable deployment/packaging tools).
* Mandatory AI Experience: Proven hands-on experience and proficiency with AI tools, AI concepts, and AI-assisted workflows.
* Core Technical Proficiency: Strong technical command of SaaS environments, APIs, XML, SOQL, Git repositories, branching strategies, and hosted version control platforms (GitHub, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket).
* Communication & Presence: Exceptional spoken and written English communication skills, with outstanding audio/video presence and active listening capabilities for live customer troubleshooting sessions.
* Problem-Solving & Work Ethic: Excellent analytical skills, attention to detail, ability to stay calm under pressure, and schedule flexibility to support global customer SLAs as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: Copado Fundamentals I and II Certifications; Salesforce Certified Administrator and/or Platform Developer.
* Support Background: Experience working frontline in a fast-paced technical support environment or customer success engineering role.

description:

Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an HPC Operations Engineer at NVIDIA, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the flawless operation of our high-performance computing (HPC) environment. This opportunity is outstanding as you will be part of a world-class team that powers semiconductor build and advanced engineering workflows. * Develop and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, knowledge base articles, and guidelines for users and internal teams

* Strong written communication skills with the ability to produce clear documentation and procedural guides
* Demonstrated ability to follow established processes while maintaining attention to detail

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Foundational scripting or automation experience (e.g., Bash or Python) sufficient to support routine operational tasks
* Solid understanding of workload schedulers such as LSF, Slurm, or similar systems

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service quality and efficiency

* 10-12 years of experience in IT Service Desk / Technical Support with 2+ years in a lead role

* Exceptional communication skills - verbal and written

* Team handling & People Management

title: Network Operations Engineer - L2
description:
**Description**
**Company Overview:**
When it comes to IT solution providers, there are a lot of choices. But when it comes to providers with innovative and differentiating end-to-end service offerings, there’s only one: Zones – First Choice for IT.TM
  
  
Zones is a Global Solution Provider of end-to-end IT solutions with an unmatched supply chain. Positioned to be the IT partner you need, Zones, a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) in business for over 35 years, specializes in Digital Workplace, Cloud & Data Center, Networking, Security, and Managed/Professional/Staffing services. Operating in more than 120 countries, leveraging a robust portfolio, and utilizing the highest certification levels from key partners, including Microsoft, Apple, Cisco, Lenovo, Adobe, and more, Zones has mastered the science of building digital infrastructures that change the way business does business ensuring whatever they need, they can Consider IT Done. Follow Zones, LLC on Twitter @Zones, and LinkedIn and Facebook.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a
**Network Operations Engineer (L2 – SD-WAN)**
to support and optimize enterprise WAN environments. In this role, you will handle escalated incidents from L1 teams, troubleshoot SD-WAN and network-related issues, and ensure high availability and performance across multi-site environments.
  
  
You should have strong troubleshooting skills, hands-on experience with SD-WAN technologies, and a solid understanding of routing, switching, and network security. Your goal will be to ensure operational stability, proactively identify issues, and drive resolution within SLA timelines.
  
  
**What you’ll do as the Network Operations Engineer (L2):**
The requirements below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.
  
  

* Handle escalated incidents from L1 support related to SD-WAN environments (Meraki, Aruba, CATO).
* Troubleshoot connectivity issues including underlay/overlay, VPN tunnels (IPSec, GRE), and SD-WAN fabrics.
* Diagnose routing issues (BGP, OSPF, static routes) and application performance degradation.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents and drive permanent fixes.
* Monitor SD-WAN infrastructure using tools such as SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios, and ThousandEyes.
* Analyze alerts, correlate events, and identify service-impacting issues proactively.
* Drive incidents to resolution within SLA timelines and provide timely status updates.
* Implement standard configuration changes including routing policies, QoS, and path selection.
* Execute approved changes through established change management processes.
* Collaborate with L3/architect teams for complex issues and deployments.
* Work with OEM vendors (Cisco TAC, VMware, Fortinet, etc.) and ISPs for critical issues.
* Analyze network performance metrics such as bandwidth utilization, latency, jitter, and packet loss.
* Recommend optimization techniques for network performance and failover strategies.
* Maintain documentation including incident logs, SOPs, runbooks, and Known Error Database (KEDB).
* Participate in incident trend analysis, SLA tracking, MTTR improvement, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**What You Will Bring To The Team**

* 5–6 years of experience in Network Operations / NOC environment.
* Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience with SD-WAN technologies.
* Strong understanding of:

+ TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP
+ Routing protocols: BGP, OSPF, EIGRP
+ VPN technologies: IPSec, DMVPN
+ NAT, ACLs, and QoS

* Hands-on experience with SD-WAN platforms (Meraki, Aruba, CATO).
* Experience in monitoring tools (SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios) and packet analysis (Wireshark).
* Proficiency in CLI troubleshooting (Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto, F5).
* Experience working with ticketing tools such as ServiceNow.
* Exposure to enterprise-scale multi-site WAN environments.
* Proven ability to work in a 24x7 support model.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to handle complex scenarios.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering/IT or equivalent.
* Certifications preferred: CCNA / CCNP.

**Zones Offers a Comprehensive Benefits Package.**

) L2 Incident Resolution: Manage daily tickets in the support queue, including initial analysis, implementing workarounds, and ensuring timely acknowledgment and resolution within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

Collaboration: Work closely with development, QA, and DevOps teams to escalate complex issues, provide insights for permanent fixes, and support new feature deployments or platform upgrades.

title: Oracle EPM Specialist - IT Architect
description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.  
  
DESCRIPTION:  
Join Thermo Fisher Scientific as an IT Architect III and be part of our mission to enable customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. In this role, you'll design and implement effective cloud solutions, focusing on EPM architecture and automation. You'll contribute to technology advancement, transforming on-premise applications into cloud-centric solutions while ensuring reliability and disaster recovery. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams, propose innovative approaches, and advance cloud technology. You'll support and guide application owners while maintaining expertise in emerging technologies and industry best practices. Your work will directly impact operations through the implementation of sophisticated machine learning solutions, cloud infrastructure optimization, and the development of scalable IT architectures.  
  
We are seeking an Oracle EPM Consultant with strong expertise in Enterprise Planning and Budgeting Cloud Service (EPBCS) to support, develop, and optimize enterprise planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting solutions.

The consultant will serve as the primary functional and technical resource for EPBCS, ensuring application stability, data accuracy, security, and performance during planning and financial close cycles. This role involves translating business requirements into scalable solutions, managing integrations, troubleshooting issues, and delivering application enhancements.

Working closely with Finance, IT, implementation partners, and Financial Systems leadership, the consultant will take ownership of knowledge transfer and support the execution of the EPM roadmap. Exposure to PCMCS and EDMCS is desirable, with these applications representing a secondary area of responsibility.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**EPBCS Solution Design & Development**

* Gather business requirements and translate them into functional designs, technical specifications, and EPBCS solutions.
* Configure and maintain planning applications, dimensions, hierarchies, forms, dashboards, navigation flows, task lists, and approval workflows.
* Develop and optimize business rules, calculation scripts, member formulas, and allocation logic using Calculation Manager and, where applicable, Groovy.
* Support planning models across scenarios, versions, entities, currencies, and business units.
* Enhance budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, and management reporting processes.
* Configure and support relevant EPBCS frameworks, such as Financials, Workforce based on business requirements.

**Data Integration & Management**

* Configure, administer, and monitor Data Integration/Data Exchange processes, data mappings, pipelines, and import/export definitions.
* Manage actuals, budget, forecast, and metadata integrations between EPBCS and source systems.
* Validate and reconcile financial data to ensure completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream system owners to assess dependencies and resolve integration issues.
* Automate routine data loads, metadata updates, and application processes using EPM Automate, REST APIs, or scripting.

**Application Support & Troubleshooting**

* Provide functional and technical support during budgeting, forecasting, financial close, and reporting cycles.
* Investigate and resolve data load failures, mapping errors, calculation issues, validation failures, and performance problems.
* Support users with forms, dashboards, approvals, reporting, and Smart View queries.
* Perform root cause analysis, implement preventive fixes, and manage Oracle Service Requests through resolution.
* Monitor scheduled jobs, business rules, integrations, and application performance.

**Security, Maintenance & Release Management**

* Administer user access, predefined roles, application permissions, and dimension-level security.
* Review monthly Oracle EPM release notes, assess impacts, and coordinate regression testing.
* Manage controlled migration of application changes across development, test, and production environments.
* Maintain application backups, configuration documentation, support runbooks, and operating procedures.
* Follow change management processes and support audit and internal control requirements.

**Business Partnership & Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with Finance and IT teams to improve planning processes, application usability, and operational efficiency.
* Assess the downstream impact of application and integration changes.
* Lead knowledge transfer from implementation partners and establish sustainable application support practices.
* Work with Financial Systems leadership to prioritize enhancements and deliver EPM roadmap initiatives.

**Secondary Support – PCMCS & EDMCS**

* Provide limited support for PCMCS allocation models and profitability processes, as required.
* Assist with EDMCS metadata updates, hierarchy maintenance, and subscriptions.
* Coordinate with application specialists for complex PCMCS and EDMCS requirements.

### **Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience implementing, developing, or supporting Oracle EPBCS/EPM Planning applications.
* Understanding of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and financial close dependencies.
* Experience with dimensions, forms, dashboards, approval workflows, business rules, calculation scripts, and Smart View.
* Strong knowledge of Essbase concepts, multidimensional modeling, and calculation performance optimization.
* Experience with Data Integration/Data Exchange, data mappings, metadata management, and financial data reconciliation.
* Experience managing application security, migrations, monthly update testing, and production support.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to translate Finance requirements into practical, maintainable technical solutions.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Groovy, EPM Automate, REST APIs, and scripting.
* Experience with EPBCS Financials, Workforce.
* Exposure to Oracle ERP or other financial source-system integrations.
* Familiarity with PCMCS and EDMCS.

title: Specialist - IT - Engineering
description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for a Backend Engineer who has built and run production systems at scale. You'll own services end-to-end: design, build, deploy, monitor and be able to address prod issues on priority. We also want someone who treats AI-assisted development as a core part of the modern engineering, and who has a track record of stepping up as a technical leader.

* Use AI coding assistants and internal AI tooling to accelerate development, review, and debugging - and help the team adopt them effectively

* Partner with product, SRE/DevOps, and other engineering teams to plan and deliver roadmap work
* Demonstrated ownership: Has driven a project or service from design through production and long-term maintenance
* Has taken point on a production incident - led triage, communicated status, and driven the postmortem/fix

**Required Qualifications**

**Core Engineering**

* 5+ years of professional backend software engineering experience
* Strong experience designing and operating microservices architectures in production
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (deployments, services, config/secrets management, autoscaling, load balancing, debugging pods/nodes in production)
* Proficiency with Apache Kafka or equivalent (event streaming, partitioning, consumer groups, schema management)
* Strong working knowledge of AWS - RDS, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC/networking basics, and at least one compute/orchestration service (ECS, EKS, or Lambda)

* Judgment about AI tool limitations and knows when to trust AI-generated code vs. when to verify manually, especially around security, correctness, and data handling

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in migrating workloads to Cloud, DB migrations etc
* Experience with service mesh (Istio/Gloo), API gateways, or multi-region/multi-AZ architectures
* Exposure to cost optimization / FinOps practices in AWS
* Experience with NoSQL stores (DynamoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch) alongside RDS
* Experience building or integrating with LLM-based features in production
