title: SAP PM Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**SAP PM – Consultant, Managed Services**
**Enterprise Performance**
Our Enterprise Performance team helps organizations improve business performance through enterprise platforms, digital operations, and technology-enabled transformation. Within this practice, professionals work across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT to support complex business process and system needs. As an SAP PM Functional Consultant, you will work with cross-functional teams to design, support, and enhance plant maintenance solutions, align business requirements to SAP capabilities, and help clients improve maintenance operations through scalable, technology-enabled processes.
  
  
**Level**
: Consultant or equivalent
  
  
As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Consultant, Managed Services on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Support SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) managed services activities across design, build, test, deployment, and post-production support.
* Gather business requirements, perform fit-gap analysis, and translate requirements into functional specifications and configuration design.
* Configure SAP PM processes and support integration with other SAP modules and external systems.
* Participate in unit testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing, and support cutover, go-live, and hyper-care activities.
* Collaborate with client stakeholders and onsite/offshore teams to resolve issues, maintain documentation, and support ongoing process improvement.

**The team**
Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise package insights and platform technology, working across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations to support delivery of holistic performance improvement and package led large scale digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business insights and collaborate with the businesses as they navigate their enterprise growth and transformation journeys.
  
  
The Enterprise Operations Portfolio is a suite of offerings designed to help clients maximize value from their Finance, Supply Chain, and IT operations. By taking a holistic approach—from strategy development to process design and technology enablement—we support clients in overcoming operational challenges and managing key business functions. As organizations pursue digital transformation, these areas become vital in shaping interactions with customers, suppliers, and stakeholders. By integrating strategy, operational improvement, implementation, and managed services, we creatively deploy resources and drive innovation, ensuring clients achieve impactful, sustainable results at the speed demanded by today’s dynamic market.
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
24\*7 rotational shifts including night shifts as per business requirements
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 3-6 years of experience with SAP Plant Maintenance (PM)
* Experience delivering SAP PM solution design, build, test, and deployment activities
* Experience with preventive maintenance and breakdown maintenance processes in SAP PM
* Experience configuring SAP PM and supporting integration with other SAP modules and external systems
* Experience contributing to at least 1 SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) implementation or support project
* Experience writing functional specifications and supporting unit, regression, and user acceptance testing
* Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, or Master of Science in Computer Science from an accredited university

Preferred:
  
  

* 2+ years of experience in asset-intensive industries
* Experience identifying custom development requirements through fit-gap analysis
* Experience supporting cutover, go-live, and hyper-care activities
* Experience with Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) service management processes
* Experience using Information Technology Service Management (ITSM) tools
* Master’s degree

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

description:
**About Brite**

Brite Systems Inc. is a U.S.-based, AI-led digital transformation company and a Top 1% Salesforce Summit Partner. Since 2006, we have helped government and nonprofit organizations modernize their technology, improve operations, and deliver better outcomes for the communities they serve.

Headquartered in Indianapolis with a Global Delivery Hub in Chennai, Brite brings together expertise across Salesforce, AWS, MuleSoft, AI, and our proprietary Enlite Accelerator to solve complex challenges and create meaningful impact.

At Brite, you’ll be part of a collaborative, people-first team where innovation, continuous learning, and meaningful work come together. We’re proud to be recognized among Indiana’s fastest growing companies, named to the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies, and recognized as a Great Place to Work in Indiana for seven years. Join Brite to build innovative technology, grow your career, and make a difference.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused IT Administrator to provide first-level IT support to employees. The ideal candidate should possess strong troubleshooting skills, excellent communication, and a service-oriented mindset to ensure timely resolution of technical issues while maintaining high customer satisfaction.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Key Responsibilities**

**End User Support**

* Provide first-level technical support for desktops, laptops, printers, mobile devices, and peripherals.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, and application-related issues.
* Install, configure, and maintain Windows operating systems and standard business applications.
* Support Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and OneDrive.



**User Administration**

* Create, modify, and deactivate user accounts.
* Manage password resets and access permissions.
* Configure email accounts, distribution groups, and shared mailboxes.

**Asset Management**

* Maintain the IT asset inventory, including laptops, desktops, monitors, and accessories.
* Track asset allocation, returns, warranty details, and lifecycle.
* Coordinate procurement and replacement of IT equipment.



**Ticket Management**

* Log, prioritize, and resolve support tickets within defined SLAs.
* Escalate unresolved issues to Level-2 or specialized support teams.
* Maintain proper documentation of incidents, resolutions, and root causes.



**Infrastructure Support**

* Assist in configuring and troubleshooting LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, and internet connectivity.
* Support printers, scanners, meeting room equipment, and video conferencing systems.
* Assist with software deployment and patch management.



**Employee Onboarding & Offboarding**

* Prepare laptops and user accounts for new employees.
* Configure required software, licenses, and access rights.
* Recover company assets and revoke system access during employee exit.



**Documentation & Compliance**

* Maintain knowledge base articles and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Ensure compliance with IT security policies.
* Support periodic audits related to IT assets and access management.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Computer Applications, or a related field.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Brite Systems is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Recruitment Fraud Alert! There has been an increase in fraud that targets job seekers. Scammers may present themselves to job seekers as Brite Systems employees or recruiters. Please be aware that Brite Systems does not request sensitive personal data from applicants via text/instant message or any unsecured method; does not promise any advance payment for work equipment set-up; and does not use recruitment or job-sourcing agencies that charge candidates an advance fee of any kind. We encourage you to review and apply to our available job openings at Brite Systems website. For more information on avoiding and reporting scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission’s job scams website

title: Customer Support Agent (Trading Platform)
description: About GoChartingGoCharting is one of the most advanced platforms for seeing and trading the markets. Traders use it to read price and volume through professional orderflow tools - footprint charts, volume profile, cumulative delta, DOM - to analyse the market and to place orders through their broker, all in the browser.Our users are active traders in India, the US and around the world: from people learning to read orderflow to professionals who trade every session. 3M+ registered traders, PE-backed since 2025, profitable, with a mandate to scale 10x over four years.The roleYou'll be the person traders talk to when they need help with GoCharting - and the person who actually solves it.The questions are rarely simple. A footprint chart looks different from what a trader expects. Data for a symbol is delayed. A broker connection drops just before the market opens. An order didn't go through. A subscription didn't renew. Behind each message is a trader who is in the middle of a session and is losing time or money while they wait.Your job is to understand the product deeply enough to find the real cause, give a complete answer, and - when it's a bug - give our engineers everything they need to fix it. Over time, you become one of the people in the company who knows the product best and knows what traders struggle with.What you'll doSolve product questions end to end. Charts and indicators, orderflow tools, market data, broker connections and order execution, account and billing. Reproduce the problem in the platform yourself, check the obvious causes, and come back with an answer that closes the question.Write answers that close the question. One complete, professional reply instead of several chat bubbles. You'll work to our Communication Standards - a short guide on tone, structure and what a complete answer looks like.Explain the product to traders. Help people set up and read footprint charts, volume profile, DOM and other tools - clearly, in their terms, without a script.Troubleshoot technical issues. Check what the trader sees, look at the browser console, compare accounts and settings, narrow it down before escalating.Escalate bugs with evidence. Write bug reports an engineer can act on without asking a follow-up question: what the trader did, what happened, what was expected, environment, screenshots, whether it reproduces.React fast during incidents. When data or the platform has a problem during market hours, flag it immediately and keep traders informed.Turn repeated questions into knowledge. Write and improve help articles and saved replies, so the next trader with the same question gets the answer faster.Be the trader's voice inside the company. Tag conversations properly and bring patterns to the team: what confuses traders, what breaks, what they keep asking for.How we think about the workEvery action in the inbox has consequences down the line. A wrong tag hides a problem from the people who could fix it. A premature close brings the trader back angrier. A vague escalation costs an engineer an hour. We look for people who think about what happens next - to the trader, to the colleague who picks up after them, and to the team that receives the escalation.You're probably a fit ifYou write excellent English - clear, calm and complete. This is the core of the job.You have 2+ years of customer-facing support for a technical product, ideally B2C SaaS or fintech, working a real inbox (chat, email, messaging).You like figuring out how things work. You can follow a UI, read an error, reproduce a problem and use browser DevTools at a basic level.You take ownership of a conversation until it's solved, not until it's handed off.Strong plus: you trade, or you've supported a trading, brokerage or market-data product. You know what a chart, an order book, a session and a broker connection are - and ideally you've used orderflow tools yourself.Nice to have: hands-on experience with a modern helpdesk (Intercom, Zendesk, Freshdesk or similar); writing help articles; Hindi and / or Tamil.Probably not a fit ifYou prefer ready-made scripts to understanding the product and the actual question.You see escalation as "passing the ticket on".Working hoursWe support traders across Indian and US market hours, so the team works in shifts, including evening and night shifts (remote), with weekend and public holiday shifts on a rotation. Shift, weekend and holiday work come with allowances.LogisticsLocation: Chennai, India.Employment type: Full-time, Onsite.Reports to: Customer Support lead.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Core Technology Infrastructure (CTI), part of the Global Technology & Operations organization, consists of more than 6,600 employees worldwide. With presence in more than 35 countries, TI designs, builds, and operates end-to-end technology infrastructure solutions and manages critical systems and platforms across the bank. TI delivers industry-leading infrastructure products and services to the company’s employees, customers, and clients around the world.
  
  
**Job Description**
An Infrastructure Engineer for Db2 z/OS is required to support software installation, upgrades, maintenance, 24x7 on-call coverage, disaster recovery testing, automation, monitoring, alerting, and security administration for resilient mainframe database and replication services.
  
  
The role contributes to the installation, upgrade, maintenance, certification, and operational support of IBM Db2 for z/OS and replication products, including Q Replication, SQL Replication, and CDC.
  
  
The engineer will help maintain service stability through monitoring, automation, security administration, documented operational procedures, disaster recovery readiness, and effective coordination with internal support teams, software vendors, and management.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
  
  

* Install, upgrade, maintain, test, and support IBM Db2 for z/OS and replication products, including Q Replication, SQL Replication, CDC etc.
* Perform software certification testing and maintain clear operational, maintenance, and recovery procedures.
* Support disaster recovery planning and testing to validate service recoverability and operational resilience.
* Develop and enhance automation, monitoring, alerting, health checks, and operational controls.
* Administer security-related activities, including access controls, RACF coordination, TCP/IP connectivity, and network certificates.
* Analyze and resolve complex Db2, replication, infrastructure, performance, and production support issues.
* Work with support teams, software vendors, and management; communicate technical risks, status, and resolution plans clearly.
* Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation and provide off-hours support as required.

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech/Computer Science degree preferred or substantially equivalent experience.
  
  
Certifications If Any: NA
  
  
**Experience Range\***
8-10+ years
  
  
**Foundational Skills**

* Hands-on experience supporting IBM Db2 for z/OS and replication products, including Q Replication, SQL Replication, and CDC.
* Experience with software installation, version upgrades, maintenance, certification testing, operational documentation, and disaster recovery testing.
* Ability to participate in 24x7 on-call rotation and provide off-hours production support when required.
* Strong analytical, debugging, problem-solving, and production incident resolution skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with support teams, software vendors, and management.

**Desired Skills**

* Experience supporting BMC for Db2 tools, IBM z/OS Connect, and Software AG ADABAS and Natural products.
* Programming or automation experience with REXX.
* Working knowledge of SQL, JIRA, SMP/E, RACF, TCP/IP, network certificates, and Splunk.
* Working knowledge of other mainframe subsystems, including CICS, IMS, and MQ.

title: Head of Finance Operations
description:
**Company Description**
The Chennai Silks (TCS) is recognized as the largest textile retailer in Tamil Nadu, serving as a trusted destination for generations of families. Known for its extensive range of garments and fabrics, TCS offers traditional and contemporary collections that cater to diverse customer preferences. The company emphasizes quality, value, and customer satisfaction across its retail operations. As a growing textile brand, TCS provides opportunities for professionals to contribute to scalable, process-driven business practices in a dynamic retail environment.
  
**Role Description**
The Head of Finance Operations will oversee end-to-end financial management for The Chennai Silks’ operations in Dindigul. This full-time, on-site role includes managing daily accounting activities, monitoring cash flow, and ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting. The role involves preparing and reviewing financial statements, leading budgeting and forecasting processes, and analyzing financial performance to support strategic decision-making. The Head of Finance Operations will establish and maintain internal controls, ensure compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements, and coordinate with auditors and banking partners. This position also leads the finance team, improves financial processes, and partners with senior leadership to drive operational efficiency and profitability.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Finance, with practical experience in corporate or retail finance operations.
* Proficiency in Financial Statements and Financial Reporting, including preparation, review, and compliance.
* Demonstrated Budgeting expertise, covering annual budgets, forecasts, and variance analysis.
* Advanced Analytical Skills to interpret financial data, identify trends, and support management decisions.
* Experience leading finance teams, setting processes, and implementing internal controls.
* Solid understanding of accounting standards, taxation, and statutory compliance relevant to the retail sector.
* Ability to work on-site in Dindigul and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Professional qualification in finance, accounting, or related field (e.g., CA, CMA, MBA in Finance) preferred.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

* Experience with batch processing and real-time EDI flows
* Good understanding of healthcare domain concepts (claims, eligibility, payments)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Good communication and stakeholder interaction skills

* Experience with Edifecs EAM, Encounter Management
* Exposure to cloud deployments (AWS/Azure)
* Knowledge of SQL and database tracking
* Experience with production support and on-call rotations

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

title: Representative Lead, BPS Client Service & Support
description:
**Position Type**
Full time
  
  
**Type Of Hire**
Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)
  
  
**Education Desired**
Bachelor's Degree
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**
**User Access Administration**

* Process new user access requests, access modifications, and access revocations for applications supported by the Access & Entitlements team
* Perform Good Order Reviews to validate request completeness, approvals, and compliance before processing
* Own end-to-end access request coordination, including follow-ups and stakeholder communication
* Track access requests through to completion and provide timely status updates and confirmations to requesters

**Access Provisioning**

* Provision, modify, and revoke user access directly for applications where administrator responsibilities reside within the team
* Ensure access is granted strictly in line with approved roles, entitlements, and organizational security standards
* Maintain complete ownership of the access lifecycle from request intake through final closure and confirmation

**Ticket Management**

* Manage access-related tickets using tools such as ServiceNow (SNOW) and TeamSupport
* Resolve or coordinate resolution of login issues, access issues, password resets, and other access-related queries
* Perform quality checks on all tickets prior to closure to ensure accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness

**Governance, Controls & Compliance**

* Participate in periodic and cyclical access reviews for applications managed by the team
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, regulatory requirements, and audit expectations
* Maintain clear documentation and audit trails for all access-related activities

Stakeholder & Client Communication
  
  

* Provide clear, professional, and timely communication to internal teams, application owners, clients, banks, and third-party vendors
* Act as a trusted point of contact for access and entitlement-related inquiries
* Support a global user base across multiple time zones as required

Other Duties
  
  

* Perform other related duties and special projects as assigned

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience
* 7+ years of experience in user access administration, IAM operations, or application access support roles
* Strong experience working in audit-driven or regulated environments
* Solid understanding of the user access lifecycle (joiners, movers, leavers)
* Hands-on experience with ticketing systems such as ServiceNow (SNOW) and TeamSupport
* Knowledge of security controls, access governance standards, and access review processes
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail
* Ability to manage high volumes of work while meeting strict SLAs
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a global team environment
* Quality-focused, compliance-driven mindset with strong documentation and tracking skills

**(Note~ Profiles of Server Administrators, SharePoint Administrators, and UNIX/Windows System Administrators are excluded.)**
**What We Offer You**

* A high-impact role supporting critical business and client applications
* Strong exposure to information security, access governance, and compliance
* Opportunity to work in a global operating model with cross-functional stakeholders
* A multifaceted role with a high degree of responsibility and learning opportunities
* Competitive salary and benefits
* A wide range of professional development and career growth opportunities at FIS

**Privacy Statement**
FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

title: IT Technical Intern
description:
We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented, and technically curious IT Technical Intern to join our Information Technology team. The intern will gain hands-on experience in IT support, systems administration, troubleshooting, networking, cybersecurity, hardware and software management, documentation, and technology operations while collaborating with IT professionals and business users.
  
  
Our intent is to develop an IT professional who can understand the organization’s technology environment end to end, translate user and business requirements into practical technical solutions, resolve issues efficiently, support reliable IT operations, and contribute to the continuous improvement of systems, processes, and security practices.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Understand the organization’s IT infrastructure, systems, applications, networks, devices, users, technical requirements, dependencies, and operational challenges.
* Assist in providing first-level technical support to employees and users through ticketing systems, email, chat, phone, or in-person support.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, network, connectivity, access, printing, and application-related issues.
* Install, configure, maintain, and support computers, laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, operating systems, and business applications.
* Assist with user account provisioning, access management, password resets, permissions, onboarding, offboarding, and identity-related tasks.
* Support Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, collaboration tools, enterprise applications, and other productivity platforms, as applicable.
* Monitor IT systems, services, devices, and alerts and escalate incidents or risks according to established procedures.
* Assist with network troubleshooting involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Wi-Fi, firewalls, switches, routers, and related infrastructure.
* Maintain accurate records of hardware, software, licenses, warranties, configurations, users, and IT assets.
* Use IT service management and ticketing tools to document incidents, service requests, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and follow-up actions.
* Assist with software deployment, patching, updates, endpoint configuration, backups, and routine maintenance activities.
* Support cybersecurity practices such as endpoint protection, access control, phishing awareness, vulnerability remediation, secure configuration, and incident reporting.
* Follow established IT policies, procedures, change management practices, security controls, and data protection requirements.
* Assist with system administration tasks across Windows, Linux, cloud platforms, virtual machines, or other environments, as applicable to the assigned team.
* Use scripting or automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies to improve repetitive IT processes and operational efficiency.
* Investigate recurring technical issues, identify root causes, and recommend improvements to systems, documentation, workflows, and user experience.
* Contribute to IT projects such as system upgrades, migrations, deployments, infrastructure improvements, asset refreshes, and technology evaluations.
* Explore the responsible use of AI tools, automation, and intelligent assistants for IT support, documentation, troubleshooting, monitoring, and knowledge management.
* Evaluate AI-generated recommendations and outputs for accuracy, security, privacy, reliability, and alignment with organizational policies.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, standard operating procedures, user guides, network diagrams, and troubleshooting references.
* Communicate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical users and provide professional, timely, and customer-focused support.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of computer hardware, operating systems, networking concepts, troubleshooting methodologies, and IT service management principles.
* Knowledge of programming fundamentals and design algorithms.
* Working knowledge of at least one operating system, such as Windows, Linux, or macOS.
* Foundational understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Wi-Fi, user accounts, access permissions, and common enterprise IT services.
* Basic familiarity with productivity applications, collaboration tools, cloud services, endpoint devices, and software installation or configuration.
* Ability to diagnose problems logically, research solutions, follow procedures, document work accurately, and escalate issues appropriately.
* Strong attention to detail, customer service orientation, ownership, curiosity, collaboration skills, and willingness to learn and accept feedback.
* Understanding of basic cybersecurity, data privacy, password security, phishing risks, and responsible handling of confidential information.

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Hands-on experience supporting Windows, Linux, macOS, mobile devices, printers, scanners, and other IT equipment.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory, Entra ID, Google Workspace, or similar enterprise platforms.
* Exposure to IT service management tools such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Freshservice, Zendesk, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with networking tools, command-line utilities, remote support tools, monitoring platforms, or diagnostic utilities.
* Experience with PowerShell, Python, Bash, batch scripting, or other automation and scripting technologies.
* Exposure to endpoint management, mobile device management, patch management, software deployment, or configuration management tools.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and practices, including endpoint protection, vulnerability scanning, identity and access management, security monitoring, and incident response.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Familiarity with virtualization, containers, backup systems, storage, servers, or infrastructure monitoring.
* Experience creating technical documentation, knowledge base articles, process guides, diagrams, or user training materials.
* Exposure to AI assistants, automation tools, prompt engineering, or AI-enabled IT support and knowledge management workflows.

**Who We Are**
Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. Our talented teams strive for perfection and innovate every chance they get. We offer an Associate-first culture, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity for all.
  
  
Shure is headquartered in United States. We have more than 35 regional sales offices, engineering hubs, distribution centers and manufacturing facilities throughout the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.
  
  
Join Shure and
**Amplify Your Impact.**
Explore our unique culture and learn the key pillars that define our legacy of excellence.
  
  
**THE MIX MATTERS**
Don’t check off every box in the job requirements? No problem! We recognize that every professional journey is unique and are committed to providing an equitable candidate experience for all prospective Shure Associates. If you’re excited about this role, believe you’ve got the skills to be successful, and share our passion for creating an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible work environment, then apply!

title: Junior Operations Associate
description:
**About 1X2 Network**

Founded in 2002, 1X2 Network has pioneered Virtual Gaming products and continues to be at the forefront of game development within the iGaming industry. With a portfolio of over 150 titles spanning Virtual Sports, Table Games, Slots, Instant Win and upcoming Multiplayer games, we work with more than 250 globally recognised operators including Bet365, BetVictor and Entain (Ladbrokes, Coral, bwin and more).

Several brands form the wider 1X2 Network, each focused on delivering unique gaming experiences across different market sectors. Our key brands include Iron Dog Studio and 1X2gaming, alongside a broad network of development and distribution partners.

The business operates across multiple international locations, with UK offices in Brighton and Brentwood, alongside offices in Malta and Hyderabad, supported by remote employees across the globe.

**Working at 1X2 Network**

At 1X2 Network, we work collaboratively and energetically to develop and distribute a successful portfolio of online and mobile iGaming products. We are committed to creating an environment where employees can grow professionally, contribute meaningfully and develop long-term careers within the business.

We offer a supportive and engaging workplace culture alongside opportunities for career progression, learning and development, and cross-functional collaboration with experienced colleagues across multiple disciplines.

Employees also have opportunities to attend industry events, exhibitions and networking festivals where appropriate, supporting collaboration with both colleagues and global partners across the iGaming sector.

**The Role**

The Junior Operations Associate role sits within our Operations team and works closely with the Integrations team. You’ll be providing high-quality support to clients, monitoring systems in real-time, running daily reports, and helping ensure everything runs smoothly. We’re looking for someone organized, proactive, and ready to learn—someone who’s happy to go above and beyond and take on additional responsibilities as they grow with the team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Answering B2B clients’ enquiries via Ticketing System & Live Chat in line with SLA’s and KPI’s.
* Following standard procedures for proper escalation of unresolved issues to the relevant internal or external teams.
* Prioritising support tickets based on their impact on the business.
* Monitoring systems, dashboards, live alerts and offer real-time support to internal stakeholders and clients, reporting issues to the relevant departments.
* Running Daily Reports and Monitoring Systems, e.g. Players and Games Profit and Loss (P/L) reports, Games Return To Player (RTP%) reports, Unsettled Bets monitoring and reports to identify potential issues on the servers and raise them to internal or external teams.
* Big Win's verification for in-house games and with 3rd party providers.
* Open bets settling.
* Assisting the team with out-of-hours support where necessary

**Skills, Knowledge & Experience**

**Essential**

* Good written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with clients and internal teams.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret reports, check data accurately and identify discrepancies or unusual activity.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including sorting, filtering and basic formulas.
* A logical approach to troubleshooting, including gathering relevant information, documenting findings and following established escalation procedures.
* Ability to prioritise enquiries and operational tasks according to urgency, business impact and agreed service levels.
* Ability to maintain accurate records and follow documented procedures when handling client information, game results and transaction data.

**Desirable**

* Previous experience in customer service, B2B support, technical support or an operations environment, including internships or work placements.
* Familiarity with ticketing systems, live chat platforms or monitoring dashboards.
* An interest in the iGaming industry and a basic understanding of concepts such as Return to Player (RTP), Profit and Loss (P/L), bet settlement and game rounds.
* Basic technical knowledge of web applications, APIs, log files or SQL to support investigation of operational issues

**Personal Attributes**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Organised with good attention to detail
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively
* Proactive and adaptable approach to work
* Comfortable working within a fast-paced environment

**The Benefits of working at 1X2 Network**

* Competitive salary
* We offer long-term career prospects with opportunities for training and development.
* A fun working atmosphere amongst an enthusiastic and dynamic team.
* We offer a stimulating work environment in a state-of-the-art, purpose-designed space, including free snacks and drinks.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

1X2 Network is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, supported and valued. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences and believe that diverse perspectives strengthen our teams, products and culture.

title: Senior IT Training Specialist
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

Medtronic is seeking a highly motivated Senior IT Training Specialist to support enterprise technology adoption and end-user enablement across a global organization. This role will partner with business stakeholders, project teams, and technical experts to design, develop, and deliver effective learning solutions that help employees maximize the value of enterprise IT tools and digital workplace technologies.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines expertise in adult learning principles, technology training, and stakeholder engagement with a passion for coaching users and driving successful adoption of new technologies.  
  
  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.**

* Design, develop, and deliver instructor-led, virtual, on-demand, and digital learning experiences for enterprise IT solutions.
* Facilitate engaging training sessions for end users and targeted audiences across the organization.
* Create and maintain training materials, user guides, job aids, performance support resources, and assessment tools.
* Serve as a learning coach by guiding users through technology adoption and helping improve their proficiency with enterprise software.
* Partner with business stakeholders, project teams, and subject matter experts to identify learning needs and develop effective training solutions.
* Review, validate, and update training content to ensure technical accuracy and alignment with business requirements.
* Support technology change initiatives through training, communication, and adoption activities.
* Evaluate training effectiveness and recommend improvements based on learner feedback and business outcomes.
Stay current on enterprise technologies, digital workplace tools, adult learning methodologies, and training best practices.  

  

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* 7+ years of IT experience with a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, MCA, MSc or MBA.
* Bachelor's degree in Adult Learning or Learning & Development preferred.
* Experience designing and delivering training programs for enterprise software or technology solutions.
* Knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies.
* Experience facilitating classroom, virtual, or blended learning sessions.
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies quickly and independently.
* Bachelor's degree in Adult Learning, Learning & Development, Instructional Design, Education, or a related field preferred.
* Experience coaching end users in the effective use and adoption of enterprise technology solutions.
* Experience supporting a broad range of enterprise IT software and digital workplace technologies.
* Business Analyst experience, including gathering requirements and translating business needs into learning solutions.
* Strong technical aptitude with experience reviewing and validating technical training content.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Microsoft Teams, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Word, and other collaboration tools.
* Experience leveraging AI-powered tools and technologies to improve learning effectiveness and business outcomes.
* Learning mindset with strong self-directed learning capability.
* Ability to quickly develop expertise in new technologies and software platforms.
* Passion for coaching and enabling others to succeed.
* Strong collaboration and influencing skills across technical and business teams.
Comfortable working independently while managing multiple priorities in a global environment.  

**Physical Job Requirements**  
  
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
‌
‌

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:

  

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.

  

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

  

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.

  

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com .

===========================

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.  
‌

This position is eligible for a short-term incentive called the Medtronic Incentive Plan (MIP).

title: Customer Support Engineer (Technical Support- SQL, Oracle)
description:
As a member of the Model N Support team, the Customer Support Engineer is responsible for managing assigned support tickets while continuously building technical, business, and product expertise.

This role involves owning the ticket lifecycle, setting and meeting customer expectations, and providing clear, timely updates. The engineer actively participates in customer interactions, communicates progress effectively, and handles sensitive situations with guidance from senior team members.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Technical & Professional Development**

* Continuously enhance business, product, and technical knowledge
* Develop deep expertise in one or more functional or technical areas
* Contribute to knowledge repositories and documentation

**2. Ticket Management & Problem Solving**

* Analyse, troubleshoot, and resolve customer issues effectively
* Provide frequent, clear updates and next steps to customers
* Set and manage customer expectations throughout the ticket lifecycle
* Participate in customer meetings and discussions
* Communicate professionally, including handling sensitive issues with guidance
* Collaborate with team members and support team decisions
* Escalate issues appropriately when customer relationships are at risk

**Technical Skills & Requirements**

**Core Technical Competencies**

* Troubleshooting and debugging skills (including log analysis)
* Understanding of Model N application configurations and behaviour
* Strong SQL skills (joins, subqueries, views, inline queries)
* Familiarity with data dictionary and application architecture
* Knowledge of reporting tools (e.g., Cognos, Looker)
* Understanding of enterprise SaaS environments

**Tools & Technologies**

* Experience with tools such as:
* + JSM, Oracle, SQL Developer
  + SharePoint, Excel
* Ability to extract diagnostics (heap dumps, thread dumps, etc.)

**Soft Skills & Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Effective written and verbal communication
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Customer-centric mindset
* Adaptability and continuous learning attitude

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 2+ years of experience supporting enterprise-level software in a customer-facing environment
* Experience in SaaS-based applications preferred

**Success Factors**

* Consistently meets SLAs and commitments
* Builds customer trust through effective communication
* Demonstrates growth in technical and product expertise
* Contributes to team knowledge and process improvements

#### **How We Work**

**Our DARE core values** - **D**REAM**, A**LIGN**, R**ESPECT, and **E**XCEL - shape how we work together.

* We solve practical problems that matter to our customers and teams.

* We work across functions and value clear, respectful communication.

* We recognize good work and support growth over time.

* We are curious about better ways to work, including thoughtful use of AI and modern tools.

We do not expect every person to be perfect in every area. We look for strong fundamentals, curiosity, ownership, and the ability to keep growing.

#### **Compensation, Benefits, and Inclusion**

At Model N, your well-being and growth matter. We offer a competitive total rewards package designed to support employees personally and professionally.

Benefits and compensation for this position will be provided in accordance with Model N’s India programs and applicable local requirements.

#### **Bring Your N Factor**

We are not just looking for a checklist of skills. We are looking for people who bring ideas, curiosity, and a point of view.

If this role sounds interesting and you can see yourself adding value, we would love to hear from you.

**About Model N**

Model N is transforming how Life Sciences companies manage revenue, commercialization, and compliance.

For more than **25 years,** Model N has been the leader in end-to-end commercialization, revenue optimization, and compliance for pharmaceutical and medical technology companies.

Our intelligent, cloud-based platform combines technology, data, analytics, AI, and industry expertise to help leading Life Sciences organizations **optimize revenue, navigate complex regulations, improve decision-making,** and bring life-changing products to market faster.

Today, **150+ leading companies** across the globe trust Model N to optimize growth and transform critical commercial processes. Our solutions manage approximately **$1.3 trillion in gross revenue**, helping customers reduce complexity, strengthen compliance, and unlock new opportunities for growth.

At Model N, we are building the next generation of **Life Sciences revenue management**—where technology, data, AI, and human expertise come together to create meaningful business impact.

Join us to build technology that powers innovation in Life Sciences and makes a difference at global scale.

For more information, visit www.modeln.com.

description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a technically sound and proactive Desktop Support Engineer to provide day-to-day IT and technical support to our employees. The ideal candidate should have basic knowledge of computer hardware, software troubleshooting, networking, and desktop support.

This role is suitable for candidates who have approximately one year of experience or relevant internship experience and are looking to build their career in IT infrastructure and technical support.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Desktop & Technical Support**

- Provide day-to-day technical support to employees for desktop computers, laptops, printers, and other IT peripherals.

- Install, configure, and troubleshoot computer hardware, operating systems, and software applications.

- Diagnose and resolve common system issues, including slow performance, software errors, connectivity problems, and device malfunctions.

- Assist employees with technical queries and ensure minimal disruption to their daily work.

- Support the setup and configuration of new desktops, laptops, and user workstations.

**2. Network Support**

- Assist with basic network troubleshooting and connectivity issues.

- Troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, and internet connectivity problems.

- Understand basic networking concepts, including IP addresses, DNS, DHCP, routers, and switches.

- Identify and escalate network issues that require advanced technical support.

- Assist with network cable connections and basic network device checks.

**3. Hardware & Software Management**

- Perform basic hardware checks and troubleshooting for desktops, laptops, monitors, keyboards, mice, and printers.

- Install and update approved software, drivers, and system updates.

- Assist with operating system installation, configuration, and maintenance.

- Support antivirus updates and follow basic IT security practices.

- Maintain records of IT assets, installed software, and equipment allocation.

**4. IT Helpdesk & User Support**

- Respond to employee IT support requests and resolve issues within a reasonable timeframe.

- Record, track, and update technical issues and their resolutions.

- Escalate complex hardware, software, and network issues to the appropriate team or service provider.

- Provide basic guidance to employees on the proper use of IT systems and equipment.

- Maintain a professional and service-oriented approach while assisting users.

**5. IT Asset & Documentation Management**

- Maintain an inventory of desktops, laptops, printers, and other IT equipment.

- Assist with IT asset allocation, collection, and configuration during employee onboarding and exit processes.

- Maintain documentation of troubleshooting activities, service requests, and equipment repairs.

- Coordinate with external IT vendors for repairs, maintenance, or technical support when required.

- Diploma or degree in IT, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field is preferred.

- CCNA certification is a must

- Around 1 year of experience in Desktop Support, IT Support, or Technical Support.

- Basic knowledge of computer hardware, software installation, and troubleshooting.

- Understanding of networking fundamentals, including LAN, Wi-Fi, IP addressing, DNS, and DHCP.

- Familiarity with Windows operating systems and common office applications.

- Basic knowledge of printers, scanners, and other office IT peripherals.

- Good troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.

- Willingness to learn, work independently on routine issues, and collaborate with the team.

**Preferred Skills**

- Basic experience with Microsoft 365 or MS Office applications.

- Familiarity with remote desktop or remote support tools.

- Basic understanding of antivirus software, system updates, and IT security.

- Knowledge of user account setup and access management.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is hands-on, organised, and eager to learn. The candidate should be comfortable assisting employees with everyday technical issues, troubleshooting network and desktop problems, and ensuring that IT equipment functions smoothly.

A positive attitude, willingness to take ownership, and an interest in developing technical skills will be important for this role.

title: Data Service Excellence Specialist, IT
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale.
  
  
Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams.
  
  
As part of our IT team, your expertise will help deliver reliable, customer-focused support for Edwards' global Data & Analytics platforms. We are seeking a Data Service Excellence Specialist to provide Level 3 support, access governance, incident resolution, user guidance, and operational coordination across Power BI, Qlik, Snowflake, and related services. This role is a hands-on escalation and resolution point that works directly with business users and partners with deeper platform and engineering specialists when a change to the underlying product or platform is required.
  
  
Shift Time - 3 PM IST to 12 AM IST
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**

* Provide Level 3 functional and technical support for Data & Analytics platforms, including Power BI, Qlik, Snowflake, and related services, resolving complex incidents and requests within the role’s area of expertise.
* Investigate incidents and service requests by gathering evidence, reproducing issues, analyzing business impact, troubleshooting root causes, implementing appropriate resolutions, and documenting outcomes.
* Own access requests and provisioning activities while ensuring alignment with security, governance, compliance, and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Act as the escalation point for front-line and offshore support resources, validating prior troubleshooting, improving escalation quality, and engaging platform engineering or product teams only when deeper code, infrastructure, or design changes are required.
* Monitor, prioritize, and coordinate incident and request workloads through ServiceNow, Jira, and established service management practices, with clear communication through resolution.
* Serve as a liaison among business users, technical teams, and Pune-based or offshore support resources to maintain effective communication and dependable service delivery.
* Coordinate day-to-day operational activities across distributed support resources, including work prioritization, knowledge transfer, onboarding, and readiness for new or changing services.
* Create, maintain, and improve knowledge articles, FAQs, runbooks, support documentation, onboarding materials, and operational procedures.
* Coach support team members on troubleshooting methods, platform knowledge, service standards, and effective customer communication without direct people-management responsibility.
* Analyze recurring incidents and support trends, perform root cause reviews, and recommend or implement improvements that reduce repeat demand and improve the user experience.
* Support training and enablement for analytics users and new support team members across technical and non-technical audiences.

**What You Will Need (Required)**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field and a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in data and analytics support, business systems analysis, application support, or a related role; or a Master's Degree and a minimum of 2 years of related experience.
* Hands-on experience supporting analytics platforms, with Power BI experience required and experience with Qlik, Tableau, Snowflake, or comparable platforms strongly valued.
* Experience resolving escalated application or platform incidents beyond basic intake and routing, including root cause investigation, documented resolution, and effective engagement of engineering teams when needed.
* Familiarity with ITIL service management practices, including Incident, Request, and Problem Management.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret incomplete or conflicting information.
* Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical users and manage multiple priorities independently.
* Strong documentation, organization, time management, stakeholder management, and customer service skills.
* Experience coordinating work, knowledge transfer, and operational readiness across geographically distributed teams.
* Ability to facilitate onboarding, training, and knowledge-sharing activities.
* Adhere to all company rules and requirements, including Environmental Health & Safety rules, and take adequate control measures to prevent injuries, protect the environment, and prevent pollution under their span of influence or control.

**What Else We Look For (Preferred)**

* Experience working in a global or matrixed environment and coordinating offshore or vendor-based support resources.
* Working knowledge of Snowflake roles and permissions and the ability to use simple SQL queries for investigation.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, GitLab, or comparable service management and version control tools.
* Understanding of data governance principles, analytics workflows, and access-control practices.
* Basic SQL or DAX knowledge, including simple queries, measures, or calculated columns.
* Experience developing runbooks, knowledge articles, support metrics, and service improvement plans.

**Additional Information**

* Works independently on Level 3 support activities with general supervision and applies judgment to select the appropriate resolution or escalation path based on technical findings and business impact.
* May provide functional guidance to lower-level or front-line support personnel while partnering with people managers or vendor leadership on formal people-management matters.
* Travel may be required up to 5%.

**Benefits And Equal Opportunity**
Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families.

title: IT Support Engineer
description:
**About This Role**
The IT Services & Support (ITSD) team keeps Comscore's global workforce productive by owning identity, endpoint, and service-desk operations across our Reston, Portland, New York, Amsterdam, Warsaw, Santiago, and Pune offices. The team runs Comscore's Okta tenant, JIRA Service Management portal, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID directory, and endpoint management platforms (Jamf Pro, Quest KACE, Automox, Intune), and is the first-line owner for every access, hardware, software, and productivity request across the company.
  
  
Comscore is hiring IT Support Engineers to join the growing Pune arm of this team. This is a hands-on, ticket-driven role that owns a defined slice of the JIRA Service Management (IESD) queue end-to-end during APAC and EMEA business hours. This role works directly with the Pune Team Lead and existing Pune specialists on daily service-desk operations, access provisioning, and endpoint recovery for employees in the US, EMEA, LATAM, and APAC.
  
  
We are open to candidates with varying years of experience. If you have strong fundamentals in identity, access, and end-user support, and the attitude to treat each ticket as a problem to understand rather than a form to fill, we will train you on our stack.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Pick up tickets from the IT Service Desk queue in JIRA Service Management, resolve them end-to-end using documented runbooks, and apply the appropriateness-check discipline that governs access grants at Comscore.
* Add and remove users from Okta groups, Active Directory security groups, and Microsoft 365 security groups to grant application access across roughly 270 Okta-managed applications, including Claude Code / Apps Gateway, Microsoft Copilot, Adobe Creative Cloud, and the long tail of business tooling.
* Manage distribution lists, mail aliases, shared mailboxes, and robotic mailboxes in Microsoft 365 admin center and Active Directory.
* Process contractor account creations, 90-day extensions, and offboarding in Active Directory and Okta.
* Perform BitLocker recovery-key retrieval, Quest KACE and Automox agent re-enrollment, and CrowdStrike Falcon user-facing endpoint recovery.
* Reset MFA factors, unlock accounts, and support user password resets across Okta and Active Directory, including scripted bulk operations on Panel Activation accounts.
* Support the Pune office with hardware setup, Windows and macOS laptop imaging, dual-monitor configuration, and new-hire onboarding, shared with the existing Pune team members.
* Document the workflows you own as reusable runbooks in Confluence and keep them current as the stack evolves.
* Escalate judgment calls (tight-license applications, admin-level access requests, policy exceptions) to the Pune Team Lead or the US senior engineers.
* Participate in the follow-the-sun support model with a defined overlap window each week for US and EMEA collaboration, closing tickets before the US team's working day begins.
* Communicate incident status, change notifications, and ticket updates in clear written English to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of the IT service catalog and the quality of request-type templates in the JIRA Service Management portal.

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field. Fresh graduates with strong fundamentals and a visible interest in IT support operations are welcome to apply.
* Zero to five years of experience in IT Service Desk, IT Support, Desktop Support, or a related operations role.
* Hands-on exposure to at least one of: Okta, Microsoft 365 admin center, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID. Working familiarity with JIRA Service Management is a plus.
* Comfortable with ticket-driven work, SLA discipline, and queue-based prioritization.
* Clear written and spoken English, sufficient for daily interaction with US and EMEA engineers, managers, and end users.
* Attention to detail and the ability to follow, refine, and author operational procedures.
* Analytical mindset — you treat a ticket as a problem to understand, not a form to fill.
* Ownership attitude and willingness to pick up unfamiliar workflows with a runbook and a bit of coaching.
* Based in Pune or willing to relocate. The role is hybrid, with Pune-office presence expected two to three days a week.
* Ability to work a schedule that provides at least two hours of overlap with US Eastern time each week for cross-region collaboration and handoff.

**Preferred**

* Exposure to Jamf Pro, Quest KACE, Automox, or Microsoft Intune on the endpoint-management side.
* Working knowledge of CrowdStrike Falcon or any enterprise EDR console.
* Scripting familiarity in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automating repetitive administrative tasks.
* Any identity or Microsoft 365 certification (Okta Certified Professional, Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator SC-300, Microsoft 365 Fundamentals MS-900).
* ITIL Foundation certification.
* Prior experience in a follow-the-sun IT support operating model with US, EMEA, and APAC handoffs.
* Familiarity with Slack, Zoom, and Adobe Creative Cloud administration.
* Experience with Confluence page authoring and knowledge-base contribution.
* Prior experience supporting ISO 27001, SOC 2, or MRC audit evidence collection cycles.

**Working Hours**
This role also supports Comscore offices in the United States and Europe during their local business hours, Monday through Friday. There is no weekend coverage; you will be assigned to one of the three fixed shift windows.
  
  
**About Comscore**
At Comscore, we’re pioneering the future of cross-platform media measurement, arming organizations with the insights they need to make decisions with confidence. Central to this aim are our people who work together to simplify the complex on behalf of our clients & partners. Though our roles and skills are varied, we’re united by our commitment to five underlying values: Integrity, Velocity, Accountability, Teamwork, and Servant Leadership. If you’re motivated by big challenges and interested in helping some of the largest and most important media properties and brands navigate the future of media, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
Comscore (NASDAQ: SCOR) is a trusted partner for planning, transacting and evaluating media across platforms. With a data footprint that combines digital, linear TV, over-the-top and theatrical viewership intelligence with advanced audience insights, Comscore allows media buyers and sellers to quantify their multiscreen behavior and make business decisions with confidence. A proven leader in measuring digital and set-top box audiences and advertising at scale, Comscore is the industry’s emerging, third-party source for reliable and comprehensive cross-platform measurement. To learn more about Comscore, please visit Comscore.com.
  
  
Comscore is committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity.

title: Specialist/Engineer Service Operations
description:
**Overview**
**WELCOME TO**
**SITA**
At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
  
  
You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a
**Great Place to Work**
® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
  
  
Are you ready to love your job?
  
  
The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
  
  
**About The Role & Team**
You will be the first point of contact for customers, delivering timely, accurate, and customer-focused IT support. You will own incidents and service requests through to resolution or approved handover, ensuring clear communication and high-quality service at every stage. Working within SITA's global service model, you will leverage ServiceNow, standardized processes, and defined escalation paths to provide a consistent support experience across regions and channels while contributing to operational excellence and customer satisfaction.
  
  
The Service Desk provides 24/7 global support from Delhi and Montreal, managing incidents, service requests, customer communications and escalations through to resolution.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Incident End-to-End Ownership**

* Own assigned incidents and requests from logging through resolution, closure or accepted handover.
* Complete diagnosis,use approved knowledge and engage resolver groups with clear evidence while retaining customer-facing ownership.
* Recognize potential P1 or Major Incident conditions,invoke the defined escalation path and support coordination, timeline capture and communications.
* Maintain disciplined shift handovers so priority work and customer commitments remain owned during reduced coverage.

**Customer Outcomes**

* Prioritize restoration and reduction of customer impact, not ticket completion alone.
* Communicate progress, ownership, next steps and follow-up in clear language.
* Confirm the agreed outcome before closure and record unresolved concerns.

**AI, Automation and Tooling Adoption**

* Use approved AI-assisted triage, summarization, knowledge recommendation and routing with required human validation.
* Use automated workflows and self-service handoffs correctly and intervene when automation does not protect the customer outcome.
* Identify repetitive demand, failed automation and missing knowledge with supporting evidence.

**Data, Service Intelligence and Predictive Awareness**

* Use queues, dashboards, service status and known-error information to prioritize work.
* Recognize patterns indicating repeat failure, rising demand or degradation and escalate with evidence.
* Record accurate categorization, timestamps, impact, diagnosis and resolution information.

**ServiceNow Greenfield and CMDB Maturity**

* Follow approved ServiceNow workflows, states, assignment paths and closure controls.
* Use available service and configuration data in diagnosis and routing.
* Report suspected CMDB inaccuracies and maintain records that support reporting, automation and auditability.

**Workforce Transformation and Continuous Improvement**

* Adopt global queues, new channels, revised processes and changing skills requirements.
* Complete required learning and share knowledge across shifts.
* Contribute practical improvement feedback based on operational evidence.

**Qualifications**
**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS**

* 3+ years of experience in Service Desk, technical support, customer support or operations.
* Practical incident handling, troubleshooting, communication and escalation experience.
* Ability to use ITSM workflows, knowledge and dashboards.
* Relevant technical, service management, operations or equivalent professional experience.
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent demonstrated ITSM knowledge.

**NICE-TO-HAVE**

* Experience with ServiceNow, AI-assisted support, automation, self-service or virtual agents.
* Exposure to CMDB or service configuration data.

**What We Offer**
We’re all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We’re really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
  
  
🏡
**Flex Week:**
Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team’s needs)
  
  
⏰
**Flex Day:**
Make your workday suit your life and plans.
  
  
🌎
**Flex Location:**
Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
  
  
🌿
**Employee Wellbeing:**
We’ve got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health – a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
  
  
🚀
**Professional Development**
: At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From
**LinkedIn Learning**
,
**Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative**
, and
**Airport Council International**
—available to all employees—to specialized solutions like
**Pluralsight**
for technology upskilling,
**Harvard Business Publishing**
for people leadership,
**Stanford**
for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.
  
  
**🙌🏽 Competitive Benefits**
: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.
  
  
*SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.*
**Salary / Compensation Note**
Hidden (-999)

description:

**Job Description**

The Software Portfolio Specialist supports the end-to-end management of the organization’s software application portfolio, from initial business need and sourcing through provisioning, ongoing administration, renewal, optimization, and retirement. This role partners with business stakeholders, Purchasing, Cybersecurity, software vendors, and other IT teams to ensure applications are effectively managed and aligned with business needs.

As a founding member of our new Delhi hub, this individual will play a key role in helping establish and shape the function locally, contributing to process development, operational excellence, and the long-term growth of the team while supporting a global technology environment.

**Job Responsibilities**

**Software Application Management**

* Support the full lifecycle of software applications, including evaluation, onboarding, administration, optimization, renewal, and retirement.
* Administer software applications as assigned, including user access, license allocation, account provisioning/deprovisioning, and routine configuration.
* Coordinate with other Technology teams on application-related security, identity/access, endpoint, infrastructure, architecture, and support requirements.
* Maintain accurate application records, including licensing information, business ownership, renewal dates, contracts, entitlements, and other portfolio data.
* Execute established policies, procedures, and controls.
* Support software license optimization and reclamation activities.

Analyzes trends to predict changes that may impact customer’s long-term business goals
