Join our team and start your journey today!
  
  
**General Manager of Manufacturing Atit India**
The General Manager of Manufacturing is responsible for leading and optimizing all manufacturing and operational functions at the Atit facility, ensuring the safe, efficient, and profitable production of IHP, FHP, Scroll, CDU, and HP product lines in Atit India. This role provides strategic and operational leadership across Production, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering (AME), Manufacturing Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, Safety, and Master Scheduling to deliver business objectives in Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and People Development.
  
  
The incumbent will drive operational excellence, capacity expansion, productivity improvements, employee engagement, continuous improvement initiatives, and talent development while maintaining compliance with company standards and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead all manufacturing operations across IHP, FHP, Scroll, CDU, and HP production lines.
* Develop and execute operational strategies aligned with business growth, productivity, quality, and customer satisfaction objectives.
* Drive operational performance through effective management of KPIs including Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Inventory, Productivity, and Employee Engagement.
* Ensure manufacturing capacity and resources are aligned with business demand and growth plans.
* Lead daily operational reviews and establish accountability for performance improvement actions.
* Champion a safety-first culture and ensure compliance with all company, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure robust quality systems, problem-solving methodologies, and corrective action processes are implemented and sustained.
* Drive reductions in defects, customer complaints, scrap, rework, and warranty costs.
* Lead Advanced Manufacturing Engineering teams in developing scalable, efficient, and standardized manufacturing processes.
* Support new product introductions, capacity expansions, process validations, and manufacturing readiness.
* Lead preventive and predictive maintenance programs to maximize equipment uptime and asset utilization.
* Oversee Master Scheduling processes to ensure alignment between customer demand, production capacity, inventory, and material availability.
* Partner closely with Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, and Customer Service teams to achieve delivery commitments.
* Build a high-performing operations organization through leadership, coaching, and succession planning.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and employee empowerment.
* Lead positive and constructive relationships with union representatives and employee committees.
* Ensure compliance with labor laws, collective bargaining agreements, and company policies.
* Partner with HR to address workforce challenges, employee relations matters, and organizational effectiveness initiatives.
* Support effective management and development of the hourly workforce while maintaining a positive employee relations environment.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Establish a culture of continuous improvement and data-driven decision-making throughout operations.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Minimum 10+ years of manufacturing leadership experience, including leadership of multiple operational functions.
* Significant experience managing large-scale manufacturing operations in a high-volume industrial environment.
* Demonstrated success leading Production, Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, Supply Chain interfaces, and Operational Excellence initiatives.
* Experience managing unionized and hourly workforces preferred.
* Proven experience leading organizational transformation, capacity expansion, and continuous improvement programs.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic leadership and business acumen.
* Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma expertise.
* Operations and supply chain management.
* Manufacturing engineering and industrial automation knowledge.
* Strong financial and cost management capabilities.
* Talent development and succession planning.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
* Effective communication and cross-functional leadership.

**Our Commitment to Our People**
Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.
  
  
Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.
  
  
Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
  
  
Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!
  
  
**Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging**

Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.

title: Senior Finance Manager (E-commerce))
description:
Tee Ess

**We Are Hiring**

**Designation:**

**Finance Manager – E-commerce**

**Experience:**

**8 to 10 years**

**Educational Qualification:**

**• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related discipline from a recognized university.**

**• CA / CMA / MBA (Finance) / M.Com or other relevant postgraduate qualification will be preferred.**

**• Professional certifications in financial management, taxation, accounting, data analytics, or ERP systems will be an added advantage.**

**Experience:**

**• Minimum 6–10 years of experience in Finance, Accounting, Commercial Finance, Business Finance, or E-commerce Finance.**

**• Strong hands-on experience in E-commerce finance, marketplace finance, D2C finance, or digital commerce operations is preferred.**

**• Candidates with experience in Color Cosmetics, Beauty, Personal Care, FMCG, Consumer Goods, D2C, Retail, or E-commerce businesses will be preferred.**

**• Proven experience in revenue reconciliation, marketplace settlements, payment gateway reconciliation, working capital, budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting.**

**• Experience in managing Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, Shopify, D2C platforms, payment gateways, and other E-commerce channels will be an added advantage.**

**• Experience in financial analysis, margin management, cost control, inventory accounting, and business performance analysis.**

**Role Summary:**

**The Finance Manager – E-commerce will be responsible for managing and overseeing Tee Ess' finance and accounting operations across its E-commerce, D2C, marketplace, and digital sales channels. The role will focus on revenue reconciliation, marketplace settlements, profitability analysis, working capital management, budgeting, forecasting, inventory accounting, cost optimization, and financial reporting.**

**The position will work closely with E-commerce, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, and Leadership teams to provide accurate financial insights, improve channel profitability, strengthen financial controls, and support sustainable business growth.**

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

**E-commerce Finance & Revenue Management**

**• Manage end-to-end finance operations for Tee Ess' E-commerce, D2C, marketplace, and digital sales channels.**

**• Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly sales revenue across marketplaces and E-commerce platforms.**

**• Reconcile orders, sales, cancellations, returns, refunds, discounts, commissions, shipping charges, and other marketplace deductions.**

**• Ensure accurate accounting of revenue across Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa, Myntra, Shopify, D2C platforms, and other sales channels.**

**• Track marketplace settlements and ensure timely reconciliation of receivables.**

**• Identify and resolve discrepancies between E-commerce platforms, payment gateways, ERP systems, and accounting records.**

**• Monitor channel-wise revenue, contribution margins, profitability, and financial performance.**

**Marketplace & Payment Reconciliation**

**• Perform regular reconciliation of marketplace statements, payment gateway settlements, bank collections, and ERP/accounting records.**

**• Monitor marketplace commissions, advertising charges, logistics costs, penalties, returns, refunds, and other deductions.**

**• Identify revenue leakage, incorrect deductions, short settlements, and unreconciled transactions.**

**• Coordinate with E-commerce and marketplace teams to resolve settlement and payment discrepancies.**

**• Maintain accurate reconciliation statements and ensure closure of outstanding items within defined timelines.**

**Financial Planning & Analysis**

**• Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets for E-commerce and D2C operations.**

**• Develop financial forecasts based on sales trends, product performance, marketing plans, inventory levels, and business projections.**

**• Prepare channel-wise and product-wise profitability analysis.**

**• Analyze gross margin, contribution margin, EBITDA, CAC, ROAS, AOV, return rates, and other relevant E-commerce financial metrics.**

**• Provide financial insights to management for pricing, promotions, product launches, marketing investments, and business expansion decisions.**

**• Conduct variance analysis between actual performance and budget/forecast and recommend corrective actions.**

**Cost & Profitability Management**

**• Monitor and control E-commerce operating costs, marketplace commissions, logistics expenses, payment gateway charges, promotional discounts, and marketing spends.**

**• Evaluate the financial impact of discounts, coupons, promotional campaigns, and marketplace offers.**

**• Analyze product-level and channel-level contribution margins to identify profitable and underperforming categories.**

**• Work with Marketing and E-commerce teams to evaluate campaign profitability and ROI.**

**• Identify opportunities for cost optimization and revenue improvement across E-commerce operations.**

**Inventory & Working Capital Management**

**• Monitor inventory valuation, stock movement, ageing, provisions, and inventory-related financial impact.**

**• Coordinate with Supply Chain and Operations teams to optimize inventory levels and working capital.**

**• Monitor slow-moving, non-moving, damaged, expired, and obsolete inventory and recommend appropriate financial provisions/actions.**

**• Track accounts receivable, accounts payable, payment cycles, and working capital requirements.**

**• Prepare working capital analysis and recommend initiatives to improve cash flow.**

**Accounting & Financial Reporting**

**• Ensure accurate recording and accounting of E-commerce transactions in the ERP/accounting system.**

**• Prepare monthly MIS, management reports, profitability statements, and financial dashboards.**

**• Support month-end and year-end closing activities, including accruals, provisions, reconciliations, and revenue recognition.**

**• Ensure accurate accounting of sales returns, refunds, discounts, commissions, freight, marketplace charges, and other E-commerce-related expenses.**

**• Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, and internal stakeholders for financial and statutory requirements.**

**• Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, GST, TDS, and other relevant statutory requirements.**

**Business Finance & Commercial Support**

**• Partner with E-commerce, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations teams to support business decisions.**

**• Evaluate new marketplace/channel opportunities from a financial and commercial perspective.**

**• Support pricing decisions by analyzing product costs, marketplace charges, logistics costs, discounts, and desired margins.**

**• Review commercial terms with marketplaces, vendors, logistics partners, agencies, and other business partners.**

**• Support management in evaluating business cases, investments, new product launches, and expansion initiatives.**

**MIS, Analytics & Continuous Improvement**

**• Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly finance dashboards for E-commerce business performance.**

**• Develop automated reports and dashboards for revenue, profitability, reconciliation, collections, expenses, and working capital.**

**• Analyze financial data to identify trends, risks, revenue leakages, and opportunities for improvement.**

**• Implement stronger financial controls and reconciliation processes across E-commerce operations.**

**• Drive process improvements through ERP, automation, analytics, and technology-enabled finance solutions.**

**Team & Cross-functional Coordination**

**• Lead and manage finance activities related to Tee Ess' E-commerce business.**

**• Coordinate with internal finance and accounting teams to ensure timely closure of transactions and reconciliations.**

**• Collaborate closely with E-commerce, Marketing, Sales, Supply Chain, Procurement, Warehouse, and Operations teams.**

**• Establish clear financial processes, controls, and accountability across E-commerce operations.**

**• Support and mentor team members in E-commerce finance, reconciliation, reporting, and analysis.**

**Required Skills & Expertise:**

**• Strong knowledge of E-commerce finance, marketplace settlements, revenue reconciliation, and D2C business models.**

**• Strong understanding of P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, working capital, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.**

**• Hands-on experience with Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa, Myntra, Shopify, D2C platforms, payment gateways, or similar E-commerce ecosystems will be preferred.**

**• Strong knowledge of GST, TDS, taxation, accounting principles, and financial controls.**

**• Proficiency in ERP/accounting systems such as SAP, Oracle, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, or similar platforms.**

**• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, dashboards, and financial modelling.**

**• Experience with Power BI or other business intelligence/reporting tools will be an added advantage.**

**• Strong analytical, numerical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.**

**• Strong commercial understanding and business acumen.**

**• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills.**

**Preferred Industry Experience:**

**Candidates with experience in the following industries will be preferred:**

**• Color Cosmetics / Beauty & Cosmetics**

**• D2C / E-commerce**

**• FMCG / Consumer Goods**

**• Personal Care / Beauty Products**

**• Retail**

**• Consumer Brands**

**• Marketplace-driven businesses**

**Candidates with direct experience in Color Cosmetics and E-commerce Finance will be strongly preferred.**

**Personal Attributes:**

**• Commercially oriented and financially astute professional.**

**• Strong analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail.**

**• Result-driven with a strong focus on accuracy and financial discipline.**

**• Proactive, process-oriented, and solution-focused.**

**• Strong ownership and accountability.**

**• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced E-commerce environment.**

**• Collaborative leader with strong interpersonal and stakeholder management abilities.**

**• Adaptable and comfortable working with changing business priorities and high-growth environments.**

**Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

**• E-commerce Revenue Reconciliation Accuracy.**

**• Marketplace Settlement Reconciliation TAT.**

**• Revenue Leakage / Recovery.**

**• E-commerce Gross Margin & Contribution Margin.**

**• Channel-wise Profitability.**

**• Budget vs. Actual Variance.**

**• Working Capital Improvement.**

**• Accounts Receivable / Collection Efficiency.**

**• Inventory Accuracy & Inventory Value Optimization.**

**• Cost Reduction / Cost Optimization.**

**• Marketplace Commission & Expense Optimization.**

**• Financial Reporting Accuracy & Timeliness.**

**• Month-end Closing TAT.**

**• MIS Reporting Accuracy and Timeliness.**

**• Compliance and Audit Closure.**

**Working Conditions:**

**• Full-time position based at Tee Ess' corporate office.**

**• Regular coordination with Finance, E-commerce, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Warehouse, Operations, marketplaces, payment gateways, and external business partners.**

**• Extended working hours may be required during month-end/year-end closing, major sales campaigns, festive periods, product launches, and business-critical operations.**

**• Occasional travel may be required to Tee Ess' offices, warehouses, manufacturing facilities, marketplaces, vendors, and business partner locations as required.**

**Salary Range – Upto 1 lakh per month**

title: Pricing Analyst - Senior
description:
**Job Summary**
The Pricing Analyst – Senior is responsible for developing, implementing, and optimizing pricing strategies that drive profitable growth while maintaining market competitiveness. This role leads pricing operations, pricing analytics, and cross-functional pricing initiatives by ensuring accurate pricing data, executing strategic price revisions, supporting customer pricing, and delivering actionable business insights. The position collaborates closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, IT, and business leadership to align pricing decisions with organizational objectives, enhance pricing processes, and improve customer value.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the development, implementation, and execution of pricing strategies that support business growth, profitability, and competitive positioning.
* Plan, analyze, obtain approvals for, and execute annual and mid-year pricing revisions across multiple product lines and market segments.
* Maintain accurate pricing data across ERP, CRM, order management, rebate, and pricing systems, ensuring data integrity and first-time accuracy.
* Manage multiple pricing structures and price lists while ensuring synchronization across enterprise systems.
* Prepare customer quotations and pricing proposals in collaboration with Sales teams and support complex customer pricing negotiations.
* Analyze pricing performance, market trends, customer behavior, competitive intelligence, and win/loss data to recommend pricing improvements and business actions.
* Lead pricing governance forums and facilitate collaborative pricing decisions with Sales, Finance, and business leadership.
* Design and continuously improve pricing methodologies, pricing policies, and pricing philosophies aligned with business objectives.
* Lead pricing analytics initiatives by leveraging business intelligence, automation, AI, and digital tools to improve pricing effectiveness and decision-making.
* Develop reports, dashboards, forecasts, and executive presentations that provide meaningful pricing insights and business recommendations.
* Lead pricing improvement projects, process optimization initiatives, and continuous improvement activities to enhance operational efficiency.
* Ensure timely resolution of complex pricing issues while providing excellent support to internal and external customers.
* Maintain confidentiality of pricing information and ensure compliance with company policies, governance requirements, and applicable regulations.
* Monitor pricing operational KPIs including turnaround time, accuracy, and service levels, implementing corrective actions where required.
* Coach, mentor, and develop pricing team members while fostering a collaborative, high-performance work environment.

Build strong partnerships across Sales, Finance, Marketing, IT, Supply Chain, and other business functions to achieve shared business goals.
  
  
**Core Competencies**

* Pricing Strategy & Execution
* Pricing Analytics & Business Intelligence
* Market Analysis & Forecasting
* Financial & Commercial Acumen
* Customer Pricing & Quotation Management
* Data Analysis & Decision Making
* Cross-functional Collaboration
* Stakeholder Management & Influencing
* Project Leadership & Continuous Improvement
* ERP, CRM & Pricing Systems Management
* AI & Digital Analytics Adoption
* Problem Solving & Critical Thinking
* Process Excellence
* Customer Focus
* Effective Communication
* Accountability & Ownership
* Managing Ambiguity
* Building Networks
* Collaboration
* Coaching & Team Development
* Valuing Diverse Perspectives

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Marketing, Strategy, Accounting, Business Administration , or a related discipline is required.
* Master's degree or relevant professional certifications in Pricing, Finance, Analytics, or Business Management are preferred.
* Position may require compliance with applicable export controls or sanctions regulations.

**Skills & Experience**

* Significant experience in pricing, commercial finance, pricing analytics, sales operations, business analytics, or related commercial functions.
* Experience developing and implementing pricing strategies within manufacturing, automotive, industrial, aftermarket, or B2B environments is preferred.
* Strong analytical capabilities with experience interpreting large datasets and translating insights into business recommendations.
* Experience managing complex pricing structures, customer pricing, rebates, quotations, and enterprise pricing systems.
* Working knowledge of ERP and CRM platforms (such as Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, or equivalent).
* Experience leading pricing governance, cross-functional projects, and strategic pricing initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and collaborate across multiple business functions.
* Experience leading or mentoring teams and driving employee development.
* Strong presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting/analytics tools; experience with Power BI, Tableau, AI-enabled analytics, or similar platforms is advantageous.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high levels of accuracy, quality, and customer focus.
* The position is for India aftermarket DBU Pricing leader.
* Lead a team of three office employees – who manage the day to day DBU pricing operations and Pricing analytics.

title: FinOps Engineer
description:
Company: Blessing Softtech Pvt. Ltd.

Product: Fonazo – AI-Powered Voice Agent & Subscription Platform

Job Title: FinOps Engineer

Experience: 4+ Years

Qualification: Bachelor's/Master's Degree in Finance, FinTech, Commerce, Accounting, or a related field

Location: Pune

Work Mode: Work from Office

Joining: Immediate joiners preferred

Salary: As per experience and industry standards

Job Summary

Blessing Softtech Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced FinOps Engineer with a strong background in Finance, FinTech, subscription billing, and payment gateway management to run financial operations for clients using Fonazo, our AI-powered voice agent and subscription platform.

The ideal candidate has 4+ years of hands-on experience with subscription billing, payment processing, reconciliation, settlements, refunds, chargebacks, and gateway integrations, and knows providers such as Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Braintree, Checkout.com, Worldpay (FIS Global), 2Checkout (Verifone), Square, Payoneer, and Amazon Pay.

The role covers end-to-end financial operations for multiple clients with full financial transparency across the Fonazo platform.

Key Responsibilities

1. Subscription Billing & Revenue Management

• Manage end-to-end billing for Fonazo clients: recurring payments, plans, renewals, upgrades, downgrades, and cancellations.

• Monitor revenue, billing cycles, failed payments, pending invoices, and receivables; track MRR, ARR, CLV, churn, and subscription growth.

• Ensure accurate calculation of charges, prorated billing, discounts, promotions, taxes, and fees; identify billing discrepancies and revenue leakage, find root causes, and implement fixes.

• Work with product and development teams to automate billing workflows.

2. Payment Gateway Management & Integration

• Manage operations across the gateways listed above and other providers: settings, transaction workflows, settlement schedules, payment methods, and recurring billing.

• Track payment success rates, declines, gateway fees, transaction costs, refunds, and settlement discrepancies across providers.

• Work with technical teams to troubleshoot integration issues, API billing errors, webhook failures, and transaction status mismatches.

• Evaluate gateway performance, pricing, currencies, coverage, and settlement timelines to recommend solutions for clients.

• Reconcile gateway records with Fonazo subscription records, invoices, and bank settlements.

3. Financial Reconciliation & Settlement Management

• Perform daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliation of gateway transactions, invoices, customer payments, refunds, and bank settlements, verifying gross values, fees, commissions, taxes, net settlements, and pending or disputed transactions.

• Investigate and resolve discrepancies across gateways, billing systems, accounting records, and bank statements; monitor settlement delays, failed payouts, duplicate transactions, reversals, and unaccounted entries.

• Maintain accurate ledgers, transaction registers, settlement reports, and audit documentation; coordinate with Accounts and Finance on recording revenue, receivables, gateway charges, and settlements.

4. Client Financial Operations & Account Management

• Manage subscription finance for multiple Fonazo clients: billing, collection, revenue reporting, and account-level records, including each client's plans, active subscriptions, transaction history, invoices, balances, refunds, and payment status.

• Prepare client-wise statements covering revenue, collections, failed payments, refunds, gateway charges, and net settlements.

• Resolve client billing disputes, payment failures, invoice discrepancies, refund requests, and settlement queries; communicate promptly on failed payments, pending dues, and billing changes.

• Maintain clear records of client transactions, payment histories, and subscription changes.

5. Refunds, Chargebacks & Dispute Management

• Manage refunds, chargebacks, reversals, and disputed transactions per company policy and gateway requirements; investigate disputes, gather evidence, and coordinate with providers for timely resolution.

• Monitor chargeback ratios, refund trends, and fraud indicators.

• Define procedures for refund approvals, verification, dispute escalation, and adjustments.

• Work with support and technical teams to identify dispute causes and prevent recurrence; document all refunds, chargebacks, disputes, and outcomes.

6. Financial Reporting, MIS & Analytics

• Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports on revenue, collections, transaction volumes, failed payments, refunds, and settlements; build dashboards tracking MRR, ARR, churn, renewals, payment success, receivables, and leakage.

• Analyze gateway fees, subscription performance, client profitability, transaction costs, and revenue trends; prepare client-wise and gateway-wise reports for management and business reviews.

• Identify irregularities, recurring billing issues, and inefficiencies through data analysis, using Excel, SQL, Power BI, or similar tools to automate reporting.

7. Financial Controls, Compliance & Risk Management

• Establish internal controls for billing, refunds, settlements, revenue recognition, and adjustments.

• Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax rules, provider policies, regulatory obligations, and data protection and payment requirements across relevant markets.

• Maintain audit trails, approval workflows, and supporting documents for audits.

• Coordinate with finance, compliance, and technical teams on PCI DSS and secure payment handling; monitor suspicious transactions, duplicate charges, unauthorized refunds, and fraud indicators.

8. Product & Technical Team Coordination

• Work with product, backend, QA, and DevOps teams to improve Fonazo's billing and payment modules.

• Translate financial requirements into functional specs for plans, billing logic, invoices, retries, refunds, and settlement workflows.

• Validate gateway integrations, lifecycle events, billing calculations, and reconciliation during releases; coordinate testing of payment APIs, webhooks, recurring billing, failed-payment recovery, and refund workflows.

• Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual reconciliation and streamline onboarding; help build scalable workflows for growing volumes and multiple client accounts.

9. Subscription Performance & Payment Optimization

• Analyze failed and declined transactions to identify causes and recommend corrective actions.

• Run dunning, automated retries, renewal reminders, and failed-payment recovery.

• Evaluate gateway performance to improve approval rates and reduce processing costs; monitor cancellations, involuntary churn, payment-related drop-offs, and recurring billing issues.

• Recommend improvements to pricing, billing frequency, payment methods, and collection workflows; partner with product and customer success teams to improve renewals, payment experience, and revenue retention.

10. Accounting, Budgeting & Financial Planning

• Support revenue forecasting, cash flow planning, budgeting, and management reports for Fonazo operations.

• Maintain accurate records of receivables, deferred revenue where applicable, gateway fees, refunds, and related entries.

• Coordinate with accounting on monthly closing, reconciliation, financial statements, and audits.

• Analyze client-wise revenue, operating costs, processing charges, and contribution margins; recommend improvements to strengthen controls, reduce costs, and improve cash flow visibility.

Required Technical & Functional Skills

• Strong understanding of subscription billing, recurring payments, payment processing, revenue reconciliation, and financial operations; hands-on experience with one or more of the gateways listed above.

• Knowledge of subscription lifecycle management, invoicing, retries, refunds, chargebacks, and settlement reconciliation.

• Understanding of financial reporting, revenue recognition, accounts receivable, gateway fees, and cash flow management.

• Proficiency in Excel (PivotTables, lookups, financial reporting) and MIS dashboards/Power BI or Tableau; working knowledge of SQL preferred.

• Advantageous: understanding of gateway APIs, webhooks, and reconciliation workflows; familiarity with accounting/ERP and automated billing platforms; knowledge of international payments, multi-currency, cross-border settlements, and applicable tax treatment.

Educational Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, FinTech, Commerce, Accounting, Business Administration, or related discipline (required); Master's in Finance, FinTech, Accounting, or Business Administration (preferred).

• Certifications in FinTech, payment systems, financial analysis, accounting, or financial operations are an added advantage.

Experience Requirements

• Minimum 4+ years in FinOps, subscription finance, payment operations, billing and reconciliation, or FinTech financial operations, with proven hands-on gateway and recurring-payment experience.

• Experience managing financial operations for multiple clients or subscription products, handling reconciliation, failed payments, refunds, chargebacks, settlement reports, and revenue tracking.

• Experience with SaaS, AI, voice-agent, or other recurring-revenue models is highly desirable, as is collaboration with finance, product, engineering, and support teams on complex payment issues.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Accuracy and timeliness of billing, reconciliation, client-wise revenue records, and MIS reports/dashboards.

• Reduction in unresolved settlement discrepancies, unaccounted transactions, gateway costs, and preventable revenue leakage.

• Payment success rate and failed-payment recovery; timeliness of collections, refunds, and dispute resolution.

• Effectiveness of billing automation and process improvements; compliance with internal controls and audit requirements.

* • Quality of coordination with clients, finance, and technical teams.

title: Business Intelligence Associate
description:
**About The Role**
Your role as a Business Intelligence Senior Associate is to work with the product and machine learning team to automate the process of manual forecasting and identify the root causes. You are expected to detect anomalies/issues early, identify root causes, track revenue and spend trends on an hourly/daily/weekly/monthly basis against the forecast. Coordination with multiple teams to fix problems with rollouts/ releases and ensure leadership always has an accurate view of performance.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Monitor the health of the business via tools such as our anomaly detection software and other dashboards, and keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned on the health of key input metrics.
* Hourly and daily (Real-time monitoring): Monitor the hourly trend continuously.
* Revenue declines must be assessed to find the root cause and verify if the decline is associated with any product release.
* Executive Communication: Share insights and learnings on long-term and short-term trends with a broader set of stakeholders to inform strategic planning and GTM execution.
* Allocate the identified cause to the corresponding teams and assess the next actions.
* Inform the Network Operations Center team to trigger P1/P2 alerts based on the severity of the revenue decline.
* Weekly (Medium Term Monitoring): Own the revenue forecasting process and provide executive updates
* Define variance thresholds that trigger deeper analysis to understand reasons behind movements of key dimensions.
* Investigate any metrics that show signs of decay or are deviating from the norm and find the root cause.
* Monthly (Long Term Monitoring): Lead the monthly review process with Marketplace, Product, and Engineering stakeholders to track the key drivers of our spend on an ongoing basis.
* Be intimately involved in the quarterly and annual planning process and be aware of what assumptions went into the plan.
* Act as the project manager of investigations. Cross-functionally manage workstreams with account stakeholders to complete analyses and troubleshooting

title: EYP-VME-Assistant Director
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Assistant Director – Corporate Finance**
As part of our EY-Corporate finance practice, you will help clients understand the value of their business, securities, intellectual property, capital equipment, intangibles and other assets. The group is comprised of several key areas, including business valuation, business modelling, capital equipment and complex securities.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Assistant Director with expertise in Corporate Finance Consulting to join EY-VME (Valuation, Modelling and Economics). Our corporate finance consultants help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we support our clients with their capital allocation decisions.
  
  
This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm and develop your career through a broad scope of engagements, mentoring, and learning & development. Specifically, you will be a part of the team that helps the clients understand the valuation implications of their corporate finance, capital allocation, restructuring and / or transaction related decisions.
  
  
**GDS Valuation, Modeling and Economics (VME)**
Within SaT, our VME professionals balance strong technical expertise with extensive sector and account focus to deliver integrated, multi-skill solutions and advanced decision support to our clients. We seek to leverage our deep financial, economics and analytics skills to help our clients in managing their risk/return trade-offs thereby supporting with better decision making around financing and capital efficiency.
  
  
VME comprises the full suite of valuation-related services, including Business Valuation, Business Modelling, Capital Equipment, Quantitative Finance & Economics, Corporate Finance, and Real Estate Valuation services. Our corporate finance team guides our clients’ on issues ranging from capital allocation, exploring strategic alternatives, portfolio review and optimization, financial planning to M&A advisory services. We provide them with valuable insights through use of valuation, modelling, and data analytics techniques.
  
  
With over 3,500 valuation professionals worldwide (600+ in GDS VME), no similarly positioned global professional organization can match our breadth of capabilities or our depth of resources.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Understand key client problems and taking a lead role in conducting analyses related to solving their problems in the corporate finance arena and reporting results
* Assume a steering role in report generation and detailed financial modelling
* Develop deep understanding of the markets and key clients to identify opportunities for new services and solutions, that drive sustainable growth and future-proof our business; lead conversations with stakeholders with consulting and problem-solving mindset
* Take ownership of your projects, while working collaboratively with other team members
* Maintain and develop positive, productive, and professional relationships with clients and winning repeat business
* Deep functional and sector knowledge is required to ensure value-driven and insightful results
* Lead high-complexity engagements and critical account relationships to build a successful partnership and become a trusted advisor to clients and EY onsite leaders
* Measure and monitor key performance metrics and make required interventions to bring performance on course
* Supervise, develop and mentor professionals at the Staff and Senior level

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Deep understanding of the financial valuation methods including DCF and relative valuations
* Use current technology and tools to enhance the effectiveness of services provided
* Experience in Equity Research, Investment Banking and Corporate Finance
* Excellent analytical, project-management, communication, interpersonal, and teaming skills
* The ability to work within a given budget and schedule, providing top-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Willingness and ability to travel, when necessary.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A post graduate degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting (CA) or business.
* A minimum of 10+ years of relevant experience with a national valuation firm or accounting firm’s valuation practice, or in quantitative management or litigation consulting, investment banking, private equity/venture capital or commercial banking
* Achievement of or significant progress towards a CFA, CPA, FRM, PRM or PMP designation is a plus, with an expectation of the completion of one designation within a given timeframe.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Project and people management skills
* Strong communication, presentation and relationship building skills
* The successful candidate must be committed to staying at the cutting edge of both, latest derivative valuation techniques and the financial and accounting standards that guide the use of these techniques.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 3500 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY SaT practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Engineering Manager(Site Reliability Engineering) – DTC Platform
description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION:**
**About the Organisation & Role:**
You will be part of the DTC Platform Engineering organisation responsible for delivering the shared platforms, engineering services, and foundations that enable product teams to build, test, deploy, and operate software securely and reliably at scale. Product engineering teams are the primary customers of the organisation. Through capabilities such as cloud platforms, developer experience, software delivery, quality engineering, security engineering, performance engineering, and AI-native engineering enablement, the organisation helps accelerate software delivery, improve engineering productivity, and establish consistent engineering standards across the technology landscape
  
  
As the Senior Engineering Manager(SRE), you will lead teams responsible for Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Operations, DevOps enablement and operational readiness across the DTC technology landscape. You will drive reliability, scalability, cloud governance and operational excellence. The role requires strong engineering leadership, organisational leadership and people leadership to establish a reliability-first culture while driving automation, observability, cloud optimisation and operational maturity across the DTC technology landscape.
  
  
**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**
**SRE Strategy and Reliability Engineering**

* Define and execute the SRE strategy, operating model and roadmap in line with DTC and Platform Engineering priorities.
* Establish and govern service level indicators (SLIs), service level objectives (SLOs), error budgets and reliability standards for critical consumer journeys and platform services.
* Drive reliability-by-design across architecture, development, testing, release and operations, ensuring operational requirements are addressed early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Use reliability, availability, latency, capacity and incident data to prioritize technical debt and reduce operational risks.
* Define and track reliability and incident metrics including availability, error budget consumption, incident volume, Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Mean Time to Restore (MTTR) and change failure rates.
* Enable engineering teams with tooling, observability, automation and best practices that improve service reliability, release confidence and system stability.

**Operational Excellence and Incident Management**

* Lead the engineering response for critical incidents, providing technical leadership, service diagnosis, recovery coordination and decision support to accelerate restoration of services.
* Drive blameless post-incident reviews, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), corrective actions and long-term remediation plans in partnership with engineering and service owners.
* Reduce recurring incidents and operational toil through automation, self-healing capabilities, platform improvements.
* Partner with Operations and Service Management teams to continuously improve incident response effectiveness, escalation processes, operational readiness and service resilience.

**Observability, Resilience and Peak Readiness**

* Drive a consistent observability strategy across metrics, logs, traces, dashboards and alerting, with a focus on actionable signals and early detection.
* Lead capacity planning, performance engineering, failure-mode analysis, disaster recovery and resilience testing for critical services and customer journeys.
* Own operational readiness for campaigns, product launches and seasonal peaks, ensuring risks, dependencies, capacity and recovery plans are understood and tested.
* Improve deployment safety through automated quality gates, progressive delivery, rollback and recovery capabilities, and strong change governance.
* Ensure business continuity and disaster recovery plans are documented, tested and improved based on outcomes.

**Cloud and Platform Operations**

* Provide leadership for the reliability and operational governance of Google Cloud Platform services and shared DTC infrastructure.
* Drive infrastructure automation, standardization and repeatability using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps practices.
* Partner with Architecture, Security and Platform Engineering to improve cloud reliability, scalability, security, compliance and cost efficiency.
* Establish guardrails for environments, access, configuration, service lifecycle management and operational controls.
* Promote sustainable cloud usage and FinOps practices while balancing availability, performance, resilience and cost.

**People and Engineering Leadership**

* Build, lead and develop a high-performing SRE organisation with clear accountability, sustainable ways of working and a strong service ownership mindset.
* Coach engineering managers, SRE leads and engineers through regular feedback, career development, succession planning and technical leadership.
* Own workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, capability development for the SRE function.
* Establish a healthy on-call culture that balances service needs with team sustainability and continuous improvement.

**YOUR TALENT:**

* 12+ years of experience across Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps or technology operations, including people leadership responsibility.
* Proven experience leading SRE or production engineering teams supporting high-traffic, business-critical digital platforms in a 24x7 environment.
* Strong track record of defining SRE strategy and implementing SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, production readiness and service ownership practices at organisational scale.
* Demonstrated experience leading major incidents, executive communication, root cause analysis and systematic reduction of operational risk and recurring failure.
* Strong knowledge of Google Cloud Platform and cloud-native architecture, including compute, networking, identity and access management, databases and managed platform services.
* Experience with Cloud Run, Kubernetes or equivalent container and serverless platforms.
* Experience with modern observability platforms and practices across metrics, logging, distributed tracing, alerting and service health dashboards.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform, GitOps or equivalent approaches.
* Experience with CI/CD, deployment safety, capacity planning, performance engineering, resilience testing and disaster recovery.
* Strong people leadership, stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to influence across engineering, product, security and business teams.
* Experience in global DTC, retail, omnichannel commerce or high-volume consumer digital environment preferred.
* Experience with FinOps, cloud cost governance and budget management.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field.

At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. title: Spa Therapist and spa manager

title: Plant Manager

title: Principal Lead-Infrastructure Operations
description:
**About Our Company**

Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year-end 2024. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.

Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**

The position will lead the enterprise Application Configuration Management and Drift Governance program supporting regulatory and cyber risk remediation initiatives. This role will be responsible for governing application security baselines, configuration compliance, drift monitoring, enterprise-wide patch governance, exception management and executive reporting.  
  
The individual will work closely with Application CDOs, Information Security, Vulnerability Management, Engineering, Cloud, Infrastructure, ServiceNow, CMDB, and Technology Governance teams to drive configuration hardening, baseline compliance, continuous monitoring of application configuration controls, patch compliance oversight, audit evidence readiness, and scalable governance designs for future configuration management processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the Application Configuration Management and Drift Governance program across enterprise applications.
* Establish governance processes for configuration baseline creation, review, approval, and ongoing compliance monitoring.
* Own and manage the ongoing enterprise patch audit governance process on a day-to-day basis once the operating model transitions into BAU.
* Establish and run enterprise-wide patch governance routines, including audit scheduling, compliance tracking, escalation management, evidence collection, and reporting across technology teams.
* Partner with infrastructure, application, vulnerability management, and technology governance teams to ensure patch compliance gaps are reviewed, tracked, remediated, or risk accepted in line with enterprise policy and SLA expectations.
* Develop governance playbooks and repeatable control designs that can be extended from patch audit governance into future configuration management and configuration drift processes.
* Partner with Application CDOs and Information Security teams to identify applications eligible for configuration drift governance.
* Drive onboarding of applications into Configuration Drift Management phases including Baseline Documentation, Verification Capability, and Compliance Reporting.
* Govern application configuration compliance against approved baselines, enterprise security standards, vendor recommendations, and industry frameworks.
* Manage configuration exceptions, risk acceptance reviews, remediation tracking, and issue escalation.
* Monitor configuration drift trends and ensure timely remediation of identified gaps.
* Define and track KPIs, KRIs, compliance metrics, coverage metrics, and remediation SLAs.
* Define patch governance KPIs and KRIs covering audit completion, patch compliance, overdue remediation, exception ageing, SLA adherence, and control effectiveness.
* Prepare executive dashboards and governance reports for technology and cyber risk leadership.
* Coordinate regulatory, audit, and compliance evidence requests related to configuration governance.
* Collaborate with ServiceNow, CMDB, Vulnerability Management, and Technology Governance teams to improve governance maturity and reporting automation.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen enterprise configuration compliance and cyber resilience.

**Required Qualifications**

title: Assistant Manager - SC Agro
description:
**Overview**
Responsible for driving Contract Farming (CF) operations across the Hooghly, West Midnapore & Jhargram geography to ensure sustainable procurement of quality potatoes for Lay's and Uncle chips. The role is accountable for expanding the farmer base, strengthening procurement networks, managing storage operations, and ensuring uninterrupted supplies to manufacturing plants while building strategic partnerships with farmers, aggregators, cold storages, government agencies, and other stakeholders.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Contract Farming Development
* Lead the expansion and execution of Contract Farming programs across Hooghly, West Midnapore & Jhargram.
* Identify and develop new potato-growing clusters, multiplication pockets, and farmer networks to increase program penetration and ensure long-term supply sustainability.
* Drive seed sales, farmer enrolment, and adoption of recommended agronomic practices (POP) through regular field engagement.
* Ensure timely seed distribution, crop monitoring, and technical advisory to achieve quality and productivity targets.
* Strengthen relationships with farmers, aggregators, FPOs, cooperatives, and channel partners to improve farmer retention and program scalability.
* Procurement & Supply Assurance
* Own regional procurement targets for both Contract Farming (CF) and Non-Contract Farming (NCF) potatoes within approved commercial and quality specifications.
* Ensure uninterrupted month-wise and season-wise supply of potatoes from Hooghly, West Midnapore & Jhargram to manufacturing plants.
* Monitor crop quality parameters including TPoD, solids, reducing sugars, and chip-grade specifications.
* Develop market intelligence on crop acreage, arrivals, pricing trends, competitor activities, and procurement opportunities to support commercial decision-making.
* Drive chip-grade procurement programs while ensuring quality compliance and minimizing pilferage.
* Cold Storage & Inventory Management
* Identify, onboard, and manage strategic cold storage partners across Hooghly, West Midnapore & Jhargram.
* Lead long-storage planning, inventory monitoring, quality management, and phased evacuation to ensure uninterrupted plant supplies throughout the storage season.
* Work closely with storage operators, transport partners, and manufacturing teams to optimize inventory utilization and minimize storage losses.
* Stakeholder & Government Engagement
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Agriculture and Horticulture Departments, Mandi Boards, district administration, and other government agencies across Hooghly, West Midnapore & Jhargram.
* Partner with FPOs, cooperatives, research institutions, and local organizations to strengthen farmer engagement and expand Contract Farming initiatives.
* Organize farmer meetings, field demonstrations, extension programs, and government-led initiatives to enhance program visibility and adoption.
* Operational Excellence & Compliance
* Ensure compliance with company policies, procurement processes, statutory requirements, and documentation standards.
* Oversee seed sale documentation, procurement records, mandi tax compliance, transportation documentation, and audit readiness.
* Establish and monitor field quality laboratories, cook tests, and procurement quality protocols.
* Promote adoption of digital agriculture tools, satellite-based crop monitoring, precision farming, and data-driven decision-making.
* Ensure operational discipline among aggregators, transporters, cold storage partners, and suppliers.
* Team Leadership & Capability Building
* Lead and develop the regional Agro team through coaching, mentoring, and technical capability building.
* Support implementation of an effective extension model to strengthen farmer connect and improve field execution.
* Foster a high-performance culture through structured reviews, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
* Strategic & Sustainability Initiatives
* Drive sustainability initiatives including Sustainable farming practices (SFP), regenerative agriculture, and other resource-efficient farming practices across the region.
* Support R&D initiatives involving new potato varieties, agronomic practices, crop protection molecules, and field demonstrations.

**Qualifications**
Experience & Qualifications
  
  
Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in agriculture (B.Sc. Agriculture) is preferable.
* MBA/Postgraduate qualification in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Marketing, or Supply Chain is preferred.

**Experience**

* 6–8 years of experience in Contract Farming, agricultural procurement, agri-input sales, or agri-supply chain management.
* Strong experience working with potato farming ecosystems, cold storage operations, and farmer engagement in North Bengal, Bihar, or similar geographies.
* Demonstrated ability to manage government stakeholders, FPOs, traders, transporters, and cold storage partners.
* Proven leadership skills with experience in leading field teams and driving regional business outcomes.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Contract Farming Development
* Farmer & Aggregator Relationship Management
* Potato Procurement & Market Intelligence
* Cold Storage & Inventory Management
* Commercial Negotiation
* Government & Institutional Liaison
* Supply Chain Planning & Execution
* Team Leadership & Capability Development
* Data Analytics & Digital Agriculture
* Sustainability & Regenerative Agriculture

Problem Solving & Execution Excellence

title: Assistant General Manager (CDL)
description:
****Assistant General Manager – Shuttle Operations (CDL Required)****
**LAZ Airport Services | Full-Time | Leadership | CDL Required**
****Lead Operations. Develop Leaders. Drive the Future of Transportation.****
At LAZ Parking, our people are the foundation of our success. As the Assistant General Manager (AGM) of Shuttle Operations, you will play a critical leadership role in supporting one of the region's largest transportation operations.
  
  
This position partners with the General Manager to oversee operational performance, employee engagement, safety, financial results, and customer satisfaction across a complex shuttle transportation environment. You will lead managers, supervisors, and frontline employees while driving operational excellence and ensuring a safe, reliable, and customer-focused transportation experience.
  
  
Whether you are looking to expand your transportation leadership experience, strengthen your operational expertise, or take the next step toward executive-level leadership, LAZ Parking offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact every day.
  
  
****Why Join LAZ?****

* Senior leadership opportunity within a growing national organization
* Opportunity to influence business strategy and operational performance
* Exposure to large-scale transportation and airport operations
* Career growth and advancement opportunities
* Collaborative, people-first leadership culture
* Opportunity to develop future leaders and strengthen organizational talent
* Dynamic environment where no two days are the same
* PayActiv, access earned wages before payday
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Health coaching and wellness resources
* Employee recognition and development programs

****Full-Time Benefits****

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Short-Term Disability Coverage
* Long-Term Disability Coverage
* Life Insurance Options

****About LAZ Parking****
LAZ Parking is one of the largest and fastest-growing parking and transportation management companies in the country. Our transportation operations help move millions of passengers annually through airport, commercial, and shuttle transportation services.
  
  
Our success is built on operational excellence, customer service, strong partnerships, and investing in our people. We believe in promoting from within, developing future leaders, and creating opportunities for employees to build long-term careers.
  
  
At LAZ, parking is our industry, but people are our passion.
  
  
****Schedule & Work Environment****
This position supports a large-scale transportation operation that functions seven days a week and may require schedule flexibility, including mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, emergency response situations, and operationally critical events.
  
  
The Assistant General Manager regularly works throughout transportation facilities, maintenance areas, operational offices, airport environments, and customer-facing locations while interacting with employees, stakeholders, clients, and regulatory agencies.
  
  
****The Spirit of the Position****
As an Assistant General Manager, you are a strategic leader, operational expert, and people developer.
  
  
You understand that successful transportation operations require strong leadership, disciplined execution, exceptional customer service, and an unwavering commitment to safety. Through your leadership, business acumen, and operational expertise, you help create an environment where employees can perform at their best while ensuring the organization delivers outstanding service, financial results, and operational performance.
  
  
You bring professionalism, accountability, innovation, and a solutions-oriented mindset to every challenge.
  
  
****What You'll Do****
****Strategic Leadership****

* Partner with the General Manager to develop and execute operational and business strategies.
* Identify opportunities for growth, service enhancement, and operational improvement.
* Develop and measure key performance indicators (KPIs) related to service, safety, financial performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Support organizational change initiatives and operational transformation efforts.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives designed to enhance efficiency and service delivery.

****Operational Leadership****

* Oversee daily shuttle transportation operations, including fleet utilization, route management, staffing, and resource allocation.
* Analyze operational performance data to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
* Develop contingency and recovery plans to address operational disruptions.
* Ensure transportation services are delivered safely, efficiently, and consistently.
* Support implementation of technology solutions and operational best practices.
* Drive operational excellence through performance measurement, accountability, and process improvement.

****People Leadership & Development****

* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop managers, supervisors, and frontline employees.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, safety, inclusion, and service excellence.
* Support succession planning and leadership development initiatives.
* Conduct performance evaluations, coaching conversations, and talent assessments.
* Promote employee engagement, retention, and workforce development programs.
* Build high-performing teams focused on achieving organizational goals.

****Safety, Compliance & Risk Management****

* Ensure compliance with all applicable DOT, OSHA, federal, state, local, airport, and company regulations.
* Lead safety initiatives and reinforce a strong safety culture throughout the organization.
* Support audits, inspections, regulatory reviews, and compliance assessments.
* Identify operational risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Maintain accurate records, documentation, and compliance reporting.
* Support incident investigations and corrective action efforts when necessary.

****Customer Experience & Stakeholder Relations****

* Champion a customer-first culture that promotes exceptional service delivery.
* Support the development of customer experience initiatives and service enhancements.
* Serve as a key partner to clients, airport stakeholders, vendors, government agencies, and community partners.
* Assist with escalated customer concerns and service recovery efforts.
* Build and maintain strong relationships that support long-term operational success.

****Financial & Administrative Leadership****

* Assist with budget development, forecasting, and financial planning activities.
* Monitor labor, operational, maintenance, and administrative expenses.
* Analyze financial and operational performance metrics.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency while maintaining service standards.
* Support revenue growth, cost management, and profitability objectives.
* Oversee vendor relationships and support procurement activities when necessary.

****Team & Operational Excellence****

* Partner closely with the General Manager to align operational objectives with organizational strategy.
* Support market growth, new business opportunities, transitions, and special projects.
* Promote LAZ Parking's mission, values, and culture throughout the operation.
* Drive innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Perform other duties and leadership responsibilities as assigned.

****Who You Are****
****Strategic Thinker****
You can translate organizational goals into actionable plans and measurable results.
  
  
****Operational Leader****
You understand complex transportation operations and can balance efficiency, service, safety, and financial performance.
  
  
****People Developer****
You enjoy coaching leaders, developing talent, and building high-performing teams.
  
  
****Business-Minded****
You understand financial performance, operational metrics, budgeting, and long-term business sustainability.
  
  
****Collaborative Communicator****
You build strong relationships across all levels of an organization and with external stakeholders.
  
  
****Customer Advocate****
You are passionate about delivering exceptional service and creating positive customer experiences.
  
  
**Qualifications Required**

* Valid CDL and ability to maintain required driving qualifications.
* Minimum of 3 years of progressive leadership experience in transportation, logistics, shuttle operations, or a related industry.
* Minimum of 3 years of leadership experience managing supervisors, managers, or large operational teams.
* Strong knowledge of transportation operations, fleet management, safety programs, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience managing operational performance metrics and business objectives.
* Excellent communication, leadership, coaching, and relationship-building skills.
* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and operational reporting systems.

****Preferred****

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Transportation Management, Logistics, or a related field.
* Airport transportation or shuttle operations experience.
* Experience managing large-scale or multi-site transportation operations.
* Experience supporting collective bargaining agreements or unionized workforces.
* Experience with fleet management systems, transportation technologies, and data analytics tools.
* Experience leading organizational change and operational transformation initiatives.

****Physical Requirements****
**This Position Requires The Ability To**

* Work both indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.
* Stand and walk for extended periods.
* Travel throughout transportation facilities, operational locations, and airport environments.
* Lift, push, and pull up to 25 pounds.
* Bend, stoop, squat, and move frequently throughout the workday.
* Safely enter and exit transportation vehicles when operational support is required.
* Communicate effectively in person, by phone, radio, video conference, and email.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.
  
  
****Lead People. Drive Performance. Shape the Future.****
If you are passionate about transportation leadership, operational excellence, employee development, and delivering exceptional customer experiences, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Join LAZ Airport Services and help lead a world-class transportation operation while developing the next generation of operational leaders.**

title: QAQC (Civil/Mech)
description: Implement and maintain the project QA/QC Management System in line with QMS requirements. Coordinate approval of QC technical submittals, method statements, and inspection requests with the client/consultant. Ensure all QA/QC documents at site are current, controlled, and properly distributed to concerned parties.

Ltd. is a 60-year-old precision engineering manufacturing company specializing in compressor spare parts and components, serving customers across India and 70+ countries.We are looking for a senior manufacturing professional who can take end-to-end ownership of our factory operations and drive improvements in productivity, quality, delivery, cost and operational discipline.Position SummaryThe General Manager – Operations / Plant Head will be responsible for the overall performance of the manufacturing facility, including Production, PPC, Quality, Maintenance, Stores, Dispatch and Shop-floor Operations.The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in CNC-based precision manufacturing and demonstrated ability to independently manage a machine shop/factory, lead cross-functional teams, improve operational KPIs and build a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.This is a hands-on plant leadership position, requiring strong shop-floor presence and the ability to convert production plans into measurable results.Key Responsibilities1. Overall Plant Operations

* Take end-to-end responsibility for factory operations and manufacturing performance.
* Plan, organize and control day-to-day plant activities to achieve production, quality, delivery and cost targets.
* Establish operational KPIs and review performance regularly.
* Identify bottlenecks and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure effective coordination between Production, PPC, Quality, Maintenance, Stores, Purchase, Engineering and Dispatch.

2. Production & CNC Manufacturing

* Lead and optimize operations involving CNC Turning Centres, VMCs and other CNC machining equipment.
* Ensure effective utilization of manpower, machines, tooling and production capacity.
* Improve machine utilization, OEE, throughput, cycle time and productivity.
* Review production processes and identify opportunities for process optimization and automation.
* Ensure proper planning of tooling, fixtures, cutting parameters, machine loading and manpower allocation.
* Monitor production against daily, weekly and monthly plans.

3. PPC & Delivery

* Lead the Production Planning & Control function and ensure realistic production schedules.
* Align production capacity with customer requirements and delivery commitments.
* Monitor plan vs. actual production, WIP, pending orders and bottlenecks.
* Improve production flow and reduce waiting time, WIP and manufacturing lead time.
* Coordinate with Sales, Purchase and Stores to ensure uninterrupted production.

4. Quality & Process Improvement

* Drive reduction in rejection, rework, customer complaints and process variation.
* Work closely with Quality to strengthen process controls and root-cause analysis.
* Ensure adherence to ISO 9001 systems and documented manufacturing processes.
* Promote Poka-Yoke, 7 QC tools, CAPA, 5 Why and Fishbone analysis where applicable.
* Establish a strong culture of first-time-right manufacturing.

5. Maintenance & Machine Reliability

* Ensure effective preventive and predictive maintenance of CNC machines and plant equipment.
* Reduce machine breakdowns, unplanned downtime and maintenance-related production losses.
* Monitor machine availability and maintenance KPIs.
* Coordinate with Maintenance for critical spares, AMC and machine servicing.

6. Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement

* Drive implementation of Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, TPM and Continuous Improvement initiatives.
* Identify and eliminate waste related to motion, waiting, over-processing, defects, inventory and downtime.
* Improve overall OEE, productivity and manufacturing cost.
* Develop measurable improvement projects with defined targets and timelines.

7. Cost & Operational Efficiency

* Take ownership of manufacturing cost reduction initiatives.
* Monitor material utilization, tooling cost, overtime, consumables, machine-hour cost and rejection cost.
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity without compromising quality.
* Prepare and monitor operational budgets in coordination with management.

8. Team Leadership

* Lead, mentor and develop Production, PPC, Quality, Maintenance and Shop-floor teams.
* Establish clear responsibilities, targets and performance metrics.
* Build a culture of discipline, accountability, safety and continuous improvement.
* Identify training requirements and develop technical and supervisory capabilities within the team.

9. Safety, Compliance & Systems

* Ensure compliance with applicable safety, statutory and environmental requirements.
* Maintain high standards of shop-floor safety and housekeeping.
* Ensure proper implementation of SOPs, work instructions and operational controls.
* Support management during audits, inspections and certification activities.

Candidate ProfileWe are looking for a senior manufacturing leader, not only a production supervisor.Mandatory Requirements

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
* 12–20+ years of relevant experience in manufacturing/plant operations, preferably with significant experience in a leadership role.
* Strong experience in CNC machine-based manufacturing / precision engineering.
* Proven experience managing a machine shop, production facility or manufacturing plant.
* Hands-on knowledge of:
* CNC Turning Centres
* VMCs
* Machining processes
* Cutting tools and tooling
* Fixtures
* Production methods
* Machine capacity planning
* Strong understanding of PPC, OEE, productivity, quality and cost control.
* Demonstrated experience in implementing Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen and TPM.
* Experience managing and developing multi-functional manufacturing teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Willingness to maintain a strong shop-floor presence.

Preferred Industry ExperienceCandidates from the following industries will be preferred:

* Industrial Valves
* Pumps
* Auto Components
* Precision Engineering
* Heavy Engineering
* Industrial Machinery
* Machine Components
* Capital Equipment

Compressor spare-parts/component manufacturing experience will be an added advantage.Key Performance AreasThe selected candidate will be expected to demonstrate measurable improvement in:Production Output | OEE | Machine Utilization | Productivity | On-Time Delivery | Rejection | Rework | Downtime | Manufacturing Cost | WIP | Lead Time | Quality | Safety | 5SWhat We Are Looking ForThe ideal candidate should be someone who can:Plan → Execute → Monitor → Identify Bottlenecks → Take Corrective Action → Improve → Deliver ResultsWe are particularly interested in candidates who can provide specific examples of measurable improvements achieved in their previous organizations, such as:

* Increase in OEE
