title: Manager - Student Recruitment & Outreach
description:
**Company Description**
ECA Global is a leading private higher education group founded in Australia, with multiple higher education brands across Sydney, Brisbane, Melbourne, Perth, and Parramatta. The group has expanded internationally with new campuses in the UK and operational hubs in Europe, China, the Philippines, Brazil, Nepal, and India. Each year, ECA Global welcomes around 15,000 students from diverse backgrounds into its global network of campuses. The organization focuses on delivering high-quality education, international pathways, and student-centric support services. ECA Global offers a multicultural work environment and opportunities to engage with learners and partners worldwide.

Position Summary: The Manager – Student Recruitment will lead and execute student recruitment strategies to achieve enrolment targets, expand market presence, strengthen institutional partnerships, and improve student conversion rates. The role is responsible for driving recruitment operations, developing effective outreach initiatives, managing recruitment channels, and building strong relationships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, and other institutional partners.

The successful candidate will combine strategic planning, commercial acumen, market intelligence, operational excellence, and people leadership to deliver sustainable student recruitment growth. The role will also work closely with academic teams, Admissions, Student Services, and other internal stakeholders to ensure a seamless prospective student journey from initial enquiry through enrolment and onboarding.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Recruitment Strategy, Market Development & Partnerships**

* Develop and implement comprehensive student recruitment strategies aligned with institutional enrolment targets and business growth objectives.
* Identify priority markets, student segments, recruitment channels, and opportunities for market expansion.
* Build and maintain strategic partnerships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, academic institutions, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Develop articulation agreements, feeder relationships, and student progression pathways to strengthen recruitment pipelines and improve conversion.
* Collaborate with academic teams to align recruitment campaigns, messaging, and market positioning with programme offerings and institutional priorities.
* Lead relationship development and stakeholder engagement across key domestic and international markets.
* Leverage market research, CRM insights, competitor analysis, and enrolment trends to inform recruitment strategies and identify new growth opportunities.
* Represent the institution at recruitment fairs, school visits, industry events, partner meetings, presentations, and other outreach activities.
* Identify and develop innovative recruitment channels, partnership models, and market penetration initiatives.
* Monitor the effectiveness of recruitment partnerships and implement strategies to improve partner engagement and performance.

**2. Recruitment Operations, Student Conversion & Performance Management**

* Manage the end-to-end student recruitment pipeline, from enquiry generation and application follow-up through offer acceptance, enrolment, and onboarding.
* Drive timely, accurate, and high-quality communication with prospective students, applicants, and recruitment partners.
* Monitor recruitment funnel performance and implement initiatives to improve enquiry-to-application, application-to-offer, and offer-to-enrolment conversion rates.
* Plan, coordinate, and oversee recruitment campaigns, marketing communications, outreach activities, open days, education fairs, and student engagement events.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), recruitment targets, pipeline metrics, and channel performance.
* Analyse recruitment data, identify conversion bottlenecks, and recommend corrective actions to improve enrolment outcomes.
* Prepare regular performance reports, market insights, pipeline updates, and strategic recommendations for senior management.
* Manage education agent performance, evaluate channel effectiveness, and implement appropriate performance improvement measures.
* Work closely with Admissions, Student Services, Marketing, and academic teams to ensure efficient application processing and a seamless student experience.
* Establish and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), process documentation, reporting frameworks, and quality assurance practices.
* Coordinate recruitment calendars, campaign timelines, event logistics, and competing operational priorities to ensure timely execution.
* Ensure recruitment activities deliver against agreed enrolment targets, service standards, and institutional growth objectives.

**3. Leadership, Team Management & Capability Development**

* Lead, motivate, and manage recruitment and outreach teams, where applicable, to achieve individual and collective performance targets.
* Set clear objectives, allocate responsibilities, monitor performance, and provide regular coaching and feedback.
* Build a high-performing, accountable, student-focused, and commercially driven recruitment culture.
* Develop team capabilities through training, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and continuous professional development.
* Foster collaboration across recruitment, marketing, admissions, academic, and student support functions.
* Introduce innovative recruitment approaches, student engagement initiatives, and outreach models to enhance productivity and market penetration.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen recruitment processes.
* Oversee recruitment-related budgets, campaign expenditure, event planning, and resource allocation, as applicable.
* Promote data-driven decision-making, continuous improvement, and accountability for recruitment outcomes.
* Support succession planning, capability development, and the effective use of team resources to meet evolving business needs.

**4. Compliance, Governance & Stakeholder Management**

* Ensure recruitment practices comply with institutional policies, applicable regulatory requirements, and relevant quality assurance standards.
* Uphold equal opportunity, workplace health and safety (OSH), data privacy, and information security requirements.
* Ensure appropriate handling of prospective student and applicant information in accordance with applicable data protection requirements, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA), where applicable.
* Maintain accurate recruitment records, partner documentation, performance reports, and operational records.
* Promote ethical recruitment practices, transparent communication, and a positive student experience throughout the recruitment journey.
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal teams, external partners, and senior stakeholders.
* Escalate recruitment risks, operational challenges, compliance concerns, and performance gaps in a timely manner.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be assessed against agreed institutional and departmental objectives, including:

* Achievement of student enrolment targets by programme, market, and recruitment channel.
* Improvement in enquiry-to-application and application-to-enrolment conversion rates.
* Growth in qualified student enquiries and recruitment pipeline volume.
* Effectiveness and productivity of education agents and institutional partnerships.
* Delivery and performance of recruitment campaigns, outreach activities, and events.
* Timeliness and quality of applicant communication and follow-up.
* Accuracy of recruitment data, reporting, and pipeline forecasting.
* Compliance with institutional policies, recruitment processes, and applicable regulations.
* Team productivity, target achievement, and professional development.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Education, International Relations, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification or relevant professional certification will be an advantage.
* Significant experience in student recruitment, education management, business development, institutional partnerships, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience in developing and executing recruitment strategies and achieving measurable enrolment or business growth targets.
* Proven experience managing recruitment pipelines, conversion processes, performance metrics, and stakeholder relationships.
* Experience developing and managing relationships with schools, colleges, education agents, employers, or institutional partners.
* Previous experience leading or supervising teams, setting performance targets, and driving accountability will be highly desirable.
* Experience in higher education, international education, or a multi-campus education environment will be an advantage.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* **Strategic thinking:**
  Ability to translate institutional growth objectives into practical recruitment strategies and actionable plans.
* **Business development:**
  Strong partnership-building, networking, negotiation, and market expansion capabilities.
* **Performance management:**
  Ability to establish KPIs, analyse recruitment data, identify trends, and drive measurable improvements.
* **Communication and presentation:**
  Excellent written and verbal communication, public speaking, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* **Leadership:**
  Ability to motivate teams, manage performance, develop talent, and foster a results-oriented culture.
* **Operational management:**
  Strong planning, organisational, prioritisation, budgeting, and execution capabilities.
* **Analytical ability:**
  Proficiency in interpreting market intelligence, CRM data, conversion metrics, and performance reports.
* **Relationship management:**
  Ability to establish and maintain productive relationships with diverse internal and external stakeholders.

title: Utilities Field Product Leader
description:
Founding Head — Utilities Field Product

**Build, roll out and grow OriginBluy's new field platform for gas utilities, from the first site to the next client.**

About OriginBluy

OriginBluy is building a new product: a field work platform that connects a city gas company's contractors, customer care and customers in one live job record. Contractors update each job on WhatsApp with photo proof. The status flows into the utility's SAP, and customers hear what is happening before they have to ask.

Our first deployment is a 90-day pilot with a leading Gujarat gas utility that completes about 38,500 new connections a quarter. You will be the person who makes that pilot work on the ground, and the template for every city we expand to after it.

The role

You own the success of a new product, end to end. First, you make our pilot with a leading Gujarat gas utility a clear success. Then you take that proof to other utilities and lead the sale. In the morning you may be on a site with a plumbing crew; in the afternoon, presenting results to an MD or pitching a new client.

This is a product-building role as much as an execution role. The platform is new, and contractors and their crews are the people who use it every day. You will help build it with them: what you observe and hear in the field decides what we build next.

You are the face of the product to contractors, to our first client's leadership and to every new utility we pursue. Contractors should trust you because you understand their work; senior leaders should trust you because you bring facts, not excuses. You report to the Founder and CEO and work as a partner in building the business.

**Title:**
 Founding Head – Utilities Field Product · 
**Type:**
 Contract to start then full time · 
**Base:**
 Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar

What you will do

**With contractors and crews**

* Onboard every contractor in the pilot area and get their crews updating jobs on WhatsApp with photo and GPS proof.
* Conduct field trainings for supervisors and plumbers, on site, in Gujarati or Hindi, and retrain crews where inspections fail.
* Demonstrate the product to contractors and their crews in 15 minutes, and get them using it the same day.
* Visit sites every week so contractors know the work is checked.
* Settle disputes between contractors, customers and the utility using the job evidence.
* Keep contractor capacity honest: jobs accepted only up to the number of certified crew available.

**With the utility's teams**

* Run a short daily review of the at-risk job list with the utility's area owner, and chase each delay until it is resolved.
* Work with care and service centre heads so their teams use the live job status in SAP.
* Present pilot progress to the MD and senior leadership: what moved, what is stuck, what you need from them.

**Building the product with OriginBluy**

* Shadow crews on real jobs and record structured observations: where time is lost, what confuses users, what workarounds they use.
* Turn those observations into clear product requirements with the product team.
* Test new features with contractors and crews before they are released, and bring back their feedback.
* Report what breaks in the field within days, with evidence.
* Track the pilot scorecard every week and own the numbers.
* Recruit and manage one or two field coordinators as the pilot scales.
* Document the playbook so the next city can be launched faster.

**Growing the business**

* Turn the pilot results into a clear, evidence-backed case for other gas utilities.
* Build a pipeline of target utilities, in Gujarat first and then other states.

Money bro is the digital lending platform of JMJ Fintech Limited, a BSE-listed Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC). We are focused on expanding our digital lending business through technology-driven solutions, efficient customer acquisition and responsible lending practices.

* **Customer Acquisition:**
  Drive customer growth through digital marketing, performance marketing, strategic partnerships, referral networks and other cost-effective acquisition channels.
* **Revenue & Profitability:**

  Build, lead and motivate teams across business development, digital marketing, operations and customer engagement.
* **MIS & Performance Monitoring:**
  Establish business dashboards, monitor key performance indicators and present periodic business reviews and growth plans to senior management.

Performance will be evaluated against measurable business outcomes, including:

* Digital loan disbursement and business growth.
* Customer acquisition, conversion and repeat customer rates.
* Revenue growth and contribution profitability.
* Customer acquisition cost and marketing return on investment.
* Portfolio quality, delinquency and collection efficiency.
* Operational turnaround time and customer experience.
* Regulatory compliance and sustainable portfolio expansion.

* A leadership opportunity to scale a digital lending business backed by a listed NBFC.
* Direct involvement in business strategy and growth decisions.

* Maintain tight calendar discipline, on call availability during peak close windows, and contingency plans for systems/data delays.
* Ensure robust inventory valuation, cycle count results analysis, slow moving/obsolete provisioning, and write off governance.

**Process, Automation & Controls**

* Design automation for recurring reports (Power Query/BI), improve data flows, and reduce manual touchpoints.

* High Commitment & Ownership: Delivers under tight timelines, escalates early, creates backup plans during month end, and ensures “right first time” outputs.
* Proactiveness: Anticipates issues (e.g., material price spikes, supply constraints), proposes mitigation, and follows through to closure.
* Analytical Rigor: Turns data into insights; explains variance bridges in business terms—price, mix, volume, productivity, one offs.
* Business Partnering: Influences cross functional stakeholders (Ops, Procurement, Supply Planning, Logistics) and aligns decisions with P&L and cash goals.
* Communication: Concise, structured, and executive ready presentations; able to challenge constructively.

**Educational Background**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Business or related quantitative field.
* Preferred: Master’s degree (MBA, Finance) or postgraduate in Controller/Corporate Finance.
* Experience: 2-3 years of progressive finance roles, with 3+ years in Supply Chain/Manufacturing/Logistics finance in a multinational environment (CPG/FMCG strongly preferred).
* Certifications (nice to have): CPA/ACCA/CMA; Lean Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt) or equivalent continuous improvement credential.
* Advance English is mandatory.

**Technical Skills**

* Excel (Advanced/Expert):
* Complex formulas (INDEX/MATCH/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS), PivotTables, Power Query, array formulas, scenario/sensitivity analysis, what-if modelling, VBA/macros (nice to have).
* Automation & Analytics:
* Power BI / Tableau (DAX, data modelling, building refreshable dashboards), Power Query, basic SQL for joins and data extraction.
* Familiarity with RPA (Power Automate/UIPath) and workflow digitization a plus.

**ERP & Finance Systems**

* SAP (FI/CO/CO-PA) or Oracle; product costing, standard cost runs, variance analysis (PPV, yield, mix, utilization), inventory accounting, and intercompany flows.
* Consolidation/Planning tools: BPC/SAC, Anaplan, Hyperion/EPBCS (advantageous).

**Controls & Compliance**

* Strong understanding of SOX/ICOFR, P2P/O2C processes, approval matrices, and audit requirements.

As a Senior Associate you will analyze complex problems, manage assigned workstreams, and develop deliverables while building meaningful client connections, interpreting feedback, and guiding junior team members through shifting priorities and changing deal conditions. In this role at PwC, you will draw on your knowledge of deal strategy and commercial diligence to help clients evaluate growth opportunities, assess operational implications, and translate insights into clear recommendations across the deal lifecycle.
  
  
As a Senior Associate you will navigate ambiguity with sound judgment, use a broad range of methodologies to break down complex concepts, and deepen your understanding of the business context behind each engagement. In this role at PwC, you will also help maintain professional and technical standards, review the work of associates when needed, and contribute to a collaborative environment focused on learning, accountability, and delivery across client assignments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* You will work on a range of projects across different business sectors, whilst also focusing on the full breadth of Finance Function responsibilities including finance processes, operations, and reporting.
* You will draw on your previous client experience, and knowledge of deals to advise CFOs and their Finance Functions on key decision making and mitigation of risks throughout the deal.
* The work involved can be complex and part of a fast-paced environment, therefore the role will require the ability to quickly understand, analyse and provide trusted opinions on the key issues and opportunities facing the Finance Function.
* Analyzing commercial diligence findings across transactions and growth initiatives to identify value creation opportunities
* Developing financial models and scenario analysis to assess revenue improvement, pricing actions, and divestiture options
* Evaluating market trends, competitive dynamics, and industry signals to support acquisition strategy and corporate development decisions
* Reviewing financial statements, business plans, and operating data to inform transaction and post-deal recommendations
* Supporting due diligence workstreams by synthesizing research, Capital IQ outputs, and management materials into clear deliverables
* Applying analytical thinking and financial risk analysis to interpret complex information and highlight key issues
* Contributing to post-merger integration and value creation planning by mapping operational and commercial levers
* Guiding junior team members on analysis, work product organization, and task completion while reviewing assigned deliverables
* Building client relationships by responding to questions, anticipating needs, and adapting to shifting deal priorities

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 4 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Preference for a Master's of Business Administration degree

title: Financial Analyst
description:
**About the Role**

We are seeking a proactive, analytical, and field-oriented **Financial Risk Analyst** to join Veeraraghavan & Co. In this role, you will act as the crucial link between financial assessment frameworks and on-the-ground reality. You will be responsible for visiting client and loan applicant business premises to conduct comprehensive financial health checks, risk evaluations, and verification. **Please note that this is strictly a risk analysis and verification role—there is no sales, target-chasing, or marketing involved.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **On-Site Client & Business Verification:** Travel to business premises, operational units, and residential locations of loan or credit applicants to conduct firsthand financial checks and risk profiling.
* **Personal Discussions & Fact-Finding:** Conduct structured personal discussions with business owners, promoters, and borrowers to evaluate business stability, cash flow realities, and intent to repay.
* **Asset & Collateral Assessment:** Physically inspect business inventory, machinery, infrastructure, and asset quality to validate reported net worth and balance sheet details.
* **Creditworthiness & Repayment Analysis:** Analyze financial statements, business records, and day-to-day operations on-site to assess risk parameters, debt-servicing capabilities, and potential fraud red flags.
* **Detailed Reporting for Lenders:** Compile meticulous, factual, and standardized risk reports containing all required touchpoints and metrics needed by banks and financial institutions to make informed lending decisions.
* **Compliance & Risk Mitigation:** Ensure all observations strictly adhere to internal risk matrices, regulatory frameworks, and audit guidelines.

**Key Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Accounting, Banking, Finance, or Management (B.Com, BMS, BBA, BFM).
* **Field Readiness:** High willingness to travel locally within assigned regions to meet business owners and assess operations on-site.
* **Skills:**
* Sound foundational knowledge of basic accounting, bookkeeping, and financial statements.
* Strong observational skills with absolute integrity and attention to detail.
* Clear interpersonal and communication skills to conduct effective personal discussions.
* Basic computer/tablet literacy for updating reports on digital platforms.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹22,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Manager_Financial Reporting_Taxation_Audits
description:
***This position is only for Chartered Accountants, Non CA or CA INTER candidates, kindly do not apply. This position is based in New Delhi NCR. Outstation candidates shall not be considered.***

**About Octagona India**

Octagona India Private Limited (www.octagona.co) is a leading management consultancy firm providing end-to-end business solutions to companies establishing and expanding operations in India. Our services span market entry strategy, business development, legal and tax advisory, and human resources management. We are committed to delivering excellence and creating lasting value for our clients. Our Head Office is located in Jasola, South Delhi, with branch offices in Pune and Bangalore, and an international presence in Italy and the USA. We're part of the Bonfiglioli Consulting Group of Italy.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a qualified and experienced Chartered Accountant to lead the finance, accounting, taxation and compliance function of Octagona India from our New Delhi head office. The ideal candidate will own the company's financial reporting, ensure timely and accurate tax and statutory compliance, and manage all audit processes, while acting as a trusted finance partner to the Director and senior management. The role also supports Octagona's international clients in navigating Indian financial, tax and regulatory requirements. This position calls for a detail-oriented professional with strong technical depth, sound commercial judgement and the confidence to interface with auditors, regulators, group entities in Italy and clients from across Europe.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Financial Accounting & Reporting***

•    Oversee day-to-day accounting operations of the Company, including general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliations, and project/client-wise revenue and cost tracking.

•    Prepare and finalise monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) / applicable Indian GAAP and the Companies Act, 2013.

•    Prepare management MIS, variance analyses, profitability reports (by service line, client and office) and dashboards for the Director and senior leadership.

•    Support the preparation of consolidated and group reporting packages as required by Bonfiglioli Consulting Group, Italy, including timely responses to Group queries and deadlines.

•    Ensure proper revenue recognition, provisioning, accruals, fixed asset accounting and period-end closing procedures.

•    Maintain robust documentation and audit trails for all financial transactions.

***Taxation & Statutory Compliance***

•    Ensure timely and accurate compliance under the Income Tax Act, including advance tax computation, TDS/TCS deductions, deposits, quarterly returns and annual income tax return filing.

•    Manage end-to-end GST compliance: monthly/quarterly returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B), input tax credit reconciliation (GSTR-2B), annual return and reconciliation statement, and multi-state registrations (Delhi, Maharashtra, Karnataka).

•    Handle tax assessments, notices, scrutiny proceedings and appeals, coordinating with external tax counsel where required.

•    Manage transfer pricing compliance for transactions with group and related entities, including benchmarking support, documentation and Form 3CEB.

•    Ensure compliance under FEMA and RBI regulations for cross-border transactions, foreign inward remittances, intercompany invoicing and related reporting (FIRC/FIRA, Form 15CA/15CB, etc.).

•    Track regulatory and tax law changes, assess their impact on the company, and advise management proactively.

***Audit & Assurance***

•    Coordinate and manage statutory audit, tax audit and any group or limited-review audits, serving as the primary point of contact for auditors.

•    Prepare audit schedules, supporting documents and responses to audit queries within agreed timelines; ensure timely closure of audit observations.

•    Design, implement and periodically review internal financial controls (IFC) and SOPs to safeguard company assets and minimise risk.

•    Coordinate internal audits, track recommendations and ensure corrective actions are implemented.

•    Support due diligence exercises, valuations and audits connected with group restructuring, new office set-ups or investments.

***Budgeting, Planning & Treasury***

•    Lead the annual budgeting and forecasting process in consultation with business heads; monitor actual performance against budget and recommend corrective measures.

•    Manage cash flow planning, working capital, collections and vendor payments to maintain healthy liquidity.

•    Oversee banking relationships, foreign currency receipts, hedging considerations and treasury operations.

•    Evaluate pricing, project costing and profitability of proposals and engagements in coordination with business development teams.

•    Provide financial inputs for strategic decisions such as service line expansion, new office openings and investments.

***Client Finance & Advisory Support***

•    Support Octagona's client companies (particularly European and Italian entities) with finance, tax and compliance guidance during and after their India market entry.

•    Assist clients with company incorporation-related financial requirements, capital infusion, FDI/FEMA reporting, accounting set-up and statutory registrations (PAN, TAN, GST, etc.).

•    Contribute to financial due diligence, financial modelling, tax structuring and cost analysis for client engagements and proposals.

•    Review outsourced accounting and compliance deliverables, where applicable, to ensure accuracy, quality and timeliness.

•    Act as a finance point of contact for international clients and group colleagues, ensuring clear communication and local regulatory support.

***Team Leadership & Process Improvement***

•    Lead, mentor and develop the accounts and finance team, including interns and article assistants, and ensure clear allocation of duties and deadlines.

•    Manage relationships with external professionals, including auditors, tax consultants, company secretaries and legal advisers.

•    Drive automation and digitisation of finance processes, including accounting software optimisation, reconciliation tools and reporting templates.

•    Establish and maintain a compliance calendar and ensure zero-default filings across all offices.

•    Implement policies for expense management, travel reimbursements, vendor onboarding and approval workflows.

***Auxiliary Responsibilities***

•    Coordinate with other colleagues on payroll processing, salary structuring, full-and-final settlements and employee tax declarations.

•    Support management with contract reviews from a financial and tax perspective (client agreements, vendor contracts, leases, intercompany agreements).

•    Oversee insurance, asset registers, procurement and vendor payment processes.

•    Assist in preparing financial sections of investor, bank, group and board presentations.

•    Maintain confidentiality of financial and client data and ensure data security in finance operations.

•    Undertake any other finance, compliance or administrative responsibilities assigned by management from time to time.

**Qualifications & Skills**

•    Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA); additional qualifications such as CS, CMA, DISA, IFRS/ACCA certification or an MBA in Finance are a plus though not mandatory.

•    6 – 9 years of post-qualification experience in accounting, taxation, audit and compliance, including at least 2 -3 years in a senior or managerial role.

•    Prior experience in a reputed consulting firm, CA firm, Big 4, multinational subsidiary or professional services organisation is strongly preferred.

•    Strong knowledge of Indian accounting standards (Ind AS), the Companies Act, 2013, Income Tax Act, GST laws, FEMA, and transfer pricing regulations.

•    Proven experience handling statutory and tax audits, tax assessments and regulatory filings end to end.

•    Exposure to international or group reporting and cross-border transactions (experience with European / Italian entities is an advantage).

•    Hands-on experience with accounting/ERP software (such as Tally Prime, Zoho Books, SAP or equivalent) and advanced proficiency in MS Excel and MS Office Suite.

•    Strong analytical, financial modelling and MIS-reporting skills with the ability to convert data into actionable business insights.

•    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

•    Strong leadership, integrity and ethical judgement, with the ability to take ownership and make sound decisions under pressure.

•    High attention to detail, organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines and balance internal finance priorities with client deliverables in a fast-paced consulting environment.

•    Collaborative and approachable, with the ability to influence and build relationships at all levels, from interns to the Director and international stakeholders.

•    Adaptability, a problem-solving mindset and a willingness to learn and grow with a growing, multi-office organisation.

**What We Offer**

•    Competitive salary and medical insurance package (post probation).

•    Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership and a diverse, talented team in India and Italy

•    Exposure to international clients, cross-border transactions and group-level reporting.

•    Career growth and development opportunities.

•    A collaborative and inclusive work environment.

•    Opportunity to travel to Italy for business purposes as and when deemed necessary.

**Joining Period:**
Within December 2026

title: Accountant
description:
**Type:**
Full-time (with at least 5-6 hours of overlap in CST)
  
  
**Location:**
Remote, India
  
  
**Company:**
Sanctuary
  
  
**Compensation:**
up to $2000 USD per month
  
  
**About Us**
Sanctuary builds nature - led, wellness - centered communities that feel alive. Our first 135-acre residential community in the Texas Hill Country is designed with:
  
  
🌱 Non-toxic materials
  
  
💧 Clean water and filtration systems
  
  
⚡ EMF-conscious design
  
  
🌿 135 acres of preserved land and eco - sensitive planning
  
  
🏗️ Masonry construction
  
  
We are a global team (spread across 8 countries) of designers, architects, engineers, and dreamers building spaces that restore and inspire. For us, it’s not just where people live - it’s how they live.
  
  
Our vision is to bring Sanctuary to major cities around the world: healthy, sovereign communities that sit on the edges of every modern metropolis.
  
  
****The role****
Sanctuary is a US-based construction and development company operating across 7 to 8 US entities with different payment structures, plus an India entity based in Delhi. We are looking for a precise, ownership-driven Accountant to own the books for both our US and India entities.
  
  
Your first major task will be reconciling Sanctuary’s financial records in QuickBooks across the past 3 years. That means reviewing historical records, identifying discrepancies, and getting everything fully reconciled and up to date. From there, you will assist our finance team and own day-to-day accounting, payables, cash flow, and compliance across both countries.
  
  
This role is for someone who can walk into a fast-moving environment, figure out what needs to be done, and do it. If you need step-by-step direction or a ready-made SOP on day one, this role is not for you.
  
  
This is not a clock-in, clock-out role.
  
  
It is not basic bookkeeping.
  
  
It is not consolidating numbers someone else has already organized.
  
  
****What you’ll own****

* Full ownership of the books across all US entities in QuickBooks Online and the India entity in Tally: entries, categorization, and accuracy
* Reconciling the past 3 years of records: backtracking all invoices paid to date, identifying outstanding amounts, and flagging what is still owed, to whom, and by when
* Tracking and managing all incoming and outgoing invoices across entities, including construction-side payments previously managed by the team
* Accounts payable end to end: knowing exactly which payments are due, to whom, and when
* Intercompany transactions and reconciliation between the US and India entities
* Consolidation of books of accounts between holding companies and subsidiaries
* Supporting the team in maintaining a forward-looking cash flow tracker so the team always knows what payments are coming and can communicate proactively with consultants and vendors if timelines shift
* Reconciling bank transactions, payment confirmations, and internal records regularly and accurately, with no missed entries and no approximations
* India payroll bookkeeping and coordination on statutory compliance (PF, ESI, TDS, PT, MCA filings) end to end, including coordination with any vendors on ground.
* Supporting documentation for construction draw applications and other external financial processes
* Flagging gaps, inconsistencies, and risks before they become problems

****What we’re looking for****

* 4 to 8 years of full-cycle accounting experience across both India and US books. That means not just bookkeeping and not just compliance, but both.
* Deep proficiency in QuickBooks Online (non-negotiable)
* Strong working knowledge of Tally
* Hands-on experience handling India statutory payroll compliance (PF, ESI, TDS, PT) yourself, not just overseeing a CA or vendor who does it
* Experience in managing accounts and consolidation for multiple entities simultaneously
* Obsessive attention to detail: you don’t miss large entries, and you don’t miss small ones either
* Strong written and verbal English. You will coordinate regularly with US-based founders and consultants.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, and high comfort using AI tools to automate and streamline workflows
* Experience with US real estate or construction accounting, including draw applications

****What success looks like****
*At 30 days:*

* You have gone through QuickBooks across all active US entities and the India entity’s books, and you know exactly what is in there and what is not
* You have a clear, accurate picture of every outstanding invoice: who is owed, how much, and since when
* You know the India entity’s compliance calendar and its current status
* You have flagged anything broken, missing, or at risk
* You have started building a cash flow tracker the team can actually use to plan and communicate future payments
* The team now relies on your support in obtaining and updating the numbers in the cash flow tracker.

*At 90 days:*

* The 3-year reconciliation is complete, or on a clear path to completion with known gaps documented
* Books across both countries are current, and month-end is running on your own rhythm
* The team no longer has to chase you. You are the one coming to them.

****Who this role is for****

* You find a messy set of books and feel the urge to fix it, not avoid it.
* You are highly proactive, communicate smartly and very proactively, own your mistakes, and don’t let things fall through the cracks.
* You catch things others miss.
* You look at a situation and figure out what to do next
* You don't just flag a problem and pass it on. You think through possible solutions, come with a proposed approach, and check if you're heading in the right direction rather than relying on the team to figure it out for you.
* You understand that in a company like this, being late is sometimes unavoidable, but being silent about it is not acceptable.

title: Urban Transport Specialist - req38813
description:
**Urban Transport Specialist**
Job #: req38813
  
  
Organization: World Bank
  
  
Sector: Transportation
  
  
Grade: GF
  
  
Term Duration: Open-Ended Staff (OPEN-OP)
  
  
Recruitment Type: Local Recruitment
  
  
Location: New Delhi,India
  
  
Required Language(s): English
  
  
**Preferred Language(s)**
Closing Date: 11/9/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC
  
  
**Description**
At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd
  
  
**South Asia Region Context**
The South Asia Region, comprising Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, and Sri Lanka, is at a pivotal stage of development. Rapid economic growth, driven by urbanization and demographic trends, has reduced poverty, but significant disparities persist. The region also faces growing climate risks, environmental pollution, informality, and low female labor force participation.
  
  
Sustained, private sector-led growth, anchored in investments in infrastructure, logistics, energy, and connectivity, is critical to creating jobs for South Asia’s sizeable youth population. At the same time, continued investment in human capital is needed to equip people for the jobs of the future.
  
  
The South Asia Infrastructure program supports countries in building sustainable, resilient, and inclusive infrastructure systems through an integrated, cross-sectoral approach to growth, job creation, connectivity, resilience, and service delivery. Infrastructure engagements increasingly combine public and private sector solutions, including collaboration across the World Bank Group, to maximize development impact.
  
  
India, the largest economy in South Asia, is undergoing a profound urban and economic transformation. Meeting the country’s growing demand for sustainable mobility, efficient logistics systems, and climate-resilient infrastructure will be important for improving access to jobs and services, enhancing competitiveness, supporting decarbonization, and attracting private investment. The World Bank Group’s engagement in India increasingly calls for integrated solutions that combine public and private financing, policy reform, institutional strengthening, and collaboration with IFC and MIGA.
  
  
**Transport And Logistics Practice**
The Transport and Logistics Practice supports efficient, safe, resilient, and low-carbon connectivity across road, rail, urban transport, maritime transport, inland waterways, and aviation. Working with public and private sector partners, it combines investment and policy support to improve access, trade, economic integration, and the performance of transport services and supply chains.
  
  
In India, the Practice’s urban transport program promotes compact, connected, inclusive, and low-carbon development through better public transport, multimodal integration, transit-oriented development, electric mobility, safer streets, stronger institutions, and sustainable financing. The program brings together lending, analytics, technical assistance, policy dialogue, and partnerships with national, state, and city governments.
  
  
**About The Position**
ISAT1 seeks to recruit an Urban Transport Specialist (GF), based in New Delhi, to support the preparation and implementation of urban mobility operations and analytical and advisory work in India and, as needed, elsewhere in South Asia. The position requires a strong combination of urban transport expertise, operational capability, client engagement, analytical judgment, and the ability to work effectively across disciplines and institutions.
  
  
The selected candidate will be expected to contribute materially to the design and delivery of complex programs, including public transport and institutional reform, urban rail and bus systems, integrated mobility, electric mobility, accessibility and inclusion, climate resilience, road safety, digitalization, infrastructure financing, and private sector participation. The Specialist will work closely with government counterparts, World Bank Group teams, development partners, consultants, and other stakeholders, and will report to the Practice Manager for Transport and Logistics in South Asia.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**
The Urban Transport Specialist will perform a full range of technical, operational, analytical, and coordination functions, including but not limited to the following:
  
  

* Urban Transport Operations
* Support and, as appropriate, lead or co-lead the identification, preparation, appraisal, and implementation of lending and non-lending activities in urban transport.
* Contribute to project design, results frameworks, implementation arrangements, cost and economic analysis, risk assessment, procurement planning, and implementation support.
* Help resolve implementation bottlenecks and provide practical, timely advice to clients on institutional, technical, contractual, and operational issues.
* Work with environmental, social, procurement, financial management, legal, and other specialists to ensure integrated and high-quality project delivery.
* Monitor progress, results, risks, disbursements, and agreed actions, and prepare concise, decision-useful reporting for task teams and management.
* Technical and Policy Support
* Provide technical advice on urban mobility planning, public transport networks and operations, urban rail and bus systems, multimodal integration, first- and last-mile connectivity, walking and cycling, transit-oriented development, and demand management.
* Support reforms related to public transport institutions, governance, service contracting, fare policy, funding and financing, data systems, performance management, and service quality.
* Contribute to electric mobility programs, including public transport electrification, enabling infrastructure, institutional arrangements, and coordination with energy and private sector stakeholders.
* Integrate climate mitigation and resilience, road safety, gender, universal accessibility, social inclusion, and environmental considerations into transport strategies and investments.
* Assess opportunities for private capital mobilization and innovative financing, including PPPs, blended finance, guarantees, land value capture, and collaboration with IFC and MIGA, where appropriate.
* Analytics, Knowledge, and Innovation
* Lead or contribute to analytical and advisory work, policy notes, investment frameworks, sector diagnostics, and city-level mobility studies.
* Collect, assess, and interpret quantitative and qualitative data; use evidence to diagnose mobility constraints, compare options, and formulate implementable recommendations.
* Promote the use of digital tools, geospatial analysis, transport modeling, open data, and other technologies where they improve planning, operations, monitoring, or user outcomes.
* Prepare clear technical reports, briefing notes, presentations, talking points, and other knowledge products for varied technical and senior audiences.
* Share lessons across projects, cities, countries, and Global Practice networks, and contribute to knowledge events and professional communities.
* Client Engagement and Partnerships
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with national ministries, state governments, urban local bodies, transport authorities, operators, development partners, private sector participants, academia, and civil society.
* Participate in policy dialogue and technical discussions, providing evidence-based and practical advice that is responsive to client priorities and implementation capacity.
* Plan and support missions, workshops, consultations, training activities, and high-level visits, including timely documentation and follow-up.
* Coordinate effectively across World Bank Group practices and institutions to develop integrated solutions relevant to India’s urban transformation.
* Team Contribution
* Work collaboratively in diverse, multidisciplinary, and geographically dispersed teams, contributing constructively to shared outcomes.
* Guide consultants and junior colleagues, review technical outputs, and contribute to quality assurance and capacity development.
* Support country and regional strategy work and other Transport and Logistics Practice priorities, including assignments outside the immediate urban transport portfolio when required.
* Undertake other related responsibilities assigned by the Practice Manager.

Selection Criteria
  
  

* Master’s degree or higher in transport planning, transport or civil engineering, urban planning, economics, public policy, finance, or a closely related field.
* At least 5 years of progressively responsible professional experience in urban transport, with demonstrated experience in project preparation, implementation, and/or advisory work.
* Substantial experience in at least three of the following areas: public transport planning and reform; urban rail or bus systems; integrated and multimodal mobility; electric mobility; active mobility and road safety; transport institutions and policy; infrastructure financing or private sector participation.
* Experience working with national, state, or city governments on complex transport programs. Experience in India or comparable federal and rapidly urbanizing settings is highly desirable.

**Technical And Operational Capabilities**

* Strong understanding of urban mobility systems, including the interactions among land use, accessibility, public transport, non-motorized transport, road networks, technology, institutions, financing, and user needs.
* Demonstrated ability to translate technical analysis into practical project design, policy advice, and implementable actions.

title: Analyst
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Finance Analyst to manage and oversee key financial operations, including month-end close, financial statement preparation, variance analysis, and global reporting. title: Financing & Risk Solutions Analyst
description:
Join us as a Financing & Risk Solutions Analyst
  
  

* In this crucial role, you'll support the Specialty Finance desk in delivering high-quality monitoring, analysis and risk oversight across securitisation transactions, including consumer loans, credit cards, auto loans and other structured finance products
* You'll play a key role in overseeing AUP processes, reviewing IPD waterfall reports and assessing ongoing transaction performance to support effective risk management and decision-making
* This is a fantastic opportunity to build specialist expertise in structured finance, supported by training, self-development opportunities and exposure to a broad range of transactions and stakeholders
* We’re offering this role at senior analyst level

What you’ll do
  
  
As a Financing & Risk Solutions Analyst, you'll support the effective management of securitisation transactions, ensuring activities remain aligned to the bank's conduct, operational, credit and regulatory risk frameworks. You'll help monitor transaction performance, analyse key risks and support the ongoing oversight of complex structured finance portfolios.
  
  
We'll also look to you to prepare analysis, presentations, reviews and supporting documentation that contribute to origination and portfolio management activities. You'll work closely with client coverage teams and a wide range of internal stakeholders, helping deliver insight that supports informed decision-making and strong customer outcomes.
  
  
**Your Day-to-day Activities Will Include**

* Preparing investor presentations, market analysis and other marketing materials, while monitoring market developments and identifying emerging trends and opportunities
* Supporting the preparation of corporate finance advisory materials and financial models across the US technology sector
* Monitoring US and European debt markets, producing market updates across investment grade, high yield and leveraged loan markets
* Writing market commentary for clients and maintaining internal databases covering issuance activity, investor demand, pricing analysis and transaction performance
* Analysing financial performance and preparing peer comparison analysis, including spread, yield and relative value assessments to support transaction and investment discussions

The skills you'll need
  
  
To succeed in this role, you'll hold an MBA in Finance or a professional qualification such as CA, CFA or FRM. You'll also bring a strong understanding of financial markets, structured finance products and financial statement analysis, together with experience using industry-standard platforms such as Bloomberg, Intex, Reuters, FactSet and Dealogic.
  
  
We're looking for someone with strong experience in securitisation, structured credit or portfolio monitoring, ideally gained within an investment banking, capital markets or analytical risk environment.
  
  
**You’ll Also Demonstrate**

* Experience working within cash management, fixed income, investment banking or credit research functions supporting debt-related products and transactions
* A good understanding of investment banking products, credit markets and structured finance solutions
* Strong analytical capabilities, including ratio analysis, sector assessment, pitch book preparation and financial modelling
* Excellent numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex information and deliver clear, insightful analysis

title: Valuation Services Senior Consultant - Financial Institutions
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Job Description**
Crowe is looking to hire Valuation Services Senior Consultant - Financial Institutions to support valuation services needs.
  
  
Please find below the job description:
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Prepare financial models and detailed valuation analyses using various methodologies, including discounted cash flow, market multiples, and precedent transactions in a variety of industries for financial reporting, tax, and consulting valuations.
* FS focused team members: focus on financial instruments associated with financial institutions with a large emphasis on loans and deposits.
* Prepare comprehensive valuation reports and presentations that clearly communicate results, findings, and/or recommendations to clients.
* Gather and analyze financial data, market trends, and industry information to support valuation conclusions.
* Perform initial translation of client data for application and use in Crowe’s models and analysis tools. Assist in maintaining control over the data, including gaps in data received, and keeping project manager informed of data collection issues that could hinder timely delivery.
* Assist in client meetings and presentations, providing support in explaining valuation methodologies and/or findings.
* Assist in managing specific project tasks and timelines, ensuring deliverables are completed on time and meet quality standards.
* Support multiple valuation projects with the ability to multi-task between several projects independently.
* Prepare reviews of third-party appraisals for audit support purposes.
* Focused team player to deliver on client engagements and collaborate with other team members and Crowe practices to build cross-functional relationships.
* Provide support in updating and maintaining valuation models utilized and internal processes.
* FS focused team members: Analyze loan portfolios for portfolio risks and cash flow drivers.
* FS focused team members: Perform analysis and modeling relating to quantitative approaches for the estimation of loan portfolio credit loss, in accordance with the Current Expected Credit Loss ("CECL") standard (ASC 326).
* FS focused team members: Perform analysis for financial due diligence for Buy or Sell Side clients based on scope and direction provided.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
  
  
**How You Can Grow:**
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
  
  
**More about Crowe:**
Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
  
  
Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

* A Master’s degree with a minimum of 6-8 years’ experience in a fast paced environment supporting senior executives, strongly preferred.

title: EP&P Senior Analyst, ESG Supplier Risk
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

Enterprise Services (ES) was established in 2022 to provide efficient, resilient, and scalable
  
services to support the evolving needs and complexities of a more digital BCG. ES brings together
  
business-critical operations - such as Procurement & Payables, Global Finance Operations, and
  
Executive Support Services - alongside specialist expertise including Real Estate, Travel, and
  
Meetings & Events. United by a common service mindset, ES enables every BCGer to focus on the
  
work that matters most by giving time and energy back through streamlined, reliable service
  
delivery. In doing so, ES creates cost advantage and strengthens BCG’s market differentiation,
  
while reducing risk through consistent controls and business continuity. Through scalable
  
platforms and globally integrated ways of working across our strategic core global hubs, Enterprise
  
Services enhances agility and helps unlock the potential of those who advance the world.

As an EP&P Senior Analyst, Supplier Risk, you will support BCG's global ESG Supplier Risk
  
Management program by helping embed responsible sourcing practices and supplier due diligence
  
into our procurement processes. Working as part of the ESG Supplier Risk team, you will
  
contribute to the delivery of ESG risk management activities, support regulatory compliance
  
efforts, and help ensure the firm meets its evolving ESG obligations.

You will collaborate with colleagues across Procurement, Legal, Compliance, Sustainability, and
  
regional teams to support supplier due diligence, improve processes, and strengthen the quality of
  
ESG data and reporting. Through your analytical skills, attention to detail, and collaborative
  
approach, you will help scale the program globally while contributing to BCG's broader ESG
  
agenda by supporting supplier ESG due diligence, responsible sourcing initiatives, regulatory
  
compliance efforts, and responses to ESG reporting requests from clients and internal
  
stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Sustainability, Environmental

Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field.  

* 4+ years of experience in data and analytics across procurement including diversity, supply

chain, ESG, sustainability, or a related field.  

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets, identify trends, and

generate meaningful insights.  

* Familiarity with ESG principles, supplier due diligence, responsible sourcing, or regulatory

compliance is preferred.  

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with procurement, reporting, or supplier

risk management platforms is a plus.  

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively

across global, cross-functional teams.  

* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple

priorities while delivering high-quality work.  

* A collaborative mindset, curiosity, and a commitment to continuous learning and process

improvement

Who You'll Work With

As an EP&P Senior Analyst, Supplier Risk, you will sit within BCG's Procurement function and
  
report directly to BCG's ESG & Diversity Supplier Risk Director.
  
You will collaborate closely with key participants within the Procurement team, particularly the
  
Third Party and the Data Analytics team, to ensure seamless integration and alignment with
  
BCG’s procurement strategies. Additionally, you will interact with other functions including
  
compliance, legal, and sustainability teams to ensure a comprehensive approach to ESG risk
  
management, and partner extensively with teams in our local geographies to support local
  
regulatory requirements.

Additional info

YOU’RE GOOD AT  

* Data analysis and attention to detail – You are comfortable working with large datasets to

identify trends, validate information, and generate insights that support ESG supplier risk
  
management and reporting.
  

* Supplier due diligence and risk support – You can support supplier ESG due diligence

activities by coordinating information, tracking progress, and maintaining accurate
  
documentation.
  

* Cross-functional collaboration – You build effective working relationships and collaborate

with Procurement, Legal, Compliance, Sustainability, and regional teams to deliver shared
  
objectives.
  

* Organization and execution – You manage multiple priorities, maintain high-quality

documentation, and deliver work accurately and on time in a fast-paced, global
  
environment.
  

* Process improvement – You look for opportunities to improve processes, simplify ways of

working, and support the adoption of new tools and technologies.
  

* Communication – You communicate clearly and confidently, preparing reports,

documentation, and presentations while supporting responses to client and internal ESG
  
reporting requests.
  

* Learning agility – You are curious, adaptable, and eager to develop your knowledge of ESG

regulations, supplier risk management, and responsible sourcing practices.

"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."

title: Financial Systems Analyst II
description:
As part of the Financial Reporting Quality Assurance (FRQA) organization within Corporate Controllership, this role is accountable for overseeing critical Level 1 production support processes for financial systems, including data sourcing, ingestion, transformation, validation, operational calendar management, end-to-end process coordination, and incident management.
  
The team maintains deep knowledge of data sources, processing workflows, and regulatory reporting requirements, and is responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving incidents across a broad range of finance technology platforms. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, financial acumen, disciplined operational execution, proactive monitoring, and timely incident resolution.
  
The Service Management Financial System Analyst is expected to be collaborative, highly organized, and results oriented, with responsibility for end-to-end operational monitoring, incident tracking, triage, problem management, and support of financial system reliability, stability, and performance.

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a technology-related field, preferably Computer Science.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial systems implementation, production support, and incident management for financial systems.
* Advanced knowledge of relational database and data management concepts, with strong proficiency in SQL and exposure to both traditional and modern data technologies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial, business, and technology concepts for diverse stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and consistently meet critical deadlines.
* Ability to perform effectively in a high-pressure environment and make sound decisions in challenging situations.
* Proven transformational mindset, with a focus on improving process efficiency and operational effectiveness.
* Self-starter and proactive team player with a strong commitment to delivering high-quality service and meeting stakeholder expectations.
* Experience with accounting and reporting processes, including financial and regulatory reporting, is preferred.
* Flexibility is essential for this production support role, including the ability to work in shifts and provide weekend support on a rotational basis.

Technical Skills & Knowledge of Platforms
  

* Advanced SQL skills for data analysis and production incident troubleshooting, including the ability to write complex queries and perform multi-table joins.
* Proficiency with MS Excel, PowerPoint, MemSQL, and Putty for incident triage, reporting, and operational support.
* Advanced knowledge of job scheduling tools such as Airflow and Automic is required.
* Experience in Generative AI frameworks would be an added advantage.
* Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including BigQuery, Cloud Storage, monitoring, logging, IAM, production support, maintenance, and troubleshooting, is preferred.
* Experience with AxiomSL is preferred.
* Knowledge of Flink and Beam server is preferred.

1950 Origins is a growing premium Indian tea brand selling through Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Amazon, and its own website.

Key Responsibilities

**Accounting & Bookkeeping**

* Maintain day-to-day books of accounts in Tally Prime.

* Perform bank reconciliations and maintain accurate customer and vendor ledgers.
* Track receivables, payables, payment deadlines, and outstanding balances.

* Reconcile sales, settlements, commissions, deductions, returns, and refunds across Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Amazon, and the company website.

* Track inventory across company warehouses, third-party locations, and marketplace warehouses.

* Investigate shortages, damages, wastage, and stock discrepancies.

* Maintain compliance documentation, including e-way bills and e-invoices where applicable.

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales, stock, and financial reports.
* Maintain channel-wise revenue, expenses, settlement, and profitability reports.
* Track cost of goods sold, inventory valuation, logistics costs, and operational expenses.
* Assist with monthly P&L statements, cash-flow summaries, and budgets.

* 2–5 years of relevant accounting experience.
* Strong working knowledge of

  .
* Ability to use Pivot Tables, SUMIFS, and XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP for reconciliation and reporting.
* Hands-on experience with inventory accounting, bank reconciliation, and ledger management.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS, and accounting compliance.

Preferred Experience

Experience in a

We have a strong conviction that sustainable business growth is only possible when you bring together the best talent and give them the opportunity to fully harness their potential. The Finance team at HUL is a mix of extremely motivated, highly talented and curious would be leaders of tomorrow. We are the CFO factory to the world and pride ourselves in the fact that many of the past, present and future CFOs of the most reputed Indian companies trace back their roots to HUL and the fertile grooming grounds of it finance function. As technology is changing and shaping our lives and everything else around us like never before, Finance team is uniquely positioned to make the most of this opportunity and lead the organization transition into the brave new digital world. **Job Description**
We are looking to hire an Assistant Finance Manager for our factory who will be responsible for managing the financial operations of a manufacturing site. The responsibilities will include: Cost Control & Budgeting: Drive factory cost management through detailed analysis of production costs, variance tracking, and adherence to annual budgets. Finance Business Partner, responsible for forecasting, tracking, and reporting an annual spend of approximately Rs. 500 Cr across 20 sites (both own and 2P/3P). * Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with supply chain, procurement, and central finance teams to align factory performance with business objectives and work closely to identify optimisation opportunities.

In HUL Finance, we believe in building careers and recruit not just for a role but for a career in the organisation.

description:
WANTED: ADVOCATES READY TO LEAD IN COURT

Assured Justice LLP

Openings in Hosur & Shoolagiri - Krishnagiri District Tamil Nadu

For a litigator, a true practice is built in the trenches—in the trial courts, through rigorous cross-examinations, and in direct client counsel. Assured Justice LLP is bringing the scale, technology, and rigorous standards of a premier national firm to the dynamic legal markets of Hosur and Shoolagiri.

We are not looking for juniors to carry files, fetch pass-overs, or watch from the sidelines. We are looking for advocates with fire in them to take complete, end-to-end ownership of their matters.

The Opportunity & Responsibilities

* Total File Ownership: From the first client conference to the final order, you are the face of the file. You will draft, file, argue, and negotiate. No shadow work. Your name will appear on the memo of parties, and your reputation will be yours to build.
* Trial to Appellate Advocacy: Get on your feet immediately. You will manage a heavy, diverse docket spanning local civil property disputes, partition suits, matrimonial proceedings, criminal litigation, and labour law, while also collaborating on constitutional and commercial briefs before the High Courts.
* Impeccable Drafting Standards: You will be mentored to produce pleadings, written submissions, and legal notices that command judicial respect. Expect a practice culture that demands rigorous statutory validation, exact volume and page number citation verification, and absolute precision in drafting.
* Direct Client Relationships: Build and retain your own client network. We expect you to conduct independent client conferences, establish clear financial engagements, and become the trusted legal advisor for local families, businesses, and institutions.

The Platform: Assured Justice LLP We are a technology-driven law firm executing an ambitious expansion to 30 offices across India within 36 months. Our Hosur and Shoolagiri branch offices are fully integrated with our headquarters in Bengaluru and our broader network spanning Chennai, Cochin, Trivandrum, Mysore, and Belgaum.

Practicing here means getting the intensive, grassroots trial experience of a mofussil court system, fully backed by the resources, modern tech-enabled platforms, and multi-jurisdictional exposure of a rapidly scaling firm.

Who Should Apply? The challenge is real. The hours are demanding, and our standards for legal research and presentation are absolute. If you have the appetite for ownership and the ambition to grow into a complete, independent litigator, there is no better canvas.

To Apply: Submit your CV alongside a brief writing sample (a drafted pleading, petition, or legal notice) to rm@assuredjustice.com.

Contact: +91 9739206710

Website: www.assuredjustice.com

title: Associate Lawyer
description:
We're hiring: Associate, Office of the Managing Partner | Chennai
| Coimbatore

Most associate roles give you one practice area and a long wait before you see how a firm is really built.

This one puts you next to the Managing Partner & CEO from day one.

You'll work on legal matters across practice areas, and also on what it takes to grow a law firm: strategy, operations, technology and new initiatives. We're looking for a lawyer who thinks from first principles, uses AI as a serious professional tool, and delivers without needing to be supervised.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Research, analyse and draft opinions, memos, contracts, pleadings and notices across corporate, real estate, disputes, IP and white collar matters

• Run matters from start to finish, taking more ownership as you grow

• Use AI research and drafting tools daily, and check every output with your own legal judgment

• Build precedents, templates, playbooks and AI workflows the whole firm will use

• Work directly with the Managing Partner on firm-building projects: operations, process improvement, technology and business development

YOU'RE RIGHT FOR THIS IF YOU

• Understand legal concepts deeply, not just the case law around them

• Write and speak clear, precise, persuasive English

• Are fluent with AI tools and know where they go wrong

• Take an outcome and deliver it with minimal supervision

WHO SHOULD APPLY

• Lawyers with 0–3 years of post-qualification experience

• Final-year LL.B. students graduating in 2027: outstanding candidates will receive pre-placement offers

• Daily mentoring from the Managing Partner & CEO

• Real responsibility and fast growth for those who deliver

• Competitive pay, linked to performance

HOW TO APPLY

Email your CV to vidya@lawindia.com, copying vs@lawindia.com

Subject: Associate – Office of the MP

In your email, make your case in 150 words: why are you the most suitable person for this role? We'll read this before your CV.
