title: Associate III - AML KYC Specialist
description:
**Role Description**
**Overview of Role/Principle Responsibilities:**
To act as subject matter expert on all core AML/KYC due diligence activities, perform robust quality assurance and handle advanced cases, directly supporting the Analysts and providing hands-on guidance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Advanced Due Diligence Execution

Complex Entity Review: Review and perform due diligence on non-standard, complex structures (e.g., layered ownership, trusts, foundations, offshore vehicles), ensuring full transparency of control and beneficial ownership.
  
  
Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD): Lead EDD work on high-risk clients (e.g., PEPs, complex private equity structures, high-risk geographies):
  
  
Analyse and corroborate sources of wealth and funds through documentary evidence and public record checks
  
  
Conduct in-depth open-source investigations on high-risk profiles or negative media hits
  
  
Liaise with customer agreed escalation point for enhanced approval and/or further escalation
  
  

* Screening and Risk Mitigation

Name Screening Oversight: Validate name screening s escalated by Analysts, determine false positives and true matches, and make decisions on further escalation.
  
  
Sanctions/Adverse Media: Investigate and document all genuine matches against sanctions, PEP, and adverse media lists, with clear escalation narratives and recommendations.
  
  

* Risk Assessment & Rating

Risk Factor Analysis: Review risk ratings assigned by Analysts, ensure scoring methodologies are correctly applied, and correct or re-assess where necessary.
  
  
KYC Reviews: Lead periodic reviews of investor files. Re-assess documentation based on trigger events—ownership changes, negative news, jurisdiction upgrade/downgrade, etc.
  
  

* Quality Control and Training

File Review: Execute rigorous file quality checks. Maintain QA checklists, document deficiencies, and confirm corrective action by Analysts.
  
  
Coaching: Provide hands-on coaching and process clarification to Analysts and act as the first point of contact for technical queries.
  
  
Knowledge Sharing: Develop guidance notes, training materials, and best practice documentation for use within the team.
  
  

* Analysis and Implementation

Procedure Updates: Monitor changes in AML/CFT internal procedures as required. Provide operational input to Team Leaders regarding impacts on workflows.
  
  
Project Participation: Support remediation, data clean-up, or regulatory project work as assigned.
  
  

* Casework & Escalation

Complex Query Resolution: Act as initial escalation point for complex or unusual cases—either resolve or clearly summarise and escalate to Team Leader/Manager.
  
  
Investor & Counterparty Liaison: Handle detailed, technical queries from investors, fund managers, or distributors related to AML/KYC requirements.
  
  

* Know your distribution (KYD) – where applicable
* In-Depth Questionnaire Analysis: Review DDQ and Wolfsberg Questionnaire responses in detail, cross-checking answers for plausibility and completeness. Follow up directly with intermediaries if clarifications are needed.
* AML Control Framework Assessment: Conduct a review and summarise the distributor’s or platform’s Financial Crime (FC) control policies and procedures, including initial and ongoing client due diligence processes. Prepare a comparison of intermediaries’ stated practices against client’s risk appetite and regulatory expectations.
* Reliance Assessment Support: Assess whether reliance on the intermediary’s AML controls may be considered, and document the findings. Where Placement Agents are involved, assist in determining if they fulfil a different role and escalate uncertainties to the designated client function.
* Investor Profile Review: Analyse and document who the underlying investors are (retail, HNWI, professional clients, etc.), as disclosed by the distributor or obtained via DDQ.
* Quality Assurance: Review Analysts’ KYD files for thoroughness and escalate deficiencies or high-risk findings as required.

**Skills And Behaviours Required**

* 5-6 years’ AML/KYC experience with focus on alternative investments and complex structures
* Demonstrable expertise in risk-based approaches, screening investigations, and EDD
* Adept communicator, able to articulate complex regulatory topics in practical terms
* Strong attention to detail, time management, and coaching ability
* High proficiency in KYC/AML databases and screening tools Proficiency with office productivity tools; prior exposure to KYC/AML systems advantageous.
* Strong interpersonal skills and team focus

**Skills**
Anti-Money Laundering, Attention to Detail, Time Management

title: Executive Legal Counsel – Employment AP
description:
**Locations**: London | Gurgaon

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As Executive Legal Counsel, you will serve as the senior-most Employment Legal leader dedicated to BCG’s Asia Pacific (AP) Region, leading the Employment Legal team within AP and advising on the region’s most important and complex employment-related matters. You will provide regional leadership while partnering closely with global Legal colleagues and external counsel .

You will be a trusted advisor to senior business and HR leaders, embedded in decision-making on complex, high-impact people topics. The role requires not only deep employment-law expertise, but exceptional judgment, stakeholder management and the ability to navigate sensitive issues across different cultures and jurisdictions. As advances in artificial intelligence reshape how organizations recruit, develop, manage and support their workforce, you will help BCG navigate an evolving employment landscape with sound legal judgment, balancing innovation with legal compliance, responsible governance and the firm's values.

Operating across AP’s diverse legal regimes, cultures and business environments, you will bring together local expertise and regional perspective to help BCG navigate its most complex people matters and implement practical solutions across the region.

  

* Your responsibilities will include:
* Lead all Employment Legal matters across AP, covering the full employee lifecycle, including recruitment, performance management, investigations, restructurings and exits.
* Lead and develop BCG’s Employment Legal team across AP, establishing clear roles and accountability, building team capabilities, and fostering a cohesive regional approach while leveraging the local expertise required across AP’s diverse jurisdictions
* Act as the primary regional legal advisor on complex and high-risk employment matters, including litigation, regulatory issues, internal investigations and sensitive employee relations matters.
* Partner closely with senior business leaders and HR to shape decisions that balance legal risk, commercial priorities and an exceptional employee experience.
* Serve as a key Employment Legal partner to AP regional and system leadership, ensuring Employment Legal is engaged early on significant people, organizational and workforce issues
* Advise on emerging workforce issues and technologies, including AI-enabled employment practices, partnering with global Legal, HR and business teams to ensure AP legal and regulatory considerations are reflected in BCG’s approach
* Drive the development and evolution of employment policies and practices to ensure they remain aligned with changing regulatory requirements, evolving workforce expectations and advances in technology.
* Lead Employment Legal support for strategic business and people initiatives across AP, including reorganizations, workforce transformations, acquisitions, divestitures and expansion into new markets.
* Navigate complex cross-border employment issues across AP, identifying common regional approaches where appropriate while recognizing when local legal, regulatory, cultural or employee-relations considerations require differentiated solutions.
* Enhance how employment legal services are delivered by identifying opportunities to leverage legal technology, AI-enabled tools and data responsibly, while ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, consistency and legal defensibility.

What You'll Bring

* Significant experience in employment law (typically 12–15+ years), with a combination of in-house and leading law firm experience preferred.
* Deep employment-law expertise in one or more major AP jurisdictions, together with significant experience advising on complex employment matters across multiple AP markets. Experience with Japan and/or broader North East Asia and China employment matters would be particularly valuable.
* Exceptional legal judgment and experience managing complex, high-profile employment matters involving significant business impact, reputational and stakeholder considerations.
* Strong understanding of how AI and emerging workplace technologies are reshaping employment law, workforce governance and regulatory expectations.
* Proven ability to influence senior executives and build trusted relationships across a sophisticated, global organization.
* Experience leading and developing high-performing legal teams across jurisdictions and cultures, while fostering collaboration, inclusion and continuous development.
* Proven ability to operate effectively across jurisdictions and cultures, bringing together local experts and stakeholders to develop practical regional solutions.
* Ability to translate complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, practical advice that enables informed business decisions.

Who You'll Work With

You will join BCG's Legal function and work closely with AP regional and system leadership, senior HR leaders, and colleagues across Legal, Risk, Compliance and the business. You will lead and develop the AP Employment Legal team while partnering closely with BCG’s global Employment CoE and Employment Legal colleagues in other regions.

You will collaborate with leaders across People, Digital and business teams to navigate evolving employment laws, emerging workforce technologies and organizational transformation. Together, you will help ensure BCG continues to adopt innovative ways of working responsibly, balancing legal compliance, business objectives and an outstanding employee experience.

Additional info

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Corporate Governance Manager, APAC
description:
Meta is seeking a Corporate Governance Manager to support its legal and corporate secretarial operations across the Asia-Pacific region. Reporting to the Director, Associate General Counsel, Corporate Legal, you will provide expert company law and governance advice to a large and diverse portfolio of Meta subsidiaries across Asia, with a primary focus on India. This role is suitable for a candidate with experience of overseeing legal entity management operations in a large US multinational environment.  
  
  

### **Corporate Governance Manager, APAC Responsibilities:**

* Manage and oversee company law, company secretarial and governance operations for Meta's India and wider APAC subsidiaries, including advising on matters such as capital contributions, share issuance, RBI and FEMA matters, new entity incorporation, licence expansion, SEZ / STP approvals, shareholder, director and officer changes and the closure of dormant subsidiaries
* working closely with our professional services advisors in India and globally and operating within the group’s affiliate governance framework
* Act as the in-country Company Secretary for certain Indian entities that require a qualified Indian Company Secretary, and as primary owner of the India board calendar, statutory compliance, and event-driven filings, becoming the day-to-day point of contact for Indian and APAC escalations
* Conduct board, shareholder and committee meetings including review of agendas, board and shareholder resolutions and associated documents and ensuring processes are in place to keep company records up to date
* Act as the point of escalation within the India and APAC portfolio on matters such as annual compliance, director and officer changes, banking resolutions, delegations of authority and powers of attorney
* Maintain oversight of compliance status across the legal entity portfolio in the region, ensuring statutory corporate documents, licences, registrations and corporate records are properly maintained, and that Meta's subsidiaries meet their statutory filing obligations
* Advise and problem solve on complex company secretarial matters across the portfolio, operating and advising within the group affiliate governance framework and flagging risks and opportunities to International Corporate Legal leadership
* Support on ad-hoc team-wide / global projects

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Meta requires all employed attorneys to have a law degree or equivalent certificate to permit the practice of law and be appropriately licensed and authorized to practice law for the company in their assigned work location. Unless prohibited under local law, an attorney must hold a current practicing certificate (including where required from the relevant authority in the jurisdiction of the assigned work location) or the local law equivalent bar registration or license as may be applicable
* Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) degree with a demonstrated knowledge of corporate law, through experiences in a global professional services firm and/or the corporate legal/company secretary’s office of a large multinational
* Registered as a Member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India. The successful candidate will be appointed as Company Secretary of one or more of Meta's Indian subsidiaries

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* 8+ years of experience in corporate governance, company secretarial, or corporate legal operations, ideally with experience leading a corporate secretarial function for a region, business unit, or equivalent
* Hands-on experience in managing legal entities across multiple jurisdictions
* Experience supporting corporate restructurings, mergers, or cross-border transactions involving APAC entities
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Familiarity with entity management software platforms used to track corporate records, compliance calendars, and statutory obligations
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

title: Subcontracts Delivery Manager
description:
**The opportunity**
The
**Subcontracts Delivery Manager (SDLM)**
is responsible for the commercial, contractual, and operational management of construction and installation subcontracts on major HVDC projects from contract award through to final completion and closeout.
  
  
The role acts as the primary commercial interface between Hitachi Energy and its subcontractors, ensuring contractual obligations are met while protecting project objectives relating to safety, cost, schedule, quality, and risk.
  
  
Working closely with Construction, Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, Cost Control, and Contract Management teams, the SDLM is responsible for proactively managing subcontract performance throughout project execution. This includes administering subcontract agreements, managing variations and change orders, assessing and resolving claims, negotiating commercial matters, monitoring performance, and identifying risks and opportunities that may impact project delivery.
  
  
A key responsibility of the role is maintaining strong commercial control of subcontract packages. This includes managing payment applications, verifying invoices, tracking costs, preparing reports, supporting cost recovery initiatives, administering contractual changes, and ensuring that all commercial matters are properly documented and managed. The SDLM also plays a key role in the negotiation of final accounts and the successful closeout of subcontracts.
  
  
The position requires strong stakeholder management and communication skills, as the SDLM regularly interfaces with subcontractors, site management, project leadership, engineers, contract managers, and clients. The ability to negotiate effectively, resolve disputes, manage commercial risk, and maintain strong working relationships is critical to success.
  
  
Successful Subcontracts Delivery Managers typically possess extensive experience in construction, infrastructure, energy, utilities, or EPC projects, combined with strong knowledge of contract administration, subcontract management, claims management, change control, commercial management, risk management, and project delivery.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Manage subcontracts from award and handover through to completion and final closeout.
* Administer subcontract agreements and ensure compliance with contractual obligations.
* Manage variations, change orders, claims, notifications, and contractual correspondence.
* Monitor subcontractor performance, progress, risks, and opportunities.
* Manage payment certification, invoice verification, and cost control processes.
* Support dispute resolution, cost recovery, and final account negotiations.
* Coordinate with project stakeholders to support successful project execution.
* Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, quality standards, health and safety requirements, and company procedures.
* Maintain accurate records, reporting, and commercial documentation.
* Capture lessons learned and contributed to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

**Your background**
**Education & Experience**

* Relevant third level degree qualification (bachelor’s degree) in Engineering
* 10 Years Experience in heavy / industrial business and preferably in power sector
* Minimum of 5 (five) years in subcontract management experience, this includes commercial, contractual and construction awareness.
* Technical background is advantageous.
* Experience of successfully coordinating and managing multiple subcontracts / tasks effectively.
* Proficient with standard form and bespoke contracts.
* Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required.

description:
General Manager IT Infrastructure Position Overview We are seeking an experienced and vision-driven General Manager IT Infrastructure to oversee and modernise our enterprise IT environment. In this role, you will lead the strategic planning, architectural design, implementation, and operational management of our global IT infrastructure—including hybrid cloud, network enterprise architecture, data centres, cybersecurity alignment, and IT service management (ITSM). As a senior leader, you will align IT infrastructure initiatives with overall business goals, ensure robust security and compliance, drive digital transformation, and manage high-value vendor relationships and CapEx/OpEx budgets. Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Leadership & Digital Transformation Define and execute the end-to-end IT infrastructure strategy aligned with long-term business objectives. Drive digital transformation initiatives, including cloud adoption/migration (AWS, Azure, GCP) and hybrid infrastructure optimization. Evaluate emerging technology trends (AI/ML automation, Edge Computing, Zero Trust Architecture) to modernize legacy systems and enhance operational efficiency. 2. Infrastructure Operations & Service Delivery Oversee multi-site data centres, enterprise networks (SD-WAN, LAN/WAN), cloud architectures, system administration, and end-user computing. Ensure high availability, performance, scalable capability, and maximum uptime across all critical enterprise applications and systems. Establish and enforce strict IT Service Management (ITSM) frameworks based on ITIL best practices for Incident, Problem, and Change Management. Drive automated monitoring, continuous integration, and proactive maintenance to maintain SLAs/OLAs. 3. Security, Governance & Compliance Partner closely with CISO/InfoSec teams to implement robust cybersecurity protocols, Zero Trust frameworks, and access management solutions. Ensure full compliance with industry standards and regulations (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, or local data privacy laws). Develop, maintain, and regularly test comprehensive Business Continuity Plans (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies to guarantee zero data loss and business resilience. 4. Team Leadership & Talent Management Lead, mentor, and grow a multi-disciplinary team of network engineers, system administrators, cloud specialists, and DevOps talent. Build a culture of continuous learning, accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence. Define KPIs, OKRs, and performance metrics for internal teams and managed service providers (MSPs). 5. Financial Management & Vendor Governance Manage large-scale IT CapEx and OpEx budgets (ranging from multi-crore investments) with a focus on Cost Optimization (FinOps). Oversee strategic sourcing, SLA negotiating, and performance management for major hardware, software, telecom, and cloud vendors. Required Qualifications & Key Competencies Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Master’s degree / MBA is preferred. senior leadership role (DGM/GM/Director level) managing large-scale enterprise IT infrastructure. Technical Expertise: 
 Hands-on exposure to Hybrid/Multi-Cloud management (AWS/Azure/GCP). Deep understanding of enterprise networking (Cisco, SD-WAN, Firewalls, VPNs) and Data Centre consolidation. Familiarity with DevOps pipelines, containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Certifications (Highly Desirable): 
 ITIL v4 Master / Foundation AWS Certified Solutions Architect / Azure Solutions Architect Expert CISSP / CISM / CISA PMP / PRINCE2 Leadership & Soft Skills: 
 Exceptional executive stakeholder management and board-level communication skills. Strong business acumen and capability to bridge the gap between technical operations and business value. Proven crisis management skills with a calm, decisive approach during high-severity outages or security incidents. Compensation & Benefits Salary Band: 45.00 LPA – 85.00 LPA (Fixed + Variable, commensurate with experience and organizational scale). title: Human Resource Business Partner
description:
Deputy Manager HR Business Partner & Operations 
 Who We Are Pinaak Aerial Systems Private Limited is a drone technology startup developing indigenous, mission-configurable unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) platforms for defence applications. We design modular drone systems with interchangeable payload capabilities for surveillance, reconnaissance and payload-delivery missions. Pinaak Aerial Systems has collaborated with multiple Indian Army battalions to develop specialized payload-dropping drone systems and deliver mission-specific UAV solutions tailored to operational requirements. By developing indigenous flight-control systems, secure communication technologies and modular payload architectures, we aim to strengthen India's self-reliance through secure, scalable and mission-ready drone solutions. 
 About the Role We are looking for a hands-on HR professional with strong technical recruitment capability, preferably from the defence, aerospace or UAV industry, who combines business understanding, attention to detail, sound people judgment and execution discipline. The role will primarily focus on end-to-end recruitment of specialized engineering talent, structured onboarding, employee lifecycle management, HR documentation and day-to-day HR operations. The person must understand the talent landscape and skill requirements of UAV, embedded systems, electronics hardware and defence technology organizations, while independently managing HR processes with accuracy, confidentiality and timely closure. This is an execution-oriented HRBP role requiring direct ownership rather than purely advisory or coordination responsibilities. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Recruitment and Talent Acquisition Own end-to-end recruitment, from sourcing and screening to interviews, negotiations, offers and joining closure. Recruit specialized talent across UAV design, embedded firmware, electronics hardware, avionics, mechanical design, testing and systems integration. Understand technical roles and evaluate candidates based on actual work experience, not just CV keywords. Build talent pipelines across defence, aerospace, drone and embedded product companies. Partner with engineering leaders to understand technical hiring requirements and priorities. Maintain recruitment trackers, hiring dashboards and timely stakeholder communication. 
 2. Onboarding and Employee Lifecycle Manage pre-joining, onboarding, probation, confirmation, promotions, salary revisions, transfers and exits. Prepare and verify offer letters, appointment letters, employment agreements and other employee documents. Coordinate background verification, document collection, induction, IT access and policy acknowledgments. Maintain accurate employee records, personnel files, HRMIS data and lifecycle trackers. Ensure timely completion of employee documentation, approvals and lifecycle activities. 
 3. HR Operations, Documentation and Compliance Manage attendance, leave records, payroll inputs and employee-related HR administration. Maintain NDAs, confidentiality agreements, IP undertakings and other employment documentation. Support applicable statutory compliance, HR audits and employee background verification. Ensure confidentiality and controlled handling of sensitive employee and organizational information. Standardize HR processes, checklists, documentation and HRMIS workflows. 
 4. Employee Relations and HR Coordination Address employee queries and concerns with empathy, discretion and sound judgment. Coordinate employee communication, engagement, performance reviews and training activities. Work closely with functional leaders to resolve HR matters and ensure timely closure. Prepare HR reports covering recruitment, headcount, attrition and employee lifecycle activities. 
 Required Skills Strong end-to-end technical recruitment and candidate assessment capability. Understanding of UAV, aerospace, defence electronics and embedded engineering talent requirements. Ability to differentiate design/development engineers from testing, integration and support profiles. Sound knowledge of onboarding, employee lifecycle management and HR documentation. Experience with HRMIS, payroll inputs, compliance and employee record management. Strong Excel, analytical, communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills. Excellent attention to detail, confidentiality and execution discipline. 
 Preferred Profile Education: Engineering degree (Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace, Computer Science or related field) with MBA/PGDM in HR strongly preferred. Experience: 36 years in HR, with significant hands-on technical recruitment and HR operations exposure. Industry: Defence, aerospace, UAV/drone technology or avionics strongly preferred. Embedded electronics, robotics and engineering product organizations may also be considered. Recruitment Exposure: Proven hiring experience for embedded firmware, electronics hardware, UAV design, avionics, mechanical design or similar technical roles. HR Operations: Practical experience in onboarding, employee documentation, HRMIS and employee lifecycle processes. Location: Pune-based or willing to work full-time from Pune. 
 Behavioural Attributes Technically curious and quick to understand engineering roles. Proactive, resourceful and focused on recruitment closure. Meticulous, organized and process-oriented. Approachable, empathetic and professionally discreet. Strong ownership, follow-through and communication skills. Comfortable working independently in a growing technology startup. 
 What Success Will Look Like Faster, higher-quality recruitment for specialized engineering positions. Strong talent pipelines within relevant defence and technology industries. Smooth onboarding with accurate and complete documentation. Timely completion of employee lifecycle processes. Reliable HRMIS records, payroll inputs and compliance documentation. Independent ownership and timely closure of HR responsibilities. 
 Additional Information Role Title: Deputy Manager – HR Business Partner & Operations

 Location: Pune
 Experience: 3–6 years
 Industry: UAV, Aerospace and Defence Technology
 Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
 Work Mode: Work from Office

title: Economic Research Analyst
description:
About the opportunity Indian Economic Research Council invites applications from talented researchers interested in Indias economic development, public policy, business environment and the global forces shaping its future. You will analyse economic evidence, evaluate policies and contribute to practical recommendations that support a developed India and improve everyday economic and business experience. 
 Available specialisations — one opening each 1. Macroeconomics & Data Analysis Study growth, inflation, employment, investment, public finance and other economic indicators. Build datasets, dashboards and quantitative analyses. 2. Industry & Microeconomics Research sectors, MSMEs, productivity, competition, business costs, credit access and operational constraints. Support business interviews and sector comparisons. 3. Public Policy & Government Schemes Examine scheme objectives, eligibility, expenditure, implementation, beneficiary access and outcomes. Identify gaps and recommend practical improvements. 4. Global Economics & Geopolitics Track international trade, supply chains, energy markets, geopolitical developments and country risks. Assess their implications for Indian industries and the economy. 
 Key responsibilities Collect, clean, analyse and maintain data from credible sources. Review research papers, government publications, policy documents and international studies. Prepare concise research notes, charts, presentations and sections of larger reports. Track developments relevant to the assigned research area. Support surveys, stakeholder interviews and field research where required. Compare policy approaches across countries and Indian states. Develop evidence-based findings and practical recommendations. Maintain clear documentation of sources, methods, calculations and assumptions. Work collaboratively and meet agreed research deadlines. 
 Education Master’s degree in Economics, Applied Economics, Econometrics, Public Policy, Development Studies, Statistics or a relevant discipline. For the global economics role, candidates with International Relations qualifications should demonstrate strong economic analysis skills. For the quantitative role, candidates with Statistics or Data Science qualifications should demonstrate a sound understanding of economics. 
 Essential skills Strong research aptitude, analytical thinking and attention to detail. Clear English writing and the ability to explain complex findings simply. Proficiency in Excel and preparation of charts and presentations. Ability to verify information and work confidently with primary sources. Sound understanding of Indian economic and policy issues. Initiative, curiosity and willingness to learn. 
 Specialisation-specific skills Macroeconomics & Data: Practical proficiency in at least one of Python, R, Stata or EViews, with an understanding of econometrics. Industry & Microeconomics: Sector analysis, business research, financial statement interpretation or survey experience. Public Policy & Schemes: Policy analysis, programme evaluation, budget analysis or field research. Global Economics & Geopolitics: Trade data analysis, country research and the ability to connect geopolitical events with economic consequences. Relevant research assistantships, substantial research projects and doctoral research will be considered when assessing experience.

Key Skills: Policy Advocacy,Research,Analytics,Policy making,Analysis,Economics,Advocacy,Economic analysis

Develop and implement area-level collection strategies to improve portfolio quality and reduce delinquency. Identify critical and high-risk accounts and ensure timely corrective action. 
 B. Team Management & Supervision Supervise and manage Team Leaders (TLs), Callers and Field Officers (FOS) responsible for collections across Ahmedabad. Allocate targets, portfolios and responsibilities to TLs and collection teams based on business requirements. Monitor the performance of TLs and ensure effective management of their respective teams. Conduct daily performance reviews and track achievement against individual, team and area-level targets. Monitor the productivity and effectiveness of Callers and FOS through regular reviews and field visits. Conduct regular field visits to monitor collection activities, customer follow-ups and team performance. Guide, train and coach TLs, Callers and FOS to improve productivity and recovery performance. Monitor attendance, field activity, productivity, PTP achievement and target achievement of the team. Ensure adequate field coverage and effective utilization of collection resources across Ahmedabad. 
 C. Portfolio Monitoring & MIS Review daily, weekly and monthly collection performance for the Ahmedabad area. Analyze collection efficiency, bucket movement, overdue portfolio, bounce trends and recovery ratios. Track PTPs, broken PTPs and pending commitments and ensure timely follow-up. Monitor the performance of TL-wise, Caller-wise and FOS-wise portfolios and targets . Prepare and maintain collection MIS and performance reports. Share regular performance updates, key observations and action plans with management. Ensure accurate reporting of collections, receipts and portfolio status. Take corrective measures wherever team or portfolio performance is below the required benchmark. 
 D. Customer & Stakeholder Management Handle customer complaints and escalated collection-related issues. Coordinate with Branch, Sales, Credit, Operations, Legal and Repossession teams, wherever required. Ensure effective resolution of customer issues while maintaining collection discipline. Negotiate repayment plans and settlements within approved company policies. Maintain professional customer relationships while ensuring timely recovery. Ensure all collection activities are carried out in accordance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements. 
 Qualifications & Experience Graduate in any discipline; MBA/Postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage. 5 to 10 years of experience in collections/recovery , preferably in Banking, NBFC or financial services. Prior experience in handling TLs and field collection teams is preferred. Experience in managing field collections and delinquency portfolios. Experience in Two-Wheeler / Auto / Retail Finance collections will be preferred. Good knowledge of collection strategies, MIS reporting and MS Excel. Exposure to collection/field-force management systems will be an added advantage. 
 Candidate Required Skills Strong leadership and team-management skills. Excellent communication and negotiation skills. Strong follow-up and target-oriented approach. Analytical and problem-solving abilities. Good understanding of collection and recovery processes. Ability to manage TLs, Callers and FOS across a defined geographic area . Strong MIS preparation and performance-analysis skills. Customer handling and conflict-resolution skills.

title: Devops Architect
description:
Role : DevOps Architect Location : Mumbai Shift : UK Shift(1-10pm) Experience : 8 12 years in DevOps, platform engineering or cloud automation architecture Role Type: Individual Contributor (no people management responsibilities) 
 THE ROLE 
 Linedata provides critical financial software to well-known global banking and asset management institutions. The Linedata Information Technology team is strengthening its global cloud operations, automation and architecture capability. 
 Define and govern the DevOps and automation architecture that enables teams to deliver secure, repeatable and supportable change across cloud environments. T his is a hands-on DevOps architecture role focused on CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (with Terraform as a key capability), automation patterns and developer platform standards. It is distinct from a Platform Architect role (which focuses on underlying cloud platform design) and from an Enterprise Architect role (which focuses on organisation-wide strategy and business alignment). The DevOps Architect owns the tooling, patterns and governance that connect code to production safely and consistently. This is an Individual Contributor (IC) position. 
 ESSENTIAL DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Define the target DevOps architecture, principles, reference patterns and roadmap across source control, build, test, release, infrastructure as code, artefact management and platform services. Design standard CI/CD pathways with embedded security, quality, approval, segregation-of-duty, traceability and rollback controls appropriate to service risk. Architect and maintain Terraform-driven automation for infrastructure provisioning, including module design, state management, workspace strategy and drift detection. Establish reusable pipeline templates, golden paths, modules and engineering standards that reduce variation while enabling product-team autonomy. Own architecture for software supply-chain security, including dependency management, secrets, signing, provenance, vulnerability scanning and artefact integrity. Provide architecture assurance for DevOps and automation designs; record decisions, exceptions, risks and technical debt and ensure remediation is governed. Partner with Cloud Architecture to ensure pipeline and automation designs comply with identity, networking, resilience, observability, data and cost standards. Guide adoption of GitOps, policy as code, automated compliance evidence and safe self-service where these improve control and delivery performance. Set non-functional requirements and operational-acceptance standards so delivery tooling and platforms are reliable, observable, recoverable and supportable. Technically direct the RFP DevOps service, reviewing designs, priorities, engineering quality and adherence to approved patterns. Coach engineers and architects, build communities of practice and communicate complex choices in language appropriate to technical and senior stakeholders. 
 MUST-HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 
 8-12 years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, cloud automation or solution architecture in complex cloud environments. Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS or Azure (experience in both is desirable but not mandatory). Deep expertise in Terraform for infrastructure as code, including module design, remote state, workspaces and CI-driven apply workflows. Deep knowledge of CI/CD pipeline design and tooling at least two of: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps. Strong experience with Git workflows, branching strategies and code-review practices at scale. Experience with automated testing, container platforms (Docker, Kubernetes / ECS / EKS / AKS) and/or serverless architectures. Strong understanding of secure software development, cloud security controls, resilience and regulated change. Experience defining enterprise patterns and governing delivery across multiple teams without becoming a delivery bottleneck. Ability to produce clear architecture documentation, diagrams and decision records. GOOD-TO-HAVE SKILLS 
 Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible. Familiarity with GitOps practices and tools (e.g. ArgoCD, Flux). Experience with policy-as-code tools (e.g. OPA, Sentinel, AWS Config Rules, Azure Policy). Relevant advanced certification (e.g. AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Terraform Associate / Professional, CKA). Experience with observability platforms (e.g. Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor). Familiarity with FinOps principles and cloud cost governance. Experience in financial services, asset management or regulated industries. 
 DEVOPS TOOLS AND TECHNOLOGY STACK 
 The DevOps Architect should demonstrate expertise across the following areas: Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (primary), CloudFormation or Bicep (secondary). CI/CD Pipelines: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps. Source Control: Git, GitHub, GitLab. Configuration Management: Ansible. Container and Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, ECS, EKS, AKS. Artefact Management: JFrog Artifactory, Nexus, ECR, ACR, GitHub Packages. Security and Compliance: SonarQube, Snyk, Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, OPA, Sentinel. Observability: Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor. Scripting: Python, Bash, PowerShell. Cloud Platforms: AWS and/or Azure. 
 COMPETENCIES 
 Strategic-to-practical thinking Able to move between strategy, architecture and practical engineering detail. Design judgement Strong design judgement, including clear articulation of options, trade-offs and consequences. Technical leadership Influential technical leadership across organisational and supplier boundaries. Pragmatic standardisation Creates guardrails and paved roads that teams will actually adopt. Architecture communication High-quality written architecture, diagrams, standards and decision records.

Partner with Cloud Operations to ensure designs are monitorable, recoverable, patchable, supportable and suitable for operational acceptance.  MUST-HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 
 Minimum 8 years of experience in cloud technologies, with depth in solution or infrastructure architecture. Strong cloud solution-architecture experience, with depth in AWS and meaningful working knowledge of Azure, or vice versa. Track record designing production services for availability, resilience, security, scalability, operability and cost control. Experience with landing zones, identity (IAM, Azure AD / Entra ID), networking (VPC, Transit Gateway, VNet peering), cloud-native services and migration architecture. Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools, particularly Terraform, and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure deployment. Experience working within formal architecture governance and regulated or customer-audited environments. Strong understanding of cloud security controls, encryption, backup and disaster recovery strategies. Ability to produce clear architecture documentation, diagrams (e.g. using draw.io, Lucidchart) and decision records. 
 GOOD-TO-HAVE SKILLS 
 Professional-level AWS or Azure architecture certification (e.g. AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert). Architecture-framework certification (e.g. TOGAF, AWS Well-Architected). Experience in financial services, asset management or regulated industries. Familiarity with FinOps practices and cloud cost management tools. Knowledge of containerisation and serverless architectures. Experience with observability platforms (e.g. Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor). 
 COMPETENCIES 
 Architecture judgement Structured architectural thinking combined with sufficient engineering depth to validate feasibility. Communication Clear communication of options and trade-offs to both technical teams and decision-makers. Secure and resilient design Security-, resilience- and operations-aware design judgement. Collaborative governance Collaborative governance that improves consistency without creating unnecessary delay. title: Data Engineer (Integration & Automation)
description:
Job Description Data Engineer 
 Job Title: Data Engineer
 Experience: 4–6 Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Department: IT Services Location : Vadodara, Corporate Office. 
 Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join our IT team. The candidate will be responsible for developing, implementing, maintaining, and supporting solutions across ETL/Data Integration, Cloud Data Lake/Data Warehouse, and Data Analytics, Robotic Process Automation (RPA) . The role requires hands-on experience with Informatica/IICS, SQL, and Google BigQuery, Automation Anywhere / Automation 360, . The candidate will work with business and technical teams to understand requirements, design scalable solutions, develop and deploy automations and data pipelines, and provide production support. Key Responsibilities: 1. Informatica / ETL & Data Integration Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain ETL workflows using Informatica / Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS) . Develop data integration pipelines from multiple source systems including: SAP Oracle SQL databases Excel/CSV files APIs Cloud data sources Analyze source data and develop appropriate source-to-target mappings . Perform data extraction, transformation, cleansing, validation, enrichment, and loading. Implement full load and incremental/delta load strategies. Design ETL processes for historical data and change data processing. Implement data quality checks, reconciliation, and validation mechanisms. Develop reusable mappings, mapping tasks, workflows, and parameterized ETL components. Implement error handling, logging, restart/recovery mechanisms, and operational monitoring. Monitor production ETL jobs and troubleshoot failures. Analyze ETL performance and optimize workflows for improved processing time and resource utilization. Work with technical and business teams to resolve data-related issues. Perform impact analysis for changes to source systems, mappings, and target structures. Maintain technical documentation, source-to-target mapping documents, and operational procedures. Participate in code reviews and ensure development follows ETL standards and best practices. 2. Google BigQuery & Data Lake / Data Warehouse Design and develop data processing solutions using Google BigQuery . Develop complex SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, aggregation, validation, and analytics. Create and maintain BigQuery datasets, tables, views, materialized views, and stored procedures where required. Design data models suitable for analytical and reporting requirements. Develop and maintain cloud-based Data Lake / Data Warehouse solutions. Work with structured and semi-structured data from SAP, databases, APIs, and files. Implement efficient data ingestion and transformation pipelines. Design and implement incremental data loading and historical data management strategies. Implement BigQuery partitioning and clustering based on data access patterns. Optimize SQL queries and BigQuery workloads for performance and cost efficiency. Monitor data processing and investigate query/data pipeline performance issues. Implement data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliation. Work with large datasets and optimize data processing approaches. Support data migration and data transformation initiatives. Assist in designing scalable and maintainable cloud data architectures. Collaborate with BI/analytics teams to provide trusted datasets for reporting and dashboards. 3. Integration & Automation Develop end-to-end solutions combining RPA, ETL, SAP, databases, APIs, and BigQuery . Identify opportunities to integrate RPA automation with data engineering workflows. Automate manual data extraction, transformation, validation, and reporting processes. Develop solutions for transferring data between enterprise applications and cloud platforms. Work with APIs and web services for system integration. Handle JSON, XML, CSV, Excel, and other data formats. Design reliable and reusable integration components. Troubleshoot issues across the complete automation and data pipeline. Required Technical Skills Informatica / ETL 3+ years of practical experience with Informatica / Informatica IICS . Strong understanding of ETL/ELT concepts. Experience developing Informatica mappings, mapping tasks, and workflows. Experience with source-to-target mapping and data transformation. Experience with full and incremental data loads. Experience integrating data from multiple source systems. Strong understanding of data cleansing, validation, reconciliation, and error handling. Experience troubleshooting and optimizing ETL workflows. SQL / BigQuery Strong SQL development skills. Hands-on experience with Google BigQuery . Understanding of BigQuery datasets, tables, views, and schemas. Experience with partitioning and clustering. Experience optimizing SQL queries and BigQuery processing costs. Understanding of data warehouse concepts and dimensional modeling is preferred. Programming / Scripting Good working knowledge of at least one programming/scripting language: Python /Java /JavaScript Python experience for data processing, automation, or API integration will be an advantage. Experience 4–6 Years The candidate should have demonstrated hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas, with the ability to work across the complete technology stack: Automation Anywhere / Automation 360 Informatica / IICS SQL Google BigQuery Data Lake / Data Warehouse ETL / Data Integration Python / scripting SAP automation or SAP data integration Candidates with strong experience across RPA + Informatica + BigQuery will be preferred.

Key Skills: ETL tool,Data integration,Big Data,Automation,SQL,Data,Python,ETL Development

 About Us: We are a forward-thinking growth marketing team at the intersection of data, technology, and performance media. We leverage MarTech ecosystems, automation, and advanced analytics to drive scalable acquisition systems and measurable revenue growth. 
 Role Overview: We are looking for a Performance Marketing Manager with deep technical expertise in MarTech, analytics, and campaign optimization. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of media buying, data strategy, and automation using technology to deliver high-impact results across multiple paid channels. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 1. Paid Media Architecture & Optimization Design and manage multi-channel acquisition strategies across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, and programmatic DSPs.

 2. Audience Management & Data Strategy Build cross-channel audience frameworks using CRM, CDP integrations, and event-based triggers.

 Develop and maintain data layer specifications (DLV) and GTM containers for accurate event tracking.

 Implement server-side tagging and CAPI setups to improve attribution and mitigate signal loss (ITP, ATT).

 Collaborate with DevOps and Data Engineering teams to unify campaign data into BI dashboards.

 4. Analytics, Measurement & Attribution Develop multi-touch attribution models (linear, time decay, data-driven) to evaluate ROI across channels.

 Build automated dashboards to track CPA, ROAS, CLV, and CAC payback period using GA4, BigQuery, and Looker Studio.

 Implement data validation and anomaly detection scripts to ensure accuracy.

 Partner with finance and sales ops to align marketing performance with pipeline and revenue.

 5. Social Media & Content Amplification Lead paid and organic strategies on Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and YouTube, integrating content intelligence with performance data.

 Use AI-driven creative analysis tools (Pattern89, CreativeX) to optimize ad creative iterations.

 Integrate social signals into attribution and engagement scoring models to measure brand lift and awareness impact.

 Qualifications: Bachelors or Master’s in Marketing, Data Science, Computer Science, or related field.

 5–8 years of hands-on performance marketing experience with a focus on MarTech and analytics.

 Advanced knowledge of Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and Tag Manager.

 Experience with GA4, BigQuery, SQL, Looker Studio (or equivalent BI platforms).

 Proficiency in server-side tracking, GTM custom templates, data layers, and API integrations.

 Familiarity with Python or JavaScript for campaign automation and data manipulation.

 Understanding of attribution modeling (MTA, MMM), conversion funnel economics, and media mix optimization. 
 KPIs: CAC, ROAS, and LTV:CAC ratio

 Cross-channel attribution accuracy and conversion signal strength

 Lift in audience conversion from first-party data utilization

 Automation efficiency (manual hours reduced per campaign cycle)

 Incremental revenue contribution from paid channels 
 Preferred Tools & Stack: Ad Platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok Ads, Reditt, DV360

 Analytics: GA4, Google Tag Manager, BigQuery, Looker Studio, Power BI

 MarTech: HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo, Segment, Zapier, GTM

 Automation: Google Ads Scripts, Meta API, Python workflows

 Optimization: Hotjar, Optimizely, VWO, Microsoft Clarity

Working knowledge of at least one programming language, preferably Python, R, MATLAB, or C++. Demonstrable experience applying programming in doctoral research or professional projects. Software development: Git/GitHub, debugging, testing, algorithms, and data structures. Databases: SQL, PostgreSQL, or MySQL. Automation: Research workflow automation and data pipelines.  CV Screening Criteria Candidates will be evaluated based on: Completion of a PhD in a relevant STEM discipline. Proficiency in at least one programming language. Practical coding experience in research or professional projects. Experience with computational analysis, simulations, data processing, or algorithm development. Evidence of independently developing or modifying code, supported by specific projects, research work, or professional achievements. 
 Important: Merely listing Python, MATLAB, or another programming language in the CV is not sufficient. title: Support Operations Lead
description:
Support Operations Lead Job Description
 
 Support Operations Lead
 Role Overview
 We are hiring a Support Operations Lead to own the operations side of customer support. You will pair with
 our Support Product Manager, and the two of you will own Support as a function together: you own how
 support runs, they own the products and tools it runs on.
 Your goal is simple to state and hard to do: learners get fast, correct, friendly help, and the support team
 runs on clear processes and the right metrics.
 
 Position Details
 Employment Type Full Time
 Experience 2–4 years in customer support or customer service, at manager level or
 above, in a consumer (B2C) product company
 Location Remote, Kolkata (preferred)
 Work Days 5 Days (official). Weekend work may be required depending on business
 requirements, as this is a Support position.
 
 Key Responsibilities
 What you will do
 • Own support operations end to end: queues, routing, SLAs, escalations, staffing and shift planning.
 • Pick the metrics that matter (first response time, resolution time, first contact resolution, CSAT, ticket
 volume per learner, backlog) and review them every week.
 • Design and document support processes, macros and escalation paths, and keep them current as the
 product changes.
 • Find the top reasons learners contact us, and work with the Support PM and other product teams to
 remove them at the source.
 • Work with the Support PM on bots, self-serve help and tooling. Bring the ground truth from the floor
 into what gets built.
 • Run quality: ticket audits, feedback loops and training for agents, including training on new product
 changes.
 • Lead and grow the support team leads, and build a culture of ownership and care for the learner. 
 What you bring
 • 2–4 years in customer support or customer service, with at least part of that as a manager or above, in
 a consumer (B2C) product company.
 • You have owned support metrics and can show a time you improved them, with the before and after
 numbers.
 • You have designed support processes from scratch or fixed broken ones: routing, SLAs, escalation,
 QA.
 • Hands-on with helpdesk and support tools (for example Freshdesk, Zendesk, Intercom or similar) and

 Desired Candidate Profile 
 Strong practical knowledge of construction quality and site execution. Ability to independently manage QA/QC activities for major project work fronts. Strong documentation and reporting skills. Good communication and coordination skills with consultants, PMC and contractors. Strong analytical and problem-solving ability. Firm approach towards maintaining project quality standards. description:
Job Description Database Administrator (DBA) Experience: 2–5+ Years
 Technology: MySQL, PostgreSQL
 Job Type: Full-Time
 Department: Software Development / IT Infrastructure Job Summary We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Database Administrator (DBA) with 2–5+ years of experience in managing, maintaining, securing, and optimizing MySQL and PostgreSQL databases. The candidate will be responsible for database performance tuning, backup and recovery, database security, troubleshooting, high availability, and ensuring the reliability and integrity of enterprise application databases. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience supporting production databases, optimizing complex queries, implementing database best practices, and collaborating with developers and DevOps teams. Key Responsibilities 1. Database Administration Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade MySQL and PostgreSQL database servers. Manage database schemas, tables, indexes, views, stored procedures, functions, and triggers. Perform database creation, user management, access control, and privilege administration. Monitor database health, availability, resource utilization, and capacity. 2. Performance Optimization Analyze and optimize SQL queries, execution plans, indexes, and database structures. Identify and resolve slow queries, locking issues, deadlocks, and performance bottlenecks. Perform database tuning to improve application response times and transaction processing. Monitor CPU, memory, disk I/O, connections, and database workloads. 3. Backup and Disaster Recovery Plan, configure, and monitor automated database backups. Implement and test database restoration and recovery procedures. Manage point-in-time recovery, transaction logs, and PostgreSQL WAL archiving, as applicable. Develop and maintain disaster recovery plans and validate backup integrity. Define and support Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) requirements. 4. Database Security Implement database security policies, role-based access control, and least-privilege permissions. Manage database users, authentication, encryption, and secure connections. Apply security patches, database updates, and configuration hardening. Monitor database logs and investigate unauthorized access or suspicious activities. Support compliance, audit requirements, and data protection policies. 5. High Availability and Reliability Configure and maintain replication and database high-availability mechanisms. Monitor replication lag and troubleshoot replication failures. Support failover, recovery, and database availability procedures. Assist in database migration, version upgrades, and infrastructure changes. 6. Development and DevOps Support Collaborate with PHP and other application development teams on database design and optimization. Review SQL scripts, schema changes, and database migration procedures. Support development, testing, staging, and production environments. Work with DevOps teams to integrate database deployment and maintenance into CI/CD pipelines. Automate routine database administration tasks using shell scripts or other suitable scripting tools. 7. Monitoring and Documentation Monitor database logs, alerts, availability, and performance metrics. Troubleshoot database incidents and provide timely resolution. Maintain database architecture documents, operational procedures, and recovery runbooks. Prepare periodic reports on database performance, capacity, backup status, and incidents. Required Technical Skills Strong hands-on experience with MySQL and PostgreSQL administration. Good knowledge of SQL, advanced queries, joins, indexing, transactions, and query optimization. Understanding of database normalization, relational database design, and schema management. Experience with database backup, restoration, replication, and recovery. Knowledge of database security, authentication, access control, and auditing. Familiarity with Linux server administration and command-line operations. Experience with database monitoring and performance diagnostic tools. Knowledge of database migration, patching, upgrades, and production troubleshooting. Basic scripting skills in Bash/Shell or Python. Understanding of TCP/IP, database connectivity, connection pooling, and application integration. Preferred Skills Experience with MySQL replication, PostgreSQL streaming replication, and high-availability configurations. Familiarity with tools. Exposure to cloud database services such as AWS RDS, Amazon Aurora, Azure Database, or Google Cloud SQL. Knowledge of Docker, containerized deployments, and CI/CD processes. Experience working with large databases and high-transaction-volume applications. Familiarity with database encryption, audit logging, and security best practices. Role & responsibilities

title: Product Manager
description:
Product Manager - NxtWave Academy NxtWave | Hyderabad | Mon-Fri | Full-Time 
 About the Role 
 The Product Manager - NxtWave Academy owns the learning product: the experience that takes a student from enrolment through active learning to course completion. This is the product-side owner of the Academy's retention and engagement north star - the person who moves activation, weekly-active-learning, progression and in-journey drop-off through the product itself (features, nudges, personalization, AI-first learning tools). It is a hands-on, experimentation-first, AI-first role: you frame problems, separate assumption from evidence, and ship and read experiments rather than execute a pre-decided feature list. 

 What You'll Own 
 Learning Product & Funnel Ownership Own and improve the in-product learner journey: activation -> active learning -> progression -> completion. Define and track the Academy learning-product metric tree (activation, WAL, progression velocity, feature adoption, in-journey drop-off). Diagnose drop-off with data before proposing a fix; instrument events and build the dashboards you rely on. 
 AI-First Product Delivery Ship features leveraging LLMs, agents, retrieval and automation (adaptive practice, doubt-solving, recommendations); write clear PRDs/DRDs. Partner with Engineering, Design and Data for fast, high-quality delivery; maintain backlog clarity across initiatives. 
 Experimentation & Prioritization Run structured, hypothesis-driven experiments across the learning journey; read them honestly and kill bad bets. Separate validated evidence from stakeholder assumption before committing engineering effort. Prioritize a constrained roadmap and defend trade-offs. 
 Cross-Functional Alignment Align Engineering, Design, Data, Curriculum and the Retention Head on a single prioritized roadmap. Present recommendations - including 'no build' recommendations - to leadership with evidence. Ensure learner privacy, data safety and ethical AI usage; own pre-launch QA and safe rollout. 
 What Success Looks Like Improve new-learner activation rate (student reaches the first meaningful learning milestone) by an agreed % QoQ, owned end-to-end (hypothesis -> build -> measure -> iterate). Reduce in-product drop-off at the weakest identified journey stage by an agreed % within 2 quarters of it being flagged. Improve weekly-active-learner (WAL) rate and average course-progression velocity through product interventions (in-app nudges, streaks, resume-flows, personalization). Ship statistically-sound product experiments every quarter across the learning journey, each with a documented hypothesis, result, and ship/kill/iterate decision. Define, instrument, and own the Academy learning-product metric tree; every shipped initiative has a pre-defined success metric before engineering effort is committed. Ship AI-first learning features (adaptive practice, doubt-solving, recommendations) that show measurable lift in progression or engagement for the targeted cohort. 
 Must-Have Has owned a product surface end-to-end and can name an activation / engagement / retention / progression metric they personally moved, with a number. Can walk through a real experiment: hypothesis, design, result, and the ship/kill/iterate decision it drove. Comfortable doing their own funnel/cohort analysis (SQL or a product-analytics tool like Amplitude/Mixpanel). Comfortable with ambiguity and multi-stakeholder pushback; can prioritize a constrained roadmap and defend the cuts. 
 Good-to-Have EdTech / learning-science / gamification / subscription-growth experience - faster ramp on learner-journey mechanics. Has built or briefed personalization / recommendation / adaptive-learning systems. 0->1 product experience in an unstructured, low-process environment. 
 Location & Work Week Hyderabad MondayFriday (5 days) 
 Compensation Fixed + annual variable + retention component. Final structure by level and experience.

 Support Operations Lead
 Role Overview
 We are hiring a Support Operations Lead to own the operations side of customer support. You will pair with

 support runs, they own the products and tools it runs on.

 above, in a consumer (B2C) product company

 requirements, as this is a Support position.
 
 Key Responsibilities
 What you will do

Job Summary We are looking for a hands-on Production Manager Silage Operations to manage the complete silage production process. The role involves working closely with farmers for crop procurement, negotiating crop prices, arranging harvesting machinery and manpower, supervising silage production, and coordinating transportation for timely dispatch to customer locations. The candidate should be comfortable working in field conditions and independently managing day-to-day farm and silage operations. Key Responsibilities 1. Crop Procurement & Farmer Coordination Identify and coordinate with farmers for crop procurement required for silage production. Build and maintain good relationships with farmers. Visit farms and assess crop availability, quality, quantity, and harvesting stage . Negotiate crop prices with farmers based on crop quality and prevailing market conditions. Finalize procurement quantities and ensure timely availability of crops for production. 2. Harvesting & Machinery Coordination Plan and coordinate crop harvesting activities with farmers. Arrange required harvesting machines, balers, chaff cutters, tractors, and other equipment . Coordinate with machine operators and ensure machines are available as per the harvesting schedule. Monitor harvesting activities to ensure minimum crop wastage and timely completion. 3. Silage Production Operations Manage the complete day-to-day silage production process at the field/site. Coordinate with labourers and machine operators involved in silage production. Ensure proper handling, processing, baling, wrapping, and storage of silage. Monitor the quality of silage during production. Ensure production is completed as per required quality, quantity, and timelines . 4. Labour & Team Management Plan and allocate labour according to daily production requirements. Supervise labourers, machine operators, drivers, and field workers. Monitor attendance, productivity, and work quality. Ensure proper coordination between farmers, labourers, operators, and internal teams. Maintain discipline and ensure safe working practices at the site. 5. Dispatch & Transportation Coordinate with transporters for loading and dispatch of finished silage . Plan transportation based on customer requirements and production schedules. Coordinate loading, vehicle placement, documentation, and timely dispatch. Ensure material reaches the client/customer location within the committed timeline. Track dispatched material and coordinate with customers regarding delivery. 6. Daily Operations & Reporting Prepare daily plans for crop procurement, harvesting, production, and dispatch . Maintain records of crop procurement, farmer details, crop quantity, pricing, production, labour, machinery, and dispatch. Monitor daily production and procurement costs. Report operational progress, challenges, and requirements to the Head – Production. Ensure efficient utilization of manpower, machinery, and other resources. Required Skills & Experience 4–7 years of experience in farm operations, agricultural production, silage, fodder, dairy, or related fields . Hands-on experience in farm operations and crop procurement . Experience in farmer coordination and crop price negotiation . Experience in managing farm labour and machine operators . Good understanding of crop harvesting and agricultural machinery . Experience in silage production will be strongly preferred. Good coordination skills with farmers, labourers, machine operators, and transporters. Ability to work independently in field/farm locations . Good communication, negotiation, and people-management skills. Willingness to travel to farms and production locations as required.
